records.japanese: うちの　ミツルは　どこまで\nあそびに　いっちゃったの　かしら‥‥\cもう　そろそろ　シダケタウンに\nでかける　じかん　だって　いうのに‥‥
records.english: Where has our WALLY gone?\cWe have to leave for VERDANTURF TOWN\nvery soon...

records.japanese:
きみ！　もしかして‥‥
トレーナーに　なりたて　かい？\cぼくら　ポケモン　トレーナーは
あたらしい　まちに　とうちゃく　したら\cまずは　そこに　どんな　ジムがあるのか
かくにん　しておく　ものなんだ！
records.english:
Hiya! Are you maybe...
A rookie TRAINER?\cDo you know what POKéMON TRAINERS
do when they reach a new town?\cThey first check what kind of GYM
is in the town.

records.japanese: ほら　ここが　トウカシティの　ジムさ！
records.english: See? This is PETALBURG CITY's GYM.

records.japanese: これが　ジムの　かんばん　だから\nかたちを　よく　おぼえておくと　いいね！
records.english: This is the GYM's sign. Look for it\nwhenever you're looking for a GYM.

records.japanese: ぼくの　かおが　すいめんに　うつってる‥‥\cきぼうに　あふれた\nかがやく　えがお‥‥\cふあんと　たたかう\nしずかな　ちんもく‥‥\cきみの　かおは　どんなふうに　うつってる？
records.english: My face is reflected in the water.\cIt's a shining grin full of hope...\cOr it could be a look of somber silence\nstruggling with fear...\cWhat do you see reflected in your face?

records.japanese: ポケモンを　すでに　６ぴき　もってるときに\nあたらしく　ポケモンを　つかまえる\cすると　パソコン　つうしんで　じどうてきに\nボックスに　おくられるのだよ！
records.english: Let's say you have six POKéMON.\nIf you catch another one...\cIt is automatically sent to a STORAGE\nBOX over a PC connection.

records.japanese: トウカ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　センリ\rつよさを　おいもとめる　おとこ！
records.english: PETALBURG CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: NORMAN\r“A man in pursuit of power!”

records.japanese: ここは　トウカ　シティ\nしぜんと　ひとが　ふれあう　まち
records.english: PETALBURG CITY\n“Where people mingle with nature.”

records.japanese: 「ミツルの　いえ」
わし　がんばりや！\nがんばって　いろいろ　うりますよ！
records.english: I'm the ENERGY GURU!\nI'll go for it and sell you what you need!

records.japanese: あら？\nきみの　[STR_VAR_1]‥‥
ものすごく　がんばったのね！\cごほうびと　して\nこの　がんばリボンを　つけてあげて！
records.english: Went for it stupendously!\cAs its reward, please give it this\nEFFORT RIBBON.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　がんばリボンを　もらった！
[PLAYER]は　がんばリボンを\n[STR_VAR_1]に　つけて　あげた！
もっと　がんばってみて！\cがんばれば　わたしが　ポケモンに\nいいもの　あげるから！
records.english: You have to go for it a little harder.\cIf you do, I'll give your POKéMON\nsomething nice.

records.japanese: あっ！　きみの　[STR_VAR_1]\nがんばリボン　にあってるよ！
records.english: Oh! Your [STR_VAR_1], that EFFORT\nRIBBON looks good on it!

records.japanese: とうだいの　あかりは\nすう１０キロさき　にも　とどくんだ\cうみの　なかの　ポケモン\nまぶしくて　おどろいて　いないかな？
records.english: The light of the lighthouse reaches\ndozens of miles away.\cI wonder if it doesn't startle POKéMON\nin the sea.

records.japanese: ほれ　みてみろ！\cこのあたりで　とれる　かいそうは\nしんせん　ピチピチ！\cいまにも　おそい　かかって　きそうだ！
records.english: Ooh, look at this!\cThe seaweed you can get around these\nparts is fresh and full of life.\cWhy, it looks like it can even rear up\nand attack!

records.japanese: みずの　きれいな　ところに\nたくさんの　みのりが　あつまり\cひとびとが　やってくる　ところに\nいちばが　できる‥‥\cこうして　まちは　おおきくなるのさ
records.english: Where the water is clean, the fruits\nof bountiful harvest gather.\cAnd where people gather, a market\nsoon starts.\cThat is how a town is born and grows.

records.japanese: うみの　かおりが　する　ばしょで\nかいものが　できるなんて‥‥\cカイナって　すてきな　ところ！
records.english: Shopping where you can breathe the\nscent of the ocean...\cSLATEPORT is such a wonderful place!

records.japanese: ぬいぐるみや　クッションって\nゆかに　おくと　よごれちゃうでしょ？\cだから　きれいなまま　かざれるように\nぬいぐるみや　クッションを　おくための\rレンガを　かいに　きたの！
records.english: If you put DOLLS or CUSHIONS on the\nfloor, they'll get dirty.\cI'm going to buy some BRICKS so my\nDOLLS and CUSHIONS won't get dirty\rwhen I leave them out.

records.japanese: うぉー！　ながい　あいだ　まちわびた\nポケモン　コンテスト！\rぼくも　しゅつじょう　するぞおー！\cと　そのまえに！\nポケモン　つかまえて　こなくちゃ！
records.english: Yeah! I've waited so long for this!\nPOKéMON CONTESTS!\rI'm going to enter!\cBut before I do, I have to catch some\nPOKéMON!

records.japanese: ふぅ　ふぅ‥‥\cおれは　キンセツシティ　から\nあるいて　ここまで　きたんだけど\rこの　まちって　ひろいなぁ‥‥\cこんな　ことなら　じてんしゃに\nのって　くれば　よかったよ！
records.english: Whew... I'm just bushed...\cI hiked over from MAUVILLE CITY.\nBut, boy, this city's huge.\cIf I'd known this, I would've ridden\nmy BIKE here.

records.japanese:
この　はくぶつかんを　つくった
クスノキ　という　じんぶつは\cかいてい　ちょうさたい　の
リーダーでも　あるんだ！\cどっちにせよ　みんなは　かれの　ことを
クスノキかんちょう　と　よんでいるよ！
records.english: STERN, the fellow who built the\nMUSEUM, also happens to be the leader\rof an undersea exploration team.\cSo, everyone calls him CAPT. STERN.

records.japanese: なんなのかしら\nあの　ぎょうれつ？
records.english: What is that over there?\nThat long line...

records.japanese: この　はくぶつかん　には\nこどもの　ころ　わたしも　よく　きました\cかんないの　てんじひんを　みて\nうみの　しんぴに　あこがれた　ものです
records.english: When I was a child, I visited the\nMUSEUM often.\cI used to dream about the mysteries of\nthe sea after seeing the exhibits.

records.japanese: ちょっと　あんた！　おさないでよ！\nじゅんばん　なんだから！
records.english: Hey, there! Quit pushing!\nThis is the line, can't you see?

records.japanese: おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　ポリシーは\n「げんち　しゅうごう」　そして\r「げんち　かいさん」　なんだぜ！
records.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] has a policy of\nassembling and dispersing at the\roperation site.

records.japanese: リーダーほど　あたまの　いい　ひとが\nいまさら　はくぶつかんに\rなんの　ようじが　あるんだ‥‥？
records.english: Our BOSS is brilliant.\cWhat would he want to do with a\nMUSEUM now?

records.japanese: こんどの　さくせんは　なんだろう？\cリーダーを　おこらせると　こわいから\nしっぱい　したくないぜ‥‥
records.english: What's the new scheme, I wonder?\cOur BOSS is scary when he's mad, so\nI'd better not screw things up...

records.japanese: はくぶつかんに　ほしいもの　あるなら\nまるごと　うばっちゃえば　いいのに‥‥
records.english: If there's something we need in the\nMUSEUM, we should take it all!

records.japanese: おい　こら！\nじゅんばん　ぬかすなよ！
ぎょうれつ　というと\nだいにんきの　ゲームを　かったときを\rおもいだすなあ‥‥
records.english: A long line, huh?\cIt reminds me of the times I lined up to\nbuy smash-hit games...

records.japanese: まじめに　おかね　はらわずに\nむりやり　はいれば　いいのによ！
records.english: Why are we even lining up and paying?\nWe should just march in!

records.japanese: うみって　おおきいなあ‥‥\cひょっとして　うみって\nポケモンが　ながした　なみだで\rできてるのかなあ‥‥
records.english: The sea is just so vast...\cCould the sea have been made by the\ntears shed by POKéMON?

records.japanese: ふるく　なって　のれない　ふねは\nどうするか　しって　いるかね？\cうみの　そこに　しずめて\nポケモンの　すみかに　してやるのだよ！
records.english: Do you know what they do with old\nships that become too creaky to sail?\cThey sink them in the sea so they\nbecome habitats for POKéMON.

records.japanese: ここに　くると　うれしくて\nつい　たくさん　かいもの　しちゃう！
records.english: Whenever I visit here, I get carried\naway and buy too much.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　ニックネームを　かえたいなら\nせいめい　はんだんしに　たのむんだね！
records.english: If you want to change your POKéMON's\nnickname, you'll have to get the NAME\rRATER to help you.

records.japanese: ひとと　こうかんした　ポケモンは\nニックネームを　かえられないわよ！\cだって　つけた　ひとの　きもちが\nこめられて　いるんですもの！
records.english: Any POKéMON you get in a trade, you\ncan't change its nickname.\cThe original TRAINER's love for that\nPOKéMON is in the nickname.

records.japanese: さいきん　カイナにも\nコンテストかいじょうが　できたんだ\cぼくも　ポケモンの　コンディションを\nたかめて　しゅつじょう　する　つもりさ
records.english: A POKéMON CONTEST HALL opened in\nSLATEPORT recently.\cI plan on entering after I improve the\ncondition of my POKéMON.

records.japanese: きのみブレンダー　っていう\nマシンを　しってるかい？
records.english: Do you know about the machine\nBERRY BLENDER?

records.japanese: みんなで　こうそくで　まわし　まくるんだ\cすっげー　はやいと\nすっげー　いいポロックが　できるらしいぜ！
records.english: People have to work together to get it\nto spin faster.\cThe faster you can make it spin, the\nbetter [POKEBLOCK]S you can get, I've heard.

records.japanese: ポロックっていう　おかしが　できるんだぜ\cいいポロックを　つくると　ポケモンの\nコンディションも　ぐーんと　アップさ！
records.english: It's used for making a kind of candy\ncalled a [POKEBLOCK].\cIf you give a good [POKEBLOCK] to a POKéMON,\nits condition will improve by a lot.

records.japanese: ゆうめいな　スターが　きていたら\nサインを　もらうつもり　だったのに\cインタビュー　されてるのは\nあれ‥‥　クスノキさん　でないかい？
records.english: I was hoping that it was a famous star\nso I could get an autograph.\cBut who's that being interviewed?\nIsn't that CAPT. STERN?

records.japanese: あの　インタビュアーの　おねえさん\nかっこよくて　びじん！\cあたしも　おおきく　なったら\nこくさい　ジャーナリストに　なるわ！
records.english: That lady interviewer is so cool and\npretty.\cWhen I grow up, I'm going to be an\ninternational journalist!

records.japanese: クスノキかんちょうは　うみの　そこで\nなにかを　はっけん　したんだって！\cなんだろなー？　なんだろなー？
records.english: CAPT. STERN says they discovered\nsomething at the bottom of the sea.\cI wonder what it is?\nWhat could it be?

records.japanese: なんだ　なんだ！？\cかんちょうは　うみの　そこから\nおおもの　でも　つりあげたのか？
records.english: What's going on here?\cDid the good CAPTAIN come back with\na big fish from the ocean floor?

records.japanese: みんなー！　みてるかー！\nおれも　テレビに　うつってるかー？
records.english: Hey! Are you watching?\nAm I on TV?

records.japanese: テレビが　しゅざいに　くる　なんて\nかんちょうも　ゆうめいじん　ですなあ！
records.english: A TV interview! Here!\nThe CAPTAIN's a celebrity!

records.japanese: ダイ『はい　クスノキさん\nそこで　えがお！
records.english: TY: Okay, CAPT. STERN, a big smile\nfor the camera!

records.japanese: マリ『なるほど　なるほど　それは\nきちょうな　たいけんを　なさいましたね‥‥
records.english: GABBY: I see, I see. You've had a most\ninvaluable experience...

records.japanese: クスノキ『‥‥というわけで　こんごも\nちょうさは　つづけて　いきますよ！
records.english: CAPT. STERN: Yes, indeed. We intend to\nmove ahead with our exploration.

records.japanese: マリ『そうですか　いやあ　クスノキさん！\nきょうは　おいそがしい　ところ\rどうも　ありがとう　ございました！\cまた　なにか　はっけんが　ありましたら\nぜひ　しゅざい　させて　くださいね！
records.english: GABBY: That's wonderful, CAPT. STERN!\nThank you for taking the time from\ryour busy schedule to talk to us.\cWe hope we can interview you again\nwith news of more discoveries!

records.japanese: クスノキ『ふう‥‥\cテレビカメラに　うつされる　なんて\nはじめて　だったから　きんちょう　したよ！
records.english: CAPT. STERN: Whew...\cThat was my first time to be filmed for\nTV. That was nerve wracking.

records.japanese:
おっ！　[PLAYER][KUN]
げんきそう　だね！\cこんかいの　かいてい　ちょうさで
すごい　はっけんを　したんだよ！\c１２８ばん　すいどうで
おおむかしに　ぜつめつ　したと　いわれるポケモンの　すみかと　おもわれるかいてい　どうくつを　みつけた‥‥
records.english:
Oh! [PLAYER][KUN]!
You're looking great!\cWe made a huge discovery on our last
seafloor exploration.\cWe found an underwater cavern on
ROUTE 128.\cWe think it's the habitat of a POKéMON
that's said to have been long extinct.

records.japanese:
『フフフ‥‥
クスノキかんちょう　とやら\cきみの　せんすいていは
われわれ　[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　いただく！\cきみたちは　われわれに　だまって
きょうりょく　すれば　いいのだよ！\cフフフ‥‥
これから　[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　なにを　するかたのしみに　していたまえ！』
records.english:
Fufufu...
CAPT. STERN, I presume.\cWe of TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] will assume
control of your submarine!\cYour objections are meaningless!
We expect your total cooperation!\cFufufu...
Just watch and learn what TEAM[EVIL_TEAM] has planned!

records.japanese: クスノキ『いまの　こえは‥‥？\cだれかが　かくせいきを　つかって‥‥\cどこから　はなしてるんだ‥‥？
records.english: CAPT. STERN: What was that all about?\cIt sounded like someone using a\nmegaphone...\cWhere did it come from?

records.japanese: ふねのりばの　なか！\cせんすいていが‥‥　うばわれる‥‥？
records.english: It's from the HARBOR!\cThe submarine!\nThey're trying to take it!

records.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]！\nいっしょに　きてくれ！
ポケモンコンテスト　ハイパーランク　うけつけ\nもえあがれ！　ポケモン　トレーナー！
records.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nHYPER RANK REGISTRATION\r“Let it burn! POKéMON TRAINERS!”

records.japanese: 「クスノキ　ぞうせんじょ」\cなみを　じざいに　あやつる　ふなのり\nだいぼしゅう　してます！
records.english: STERN'S SHIPYARD\c“Wanted: A sailor capable of sailing\nin all currents.”

records.japanese: 「クスノキ　ぞうせんじょ」\cカイナと　ミナモを　むすぶ\nれんらくせん　タイドリップごうは\rかんせい　まで　あと　わずか！
records.english: STERN'S SHIPYARD\c“The ferry S.S. TIDAL nears\ncompletion for serving the ports of\rSLATEPORT and LILYCOVE.”

records.japanese: 「クスノキ　ぞうせんじょ」\cれんらくせん　タイドリップごうに\nじょうせんを　きぼう　される　かたは\rふねのりば　うけつけ　まで　どうぞ！
records.english: STERN'S SHIPYARD\c“Boarding of the SLATEPORT-LILYCOVE\nferry S.S. TIDAL is handled at the\rHARBOR.”

records.japanese: 「ポケモン　だいすきクラブ」\nポケモンが　すきなひと　みんな　あつまれ！
records.english: POKéMON FAN CLUB\n“Calling all fans of POKéMON!”

records.japanese: はてしない　うみ‥‥\nそれは　いのちの　みなもと‥‥\c「うみの　かがく　はくぶつかん」
ここは　カイナ　シティ\nヒトと　ポケモンが　いきかう　みなと
records.english: SLATEPORT CITY\c“The port where people and POKéMON\ncross paths.”

records.japanese: 「カイナ　いちば」\nここでしか　かえない　もの　たくさん！
records.english: SLATEPORT MARKET\n“Unique items found nowhere else!”

records.japanese: 「カイナ　シティ　ふねのりば」\cれんらくせん　タイドリップごう　は\nぞうせんじょ　にて　けんぞう　ちゅう！\cもう　しばらく　おまちください！
records.english: SLATEPORT HARBOR\c“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in the SHIPYARD.\c“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”

records.japanese: 「カイナ　シティ　ふねのりば」\cれんらくせん　タイドリップごうで\nふねの　たびを　おたのしみ　ください！
records.english: SLATEPORT HARBOR\c“Enjoy a delightful cruise on the\nferry S.S. TIDAL.”

records.japanese: 「せいめい　はんだんし　の　いえ」\nポケモンの　なまえ　うらないます
おじさん『このこは　ポケモンの　おかげで\nげんきに　なれたような　もんだけど\rちょっと　げんきに　なりすぎ　なんだ‥‥
records.english: UNCLE: It's because of POKéMON that\nthis boy's got more pep, I suppose...\rBut he's become a bit too peppy...

records.japanese: ミツル『おじさん　おねがい　だから！\cじぶんが　どれくらい　つよくなったか\nこのジムで　ためして　みたいんだ！\cね　ね　いいでしょう！？
records.english: WALLY: Aww, UNCLE, please?\cI want to challenge this GYM and see\nhow much better I've become.\cPlease? May I, please?

records.japanese: おじさん『まあまあ　ミツルくん！\cたしかに　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nくらすように　なってから\rきみは　ずいぶん　げんきに　なった！\cだからって　いきなり　ポケモンジムに\nちょうせん　なんて　むり　してないかい？
records.english: UNCLE: Now hold on, WALLY.\cSince you started living with POKéMON,\nyou have grown quite a lot stronger.\cBut don't you think you're pushing it\nto suddenly challenge a GYM?

records.japanese: ミツル『むり　なんか　してません\cぼくと　ラルトスが　ちからを　あわせれば\nだれにだって　かてる　はずです！
records.english: WALLY: I'm not pushing it.\cIf I combine forces with RALTS,\nwe can beat anyone!

records.japanese: ミツル『あっ！　[PLAYER]さん！\cぼく　あれから　つよくなったんだ！\cそれを　[PLAYER]さんにも　\nおじさんにも　わかって　もらいたいんです！\c[PLAYER]さん　おねがいです！\nぼくと　しょうぶ　してください
records.english:
WALLY: Oh! Hi, [PLAYER]!\cI've gotten a lot stronger since we
met.\c[PLAYER], I want you and my UNCLE to
understand that.\c[PLAYER], please, will you have a
battle with me?

records.japanese: ミツル『[PLAYER]さんが\nぼくと　しょうぶ　してくれないと‥‥\cおじさんに　ぼくが　つよくなったこと\nわかって　もらえないよ‥‥
records.english: WALLY: Oh... If you won't battle me,\n[PLAYER], my UNCLE won't know that I've\rbecome really strong.

records.japanese: おじさん『[PLAYER][KUN]とやら\nわるいけど　ミツルくんと\rしょうぶ　してあげて　くれないかな？\cこのままだと　なにを　いっても\nきいて　もらえそうに　ないよ
records.english: UNCLE: [PLAYER][KUN], was it?\nOn WALLY's behalf, can I ask you to\rbattle with him just this once?\cI don't think he's going to listen to\nany reason the way he is now.

records.japanese: ミツル『[PLAYER]さん　おねがいです！\nぼくと　しょうぶ　してください
ミツル『ありがとう　[PLAYER]さん\cそれでは‥‥　いきますね！
records.english: WALLY: [PLAYER], thank you.\cOkay... Here I come!

records.japanese: ミツル『おじさん‥‥\nぼく　シダケに　もどります
records.english: WALLY: UNCLE...\nI'll go back to VERDANTURF...

records.japanese: [PLAYER]さん　ありがとう\nやっぱり　トレーナーって　すごいんですね\cただ　ポケモンを　もっていて\nたたかわせる　だけじゃ　ほんとうの　いみで\rトレーナーには　なれないんだ‥‥
records.english: [PLAYER], thank you.\nBeing a TRAINER is tough, isn't it?\cIt's not enough just to have POKéMON\nand make them battle. That isn't what\rbeing a real TRAINER is about.

records.japanese:
おじさん『ミツルくん
そんなに　しょげることは　ないよ\cこれから　もっともっと
つよくなれば　いいじゃないか！\cさあ　うちに　かえろう
みんな　まってるよ
records.english:
UNCLE: WALLY, there's no need to be so
down on yourself.\cWhy, what's keeping you from becoming
stronger and stronger?\cCome on, let's go home.
Everyone's waiting for you.

records.japanese: おじさん『なるほど　ミツルくんが\nポケモンを　つかまえるのを\rみまもって　くれたのは　[PLAYER][KUN]！\rきみ　だったんだね\cよかったら　シダケにも\nあそびに　きてくれないか？\rミツルくん　きっと　よろこぶから
records.english: UNCLE: [PLAYER][KUN], it just dawned on me\nthat you must be the TRAINER who kept\ran eye out for WALLY when he caught\rhis POKéMON.\cWhy don't you visit us in VERDANTURF\nsometime?\rI'm sure WALLY would enjoy it.

records.japanese:
テッセン『おお　[PLAYER][KUN]
げんきそうに　しておるのうわっはははは！　いいこと　じゃよ！\cよしっ！　きめた！
[PLAYER][KUN]に　おねがいを　するぞい！\cじつは　この　キンセツには
ニューキンセツ　という　ちかとしが　ある\cで　[PLAYER][KUN]　には
そこの　はつでんそうちの　スイッチをきってきて　ほしいんじゃよ！\cさいきん　はつでんそうちが
ぼうそうぎみで　なにかと　あぶないからのう\cほら　これが　ニューキンセツの
とびらを　あける　カギじゃ！
records.english:
WATTSON: Oh, [PLAYER][KUN]!
You look like you have a lot of zip!That's a good thing, wahahahaha!\cFine! I've decided!
I need a favor, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cMAUVILLE CITY has an underground
sector called NEW MAUVILLE.\c[PLAYER][KUN], I'd like you to go there and
switch off the GENERATOR.\cThe GENERATOR has been running a bit
haywire. It's getting unsafe.\cHere, this is the KEY to get into NEW
MAUVILLE.

records.japanese:
テッセン『なーに
おまえさんなら　だいじょうぶ　じゃ\cちなみに　ニューキンセツの　いりぐちは
１１０ばんどうろで　なみのりを　してすぐの　ところに　あるからのう\cでは　よろしく　たのんだぞ！
わっはははは！
records.english:
WATTSON: Don't you worry about it.
It won't be a challenge to you.\cThe entrance to NEW MAUVILLE is just
a short SURF away from ROUTE 110.\cThat's it, then, you have my trust!
Wahahahaha!

records.japanese: テッセン『わっはははは！\cさすがは　[PLAYER][KUN]！　おまえさんに\nたのんで　せいかい　じゃったよ！\cこれは　おれいじゃ\n１０まんボルトの　わざマシン\rえんりょせずに　もっていくが　いいぞ！
records.english: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\cI knew it, [PLAYER][KUN]! I knew I'd made\nthe right choice asking you!\cThis is my thanks - a TM containing\nTHUNDERBOLT!\cGo on, you've earned it!

records.japanese: テッセン『わっはははは！\cわかものの　たのもしい　すがたを　みるのは\nよろこばしい　こと　じゃな！
records.english: WATTSON: Wahahahaha!\cIt pleases me to no end to see the\nyoung step up and take charge!

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶを　するのも　いいけど\cもしも　じぶんの　ポケモンが\nたたかいで　きずついたり　したなら\rやさしく　いたわって　あげなきゃね！
records.english: You know, it's cool to have POKéMON\nbattles and stuff...\cBut if your POKéMON gets hurt, you\nhave to nurse it back to health.

records.japanese: この　まちは　とうざい　なんぼく　に\nみちが　つうじて　いるから\rいろんな　ひとが　やってきます！
records.english: The roads of this town stretch north\nand south, and east and west.\cBecause of that, we get all sorts of\npeople coming through.

records.japanese: あなた　サイクルショップ　には\nもう　いってみた？\cあそこの　ごしゅじんの　カゼノさんは\nすごく　きまえが　いいのよね！
records.english: Have you been to RYDEL'S CYCLES yet?\cRYDEL, the owner, is a very generous\nman.

records.japanese: じてんしゃに　のっていても\nやせいの　ポケモンは　とびだしてくるよ！
records.english: Even if you're riding a BIKE, wild\nPOKéMON could jump you.

records.japanese: ここは　キンセツ　シティ\nあかるく　かがやく　たのしい　まち
records.english: MAUVILLE CITY\n“The bright and shiny city of fun!”

records.japanese: キンセツ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　テッセン\rあっかるい　でんげき　オヤジ！
records.english: MAUVILLE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WATTSON\r“The cheerfully electrifying man!”

records.japanese: じゃりみち　はしれば　こころも　はずむ！\n「サイクルショップ　カゼノ」
records.english: “Ride in gravel and shake up your\nsoul!”\rRYDEL'S CYCLES

records.japanese: だれもが　あそべる　すてきな　スポット！\n「キンセツ　ゲームコーナー」
records.english: “The play spot for all!”\nMAUVILLE GAME CORNER

records.japanese:
ねえ　きみ
テレビって　チェック　してるかい？\cさいきんに　なって　おもしろい
ばんぐみが　きゅうに　ふえたんだぜ！\cいいよね　テレビって　
いきなり　ともだちの　ことがしょうかい　されたり\cしらない　うちに　じぶんが
テレビに　でていたり　するんだよ\cこんど　ぼくも　テレビに　
うつんない　かなー\cきみも　こんどから
ちゃんと　チェックを　してみなよ！
records.english:
Hi, do you check out TV at all?\cThey've added a bunch of cool new
shows recently.\cTV is so cool. I've seen my friends on
TV just out of the blue.\cAnd, sometimes, they even put you on TV
without telling you.\cI wish I would be on TV sometime.\cThat's why I think you should check
out TVs whenever you can.

records.japanese: やあ！\nテレビは　ちゃんと　チェック　してる？
records.english: Hi, have you been checking out TVs?

records.japanese: デボン　コーポレーション‥‥\nながいから　みんな　デボンって　よぶけど\cあの　かいしゃ　では　いろいろと\nべんりな　ものを　つくってるんだ！
records.english: The DEVON CORPORATION...\nWe all just shorten it to DEVON.\cThat company makes all sorts of\nconvenient products.

records.japanese: ん？　あやしい　おとこ？\cそういえば　にんそうの　わるい　おとこが\nそこの　かどを　まがっていったよ
records.english: Hm? A sneaky-looking man?\cCome to think of it, yes, a shady-\nlooking guy went around the corner.

records.japanese: ポケモンジムに　ちょうせん　したかい？\cあの　キラリと　かがやく\nジムバッジを　もつと　トレーナーとしての\rじかくが　めばえて　くるんだな！
records.english: Have you taken the POKéMON GYM\nchallenge?\cWhen you get that shiny GYM BADGE\nin hand, I guess TRAINERS begin to\rrealize what is required of them.

records.japanese: おっ！　カナズミの　ジムバッジ！\cいくつか　ある　バッジの　なかで\nカナズミの　やつが　いちばん　かっこいいな！
records.english: Hey, that's RUSTBORO's GYM BADGE!\cOut of all the POKéMON GYM BADGES,\nRUSTBORO's is the coolest, I'd say.

records.japanese: おや？　きみは　だれだい？\nこの　あたりでは　みかけない　かお　だね\cトレーナーズ　スクールの　てんこうせい？
records.english: Oh? Who might you be?\nYou're a new face around these parts.\cHave you just transferred into the\nPOKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?

records.japanese: ジムリーダーに　ちょうせん　したけど‥‥\cあたしの　ほのおタイプの　ポケモンじゃ\nちょっと　かつのは　たいへんそう‥‥\cだって　ほのおタイプ　って\nいわタイプに　あいしょうが　わるいもの‥‥
records.english: I challenged the GYM LEADER, but...\cIt's not going to be easy winning with\nmy FIRE-type POKéMON...\cFIRE-type POKéMON don't match up\nwell against ROCK-type POKéMON...

records.japanese: はまべの　こやに　すんでいる\nふなのりの　ハギろうじん\rときどき　トンネルに　さんぽに　いくんだよ
records.english: The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a\ncottage by the sea.\cHe goes for walks in the tunnel every\nso often.

records.japanese: はまべの　こやに　すんでいる\nふなのりの　ハギろうじん\rピーコちゃんの　ために　カイナに　いって\rかいもの　するんだってさ\cほんとうに　ピーコちゃんが　すきなんだな！\nあの　じいさん
records.english:
The old sailor MR. BRINEY lives in a
cottage by the sea.\cHe said he was going shopping in
SLATEPORT for his pet, PEEKO.\cThat old seadog, he must really love
that PEEKO.

records.japanese: あなたも　ポケモンを　つれてるのね\cあたしも　おおきくなったら\nポケモンと　どこかに　いくんだ！
records.english: Wow, you have POKéMON with you, too.\cWhen I get bigger, I'm going to go\nplaces with POKéMON, too.

records.japanese: ぽけもん　とれーなーず　すくーる　かぁ！\cここに　にゅうがく　すれば\nめずらしい　ポケモンでも　かんたんに\rつかまえられるように　なるのかな？
records.english: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL!\cIf I go to this school, will I be able\nto catch rare POKéMON easily?

records.japanese: ポケモンって　たたかいの　けいけんを\nつんでいくと　すがたかたち　が\rかわっちゃうことが　あるんだよ！
records.english: If a POKéMON gains experience in\nbattles, it can sometimes change in\rthe way it looks.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　すがたが　かわっちゃうの？\nいきなり　かわると　ビックリしちゃう！
records.english: A POKéMON changes shape?\nIf one did that, I would be shocked!

records.japanese: ひとと　こうかんした　ポケモンは\nそだつのが　はやい！\c‥‥でも　ジムバッジを　もっていないと\nいうことを　きいて　くれないんだ
records.english: A POKéMON you get in a trade from\nsomeone grows fast.\cBut if you don't have certain GYM\nBADGES, it may not obey you...

records.japanese: どけー！　どけどけー！！
records.english: Get out! Out of the way!

records.japanese: まってぇー！\cその　にもつを　かえしてぇぇぇー！！

ああ　きみは！\cトウカのもりで　たすけてくれた
すてきな　トレーナーじゃ　ないですか！\cおねがいです！\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　うばわれた
デボンのにもつ　とりかえして　ください！\cあれが　ないと‥‥
わたし　とても　こまるんです
records.english:
Oh, it's you!\cYou're that fantastic TRAINER who
helped me in PETALBURG WOODS!\cHelp me! I was robbed by TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!
I have to get the DEVON GOODS back!\cIf I don't...
I'm going to be in serious trouble.

records.japanese: さっきの　あやしい　やつは\nむこうの　トンネルの　ほうに\rにげていったと　おもうのですよ
records.english: That shady character, I think he took\noff towards the tunnel over there.

records.japanese:
ああ！　どうでした
デボンのにもつ　は‥‥？\cそうですか！
とりかえして　くれたのですか！\cきみは　ほんとうに
すごい　トレーナー　ですね！\c‥‥そうだ！　おれいに　また
スーパーボールを　あげちゃおう！
records.english:
Oh! How did it go?
The DEVON GOODS?\cYou did!
You got them back!\cYou really are a great TRAINER!\cI know! As my thanks, I'll give you
another GREAT BALL!

records.japanese: どうぐ　いっぱいで\nスーパーボール　あげられないね
records.english: Your BAG's full.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.

records.japanese: きみ！　きみ！\nわたしに　ついてきて　ください！
records.english: Excuse me, please!\nPlease come with me!

records.japanese: ハルカ『あっ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\nポケモンずかんの　ちょうしは　どう？\cあたしは　かなり　いい　かんじよ\cトウカのもりで\nモンスターボール　なくなる　ぐらい\rポケモン　つかまえた　もの！
records.english: MAY: Oh, hi, [PLAYER][KUN]!\nHow's your POKéDEX coming along?\cMine's looking pretty decent.\cI caught POKéMON in PETALBURG WOODS\nuntil I ran out of POKé BALLS.

records.japanese:
ハルカ『そういえば　トウカのもりで
ハギろうじんと　すれちがったわ\cたぶん‥‥
はまべのこやに　もどるところ　だったのよ！\c[PLAYER][KUN]は　ひっこして　きたから
しらないかも　しれないけどハギろうじん　って　むかしはすっごい　ふなのり　だったんだから！
records.english:
MAY: Oh, by the way, I passed MR. BRINEY
in PETALBURG WOODS.\cI guess he's on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\c[PLAYER][KUN], you just moved here so you
might not know this, but MR. BRINEYwas once a revered seafarer.

records.japanese: ユウキ『[PLAYER]\nポケモンずかんは　どう？\rちょっとは　ページ　うまったか？\cオレは　すごいよ\cトウカのもりで\nポケモン　つかまえ　まくって\rモンスターボール　なくなったよ！
records.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER], how's your POKéDEX?\nHave you filled in any pages yet?\cMine rules.\cI went on a POKéMON-catching frenzy\nin PETALBURG WOODS until I ran out\rof POKé BALLS.

records.japanese:
ユウキ『そういえば　トウカのもりで
ハギろうじんと　すれちがったよ\cきっと　はまべの　こやに
かえる　ところ　だな\cおまえ　しらない　だろうけど
あの　ひと　いつもポケモンと　いっしょ　なんだ
records.english:
BRENDAN: By the way, I walked by MR.
BRINEY in PETALBURG WOODS.\cI bet he was on his way home to his
cottage by the sea.\cI bet you didn't know this, but he's
always got a POKéMON with him.

records.japanese: 「べんりな　トンネル　かんせい　まぢか！」\c‥‥と　かんばんに　かかれているが\nその　うえに　あかい　ペンキで\rおおきな　バッテンが　つけられている
records.english: “Timesaving tunnel nearing\ncompletion!”\c...Is what it says on the sign, but\nthere's also a big “X” splashed\racross it in red paint...

records.japanese: 「デボン　コーポレーション」\cみなさんの　せいかつの　ために\nなんでも　つくっています！
records.english: DEVON CORPORATION\c“For all your living needs, we make\nit all.”

records.japanese: カナズミ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　ツツジ\rいわに　ときめく　ゆうとうせい！
records.english: RUSTBORO CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: ROXANNE\c“The ROCK-loving honors student!”

records.japanese: 「デボン　コーポレーション　ぶんしつ」\cかんけいしゃ　いがいの　たちいりは\nどうぞ　ごえんりょ　ください！
records.english: DEVON CORP. BRANCH OFFICE\c“Access limited to DEVON employees\nand authorized personnel.”

records.japanese: ここは　カナズミ　シティ\cしぜんと　かがくの　ゆうごうを\nついきゅうする　まち
records.english: RUSTBORO CITY\c“The city probing the integration of\nnature and science.”

records.japanese: 「ポケモン　トレーナーズ　スクール」\nポケモンのことなら　なんでも　おしえます！
records.english: POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL\c“We'll teach you anything about\nPOKéMON!”

records.japanese: 「いあいぎりオヤジの　いえ」
くんくん‥‥\nなんか　きみ‥‥　コゲくさいね\cかざんに　でも　いってきた？
records.english: Sniff...\nUm... You, uh...smell singed.\cWere you at a volcano or something?

records.japanese: ポケモンジムに　いきたいのに\nなにかが　みちを　ふさいでいるのよ！\cせっかく　１２０ばん　どうろで\nポケモン　そだてて　きたのに！
records.english: I want to go to the POKéMON GYM, but\nsomething's blocking the way.\cAfter all the bother I went through\ntraining on ROUTE 120...

records.japanese: あたしの　じまんの　ポケモンで\nこんどこそ　ナギさんに　かってみせるわ！
records.english: I've got my pride-and-joy POKéMON\nwith me. This time, I'll beat WINONA.

records.japanese: あめが　じめんに　すいこまれて\nその　みずを　すって　きがそだつ‥‥\cみずと　つちが　りょうほう　あるから\nこの　ヒワマキシティも　あるのよね
records.english: The ground absorbs rainwater, and\ntrees grow by drinking that water...\cOur FORTREE CITY exists because\nthere's both water and soil.

records.japanese:
このまちは　きのうえに
いえを　たてて　くらしている‥‥\cそのせいか　みんな　げんきで
イキイキと　している　のですよ\cわしも　このまちに　きてから
３０ねんほど　わかがえった　きぶんです
records.english:
The CITY consists of homes built on
trees.\cPerhaps because of that lifestyle,
everyone is healthy and lively.\cWhy, even myself - I feel as if I've
grown thirty years younger.

records.japanese: きのうえで　くらすのは　いいんだけど\cときどき　まどの　そとから\nむしポケモンが　はいって　きたりして\rびっくり　しちゃうんだよね
records.english: Living on top of trees is okay.\cBut sometimes BUG POKéMON come in\nthrough windows.\rIt can be really startling.

records.japanese: つうしんケーブルを　とおることで\nしんか　する　ポケモンも　いるよ
records.english: Some POKéMON evolve when they go\nthrough a Game Link cable.

records.japanese: みえない　なにかが　いるようだ
records.english: Something unseeable is in the way.

records.japanese: みえない　なにかが　いるようだ\cデボンスコープを　つかいますか？
records.english: Something unseeable is in the way.\cWant to use the DEVON SCOPE?

records.japanese:
[PLAYER]は
デボンスコープを　つかった！\cとうめいに　なっていた
ポケモンの　すがたが　まるわかりだ！\cポケモンは
おどろいて　にげだした！
records.english: [PLAYER] used the DEVON SCOPE.\cAn invisible POKéMON became completely\nvisible!\cThe startled POKéMON fled!

records.japanese: ここは　ヒワマキ　シティ\nきの　うえで　しぜんと　たわむれる　まち
records.english: FORTREE CITY\n“The treetop city that frolics with\rnature.”

records.japanese: ヒワマキ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　ナギ\rせかいに　はばたく　とりつかい！
records.english: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WINONA\c“The bird user taking flight into\nthe world.”

records.japanese:
ハルカ『あら！？
[PLAYER][KUN]も　おかいもの？\cあたし　ぬいぐるみとか　ポスター
いっぱい　かっちゃった！\cもちろん　ポケモン　いっぱい　つかまえたし
ちゃんと　そだてて　いるんだから！\cあたし　としては　[PLAYER][KUN]が
ポケモン　そだててるか　しんぱい　だな\cしょうぶ　してあげるから
[PLAYER][KUN]の　ポケモン　みせてよ！
records.english:
MAY: Oh, hey?
[PLAYER][KUN], are you shopping, too?\cI bought a whole bunch of DOLLS and
POSTERS.\cOf course, I've also caught a lot of
POKéMON, and I'm raising themproperly, too.\cActually, I'm more worried if you're
raising POKéMON properly, [PLAYER][KUN].\cI'll battle with you, so you can show
me your POKéMON, [PLAYER][KUN].

records.japanese: ハルカ『えー　なんで？\n[PLAYER][KUN]　ポケモン　そだてていないの？\cそれじゃあ　トレーナーとして\nまだまだ　ね！
records.english: MAY: Oh, why? [PLAYER][KUN], haven't you\nbeen raising your POKéMON?\cThat's not a very good showing as a\nTRAINER...

records.japanese: ハルカ『しょうぶ　してあげるから\n[PLAYER][KUN]の　ポケモン　みせてよ！
records.english: MAY: Come on, battle with me, so I can\ncheck out your POKéMON!

records.japanese: ハルカ『あたしの　そだてた　ポケモンが\n[PLAYER][KUN]の　ポケモンに\rまけるわけ　ないんだから！
records.english: MAY: The POKéMON I raised won't be\nbeaten by your POKéMON, [PLAYER][KUN]!

records.japanese: ‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\c１０３ばん　どうろで\n[PLAYER][KUN]と　しょうぶ　したこと\rおもいだしちゃった！\cあの　しょうぶが　あったから\n[PLAYER][KUN]　ここまで\rつよく　なったんだね！
records.english: ... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cI remember the battle I had with you,\n[PLAYER][KUN], on ROUTE 103.\cThat battle helped you become this\nstrong, [PLAYER][KUN], didn't it?

records.japanese: ハルカ『あたし　そろそろ\nミシロタウンに　かえる　つもりなの\cいろいろ　ポケモン　つかまえて\nずかんも　けっこう　できてきたから\rおとうさんに　みせるんだ！
records.english: MAY: I'm thinking of going back to\nLITTLEROOT soon.\cI've caught a decent group of POKéMON,\nand my POKéDEX is coming along, so\rI'm going home to show my dad.

records.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]は　どうするの？\cあちこちの　ジムバッジを　あつめて\nポケモンリーグ　ちょうせん　するの？\cじゃあ　あたし　[PLAYER][KUN]が\nバッジを　あつめている　あいだに\rポケモンずかんを　かんせい　させちゃお！\cじゃね！
records.english: [PLAYER][KUN], what are you going to do?\cCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\cWell, while you're collecting BADGES,\n[PLAYER][KUN], I'm going to work on my\rPOKéDEX. I'll complete it before you!\cSee you!

records.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]は　どうするの？\cポケモンリーグ　ちょうせん　するの？\cそれとも　ポケモンずかん\rかんせい　させるの？\cポケモンしょうぶ　じゃ　まけちゃったけど\nずかんは　あたしの　ほうが\rさきに　かんせい　させるんだから！\cじゃね！
records.english:
[PLAYER][KUN], what are you going to do?\cAre you taking the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge?\cOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\cI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\cSee you!

records.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]は　どうするの？\cバトルタワーに　ちょうせん　するの？\cそれとも　ポケモンずかん\rかんせい　させるの？\cポケモンしょうぶ　じゃ　まけちゃったけど\nずかんは　あたしの　ほうが\rさきに　かんせい　させるんだから！\cじゃね！
records.english:
[PLAYER][KUN], what are you going to do?\cAre you taking the BATTLE TOWER
challenge?\cOr, are you going to complete your
POKéDEX?\cI might've lost to you in battling,
but I'll finish my POKéDEX before you!\cSee you!

records.japanese: ユウキ『なんだ　[PLAYER]か\cオレ　とうさんに　たのまれた\nかいものを　してたんだ\rべつに　ぬいぐるみ　なんか　かってないよ\cそれよりも　ひさしぶりに　あったんだ\cどっちが　うまく\nポケモン　そだてているか\rしょうぶ　してやろうか？
records.english: BRENDAN: Oh, hey, it's [PLAYER].\cI'm running an errand for my dad.\nNo, I'm not buying any DOLLS.\cAnyways, it's been a while.\cWant to have a battle to see who's been\nraising POKéMON better?

records.japanese: ユウキ『なんだよ\nじしんが　ないのかよ
records.english: BRENDAN: Oh, what's the matter?\nDon't have the confidence?

records.japanese: ユウキ『どっちが　うまく\nポケモン　そだてているか\rしょうぶ　してやろうか？
records.english: BRENDAN: Want to battle to see who's\nbeen raising POKéMON better?

records.japanese: ユウキ『まあ　オレが\n[PLAYER]に　まけるわけ　ないんだけど
records.english: BRENDAN: Aww, but you know I'm not\ngoing to lose to no [PLAYER].

records.japanese: ふうん‥‥\nかなり　そだててるんだな\cちょっと　くやしいな\nトレーナーとしては　オレの　ほうが\rセンパイ　だったのに‥‥
records.english: Humph...\nYou've done a lot of raising.\cThat stings a bit - I had a head start\non you as a TRAINER...

records.japanese: ユウキ『オレ‥‥\nミシロタウンに　もどるつもり　なんだ\cとうさんの　てつだいで　つくっている\nポケモンずかんも　けっこう　できてきたし\rいちど　とうさんに　みせておかないと
records.english: BRENDAN: I...\nI plan on going home to LITTLEROOT.\cYou know I'm helping out my dad on his\nPOKéDEX. It's coming together pretty\rdecently, so I should go show him.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　どうする？\cやっぱり　ぜんぶの　ジムバッジ　あつめて\nポケモンリーグ　ちょうせん　するのか？\cオレも　そうしようかな\cまあ　いいや\nとにかく　がんばれよ！
records.english: [PLAYER], what are you going to do?\cCollect all the GYM BADGES and take\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\cMaybe I'll do that, too...\cWell, anyway, hang in there!

records.japanese:
[PLAYER]は　どうする？\cそんなに　つよいんだから
ポケモンリーグに　ちょうせん　するのか？\cオレだって　もうちょっと
ポケモン　そだてれば　[PLAYER]よりもつよくなれる　はずだからな\cまあ　いいや
とにかく　がんばれよ！
records.english: [PLAYER], what are you going to do?\cSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge?\cHeh, even me - if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\ryou, [PLAYER].\cWell, anyway, hang in there!

records.japanese:
[PLAYER]は　どうする？\cそんなに　つよいんだから
バトルタワーに　ちょうせん　するのか？\cオレだって　もうちょっと
ポケモン　そだてれば　[PLAYER]よりもつよくなれる　はずだからなオレも　バトルタワーに　いこうかな？\cまあ　いいや
とにかく　がんばれよ！
records.english: [PLAYER], what are you going to do?\cSince you're that strong, are you\ntaking the BATTLE TOWER challenge?\cHeh, even me - if I trained my POKéMON\na bit more, I should be stronger than\ryou, [PLAYER].\rMaybe I will go to the BATTLE TOWER.\cWell, anyway, hang in there!

records.japanese: ふふふ‥‥\cきょうも　うばった　ブツを\nアジトに　はこびこんだぞ‥‥\cなっ　なんだ　おまえ！\nいっ　いまのは　ひとりごと　だぞ！
records.english: Fufufu...\cWe moved more loot into our secret\nHIDEOUT today...\cWh-who are you?!\nI was just talking to myself!

records.japanese:
リーダーが　なに　かんがえてるのか
したっぱの　オレには　わからんが\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　いると
すごいこと　できそうだぜ！\cなっ　なんだ　おまえ！
いっ　いまのは　ひとりごと　だぞ！
records.english:
I'm just a GRUNT, so I don't know what
the BOSS is thinking...\cBut being on TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], I know I'll get
the chance to do big things!\cWh-who are you?!
I was just talking to myself!

records.japanese: おい　おまえ！\cいりえに　ある\nどうくつには　ちかづくなよ！\cなぜって？　りゆうは　どうでも　いいんだ！\nおとなの　いうこと　きけよな！！
records.english: Hey, you!\cDon't go near the cave in the cove!\cWhy? You don't need a reason why!\nI'm an adult, so you just listen to me!

records.japanese: この　ひろい　せかい　すべてが\nおれら　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　ものに　なったら\rポケモンも　しあわせに　なれるはずだ！
records.english: If this whole wide world becomes ours,\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s, it will be a happier\rplace for POKéMON, too.

records.japanese: それっ！　ホエルコ！\nそこで　すいめんから　ジャンプするのだ！
records.english: There! WAILMER!\nLeap out of the water now!

records.japanese: ‥‥ん？　なんだ　おまえは？\cトレーニングの　じゃまに　なるから\nあっちに　いっててくれ！
records.english: Hunh? What do you want?\cYou're messing up our training, so can\nyou, like, get lost?

records.japanese: この　コンテスト　かいじょう　には\nぜんこく　から　かちぬいてきた\rポケモンが　あつまって　いるんだな！\cわしの　ハートは　わくわく　なんだな！
records.english: The POKéMON that come to this CONTEST\nHALL are all prizewinners.\rThey come from all over the country.\cMy heart swells with excitement!

records.japanese: まちの　はずれの　いりえに\nおかしな　どうくつが　あるの　みた？
records.english: Have you seen that strange cave in\nthe cove at the edge of town?

records.japanese: あたしの　ポケモン\nコンテストの　ために　あたらしい　わざを\rおぼえさせる　つもりなの！\cだからね　わざわすれ　じいさんに　たのんで\nひでんわざを　わすれさせて　もらうのよ！
records.english: I'm going to teach my POKéMON some new\nmoves for entering a CONTEST.\cSo, I'm going to see the MOVE DELETER\nand make it forget HM moves.

records.japanese: ぼくは　カントーから　きました！\cホウエン　ちほうは　みずと　みどりに\nあふれた　うつくしい　ところ　ですね！\c‥‥ん？　ということは？\cこの　とち　だけに　せいそくする\nめずらしい　ポケモンが　いるのかも？
records.english: I came from KANTO.\cThe HOENN region is beautiful with\nall its water and verdant nature.\cHunh? Wait a second...\cCould there be rare POKéMON that live\nonly in this area?

records.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんの　れんちゅうが\nいりえで　ホエルコを\rトレーニング　してるんだよ！\cおいらたち　ふなのり\nこのままじゃ　うみに　でられないよ！
records.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s been training their\nWAILMER in the cove.\cWe SAILORS can't get our boats out\nto sea with them in the way!

records.japanese: あんた　しってるかい？\cだれかが　[EVIL_TEAM]だんを\nけちらしてくれた　らしいんだ！\cおかげで　ホエルコ　いなくなって\nうみに　でられるように　なったよ！
records.english: Ahoy, did you know?\cSomeone punted TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] out of the\nway for us!\cThat got the WAILMER out of the cove,\nso we can get our boats out again.

records.japanese: うみべの　やどで　なみの　おとを\nききながら　のんびり　おひるね\r‥‥を　していたら\cわたしの　ポケモン　とられちゃった！\cはんにんは　だれー！？\n[EVIL_TEAM]だん？　[EVIL_TEAM]だん　なのー！？
records.english: I was taking a relaxing snooze at the\nseaside inn to the sound of waves...\cWhen someone stole my POKéMON!\cWho's the abductor?\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM]? Is it TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?

records.japanese: いなくなってた　わたしの　ポケモン\nいつのまにか　かえってきたの！
records.english: My missing POKéMON...\nIt came back without me noticing!

records.japanese: わたしは　ガショウ　です！\cいや　そういう　なまえ　なのではなく\nかちのある　えを　かったり　うったりする\rしょくぎょうの　なまえ　なんです！\cこのまちの　びじゅつかんに　すばらしい\nめいが　が　あると　きいたの　ですが‥‥
records.english: I'm an ART DEALER.\cI am a buyer and seller of fine art,\nespecially paintings.\cI've heard that the MUSEUM here has\nmagnificent works on exhibit...

records.japanese: わしらが　しわくちゃに　なっても\nこのうみは　いつまでも　わかわかしく\rいのちの　かがやきに　あふれとる\cふほほ　ふほほほほ‥‥
records.english: Even as we grow old and wrinkled, the\nsea remains forever young with the\rvivid brilliance of life...\cFwohoho fwohohohoho...

records.japanese: ６０ねんまえ　ここで　おじいしゃんが\nわしに　プロポーズ　してくれた　ときから\rこのうみは　うつくしいまま　ですのじゃ\cむふふ　むふふふふ‥‥
records.english: It was sixty years ago that my husband\nproposed to me here.\rThe sea remains as beautiful as ever.\cMufufufu mufufufufufu...

records.japanese:
この　いりえの　ところに　おかしな
どうくつの　いりぐちが　ある　じゃろう？\cいぜんは　てんねんの　どうくつ　だったが
[EVIL_TEAM]だん　とかいう　れんちゅうがかいぞうして　あんなふうに　したんじゃ！\c「しぜんを　あいする　[EVIL_TEAM]だん！」
‥‥と　いっておるが\cいうことと　やることが　ちがっとる！
records.english:
Hm, you know of the peculiar cavern
in this cove?\cThat had been a natural formation, but
then that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] lot came alongand made their renovations.\cThey call themselves the “nature-loving
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]”!\cBut what they do and what they say
don't match at all!

records.japanese: いりえに　あった　どうくつ‥‥\nいつのまにやら　いりぐちが　なくなって\rなかに　はいれなく　なっておるんじゃ！\cきっと　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　れんちゅう\nどこか　とおくへ　いって　しまったんじゃ！
records.english: That cave in the cove...\nIt seems someone sealed the entrance,\rso no one can enter it anymore.\cThat TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] lot, they must\nhave gone away for good.

records.japanese: ここは　ミナモ　シティ\nりくちの　さいはて　うみの　はじまり
records.english: LILYCOVE CITY\c“Where the land ends and the\nsea begins.”

records.japanese: ポケモンコンテスト　マスターランク　うけつけ\nおともだち　とも　いっしょに　でられます！
records.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nMASTER RANK REGISTRATION\c“Enter CONTESTS with your friends!”

records.japanese: 「みんしゅく　モナミ」\nミナモのモナミ　と　おぼえて　ください
records.english: COVE LILY MOTEL\c“Remember us as COVE LILY of\nLILYCOVE.”

records.japanese: 「ミナモ　びじゅつかん」\nポケモン　めいがてん　かいさい　ちゅう！
「ミナモ　びじゅつかん」\c[PLAYER]の　ポケモン　コレクション\nかいさい　ちゅう！
「ミナモ　シティ　ふねのりば」\cれんらくせん　タイドリップごう　は\nカイナシティにて　けんぞう　ちゅう！\cもう　しばらく　おまちください！
records.english: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\c“The ferry S.S. TIDAL is under\nconstruction in SLATEPORT CITY.\c“Service is scheduled to begin\nshortly.”

records.japanese: 「ミナモ　シティ　ふねのりば」\cれんらくせん　タイドリップごうで\nふねの　たびを　おたのしみ　ください！
records.english: LILYCOVE CITY HARBOR\c“Enjoy a delightful cruise on the\nferry S.S. TIDAL.”

records.japanese: 「ポケモン　トレーナー　ファンクラブ」\cかんばんに　いろんな　トレーナーの\nなまえが　らくがき　されている‥‥
records.english: POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB\cThe names of TRAINERS are scribbled\nall over the sign...

records.japanese: 「ミナモ　デパート」\cグッズ　いっぱい！　ドキドキ　いっぱい！\nなにかが　みつかる　すてきな　ところ
records.english: LILYCOVE DEPARTMENT STORE\c“Overflowing with great merchandise\nand excitement!\c“A great place to find that something\nyou need!”

records.japanese: 「わざわすれ　じいさんの　いえ」\nポケモンの　わざ　わすれさせます
records.english: MOVE DELETER'S HOUSE\c“Unwanted POKéMON moves deleted.”

records.japanese: これ‥‥　ダイゴさんに　もらったけど\nなんだか　よく　わかんないや！\cおうじゃのしるし　って　いうらしいけど\nおまえ　ほしい？
records.english: I got this from STEVEN, but I don't\nknow what it's good for.\cI think it's called KING'S ROCK.\nDo you want it?

records.japanese: これが　ほしいなんて\nおまえも　かわってるよな！\cやるけど　そのかわり\nダイゴさんには　ないしょ　だぜ！
records.english: Why would you want it?\nYou're weird.\cYou can keep it, but keep it a secret\nfrom STEVEN.

records.japanese: いし　あつめて　たのしいのかな？\nおれには　わかんないや！
records.english: Is it really that fun collecting\nrocks? I don't get it.

records.japanese: そうだろ！　へんてこな　いしを\nもらっても　こまっちゃうよな！
records.english: Yeah, you think so, too! What are you\nsupposed to do with some weird rock?

records.japanese: この　トクサネの　しゅうへん　では\nやせいの　ホエルコが　けんぶつ　できるんだ\cそーいうのを　えーと‥‥\nなんて　いったっけ　かな‥‥\cホエ　ホエ　ホエ‥‥\cホエルコ　ウオッチング　だ！
records.english: Around MOSSDEEP, you can see wild\nWAILMER.\cIt's called, uh...\nWhat was it now...\cWAI, WAI, WAI...\cWAILMER watching!

records.japanese: しまの　うちゅうセンター　では\nすんごい　ロケットを　とばしてるのよ！
records.english: The island's SPACE CENTER has been\nlaunching huge rockets.

records.japanese: ミナモの　なかま　から\nホエルコが　いなくなった！　って\rれんらくが　あったんだ\cいったいぜんたい\nミナモで　なにが　あったんだろうな？
records.english: I'd heard from my mates in LILYCOVE\nthat the herd of WAILMER has\rdisappeared.\cWhat went down over there, I wonder?

records.japanese: せかいじゅうの　すべてが！\cこのしま　みたいに　くさばなで\nいっぱいに　なれば　いいのにね！
records.english: Wouldn't it be nice?\cIf the whole world was covered in\nplants and flowers like this island?

records.japanese:
いのちの　みなもとは　うみから　うまれて
りくに　あがって　きた\cやくめを　おえた　いのちは
つち　となって　だいちに　かえって　いく\cそして　うみと　だいちは
いつでも　つながって　いる‥‥\cそう　この　かいがんせんの　ようにな
records.english:
All life needs the sea to live, even
though it makes its home on the land.\cLife, having run its course, becomes
soil and returns to the land.\cAnd the sea is always connected to
the land.\cYes, like the very shoreline here.

records.japanese: ふねのたびも　いいけどな\cポケモンと　ともに　なみのりで\nうみを　わたるのは　なんとも　いえない\rきもちよさが　あるよな‥‥\cそう　おもわないか？　わかものよ
records.english: A voyage on a ship is fine.\cBut crossing the sea with POKéMON\nusing SURF...\cNow that's an exhilarating trip!\nWouldn't you agree, youngster?

records.japanese:
この　いわ　って
うちゅうセンターの　みんなに　とってだいじな　いわ　なの\cロケットが　ぶじに　とぶように　ねがって
ここに　おいたんだって！\cあなたは　ねがいごとを　かなえたいとき
どうするの？ながれぼしに　ねがうの？\cあたしなら　たんざくに
おねがいごとを　かくかな　やっぱ！
records.english:
This rock has a special meaning to
the people at the SPACE CENTER.\cThey put it here as their wish for
their rockets to fly safely.\cWhen you make a wish, what do you use?
Do you wish upon a star?\cI use a wish tag to make it happen.
That's what I do.

records.japanese: しろい　いわ　だ！
トクサネ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　フウ　ラン\rしんぴの　コンビネーション！！
records.english: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADERS: LIZA & TATE\c“The mystic combination!”

records.japanese: ここは　トクサネ　シティ\n「ポケモンを　たいせつに！」が　あいことば
「トクサネ　うちゅうセンター」\nうちゅうに　いちばん　ちかい　ばしょ
records.english: MOSSDEEP SPACE CENTER\n“The closest place to space.”

records.japanese: とびらは　とざされて　いる！
あなたは　なんですかな？\cここは　めざめのほこら‥‥\cおくりびやまで　しずめられた\nポケモンの　たましいが\rよみがえると　いわれる　ばしょ‥‥\cどうか　おひきとり　ください
records.english: Who might you be?\cThis is the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\cThe spirits of POKéMON, becalmed at\nMT. PYRE, are said to be revived here.\cPlease leave.

records.japanese: うみに　もぐったり\nかいだんを　のぼったり　おりたり‥‥\cこのまちで　くらして　いると\nけっこう　たくましく　なるんだよね
records.english: Diving in the sea. Climbing up and\ndown stairs all the time...\cIf you live in this town, you end up\ngetting physically fit.

records.japanese: ぼく‥‥　まだ　いちども　このまちから\nそとに　でたこと　ないんだ\cあの　まあるい　そらの　むこうには\nどんな　せかいが　あるのかな？
records.english: I... I've never been out of this city.\cI wonder what the world is like on the\nother side of this round sky?

records.japanese: ほう！\nわざわざ　ルネに　やってくるとは\rただの　かんこうきゃく　じゃ　ないな！\cだからといって　おかねを　はらった\nかんこうきゃく　でも　ないな‥‥
records.english: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\rYou're no ordinary tourist.\cBut I suppose that doesn't make you an\nextraordinary tourist, either.

records.japanese:
ルネは　かざんの
かこうの　なかに　できた　まち\cうえを　みあげると
かこうも　いっしょに　みえてしまってそらの　すべては　みえない\cでも　だからこそ
ルネから　みえる　そらがいちばん　うつくしいの
records.english:
SOOTOPOLIS sprang up as a town in the
crater of a volcano.\cIf you look up at the sky, the lip of
the crater is also visible.So, all you see is the sky in a circle.\cBut that's what makes the sky above
SOOTOPOLIS the most beautiful.

records.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]\nきみも　きたのか\rこんな　ひどい　あめ　なのに‥‥\cそうだ！\nかれの　はなしを　きいてくれ
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN], you came, too?\nIn this terrible rainstorm, yet...\cOh, yes, can you hear out what my\nfriend has to say?

records.japanese:
わたしは　ミクリ
この　まちの　ジムリーダー\cそして
めざめのほこらを　まもる　もの\cこの　おおあめは　めざめのほこら　からの
ちからに　よって　おこされています
records.english:
My name is WALLACE.
I'm this town's GYM LEADER.\cI've also been entrusted with the
protection of the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\cThis downpour is caused by a power
emanating from the CAVE OF ORIGIN.

records.japanese: それは　あいいろのたま\cわかりました\nわたしに　ついて　きなさい
records.english: That... That is the BLUE ORB.\cI see.\nFollow me.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『ひとが‥‥　ポケモンが‥‥
いきていくのに　ひつような　みず　なのに\cどうして　ボクたちを
ふあんな　きもちに　させるんだ‥‥\cルネの　まうえに　あつまった
あまぐもは　さらに　おおきく　ひろがりホウエン　すべてを　おおうだろう‥‥\cこのままでは‥‥
records.english: STEVEN: This rain...\cPeople and POKéMON need water to live...\cBut why does this rain fill us with\nso much dread?\cThe rain clouds over SOOTOPOLIS will\nkeep building and soon extend all\rover HOENN...\cIf that were to happen...

records.japanese:
ミクリ『この　さきが　めざめのほこら\cわたしたち　ルネの　にんげんは
この　めざめのほこらの　なかにはいることを　ゆるされて　いません\cですが　きみは　いかねば　ならない
その　あいいろのたまと　ともに\cほこらの　なかで　なにが　おころうとも
なにが　まっていようとも
records.english:
WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN is ahead.\cNo one from SOOTOPOLIS is permitted
to enter the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\cBut you must go.
Together with your BLUE ORB.\cYou must go regardless of what awaits
you inside the CAVE...

records.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]　きみが\nあいいろのたまを　もっていた　とはね\cだいじょうぶ！\nきみと　きみの　ポケモンなら\rなにが　おきても　うまくやれる\cボクは　そう　しんじている
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN], I never expected you\nto be holding the BLUE ORB.\cYou'll be okay. With your POKéMON,\nyou'll get things done no matter what.\cI'm convinced of it!

records.japanese: ミクリ『きみは　いかねば　ならない\nその　あいいろのたまと　ともに\cほこらの　なかで　なにが　おころうとも\nなにが　まっていようとも
records.english: WALLACE: You must go together with\nyour BLUE ORB.\cYou must go regardless of what awaits\nyou inside the CAVE...

records.japanese: ダイゴ『だいじょうぶ！\nきみと　きみの　ポケモンなら\rなにが　おきても　うまくやれる\cボクは　そう　しんじている
records.english: STEVEN: You'll be okay. With your\nPOKéMON, you'll get things done\rwhatever happens.\cI'm convinced of it!

records.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]\nきみも　きたのか\rこんな　ひどい　ひでり　なのに‥‥\cそうだ！\nかれの　はなしを　きいてくれ
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN], you came, too?\nUnder this scorching sun, yet...\cOh, yes, can you hear out what my\nfriend has to say?

records.japanese:
わたしは　ミクリ
この　まちの　ジムリーダー\cそして
めざめのほこらを　まもる　もの\cこの　ひでりは　めざめのほこら　からの
ちからに　よって　おこされています
records.english:
My name is WALLACE.
I'm this town's GYM LEADER.\cI've also been entrusted with the
protection of the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\cThis sunshine is caused by a power
emanating from the CAVE OF ORIGIN.

records.japanese: それは　べにいろのたま\cわかりました\nわたしに　ついて　きなさい
records.english: That... That is the RED ORB.\cI see.\nFollow me.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『ひとが‥‥　ポケモンが‥‥
いきていくのに　ひつような　ひかり　なのに\cどうして　ボクたちを
ふあんな　きもちに　させるんだ‥‥\cルネの　まうえに　みえる
たいようは　さらに　かがやきを　ましてホウエン　すべてを　てらしつくす‥‥\cこのままでは‥‥
records.english:
STEVEN: This sunlight...\cPeople and POKéMON need sunlight
to live...\cBut why does this sunlight fill us
with so much dread?\cThe blazing sun over SOOTOPOLIS is
intensifying... Soon, all of HOENNwill be under its withering glare...\cIf that were to happen...

records.japanese:
ミクリ『この　さきが　めざめのほこら\cわたしたち　ルネの　にんげんは
この　めざめのほこらの　なかにはいることを　ゆるされて　いません\cですが　きみは　いかねば　ならない
その　べにいろのたまと　ともに\cほこらの　なかで　なにが　おころうとも
なにが　まっていようとも
records.english:
WALLACE: The CAVE OF ORIGIN is ahead.\cNo one from SOOTOPOLIS is permitted
to enter the CAVE OF ORIGIN.\cBut you must go. 
Together with your RED ORB.\cYou must go regardless of what awaits
you inside the CAVE...

records.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]　きみが\nべにいろのたまを　もっていた　とはね\cだいじょうぶ！\nきみと　きみの　ポケモンなら\rなにが　おきても　うまくやれる\cボクは　そう　しんじている
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN], I never expected you\nto be holding the RED ORB.\cYou'll be okay. With your POKéMON,\nyou'll get things done no matter what.\cI'm convinced of it!

records.japanese: ミクリ『きみは　いかねば　ならない\nその　べにいろのたまと　ともに\cほこらの　なかで　なにが　おころうとも\nなにが　まっていようとも
records.english: WALLACE: You must go together with\nyour RED ORB.\cYou must go regardless of what awaits\nyou inside the CAVE...

records.japanese: ダイゴ『だいじょうぶ！\nきみと　きみの　ポケモンなら\rなにが　おきても　うまくやれる\cボクは　そう　しんじている
records.english: STEVEN: You'll be okay. With your\nPOKéMON, you'll get things done\rwhatever happens.\cI'm convinced of it!

records.japanese: おくりびやまの　おじいさんの　いいつたえ‥‥\nあれは　ほんとう　だったのですね‥‥
records.english: The legend told by the old man on\nMT. PYRE... It wasn't a made-up story.

records.japanese: いま　ホウエンちほうの　バランスが\nおおきく　くずれようと　しています‥‥
records.english: The natural balance of HOENN is going\nthrough a wrenching shift...

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]
きみの　おかげ　なんだね\cルネの　そらが　もとどおりに　なった
ミクリも　かんしゃ　していたよ\cそう　その　ミクリだけど
なかで　きみを　まっている\cかれは　つよいよ
だけど　いまの　きみならごかくに　わたりあえる　だろうね\cじゃあ
がんばりなよ
records.english:
STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN], we owe it all to you.\cThe sky above SOOTOPOLIS has returned
to normal. For that, WALLACE sends histhanks, too.\cAnd, that same WALLACE is waiting for
you inside.\cHe's strong.
But the way you are now, you should beon equal footing with him.\cGive it your best shot.

records.japanese: すべての　はじまりは　めざめのほこら\nすべての　おわりは　おくりびやま‥‥\cポケモンも　ひとも\nどこから　きて　どこへ　いくのでしょう‥‥
records.english: All life starts at the CAVE OF ORIGIN,\nand it all ends on MT. PYRE...\cWhere do people and POKéMON come\nfrom? Where are we bound?

records.japanese: あなた　ひょっとして\nミクリさまに　ちょうせん　するつもり？\cゆうき　あるのねー！
records.english: Let me guess, you're going to challenge\nWALLACE?\cOh, you are really?\nYou're awfully brave!

records.japanese: あなた　ひょっとして\nミクリさまに　かっちゃったの！？\cじゃあ　あたし\nあなたの　ファンに　なっちゃおうかな！！
records.english: Let me guess, you've beaten WALLACE!\nOh, you did, really?\cMaybe I'll become your fan!

records.japanese: ほう！\nわざわざ　ルネに　やってくるとは\rただの　かんこうきゃく　じゃ　ないな！\cだからといって　おかねを　はらった\nかんこうきゃく　でも　ないな‥‥
records.english: Hm!\nYou've come all the way to SOOTOPOLIS?\rYou're no ordinary tourist.\cBut I suppose that doesn't make you an\nextraordinary tourist, either.

records.japanese: かざんの　かこう　という\nわっかに　かこまれた　まるい　よぞら\cその　なかでは　たくさんの　ほしが\nいきている　みたいに　またたくの‥‥\rわたしが　いちばん　すきな　けしき
records.english: A circle of a night sky framed by the\ncrater of a volcano...\cAnd in that ring, stars flicker and\nblink as if they were alive...\rIt's my favorite scenery.

records.japanese: あれ？　ぼくんち　どこだっけ？
ルネ　シティ　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　ミクリ\rみずを　あいする　アーティスト！
records.english: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: WALLACE\c“Artist, and lover of WATER.”

records.japanese: ここは　ルネ　シティ\nれきしが　ねむる　しんぴの　まち
records.english: SOOTOPOLIS CITY\c“The mystical city where history\nslumbers.”

records.japanese: これより　チャンピオン　ロード
これより　ポケモン　リーグ\nしょうめん　ゲート
ここは　サイユウ　シティ\nはなと　うみと　ポケモンの　らくえん
records.english: EVER GRANDE CITY\c“The paradise of flowers, the sea,\nand POKéMON.”

records.japanese:
ママ『[PLAYER]　おつかれさま！\cながいあいだ　トラックに　ゆられて
たいへん　だったでしょ？\cここが　ミシロタウンよ！\cどう？　これが　わたしたちの
あたらしい　おうち！\cちょっと　こふうな　かんじで
すみやすそうな　ところ　でしょ？\cこんどは　[PLAYER]の　おへやも　あるのよ！
さあ　なかに　はいりましょ！
records.english:
MOM: [PLAYER], we're here, honey!\cIt must be tiring riding with our things
in the moving truck.\cWell, this is LITTLEROOT TOWN.\cHow do you like it?
This is our new home!\cIt has a quaint feel, but it seems to be
an easy place to live, don't you think?\cAnd, you get your own room, [PLAYER]!
Let's go inside.

records.japanese: ママ『まって　[PLAYER]！

ママ『[PLAYER]！　[PLAYER]！
オダマキはかせに　あいさつ　した？\cあら！　かわいい　ポケモン！
オダマキはかせ　に　いただいたのね\cやっぱり　パパの　こども　なのね‥‥
ポケモンと　いっしょに　いるのがさまに　なっているわよ！\cほらっ！　ぼうけんに　でるなら
ランニングシューズを　はくと　いいわ！\cいろんな　ところ
はしれるように　なるわよ！
records.english:
MOM: [PLAYER]! [PLAYER]! Did you
introduce yourself to PROF. BIRCH?\cOh! What an adorable POKéMON!
You got it from PROF. BIRCH. How nice!\cYou're your father's child, all right.
You look good together with POKéMON!\cHere, honey! If you're going out on an
adventure, wear these RUNNING SHOES.\cThey'll put a zip in your step!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ランニングシューズに\nはきかえた！

ママ『[PLAYER]！
これが　せつめいしょ　よ\c「ランニングシューズは
　ビーボタンを　おすことで　いままでよりも　はやく　はしれるように　なります！\c　ランニングシューズを　はいて
　おもいっきり　そとを　はしろう！」
records.english:
MOM: [PLAYER], those shoes came with
instructions.\c“Press the B Button while wearing these
RUNNING SHOES to run extra-fast!\c“Slip on these RUNNING SHOES and race
in the great outdoors!”

records.japanese:
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cあなたが　じぶんの　ポケモンを
もつように　なった　だなんて‥‥パパが　しったら　おおよろこび　するわよ！\c‥‥　でも　むりは　しないでね
なにか　あれば　かえって　くればいいから\cじゃあ　がんばってね！
records.english:
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cTo think that you have your very own
POKéMON now...Your father will be overjoyed.\c...But please be careful.
If anything happens, you can come home.\cGo on, go get them, honey!

records.japanese: パソコンを　つかえば\nどうぐや　ポケモンが　ほぞん　できるんだ！\cかがくの　ちからって　しびれるーっ！
records.english: If you use a PC, you can store items\nand POKéMON.\cThe power of science is staggering!

records.japanese: ずーっと　けんきゅうしつに　こもって\nしらべものを　しているかと　おもえば\rとつぜん　のやまに　とびだしていく‥‥\cオダマキはかせって　いったい\nいつ　うちに　かえっているんだろう？
records.english: PROF. BIRCH spends days in his LAB\nstudying, then he'll suddenly go out in\rthe wild to do more research...\cWhen does PROF. BIRCH spend time\nat home?

records.japanese: ここから　さきの　どうろ\nくさむらに　はいると\rやせいの　ポケモンが　でてくるんだ！
records.english: If you go in the tall grass at the sides\nof this road, wild POKéMON will appear.

records.japanese: じぶんの　ポケモンを　もってないと\nあぶないよ！
records.english: It's not safe to go out there if you\ndon't have any POKéMON with you.

records.japanese: この　さきで\nさけびごえが　きこえるよ！？\cどうしよう？　どうしたら　いいかな？\nだれか　たすけに　いかなきゃ‥‥
records.english: I can hear someone shouting down the\nroad here.\cWhat should I do? What should we do?\nSomebody has to go help...

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　おかげで\nはかせ　たすかって　よかったよ！
records.english: Boy, am I glad you went and rescued\nthe PROFESSOR.

records.japanese: ポケモンを　つかまえに　いくの？\nがんばってね！
records.english: Are you going to catch POKéMON?\nGood luck!

records.japanese: ここは　ミシロ　タウン\nどんな　いろにも　そまらない　まち
records.english: LITTLEROOT TOWN\n“A town that can't be shaded any hue.”

records.japanese: 「オダマキ　ポケモン　けんきゅうじょ」
「[PLAYER]の　いえ」
「オダマキ　はかせの　いえ」
ちょっと　ひとやすみ　したいから\nレポート　かいてるの
records.english: I want to take a rest, so I'm saving my\nprogress.

records.japanese: おれ　フレンドリィショップの　てんいん！\cきみ！　きみ！\nちょっと　ついてきて！
records.english: Hi!\nI work at a POKéMON MART.\cCan I get you to come with me?

records.japanese:
ここが　フレンドリィショップ！
あおい　やねが　めじるし　なのさ！\cポケモンを　つかまえる　ボールとか
いろんな　グッズを　うってるよ！\cキミには　サービスとして
これを　あげよう！
records.english:
This is a POKéMON MART.
Just look for our blue roof.\cWe sell a variety of goods including
POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.\cHere, I'd like you to have this as a
promotional item.

records.japanese: どんな　ときでも　つかえる\nキズぐすりは　ばあいに　よっては\rポケモンセンターより　たよりに　なるからね
records.english: A POTION can be used anytime, so it's\neven more useful than a POKéMON CENTER\rin certain situations.

records.japanese: あーー！\nこっちに　はいらないで　くれよ！\cめずらしい　ポケモンの　あしあとを\nはっけん　したんだ！\rスケッチが　おわるまで　まっててくれよ
records.english:
Aaaaah! Wait!
Please don't come in here.\cI just discovered the footprints of
a rare POKéMON!\cWait until I finish sketching
them, okay?

records.japanese: めずらしい　ポケモンの　あしあとを\nはっけん　したんだ！\rスケッチが　おわるまで　まっててくれよ
records.english: I just discovered the footprints of\na rare POKéMON!\cWait until I finish sketching\nthem, okay?

records.japanese: かんせい　させた　めずらしい\nポケモンの　あしあとの　スケッチ\rよくみたら　じぶんの　あしあと　だったよ‥‥
records.english: I finished sketching the footprints of\na rare POKéMON.\cBut it turns out they were only my\nown footprints...

records.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]！\nこっち　こっち！\rはやく　かえろうよ！
ユウキ『オレ　さきに\nけんきゅうじょに　もどるから\r[PLAYER]も　はやく　こいよな
records.english: BRENDAN: I'm heading back to my dad's\nLAB now.\r[PLAYER], you should hustle back, too.

records.japanese: ここは　コトキ　タウン\nなにかが　かすかに　はじまる　ところ
records.english: OLDALE TOWN\n“Where things start off scarce.”

records.japanese: ムロタウンって　ちいさな　しま　だから\nなにかが　はやりだすと\rみんな　すぐに　まねを　するのよね
records.english: DEWFORD TOWN is a tiny island community.\nIf something gets trendy here,\reveryone picks up on it right away.

records.japanese: ここは　ムロ　タウン\nあおい　うみに　うかぶ　ちいさな　しま
records.english: DEWFORD TOWN\n“A tiny island in the blue sea.”

records.japanese: ムロ　タウン　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　トウキ\rかくとう　ビッグウェーブ！
records.english: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: BRAWLY\r“A big wave in fighting!”

records.japanese: 「ムロの　しゅうかいじょ」\nみんなの　じょうほう　こうかんの　ばしょ
ハギ『ほい！　ムロに　とうちゃく！\cたしか　ダイゴとやらに\nてがみを　とどけるんだったな！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD.\cI suppose you're off to deliver that\nLETTER to, who was it now, STEVEN!

records.japanese: ハギ『てがみは　とどけたのかい？\cそれとも　トウカに　もどるのかね？
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Have you delivered your\nLETTER?\cOr were you meaning to sail back to\nPETALBURG?

records.japanese: ハギ『では　トウカに　もどると　しよう！\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG it is, then!\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

records.japanese: ハギ『では　てがみを　とどけておいで\nわしは　ここで　まっておるから
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe LETTER. I'll be waiting.

records.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　ムロタウンに　とうちゃく！\cふねに　のりたくなったら\nまた　わしに　こえを　かけておくれ！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've hit land in DEWFORD!\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!

records.japanese: ハギ『やあ！　きみのため　なら\nいつでも　ふねを　だそう！\cきみが　いきたいのは　どこ　かな？
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\cNow, my friend, where are we bound?

records.japanese: ハギ『トウカシティ　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: PETALBURG, is it?\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

records.japanese: ハギ『カイナシティ　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: SLATEPORT, is it?\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

records.japanese: ハギ『ふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　こえを　かけておくれ
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Just tell me whenever you\nwant to set sail again.

records.japanese: このへんは　つりの　めいしょ　なんだ\nきみも　つりが　したくなった？
records.english: This is a renowned fishing spot.\nAre you getting the itch to fish?

records.japanese: うんうん　うれしいな\nわたしの　つりざお　わけてあげよう！
records.english: I hear you, and I like what\nyou're saying!\cI'll give you one of my fishing RODS.

records.japanese:
よーしっ　だいサービス！
つりの　コツも　せつめい　しておくよ！\cまずは　すいめんに　むかって
つりざおを　つかう！\cそして　きもちを　しゅうちゅう　させ‥‥
ひいてる　ひいてる！！　となったらすばやく　つりざおを　ひくんだ！\cすぐに　ひきあげられる　ときも　あるけど
おおものは　なんども　タイミングをあわせる　ひつようが　あるんだよ！
records.english:
And, as an added bonus, I'll even throw
in a little fishing advice!\cFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\cFocus your mind...
If you get a bite, pull on the ROD.\cSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,you need to time the pulls on your RODto haul them in.

records.japanese: あらら‥‥\nそれは　ざんねん
records.english: Oh, is that so?\nThat's too bad, then.

records.japanese: よっ！\nつりの　ちょうしは　どう？
そうか！　そりゃ　すごい！\nおおものを　つりあげて　くれよ！
records.english: Is that right! That's great!\nHaul in some big ones!

records.japanese:
なんだよ　ガッカリ　しないでよ！
つりの　コツを　おしえて　あげるから！\cまずは　すいめんに　むかって
つりざおを　つかう！\cそして　きもちを　しゅうちゅう　させ‥‥
ひいてる　ひいてる！！　となったらすばやく　つりざおを　ひくんだ！\cすぐに　ひきあげられる　ときも　あるけど
おおものは　なんども　タイミングをあわせる　ひつようが　あるんだよ！
records.english:
Oh, hey, don't get down on yourself!
I'll give you a little fishing advice.\cFirst, you want to face the water,
then use the ROD.\cFocus your mind...
If you get a bite, pull the ROD.\cSometimes you can snag something
immediately, but with bigger catches,you need to time the pulls on your RODto haul them in.

records.japanese:
ぼく　はやってる　ものが　すきで
いつも　チェック　してるんだ\cねぇ　『[STR_VAR_1]』って
しってるかい？\cもちろん　しってるよね！\cだって　いま
『[STR_VAR_1]』がだいりゅうこう　してるからね！\cきみの　まわりでも　
『[STR_VAR_1]』がはやってる　だろ？
records.english:
I like what's hip, happening, and trendy.
I'm always checking it out.\cListen, have you heard about this new
“[STR_VAR_1]”?\cThat's right!
Of course you know!\cI mean, sheesh,
“[STR_VAR_1]”...It's the hottest thing in cool!\cWherever you're from,
“[STR_VAR_1]”is the biggest happening thing, right?

records.japanese: え？\nはやって　ないの！？\cじゃあ　いま　なにが　はやってるか\nきかせてよ！
records.english: Hunh?\nIt's not the hip and happening thing?\cWell, hey, you have to tell me,\nwhat's new and what's “in”?

records.japanese:
え？　『[STR_VAR_2]』？\c‥‥\c‥あ！　あぁ！
しってる　しってるよ！\cもっ　もちろん　しってるさ！
『[STR_VAR_2]』　だろ？\cいいよね！
『[STR_VAR_2]』　って！\cいま　すごく　はやってる　よね
ぼくが　しらないはず　ないじゃ　ないか！\c『[STR_VAR_1]』　なんて
もう　じだいおくれ\cいまは　『[STR_VAR_2]』の
じだい　だね！
records.english:
Hunh?
“[STR_VAR_2]”?\c... ...\c...Uh... Yeah! That's right!
Yeah, I knew that! Knew it all along!\cOf course I know about that!
“[STR_VAR_2],” right?\cYeah, that's it, it's there!
Isn't “[STR_VAR_2]”the coolest, or what?\cIt's the hippest thing in hip.
You think I'd not know about it?\c“[STR_VAR_1]”...
It's, like, so five minutes ago.\cNow, “[STR_VAR_2]” is
what's vital and in tune with the times!

records.japanese: ふーん\n『[STR_VAR_2]』　か‥\cでも　ぼくは\n『[STR_VAR_1]』　のほうが\rいいと　おもうけどね
records.english: Hmm...\n“[STR_VAR_2],” huh?\cBut personally, I think\n“[STR_VAR_1]”\ris what's real in cool.

records.japanese: じゃあ　あたらしい　りゅうこうが　あったら\nまた　きかせて　くれよ！
records.english: Well, if you hear of any happening new\ntrends, come share them with me, okay?

records.japanese: そうだろ！\cやっぱり　いまは\n『[STR_VAR_1]』　だよね！
records.english: Yeah, absolutely right!\c“[STR_VAR_1]” is the\ndefinition of “in” right now.

records.japanese: やっぱり　いまは\n『[STR_VAR_2]』が\rいちばん　だよね！
records.english: “[STR_VAR_2]” is at\nthe pinnacle of cool right now.

records.japanese:
ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]！　ひさしぶり！\cあら？　あたしが　おんせんに
はいったり　してる　あいだにフエンの　ジムバッジ　てに　いれたんだ！\cかなり　ポケモン　あつめてる　っていうか
そだてて　いるんだね！\cじゃあ　これを　あげても
だいじょうぶ　だよね
records.english:
MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]! Long time no see!\cOh? While I was visiting the hot springs,
you got the LAVARIDGE GYM BADGE.\cYou must have caught good POKéMON...
No, I guess you raised some.\cI guess it would be okay for you to
have this.

records.japanese:
ハルカ『その　ゴーゴーゴーグルが　あると
１１１ばん　どうろの　さばくにもはいれるように　なるんだよ！\cそれにしても　[PLAYER][KUN]
ポケモンジムに　ちょうせん　だなんて‥‥\cあたしに　まけたくない　からって
がんばって　いるのね！\cじゃあ　あたし　トウカで　[PLAYER][KUN]の
おとうさんに　ちょうせん　しようかな？\c[PLAYER][KUN]　じゃあ　またね！
records.english:
MAY: With those GO-GOGGLES, you'll
have no trouble getting through thedesert near ROUTE 111.\cBut, wow, [PLAYER][KUN]...
Challenging GYMS...\cYou're trying hard because you don't
want to lose to me, I bet!\c[PLAYER][KUN], I think I should challenge
your dad in PETALBURG GYM.\c[PLAYER][KUN], see you again!

records.japanese:
ユウキ『[PLAYER]　ひさしぶり　だな
ちょうしは　どう？\cふうん‥‥
バッジは　けっこう　あつめてるんだな\cじゃ
こいつを　やろうかな？
records.english:
BRENDAN: [PLAYER], hey, it's been a while.
How's it going?\cHmm...
That's a decent collection of BADGES.\cAll right, then.
You may as well have this.

records.japanese:
ユウキ『それを　もっていれば
１１１ばん　どうろの　さばくに　はいれるよ\cさばくにしか　いない
ポケモンも　いるはず　だからよかったら　いけば‥‥？\cオレは‥‥
トウカの　ジムリーダー　センリさんにちょうせん　してみようかな‥‥\c[PLAYER]の　とうさん
[PLAYER]と　ちがって　つよそうだからな\cじゃな！
records.english:
BRENDAN: Keep those with you if you're
planning on going into that desert nearROUTE 111.\cThere should be some POKéMON that
are exclusively desert-dwellers.You might look around for those.\cAs for me...
I'm considering challenging NORMAN,the GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.\cUnlike you, [PLAYER], your dad looks like
he really is tough.\cSee you around!

records.japanese:
タマゴを　かえそうと　おもって
すなぶろに　いれて　あたためていたがそれだけ　じゃあ　だめらしいの‥‥\cなんでも　げんきな　ポケモンと　いっしょに
つれてあるいた　ほうが　いいそうな‥‥\cおまえさん　トレーナー　じゃろ？
しかも　げんきな　ポケモンを　つれておる\cどうかね？
タマゴを　かえして　みるかね？
records.english:
I have here an EGG.\cI'd hoped to hatch it by covering it in
hot sand by the hot springs.But that doesn't seem to be enough...\cI've heard it would be best if it were
kept together with POKéMON andcarried about.\cYou are a TRAINER, yes?
And your POKéMON radiate vitality.\cSo, what say you?
Will you take this EGG to hatch?

records.japanese: タマゴと　いっしょに\nたーっぷり　あるいて　おくれ！
records.english: Good! I hope you'll walk plenty with\nthis here EGG!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nタマゴを　もらった！
あれ？　ポケモン　いっぱいで\nタマゴを　つれて　あるけないよ‥‥
records.english: Oh? You've too many POKéMON.\nThere's no room for this EGG...

records.japanese: そうかね‥‥\cまあ　タマゴを　かえしたく　なったら\nまた　はなしかけて　おくれよ
records.english: As you wish, then...\cIf you have a change of heart about\nhatching this EGG, I will be here.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　タマゴは\nときどき　そだてやさんで　みつかる‥‥\cそんな　うわさを　きいたよ
records.english: Every so often, an EGG will be found at\nthe POKéMON DAY CARE.\cOr at least that's how the rumor goes.

records.japanese: くめども　くめども　おゆが　でる\nポットでも　ないのに　おゆが　でる\c‥‥ふしぎ　じゃろ？\cかざんが　ちかくに　あるところ　では\nちかすいが　ようがんの　ねつで\rあたためられて　いるのじゃよ！
records.english: We draw as much hot water as we need,\nand yet the hot springs never run dry.\cIsn't it magical?\cThese hot springs appear near active\nvolcanoes. Veins of water under the\rground are heated by magma to well up\ras hot springs.

records.japanese: こうして　すなに　うまっていると\nはあぁ‥‥\cあたたかくって　イイキモチ‥‥\c‥‥ん？　イテテッ！\cしりを　ポケモンに　かまれた！
records.english: Being buried in this hot sand is...\nSigh...\cSo warm and heavenly...\cEh? Gyaah! Ouch!\cA POKéMON nipped my backside!

records.japanese: おや　あんた\nおんせんが　すき　なのかい？\cまだ　わかいのに　めずらしいねえ‥‥
records.english: Oh, you like hot springs, do you?\cThat's surprising for one as young\nas you.

records.japanese: あたし　アスナさん　みたいに\nすてきで　つよい　ジムリーダーに　なるため\rまいにち　おんせんに　はいってるの！
records.english: I bathe in the hot springs every day.\cI want to become a beautiful and strong\nGYM LEADER like FLANNERY.

records.japanese: おんせんに　ポケモン　いれると\nでんきぶろや　あわぶろ　はたまた\rようがんぶろに　なって　すごそうだわ
records.english: If people put POKéMON in hot springs,\nit might be seriously strange.\cWhy, it might be an electric bath, or\na bubble bath, or even a lava bath...

records.japanese: この　おんせんは‥‥\cしんけいつう　きんにくつう　それから\nれんあいのなやみ　おかねもうけ　などに\rこうかてき　なんだとさ‥‥
records.english: They're claiming that these hot springs\nare good for calming nervous tension,\rrelieving aching muscles, solving\rromantic problems, and attracting\rmoney...

records.japanese: ここは　フエン　タウン\nポケセン　おんせん　よいところ
records.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN\c“POKéMON CENTER HOT SPRINGS\nAn excellent place for relaxing!”

records.japanese: フエン　タウン　ポケモンジム\nリーダー　アスナ\rやけど　しそうな　じょうねつの　ひと
records.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: FLANNERY\r“One with a fiery passion that burns!”

records.japanese: 「ポケモン　かんぽうやく」\nりょうやく　くちに　にがし！
records.english: POKéMON HERB SHOP\n“Bitter taste - better cure!”

records.japanese: なんだ　なんだ！？\cソライシはかせの　けんきゅうじょに\nあやしい　おとこが　ではいり　しておったぞ！
records.english: What's up, what's up?\cI saw a shady fellow scuttling in and\nout of PROF. COZMO's LAB.

records.japanese: ここいら　いったいは\nむかしから　いんせきが　おおくてな\cりゅうせいのたきも　いんせきが　おちて\nできたとか　そう　いわれておる
records.english: This region's been known for meteors\nsince the olden days.\cThey say METEOR FALLS was gouged out\nby a falling meteorite long ago.

records.japanese: ほら！　みてちょうだい！\nわたしの　たいせつな　ルリリ！\cツヤツヤの　ナデナデの　フカフカよ！
records.english: See! Take a look!\nThis is my precious AZURILL!\cIt's slick and smooth and plushy, too!

records.japanese: ルリリ『るーりーるー

フエンタウンの　ジムリーダー
アスナとは　たたかったかね？\cあのこの　おじいさんは　すごかったよ
なんでも　ポケモンリーグのしてんのう　だった　らしいからね\cきっと　アスナも　これから
すばらしい　トレーナーに　なるだろうね
records.english:
Have you already challenged FLANNERY,
the LEADER of LAVARIDGE GYM?\cThe girl's grandfather was famous.
He was one of the ELITE FOUR in thePOKéMON LEAGUE at one point.\cIt wouldn't surprise me to see FLANNERY
become a great TRAINER in her ownright.

records.japanese: ポケモンコンテスト　スーパーランク　うけつけ\nはじけろ！　ポケモン　トレーナー！
records.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nSUPER RANK REGISTRATION\c“Burst on to the POKéMON scene!”

records.japanese: ここは　ハジツゲ　タウン\nちいさな　はたけが　ある　のうそん
records.english: FALLARBOR TOWN\n“A farm community with small gardens.”

records.japanese: 「わざおしえマニアの　いえ」\nポケモンの　わざ　おしえます！
records.english: MOVE TUTOR'S HOUSE\n“New moves taught to POKéMON.”

records.japanese: わたしの　パパが　いってたの\cこの　トンネルって　おーきな　おとに\nはんのうして　さわぎだす　おくびょうな\rポケモンが　いっぱい　なんだって！\cだから　かいはつ　こうじ　やめたんだけど\nおとこの　ひとが　ひとりで\rトンネルを　ほろうと　してるんだって！
records.english:
My papa told me.\cHe says this tunnel is full of
timid POKéMON.\cThey get all scared of loud noise and
make a big uproar.\cSo they had to stop the big tunnel
project.\cBut there's one man.
He's trying to dig the tunnel by himself!

records.japanese: あいする　ひとの　ために\nどうくつを　ほっていた　ひとが　いるの！\cなんだか　すごーい！
records.english: There was a man who dug a tunnel for\na lady he loved.\cI don't really get it, but hey!

records.japanese: かざむきの　かんけいで　このまち　には\nかざんばいが　とんでくることは　ない！\cくうきの　おいしい　このまちで　くらせば\nからだが　じょうぶでない　ひとでも\rきっと　げんきに　なれる　はずさ！
records.english: The way the winds blow, volcanic ash\nis never blown in this direction.\cThe air is clean and delicious here.\nLiving here should do wonders for even\rfrail and sickly people.

records.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモン　かわいさに\nすこし　じしん　でてきたからね\cコンテスト　デビュー　させたくて\nこの　まちに　きたんだ！
records.english: I'm feeling a little confident about the\ncuteness of my POKéMON.\cI wanted to make its CONTEST debut,\nso that's why I'm here.

records.japanese:
フレンドリィ　ショップの　となりに
どうくつが　あるだろ？\cなかを　ふさいでいる　いわを　こわし
とおれるように　しようと　がんばっているやつが　いるらしいんだ！\cとおれるように　なると　いいのに‥‥
カナズミにも　いきやすく　なるから！
records.english:
Did you see the cave next to the
POKéMON MART?\cThere's a guy in there who's trying to
bust up boulders so he can bust outthrough to the other side.\cIt'd be great if we could go through...
It'll make it easy to visit RUSTBORO.

records.japanese: フレンドリィ　ショップの　となりの\nどうくつが　とおれるように　なっただろ！\cカナズミまで　デボンの　しんせいひんを\nかいに　いきやすくなって　うれしいよ！
records.english: That cave next to the POKéMON MART\nis now a tunnel to the other side.\cIt's great - it's easy to go shop for new\nDEVON products in RUSTBORO now.

records.japanese: ここは　シダケ　タウン\nくさの　においの　かぜふく　こうげん
records.english: VERDANTURF TOWN\c“The windswept highlands with the\nsweet fragrance of grass.”

records.japanese: 「ミチルの　いえ」
ポケモンコンテスト　ノーマルランク　うけつけ\nあつまれ！　ポケモン　トレーナー！
records.english: POKéMON CONTESTS\nNORMAL RANK REGISTRATION\c“Gather here, all ye POKéMON TRAINERS!”

records.japanese: カナズミと　シダケを　むすぶ\n「カナシダ　トンネル」\cかいつう　こうじは　ちゅうしに　なりました
records.english: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\c“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”

records.japanese: キナギから　カイナへは\nしおの　ながれが　とても　はげしいの\cうかつに　なみのり　すると\nおもわぬ　ほうこうに　ながされちゃう
records.english: The sea between PACIFIDLOG and\nSLATEPORT has a fast-running tide.\cIf you decide to SURF, you could end\nup swept away somewhere else.

records.japanese: ね！　ね！　すごいでしょ！\nみずの　うえに　おうちが　たってるの！\cぼく　ここで　うまれたんだよ！
records.english: See, isn't it neat?\nThese houses are on water!\cI was born here!

records.japanese: キナギの　にんげんは\nみんな　つりをしたり　もぐったりして\rせいかつ　してるんだな
records.english: The folks of PACIFIDLOG all fish and\ndive as part of the lifestyle.

records.japanese: ここは　キナギ　タウン\nあさひが　みずべを　てらす　まち
records.english: PACIFIDLOG TOWN\c“Where the morning sun smiles upon\nthe waters.”

records.japanese: たっ　たすけて　くれーっ！！
おーい！　そこの　きみ！\nたすけて　おくれーっ！！\cそこに　ある　カバンに\nモンスターボールが　はいってる！
records.english: Hello! You over there!\nPlease! Help!\cIn my BAG!\nThere's a POKé BALL!

records.japanese: どっ　どこへ　いくんだ！？\nわたしを　みすてないで　おくれーっ！
records.english: Wh-Where are you going?!\nDon't leave me like this!

records.japanese: オダマキ『はあ　はあ‥‥\cやせいの　ポケモンを　ちょうさ　しようと\nくさむらに　はいったら\rとつぜん　ポケモンに　おそわれて‥‥\cとにかく　たすかったよ　ありがとう！\c‥‥おや？\cきみは　[PLAYER][KUN]　じゃないか！\cこんな　ところでは　なんだから\nちょっと　けんきゅうじょ　まで　きておくれ
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: Whew...\cI was in the tall grass studying wild
POKéMON when I was jumped.\cYou saved me.
Thanks a lot!\cOh?\cHi, you're [PLAYER][KUN]!\cThis is not the place to chat, so come
by my POKéMON LAB later, okay?

records.japanese: ポケモンが　よわってきたら\nポケモンセンターに　いくと　いいよ！\cポケモンセンターなら　すぐ　ちかく\nコトキタウンに　あるからね
records.english: If POKéMON get tired, take them to\na POKéMON CENTER.\cThere's a POKéMON CENTER in OLDALE\nTOWN right close by.

records.japanese: やせいの　ポケモンは\nくさむらから　とびだしてくる　からな！\cこうして　くさむらの　なかに　はいって\nつかまえたい　ポケモンを　さがすんだよ！
records.english: Wild POKéMON will jump out at you in\ntall grass.\cIf you want to catch POKéMON, you have\nto go into the tall grass and search.

records.japanese: ここは　１０１ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　コトキタウン
ミツル『[PLAYER]さん‥‥\nポケモンって　こういう　くさむらに\rいたり　するんでしょ‥‥？\cぼくが　じょうずに　つかまえられるか\nそこで　みてて　くださいね‥‥\c‥‥うわっ！！
records.english: WALLY: [PLAYER]...\nPOKéMON hide in tall grass like this,\rdon't they?\cPlease watch me and see if I can\ncatch one properly.\c...Whoa!

records.japanese: ミツル『やった‥‥　ぼくの‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモンだ‥‥！！
records.english: WALLY: I did it... It's my...\nMy POKéMON!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]さん　ありがとう！\nジムに　もどろうよ！
records.english: [PLAYER], thank you!\nLet's go back to the GYM!

records.japanese: ぼく‥‥　せが　ひくいから\nくさむらを　あるくと　もぐっちゃうんだ\cハッパが　はなの　あなに　はいって\nふぁ　ふぁ　ふぁ　ふぁ‥‥\cぶわっくしょーん！
records.english: I'm...not very tall, so I sink right\ninto tall grass.\cThe grass goes up my nose and...\nFwafwafwafwafwa...\cFwatchoo!

records.japanese: ふふふ　みてて　ごらん！
どうだ？　すごいだろ！\cあがれない　だんさも　うえから　ならば\nとびおりる　ことが　できるのだ！
records.english: Ta-daaaah! Awesome, huh?\cThere are some ledges that you can't\nclimb up, but you can jump down.

records.japanese: ポケモン　たくさん　つかまえよーっと！
records.english: I'm going to catch a whole bunch of\nPOKéMON!

records.japanese: ここは　１０２ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　コトキタウン
ここは　１０２ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　トウカシティ
ハルカ『えーと　１０３ばん　どうろに　いる\nポケモンは　あれと　あれね‥‥
records.english: MAY: Let's see... The POKéMON found\non ROUTE 103 include...

records.japanese:
あら　[PLAYER][KUN]！\c‥‥そうか！　おとうさん　から
ポケモンを　プレゼントして　もらったのね！\cせっかくだから　ちょっと
ポケモンしょうぶ　しようよ！\cトレーナーって　どんな　ものか
あたしが　おしえて　あげるから！
records.english:
Oh, hi, [PLAYER][KUN]!\c...Oh, I see, my dad gave you a
POKéMON as a gift.\cSince we're here, let's have a quick
battle!\cI'll give you a taste of what being a
TRAINER is like.

records.japanese: うわっ！　すごい　すごい！\n[PLAYER][KUN]　つよい　じゃない！
records.english: Wow! That's great!\n[PLAYER][KUN], you're pretty good!

records.japanese:
ハルカ『あたし　おとうさんが
あなたの　ことを　ちゅうもく　するのもわかるような　きが　する！\cだって　もらって　すぐの　ポケモンが
もう　あなたに　なついているもの！\cあなたなら　どんな　ポケモンとでも
なかよく　なれるかも！\cじゃあ
けんきゅうじょに　かえろっか！
records.english:
MAY: I think I know why my dad has an
eye out for you now.\cI mean, you just got that POKéMON but
it already likes you.\cYou might be able to befriend any
kind of POKéMON easily.\cWell, it's time to head back to the
LAB.

records.japanese: ユウキ『そうか　あいつと　あいつが\n１０３ばん　どうろに　いる　ポケモンか‥‥
records.english: BRENDAN: Okay, so it's this one and\nthat one that live on ROUTE 103...

records.japanese:
おや？　[PLAYER]！\c‥‥そうか　とうさん　から
ポケモンを　もらったのか\cじゃあ　ついでだ
ポケモンしょうぶ　してやろうか？\cトレーナーって　どんな　ものか
オレが　おしえてやるよ！
records.english: Hey, it's [PLAYER]!\c...Oh, yeah, Dad gave you a POKéMON.\cSince we're here, how about a little\nbattle?\cI'll teach you what being a TRAINER's\nabout!

records.japanese: ふうん\n[PLAYER]って　つよいんだね

ユウキ『とうさんが
[PLAYER]の　ことを　ちゅうもく　するのもわかったような　きが　する‥‥\cもらって　すぐの　ポケモンが
もう　なついているよ\c[PLAYER]なら　どんな　ポケモンとでも
なかよく　なれるかも　しれないな\cじゃ
けんきゅうじょに　もどろうか
records.english:
BRENDAN: I think I get it.
I think I know why my dad has his eyeout for you now.\cLook, your POKéMON already likes you,
even though you just got it.\c[PLAYER], I get the feeling that you
could befriend any POKéMON with ease.\cWe should head back to the LAB.

records.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモン　もう　へろへろ‥‥\nキズぐすり　もってくれば　よかった‥‥
records.english: My POKéMON is staggeringly tired...\nI should have brought a POTION...

records.japanese: ここから　うみを　わたっていけば\nコトキタウンまで　ちかみちが　できるぞ！\cふふふ　おとくな　じょうほう　だろ？
records.english: If you cross the sea from here,\nit'll be a shortcut to OLDALE TOWN.\cFufufu, that's useful, isn't it?

records.japanese: ここは　１０３ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　コトキタウン
その　はまべの　こやには\nハギろうじん　という　ひとが　すんでるの！\cむかしは　どんな　あらなみも　おそれない\nすごうでの　ふなのり　だった　らしいわ！
records.english: That seaside cottage is where\nMR. BRINEY lives.\cHe was once a mighty sailor who never\nfeared the sea, however stormy.

records.japanese: うみ　かぁ‥‥\cうみのそこ　って　いったい\nどんな　ふうに　なってるのかな？
records.english: The sea, huh?\cI wonder what it's like at the bottom\nof the sea?

records.japanese: モンスターボールを　なげるときは\nポケモンの　わざで\rどくや　やけどに　したり\rねむらせると　つかまえ　やすいよ！
records.english: If you're going to throw a POKé BALL,\nweaken the wild POKéMON first.\cIt will be easier to catch if it's been\npoisoned, burned, or lulled to sleep.

records.japanese: ひとの　ポケモンを　とったら　どろぼうよ\cモンスターボールは\nやせいの　ポケモンにだけ　なげましょうね！
records.english: You're a thief if you try to steal\nsomeone else's POKéMON.\cYou should throw POKé BALLS only at\nwild POKéMON.

records.japanese: わたし　トレーナーじゃ　ないわよ\cでも　トレーナーどうし　しせんが　あうのは\nしょうぶしようって　サイン　なのよね！\cもし　たたかいたく　なかったら\nしせんを　あわさなければ　いいのよね！
records.english: Oh, no, I'm not a TRAINER.\cBut that's right, if TRAINERS lock eyes,\nit's a challenge to battle.\cIf you don't want to battle, stay out\nof their sight.

records.japanese: くちのなかに　タネを　いっぱい　いれて\nそれを　プププッ！　とふきだすのが　すき！\cおまえも　これを　やるから　つかえよ！\cポケモンに　つかうとさ\nタネを　とばす　わざを　おぼえるから！
records.english: I like filling my mouth with seeds,\nthen spitting them out fast!\cYou can have this, so you try it out!\cUse it on a POKéMON, and it will learn\na move for firing seeds rapidly.

records.japanese: ひとこと　アドバイスな！\cわざマシンは　つかいすて！\nつかうと　なくなるから\rよく　かんがえてから　つかえよな！
records.english: A word of advice!\cA TM, TECHNICAL MACHINE, is good only\nfor one-time use.\cOnce you use it, it's gone.\nThink twice before using it!

records.japanese: この　フラワーショップ　ちかごろ\nうえきも　うって　くれるのよ！\cうれしくて　たくさん　かっちゃったから\nあたしの　しろいハーブは　もう　いらないわ\rあなた　もらってよ！
records.english: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\cIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. I don't need this WHITE HERB\ranymore. Would you take it, please?

records.japanese: この　フラワーショップ　ちかごろ\nうえきも　うって　くれるのよ！\cうれしくて　たくさん　かっちゃった！\nどこに　かざろうかしら？
records.english: This FLOWER SHOP started selling\nsaplings recently.\cIt made me so happy, I went overboard\nshopping. Where should I put them?

records.japanese: 「ハギろうじんの　こや」
ここは　１０４ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　トウカシティ
ここは　１０４ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　カナズミシティ
「フラワーショップ　サン・トウカ」
おとくな　けいじばん！！\cホウエンちほう　には\nダブルバトルと　いって　２たい２の\rポケモンしょうぶを　いどんでくる\rトレーナーが　います！\cダブルバトルでは　ポケモンの　リストの\nひだりと　いちばん　うえにいる\rポケモンが　とびだして　たたかうので\rリストの　ならびには　ようちゅうい！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cIn the HOENN region there are pairs\nof TRAINERS who challenge others\rfor 2-on-2 POKéMON battles called\rDOUBLE BATTLES.\cIn a DOUBLE BATTLE, the TRAINER must\nsend out two POKéMON, the one at the\rleft of the list and the top one.\rWatch how POKéMON are lined up.

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンを　うまく　つりあげる　コツは\nビックリ　したら　エーボタン！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cAdvice on catching POKéMON with a ROD:\nPress the A Button if you get a bite.

records.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　カイナに　とうちゃく！\cたしか　クスノキさんに\nデボンのにもつを　とどけるんだったな！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in SLATEPORT!\cI suppose you're going to visit CAPT.\nSTERN and deliver the DEVON GOODS?

records.japanese: ハギ『にもつを　とどけないのかい？\cそれとも　ムロに　もどるのかね？
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Aren't you delivering the\nDEVON GOODS?\cOr were you meaning to sail back to\nDEWFORD?

records.japanese: ハギ『ムロタウン　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD it is, then!\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

records.japanese: ハギ『では　にもつを　とどけておいで\nわしは　ここに　いるから
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Then you go on and deliver\nthe DEVON GOODS. I'll be waiting.

records.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　カイナに　とうちゃく！\cふねに　のりたくなったら\nまた　わしに　こえを　かけておくれ！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy! We've made land in\nSLATEPORT!\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail again!

records.japanese: ハギ『やあ！　きみのため　なら\nいつでも　ふねを　だそう！\cきみが　いきたいのは　どこ　かな？
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\cNow, my friend, where are we bound?

records.japanese: ハギ『ふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　こえを　かけておくれ
records.english: MR. BRINEY: You just tell me whenever\nyou need to set sail again!

records.japanese: あつい　トレーナーさんも\nあつくない　トレーナーさんも\rおとうさんの　おみせに　よってってー！
records.english: Yo, TRAINERS!\nWhether you're hot to trot,\ror cool cat not,\rchill at my papa's spot!

records.japanese: こどもって　あちこち　うごきまわるから\nめを　はなせなくて　たいへん！\cポケモンが　いっしょ　だから\nだいじょうぶ　だと　おもってるけど‥‥
records.english: Little kids can dart around so quickly...\cYou don't dare take your eyes off them\nfor an instant. It's very taxing.\cMine's with my POKéMON, so they should\nbe okay, but...

records.japanese: なかなか　すなの　おしろ　できないね
records.english: Our sand castle's taking a long time\nto make.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　これ　あげる！

すなはまの　すなを　ぜーんぶ　あつめて
おっきな　おしろを　つくるの\cそれで　あたしたち
おうさまと　おうじょさまに　なるの\c[STR_VAR_1]は
けらいに　してあげるね
records.english: We're going to get all the sand from\nthe beach and make a big castle!\cAnd then we're going to be a king and\nqueen.\cWe'll let you be a servant.

records.japanese:
この　あたりの　うみは　きれいだがな\cそれでも　たまに　こうして　すてられた
ゴミを　ジグザグマに　あつめてもらうよ\cよごれた　みずは　あめと　なって
かわに　ながれこみ　のみみずと　なる‥‥\cうみを　よごすと
けっきょく　じぶんらが　こまるからの
records.english:
The water around these parts is clean.\cBut, I get my ZIGZAGOON to pick up
litter from the shoreline at times.\cDirty water becomes rain and joins our
rivers, which we drink from...\cIf we pollute the sea, it all comes
back to haunt us eventually.

records.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぐぐ？
「うみの　いえ」\cすなはま　といえば　ポケモンしょうぶ！\nあつい　トレーナー　ここに　つどえ！
records.english: SEASHORE HOUSE\c“May hot battles rage on hot sands!\nThe place for hot TRAINERS!”

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンの　レベルが　おなじ　でも\nつよさまで　おなじとは　かぎりません！\cそれに　トレーナーが　そだてた\nポケモンの　ほうが　つよくなると\rいわれて　います！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cPOKéMON at the same level may not\nalways have identical stats.\cPOKéMON raised by TRAINERS are said\nto grow stronger than wild POKéMON.

records.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは\nいまは　まだ　だれにも　いえないのだ
records.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s activities must be kept\nsecret for now.

records.japanese: はやく　カイナに　いって\nひとあばれ　したいんだよな
records.english: I want to get going to SLATEPORT and\nkick up a ruckus!

records.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんに　はいって\nはじめての　しごと　だぜ‥‥　どきどき
records.english: This is my first job after joining\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM]. I've got the shakes!
