records.japanese: [EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは\nきっと　みんなを　えがおに　するだろう
records.english: TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s actions will put a smile\non everyone's face!

records.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]　ひさしぶり！\cいろいろ　ポケモン　さがしてる　あいだに\nあたしの　ポケモンも　つよくなったんだ！\cだから‥‥\nちょっと　しょうぶ　しようよ！
records.english: MAY: Hi, [PLAYER][KUN], long time no see!\cWhile I was searching for other\nPOKéMON, my POKéMON grew stronger.\cSo...\nHow about a little battle?

records.japanese: あっちゃー！\nおもってたより　つよいよ！
ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]も\nポケモン　そだててるんだね！\cうん　じゃあ　これは\nあたしからの　プレゼントよ！
records.english: MAY: [PLAYER][KUN], you've been busy\ntraining, too, haven't you?\cI think you deserve a reward!\nThis is from me!

records.japanese:
ハルカ『それは　ダウジングマシン！\cダウジングマシンを　つかうと
めには　みえなくても　おちているどうぐが　あると　はんのう　しておとで　おしえて　くれるのよ！\cじゃあ　[PLAYER][KUN]
また　どこかで　あおうね！\cまけた　あたしが　いうのも　なんだけど
そのときまでに　もっと　ポケモンそだてて　おいた　ほうが　いいかもよ！
records.english: MAY: That's an ITEMFINDER.\cTry it out. If there is an item that's\nnot visible, it emits a sound.\cOkay, [PLAYER][KUN], let's meet again!\cI know it's a little silly coming from\nme, but I think you should train a lot\rharder for the next time.

records.japanese: ユウキ『[PLAYER]か\nこんなところに　いたんだ\rちょうしは　どう？\cポケモン　そだててるか　どうか\nオレが　たしかめて　やるよ
records.english: BRENDAN: Hey, [PLAYER].\nSo this is where you were.\rHow's it going?\cHave you been raising your POKéMON?\nI'll check for you.

records.japanese: ふうん‥‥\nなかなか　やるね
ユウキ『[PLAYER]も　いつのまにか\nポケモン　そだててたのか‥‥\cよし！\nこれを　やるよ
records.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER], you've trained\nwithout me noticing...\cGood enough!\nHere, take this.

records.japanese: ユウキ『そいつは　ダウジングマシン\cつかうと　めには　みえなくても\nおちている　どうぐが　あると\rはんのう　して　おとで　おしえてくれる\cじゃ　オレ　あたらしい\nポケモンを　さがしに　いくから
records.english:
BRENDAN: That's an ITEMFINDER.\cUse it to root around for items that
aren't visible.\cIf it senses something, it emits a
sound.\cAnyway, I'm off to look for new
POKéMON.

records.japanese: この　サイクリング　ロードを\nじてんしゃで　はしりぬけたら\rだんぜん　きもち　よさそうだね！
records.english: Wouldn't it be great to ride a BIKE\nat full speed on CYCLING ROAD?

records.japanese: どう？　かぜになびく　わたしの　くろかみ！\cこのため　だけに　かみを　のばしたの！
records.english: How do you like the way my raven-\ncolored hair streams behind me?\cI grew my hair out just for that.

records.japanese:
おっ！　その　じてんしゃ
ミスターカゼノに　もらったんだね！\cみれば　わかるよ
だって　きみの　じてんしゃに‥‥\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ\cカゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ　カゼノ
‥‥って　かいて　あるんだもん！\cあっちこっち　のりまわして
せんでん　してあげると　いいね！
records.english:
Oh, hey, you got that BIKE from RYDEL!\cOh, it's glaringly obvious.
It says right on your bike...\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,
RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL,\cRYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL, RYDEL...
That name's everywhere.\cYou should ride it around all over
the place - it's good advertising!

records.japanese: うえと　した　２つの　どうろ‥‥\cにんげんと　ポケモン\nそれぞれの　どうろ　だと　おもえば\rこれもあり　なのかも　しれんのう
records.english: The two roads, one above, one below...\cA road each for people and POKéMON.\nPerhaps that is right and fair.

records.japanese: あたしは　じてんしゃ　もってない　からねえ\nしたの　みちを　のんびり　あるいて　いくよ
records.english: I don't have a BIKE, so I'll take a\nleisurely walk on the low road.

records.japanese: いろんな　テクニックを　おぼえると\nますます　じてんしゃが　たのしくなる！\cテクニックを　つかわないと\nすすめない　ばしょも　あるしね！
records.english: Learning techniques will make BIKE\nriding even more fun.\cThere are some places that you can\nreach only by using a BIKE technique.

records.japanese: サイクリングロードで　キンセツを　めざすか\nしたの　みちで　ポケモンを　さがすか\rどっちに　しようかな？
records.english: Which should I choose?\cMake a beeline for MAUVILLE on\nCYCLING ROAD, or take the low road\rand look for POKéMON?

records.japanese: ぶつかった　かいすう\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_1]！\cかかった　タイム\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_2]！
ブラボー！！　すばらしい！！\cきみは　じてんしゃを　こころから\nあいしている！　たましいを　ゆさぶられたよ！
records.english: Bravo! Splendid showing!\cYour love of cycling comes from deep\nwithin your heart.\rYou've shaken me to my very soul!

records.japanese: なかなかの　テクニックを　もってるな！\cまあ　スピードを　だしすぎて\nアクシデントを　おこさないように　しなよ！
records.english: Your technique is remarkable.\cI suggest you slow down just enough\nto avoid collisions.

records.japanese: まだ　みじゅくな　ぶぶんも　あるようだが\nせっかくの　じてんしゃを\rたのしむ　きもちを　わすれないで　くれよ
records.english: I would consider you a work in\nprogress.\cStill, I hope you don't forget the\nsheer pleasure of cycling.

records.japanese: おいおい　なんだか\nあぶなっかしい　うんてん　してるなあ\rもっと　れんしゅう　しろよな
records.english: My word... Your cycling skills border\non terrifying.\cMost certainly, you need much more\npractice riding.

records.japanese: うむむ‥‥　うむむむ‥‥\cきみには　じてんしゃは　むいていない　かもな\nミスターカゼノに　かえしたら　どうだね？
records.english: ...I am aghast...\cYou're perhaps not cut out for this\nunfortunate cycling business.\cYou ought to give serious thought to\nreturning that BIKE to RYDEL.

records.japanese: この　サイクリングロード！\cキンセツから　カイナに　むかって\nマッハじてんしゃで　はしりぬける\rレーサーの　ぶつかった　かいすうと\rかかった　タイムを　はかって　いるんだ！
records.english: This is CYCLING ROAD.\cIf you were to ride from MAUVILLE to\nSLATEPORT on a MACH BIKE, you would\rbe rated for the number of collisions\rand your total time.

records.japanese: どんな　けっか　だろうが　さらに\nうえを　めざしての　チャレンジ　まってるよ！
records.english: Regardless of the results, I count on\nseeing more challenges from you.\rAlways aim higher!

records.japanese: この　サイクリング　ロードでは\nマッハじてんしゃ　で　はしりぬけた\rレーサーの　ぶつかった　かいすうと\rかかった　タイムを　はかって　いるんだ！\cダートじてんしゃ　だと　まがりやすいから\nきろくは　はかって　あげないよ！
records.english: On this CYCLING ROAD, those riding\nMACH BIKES are rated for their number\rof collisions and their total times.\cACRO BIKES do not qualify for rating.\nThey are easy to turn, so it's not fair.

records.japanese: ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　カイナシティ
「シーサイド　サイクリング　ロード」
「[EVIL_TEAM]だん　さんじょう！」\c‥‥かんばんに　らくがきが　してある
records.english: “TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] RULEZ!”\cSomebody scribbled that on the sign...

records.japanese: ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１０３ばん　どうろ
「シーサイド　パーキング」
ここは　１１０ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンを　ねむらせたり　まひさせると\nあいての　じゆうを　うばえます！\cこれは　ポケモンしょうぶの\nじゅうような　テクニック　です！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cThe foe can be made helpless by\nparalyzing it or causing it to sleep.\cIt is an important technique for\nPOKéMON battles.

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cバッグに　いれた　どうぐは\nセレクトボタンを　おすと　じゅんばんを\rいれかえる　ことが　できます！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cThe items in the BAG can be reorganized\nby pressing SELECT.

records.japanese: ここより　[RIGHT_ARROW]へ３ぽ　[UP_ARROW]へ２ほ　ゆけば\nそこは　すてきな　「カラクリやしき」！
records.english: “Three steps [RIGHT_ARROW] and two steps [UP_ARROW]\nto reach the wondrous TRICK HOUSE.”

records.japanese: いままでの　さいこう　きろく‥‥\cぶつかった　かいすう\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_1]！\cかかった　タイム\n　‥‥　[STR_VAR_2]！
records.english: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...\cNo. of collisions: [STR_VAR_1]\cElapsed time: [STR_VAR_2]

records.japanese: いままでの　さいこう　きろく‥‥\c‥‥　だれも　ちょうせん　していないのか\nなにも　きろく　されていない！
records.english: THE BEST RECORD TO DATE...\cNo one seems to have taken the\nchallenge. There is no record...

records.japanese: いつも　みずを　あげてたら\nたくさん　はなが　さいたんだ\cそしたら　きのみも　たくさん　できた！\cはい！\nこれ　あげる
records.english: I watered the plants every day.\nThey grew lots of flowers.\cAnd they gave me lots of BERRIES, too.\cHere you go!\nYou can have it!

records.japanese: がんばって　あかいポロック　つくるんだ！\n[STR_VAR_1]も　がんばってね！
records.english: I'm trying to make RED [POKEBLOCK]S!\nI hope you do, too!

records.japanese: あれ？　バッグの　きのみポケットが\nいっぱいだよ！\cまた　こんどね
records.english: Your BAG's BERRIES POCKET is full.\cI'll give it to you another time.

records.japanese: きょうは　あかいポロックのために\nあかい　きのみを　さがそっと
records.english: I'm going to look for red BERRIES to\nmake RED [POKEBLOCK]S.

records.japanese: きみ！　たびの　とちゅう　だろうけれど\cどうだ？　ここは　ひとつ\nわたしたち　かぞく　４にんと\rポケモン　しょうぶを　してみないか？
records.english: Hello! I take it you're a traveler.\cHow's this? What do you say to taking\non our family of four in a series of\rPOKéMON battles?

records.japanese: あっそ！\nきが　むいたら　また　おいで！
records.english: Is that so?\nDrop in, if you change your mind!

records.japanese: いい　どきょうだ！　きにいったぞ！
records.english: That's the spirit! I like you!

records.japanese: たはーっ！\nおもっていたより　つよいんだね　きみは！
records.english: Aiyah!\nYou're a lot tougher than I expected!

records.japanese: おーい！\nなかなか　つよい　トレーナーが　いたぞー！
records.english: Hey, all!\nI've found a pretty strong TRAINER!

records.japanese: あれま！　いがいに　わかいのね！\cうちの　しゅじんに　かってしまう　とは\nなんと　すごうでの　トレーナー　なの！\cじゃあ　こんどは　わたしと　しょうぶよ！
records.english: Oh, my goodness! Aren't you young?\cYou must be quite the TRAINER to beat\nmy husband, though.\cIt's my turn to battle now!

records.japanese: んまーっ！\nあなたって　なんて　つよいのかしら！
records.english: Oh, gosh!\nI can't get over how strong you are!

records.japanese: つよいわよー！\nこのひと　すっごく　つよいわよー！
records.english: There's a strong TRAINER here!\nThis one's really strong!

records.japanese: ママより　つよいなんて　すごーい！\cでも　あたし　だって　つよいんだから！\nほんと　なんだってば！
records.english: You're stronger than Mommy? Wow!\cBut I'm strong, too!\nReally! Honestly!

records.japanese: えっ　もしかして　まけちゃった‥‥
くやしい‥‥\c‥‥　ぐっすん！　おばあちゃーん！！
こらーっ！\nわしの　かわいい　まごに　なにすんじゃ！\cこうなったら　わしが　おまえさんを\nメタメタに　してやるから　かくごせぇ！
records.english: How dare you make my granddaughter\ncry!\cFor that, I'm going to smack you!\nPrepare to lose!

records.japanese: フガッ！　つよいのう‥‥\nまごの　いうことは　ほんとう　じゃった
records.english: Kwah! You are strong...\nMy granddaughter was right...

records.japanese: あんた‥‥　いそぎのたびで　ないのなら\nうちに　よっていって　おくれ‥‥
records.english: If you're not in any hurry, visit with\nus awhile.

records.japanese: ねっこのカセキを　みつけた！\cこっちの　カセキを　とると\nもう　ひとつの　カセキは　しずみそうだ‥‥\cねっこのカセキを　とりますか？
records.english: You found the ROOT FOSSIL.\cIf this FOSSIL is taken, the other\none will sink into the sand...\cTake the ROOT FOSSIL anyway?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ねっこのカセキを\nそのままに　しておいた
ツメのカセキを　みつけた！\cこっちの　カセキを　とると\nもう　ひとつの　カセキは　しずみそうだ‥‥\cツメのカセキを　とりますか？
records.english: You found the CLAW FOSSIL.\cIf this FOSSIL is taken, the other\none will sink into the sand...\cTake the CLAW FOSSIL anyway?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ツメのカセキを\nそのままに　しておいた
もっと　ポケモン　きたえないと\nかちぬくのは　きびしそうだ\cいままでの　ジムリーダーより\nはるかに　つよいと　きくからな\rポケモンリーグにいる　してんのうは！
records.english: If you don't raise your POKéMON some\nmore, it could be tough to keep winning\rup through the ranks.\cI've heard the POKéMON LEAGUE's\nELITE FOUR are far stronger than\rany GYM LEADER.

records.japanese: カチヌキいっかに　いどんだけれど\n４にん　つづけての　ポケモンしょうぶは\rきびしいよな‥‥　ボロまけ　したよ
records.english: I challenged the WINSTRATE family,\nbut four matches in a row is tough\rgoing... They destroyed me.

records.japanese: ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
われら　かぞくの　こころは　ひとつ\n「カチヌキ　ファミリーの　いえ」
records.english: “Our family's hearts beat as one!”\nTHE WINSTRATE'S HOUSE

records.japanese: ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１１２ばん　どうろ
ここは　１１１ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　１１３ばん　どうろ
「ケンコーばあさんの　いえ」\nつかれたと　おもうなら　よってらっしゃい！
records.english: OLD LADY'S REST STOP\n“Come in and rest your tired bones.”

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンの　つよさを　あらわす　ことばで\nとくこう　とは\rとくしゅ　こうげきりょく　のこと！\cとくぼう　とは\nとくしゅ　ぼうぎょりょく　のこと　です！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cOne of the indicators of a POKéMON's\npowerfulness is SP. ATK. It stands for\r“SPECIAL ATTACK.”\cLikewise, SP. DEF stands for “SPECIAL\nDEFENSE.”

records.japanese: ブツブツ‥‥\cハジツゲに　むかった　なかまは\nなにを　やってるんだ？　おそいなあ‥‥
records.english: Grumble...\cWhat happened to the others who went\nto FALLARBOR? They're late...

records.japanese: ブツブツ‥‥\cおれも　ロープウェイに　のって\nちょうじょうに　いきたいぜ‥‥
records.english: Grumble...\cI'd like to ride the CABLE CAR to the\ntop, too..

records.japanese: うーむ‥‥　キンセツに　いきたいのだが‥‥\nこの　だんさを　おりてしまうと\rフエンに　もどるのは　たいへん　だよな‥‥
records.english: Eh, I'd like to get to MAUVILLE, but if\nI went down these ledges, it'd be no\reasy matter to get back to LAVARIDGE.

records.japanese: 「えんとつやま　ロープウェイ　のりば」\n[UP_ARROW]　このさき　すぐ！
records.english: MT. CHIMNEY CABLE CAR\n“A short walk [UP_ARROW] way!”

records.japanese: 「えんとつやま」\cフエンタウンや　ちょうじょう　へは\nロープウェイを　ごりよう　ください
records.english: MT. CHIMNEY\c“For LAVARIDGE TOWN or the summit,\nplease take the CABLE CAR.”

records.japanese: ここは　１１２ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　フエンタウン
ワハハ！！\nいまの　かがくりょくは　すごいですぞ！\cなんと　この　かざんばいを\nガラスに　かえることが　できるのです！
records.english: Wahahaha! Today's technology is a\nwondrous thing!\cTake this volcanic ash here.\nIt can be fashioned into glass.

records.japanese: かざんばい　つもった　くさむらの　うえ\nあるくと　どこを　とおったか　わかるから\rたのしく　なっちゃう！
records.english: It's fun walking through the volcano's\nashes on the ground and grass.\cYou can see where you walked - it's\nreally neat!

records.japanese: ここは　１１３ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　１１１ばん　どうろ
ここは　１１３ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　ハジツゲタウン
おとくな　けいじばん！！\cバッグの　たいせつなものに　いれた\nどうぐを　とうろく　しておくと\rセレクトボタンを　おすだけで\rつかえるように　なって　べんり　です！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cYou may register one of the KEY ITEMS\nin your BAG as SELECT.\cSimply press SELECT to use the\nregistered item conveniently.

records.japanese: 「ガラスざいくの　おみせ」\nかざんばい　から　ガラスの　どうぐ
records.english: GLASS WORKSHOP\n“Turning Volcanic Ash into Glass Items”

records.japanese: わたしの　ポケモン　ほえてばかりで\nみんなが　にげてしまって‥‥\cあなた　よかったら\nこの　わざマシン　もらってください
records.english: All my POKéMON does is ROAR...\nNo one dares to come near me...\cSigh... If you would, please take\nthis TM away...

records.japanese: わざマシン０５の　なかみは　ほえる　です\nほえると　ポケモンも　にげだすのです
records.english: TM05 contains ROAR.\nA ROAR sends POKéMON scurrying.

records.japanese: ばうっ！！　ばばうっ！！
ここは　りゅうせいのたき\nとおりぬけると　カナズミシティ
「かせきマニアの　いえ」\nめずらしい　かせき　ください！
「マユミの　いえ」
どうくつの　なかって\nくさむらの　ある　どうろと　ちがって\rいつ　ポケモンが　とびだして　くるのか\rわからないから　ドキドキ　しちゃうわ
records.english: Exploring a cave isn't like walking\non a road.\cYou never know when wild POKéMON will\nappear. It's full of suspense.

records.japanese: ここは　１１５ばん　どうろ\n[DOWN_ARROW]　カナズミシティ
ここは　りゅうせいのたき\nとおりぬけると　ハジツゲタウン
あああ　なんという　ことだ！\cピーコちゃんと　さんぽを　していたら\nいきなり　おかしな　やつが　やってきて\cわしの　かわいい　ピーコちゃんが\nうばわれて　しまったのじゃ！\cうおー！　ピーコちゃーん！
records.english: Ohhh, what am I to do?\cWe were on our walk, PEEKO and I, when\nwe were jumped by an odd thug...\cThe scoundrel made off with my\ndarling PEEKO!\cWrrrooooooaaaar! PEEKO!

records.japanese: ぬぉー！！\cトンネル　ほりてー！！
records.english: Nnn... Roar!\cI want to dig that tunnel!

records.japanese:
ぬぉー！！
なんて　ことだ！？\cどうぐも　なにも　つかわずに
トンネルを　ほっていたのにへんな　おとこに　おいだされた！\cあの　トンネルには
おおきな　ものおとに　はんのう　してさわぎだす　ポケモンが　いる\cだから　きかいを　つかっての
かいはつ　こうじを　やめたのに‥‥\cへんに　さわぎを　おこされると
ポケモンが　おびえないか　しんぱいだ！
records.english:
Nnn... Roar!
What's going on?\cI was digging the tunnel without any
tools when some goon ordered me out!\cThat tunnel's filled with POKéMON
that react badly to loud noises.They could cause an uproar.\cThat's why we stopped using heavy
equipment for tunneling...\cI'm worried that the goon will do
something stupid and startle thePOKéMON into an uproar.

records.japanese: ぬぉー！！\cへんな　おとこが　とびだしていった！\nこれで　トンネルを　ほれるよ！
records.english: Nnn... Roar!\cThat goofy goon hightailed it out of\nthe tunnel! I can go back to digging!

records.japanese:
ああっ！
きみは！！\cトウカのもりで　たすけてくれた　だけでなく
ぬすまれた　にもつを　とりかえしはたまた　カイナへの　とどけものをこころよく　ひきうけてくれた　ひと！！\cクスノキかんちょう　から
「にもつが　とどいた」とれんらくが　ありましたよ！\cどうも　ありがとう　なのです！
かんしゃ　かんげき　あめ　あられ　なのです\cそんな　すてきな　トレーナーさんに
グッド　ニュース！\cさいきん　わがしゃ　では
あたらしい　モンスターボールのかいはつに　せいこう　したのです！\cかんしゃの　きもちとして
トレーナーさんにも　プレゼント　なのよね！
records.english:
Oh! It's you!\cYou're that person who not only helped
me in PETALBURG WOODS, but also gotback my stolen package and then evengraciously delivered it to SLATEPORT!\cCAPT. STERN informed us that the
package arrived, too!\cI thank you very, very much!\cWhy, if I were a rain cloud, I would
shower you with gratitude and hailyou as a hero!\cFor you, the most wonderful TRAINER,
I bear good news!\cRecently, our company developed a new
kind of POKé BALL.\cAs a token of our appreciation, this
is our gift to our wonderful TRAINER!

records.japanese: あたらしい　モンスターボールは\nカナズミの　フレンドリィ　ショップで\rうってますからね！\cぜひ　つかって　みてください！\nではでは‥‥
records.english: Our new POKé BALL will be available\nat the POKéMON MART in RUSTBORO.\cPlease do try it out!\nThank you and bye-bye!

records.japanese: どうぐ　いっぱいで\nリピートボール　あげられないね
records.english: Your BAG is jam-packed.\nI can't give you this REPEAT BALL.

records.japanese: にもつを　とどけてくれた　ことへの\nかんしゃの　きもちとして\rトレーナーさん　にも　あたらしい\rモンスターボールを　プレゼント　なのよね！
records.english: As a token of our appreciation for\nyour delivering our package, I have a\rgift of a new kind of POKé BALL for our\rmost wonderful TRAINER!

records.japanese: メガネを　おとしたんだ‥‥\nきみも　さがすの　てつだってよ
records.english: I dropped my glasses...\nCan you help me find them?

records.japanese: その　メガネ‥‥？\nちょっと　みせてよ！
records.english: Those glasses!\nMay I see them for a second?

records.japanese: うーむ‥‥\nこれは　くろいメガネ　だね\rぼくが　さがしているのと　ちがうなあ‥‥\cここには　ぼくの　メガネ　ないのかなあ
records.english: Hmm...\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\rThey're not what I'm looking for...\cMaybe my glasses aren't around\nhere...

records.japanese: うーむ‥‥\nどうにも　メガネが　みつからないんだ\rここには　ぼくの　メガネ　ないのかなあ
records.english: Hmm...\nI can't find my glasses anywhere...\rMaybe they're not around here...

records.japanese: うーむ‥‥\nこれは　くろいメガネ　だね\rぼくが　さがしているのと　ちがうなあ‥‥
records.english: Hmm...\nThese are BLACKGLASSES.\rThey're not what I'm looking for...

records.japanese: ここは　１１６ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　カナズミシティ
カナズミと　シダケを　むすぶ\n「カナシダ　トンネル」\cかいつう　こうじは　ちゅうしに　なりました
records.english: RUSTURF TUNNEL\n“Linking RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF\c“The tunnel project has been\ncanceled.”

records.japanese: トンネルこうじ　さぎょういん　つめしょ
おとくな　けいじばん！\cポケモンが　しんか　しそうなとき\nビーボタンを　おすと\rびっくりして　しんかを　やめます！\cこれを　しんかキャンセルと　いいます
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cIf you want to stop a POKéMON from\nevolving, press the B Button while it\ris trying to evolve.\rThe startled POKéMON will stop.\cThis is called an evolution cancel.

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cバッグには　いくつかの　ポケットが　あり\nいれる　どうぐの　しゅるい　によって\rそれぞれの　ポケットに\rオートで　ぶんるい　されます\cまさに　トレーナーの　ひつじゅひん　です！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cYour BAG has several POCKETS.\cItems you obtain are automatically\nplaced in the appropriate POCKETS.\cNo TRAINER can afford to be without\na BAG of their own.

records.japanese: そだてやに　ポケモン　あずけていたの\cそしたら　あたしの　ポケモン\nいつのまにか　しらない　わざ　おぼえていて\rわたしが　とまどっちゃった！
records.english: I left my POKéMON at the DAY CARE.\cWhen I got it back, it had a new move\nthat I didn't teach it.\rI was really, really surprised.

records.japanese: どお？\nきれいに　ならんだ　この　はな！\cぜーんぶ　わたしが　うえたのよ！
records.english: What do you think?\nAren't these flowers pretty?\cI planted them all!

records.japanese: くうきが　うまーい！
ここは　１１７ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　シダケタウン
ここは　１１７ばん　どうろ\n[RIGHT_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
「ポケモン　そだてや」\nあなたの　ポケモン　そだてます
records.english: POKéMON DAY CARE\n“Let us raise your POKéMON.”

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『やあ！\cきみは　ムロで　であった
トレーナー　だよね！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか
うん　おぼえておく\c[PLAYER][KUN]\cこの　ひろい　せかいには
さまざまな　ポケモンがいるそれぞれ　さまざまな　タイプを　もっている\cいろんな　タイプの　ポケモンを　そだてるか
それとも　すきな　タイプのポケモンばかり　そだてるか‥‥\cきみは　ポケモン　トレーナーとして
どう　かんがえてる？\cボクが　きに　すること　ないけどね\cじゃあ
また　あえると　いいね
records.english:
STEVEN: Hi!\cYou're that TRAINER I met in DEWFORD!\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cOh, okay, you're [PLAYER][KUN].
I'll remember it.\c[PLAYER][KUN].\cIn this vast world, there are many
kinds of POKéMON.They come in many types.\cDo you raise different types?
Or do you raise only POKéMON of acertain type?\cWhat do you think as a TRAINER?\cSorry, it's not my place to ask, is it?\cWell, anyway, I hope to see you
again.

records.japanese: うむ！\nいいつりざおは　ほんとうに　いいよ！\cきみも　そう　おもうでしょ？
records.english: Hmm!\nA GOOD ROD is really good!\cWouldn't you agree?

records.japanese: うむ！\nきみとは　きが　あうよ！\cうむ！\nいいつりざおを　あげよう！
records.english: Hmm!\nWe're of identical minds!\cHmm!\nTake this GOOD ROD!

records.japanese: みずの　ある　ところなら\nどこでも　つりを　すると　いいよ！
records.english: Wherever there's water, try your luck\nat fishing.

records.japanese: つりは　きらい　かい？
いいつりざおで\nいろんな　ポケモンを　つると　いいよ！
records.english: Try catching all sorts of POKéMON\nwith your GOOD ROD.

records.japanese: ふねを　もって　いなくても\nなみのりを　おぼえた　ポケモンが　いれば\rうみや　かわを　わたって　いけちゃうの！\cポケモンって　たのもしーい！
records.english: Even if there isn't a boat, you can\ncross rivers and the sea if you have\ra POKéMON that knows SURF.\cPOKéMON can be counted on to do so\nmuch!

records.japanese: ここは　１１８ばん　どうろ\n[LEFT_ARROW]　キンセツシティ
ここは　１１８ばん　どうろ\n[UP_ARROW]　１１９ばん　どうろ

ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]！
どこに　いたのよ？　さがしたわ！\cどれくらい　つよく　なったのか
ちょっと　ためして　あげる！\cポケモンの　じゅんびは‥‥
いいに　きまってるよね！　それっ！
records.english:
MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]!
Where were you? I was looking for you!\cHow much stronger have you gotten?
Let me check for you!\cReady with your POKéMON?
Of course you are! Go!

records.japanese: あっちゃー！\n[PLAYER][KUN]　つよい　じゃない！\cポケモン　そだってなくて\nこまってるかも　って　しんぱい　してたのに
records.english: Achah!\n[PLAYER][KUN], you're strong!\cI was worried that you might be\nstruggling with your training.

records.japanese: ハルカ『ぜんぜん　だいじょうぶ！\nその　ちょうしで　がんばってね！\cこれは　あたし　からの　プレゼントよ！
records.english: MAY: But I had absolutely nothing to\nworry about! Keep it up!\cAnd, here! I have a present for you.

records.japanese:
ハルカ『そらをとぶを　つかえば
いちど　いった　まちなら　いっしゅんでとんでいく　ことが　できるの！\cでも　そらをとぶを　つかうには
ヒワマキの　ジムバッジが　いるのよこれ　だいじだから　わすれないでね！\cたまには　そらをとぶで
ミシロに　かえるのも　いいんじゃない？\c[PLAYER][KUN]の　おかあさん
しんぱい　してるかも　しれないし‥‥\cじゃあ
また　どこかで　あおうね！
records.english:
MAY: Use FLY, and your POKéMON will
instantly carry you to any town you'vealready visited.\cBut, to use FLY, you have to get the
GYM BADGE from FORTREE CITY.That's important, so don't forget.\cYou should FLY home and visit
LITTLEROOT for a change.\cI bet your mom's worried about you,
[PLAYER][KUN].\cWell, let's meet again somewhere!

records.japanese:
ユウキ『[PLAYER]！
ここで　ポケモン　さがしてたのか？\cどれくらい　つよく　なったか
ためして　やるよ\cさあ！
しょうぶ　しょうぶ　だぜ！
records.english:
BRENDAN: [PLAYER]! So this is where
you've been looking for POKéMON?\cLet me see how good you got.
I'll test you!\cNow!
It's a battle, so battle!

records.japanese: ふうん‥‥\nけっこう　つよく　なってるんだな
ユウキ『それなら　どこで　ポケモン\nさがしても　だいじょうぶ　だな\cこれ　やるから　つかってみろよ！
records.english: BRENDAN: I'd say you're good enough\nto search for POKéMON anywhere.\cHere, I'll give you this.\nTry it out.

records.japanese: ユウキ『そらをとぶを　つかえば\nいちど　いった　まちなら\rいっしゅんで　とんでいける\cもっとも　ヒワマキの\nジムバッジが　ひつよう　だけど‥‥\cじゃ　オレ　さきにいくよ
records.english: BRENDAN: Use FLY, and your POKéMON\ninstantly carries you to any town\ryou've already visited.\cBut you need the FORTREE GYM BADGE \nto do that.\cAnyway, I have to move along.

records.japanese: オレたち　ここで　みはりを　しているのさ\cおい　おまえ！　あぶないから\nてんき　けんきゅうじょ　には　ちかづくなよ
records.english: We're standing lookout here.\cHey, you! Stay away from the WEATHER\nINSTITUTE. It's not safe.

records.japanese: みはりって　いがいと　ヒマだなあ‥‥\cおい　おまえ！　おねがいだから\nてんき　けんきゅうじょ　には　ちかづくなよ

[EVIL_LEADER]?\cDo you finally see how disastrous

I think it's wonderful for people to
travel with POKéMON.\cBut you should go home every so often
to let your mother know you're okay.\cShe might not say it, but I'm sure she
worries about you, [PLAYER][KUN].

records.japanese: ポケモンは　たいりょく　まんたん！\nどうぐも　これで　よし‥‥と！
records.english: POKéMON fully restored!\nItems ready, and... Huh?

records.japanese:
えっ‥‥！？
あなた　だれ‥‥　なの？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cあなたが　[PLAYER][KUN]‥‥
そうか　きょう　ひっこし　だったんだ‥‥\cあ　あたし　ハルカ！
よ　よろしくね\cあたし‥‥
せかいじゅうの　ポケモンとともだちに　なるのが　ゆめ　なの‥‥\cで　でね
おとうさん‥‥　オダマキはかせ　から[PLAYER][KUN]の　おなはし　きいて\cあたし　[PLAYER][KUN]　とも
おともだちに　なれたらなあ‥‥なんて　おもってたの‥‥\cあっ　あたしったら　[PLAYER][KUN]と
はじめて　おはなし　してるのになに　いってんだろ‥‥\cてへへ‥‥\cあっ　いけない！\cあたし　おとうさんの　おてつだいで
やせいの　ポケモンつかまえに　いくところ　だったんだ！\c[PLAYER][KUN]
まっ　また　あとでね！
records.english:
Huh?
Who... Who are you?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cOh, you're [PLAYER][KUN].
So your move was today.\cUm... I'm MAY.
Glad to meet you!\cI...
I have this dream of becoming friendswith POKéMON all over the world.\cI... I heard about you, [PLAYER][KUN], from
my dad, PROF. BIRCH.\cI was hoping that you would be nice,
[PLAYER][KUN], and that we could be friends.\cOh, this is silly, isn't it?
I... I've just met you, [PLAYER][KUN].\cEheheh...\cOh, no! I forgot!\cI was supposed to go help Dad catch
some wild POKéMON!\c[PLAYER][KUN], I'll catch you later!

records.japanese: ポケモンは　たいりょく　まんたん\nどうぐも　これで　だいじょうぶ　‥‥か
records.english: POKéMON fully restored...\nItems all packed, and...

records.japanese:
おまえ‥‥\cだれ？\cあっ　おまえが　となりに
ひっこして　きた　[PLAYER]か‥‥\cふうん
おんなのこ　だったんだ‥‥\cとうさん‥‥　オダマキはかせ　から
となりに　ひっこして　くるのはジムリーダーの　こども　って　きいてたからかってに　おとこ　だと　おもってたよ\cオレは　ユウキ
まあ　おとなりさんに　なったことだしこれから　よろしくな\cおや？　[PLAYER]は
ポケモン　もってないのか？\cよかったら　オレが
つかまえてきて　やろうか？\cって　わすれてた‥‥\cオレ　とうさんの　てつだいで
やせいの　ポケモンつかまえに　いく　ところ　だったんだ\cまた　こんどな！
records.english:
Hey!
You...\cWho are you?\cOh, you're [PLAYER], aren't you?
Moved in next door, right?\cI didn't know that you're a girl.\cDad, PROF. BIRCH, said that our new
next-door neighbor is a GYM LEADER'skid, so I assumed you'd be a guy.\cMy name's BRENDAN.
So, hi, neighbor!\cHuh? Hey, [PLAYER], don't you have
a POKéMON?\cDo you want me to go catch you one?\cAw, darn, I forgot...\cI'm supposed to go help my dad catch
some wild POKéMON.\cSome other time, okay?

records.japanese:
ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]！\cあたし　いまね
ポケモンずかんを　ながめていたの\cみつけた　だけで
つかまえていない　ポケモンやしんか　しそうな　ポケモンまだまだ　いっぱい　いるんだよね\cこんどは　どこに
ポケモン　つかまえに　いこうかな？
records.english:
MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI was just checking my POKéDEX.\cThere's still a lot of POKéMON that
I've seen but haven't caught.\cAnd there are many others that
I think will evolve.\cI wonder where I should go catch
some POKéMON next?

records.japanese: ハルカ『こんどは　どこに\nポケモン　つかまえに　いこうかな？\cいった　さきで　また\n[PLAYER][KUN]と　であったりして！？
records.english: MAY: I wonder where I should go catch\nsome POKéMON next?\cWouldn't it be funny if we ran into each\nother, [PLAYER][KUN]?

records.japanese:
ユウキ『[PLAYER]か\cいま　ポケモンずかんを
チェック　してたんだ\cまだまだ　つかまえていない
ポケモンも　いるけどかなり　いい　かんじだろ？\cこうして　ずかんを　みていると
また　ぼうけんに　いきたくなるな
records.english: BRENDAN: Hey, it's [PLAYER].\cI was just checking out my POKéDEX.\cThere are still many POKéMON that\nI need to catch, I know, but this\ris looking pretty good.\cChecking this POKéDEX out gives me\nthe urge to hit the road again.

records.japanese: ユウキ『こんどは　どこで\nポケモン　つかまえるか　なやむな‥‥\cもし　ポケモン　つかまえているとき\n[PLAYER]と　であったら\rしょうぶ　してやろうか？
records.english: BRENDAN: I'm having a hard time deciding\nwhere I should catch POKéMON next.\cHey, [PLAYER], if I see you while I'm out\ncatching POKéMON, I can pitch you a\rbattle if you'd like.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　えほんが\nたくさん　そろっている！
records.english: It's lined with POKéMON picture books.

records.japanese: 『ポケモンの　しゅるいと　ぶんぷ』\n『ヒトと　ポケモンの　きょうぞん』\r『はじめて　まなぶ　ポケモンがく』\cオダマキはかせが　かいた　ほんが\nたくさん　ならんでいる！
records.english: POKéMON SPECIES & HABITATS...\nHUMAN & POKéMON COEXISTENCE...\rPOKéMONOLOGY FOR BEGINNERS...\cIt's brimming with books written by\nPROF. BIRCH.

records.japanese: はかせは　つくえのうえで　けんきゅうを\nするよりも　じっさいに　そとへ　とびだして\rたいけんする　タイプのひと　なんです！
records.english:
Hunh? PROF. BIRCH?\cThe PROF's away on fieldwork.
Ergo, he isn't here.\cOh, let me explain what fieldwork is.\cIt is to study things in the natural
environment, like fields and mountains,instead of a laboratory.\cThe PROF isn't one for doing desk work.
He's the type of person who wouldrather go outside and experiencethings than read about them here.

records.japanese: はかせは　つくえのうえで　けんきゅうを\nするよりも　じっさいに　そとへ　とびだして\rたいけんする　タイプのひと　なんです！
records.english: The PROF isn't one for doing desk work.\nHe's the type of person who would\rrather go outside and experience\rthings than read about them here.

records.japanese: オダマキはかせは\nポケモンが　どこに　すんでいるのか\rぶんぷの　ちょうさを　なさっています\c[RIVAL]さんは　すきな　おとうさんの\nおてつだいを　なさって　いるのですよ
records.english: PROF. BIRCH is studying the habitats\nand distribution of POKéMON.\cThe PROF enjoys [RIVAL]'s help, too.\nThere's a lot of love there.

records.japanese:
オダマキ『‥‥さて　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cきみのことは　おとうさん　から
いつも　きかされていたよ！\cきみは　まだ　じぶんの　ポケモンを
もったことが　ないんだって？\cそれにしては　さっきの　たたかいぶり
なかなか　みごと　だったよ！\cやっぱり　きみには　おとうさんの
ちが　ながれて　いるんだな！\cそうそう！　たすけてくれた　おれいに
さっきの　ポケモンは　わたしからきみへの　プレゼントに　しよう！\c[PLAYER]は
[STR_VAR_1]を　もらった！
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: So, [PLAYER][KUN].\cI've heard so much about you from
your father.\cI've heard that you don't have your
own POKéMON yet.\cBut the way you battled earlier,
you pulled it off with aplomb!\cI guess you have your father's blood
in your veins after all!\cOh, yes. As thanks for rescuing me,
I'd like you to have the POKéMON youused earlier.\c[PLAYER] received the [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: オダマキ『せっかく　だから　[STR_VAR_1]に\nニックネームを　つけてみては　どうだい？
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: While you're at it, why not\ngive a nickname to that [STR_VAR_1]?

records.japanese: オダマキ『これから　さらに\nけいけんを　つんで　いけば\rいい　トレーナーに　なれそうだ！\cちょうど　うちの　[RIVAL]が\n１０３ばん　どうろで\rポケモンの　ちょうさを　しているから\rあいに　いったら　どうだろう？
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: If you work at POKéMON
and gain experience, I think you'll makea darn good TRAINER.\cMy kid, [RIVAL], is out on ROUTE 103
studying POKéMON.\cIt might not be a bad idea for you to
go see [RIVAL]. What do you think?

records.japanese: オダマキ『そうか！\nそれは　[RIVAL]も　よろこぶぞ！\cトレーナーが　どんな　ものか\nおしえてもらうと　いいぞ！
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: Great!\n[RIVAL] should be happy, too.\cGet [RIVAL] to teach you what it\nmeans to be a TRAINER.

records.japanese: オダマキ『そんなこと　いわずに\nあいに　いったら　どうだろう？
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: Oh, don't be that way.\nYou should go meet my kid.

records.japanese: オダマキ『[RIVAL]　だったら\n１０３ばん　どうろに　いる　はずだ！\cもしも　きみの　ポケモンが　キズついたら\nじぶんの　いえで　やすむと　いいぞ！
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: [RIVAL] should be on\nROUTE 103 somewhere.\cIf you or your POKéMON get tired,\nget some rest at home.

records.japanese:
オダマキ『おっ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cはじめてで　[RIVAL]に
かつ　だなんて　すごいじゃないか！\c[RIVAL]は　かなり　まえから
わたしの　けんきゅうを　てつだっていてトレーナーれきは　けっこう　ながいんだよ！\cうむ！　[PLAYER][KUN]　にも
けんきゅうの　ために　とりよせたこの　ポケモンずかんを　あげよう！
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: Oh, hi, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI heard you beat [RIVAL] on
your first try. That's excellent!\c[RIVAL]'s been helping with my research
for a long time.\c[RIVAL] has an extensive history as
a TRAINER already.\cHere, [PLAYER][KUN], I ordered this for my
research, but I think you should havethis POKéDEX.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nポケモンずかんを　もらった！

オダマキ『その　ポケモンずかんは
きみが　であった　ポケモンを\cじどうてきに　きろく　していってくれる
ハイテクな　どうぐ　なんだ！\c[RIVAL]も　その　ずかんを　もっていて
あちこちに　あそびに　いくんだな\cで　めずらしい　ポケモンを　つかまえて
ずかんに　きろく　できるとだね\cフィールドワークを　している　わたしを
さがしだしては　みせて　くれるんだよ！
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: The POKéDEX is a high-tech
tool that automatically makes a recordof any POKéMON you meet or catch.\cMy kid, [RIVAL], goes everywhere
with it.\cWhenever my kid catches a rare POKéMON
and records its data in the POKéDEX,why, [RIVAL] looks for me while I'm outdoing fieldwork, and shows me.

records.japanese: オダマキ『きみの　ゆくてには\nたくさんの　ポケモンが　まっているよ！\cあー　はやく　フィールドワークに\nいきたく　なってきたぞ！
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: Countless POKéMON await\nyou!\cArgh, I'm getting the itch to get out\nand do fieldwork again!

records.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]も\nポケモンずかん　もらったんだね！\cよかったね！　あたしと　いっしょだよ！\nじゃあ　あたしは　これを　あげる！
records.english: MAY: Oh, wow, [PLAYER][KUN]!\nYou got a POKéDEX, too!\cThat's great! Just like me!\nI've got something for you, too!

records.japanese:
ハルカ『ポケモンが
たくさん　いると　たのしいよ！\cあたし　いろんな　ポケモン　さがしたいから
いろんな　ところを　さがすわ！\cそして　かわいい　ポケモンが　いたら
モンスターボールで　つかまえちゃう！
records.english:
MAY: It's fun if you can get a lot of
POKéMON!\cI'm going to look all over the place
because I want different POKéMON.\cIf I find any cute POKéMON, I'll catch
them with POKé BALLS!

records.japanese: あら？　バッグ　いっぱいだよ
ハルカ『こんどは　どこまで\nポケモンを　さがしに　いこうかな？
records.english: MAY: I wonder where I should go look\nfor POKéMON next?

records.japanese: ユウキ『ふうん　[PLAYER]も\nポケモンずかん　もらったのか\cじゃあ　オレは　これ　やるよ
records.english: BRENDAN: Huh...\nSo you got a POKéDEX, too.\cWell then, here.\nI'll give you this.

records.japanese:
ユウキ『ポケモンが
たくさん　いると　たのしいからな\cオレ　いろんな　ポケモン　さがすため
いろんな　ところに　いくんだ\cそして　かっこいい　ポケモンが　いたら
モンスターボールで　つかまえるんだ
records.english:
BRENDAN: You know it's more fun to
have a whole bunch of POKéMON.\cI'm going to explore all over the place
to find different POKéMON.\cIf I find any cool POKéMON, you bet
I'll try to get them with POKé BALLS.

records.japanese: おや？　バッグ　いっぱいだよ
ユウキ『こんどは　どこに\nポケモン　さがしに　いこうかな‥‥
records.english: BRENDAN: Where should I look for\nPOKéMON next...

records.japanese: なんか　すごそうな　マシンだ！\nはかせが　けんきゅうに　つかうのかな？
records.english: It's a serious-looking machine.\nThe PROF must use this for research.

records.japanese: けんきゅうに　つかわれている　パソコンだ！\n‥‥　さわるのは　やめておこう
records.english: It's a PC used for research.\nBetter not mess around with it.

records.japanese: ポケモンに　ついて　かかれた\nほんが　いっぱい　ある！
records.english: It's crammed with books on POKéMON.

records.japanese: むずかしそうな　ほんが　おいてある！
records.english: It's a book that's too hard to read.

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶの　とき\nポケモンの　リストの　ひだりに　いる\rポケモンが　とびだして　たたかうの\cだから　つれあるく　ポケモンが　ふえてきたら\nポケモンの　じゅんばんを　かえると\rしょうぶが　ゆうりに　なるかも！
records.english: When a POKéMON battle starts, the one\nat the left of the list goes out first.\cSo, when you get more POKéMON in your\nparty, try switching around the order\rof your POKéMON.\cIt could give you an advantage.

records.japanese: ポケモンって　たたかうと\nレベルアップして　つよくなるのよ！
records.english: When POKéMON battle, they eventually\nlevel up and become stronger.

records.japanese: つれて　あるく　ポケモンが　つよかったら\nとおくまで　いけるように　なるね！
records.english: If the POKéMON with you become\nstronger, you'll be able to go farther\raway from here.

records.japanese: すみっこに　おいてある　パソコンは\nポケモントレーナーの　ための　ものなんだ\cきみも　じゆうに　つかって　いいんだよ！
records.english: That PC in the corner there is\nfor any POKéMON TRAINER to use.\cNaturally, that means you're welcome\nto use it, too.

records.japanese: ポケモンセンターって　すごいよな！\cポケモン　なんびき　あずけても\nおかねが　かからないから\rどんな　ときでも　あんしん　だよね！
records.english: POKéMON CENTERS are great!\cYou can use their services as much\nas you like, and it's all for free.\rYou never have to worry!

records.japanese: ２かいの　ポケモン　つうしん　クラブは\nつい　さいきん　できたの\cでも　まだ\nちょうせいちゅう　ですって
records.english: The POKéMON CABLE CLUB on the second\nfloor was built recently.\cBut they say they're still making\nadjustments.

records.japanese: ２かいの　ポケモン　つうしん　クラブは\nつい　さいきん　できたの\cあたし　さっそく\nポケモンこうかん　しちゃった！
records.english: The POKéMON CABLE CLUB on the second\nfloor was built recently.\cI traded POKéMON right away.

records.japanese: なんでも　うりきれ　らしくて\nモンスターボール　かえないの‥‥
records.english: The clerk says they're all sold out.\nI can't buy any POKé BALLS.

records.japanese: どんどん　モンスターボール　かって\nどんどん　ポケモン　つかまえちゃうわよ！
records.english: I'm going to buy a bunch of POKé BALLS\nand catch a bunch of POKéMON!

records.japanese: ポケモンは　たいりょくが　なくなると\nたたかう　げんきも　なくなる\cそんな　ときは　キズぐすりを　つかって\nたいりょくを　かいふく　してあげるんだ！
records.english: If a POKéMON gets hurt and loses its HP\nand faints, it won't be able to battle.\cTo prevent your POKéMON from fainting,\nrestore its HP with a POTION.

records.japanese: こういう　ちいさな　しまで\nポケモンと　かぞく　なかよく　くらすのも\rなかなか　いい　もんですよ
records.english: There's a lot to be said for living on\na small island like this in harmony with\rPOKéMON and the family.

records.japanese: わたしは　カイナシティ　という\nおおきな　みなとまち　から\rおよめさんに　きたのよ\cのんびりとした　しま　だけれど\nきれいな　うみに　かこまれて　いれば\rそれだけで　しあわせ　なんだね
records.english: I came from the large port of SLATEPORT\nCITY when I married my husband here.\cLife goes by slowly on this little\nisland. But being surrounded by the\rbeautiful sea - that's happiness, too.

records.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぐぐう！
まちの　はずれの　いしのどうくつ　には\nめずらしい　いしが　あるって　きいたわ
records.english: There's a stone cavern at the edge\nof town.\cI've heard you can find rare stones\nthere.

records.japanese: つかれて　たたかうことの　できない\nポケモンだって　ひでんと　いわれる\rわざは　つかうことが　できるよ！
records.english: Even if a POKéMON faints and can't\nbattle, it can still use a move learned\rfrom a Hidden Machine, HM.

records.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cムロタウン　ジムの　リーダー　トウキは
かくとうタイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてだ！\cノーマルタイプで　むかうと
きびしぃー　いちげきを　くらうからきを　つけたほうが　いいぞ！\cしかも！　この　ジムの　なかは
うみのそこ　みたいに　くらいんだ！\cでも！　トレーナーを　ひとり　たおすごとに
だんだん　あかるく　なって　いくぞ！\cじゃ　きばってこォー！！
records.english:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cDEWFORD's GYM LEADER BRAWLY commands
FIGHTING-type POKéMON.\cGoing against him with NORMAL-type
POKéMON is asking for trouble.\cFIGHTING POKéMON will lay a serious
smack down on NORMAL POKéMON,so be careful!\cWhat's worse, the GYM is as dark as
the ocean floor.\cBut it will get brighter after defeating
the TRAINERS in your way.\cHey, okay, go for it!

records.japanese: うおォ！　ずいぶん　あかるく　なったな！\cきみの　みらいも　あかるいぞ！
records.english: Whoah! It's turned too bright in here!\cYour future is bright, too!

records.japanese: ちから　こそ　せいぎっ！\nドリャーッ！！
ちからぶそく　だった‥‥！
じゅう　よく　ごうを　せいす！\nみごとな　たたかいぶり　だった！
records.english: Your skill overcame my strength!\nYour technique is commendable!

records.japanese: トウキさまと　たたかうまでも　ないわ！\nわたしが　たおして　あげる！
records.english: There's no need for BRAWLY to be\ninvolved!\cI'll crush you!

records.japanese: まさか‥‥\nこんなに　かんたんに　やられるなんて
records.english: But... How?\nHow could I lose so easily?

records.japanese: この　まけを　むだに　しないため\nもっと　とっくん　する！\cそして　いつかは　ジムリーダーに‥‥\cいえ　ポケモンリーグの\nチャンピオンに　なるわよ！
records.english: I'm not going to waste this loss.\nI'll use it to motivate me to train!\cOne day I'll become a GYM LEADER...\cNo, I'll become the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION!

records.japanese: あたしを　あまく　みない　ことね！\nないても　しらないわよ！
records.english: Don't you dare brush me off!\nIt's not my fault if you cry!

records.japanese: わぁーーーん！\nまけたーーーっ！
くらやみの　なかで　たたかうことで\nこころを　きたえるの\cでも　まっくら　だから\nトウキさまの　おかおを　みられない‥‥
records.english: I battle in the dark to make my heart\nstronger.\cBut because it's so dark, I can never\nsee BRAWLY's face...

records.japanese:
ボクは　ムロ　ポケモンジム
リーダーの　トウキ！\cこの　あたりの
はげしい　なみに　もまれ‥‥\cくらい　どうくつで
しゅぎょう　して　いるのさ！\cボクに　ちょうせん　しよう　という
キミの　じつりょく‥‥どれほどの　ものか　みさせてもらうよ！
records.english:
I'm BRAWLY!
DEWFORD's GYM LEADER!\cI've been churned in the rough waves
of these parts, and I've grown toughin the pitch-black cave!\cSo you wanted to challenge me?
Let me see what you're made of!

records.japanese: ううーん　よそう　していたより\nキミは　ビッグウェーブ！\cわかった！\nこの　バッジを　もっていきな！
records.english: Whoah, wow! You made a much bigger\nsplash than I expected!\cYou swamped me!\cOkay, you've got me.\nTake this GYM BADGE!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　トウキから\nナックルバッジを　もらった！

ナックルバッジには
レベル３０までの　ポケモンならひとから　もらった　ポケモンでもすなおに　する　こうかが　ある！\cそれに　たたかって　いなくても
ひでんわざの　フラッシュを　つかえる！\cこの　わざマシン
よかったら　つかいな！
records.english:
The KNUCKLE BADGE makes all POKéMON
up to Level 30, even those you get intrades, obey without question.\cAnd, you'll be able to use the HM move
FLASH outside of battle.\cIf you'd like, use this TECHNICAL
MACHINE, too.

records.japanese: その　わざマシン０８　には\nビルドアップが　はいっている！\cこうげきりょくと　ぼうぎょりょくを\nあげる　わざ　なのさ！
records.english: That TM08 contains BULK UP.\cIt's a move that raises both ATTACK\nand DEFENSE stats.

records.japanese: キミの　さいのうは\nいつのひか　おおきな　なみと　なって\cポケモン　トレーナーたちの　あいだに\nおどろきの　あらしを　まきおこすだろう！
records.english: I can see your talent becoming a giant\nwave to cause a storm of astonishment\ramong TRAINERS one day!

records.japanese: ムロタウン　ポケモンジム
ムロタウン　ポケモンジム\cトウキ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
records.english: DEWFORD TOWN POKéMON GYM\cBRAWLY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

records.japanese: いまの　はやりって　いったら　やっぱり\n「[STR_VAR_1]」よね！\c「[STR_VAR_1]」の　ない\nせいかつ　なんか　かんがえられない！
records.english: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“[STR_VAR_1]”!\cI can't imagine what life would be like\nwithout “[STR_VAR_1]”!

records.japanese: いまの　はやりって　いったら　やっぱり\n「[STR_VAR_1]」よね！\cでも　もう　そろそろ\nあきてきたなー\cあたらしい　はやりでも　さがそっかなー
records.english: What's in vogue? Why, it has to be\n“[STR_VAR_1]”!\cBut I'm getting kind of bored with it.\cI should look for the next big thing.

records.japanese: わたしは　ポケモンにも\n「[STR_VAR_1]」を\rおしえてるんだけど\cこれが　なかなか\nたいへん　なのよねー
records.english: I'm teaching my POKéMON about\n“[STR_VAR_1],”\rbut it's not going well.\cIt's a bit too much, I think.

records.japanese:
いま　はやりの
「[STR_VAR_1]」のことをしらべてるんだけど\c「[STR_VAR_1]」と
「[STR_VAR_2]」ってのは\cふかい　かんけいが　あるって　いうのは
ほんとうの　ことなのかい？
records.english: I'm studying up on the hip and trendy\n“[STR_VAR_1]” now.\cIs it true that there's a deep link\nbetween “[STR_VAR_1]”\rand “[STR_VAR_2]”?

records.japanese: お！\nやっぱり　そうなのか\cこれで　おじさんも　またいっぽ\nりゅうこうに　ちかづいたぞ！
records.english: Oh!\nSo, my hunch was right!\cI'm one step closer to being hip and\nhappening, yowza!

records.japanese: なに！？\nそうなのか！？\cいやー　おじさんが　りゅうこうに\nついて　いくのは　たいへんだ！
records.english: What?!\nIs that so?!\cIt's not easy for an older fellow like\nme to keep up with trends!

records.japanese: 「[STR_VAR_1]」の\nテレビって　いうのは\rやってないのかのう‥‥
records.english: This whole business about\n“[STR_VAR_1]”...\rIsn't there a TV show on it?

records.japanese: うみの　むこうでは\cもっと　「[STR_VAR_1]」が\nはやってるのかな？

ぼくは　「[STR_VAR_1]」の
グッズを　いっぱい　あつめて　いるんだ！\c「[STR_VAR_1]」にんぎょう
とか\c「[STR_VAR_1]」ようふく\c「[STR_VAR_1]」の　えほん
なんかも　もってるよ\cいいだろー！
ほしくても　あげないよー
records.english:
I collect official
“[STR_VAR_1]”licensed merchandise.\cI have official
“[STR_VAR_1]” dolls...\cOfficial “[STR_VAR_1]”
brand clothing...\cAnd officially licensed
“[STR_VAR_1]”picture books.\cHeheh, I own!
I'm not sharing anything with you!

records.japanese:
『よい「[STR_VAR_1]」と
　わるい「[STR_VAR_1]」』\c『「[STR_VAR_1]」と
　ポケモンの　かんけい』\c『やくにたつ
　「[STR_VAR_1]」』\c「[STR_VAR_1]」に
ついての　ほんが　ずらっと　ならんでいる！
records.english:
IDENTIFYING GOOD
“[STR_VAR_1]” &BAD “[STR_VAR_1]”...\cTHE LINK BETWEEN
“[STR_VAR_1]” ANDPOKéMON...\cUSEFUL
“[STR_VAR_1]”...\cIt's neatly jammed with books about
“[STR_VAR_1].”

records.japanese: 『「[STR_VAR_1]」の\n　さけび』\cという　だいめい　だ！
『「[STR_VAR_1]」の\n　ほほえみ』\cという　だいめい　だ！
『さいごの\n　「[STR_VAR_1]」』\cという　だいめい　だ！
『「[STR_VAR_1]」の\n　たんじょう』\cという　だいめい　だ！
ぼく　さいきん　はやりの\c「[STR_VAR_1]」を\nみたんだ　いいだろ！\cすごかったよ\nほんもの　だぜ！
records.english: I saw “[STR_VAR_1]”!\nCool, huh?\cIt's, like, the coolest thing going!\cIt was awesome!\nIt was the real thing, oh yeah!

records.japanese:
いや　きみの　みた
「[STR_VAR_1]」はほんもの　じゃないね！\cほんものは　もっと
キレが　あるというかうつくしい　というか‥‥\cまあ　とにかく
もっと　すごいんだよ！
records.english: Oh, no, no, no.\cThat alleged\n“[STR_VAR_1]”\ryou claim to have seen - it's not.\cThe authentic article is much...\nHow should I say it?\rSharper, yet more mellifluous!\cAh, no matter. It's astonishing!

records.japanese:
ぼく　さいきん　はやってる
「[STR_VAR_1]」のテーマ　きょくを　かんがえたんだきいてくれよ！\c‥‥\cおー！
[STR_VAR_1]　ー！\cすばらしい
[STR_VAR_1]　ーー！！
records.english:
Hey, listen, I composed a theme song
for “[STR_VAR_1].”\c“[STR_VAR_1]”
is really popular right now.\cOkay, listen!
... ...\cOh!
[STR_VAR_1]!\cWonderful
[STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: ‥‥\cきみは\n「[STR_VAR_1]」　よりも\cうたの　べんきょうを\nしたほうが　いいね
records.english: ... ...\cI dare say, chap, it would pay for you\nto work on your singing before you\rtrifle yourself with\r“[STR_VAR_1].”

records.japanese: さっきの　はなし\nなんだけどさ\cこんど　この　しまで\n「[STR_VAR_1]」\rパーティーを　ひらこうぜ！
records.english: Anyway, as I was saying earlier, we\nshould get together and organize a\r“[STR_VAR_1]” party\ron the island.

records.japanese: お　いいね！！\cだれが　いちばん\n「[STR_VAR_1]」が\rうまいかを　きめるんだね！\cじゃあ　きょうから\c「[STR_VAR_1]」\nざんまいだ！
records.english: Oh, a smashing good idea!\cIt will settle once and for all\nwho is the best at\r“[STR_VAR_1].”\rBrilliant, indeed!\cStarting today, our lives will revolve\naround “[STR_VAR_1]”!

records.japanese: ‥‥そうだなぁ\c「[STR_VAR_1]」は　もう\nりゅうこう　じゃなくて\cせいかつの　いちぶ\nという　かんじかなぁ？
records.english: I was thinking, though...\cWouldn't you agree that\n“[STR_VAR_1]” has\rgrown from being something trendy to\rbeing a part of our daily lives?

records.japanese:
え？
そんなに！？\cきみは　ねても　さめても
「[STR_VAR_1]」　のことばっかり　かんがえてる　からな\c「[STR_VAR_1]　はかせ」
だね　まったく
records.english:
Beg pardon?
That much, what?\cHowever, it's true that
“[STR_VAR_1]”weighs heavily on your mind, whetheryou're awake or asleep.\cAbsolutely, you're the
“[STR_VAR_1]”PROFESSOR, old sport!

records.japanese: ぼくと　きみが\nコンビを　くめば\c『[STR_VAR_1]』では\nもう　むてきって　ことだな！
records.english: If you and me team up as a combo,\nwe'll be invincible when it comes to all\rthings “[STR_VAR_1]”!

records.japanese: そのとおり！\c「[STR_VAR_1]　コンビ」\nっていう　かんじだね！\cハハハ！！
records.english: Spot on, my friend!\cWe shall be the\n“[STR_VAR_1]” DUO!\cIsn't that a ripe image?\nHahahah!

records.japanese:
さいきん　ぼくの　なかでは
「ヘドロばくだん」が　だいブーム　なのさ！\cえー　きみ
「ヘドロばくだん」　しらないの？\cそれは　かわいそうだな
よし！　ぼくが　あげるよ！
records.english:
For me, SLUDGE BOMB is at the peak
of popularity. It's the one.\cHunh? You're telling me that you don't
know about SLUDGE BOMB?\cThat's outright pitiful.
I'll give you one.

records.japanese: 「ヘドロばくだん」も　いいけど\n「[STR_VAR_1]」って\rわざを　つかえる\rポケモンも　いいよね！
records.english: I love SLUDGE BOMB.\cBut POKéMON with the\n“[STR_VAR_1]”\rmove are in, too.

records.japanese:
ほら！　りゅうこう　さいせんたんの
この　シルクのスカーフ　ステキだろ！\cおっ　めが　かがやいてるね！
オレの　センスが　わかるんだな　きみは！\cうれしいね！
これは　プレゼント　するよ！
records.english:
Gorge your eyes on this!\cIt's a SILK SCARF. It's right at the
cutting edge of fashion, yeah!\cOh, I can see your eyes twinkling!
You appreciate my dazzling style!\cOh, you're a delight!
Here you go. I want you to have it!

records.japanese: え　もてないの？\nきみの　にもつを　ぜんぶ　うってでも\rもつべき　スカーフだぜ　これは！
records.english: Oh, you don't have room?\cNow, listen tight, this SCARF is a must-\nhave! Why, I would sell all my items\rin order to get it!

records.japanese: シルクのスカーフは　ノーマルタイプの\nわざの　いりょくを　あげてくれる！\cほとんどの　ポケモンに　にあう\nすてきな　スカーフ　ってことだぜ！
records.english: The SILK SCARF raises the power of\nNORMAL-type moves.\cIt's a marvelous SCARF that will go\nwith almost all POKéMON!

records.japanese:
へえ！　きみ　うみを　こえて
わざわざ　ムロまで　きたの！\cもしかして　トウキさんの　うわさを　きいて
あいに　きたんじゃない？\cトウキさん　かっこよくて
みんなが　あこがれるもんな！
records.english:
Wow, you bothered to cross the sea
to visit DEWFORD?\cDid you maybe come here because you
heard about BRAWLY?\cHe's so cool...
Everyone idolizes him.

records.japanese: どうも！\nやすくて　よく　きく　かんぽうや　です
records.english: Welcome to the HERB SHOP, home of\neffective and inexpensive medicine!

records.japanese: フエンの　かんぽうやくを\nみにくるとは　なかなか　しぶいのう\cきにいった！　これを　もってけ！
records.english: You've come to look at herbal medicine\nin LAVARIDGE?\cThat's rather commendable.\cI like you! Take this!

records.japanese: おまえさんに　あげた　もくたんは\nかんぽうやくを　つくるのに　つかうが\rポケモンに　もたせても　すごいぞ！\cほのおタイプの　わざの　いりょくを\nたかめて　くれるのじゃよ！
records.english:
That CHARCOAL I gave you, it's used
for making herbal medicine.\cIt also does wonders when held by
a POKéMON.\cIt intensifies the power of FIRE-type
moves.

records.japanese: かんぽうやくの　ききめは　すごいが\nポケモンに　のませると　きらわれるぞよ\rきっと　すっごく　にがいんじゃろうな！
records.english: Herbal medicine works impressively well.\nBut your POKéMON will dislike you for it.\rIt must be horribly bitter!

records.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cフエンタウン　ジムの　リーダー　アスナは
ほのおタイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてだ！\cポケモンに　たいする　じょうねつは
かざん　よりも　はげしく　あちィ！\cうっかり　ちかづくと　やけど　するから
みずで　ひやしながらきばってこー　な！！
records.english:
Hey, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cLAVARIDGE's GYM LEADER FLANNERY
uses FIRE-type POKéMON.\cHer passion for POKéMON burns stronger
and hotter than a volcano.\cDon't get too close to her - you'll burn!
Hose her down with water and thengo for it!

records.japanese: いやあー　あちィ　たたかい　だった！
records.english: Yow! That was a scorching hot battle!

records.japanese: あちちちちちっ！\nぷはーっ！　あつかったーっ！
あせが　めに　しみるぜ‥‥
records.english: I'm blinded by sweat in my eyes...

records.japanese: すなブロは　けっこうが　よくなって\nかんせつの　いたみに　こうかてき　だぜ！
records.english: Being buried in hot sand promotes\ncirculation.\cIt's effective for healing pain in\nyour joints.

records.japanese: ストレスを　かいしょう　する\nおれの　ひとときを　ジャマ　するなーっ！
records.english: I'm trying to relieve my stress.\nDon't come along and stress me out!

records.japanese: アスナさんに　まけてしまえーっ！
records.english: I hope FLANNERY flames you good!

records.japanese: はあ　ふう‥‥\cすなブロに　ながく　はいっていると\nけっこう　つかれちゃう　もんだよ‥‥
records.english: Haaah... Whew...\cIf you spend too much time buried in\nhot sand, it tuckers you out...

records.japanese: さすがに　つかれてきた　ようだね\nすなブロで　ひとやすみ　したいだろう？\cだが　きりょくを　たもつ　ことも\nトレーナーに　ひつような　さいのう　だよ
records.english: You must be getting tired by now.\nYou'd like to rest in the hot sand,\rwouldn't you?\cBut you should know that maintaining\nyour willpower is an important ability\rfor all TRAINERS.

records.japanese: ひあそびは　けがのもと　だったか‥‥
records.english: Play with fire, and be burned...

records.japanese: きみの　ちからは　ほんものだ‥‥\nでも　リーダー　アスナさんは　つよいよ！\cあまく　みていると　おおやけど　するぜ！
records.english: Your skill is real...\nBut our LEADER FLANNERY is strong.\cIf you don't watch yourself, you'll be\nburned seriously.

records.japanese: おまえの　ポケモン\n２００どの　あつさに　たえられるかよ！？
もえかたが　たりなかったか‥‥
２００どの　あつさ　ってのは\nようがんの　おんど！\cおまえの　ポケモン　おれに　かてたんだから\nようがんの　なかでも　へいき　だろうな！
records.english: The temperature of magma is\n392 degrees.\cYour POKéMON beat me, so they should\neasily survive in magma.

records.japanese: えーっと！\nじゃあ　しょうぶの　あいて　しますね！
なんて　つよいの！？
あたしも　アスナさんと　いっしょに\nきれいで　つよい　トレーナーに　なるんだ！
records.english: I'm going to be a pretty and strong\nTRAINER just like FLANNERY.

records.japanese:
ようこそ　‥‥じゃなくて\cよくぞ　ここまで　きた　ものだな！\cわたしは　ここの　ジムリーダーを
つとめさせて　いただく　‥‥じゃなくて\cジムリーダーを　まかされた　アスナだ！\cくう‥‥
ジムリーダーに　なりたて　だからってゆだん　など　しないことだ！\cおじいちゃん　ゆずりの　さいのうと
このとちで　みがきあげた　ホットな　わざあなたに　みせてやる！
records.english:
Welcome... No, wait.\cPuny TRAINER, how good to see you've
made it here!\cI have been entrusted with the...
No, wait.\cI am FLANNERY, and I'm the GYM
LEADER here!\cUh...
Dare not underestimate me, thoughI have been LEADER only a short time!\cWith skills inherited from my grand-
father, I shall, uh...demonstrate thehot moves we have honed on this land!

records.japanese:
くう‥‥
かたに　ちから　はいっちゃって‥‥\cあたし‥‥
ジムリーダーに　なりたて　だからってちょっと　むり　していたのかな‥‥\cやっぱ　じぶんらしく　でないと
いっしょに　たたかってくれるポケモンも　こまっちゃうよね！\cそれを　おしえてくれた
あなたに　これ　あげる！
records.english:
Oh...
I guess I was trying too hard...\cI... I've only recently become a GYM
LEADER.\cI tried too hard to be someone I'm not.\cI have to do things my natural way.
If I don't, my POKéMON will be confused.\cThanks for teaching me that.
For that, you deserve this.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　アスナから\nヒートバッジを　もらった！

ヒートバッジが　あれば
レベル５０　までならひとから　もらった　ポケモンでもいうことを　きいて　くれるんだ！\cそれに　ひでんわざの　かいりき　が
つかえるようにも　なるよ！\cこれは　かんしゃの　きもち
えんりょ　せずに　もらって！
records.english:
If you have a HEAT BADGE, all POKéMON
up to Level 50, even those you get intrades from other people, will obeyyou completely.\cAnd, it lets POKéMON use the HM move
STRENGTH outside of battle.\cThis is a token of my appreciation.
Don't be shy about taking it!

records.japanese:
わざマシン５０　には
オーバーヒートが　はいってるよ！\cその　わざは　あいてに
おおきな　ダメージを　あたえるんだ！\cだけど　とくこうが
がくっと　さがっちゃう　からながい　しょうぶには　むかないかも‥‥
records.english: That TM50 contains OVERHEAT.\cThat move inflicts serious damage on\nthe opponent.\cBut it also sharply cuts the SP. ATK\nof the POKéMON using it. It might not\rbe suitable for longer battles.

records.japanese: あなたの　つよさ\nだれかを　おもいださせるの　よね‥‥\cそうだ！　トウカシティの　ジムリーダー\nセンリさんに　にているんだ！
records.english: Your power reminds me of someone...\cOh! I know! You battle like NORMAN,\nthe GYM LEADER of PETALBURG.

records.japanese: フエンタウン　ポケモンジム
フエンタウン　ポケモンジム\cアスナ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
records.english: LAVARIDGE TOWN POKéMON GYM\cFLANNERY'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

records.japanese: おんせんで　タマゴを　あたためている\nばあさんから　きいたんじゃが‥‥\cそだてやに　ポケモンを\n２ひき　いっしょに　あずけたらの\rなんと　タマゴが　みつかったそうじゃ！！
records.english: My wife's warming an EGG in the hot\nsprings. This is what she told me.\cShe left two POKéMON with the DAY CARE.\nAnd they discovered that EGG!

records.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぷしゅー！
スピーダー　つかって\nポケモンの　すばやさ　あげるんじゃ！\cそうすりゃ　せんせいこうげき　できて\nたたかいが　ゆうりに　なるからのう！
records.english: Use X SPEED to add to a POKéMON's\nSPEED in battle.\cThat will help it get in the first\nstrike - a decided advantage!

records.japanese: えんとつやまの　ちょうじょう　だけで\nかうことが　できる　おみやげは\rポケモンに　あげると　よろこぶよ！
records.english: On MT. CHIMNEY's peak, there's a local\nspecialty that you can buy only there.\cGive it to a POKéMON - it will be elated.

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　あるいていると\nなんだか　ポケモンが　なついてくれるような\rそんな　きが　するのよね
records.english: I think POKéMON get closer to their\nTRAINERS if they spend time together.\cThe longer the better.\nThat's what I think.

records.japanese: ポケモンに　あかいポロックを　あげると\nなんだか　かっこよくなった！\cボクも　あかいポロック　たべようかな？
records.english: I gave a RED [POKEBLOCK] to my POKéMON.\nIt looks a lot cooler all of a sudden.\cHmm...\nMaybe I ought to eat a RED [POKEBLOCK].

records.japanese: ほっほっほ！　おわかいの\nここから　おんせんに　いけますぞ！\cポケモンが　ここで　やすむのなら\nひとも　おんせんで　ゆっくり　しませんと！
records.english: Hohoho! Hey, kid, you can reach\nthe hot springs from here.\cIf POKéMON are getting rest, so too\nshould their TRAINERS.

records.japanese:
あたしの　エネコにね
つきのいしを　つかってね‥‥\cしんか　させるか　どうか
すっごい　まよってるのよぉ\cしんか　させると　つよくなるけど
すがたかたち　かわっちゃうし‥‥
records.english:
I'm having a hard time deciding if I
should make my SKITTY evolve or not.\cI only have to use this MOON STONE,
but it's so hard to decide...\cIf I make it evolve, it will become
much stronger.\cBut it will look so different, too.

records.japanese: エネコ『みゃおう？
ひろった　きんのたま‥‥\nやっぱり　うるしか　ないのかなあ？\rほかに　つかいみちも　ないからなあ‥‥
records.english: This NUGGET I found here...\nI suppose I'll have to sell it, seeing\ras how it has no other use.

records.japanese:
ぼくの　ポケモン　あそこの　かべに
にがおえが　はって　あったんだ　けど\cもう　ちがう　ポケモンの　やつに
かわっちゃった‥‥\cまた　がんばって　ぼくの　ハナちゃんを
はって　もらうぞう！
records.english: They had a sketch of my POKéMON up\non the wall over there, but they\rchanged it with a new one already.\cI'm going to enter my HANA in CONTESTS\nso we can get her sketch up again!

records.japanese: ポロックは　つくってる？\cこんど　いっぱい　きのみを\nもっておいでよ！
records.english: Hi, are you making any [POKEBLOCK]S?\cYou should come by with a bunch of\nBERRIES sometime.

records.japanese: ここに　ゆうしょう　した　ポケモンの\nえが　かざって　あるだろ？\cこれ　ぼくが　かいてるんだ！\cきみの　ポケモンが　ゆうしょう　したら\nはりきって　かかせて　もらうよ！
records.english: You see how they display a sketch of\na CONTEST winner here?\cI sketch them!\cIf any of your POKéMON wins a CONTEST,\nI'd gladly make a sketch of it!

records.japanese: やあ　ゆうしょう　おめでとう！\cきみの　ポケモンの　にがおえは\nここに　バッチリ　かざって　おいたからね！
records.english: Hello! Congratulations!\cI've put up a sketch of your POKéMON\nright here for everyone to see!

records.japanese: １じ　しんさでは　いいセン　いくけど\nなぜか　アピールで　かてないんだ‥‥\cじぶんの　ポケモンばっかり　みてると\nかてないって　ことかなあ
records.english: We do all right in the preliminary round,\nbut we can never win the appeals...\cMaybe it means I have to watch what\nother contestants are doing...

records.japanese: みて！　わたしの　ポケモン\nこんなに　リボンが　いっぱい！\cあなたの　ポケモンは　リボン　もらった？\nもらって　いれば　ポケナビで　みられるわよ！
records.english: See!\nMy POKéMON won all these RIBBONS!\cHave your POKéMON earned any RIBBONS?\nYou can check them on your POKéNAV.

records.japanese: ジムリーダーにも　かてない‥‥\cコンテストでも　かてない‥‥\cあっちのまち　こっちのまちを\nいったり　きたり　だよ‥‥
records.english: I can't beat GYM LEADERS...\cI can't win any CONTESTS...\cI've been here, there, and everywhere,\nand it's all for naught...

records.japanese: ポケモン　コンテスト\nスーパーランク　ステージ！

あなたは‥‥？\c[PLAYER][KUN]　というのですか
あなた　トレーナー　なんですね\cということは　あたしの　つくった
あずかりシステム　つかってますね？\cだって　つかいたいから
パソコンの　まえに　いる　あたしにはなしかけてきた　という　わけですよねかんたんな　すいり　です\cあっ　あたし　マユミ　といいます\cあずかりシステムを　つかっている
トレーナーに　あえて　すごく　うれしいです\cよかったら　あたしの　いえにも
あそびに　きてください１１４ばんどうろに　ありますから
records.english:
Oh, hello.
You are?\cOkay, your name's [PLAYER][KUN].
I can see that you're a TRAINER.\cSo that means you use the POKéMON
Storage System I developed.\cHow I arrived at that conclusion is
a simple deductive process.\cYou spoke to me because you wanted
to access something on this PC.\cOh, I'm sorry. I'm LANETTE.\cHonestly, I'm glad to meet you - it's
great you're using the Storage System.\cIf you could, please visit me at home.
My house is on ROUTE 114.

records.japanese: おおむかしの　ポケモンって\nどんな　すがた　だったのかしら？\cこの　まちの　はずれにいる\nかせきマニアなら　おしえてくれるかも
records.english: I wonder what POKéMON looked like\nlong, long ago?\cMaybe the FOSSIL MANIAC at the edge\nof town will know.

records.japanese: この　ハジツゲの　はたけ　ではな\nかざんばいの　なかでも　そだつような\rじょうぶな　きの　なえを　うえてるんじゃ
records.english: In the fields of FALLARBOR, we plant\nseedlings of hardy trees that thrive\reven in volcanic ash.

records.japanese: ソライシ『ああ‥‥\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　だまされたからと　いって\rいんせきが　てに　はいる　ばしょを\rおしえてしまったら　だめ　だなあ‥‥\cりゅうせいのたき　の　いんせき\nもう　ぼくの　モノには　ならないよな‥‥
records.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh...\nI never should have let myself be\rconned into telling TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] where\ryou can find METEORITES...\cThat METEORITE from METEOR FALLS...\nIt's never going to be mine now...

records.japanese: おお！　ええ？\cそれは‥‥\cもしかして　もしかすると‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　りゅうせいのたき　から\nもっていった　いんせき　ですか‥‥！？\cよかったら　ぼくに　ください！\cただで　とは　いいません\nかわりに　この　わざマシンを\rあげますから‥‥
records.english:
Oh!
Hah?\cThat item...\cCould it be?\cIs it the METEORITE that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
took from METEOR FALLS?\cPlease, may I have it?\cI'm not asking for it for free.
How about in exchange for this TM?

records.japanese: ソライシ『この　わざマシンは\nぼくの　きもちです\rぜひ　つかってください！
records.english: PROF. COZMO: This TM, it represents\nmy feeling of gratitude.\rPlease use it!

records.japanese: ソライシ『いやー　すごく　うれしいな\nこれで　ぼくの　けんきゅうも　はかどります！
records.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh, I can't believe it.\nThis is really, really great!\cThis is really going to help my research!

records.japanese: ソライシ『そんな‥‥\nものすごく　がっかりだよ‥‥
records.english: PROF. COZMO: Oh, but...\nI'm crushed with disappointment...

records.japanese: ソライシ『その　いんせき‥‥\nよかったら　ぼくに　ください！\cただで　とは　いいません\nかわりに　この　わざマシンを\rあげますから‥‥
records.english: PROF. COZMO: Please, may I have that\nMETEORITE?\cI'm not asking for it for free.\nHow about in exchange for this TM?

records.japanese: ソライシはかせは\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　ひとと　いっしょに\r１１４ばん　どうろに　ある\rりゅうせいのたきに　いきましたよ
records.english: PROF. COZMO went off to METEOR FALLS\non ROUTE 114 with some people from\rTEAM [EVIL_TEAM].

records.japanese: ソライシはかせ‥‥\nあんなに　おちこんで　かわいそう！
records.english: Poor PROF. COZMO...\nHe's so depressed... I feel sorry for him.

records.japanese: ソライシはかせ　ったら\nあんなに　よろこんで　かわいい！
records.english: Look at PROF. COZMO...\nHe's so happy! I think it's cute.

records.japanese: ぼく　ポケモン　わざマニア\cポケモンが　せいちょうして　おぼえていく\nわざを　すべて　しっていて\rポケモンに　おしえることが　できるんだ！\cぼくが　いま　あつめている\nハートのウロコを　くれたら\rしってる　わざを　おしえてあげるよ！
records.english:
I'm the MOVE TUTOR.\cI know all the moves that POKéMON
learn - every one of them - and I canteach POKéMON those moves.\cI can teach a move to a POKéMON
of yours if you'd like.\cI'll do it for a HEART SCALE.
I'm collecting those now.

records.japanese: おおっ！\nそれは　まさしく　ハートのウロコ！\cわざを　おぼえさせたいんだね？
records.english: Oh! That's it! That's an honest to\ngoodness HEART SCALE!\cLet me guess, you want me to teach\na move?

records.japanese: どの　ポケモンに　するんだい？
どの　わざに　するんだい？
ごめんね‥‥\cぼくが　その　ポケモンに\nおしえられる　わざは　ないみたいだよ
records.english: Sorry...\cIt doesn't appear as if I have any move\nI can teach that POKéMON.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　おれいに\nハートのウロコを　１まい　あげた！
records.english: [PLAYER] handed over one HEART SCALE\nin exchange.

records.japanese: おぼえさせたい　わざが　あったら\nハートのウロコを　もってきてね！
records.english: If your POKéMON need to learn a move,\ncome back with a HEART SCALE.

records.japanese: えっ？\nタマゴに　おしえられる　わざは　ないよ
records.english: Hunh? There isn't a single move that\nI can teach an EGG.

records.japanese: そこの　いりぐちから　はいって\nコンテストの　かいじょうを　みてきたんだ\rあんな　おおきい　ステージに\rのぼるなんて　きんちょう　するなあ！
records.english: I went in through the entrance and\ntook a look around the CONTEST hall.\cGetting up on that big stage...\nIt's going to be tense!

records.japanese: あたしの　ポケモンへの　きもち‥‥\nそれは　まさに　メロメロなのよ‥‥\cあら　へんなところ　みられちゃった\cまあ　いいわ\nあなた　コンテストに　でるのなら\rこの　わざマシンは　いかが？
records.english:
Oh, my love for POKéMON...
The attraction they evoke in me...\cWhoops!
You weren't meant to see that!Well, anyway.\cIf you're entering a CONTEST, try this
move on for size.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　あたしへの　きもちも‥‥\nやっぱり　メロメロに　ちがいないわ！
records.english: My feelings for POKéMON...\nOh, they attract me so...

records.japanese: きみは　なにコンテストに　でるんだい？\cたとえば　かっこよさコンテストに　だすなら\nかっこいい　ポケモンで　きまりさ！\cコンテストに　ふさわしい　ポケモンに\nふさわしい　わざを　もたせて\rエントリー！　これ　じょうしきさ！
records.english:
Which CONTEST are you planning on
entering?\cIf you're entering a COOL CONTEST,
a cool POKéMON has to be the one!\cPick a POKéMON worthy of the CONTEST
theme, and make sure it has theright set of moves to match.\cThat's fundamental!

records.japanese: きみ　なにコンテストに　でるの？\nひとつ　アドバイス　してあげるよ！\cたとえば　かわいさコンテスト　でも\n１じしんさで　かわいさ　だけが\rみられてる　わけじゃ　ないみたいなんだ\cそだてかたを　くふう　したほうが　いいよ！
records.english:
Which CONTEST are you entering?
Want a piece of advice?\cIn any CONTEST, for example, a CUTE
CONTEST, I don't think they judge youonly on cuteness in the first round.\cYou need to work out ways for raising
POKéMON better.

records.japanese: ポケモンが　かわいく　なるように\nそだてて　いたんだけど\cコンテストって　かわいらしさも\nきそう　ことが　できるのね！\cだいじに　そだてて　よかった‥‥
records.english: I raised my POKéMON to be cute.\cI found out you can put POKéMON in\na CONTEST for cuteness!\cI'm so glad I raised my POKéMON with\nloving care...

records.japanese: おれの　ポケモン‥‥\cそりゃあ　もう　かっこよくて\nたくましくて　うつくしくて\rかわいくて　かしこいんだけど　さ\cこうなったら　ぜんぶの　コンテストで\nかたっぱし　から　ゆうしょう　ねらうか！
records.english: My POKéMON rules!\cIt's cool, tough yet beautiful, cute,\nand smart. It's complete!\cI may as well go for wins in every\nsingle CONTEST.

records.japanese: ポケモン　コンテスト\nノーマルランク　ステージ！
ポケモン　しょうぶに\nスペシャルアップは　かかせない！\cたたかいの　ときだけ　とはいえ\nわざの　いりょくが　あがるんだからな！
records.english: For any POKéMON match, X SPECIAL\nis crucial.\cIt jacks up the power of some moves\neven though it's only for one battle.

records.japanese: コンテストに　かてるような\nどうぐは　うってない　ですねえ‥‥\cやはり　ふだんから\nだいじに　そだてないと　ダメなんですねえ
records.english: They don't sell any items that will let\nyou win CONTESTS...\cIt means you have to raise POKéMON\ndiligently on an everyday basis.

records.japanese: シダケでしか　かえない　ネストボール\nよわい　ポケモンほど　つかまえ　やすくなるの
records.english: The NEST BALL works better on\nweakened POKéMON.\cVERDANTURF is the only place you can\nbuy it.

records.japanese: ポケモンに　なつかれて　いないようでは\nいちにんまえ　とは　いえないね\rポロックを　あげたりとか　しているのかい？
records.english: I daresay a TRAINER isn't qualified if\nPOKéMON aren't settled and friendly.\rHave you given them any [POKEBLOCK]S?

records.japanese: シダケにくる　りゆうと　いえば\nずばり　ポケモン　コンテストじゃろ？\cコンテストへの　ちょうせんは\nここから　はじまるからのう‥‥
records.english: Let me hazard a guess why you're in\nVERDANTURF. The reason: CONTESTS.\cAll CONTEST challenges originate here.

records.japanese:
ミツル『[PLAYER]さんに　まけたけど
もう　おちこんでないよ\cだって　ラルトスと　いっしょに
あちこちの　ジムで　うでだめし　してすごい　トレーナーに　なるってもくひょうが　できたから！\cいつか　[PLAYER]さん　よりも
つよくなって　もういちどポケモンしょうぶを　おねがい　するからね！
records.english:
WALLY: I lost to you, [PLAYER], but I'm
not feeling down anymore.\cBecause I have a new purpose in life.
Together with my RALTS, I'm goingto challenge POKéMON GYMS and becomea great TRAINER.\cPlease watch me, [PLAYER].
I'm going to be stronger than you.\cWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you
to another battle.

records.japanese: ミツル『いつか　[PLAYER]さん　よりも\nつよくなって　もういちど\rポケモンしょうぶを　おねがい　するからね！
records.english: WALLY: Please watch me, [PLAYER].\nI'm going to get stronger than you.\cWhen I do, I'm going to challenge you\nto another battle.

records.japanese:
おじさん『おお！　[PLAYER][KUN]
ミツルくんは　となりに　いるよ！\cしかし　たいした　もんだね！\cしぜんに　かこまれた　かんきょうが
ミツルくんを　げんきに　させている！\c‥‥いや　もしかすると
あのこに　きぼうを　あたえて　いるのは\cポケモンなのかも　しれないな‥‥
records.english:
UNCLE: Oh! [PLAYER][KUN]!
WALLY's next door.\cBut, boy, there's something I have to
tell you.\cThis natural environment is doing
wonders for WALLY's health.\cMaybe it's not just the environment.
It could be POKéMON that are giving theboy hope.

records.japanese: ミツルくん‥‥\nいつのまにか　いなくなっちゃった‥‥
records.english: WALLY's gone away...\nHe slipped off on his own...

records.japanese: おじさん『そうですか‥‥\nあの　ミツルくんが\rひとりで　そんな　とおくまで‥‥\cさすがは　わたしの　おとうとの　むすこだ！
records.english: UNCLE: Is that right?\nWALLY's gone away that far all by\rhimself...\cWell, I have to give him credit - he is\nmy little brother's son.

records.japanese:
ミチル『あなたは‥‥？
‥‥‥あ　そうか！\cミツルくんが　いってた
[PLAYER]さんって　あなたの　ことね！\cわたしは　ミツルくんの　いとこ　なの！\cどう？　あのこ　こっちに　きてから
ずいぶん　げんきに　なったでしょう？
records.english:
WANDA: You are?
Oh, right, I get it!\cYou're the [PLAYER] who WALLY was
telling me about.\cI'm WALLY's cousin.
Glad to meet you!\cI think WALLY's become a lot more lively
and healthy since he came here.

records.japanese: ミチル『ミツルくんの　ことなら\nだいじょうぶ！　しんぱい　ないわよ！\cだって　わたしの　いとこ　だし\nなにより　ポケモンが　いっしょ　ですもの！
records.english: WANDA: Don't worry about WALLY.\nHe'll be just fine.\cI know my little cousin, and he has\nPOKéMON with him, too.

records.japanese: きみの　おかげで\nまいにち　かのじょに　あえて\rおれは　ハッピーだよ！
records.english: Thanks to you, I can see my girlfriend\nevery day.\rHappy? You bet I am!

records.japanese:
うちの　むすめの　こいびとは
ずいぶん　じょうねつてきな　ひとでね\cむすめに　あうため　だけに
ひたすら　トンネルを　ほってるってよ！\cむすめも　しんぱい　なのか
いつも　トンネルに　あしを　はこんでるよ
records.english:
My daughter's boyfriend is a very
driven and passionate sort of person.\cHe's been digging a tunnel nonstop
just so he can see my daughter.\cMy daughter's a little concerned,
so she goes out to the tunnel a lot.

records.japanese: なんと！　むすめの　こいびと　ときたら\nすでで　トンネルを　ほっていたって！\cそりゃあ　たまげた　もんだ！
records.english: It's amazing. My daughter's boyfriend\nwas digging the tunnel by hand!\cIt's so incredible!

records.japanese: ミツルくんに　もしものことが　あったら\nあたしゃ　トウカにいる　ごりょうしんに\rあわせる　かおが　ないよ‥‥
records.english: If anything were to happen to WALLY,\nI would never be able to look his\rparents in PETALBURG in the eye...

records.japanese: ミツルくんが　サイユウに　いたって！？\cそりゃ　トウカの　ごりょうしんも\nびっくり　するだろうねぇ
records.english: WALLY was in EVER GRANDE?\cHis parents in PETALBURG would be\nastonished to hear that!

records.japanese: あなたの　ポケモンが\nどれくらい　なついているか　みてあげる\cあら‥‥\nあなたの　ポケモン
records.english: Let me see your POKéMON.\nI'll check to see how much it likes you.\cOh.\nYour POKéMON...

records.japanese: これいじょうは　ない　ってぐらい\nあなたに　なついているわね\rみている　こっちも　しあわせに　なるわ！
records.english: It adores you.\nIt can't possibly love you any more.\rI even feel happy seeing it.

records.japanese: なんだか　しあわせそう\nすごく　あなたに　なついているわね
records.english: It seems to be very happy.\nIt obviously likes you a whole lot.

records.japanese: かなり　なついているわね\nあなたに　あまえたそうに　しているわよ
records.english: It likes you quite a lot.\nIt seems to want to be babied a little.

records.japanese: ちょっと　なついてきた　って　かんじ　かな\nあなたのこと　しんじている　みたい
records.english: It's getting used to you.\nIt seems to believe in you.

records.japanese: まだ　あなたに　なれていない　ようね\nふつうの　かんけい　って　かんじが　するわ
records.english: It's not very used to you yet.\nIt neither loves nor hates you.

records.japanese: ‥‥　なんだか　けいかい　しているみたい\nめつきも　ちょっと　こわいし\rぜんぜん　あなたに　なついていないわ
records.english: It's very wary.\nIt has scary viciousness in its eyes.\rIt doesn't like you much at all.

records.japanese: ‥‥　ちょっと　いいづらいんだけど\cあなた　じぶんの　ポケモンに\nそんなに　きらわれていて　だいじょうぶ？
records.english: This is a little hard for me to say...\cYour POKéMON simply detests you.\nDoesn't that make you uncomfortable?

records.japanese: ピカチュウ『ピカピカッ！
とおく　はなれた\nサイユウの　おくちに　ある　という\rポケモン　リーグ\cそこに　あつまるのは\nすごうでの　トレーナー　ばかり　ですって！
records.english: Far away, deep in EVER GRANDE CITY,\nis the POKéMON LEAGUE.\cThe TRAINERS who gather there are\nall frighteningly well skilled.

records.japanese: ポケモン　リーグは\nしてんのう　４にん　つづけて\rしょうぶする　という　ルールらしいの！\cとちゅうで　まけたら　ひとりめ　から\nやりなおし　だなんて　きびしいのね！
records.english: In the POKéMON LEAGUE, I think the\nrules say that you have to battle the\rELITE FOUR all in a row.\cIf you lose to any of them, you have\nto begin your challenge again from the\rfirst one.

records.japanese: きみの　トレーナーカードは　なにいろ？\nあたしのは　カッパー　なんだよ！
records.english: What color is your TRAINER'S CARD?\nMine's copper!

records.japanese: キナギタウンって　サニーゴたちの\nあつまりの　うえに　うかんでいるの\c‥‥なんて　いったら\nあなたは　しんじるかしら？
records.english: PACIFIDLOG TOWN floats on top of\na colony of CORSOLA.\cIf I told you that, would you believe me?

records.japanese: キナギで　くらす　ひとびとの　せんぞは\nふねの　うえで　うまれて\rそして　ふねの　うえで　しんだ　という\cなにかを　さがすために\nそんな　いきかたを　していたそうじゃ
records.english: The ancestors of the people in\nPACIFIDLOG were said to have been\rborn on boats and then lived and died \raboard them.\cI understand that they lived that way\nbecause they were searching for\rsomething.

records.japanese:
ホウエンちほう　には
いわ‥‥　こおり‥‥　はがね‥‥\cそれぞれの　ちからを　つかさどる
３びきの　ポケモンがそれぞれ　どこかの　どうくつに　いる‥‥\cおれ　ちいさな　ころに
そんな　はなしを　きいたことが　あるよ
records.english:
In the HOENN region, there are three
POKéMON that represent the power ofrock, ice, and steel.\cEach of them is said to hide away deep
inside caves.\cThat's the story I heard when I was
just a little kid.

records.japanese: 「むっつの　てんが\n　みっつの　とびらを　あける」\cおじいちゃんが　よく　いっていたけど\nいまだに　なんのことだか　わからないわ
records.english: “Six dots open three doors.”\cGrandpa used to say that, but I don't\nknow what he meant.

records.japanese: ウォッホン！！\cわしが　ポケモン　だいすきクラブで\nいちばーん　えらい　かいちょうの‥‥\cおとうと　ですぞ！\cまあ　ここで　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nバカンスを　たのしんで　おるのですな！
records.english: Er-hem!\cI am the POKéMON FAN CLUB's most\nimportant person, the CHAIRMAN's\ryounger brother.\cI'm here enjoying my vacation with\nPOKéMON, yes, indeed.

records.japanese: ほう！\nきみの　ポケモン‥‥
とっても　なついて　いますなあ\cそんな　かわいらしい　ポケモンには\nこの　わざマシン　どうですかな？
records.english: It clearly likes you very much.\cA POKéMON that adoring and adorable\ndeserves a TM like this, no?

records.japanese: ふむう‥‥\nわるくは　ないんだが　よくもない‥‥\cおやの　トレーナーである　きみの\nどりょくが　ひつよう　ですな！
records.english: Hmm...\nIt's not bad, but it's also not good.\cYou, as the TRAINER, need to put in\nsome more effort.

records.japanese: なんだか　めつきが　わるいですのう\cそんな　こわそうな　ポケモンには\nこの　わざマシン　どうですかな？
records.english: It has a vicious look to it.\cA frightening POKéMON like that\ndeserves a TM like this.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　なつきどが　たかいと\nおんがえしの　いりょくも　たかくなる\cなつきどが　ひくいと\nやつあたりの　いりょくが　つよまるんだよ！
records.english: If a POKéMON likes you a lot, RETURN's\npower is enhanced.\cIf it doesn't like you, FRUSTRATION's\npower goes up.

records.japanese: そうそう　あと[STR_VAR_1]にち　たてば\nいい　わざマシンが　てに　はいるんだよ！\cそのとき　また　あそびに　きたまえ！\nきみの　ポケモンに　あった\rすてきな　わざマシンを　あげるから
records.english: Oh, yes. In about [STR_VAR_1] or so days,\nI should be getting a good TM or two.\cYou should come see me then.\nI'll give you a TM that's suitable for\ryour POKéMON.

records.japanese: ルリリ『るりー
とっても　なついて　いるようだ
records.english: It appears to be very friendly with the\nTRAINER.

records.japanese: ルリリ『ルルリッ！！
あんまり　なついて　いないようだ‥‥
records.english: It doesn't appear to like the TRAINER\nvery much.

records.japanese:
トレーナーさん！　よかったら
ポケモンを　こうかん　して　くださいな\cキナギだけに　いると　つかまえられる
ポケモンが　かぎられるのよね！\cあなた　[STR_VAR_1]　もってない？
あたしは　[STR_VAR_2]を　あげるわ！
records.english:
Hello, TRAINER. Would you do me a favor
and trade POKéMON with me?\cLiving in PACIFIDLOG, I can only catch
certain kinds of POKéMON.\c[STR_VAR_1]? Do you have one?
I'll trade you my [STR_VAR_2] for it.

records.japanese: わあ！\n[STR_VAR_1]　って　ふわふわ　してるのね！
それ　[STR_VAR_1]　と　ちがうわよ
ちょっと　がっかり‥‥
こうやって　ポケモン　こうかん　したら\nあなたと　あたし　もう　ともだち　よね！
records.english: Since we traded, you and me,\nwe're friends, aren't we?

records.japanese: それって　ポケモンずかん？\cそれって　あなた　たくさんの\nポケモンと　であった　ってこと？\cそれって　すっごい　うらやましい！
records.english: Is that a POKéDEX?\cDid you get to meet a lot of different\nPOKéMON?\cI wish I was like you.

records.japanese: ホウエンの　そらたかくを　とんでいく\nポケモンを　みた！　って　ひとが　いるけど\cずっと　とびまわって　いるのかしら？\nどこかで　やすんだり　しそうだけど
records.english: People were saying they saw a POKéMON\nFLYING high above HOENN.\cIs it FLYING around all the time?\nDoesn't it need to rest somewhere?

records.japanese: おそらの　ポケモン！\nおそらの　ポケモン！
きみ　どこから　きたの？
はい‥‥？\nハイ‥　タウン‥‥？\cしらないなぁ　そんな　まち
records.english: Yes?\nYES TOWN?\cI've never heard of a place like that.

records.japanese: いいえ　って　そんな‥‥\nどこからも　きてない　はずが　ないでしょ\cま　まさか　きみ‥‥\nうみの　そこで　うまれた　とか‥‥？
records.english: No? That doesn't make any sense.\nYou have to come from somewhere.\cOh! Wait! You're not going to say you\nwere born at the bottom of the sea?

records.japanese: きょうは　マボロシじま　みえんのう‥‥
records.english: I can't see MIRAGE ISLAND today...

records.japanese: なっ　なんと！\nきょうは　マボロシじま　みえるのじゃ！
records.english: Oh! Oh my!\nI can see MIRAGE ISLAND today!

records.japanese: マボロシじま‥‥\nおそらく　しんきろうの　かんけいで\rみえたり　みえなかったり　するんだろう\cいや　ひょっとしたら　ほんとうに\nあらわれたり　きえたり　しているのか‥‥？
records.english: MIRAGE ISLAND...\cIt must become visible and invisible\ndepending on the weather conditions\rthat make mirages appear.\cOr is it really appearing and\ndisappearing?

records.japanese:
きみは‥‥
そうか　[PLAYER][KUN]　だね？\cさっきは　ミツルの　あいてを　してくれて
ありがとう‥‥\cあのこは　うまれた　ときから
からだが　じょうぶでは　なくてね\cそれで　すこしの　あいだ　シダケタウンの
わたしの　しんせきの　うちであずかってもらう　ことに　したんだよ\cあそこは　ここよりも　ずっと
くうきが　きれいな　ところ　だからね！\c‥‥で　ミツルかい？　ミツルなら
もう　しゅっぱつ　していったよ\cいまごろは　どの　あたりかなあ‥‥
records.english:
You're...
Ah, you must be [PLAYER][KUN], right?\cThank you for playing with WALLY a
little while ago.\cHe's been frail and sickly ever
since he was a baby.\cWe've sent him to stay with my relatives
in VERDANTURF TOWN for a while.\cThe air is a lot cleaner there
than it is here.\cWhat's that? Where's WALLY?
He's already left, our WALLY.\cI wonder where he could have
gotten by now?

records.japanese: ミツルは　どうしてるかなあ‥‥
records.english: I wonder how our WALLY is doing?

records.japanese:
やあ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cミツルは　シダケタウンに　いってから
すっかり　げんきを　とりもどしたよ！\cそれも　みんな　きみの　おかげさ！\cなにしろ　このまちを　でるときに
ミツルが　ポケモンを　つかまえるのをてつだって　くれただろう？\cあのときの　ことが　ミツルは　とっても
うれしかった　らしいんだ！\cいや　ミツル　だけじゃない
ちちおやの　わたしも　うれしいよ！\cあのこに　きみの　ような
やさしい　ともだちが　できたことが　ね！\cそのおれい　という　わけでは　ないけど
これを　うけとって　くれないか！
records.english:
Hi there, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cOur WALLY's become very healthy
since he went to VERDANTURF TOWN.\cWe owe it all to you!\cWhen WALLY left town, you helped
him catch a POKéMON, right?\cI think that made WALLY really
happy.\cActually, not just WALLY.
It made me, his father, happy too.\cHappy that he's got such a great
friend as you.\cThis isn't a bribe or anything, but
I'd really like you to have this.

records.japanese: なみのりを　つかえるように　なれば\nいろんな　ばしょに　いけるように　なるよ！
records.english: If your POKéMON can SURF, you'll be\nable to go to all sorts of places.

records.japanese: もうすぐ　ミツルが　かえってくるぞ！\nたのしみだなあ‥‥！
records.english: WALLY's coming home soon.\nI'm looking forward to that.

records.japanese: ええっ！？　サイユウシティで\nミツルと　であった　だって‥‥？\cんもう　[PLAYER][KUN]ってばー\cいくら　あのこが　げんきに　なったからって\nそんな　とおくの　まち　まで\rひとりで　いけるわけ　ないよねえ‥‥
records.english: Oh? You met WALLY in EVER GRANDE\nCITY?\cOh, [PLAYER][KUN], don't be silly.\cHe may have gotten healthy, but he\ncan't go somewhere far away like\rthat all by himself.

records.japanese: ミツルが　ポケモンを　つかまえた　って\nすごく　うれしそうに　はなしていたの\cあのこの　あんな　えがお　ひさしぶり
records.english: WALLY was really happy when he told\nus that he caught a POKéMON.\cIt's been ages since I've seen him\nsmile like that.

records.japanese: あら　[PLAYER]さん！\nあなたに　わたしたい　ものが　あるの！\cうちの　しゅじんに　こえを　かけて\nぜひ　うけとって　くださいな！
records.english: Oh, hello, [PLAYER]! We've got\nsomething we want you to have.\cMy husband has it, so please have a\nword with him, dear.

records.japanese: うちの　しゅじんには　ないしょ　だけど\cじつは　ミツルったら　シダケタウンを\nかってに　でて　いっちゃった　らしいの‥‥\cあのこ　からだは　よわかったけど\nあんがい　しっかりした　せいかく　だから\rかならず　ぶじで　かえってくると\rわたしは　しんじてるわ！
records.english:
I want you to keep this a secret
from my husband...\cBut our WALLY left VERDANTURF TOWN
without telling anyone.\cYou know, WALLY is frail, but
he's surprisingly strong-willed.\cI'm sure that he'll come back safe
and sound one day!

records.japanese:
パパ『ん？\c[PLAYER]じゃ　ないか！
そうか　ひっこしが　おわったんだね\cそれにしても
よく　ここまで　ひとりで　これたな\cなるほど‥‥
ポケモンと　いっしょ　なのか\cふむ‥‥　じゃあ　[PLAYER]も
わたしの　ようにポケモントレーナーに　なるのか\cそれは　たのしみ　だな！
records.english:
DAD: Hm?\cWell, if it isn't [PLAYER]!
So you're all finished moving in?\cI'm surprised that you managed to
get here by yourself.\cOh, I see.
You're with your POKéMON.\cHm... Then I guess you're going to
become a TRAINER like me, [PLAYER].\cThat's great news!
I'll be looking forward to it!

records.japanese: あの‥‥　ぼく‥‥\nポケモンが　ほしいん　ですけど‥‥
records.english: Um... I... I'd like to get a\nPOKéMON, please...

records.japanese: パパ『ん？　きみは‥‥　たしか\nミツルくんと　いったよね
records.english: DAD: Hm? You're... Uh... Oh, right.\nYou're WALLY, right?

records.japanese:
ミツル『ぼく　きょうから　シダケタウンの
しんせきの　うちに　いくんですけど\cひとりじゃ　さみしいから　ポケモンを
つれて　いこうかと　おもって‥‥\cでも　いままで　じぶんで　ポケモンを
つかまえた　ことが　ないからどう　やったら　いいのか‥‥
records.english:
WALLY: I'm going to go stay with my
relatives in VERDANTURF TOWN.\cI thought I would be lonely by myself,
so I wanted to take a POKéMON along.\cBut I've never caught a POKéMON before.
I don't know how...

records.japanese: パパ『‥‥ふむ　なるほど
パパ『[PLAYER]！　はなしは　きいたね\cミツルくんが　ぶじに\nポケモンを　つかまえられるか\rみまもって　あげるんだ
records.english: DAD: [PLAYER], you heard that,\nright?\cGo with WALLY and make sure that he\nsafely catches a POKéMON.

records.japanese: ミツルくん\nわたしの　ポケモンを　かして　あげよう！\cミツルは\nジグザグマを　あずかった！
records.english: WALLY, here, I'll loan you my POKéMON.\cWALLY received a ZIGZAGOON!

records.japanese:
ミツル『わあ‥‥
ポケモンだぁ‥‥！\cパパ『うむ‥‥
モンスターボールは　あげるからがんばって　みなさい！\cミツルは
モンスターボールを　もらった！
records.english: WALLY: Oh, wow!\nA POKéMON!\cDAD: Hm. I'll give you a POKé BALL, too.\nGo for it!\cWALLY received a POKé BALL!

records.japanese: ミツル『おじさん　ありがとう！
[PLAYER]さん‥‥\nぼくと　いっしょに　きてくれますよね
パパ『うまく　いったかい？
records.english: DAD: So, did it work out?

records.japanese:
ミツル『おじさん
おかりした　ポケモン　おかえし　します\c[PLAYER]さん　いっしょに　きてくれて
どうも　ありがとう‥‥\cポケモンを　つかまえることが　できたのは
ふたりの　おかげです！つかまえた　ポケモン　たいせつに　しますね\c‥‥あ！　おかあさんが　まってるから
ぼくは　もう　いかなきゃ！\cじゃあね　[PLAYER]さん！
records.english:
WALLY: Thank you, yes, it did.
Here's your POKéMON back.\c[PLAYER], thank you for coming along
with me.\cYou two are why I was able to catch
my POKéMON.\cI promise I'll take really good
care of it.\cOh! My mom's waiting for me, so I
have to go!\cBye, [PLAYER]!

records.japanese:
パパ『さて‥‥\c[PLAYER]！　ポケモントレーナー　として
つよく　なりたいのならわたしの　アドバイスを　ききなさい\cまずは　この　さきにある
カナズミシティに　いくんだ\cそこで　ツツジ　という　ジムリーダーと
たたかうと　いい！\cそうやって　かくちの　ポケモンジムで
ジムリーダーを　たおしてジムバッジを　あつめて　いくんだ\cもちろん　わたしも　ジムリーダーだ
いずれ　[PLAYER]と　しょうぶ　するだろう\cだが　それは　[PLAYER]が
つよくなってからの　はなし　だよ
records.english:
DAD: Now...\c[PLAYER], if you want to become a
strong TRAINER, here's my advice.\cHead for RUSTBORO CITY beyond this
town.\cThere, you should challenge the GYM
LEADER, ROXANNE.\cAfter her, go on to other POKéMON
GYMS and defeat their LEADERS.\cCollect BADGES from them,
understood?\cOf course, I'm a GYM LEADER, too.
We'll battle one day, [PLAYER].\cBut that's only after you become
stronger, [PLAYER].

records.japanese:
パパ『ん？　カナズミの
ポケモンジムには　いかないのか？\cまだまだ　かけだしの　トレーナーと
たたかっても　おもしろく　ないからな\c[PLAYER]には　もっと　つよくなって
わたしの　まえに　あらわれて　ほしいんだ\cそうだな　ジムバッジを
４つ　あつめられたら　そのときは[PLAYER]と　しょうぶ　しよう！
records.english:
DAD: Hm? Aren't you going to the
POKéMON GYM in RUSTBORO CITY?\cThere's no challenge for me to
battle a greenhorn TRAINER.\c[PLAYER], I want you to challenge me
when you become a lot stronger.\cI'll battle you, [PLAYER], when you
can show me four GYM BADGES, okay?

records.japanese:
パパ『なるほど‥‥
カナズミの　ジムリーダーに　かったのか\cだが　まだまだ　[PLAYER]より
つよい　トレーナーは　いっぱい　いる\cうみの　むこう　ムロタウンには
トウキ　という　ジムリーダーが　いるかれとも　しょうぶ　してみると　いい
records.english:
DAD: I see... So, you've beaten the
GYM LEADER in RUSTBORO CITY.\cBut there are many more TRAINERS
who are stronger than you, [PLAYER].\cAcross the sea in DEWFORD TOWN is a
GYM LEADER named BRAWLY.\cYou should go challenge him.

records.japanese: パパ『ふむ‥‥\n[PLAYER]は　つよくなって　いるな\cその　バッジの　かずを　みれば　わかるよ
records.english: DAD: Hm... [PLAYER], you have gotten\nstronger.\cI can tell by the number of BADGES\nthat you've earned.

records.japanese:
パパ『そうか‥‥
ジムバッジを　４つ　あつめたのか\cでは　やくそく　どおり
ポケモンしょうぶ　だな‥‥\c[PLAYER]‥‥\cわたしは　いま　こうして
じぶんの　こどもとしんけん　しょうぶ　できることがうれしくて　たまらない！\cだが　しょうぶは　しょうぶ！\cわたしは　ジムリーダーとして
ぜんりょくを　つくす！[PLAYER]も　ほんきで　かかってくるんだ！
records.english:
DAD: Hm...
So, you did get four GYM BADGES.\cFine, as I promised, we will have a
POKéMON battle.\c[PLAYER]...\cI'm so happy that I can have a 
real battle with my own child.\cBut, a battle is a battle!\cI will do everything in my power as
a GYM LEADER to win.\c[PLAYER], you'd better give it your
best shot, too!

records.japanese: ‥‥！\cまさか‥‥\cまさか　[PLAYER]に‥‥\c[PLAYER]に　まける　とは‥‥\c‥‥わかった！　きまりは　きまりだ！\nこれを　わたそう
records.english: ...\cI... I can't...\cI can't believe it. [PLAYER]...\cI lost to [PLAYER]?\cBut, rules are rules!\nHere, take this.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　パパから\nバランスバッジを　もらった！

パパ『その　バランスバッジで
[PLAYER]の　ポケモンのぼうぎょりょくが　たかくなる\cひでんわざの　なみのり　を
おぼえた　ポケモンが　いるならみずのうえを　すすめるように　なる\cこれは　わたしからの　おくりもの
[PLAYER]なら　つかいこなせるだろう！
records.english:
DAD: With that BADGE, the DEFENSE
of all your POKéMON will increase.\cPOKéMON that know the HM move SURF
will be able to travel over water.\cThis is my gift to you. [PLAYER], I'm
sure you can use it correctly.

records.japanese: パパ『わざマシン４２は　からげんき\cどくや　まひ　やけどに　なると\nわざの　いりょくが　ばいに　なる！\cピンチを　チャンスに\nかえることが　できるかも　しれないな
records.english: DAD: TM42 contains FACADE.\cIt doubles the power of moves if\nthe POKéMON is poisoned, paralyzed,\ror burned.\cIt might be able to turn a bad\nsituation into an advantage.

records.japanese: パパ『ジムリーダーとして\nいいようが　ないくらい　くやしい‥‥\cだが　おや　としては\nうれしいような　さびしいような\rふしぎな　きもち　だ‥‥
records.english: DAD: As the GYM LEADER, I can't\nexpress how upset I am...\cBut as a father, it makes me both\nhappy and a little sad. It's odd...

records.japanese: パパ『そうだ‥‥\cさっき　ミツルくんの　ごりょうしんが\nいらして　[PLAYER]に\rわたしたい　ものが　あると　いってたぞ！
records.english: DAD: Oh, yes...\cWALLY's parents came calling\nearlier.\cThey said that they had something\nthey wanted to give you, [PLAYER].

records.japanese:
パパ『[PLAYER]！　たまには　ママにも
あいに　いって　あげるんだぞ！\cわたしは　ここで
じぶんを　きたえなおす！\c[PLAYER]に　まけた　ままでは
トレーナーとして　くやしすぎる　からな
records.english:
DAD: [PLAYER], you should go visit
your mother every so often.\cI'm going to stay here and redouble
my training.\cIt would bother me as a TRAINER to
not avenge my loss to you, [PLAYER]!

records.japanese: パパ『[PLAYER]！\nちょうしは　どうだ？\cポケモンは　おくが　ふかい！\nわたしは　いくら　しゅぎょう　しても\rたりなく　おもっている　ところだよ
records.english: DAD: [PLAYER], how are things going?\cThe world of POKéMON is deep.\cI honestly think that no amount of\ntraining would ever be enough.

records.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
