That HM, it's CUT.\cAn HM move is one that can be used
by POKéMON out of a battle.\cAny POKéMON that's learned CUT can
chop down thin trees if the TRAINERhas earned the STONE BADGE.\cAnd, unlike a TM, an HM doesn't break
after one use.

records.japanese: この　カナズミが　おおきくなるとき\nおとうさん　みんなの　ために\rいあいぎりを　つかって\rあたりを　きりひらいたんだって！
records.english: When they were expanding the city of\nRUSTBORO, my dad helped out.\cHe made his POKéMON use CUT to clear\nthe land of trees.

records.japanese: トレーナーズ　スクールは　いいわよ！\cあそこで　ポケモンの　べんきょう　すれば\nジムリーダーに　だって　なれますもの！
records.english: The TRAINER'S SCHOOL is excellent.\cIf you study there, you could even\nbecome a GYM LEADER.

records.japanese: ジムリーダーの　ツツジ　ねーちゃん\nすっごい　ポケモン　くわしくて\rすっごい　ポケモン　つよいんだから！
records.english: ROXANNE, the GYM LEADER, really knows\na lot about POKéMON.\cShe's really strong, too!

records.japanese: ここには　デボン　コーポレーションの\nしゃいんの　みなさんが　すんでるのですよ
records.english: DEVON CORPORATION's workers live in\nthis building.

records.japanese: エネコ『ぎゃー！！
デボンもな　むかしは\nちいさな　ちいさな　かいしゃ　だったわい
records.english: Way back in the old days, DEVON was just\na teeny, tiny company.

records.japanese: おとうさんは　かいしゃで　おしごと！\cこれ　おとうさんが　つくったんだぜ！\nでも　ぼく　まだ　つかえないから　あげるよ
records.english: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\cMy daddy made this!\nBut I can't use it, so you can have it.

records.japanese: おとうさんは　かいしゃで　おしごと！\cぼくも　おおきく　なったら\nデボンで　はたらくんだ！
records.english: My daddy's working at the CORPORATION.\cWhen I grow up, I'm going to work for\nDEVON, too.

records.japanese: デボンの　しゃちょうは\nめずらしい　いしを　あつめるのが\rしゅみ　なんだよ
records.english: DEVON's PRESIDENT likes to collect\nrare stones.

records.japanese: たしか　むすこさんも\nめずらしい　いしを　あつめるのが\rしゅみ　だったっけ‥‥？
records.english: I think the PRESIDENT's son also\ncollects rare stones.

records.japanese: じぶんの　ポケモンには\nぴったりの　ニックネームを　つけるんじゃ\rいわゆる　おりじなりてぃ　じゃ！
records.english: For my own POKéMON, I give them\nperfectly suited nicknames!\cIt's my expression of, uh...\noriginality, yes, that's it!

records.japanese: だからって　ピカチュウに\n「ペカチュウ」って　つけても\rほとんど　かわって　ないでしょうに‥‥\cまあ　わかりやすいのも\nニックネームには　だいじ　ですけどねぇ
records.english: But giving the name PEKACHU to a\nPIKACHU? It seems pointless.\cI suppose it is good to use a name\nthat's easy to understand, but...

records.japanese: ペカチュウ『ぺかー！
ねえねえ　わたし\nさがしてる　ポケモン　いるんだ\c[STR_VAR_1]　なんだけど　もってる？\nわたしの　[STR_VAR_2]と\rとりかえて　くれない　かしら？
records.english: Hi, there's this POKéMON that I'm\nlooking for.\cI want a [STR_VAR_1].\nDo you have one?\cWould you trade it for my [STR_VAR_2]?

records.japanese: ありがとう！！\cあたし　[STR_VAR_1]　だいじに　するから\nあなたも　[STR_VAR_2]　かわいがってね！
records.english: Thank you!\cI'll be good to your [STR_VAR_1],\nso please be nice to my [STR_VAR_2]!

records.japanese: えっ！　その　ポケモン\n[STR_VAR_1]　と　ちがうじゃない！\rなんだ　こうかん　してくれないのね
records.english: Wait!\nThat POKéMON isn't a [STR_VAR_1].\cI guess you don't want to trade\nwith me.

records.japanese: あ　そうなんだ！\nまた　きが　かわったら　きてね\rあたし　まってるから
records.english: Oh, okay. If you change your mind,\nplease come see me.\cI'll be waiting!

records.japanese: こうかん　してくれて　ありがとう！\nすごく　ほしかった　ポケモンだから\rたいせつに　そだてるわ！
records.english: Thank you for trading with me!\cI really wanted this POKéMON, so\nI promise to take good care of it!

records.japanese: ひとと　ポケモンを　こうかん　する‥‥\cつまりは　それぞれの\nおもいでを　こうかん　しているのじゃな
records.english: Trading POKéMON with others...\cIt's as if you're trading your own\nmemories with other people.

records.japanese: ジグザグマ『グモモォ？

げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cヒワマキシティ　ジムの　リーダー　ナギは
ひこうタイプ　ポケモンの　つかいてだ！\cこの　かいてんとびら　だらけの
ジムの　おくで\cかのじょは　あらたな　チャレンジャーが
はばたこうと　するのを　まっている！\cじゃ　きばってこォー！！
records.english:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cFORTREE GYM LEADER WINONA is a
master of FLYING-type POKéMON.\cShe's waiting at the back of this GYM,
behind the rotating doors.\cShe's waiting for new challengers who
are trying to take wing!\cOkay, go for it!

records.japanese: えんやっと　きみは　はばたいたッ！
かれいな　とりポケモンの　たたかいを\nみせて　やるぜっ！
records.english: Behold the elegant battle style of\nBIRD POKéMON!

records.japanese: きみ‥‥　つよいんだな‥‥
トレーナーは　あたまの　かいてんも\nはやく　なければ　つとまらないぜ！\cきみは　リーダーの　ところまで\nちゃんと　たどりつく　ことが　できるかい？
records.english: A TRAINER has to be smart to keep\nup with unexpected turns of events.\cLet's see if you have the smarts to\nget to our LEADER?

records.japanese: とりポケモンを　あいする　ものは\nこの　ジムを　もくひょうと　している！\cヒワマキ　ジムの　いちいん　として\nまける　わけには　いかないんだ！
records.english: The lovers of BIRD POKéMON aspire\nto join this GYM.\cAs a member of the FORTREE GYM,\nI'm not allowed to lose!

records.japanese: オレには　にが　おもすぎたか‥‥！
records.english: It was too much of a load for me\nto bear...

records.japanese: せかいは　ひろい\nつよい　トレーナーは　たくさん　いる\cオレも　ここで　しゅぎょうを　つづけて\nつよくなって　みせるよ！
records.english: The world is huge, and there are\ncountless tough TRAINERS.\cI'm going to keep training and make\nmyself even stronger.

records.japanese: ジムリーダーの　ナギさんの\nてを　わずらわせるまでも　ない！\cきみの　あいては　オレで　じゅうぶん！
records.english: There's no need for WINONA, our GYM\nLEADER, to deal with you!\cI'm plenty good enough for you!

records.japanese: ナギさん‥‥　まけました‥‥！
ナギさんは　かわいくて　つよい‥‥\nほんと　さいこうの　リーダーだよ！\c‥‥ポッ
records.english: WINONA is cute and she's strong.\nShe's the ultimate LEADER!\cBlush...

records.japanese: ナギさんの　おしえを　うけた　あたし！\nそう　かんたんに　たおされないわ！
records.english: WINONA taught me personally!\nYou can't beat me easily!

records.japanese: たおされ　ちゃった‥‥
ナギさんが　いてくれるから\nヒワマキの　ひとは　あんしんして　くらせるの
records.english: Thanks to WINONA, the people of\nFORTREE can live without fear.

records.japanese:
わたしは　この　ヒワマキ　ジムで
リーダーを　している　ナギ‥‥\cとりポケモンと　こころを　かよわし
いっしょに　おおぞらを　まい‥‥\cどんな　くるしい　しょうぶも
ゆうがに　かってみせる‥‥\cさあ　わたしと　ポケモンが　おりなす
かれいな　まいを　みせましょう！
records.english:
I am WINONA. I am the LEADER of the
FORTREE POKéMON GYM.\cI have become one with BIRD POKéMON
and have soared the skies...\cHowever grueling the battle, we have
triumphed with grace...\cWitness the elegant choreography
of BIRD POKéMON and I!

records.japanese: わたしより　かれいに\nポケモンを　たたかわせる　ひと‥‥\rはじめて　であいました‥‥\cその　じつりょくを　みとめ\nこの　ジムバッジを　おわたしします！
records.english: Never before have I seen a TRAINER\ncommand POKéMON with more grace\rthan I...\cIn recognition of your prowess,\nI present to you this GYM BADGE.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ナギから\nフェザーバッジを　もらった！

フェザーバッジを　つけてると
ひとから　もらった　ポケモンでもレベル７０までの　ポケモンならいうことを　すなおに　きいてくれます！\cひでんわざの　そらをとぶ　を
つかえる　ようにも　なります！\cそして　これを
あなたに　プレゼント　します
records.english:
With the FEATHER BADGE, all POKéMON up
to LV 70, even those received throughtrades, will obey your every command.\cYou will also be able to use the
HM move FLY outside of battle.\cAnd this...
This is a gift from me.

records.japanese: わざマシン４０の　なかみは\nつばめがえし！\cその　すばやさ‥‥\nどんな　ポケモンでも\rよけることは　できないでしょう！
records.english: TM40 contains AERIAL ACE.\cIts speed...\nNo POKéMON should be able to avoid it.

records.japanese: あなたには　まけました　けど\cわたしは　これからも\nとりポケモンに　こだわって　いきます
records.english: Though I fell to you, I will remain\ndevoted to BIRD POKéMON.

records.japanese: ヒワマキシティ　ポケモンジム
ヒワマキシティ　ポケモンジム\cナギ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
records.english: FORTREE CITY POKéMON GYM\cWINONA'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

records.japanese: きみぃ\nポケモンずかん　つくっておるのか？\cふむぅ　１２１ばん　どうろの\nサファリゾーンに　いっては　どうかな？
records.english: Listen, kid, are you working\non a POKéDEX?\cHmm... Go to the SAFARI ZONE.\nThat's my suggestion.

records.japanese: レコードコーナー　つかってるかい？\cレコードって　きろくの　ことだろ\nきろくが　いろいろ　まざるって‥‥\cよく　わかんないけど　すごいよな！\nワクワク　しちゃうよ！
records.english:
Have you done anything at the
RECORD CORNER?\cIt's pretty neat. It mixes and matches
the records of TRAINERS.\cI don't know quite how it works,
but it's cool. It's exciting, even!

records.japanese: おっ　ポケナビ　もってるな！\nおれと　おんなじ　だ\cポケナビの　トレーナーアイ　つかうと\nもういちど　しょうぶ　したがってる\rトレーナーが　わかるってのが\rすぐれもの　だよな！　さすが　デボンだぜ！
records.english:
Hey, you've got a POKéNAV!
It's the same as mine.\cCheck out the TRAINER'S EYES on it.\cIt shows you TRAINERS who want a
rematch with you.\cIsn't it great?
You have to hand it to DEVON!

records.japanese: シルバースプレーは\nききめ　ながもち！　こうか　ばつぐん！\cつまり　むしよけスプレー　よりも\nすごい　ってことね！
records.english: SUPER REPEL lasts a long time, and\nit gets the job done.\cIt's much better than an ordinary\nREPEL.

records.japanese: もしも　ってことが　あるかも　しれないし\nどうぐは　おおめに　かうように　してるのよ
records.english: I always stock up on more items than\nI'm sure I'll need.\cYou never know what might happen.\nBetter to be safe than sorry!

records.japanese: ふしぎなアメを　あげると\nポケモン　いっきに　そだって\rレベルが　あがっちゃうんだ！
records.english: A RARE CANDY makes a POKéMON grow\nimmediately by one level.

records.japanese: ひとも　ポケモンも\nしぜんの　なかで　くらすことで\rもともとの　パワーが　めざめる‥‥
records.english: People... POKéMON...\cTheir hidden powers are aroused by\nliving in natural environments...

records.japanese: おぬしの　パワーが　めざめているか\nたしかめると　するかの‥‥\cどれ‥‥　わしの　みぎてと　ひだりて\nどちらに　コインが　はいっておるか\rちょっかんで　えらんで　みなさい
records.english: Let this old woman see if your hidden\npower has awoken...\cI hold a coin in my hand.\cNow, tell me, have I palmed it in the\nright hand? Or in the left?

records.japanese: おお！　せいかい　じゃ！\cつぎは　みぎてと　ひだりて\nどちらに　コインが　はいっておるか\rちょっかんで　えらんで　みなさい
records.english: Oh! Yes, correct!\cWe shall try again.\cIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left?

records.japanese: おお！　せいかい　じゃ！\cつぎは　みぎてと　ひだりて\nどちらに　コインが　はいっておるか\rちょっかんで　えらんで　みなさい
records.english: Oh! Yes, correct again!\cWe shall try once more.\cIn which hand have I palmed the coin?\nThe right or left? Choose!

records.japanese: おお！　みごと　じゃ！\nおぬしの　パワーは　めざめているの！\cこれを　あげるから\nおぬしの　ポケモンも　パワーを\rめざめさせて　やると　ええぞ！
records.english: Oh! Splendid!\nYour hidden power has awoken!\cHere, take this and awaken the hidden\npower of your POKéMON.

records.japanese: めざめるパワーは　ポケモンによって\nいりょくが　かわる　わざ　なんじゃよ！
records.english: HIDDEN POWER is a move that changes\nwith the POKéMON.

records.japanese: ざんねん‥‥\nはずれ　じゃ‥‥
ヒワマキの　まわりは\nまるで　ジャングル　だから\rあるいていると　くたくたに　なっちゃう！\cそんなとき　ポケモンの　そらをとぶで\nいった　まち　まで　ひとっとび！
records.english:
The area around FORTREE CITY is like
a jungle.\cIt gets awfully tiring walking around
this city.\cThat's why I use FLY to instantly go to
any city I've visited.

records.japanese:
ポケモンずかんで
おもいだした　ことが　あるよ\cめずらしい　いしを　さがしてるとき
ダイゴって　トレーナーと　であったけどあいつの　ポケモン　すごいね！\cめずらしい　だけでなく
おそろしいほど　きたえられてた！\cもしかしたら　この　まちの
ジムリーダーよりも　つよいかも‥‥
records.english:
Speaking of POKéDEXES, I remembered
something.\cI met this TRAINER, STEVEN, when
I was searching for rare stones.\cHoo, boy, he had some amazing POKéMON
with him.\cThey weren't just rare, they were
trained to terrifying extremes!\cHe might even be stronger than the
GYM LEADER in this town...

records.japanese: きみの　もっている　それ　なに？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cへー　ポケモンずかん　っていうんだ？\nすごいねえ！
records.english: What's that thing you have there?\c... ... ... ... ... ...\cOh, it's called a POKéDEX?\nIt's really awesome!

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いることで\nなかの　いい　ともだちが　ふえていく‥‥\cこうして　せかいは　つながって　いくのね！\nすてきだわ！
records.english: By being together with POKéMON,\npeople make more and more friends.\cAnd that brings the world closer\ntogether. I think it's wonderful!

records.japanese: それっ！\nゆけっ　とりポケモン
えへへ　キャモメに\nちょっと　おつかいを　たのんだのさ
records.english: Heheh, I asked my WINGULL to run an\nerrand for me.

records.japanese:
よーし！
おかえり　キャモメ！\cあれえ？　なに　もってるんだ？\cメンタルハーブ　かあ‥‥
どこかで　ひろったんだな\cでも　ぼく　トレーナーじゃ　ないからな
きみに　あげるよ！
records.english:
Good!
Welcome back, WINGULL!\cHuh? What is this?
What is it holding?\cA MENTAL HERB?
It must have picked it up somewhere.\cBut I'm not a TRAINER, so you can
have it.

records.japanese: キャモメの　おかげで\nとおくの　ともだちとも　なかよし　なのさ！
records.english: Thanks to my WINGULL, I have friends\nwho live far away.

records.japanese: キャモメ『ぴひょー！
ヒワマキの　ツリーハウスって　さいこう！\nポケモンと　いっしょに　くらすなら\rいちばんの　まちだと　おもっているわ！
records.english: The tree houses of FORTREE are great!\cI think it's the number one town for\nliving together with POKéMON.

records.japanese: ポケモンも　ひとも\nしぜんに　あわせて　くらしてきたからな\cいまさら　じぶんらの　つごうに\nしぜんを　あわせなくて　いいんだよ
records.english: POKéMON and people have adapted to\nnature to survive.\cThere's no need to make nature\nconform to the way we want to live.

records.japanese: ジグザグマ『ぶふう！！
ここで　かった　ものは\nパソコンに　とどけられる！\cなんと　すばらしい！　ついでに　わしも\nいえまで　とどけて　くれないものか
records.english: Merchandise you buy here is sent to\nyour own PC.\cThat's fantastic! I wish they could\nalso deliver me home like that.

records.japanese: すてきな　つくえを　かって　そのうえに\nかわいい　ぬいぐるみを　ならべるんだ！\cそうしないと　ひみつきちに　おくとき\nつちで　よごれたり　トゲが　ささって\rぬいぐるみが　かわいそう　だもん！
records.english: I'm buying a pretty desk and I'm\nputting my cute DOLLS on it.\cIf I don't, when I decorate my\nSECRET BASE, my DOLLS will get\rdirty or poked with splinters.

records.japanese:
ほほう　ポケモンの　みりょくで
おきゃくさまが　ばいぞう　したって！？\cそうかあ　うちも　かわいい　ポケモンを
りょかんの　マスコットに　すれば\cもっと　たくさんの　おきゃくさまが
とまりに　きてくれるように　なるかな？
records.english:
Hm, so they doubled the guests by
using POKéMON as attractions?\cHm, well, maybe I should make a cute
POKéMON our inn's mascot.\cI wonder if that will attract more
guests to stay with us?

records.japanese: あ　ごめん　ごめん！\nテレビに　むちゅう　だったもんで！\c[EVIL_TEAM]だん　とかいう　れんちゅうが\nまちに　やってきた　おかげで\rかんこうきゃくも　さっぱり　なんだよね
records.english: Oh, sorry, sorry!\nI was too involved in watching TV!\cSince that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] came to town,\nthe tourists have been staying away.

records.japanese: あー　ちょっと　じゃま　しないで！\nテレビが　みえない　じゃないか！
records.english: Hey, down in front!\nI can't see the TV!

records.japanese:
なんと！　なくした　どうぐを
ポケモンが　ひろって　きたって！？\cそうかあ　うちも　そんな　
かしこい　ポケモンが　いてくれれば\cおきゃくさまの　なくした　ものも
すぐに　みつかるのになぁ‥‥
records.english:
Amazing! You're telling me a POKéMON
found someone's lost item?\cThat's something. If we had some smart
POKéMON like that...\cWe could recover anything that our
guests mislaid...

records.japanese:
あ　ごめん　ごめん！
テレビに　むちゅう　だったもんで！\cそういえば　だれかが　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの
アジトを　かいめつ　させた　らしいね！\cおかげで　さっき　だんたいさん　からの
しゅくはく　よやくが　はいったよ！\cたしか‥‥　ゲームなんとか　っていう
かいしゃ　だったかな‥‥
records.english:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV!\cI heard that someone busted the
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] HIDEOUT.\cThanks to that, we just booked a
reservation from a big group.\cIt was a company called... Uh...
GAME something...

records.japanese:
なんと！　しのびこんだ　どろぼうを
るすばんの　ポケモンが　つかまえたって！？\cそうかあ　うちも　ガードマンの　かわりに
つよい　ポケモンが　いてくれれば\cおきゃくさまの　あんぜんを
まもることが　できそうだなぁ‥‥
records.english:
Amazing! A house-sitting POKéMON
caught a burglar?\cThat's something. If we had a tough
POKéMON as a security guard...\cWe would be able to provide our guests
with greater safety.

records.japanese:
あ　ごめん　ごめん！
テレビに　むちゅう　だったもんで！\cそういえば　さっき
だんたいさん　が　とうちゃく　したよ！\cゲームフリークって　いうから
ゲームの　かいしゃの　ひとたち　かなぁ？ああ　ごはんの　じゅんびを　しなくちゃ‥‥
records.english:
Oh, sorry, sorry!
I was too involved in watching TV.\cOh, yes. A big group of guests arrived
a little while ago.\cThey booked in as GAME FREAK, so I
guess they must make games.\cUh-oh, I'd better get working on
their dinner!

records.japanese: ぼくは　ゲーム　デザイナー\cへー\nポケモンずかん　あつめてるの？\cぜんぶ　あつめるの\nたいへん　だけど　がんばって！\cもし　ぜんぶ　あつめたら　おしえてよ！
records.english:
I'm the GAME DESIGNER.\cOh, is that right?
You're working on a POKéDEX?\cIt's tough trying to complete it,
but don't give up.\cIf you do complete it, please come
show me.

records.japanese:
すごいなー！
いやー　すごいよ　きみ！！\cこの　ポケモンずかん
ぜんぶ　あつまって　いるんだね！それだけ　ポケモンを　あいしてるんだね！\cかんどう　しました！
きみを　ひょうしょう　させてもらいますね！
records.english:
Wow! That's awesome!
Yep, it's totally awesome!\cThis POKéDEX is completely filled!
You really must love POKéMON!\cI'm so impressed!\cLet me give you something in
recognition of your feat!

records.japanese: おれさま？\cプログラマーだよ！　こっちの\nスロットは　どんなのか　たのしみだな！
records.english: Me? You're talking to me?\nI'm the PROGRAMMER.\cI wonder what the SLOTS are\nlike here.

records.japanese: おれ　グラフィッカー！\nホウエンの　ポケモンは　おもしろいね
records.english: I'm the GRAPHIC ARTIST! Aren't the\nPOKéMON of HOENN interesting?

records.japanese: うきわガール　かわいい　でしょ！\nうきわガールと　しょうぶ　なんて‥‥\cくー！　たまらんー！\cふたごちゃん　かわいい　でしょ！\nふたごちゃんと　２たい２　なんて‥‥\cくー！　たまらんー！
records.english: The girl TUBERS, they're cute, hey?\nTo battle against a cute TUBER...\cWhoop, it drives me wild!\cAnd the TWINS! Aren't they cute?\nA 2-on-2 battle with TWINS...\cWhoop, it's unbearably fun!

records.japanese: なんだか　しおかぜが　こころを　くすぐって\nきもち　いいですね！
records.english: The sea breeze tickles my heart.\nIt feels wonderful here!

records.japanese: いつ　どこで　たいせんや　しょうぶを\nいどまれるか　わからないからな\rゲームボーイ　アドバンスは　てばなせないよ！
records.english: You never know when and where\npeople will challenge you.\cThat's why I never leave home without\nmy GAME BOY ADVANCE.

records.japanese: ミナモ　びじゅつかん　へ　ようこそ！\cポケモンたちを　えがいた\nすばらしい　めいがの　かずかずを\rゆっくり　ごらんに　なって　くださいね！
records.english: Welcome to LILYCOVE MUSEUM.\cPlease take the time to enjoy our\ncollection of fantastic artwork\rfeaturing POKéMON.

records.japanese: わたしは　この　びじゅつかんの\nかんちょう　です！\cあなたは　おわかいのに　びじゅつかんに\nいらっしゃる　とは　かんしん　ですね！\cもう　えは　ごらんに　なりましたか？
records.english:
I'm the CURATOR of this MUSEUM of
fine arts.\cIt's heartening to see someone so
young as you in our MUSEUM.\cHave you viewed our collection of
paintings already?

records.japanese: では　おじゃま　いたしません　から\nゆっくり　みていって　ください！
records.english: Ah, then let me not disturb you.\nPlease, do take your time.

records.japanese: おや？　あなたは\nポケモントレーナーさん　みたい　ですね\cえにも　きょうみが　おあり　ですか？
records.english: Oh? I do believe that you seem to\nbe a POKéMON TRAINER.\cHave you an interest in paintings,\ntoo?

records.japanese: そうですか‥‥\cそれなのに　わざわざ　おいで　くださって\nこうえい　ですよ
records.english: I see...\cI'm honored that you would visit\nus in spite of that.

records.japanese: そうですか！　えが　おすき　ですか！\cでは　ちょっと　わたしに\nついてきて　ください　ませんか？
records.english: Ah, excellent!\nYou do like paintings!\cThen, may I ask you to come with me?

records.japanese: むかしの　ひとが　かいた　えだ！\nところどころ　えのぐが　はがれてる
records.english: It's a very old painting.\nThe paint is peeling here and there.

records.japanese: みたことも　ないような　ふしぎな\nけしきが　えがかれている
records.english: It's an odd landscape with bizarre\nand fantastic scenery.

records.japanese: ひざに　ポケモンを　のせて　ほほえむ\nうつくしい　じょせいが　えがかれている
records.english: It's a painting of a beautiful, smiling\nwoman with a POKéMON on her lap.

records.japanese: むかしの　ひとが　そうぞうで　かいた\nでんせつの　ポケモンの　えだ！
records.english: It's a painting of a legendary POKéMON\nfrom long ago.\cThe artist painted this from\nimagination.

records.japanese: かぜに　なびいて　きもち　よさそうに\nゆれている　くさポケモンが　えがかれている
records.english: It's a painting of GRASS POKéMON\nswaying in a breeze.\cThey appear to be enjoying the wind's\ngentle caress.

records.japanese: おいしそうな　きのみが　えがかれている\nおなかが　すいて　きそう！
records.english: It's a delicious-looking painting\nof BERRIES.\cThis painting could make you hungry!

records.japanese: こだいの　とりポケモンを　ほった\nゆうめいな　ちょうこくの　レプリカだ！
records.english: It's a replica of a famous sculpture.\cIt depicts an ancient BIRD POKéMON.

records.japanese: くろい　いしで　つくられた\nおおきい　モンスターボールだ！\rむかし　おまつりに　つかって　いたらしい
records.english: It's a big POKé BALL carved from a\nblack stone.\cIt was apparently used in festivals\nin the olden days.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　すがたと　しらない　もじが\nこまかく　ほられてある　せきばんだ！
records.english: It's a huge stone tablet inscribed\nwith POKéMON and dense text in the\rsmall characters of an ancient,\runreadable language.

records.japanese: うーん　すばらしい　さくひんだ‥‥
ポケモン　しょうぶも　いいけど\cげいじゅつを　あいする　きもちも\nわすれずに　いないとね！
records.english: Battling with POKéMON is fun,\nI'll grant you that.\cBut one mustn't forget our love for\nthe fine arts.

records.japanese: この　びじゅつかんは\nすごい　えが　たくさん　みられるし\rかんちょうも　すばらしい　ひとだし\rぼくたち　がかの　あいだ　でも\rあこがれの　ばしょ　なんだよ
records.english: This ART MUSEUM... Well, you could\nsee many fantastic paintings.\cAnd the CURATOR is a wonderful person.\cAmong artists like myself, this MUSEUM\nis an inspiration.

records.japanese: この　おんなの　ひと　きれーい！\nママみたーい！
records.english: This lady is pretty!\nShe's like Mommy!

records.japanese: この　ポケモン　かわいいわ！\nうちの　ぼうや　みたい！
records.english: This POKéMON is adorable!\nJust like our little boy!

records.japanese: この　びじゅつかんに　あたらしい　えが\nはいったって　きいたから\rさっそく　みにきて　みたの！\cあたらしい　えは　２かい　かな？
records.english: I'd heard that this ART MUSEUM got\nin some new paintings.\cSo, naturally I hurried over.\cAre the new paintings up on the\nsecond floor?

records.japanese: さいきん　かんちょうの　ごきげんが\nとても　いいみたい\cいいこと　あったんだね　きっと
records.english: Lately, the CURATOR has been\nunusually cheerful.\cI bet something good happened for him.\nDefinitely.

records.japanese: ここで　いい　えを　たくさん　みて\nべんきょう　しないとな！\cここに　いつか　じぶんの　さくひんを\nかざって　もらうのが　ゆめ　なんだ！
records.english: I aim to see many great paintings\nhere and learn from them.\cI have this dream of one day having\nmy artwork exhibited here.

records.japanese: この　びじゅつかんも　すっかり　ミナモの\n‥‥いや　ホウエンちほうの\rかんこう　めいしょに　なったねえ！\cきいた　はなしだと\nひとりの　トレーナーが　２かいの　えを\rそろえて　くれた　らしいよ！
records.english:
The ART MUSEUM has become a favorite
tourist destination.\cIt's great for LILYCOVE...
No, great for the HOENN region!\cThis is what I've heard - a lone TRAINER
procured all the paintings upstairs.

records.japanese: ここは　とくべつ　てんじしつ　です
records.english: This is our special exhibit hall.

records.japanese:
ごらんの　とおり　まだ
えが　かざられて　おりません\cここには　１かいに　あるような
いわゆる　めいが　といった　ものとはちがう　えを　かざりたいの　ですよ！\cふるい　めいが　ばかりが
げいじゅつ　なのでは　ありません！\cこの　てんじしつ　には‥‥\cいまにも　ポケモンが　とびだして　きそうな
モダンで　いきいきとした　さくひんをかざって　みたいのです！
records.english:
As you can plainly see, there is not a
single painting on exhibit.\cHere, I don't wish to exhibit works of
so-called classical art.\cSuch classical works you can see on
our ground floor.\cI wish to exhibit work that is far
different from the classics.\cArt, after all, is not restricted to old,
famous works!\cThis exhibit hall, I wish to fill it with...\cModern and vibrant artworks of
POKéMON seemingly ready to springforth into glorious life!

records.japanese:
つい　ながながと　しつれい　しました\cあなたは　まだ　おわかいし
たびを　なさって　いる　ようだから\cいきいきとした　ポケモンや
それを　えがいた　すてきな　さくひんにであわれる　かも　しれません！\cもし　そんな　さくひんに　であったら
そのえを　ここに　かざれる　ようにあなたから　おねがい　して　くださるとたいへん　うれしいです
records.english:
I beg your pardon. I didn't intend
to monopolize the conversation.\cNow, as you are young, and yet
obviously well traveled...\cYou must encounter lively POKéMON
and works of art depicting them.\cIf you were to come across such a
painting, may we ask you to obtainthe artist's permission to exhibitit here?

records.japanese: この　てんじしつ　には\nげんだいの　いきいき　とした　ポケモンの\rえを　かざりたい　ものです
records.english: I wish to fill this exhibit hall with\nmodern and vibrant paintings of\rPOKéMON.

records.japanese: おかげさまで　えを\nかざる　ことが　できましたよ！\cあなたの　ポケモン　なんですって　ね！\nほんとうに　すばらしい　です！\cどうも　ありがとう‥‥！
records.english: Thanks to you, we've added a new\npainting to our collection!\cI've heard it depicts your POKéMON.\nTruly magnificent!\cThank you so very, very much!

records.japanese: あ　あなた！　[PLAYER]さん！

どうです　みて　ください！
この　すばらしい　さくひん　たちを！\cどれも　おたがいに
ひけをとらない　すばらしさ！\cこの　えの　おかげで　びじゅつかんに
こられる　かたも　ふえたんです！\cほんとうに　ありがとう　[PLAYER]さん！
わたしの　ゆめが　かないました！
records.english:
Isn't this marvelous?
This collection of paintings!\cEach one of them flawless!
None better than another!\cThese paintings have attracted
more guests to our ART MUSEUM.\cSincerely, I thank you, [PLAYER].
This is my dream come true!

records.japanese: ‥‥これは　わたしからの\nおれいの　きもち　です！
records.english: This is merely a token of my gratitude.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nガラスのオブジェを　もらった！
それでは　また　いらした　ときに\nさしあげましょう
records.english: I will keep this for you until we\nmeet again.

records.japanese: やあ　これは　[PLAYER]さん！\cおいそがしい　たびの　あいまに\nおたちより　くださって　こうえいです！\cどうぞ　ごゆっくり　おすごしくださいね
records.english: Ah, so good to see you, [PLAYER]!\cIt's an honor to have you visit us\non your busy journeys.\cPlease, relax and do enjoy your\nvisit with us.

records.japanese: ももいろの　かざりが　ついた　がくぶちだ！
records.english: It's a picture frame with pink-colored\nadornments.

records.japanese: きいろの　かざりが　ついた　がくぶちだ！
records.english: It's a picture frame with yellow-colored\nadornments.

records.japanese: あおい　かざりが　ついた　がくぶちだ！
records.english: It's a picture frame with blue-colored\nadornments.

records.japanese: あかい　かざりが　ついた　がくぶちだ！
records.english: It's a picture frame with red-colored\nadornments.

records.japanese: みどりいろの　かざりが　ついた　がくぶちだ！
records.english: It's a picture frame with green-colored\nadornments.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　えが　かざってある！
ひさしぶりに　きて　みたら　２かいにも\nえが　かざって　あって　びっくり！\cいいなあ　あたしの　ポケモンも\nこんなふうに　すてきに　かいて　ほしいな
records.english: I've been away awhile, so the new\npaintings up here surprised me.\cI wish someone would paint my POKéMON\nthis pretty.

records.japanese: ほう‥‥　ここが　さいきん　わだいの\nポケモンの　えが　ある　ところか‥‥\cなるほど　あたらしい　えが　いっぱいで\nなかなか　おもしろい　のう‥‥
records.english: Well... So this is where they show the\ntopical POKéMON paintings.\cI see, these new paintings are indeed\nrather amusing.

records.japanese: へえー！　これって\nきみの　ポケモンの　えなんだ！\cそれって　トレーナー　として\nさいこうの　しあわせ　だよな！
records.english: Wow, is that right?\nThese paintings are of your POKéMON.\cIsn't that just the ultimate joy for\na TRAINER?

records.japanese: こちらは　ポケモンコンテストの\n４めいさま　せんようの　うけつけです！\cおともだちが　あと３めい　そろえば\n４にんで　おなじ　コンテストに　でられます！\rさんか　しますか？
records.english: I only register four players for\nPOKéMON CONTESTS.\cIf three other players link up, all\nfour may enter the same CONTEST.\cWould you like to take part?

records.japanese: コンテストに　エントリーする　まえに\nレポートを　かきます
records.english: Before entering a CONTEST, your\nprogress will be saved.

records.japanese: またの　さんかを　おまち　してます！
records.english: We hope you will participate another\ntime.

records.japanese: コンテストに\nさんか　しますか？
records.english: Would you like to enter a CONTEST?

records.japanese:
トレーナーの　おともだちが　４めい
そろったら　ケーブルを　つないでこちらで　エントリー　して　ください！\cコンテストは　おなじ　ものを
えらんで　くださいね！\cみなさんの　エントリーが　おわれば
コンテストが　はじまりますのであとは　いつもと　おなじ　ちょうしでがんばって　ください！
records.english:
When four players are ready, connect
over a Game Link cable, and registerwith me, please.\cPlease choose the same CONTEST
as your fellow contestants.\cThe CONTEST begins as soon as all
players register their entry.\cAfter that, the usual CONTEST rules
apply.

records.japanese: では　つうしんの　じゅんびが　できましたら\nさんかしたい　コンテストを\rえらんで　ください！
records.english: Once you have linked up, please choose\nthe CONTEST.

records.japanese: どの　コンテストに　さんか　しますか？
records.english: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?

records.japanese: どの　ポケモンを　さんか　させますか？
records.english: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?

records.japanese: つうしん　しています‥‥
つうしんに　しっぱい　しました
えらんだ　コンテストが\nおともだちと　ちがう　ようです！
records.english: You may have chosen a different\nCONTEST than another player.

records.japanese: おたがいの　せんたくが　ちがっているようです
records.english: You may have made a different\nchoice than another player.

records.japanese: しょうしょう　おまち　ください\n‥‥Ｂボタンで　キャンセル
records.english: Please wait.\nPress the B Button to cancel...

records.japanese: またの　さんかを　おまち　してます！
records.english: We hope you will participate\nanother time.

records.japanese: つうしん　エラーです\nもう１ど　やりなおして　ください
それでは　おきゃくさまの　ポケモンを\nエントリー　します！\cおきゃくさまの　エントリーナンバーは\n[STR_VAR_2]ばん　に　なります！
records.english: Your POKéMON will be entered in\nthe CONTEST.\cYour POKéMON is Entry No. [STR_VAR_2].

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_2]ばんの　かたは\nきょうは　この　カラーで\rちょうせん　してみて　くださいね！
records.english: Entry No. [STR_VAR_2] is assigned this color\nfor this CONTEST.

records.japanese: コンテストは　すぐに　はじまります！
それでは　こちらから　どうぞ！\nがんばって　くださいね！
records.english: Please come through this way.\nGood luck!

records.japanese: ゆうしょう　おめでとう！\cさっそく　きねんに\nきみの　ポケモンの　えを\rかきあげたんだけど‥‥\cなんだか　きみの　ポケモンの　アピールが\nあまり　にも　すばらしくて\rいつもより　うまく　かけたんだ！\rほらっ　これ！
records.english: Congratulations!\cI did a painting of your POKéMON to\ncommemorate its victory...\cWell, your POKéMON's appeals were\nso fantastic, it spurred me into\rpainting better than I usually do.\rLook, see?

records.japanese: ここで　がめんを　きりかえて\nえを　みせます
records.english: The screen switches to display the\npainting.

records.japanese:
どうかな？　じしんさく　なんだけど
きにいったろ？\cこれくらいの　でき　なら
びじゅつかんに　かざられて　いてもふしぎじゃ　ないね！\c‥‥え　ほんとに　びじゅつかんで
えを　さがして　いるって？じゃあ　これ　もっていって　みようかな？
records.english:
What do you think? I'm confident in
what I've done, but do you like it?\cA work of this caliber, it wouldn't look
out of place in an art museum.\cHuh? An art museum really is looking
for paintings?\cDo you think I should take this there?

records.japanese: そ　そうか！\nじゃ　いますぐ　もっていって　みるよ\rタイトルも　つけて　おくからね！\cこれが　きにいられて\nかざって　もらえて　いるか　どうか\rきみも　こんど　みに　いってね！\rじゃ　ありがとう！
records.english:
What, really? Then, sure, I will take
this painting there right now.\cI'll give it a proper title, too.\cI hope they'll like it and consider
exhibiting this.\cPlease check if they did accept this.
Thank you!

records.japanese: ‥‥あ　そうだ\cポケモンを　かかせて　もらった　きねんに\nこれを　うけとってよ！
records.english: Oh, that's right!\cAs a memento of me painting your\nPOKéMON, please take this.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　リボンを　もらった！
[PLAYER]は　リボンを\n[STR_VAR_1]に　つけて　あげた！
それじゃね！
うーん‥‥　じゃあ　これは\nぼくが　もってかえると　するか‥‥\cでも　やっぱり　もっていきたいな‥‥\nいいだろ？
records.english: Oh... Then, I guess I'll just take\nthis home with me...\cBut, you know, I would like to take\nthis to the art museum... Okay?

records.japanese: そっか　しかたないね\nそれじゃ　これは　ぼくの\rいえに　かざります\cつぎ　がんばると　するか‥‥\nじゃあな
records.english: Oh, fine, that's the way it is.\nI will hang this in my own house.\cI'll just have to try harder next time.\nWell, be seeing you.

records.japanese: いっ　いよいよ\nコンテストも　マスターランク‥‥\cおれの　ポケモンちゃんが\nこのよで　いちばん\rかわいいって　ことを\rしょうめいする　ときが　きたんだ‥‥\rうへへへへ
records.english: Hoo, boy... Master Rank CONTESTS,\nhere I come.\cThe world will know that my dearest\nPOKéMON is the cutest being in all\rexistence. The time has come!\rUheheheh.

records.japanese: ここに　くれば\nポケモンを　たくさん　みられるから\rさんぽコースに　してるの！
records.english: You can see a whole variety of\nPOKéMON here.\cThat's why I make this place a regular\npart of my daily stroll.

records.japanese: あら　まだ　コンテストパスを\nもらって　ないのね！\rシダケタウンで　はやく　もらっておいでよ！\cだいじに　そだてた　ポケモンを\nおおぜいに　みてもらうのって　かいかんよ！
records.english:
Oh, dear! They still haven't given
you a CONTEST PASS?\cYou should go get one in VERDANTURF
TOWN right away.\cIt's such a thrill having others see
POKéMON that you've raised with careand love.

records.japanese: いやあ　コンテストも\nマスターランクまで　くると\rかきがいの　ある　ポケモンが\rいっぱい　だね！
records.english: When you get up to the Master Rank\nCONTESTS, you get your eyes opened\rto striking POKéMON that just scream\rto be painted.

records.japanese: たくましさコンテストって\nさいこう　だよな！\cちからづよい　アピール‥‥　　\nほとばしる　あせ‥‥　たまらん！
records.english: The TOUGHNESS CONTEST is like\nextreme, man!\cThose muscular appeals...\nCascading sweat... I swoon!

records.japanese: まいにち　だいじに　だいじに\nそだてあげた　わしの　ポケモン\rコンディションは　カンペキ！\rきょうは　かつぞおおおおおうう！
records.english: Day in and day out, I lavished my care\non this POKéMON.\cIts condition is peaking.\nToday, victory is mine!

records.japanese: ママと　パパと　おねえちゃんと\n４にんで　ポロックを　つくったら\rすごく　いいやつが　できたんだ！\cきっと　おおぜいで　つくれば　つくるほど\nなめらかで　いい　ポロックが　できるんだよ！
records.english: I made [POKEBLOCK]S with Mom, Dad and\nBig Sister. They turned out great!\cI bet you can make smoother, better\n[POKEBLOCK]S if you have more people.

records.japanese: うつくしさ　コンテストで\nゆうしょうした　この　ポケモンを\rきょうは　かしこさ　コンテストで\rゆうしょう　させたんだぜ！\cああ　じぶんの　さいのうが　こわい‥‥
records.english: This POKéMON won the BEAUTY CONTEST\nhere before.\cWell, guess what? Today, I made it\nwin a SMARTNESS CONTEST!\cMy abilities scare even me...

records.japanese: なんども　コンテストに　でていて\nなんとなく　わかって　きたんだけど\cたとえば　かっこいいコンテストで\nかっこいいわざを　だすと　うけるけど\rかしこいアピールや　かわいいアピールは\rなぜか　うけが　わるいんだよな‥‥
records.english:
I've entered a bunch of CONTESTS,
so I'm seeing how things work.\cIf you're in a COOLNESS CONTEST,
cool moves go over as appeals.\cBut smart moves and cute moves
don't go over well, for instance.

records.japanese: さっき　ゆうしょう　した　おにいさん\nすっごい　たくさんの　しゅるいの\rポロックを　もってた！\cあれだけ　もってれば\nゆうしょう　できるのかな？
records.english: That young man who won earlier had\na whole bunch of different [POKEBLOCK]S.\cCan you win if you had that many\nof those things?

records.japanese: かーっ　ひろいね　ここは！\nいなかの　コンテスト　かいじょう　とは\rきんちょうかんが　ちがうね！
records.english: Whoa, isn't this place humongous!\cThe tension in the air... It's not\nlike a CONTEST hall in the sticks.

records.japanese: しかい『はあい　かしこい　ポケモンと\nそして　トレーナーの　みなさーん！\rがんばってくださーーい！\rレッツ！　アピール！！
records.english: MC: Okay, SMART POKéMON and their\nTRAINERS, are you ready?!\cGive it your best showing!\nLet's appeal!

records.japanese: しんさいん『コンテスト　たのしんでますか？\cおともだちを　３にん　つれてくれば\n４にん　いっしょに　さんか　できますよ！
records.english: JUDGE: Are you enjoying this CONTEST?\cCome back with three friends, and\nall of you may enter a CONTEST!

records.japanese:
あわわわ‥‥
でる　コンテスト　まちがえた‥‥\cたくましい　ポケモンを
かしこさ　コンテストに‥‥\cよ　よしっ
かしこそうな　いわくだき　たのむぞ！
records.english:
Ayayayay...
I entered the wrong CONTEST.\cI entered this tough POKéMON in the
SMARTNESS CONTEST...\cCome on, wow them with a smart-looking
ROCK SMASH.

records.japanese: わしが　ながねん\nちしきの　すべてを　かけて\rかしこく　そだてた　ポケモン！\cわかい　やつらの　ポケモン　なんぞに\nそう　やすやすと　まけたりは　せんぞ！\cばあさん　みとるかー！？
records.english: I've spent many a year, and all my\nwisdom besides, raising this POKéMON\rto be smart.\cIt won't be easily bested by some\nyoung pup's POKéMON.\cMy dear wife, are you seeing this?

records.japanese: よし！　おれの　ポケモンが\nこのつぎに　かしこい　わざをだせば\rいっきに　かいじょうが　エキサイトするぞ！
records.english: There it is!\cIf my POKéMON pulls a smart move next,\nthe audience's excitement will peak!

records.japanese: やだあ！\cわたしの　ズバットちゃんの\nきゅうけつが　あんまり　すてきで\rつづけて　なんども　だしてたら\rなんか　がっかり　されちゃってるー！
records.english: Oh, dear, no!\cMy darling ZUBAT's LEECH LIFE is so\ncute I kept using it over and over!\cBut these mean people don't appreciate\nit at all!

records.japanese: キャー！　おじいさん　すてきー！
おなじ　ポケモンを　つかっていても\nトレーナーに　よって\rぜんぜん　ちがう　わざで\rアピールして　くるんだよね\cそれは　しょうぶと　いっしょだね！
records.english: Even when TRAINERS enter the same\nkind of POKéMON, they all seem to use\rdifferent moves for appeals.\cIt's just like the way people have\ndifferent styles for battling.

records.japanese: トレーナーより　ポケモンの　ほうが\nあたま　よさそうに　みえるなあ
records.english: I think the POKéMON look smarter\nthan their TRAINERS. By a lot.

records.japanese: やっぱり　かしこさ　コンテストよ！\cちせいてきな　みどりいろが\nうーん　クールだわー！
records.english: When all's said and done, I still love\nSMARTNESS CONTESTS.\cThat intellectual green color...\nIt's so... So... Cool.

records.japanese: しかい『あら？　あなたも\nうつくしさ　コンテストに　でるの？\rがんばってね！
records.english: MC: Are you entering the BEAUTY\nCONTEST, too? Good luck!

records.japanese: しんさいん『どの　ポケモンも\nじつに　うつくしい　ですなぁ！\cおもわず　さいてんを　わすれますよ！
records.english: JUDGE: Ah, every POKéMON here is a\nmodel of pristine beauty!\cWhy, I almost forgot to score them!

records.japanese: こんなに　うつくしい　ポケモン\nほかに　いないわよ　ねえ\cみんなの　めを　くぎづけに　しちゃうわ！
records.english: A POKéMON this beautiful...\nThere isn't another one like it.\cEveryone's eyes will be glued to\nmy beauty.

records.japanese: うわーん！\cこの　コンテストの　ために\nいっしょけんめい　けづくろい　したら\cやりすぎて　あたしの　ポケモン\nボサボサに　なっちゃった！\cどうしよう‥‥
records.english: Waaaah!\cI brushed and groomed my POKéMON\ncarefully for this CONTEST...\cBut I overdid it...\nMy POKéMON's coat turned all scraggly...\cWhat should I do?

records.japanese: この　まぶしすぎる　オーロラビームに\nしんさいんも　めを　あけられない！\c‥‥あれ？\nそれじゃ　いみが　ないのか？
records.english: This AURORA BEAM is so dazzling,\nthe JUDGE won't be able to see it.\cUh, wait a second...\nThat'll be meaningless, then!

records.japanese: この　きれいな　ポケモン\nあたしの　わかい　ころに　そっくり！\cって　いったら‥‥　とうちゃんが\nのんでた　おちゃを　ふきだしたよ\cあたし　なんか　へんなこと　いったかね？
records.english: This pretty POKéMON looks just like\nme when I was younger.\cRight when I said that, my husband\nspewed the coffee he was drinking.\cDid I say something funny?

records.japanese: やっぱり　じょせいと　しては\cうつくしさコンテストで　かてると\nいつもより　ちょっぴり　うれしいのよねー！
records.english: You know, as a woman, if I win at a\nBEAUTY CONTEST, sure it makes me\rhappy. More than usual, anyway.

records.japanese: うわっはっは！\cべっぴんな　ポケモンちゃん　が\nいっぱいだ‥‥\rこりゃ　はなやかで　ええのう！
records.english: Wahahahah!\cWill you take a gander at all those\npretty POKéMON!\rI just love this sort of glitz!

records.japanese: ただ　うつくしい　だけじゃ\nなかなか　かてないわよ！\cあたしの　ポケモンみたいに\nおていれして　ツヤツヤ　じゃなきゃ！
records.english: You can't always win on just beauty\nalone.\cYou have to groom your POKéMON so\nit's nice and glossy like mine.

records.japanese: しかい『あら　あらー！\nいまは　コンテスト　ちゅう　ですよー！\cうけつけで　エントリー　してから\nでて　くださーい！　ねっ！
records.english: MC: Uh-oh! Hello!\nWe're in the middle of a CONTEST!\cPlease enter at our registration\ncounter and come out, okay?

records.japanese: しんさいん『おお\nみんな　かわいい　アピールだなあ！\cおおっ　なんて　かわいい\nみずあそびの　アピールなんだろう！
records.english: JUDGE: Oh, such charming and cute\nappeals!\cOh, my goodness! What a perfectly\nadorable WATER SPORT appeal!

records.japanese: ああ　ぼくの　ルリリちゃんが\nほかの　ポケモンに　きを　とられちゃった！
records.english: Oh, no... My sweet AZURILL was\ndistracted by another POKéMON.

records.japanese: わたしの　ポケモンって　しょうぶだと\n１ども　かった　こと　ないけど\rコンテストは　おとくい　なのよ！
records.english: My POKéMON has never won in a battle,\nbut put it in a CONTEST and look out!

records.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモンの　かれいな\nはなびらのまい‥‥\rだれにも　じゃまは　させないぞ！
records.english: My POKéMON's PETAL DANCE is a marvel\nof elegance.\cI won't let anyone disturb its\nperformance.

records.japanese: どなたの　ポケモンも\nほんとうに　かわいいわねえ\cでも　わたしの　ポケモンが\nかわいく　アピール　すれば‥‥\cきっと　もっと　かわいい　はずよ
records.english: Everyone's POKéMON are very cute.\cHowever, if my POKéMON were to make\na cute appeal...\cI'm sure that it would be so much \ncuter than the others.

records.japanese: うちのこが　コンテストに　でてるんですよ\cほらっ　がんばって！\nあなたの　ポケモンが　いちばんよっ！
records.english: My child is in this CONTEST.\cCome on, dear. Go for it!\nYour POKéMON is the best!

records.japanese: ワシは　あの　おんなのこが\nいちばん　かわいいと　おもうな‥‥\cえっ？　ポケモンの　みためを\nくらべてるんか！？
records.english: I think that girl over there is the\ncutest of the lot.\cWhat's that? They're judging\nPOKéMON by their looks?

records.japanese: ああん　みてたら\nあの　ポケモン　ほしく　なっちゃった\rつかまえに　いこっと！
records.english: Ohh, seeing all these cute POKéMON,\nthey make we want to get my own!\cI'm going to go catch some!

records.japanese: かっこよさコンテスト　ステージ\nクールな　ポケモンに　メロメロ！
records.english: COOLNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHILLED BY COOL POKéMON!

records.japanese: うつくしさコンテスト　ステージ\nビューティフル　ポケモンに　クラクラ！
records.english: BEAUTY CONTEST STAGE\nBE ALLURED BY BEAUTIFUL POKéMON!

records.japanese: かわいさコンテスト　ステージ\nキュートな　ポケモンに　ウキウキ！
records.english: CUTENESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE CHARMED BY CUTE POKéMON!

records.japanese: かしこさコンテスト　ステージ\nインテリ　ポケモンに　トロトロ！
records.english: SMARTNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE IMPRESSED BY SMART POKéMON!

records.japanese: たくましさコンテスト　ステージ\nワイルドな　ポケモンに　ドキドキ！
records.english: TOUGHNESS CONTEST STAGE\nBE THRILLED BY TOUGH POKéMON!

records.japanese: この　せかいには\nどれだけの　ポケモンが　いるのかな？\cいつのひか　うみを　こえて\nとおい　くにの　ひとと\rポケモン　こうかん　したいなあ！
records.english: I wonder how many kinds of POKéMON\nthere are in the world?\cIt'd be great to cross seas and\ntrade POKéMON with people far away.

records.japanese: ちかごろ　ひとの　ポケモンを　うばったり\nいんせきを　よこどり　したりする\rろくでもない　やつらが　いるらしいな！
records.english: I've been hearing about some rotten\nscoundrels who steal POKéMON and rip\roff METEORITES.

records.japanese: ひとの　ポケモンを　うばったり\nいんせきを　よこどり　していた\rろくでもない　やつら‥‥\cちかごろ　すがたを　みなくなったよ
records.english: Those rotten scoundrels who steal\nPOKéMON and rip off METEORITES...\cI haven't seen them around recently.

records.japanese: プラスパワーを　ポケモンに　つかって\nこうげきりょくを　たかめるんだ！\cこれで　しょうり　まちがいなし　さ！
records.english: I'm going to get X ATTACK to raise\nATTACK during battle.\cThat way, I'll be guaranteed to win!

records.japanese: ちょっと　たかいかも　しれないけど\nなんでもなおし　って　べんりよ\cポケモンの　どんな　いじょうも\nこれひとつで　なおせるんだもんね！
records.english: FULL HEAL is a little expensive,\nbut it is convenient.\cJust one of these can cure any\nPOKéMON status problem.

records.japanese: あ！\n[PLAYER]だ！！

きいたよ！
きみ　つよいんだってな\cここでは　みんな
だれが　いちばん　つよい　トレーナーかはなしを　してるんだけど\cおれ　きみの　うわさを　きいて
きみの　ファンに　なることに　したよ！\cこれからも　つよい　トレーナーと
バンバン　たたかって\cおれたちに　あつい
たたかいを　みせてくれよ！\cそうすれば　きっと　みんなも
きみの　ことを　みなおすと　おもうんだ\cじゃあ　きたい　してるよ！
[PLAYER]！！
records.english:
I've heard the news!
You're really strong, aren't you?\cWe always argue about who is the
strongest of all TRAINERS here.\cSo when I heard about you, I decided
to be your fan!\cI hope you'll keep on battling other
tough TRAINERS.\cThat way, we'll be able to see more
of your hot, hot battles.\cThat will make the others here see
exactly how great you are.\cRemember, I'm cheering for you,
[PLAYER]!

records.japanese: おう　[PLAYER]！！\nおうえん　してるぞ！！
records.english: Yo, [PLAYER]!\nYou're the one we want to win!

records.japanese: あいつらは　しらないんだ\nきみが　いちばん　すごいって　ことをさ！\cそうだろ　[PLAYER]！\nこんじょう　みせてくれ！
records.english: The others, they don't know that\nyou're the best of the best!\cIsn't that right, [PLAYER]?\nShow them you've got guts!

records.japanese: きみには　わるいけど　いま　いちばん\nちゅうもくの　トレーナーは\rまちがいなく　[STR_VAR_1]　だね！\cあの　つよさは\nだたものじゃ　ないよ
records.english: I hate to say this, but the TRAINER\neverybody's talking about is\r[STR_VAR_1], no question about it!\cThat TRAINER's power...\nIt's out of the ordinary.

records.japanese: くそー　いまは　[STR_VAR_1]が\nいちばん　つよいって　いってるのに\cだれも　きいて　くれない‥‥
records.english: Darn it... I've been telling people\nthat [STR_VAR_1] is the best now...\cBut no one wants to listen...

records.japanese: さいきん　つぎつぎと　ジムリーダーを\nたおしている　っていう\cつよい　トレーナーが\nあらわれた　らしいんだ\cきみ　しらないかい？
records.english:
I've been hearing things about a
tough new TRAINER.\cThis TRAINER's supposed to be beating
GYM LEADERS, even.\cDo you know anything about this
new TRAINER?

records.japanese: あ！\n[PLAYER]！！\cがんばってね\nおうえん　してるから！
records.english: Oh!\n[PLAYER]!\cGo for it!\nI'm pulling for you!

records.japanese:
トウキさま‥‥\cあ！
ちがう　ちがう！\cわたしは　あくまで　あなたの
ファン　なんだからね！\cだから　あたしの　ために
がんばってよ！
records.english:
Sigh...
BRAWLY...\cOh, no! Wait!
That's not right! No, no, no!\cI'm your fan through and through!\cSo make me proud!
Go for it!

records.japanese: やっぱり　わたしは　トウキさま　しか\nすきに　なれない　のよねー
records.english: I can't help it, I can only get to\nlike BRAWLY...

records.japanese: だれも　トウキさまの\nみりょくを　わかって　くれないの‥‥\cいいわ！\cわたし　ひとりでも　トウキさまの　ことを\nおうえん　しつづけるから！
records.english: Nobody understands the charm of\nBRAWLY...\cI don't care!\cEven if I'm the only one, I'm going\nto keep cheering for BRAWLY!

records.japanese: わたしの　いちばん　すきな\nトレーナーは　なんと　いっても\cムロの　ジムリーダー\nトウキさまよ！
records.english: Whatever anyone says, my favorite\nTRAINER is DEWFORD's GYM LEADER\rBRAWLY!

records.japanese: きみは　ついに　あらゆる　めんで\nきみの　おとうさんを　こえたな！\cこの　わしが　いって　いるんだから\nまちがいない！
records.english: You've surpassed your own father in\nevery regard!\cI'm telling you, so there's no question\nabout it at all!

records.japanese: きみの　おとうさんは　ピンチに　なっても\nあきらめずに　たたかって　いたよ‥‥\cわしは　しっているよ\cきみは　いくら　まけても　けっして\nあきらめない　という　ことを！\rだから　がんばってくれ！
records.english: Even when things turned bleak, your\nfather never gave up.\cThis I know to be true.\cYou never give up even if you lose!\nSo keep on battling!

records.japanese:
きみより　センリさんの　ほうが
もっと　つよくて　かっこよくみごたえの　ある　たたかいを　していたぞ！\cいくら　きみが　つよいと
いわれて　いても\cきみの　おとうさんに　くらべたら
まだまだ　だな
records.english:
NORMAN battled with more power,
charisma, and showmanship than you.\cEven though people may say that
you're strong...\cYou've still got a long way to go
compared to your father.

records.japanese:
きみも　センリさんと　おなじ　ふんいき
というか　はくりょくが　でてきたね\cしかし　センリさん　とは　けっていてきに
ちがう　ものが　ある！\c‥‥それは　わたしからは　いえない
じぶんで　さがして　みるんだな
records.english:
You're beginning to get the same
air of awe NORMAN exudes.\cBut there's something conclusively
different between you and NORMAN.\cI can't tell you what that is.
You'll have to find it yourself.

records.japanese:
ここにいる　みんなは
ポケモンしょうぶが　だいすきでね\cだれが　いちばん　つよい　トレーナーか
はなしを　して　いるんだ！\cきみも　ゆうめいに　なれば
みんな　ファンに　なるかもな！
records.english:
Everyone here, we're all huge fans
of POKéMON battles.\cWe discuss who we consider to be
the strongest of all TRAINERS.\cIf you were to become famous, we
might even become your fans!

records.japanese: うわー！　[PLAYER]だー\nほんもの　だー\cあくしゅ　してー\nあくしゅ！
records.english: Oh, woweee! It's [PLAYER]!\nFor real, too!\cPlease, shake my hand, shake my hand!

records.japanese:
‥‥わたし　いつまでも　[PLAYER]の　こと
おうえん　する　からね！\cわたし　もう　[PLAYER]の　まける
とこなんて　みたくないよ\c[PLAYER]　ほんとは
つよいんだ　もんね！
records.english:
I'll always cheer for you, [PLAYER]!
Always, always!\cI don't want to see you lose ever,
[PLAYER].\cBecause I know you're really, really
strong, [PLAYER]!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さん　って　かっこいい‥‥\cねえ　みんなも\nそう　おもうでしょー？
records.english: [STR_VAR_1] is really cool...\cEveryone thinks so, right, right?

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さん　って　ほんとうに\nかっこいい　よねぇ‥‥\cわたし　ひとりに　なっても\nずうっと　おうえん　するんだー！
records.english: [STR_VAR_1] really is cool, don't\nyou think so?\cEven if it's just me, I'm going to keep\ncheering my favorite TRAINER.

records.japanese: わたしのね\nすきな　トレーナーは\cかっこよくて\cつよくて\cそれでいて　やさしい\cそんな　トレーナーが　いいなぁ‥‥
records.english: My favorite TRAINER is...\cCool...\cStrong...\cAnd really nice...\cI wish there was a TRAINER like that...

records.japanese: あ！　[PLAYER]だー！\nすげー！\cぼくも　おおきく　なったら\n[PLAYER]　みたいに　つよく　なりたいよ！
records.english: Whoa! It's [PLAYER]!\nWicked!\cWhen I grow up, I want to be strong\nlike you, [PLAYER]!

records.japanese:
‥‥
ぼく　ひとりに　なったって\cずっと　[PLAYER]の　ことを
おうえん　するよ！\cだって　[PLAYER]の　こと
しんじてるもん！
records.english: Even if I'm the only one...\cYou'll always be the only one I\ncheer for, [PLAYER]!\cBecause I believe in you, [PLAYER]!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]って　かっこいいよねー\nぼく　あくしゅ　してほしいなー
records.english: [STR_VAR_1] is so wickedly cool...\nI want to shake hands with my hero.

records.japanese:
‥‥
ぼく　ひとりに　なったって\cぜったい　[STR_VAR_1]の　ファンを
やめない　からね！\cだって　ぼく　きいたんだもん
[STR_VAR_1]は　ぜったいに　まけないって
records.english: Even if I'm the only one...\cI'm never going to stop being\n[STR_VAR_1]'s fan!\cBecause I've heard, [STR_VAR_1]\nnever loses!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]！\nやっぱり　すごいよ　きみは！\cぼくは　きみを　はじめて　みたときから\nすごい　やつだって　おもってたよ！\rやはり　ぼくのめは　たしかな　ようだね！
records.english: [PLAYER]!\nYou are amazing after all!\cEver since I set eyes on you, I knew\nthat you were great.\cIt looks like my eyes didn't deceive me.

records.japanese: まあ　ほかの　やつの\nことなんて　きにするなよ\rぼくが　ついて　いるんだ！\cきみは　しんぱい　しないで　いつもどおり\nたたかって　いれば　いいんだよ
records.english: Who cares about the others.\nI'm in your corner!\cYou don't need to worry. Just get\nout there and battle like always.

records.japanese:
きみも　なかなか
いい　トレーナーだと　おもうけど\cいまは　やっぱり　[STR_VAR_1]が
いちばんだと　おもうんだ\cまあ　ぼくが　おもっている　だけだから
あまり　きにしなくて　いいよ
records.english:
You're a pretty decent TRAINER,
I think.\cBut I also think that [STR_VAR_1]
is number one right now.\cThat's just my opinion.
Don't worry about it too much.

records.japanese:
きみは　ほんとうに　つよいな‥‥
[STR_VAR_1]　より　つよいかも　しれない\cでも　[STR_VAR_1]　には
ぼくが　ひつよう　なんだ\cだって　ぼくが　[STR_VAR_1]を
おうえん　しなきゃだれが　おうえん　するんだ！
records.english: Wow, you really are strong.\nMaybe even stronger than [STR_VAR_1].\cBut [STR_VAR_1] needs me.\cIf I don't cheer for [STR_VAR_1],\nwho will?

records.japanese: みなおしたわ！\nあなたって　ほんとうに　つよいのね！\cどうしたら　そんなに　つよく　なれるのか\nおしえて　もらいたいわ
records.english: You've changed my mind!\nYou are strong, aren't you?\cI'd like you to tell me how you managed\nto get so strong!

records.japanese: あなたって　ピンチに　なれば　なるほど\nみりょくてきな　たたかいを　するのよね\rつぎの　たいせんが　たのしみだわ！
records.english: The tougher the situation, the more\nattractively you battle.\cI can't wait for your next battle!

records.japanese: さいきんの　トレーナーは\nやっぱり　[STR_VAR_1]よね！\rあの　つよさは　ただもの　じゃないわ\cあなたも　いいせん　いってるけど\n[STR_VAR_1]に　くらべたら　まだまだねー
records.english: Among the recently hot TRAINERS,\n[STR_VAR_1] is the standout.\cThat toughness, it's simply not normal.\cYou're doing okay, but you're not in\nthe same class as [STR_VAR_1].

records.japanese:
あなたって　ほんとうに
にんき　ものよね‥‥\cつよいし　ポケモンにも　やさしいし
いうこと　ないわ\cでもね！　わたしは
[STR_VAR_1]を　しんじているの！\c[STR_VAR_1]の　ほうが　ぜったいに
つよいに　きまってるん　だから！
records.english: You are really popular...\cYou're strong, and you're caring to\nPOKéMON. No one can knock you.\cBut, you know, I believe in [STR_VAR_1].\c[STR_VAR_1] is definitely stronger!\nI'm positive!

records.japanese: おぬし‥‥\cやるな！
おぬしの　しんの　ちからは\nこの　わしだけが　しっていれば　よいのじゃ\cみなには　その　ひめられた　ちから\nわかるまい‥‥
records.english: Your true worth, it is fine if only\nI recognized it.\cThe others I doubt will understand\nthe hidden power that beats within.

records.japanese: うむ　おぬし　なかなかの\nめを　しておるな\cじゃが！\c‥‥うーむ\nまだまだの　ようじゃな
records.english: Yes, I see strength in your eyes.\cBut!\cYou still haven't realized your\npotential.

records.japanese:
たしかに　おぬしは
とてつもなく　つよいかも　しれない\cじゃが！
わしには　わかる\cその　つよさは　まだ
しんの　つよさとは　いわないのじゃ！しんの　つよさとは！\c‥‥\cじつは　わしも
よく　わからんのじゃ
records.english:
It is true that you are tremendously
powerful.\cBut!
I can tell...\cThat strength cannot be considered
true strength yet!\cTrue strength is...!
... ...\cActually, I have no idea, either.

records.japanese: えっ？　ふね　ですか？\cもうしわけ　ございません　げんざい\nれんらくせんは　ないんです‥‥
records.english: I beg your pardon?\nYou're looking for a ship?\cI'm sorry, the ferry service isn't\navailable at present...

records.japanese: れんらくせんを　ごりよう　ですね！\nチケットは　おもち　でしょうか？
records.english: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nチケットを　もっていない！\c‥‥もうしわけ　ありません！\cふねに　のれるのは\nチケットの　ある　かた　だけです
records.english: [PLAYER] doesn't have the TICKET...\cI'm terribly sorry.\cYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nふねのチケットを　みせた！\cはい！　けっこう　です！\cいきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
records.english: [PLAYER] flashed the TICKET.\cPerfect! That's all you need!\cAnd where would you like to go?

records.japanese: また　ごりよう　ください！
records.english: Please sail with us another time!

records.japanese: カイナ　ですね！
バトルタワー　ですね！
れんらくせんに　のって　おまちください
records.english: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

records.japanese: いきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
records.english: Then, where would you like to go?

records.japanese: れんらくせんが　かんせい　しないと\nふなのり　というものは　ヒマだぜ‥‥\cカイナの　ぞうせんじょの　れんちゅう\nしゃかりきに　がんばって　くれよな
records.english: Until they finish making the ferry, we\nsailors have nothing to do...\cI wish they'd get a move on, the folks\nat the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT.

records.japanese: やっと　れんらくせん　タイドリップごうが\nうんこう　するように　なったんだ！\cカイナの　ぞうせんじょの　みんな\nたいへん　だったろうな\rこれからは　おれが　いそがしくなるぞ！
records.english: The ferry S.S. TIDAL is finally in\noperation.\cThe folks at the SHIPYARD in SLATEPORT\nmust've worked extra hard.\cWell, it's my turn to get busy now!

records.japanese: えーと‥‥\nそうじゃ　わし　わすれじいさん\cポケモンの　わざを\nわすれさせる　ことが　できるんじゃ！\cわざを　わすれ　させるかね？
records.english: Uh...\nOh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.\cI can make POKéMON forget their moves.\cWould you like me to do that?

records.japanese: どの　ポケモンに　するんじゃ？
records.english: Which POKéMON should forget a move?

records.japanese: どの　わざを\nわすれ　させるんじゃ？
[STR_VAR_1]は　わざを　１つしか\nもってない　ようじゃ‥‥
むむ！　\n[STR_VAR_1]の　[STR_VAR_2]じゃな？
だいせいこう　じゃ！\c[STR_VAR_1]は　[STR_VAR_2]を\nわすれた　ようじゃ！
records.english: It worked to perfection!\c[STR_VAR_1] has forgotten\n[STR_VAR_2] completely.

records.japanese: わすれさせたい　わざが　あったら\nまた　くるのじゃぞ！
records.english: Come again if there are other moves\nto be forgotten.

records.japanese: なぬ！？　タマゴは\nわざを　おぼえていない　ようじゃが‥‥？
records.english: What?\nNo EGG should know any moves.

records.japanese: ポケモンは　にんげんの　パートナーであって\nけっして　にんげんの　どうぐ　じゃないよ\cそこを　かんちがい　しておる\nにんげんも　たまに　いるんだよ‥‥
records.english: POKéMON are partners to people.\nThey aren't our tools.\cUnfortunately, there are some people\nwho fail to understand that...

records.japanese: カクレオン『るろろ‥‥？
むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cぼく　ねぼけて　いるから\nこれを　あげる‥‥
records.english: Huh? What? What's that?\cI'm not near awake yet...\nYou can have this...

records.japanese: むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cねる　こは　そだつ‥‥\nねむって　たいりょく　かいふく‥‥
records.english: Yawn...\cSleep is essential for good health...\nSleep and regain health...

records.japanese:
あら　あら　あら！　あなた　わかいのに
ひとりたび？　えらいわねえー！うちのこ　たちにも　みならわせたいわあ\cおばさんは　ポロックめいじん！
ちょいと　ほんきを　だせばすごく　いい　ポロックを　つくれるのよー！\cポロックめいじんの　おばさんが
いろいろと　おしえてあげようか？
records.english:
Oh, my, my! Are you traveling alone?
But you're so young! Good for you!\cI'm sure my kids could learn a thing
or two from you!\cMe? I'm a master of [POKEBLOCK]S.\cIf I get serious just a little, why, I
can concoct great [POKEBLOCK]S.\cWould you like to learn from me, a
master of [POKEBLOCK]S?

records.japanese: あらあ　そう？\nなんでも　じぶん　ひとりだけで\rがんばろうと　しちゃ　ダメよー！
records.english: Oh? Are you sure?\cYou shouldn't always try to do\neverything by yourself, dear!

records.japanese:
あらあ　すなおな　いいコねえー！
じゃ　ちょっとながいけど　ききなさいよ\cいい？\cポロックには　なめらかさって　もんが　あるの
ポロックを　みれば　わかるでしょ？なめらかさは　かずが　すくないほど　いいの！ここ　まちがっちゃ　ダメよ！\cなめらかさの　すうじが　ひくくて
レベルが　たかいのが　いい　ポロック！いい　ポロックは　たくさんポケモンが　たべて　くれるんだから！\cそれと　いい？\cなめらかな　ポロックが　つくりたかったら
けちらないで　いろんな　しゅるいのきのみで　つくってみるのよ！まぜた　きのみによって　なめらかさがちがって　くるんだから！\cそれと　いい？\cなるべく　おおぜいで　つくったほうが
なめらかな　ポロックが　できるのよ！だれでも　いいから　おねがいしていっしょに　つくって　もらいなさいよ！\cさてと　このくらい　おぼえて　おけば
あなたも　いちにんまえに　なれるわよ！\cだいすきな　ポケモンと　なめらか　ポロック
そして　なかよし　かぞくが　いればこのよは　しあわせ！あなたも　がんばりなさいな！
records.english:
Oh, good! You're a smart soul!
This is a bit long, so listen up!\cAre you ready?\cIf you look at [POKEBLOCK]S, you should see
that they are rated on how they feel.\cThe lower the feel rating,
the better it is. Don't forget this!\cA good [POKEBLOCK] has a low feel
rating and a high level.\cA POKéMON can eat more good
[POKEBLOCK]S than ordinary ones, too.\cAnd this is important.\cIf you want to make smooth [POKEBLOCK]S,
use different kinds of BERRIES.\cDon't be stingy - the kinds of BERRIES
affect the smoothness of [POKEBLOCK]S.\cAnd another thing.\cThe more people blending BERRIES, the
smoother the [POKEBLOCK]S.\cThat's why you should talk to other
people and make [POKEBLOCK]S together.\cThat's about all you need to know to
make good [POKEBLOCK]S.\cIf everyone had POKéMON they love,
smooth [POKEBLOCK]S, and a loving family,the world would be a happier place.\cDon't give up, dear!

records.japanese: よつごが　うまれた　ときは\nすごく　ビックリ　したが\rみんなで　なかよく　あそんでいる　すがたを\rみていると　しあわせ　きぶんに　なるよ！
records.english: When my wife gave birth to quadruplets,\nyou bet I was shocked.\cBut, now, seeing them play together,\nit makes me happy.

records.japanese: マルチバトル　してるけど\nぼくが　かつに　きまってるぜ！
records.english: We're having MULTI BATTLES, but I know\nI'm going to win.

records.japanese: レコードコーナーで　まぜまくる！\nって　なにが　まざってるんだ？
records.english: We like mixing stuff at the RECORD\nCORNER.\cBut what gets mixed up?

records.japanese: きのみブレンダーで\nとびっきりの　ポロック　つくっちゃうぜ！
records.english: We're going to make super [POKEBLOCK]S\nwith a BERRY BLENDER!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　たくましさ　じまん　したいから\nみんなで　コンテスト　してるんだ！
records.english: I want to brag about how tough my\nPOKéMON is, so we're going to enter a\rCONTEST together.

records.japanese: この　ほしの　さいだいの　なぞ\nそれは　かいていに　あると　おもうんだ！\c‥‥というのは\nだれかが　いってた　ことなんだけど
records.english: This planet's biggest mysteries are\nat the bottom of the sea.\cSomebody said that, but I don't know...

records.japanese: そういや　トクサネと　ルネの　あいだには\nふかい　ふかい　かいこうが　ある\c‥‥そんな　はなしも\nだれかが　いってた　ことなんだけど
records.english: There's a deep underwater trench\nbetween MOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\cThat's what someone told me, anyway.

records.japanese: いらっしゃいませ！\nミナモ　デパート　です
デパートに　くると　たのしくなって\nいろんな　ものを　かっちゃうのよ
records.english: Whenever I come to the DEPARTMENT\nSTORE, I always end up buying all sorts\rof things because it's so fun.

records.japanese: きょうは　すてきな　かぐを\nおかあさんに　かって　もらうの
records.english: Today, my mom is going to buy me some\nnice furniture.

records.japanese: コンテストで　ゆうしょうした　ごほうびに\nマリルリに　なにか　かって　あげるんだよ！
records.english: I'm buying something for my AZUMARILL\nas a reward for winning a CONTEST.

records.japanese: マリルリ『まりりるぅー！
１かい　‥‥　サービス　カウンター\n　　　　　　　ちゅうせん　かいじょう\c２かい　‥‥　トレーナーズ　ゾーン\c３かい　‥‥　バトル　コレクション\c４かい　‥‥　わざマシン　コーナー\c５かい　‥‥　ぬいぐるみ　フロアー\cおくじょう　‥‥　いこいの　ひろば
records.english: 1F: SERVICE COUNTER\n    LOTTERY CORNER\c2F: TRAINER'S ZONE\c3F: BATTLE COLLECTION\c4F: TM CORNER\c5F: POKé DOLL FLOOR\cROOFTOP: ROOFTOP PLAZA

records.japanese: どうぐの　きほんは　うまく　つかいこなすこと\nこれ　いちばん　だいじ　なのヨ
records.english: Learn to use items properly.\nThat's basic, really.

records.japanese: いえで　まってる　ダンナの\nおみやげ　なんだけど　どれが　いいかしら？
records.english: My husband is waiting at home.\nWhat would make a good gift for him?

records.japanese: これから　とおい　ところへ\nたびに　いくからな\rここで　どっさり　どうぐを　かっておくのさ
records.english: I'm leaving on a long journey soon.\nI need to stock up on items.

records.japanese: たびの　おともに\n２かい　‥‥　トレーナーズ　ゾーン
records.english: FOR YOUR TRAVELING COMPANIONS\n2F: TRAINER'S ZONE

records.japanese: てっとりばやく　ポケモンを　つよくするなら\nどうぐを　あたえるのが　いちばん！\cタウリンなら　こうげきりょく　アップ！\nリゾチウムなら　とくこう　アップ　だぜ！
records.english: For quickly toughening up POKéMON,\nitems are the best.\cPROTEIN boosts ATTACK, and CALCIUM\nraises SP. ATK.

records.japanese: じょうぶな　ポケモンに\nなって　ほしいからね\cブロムヘキシンで　ぼうぎょりょくを　あげるか\nキトサンで　とくぼうを　あげるか\rいま　かんがえている　ところ　なんだ
records.english: I want my POKéMON to have more\nendurance.\cI'm trying to decide whether to raise\nDEFENSE with IRON, or SP. DEF with ZINC.

records.japanese: ポケモンにね\nインドメタシンを　あげたら\rすばやさが　あがったの！
records.english: I gave a CARBOS to my POKéMON and its\nSPEED went up.

records.japanese: まけない　トレーナーの　ひつじゅひん\n３かい　‥‥　バトル　コレクション
records.english: ESSENTIALS FOR UNBEATABLE TRAINERS\n3F: BATTLE COLLECTION

records.japanese: うむむ‥‥\cこうげきの　わざ　か‥‥\nまもりの　わざ　か‥‥\cどの　わざマシンを\nポケモンに　おぼえさせるか　なやむ‥‥
records.english: Hmm...\cAn attacking move...\nOr a defensive move...\cIt's no easy matter to decide which TM\nmoves should be taught to POKéMON...

records.japanese: わざマシンって　たくさん　あるのね！\cなにかの　カタログには\nぜんぶで　５０しゅるい　って\rかいて　あったわ
records.english: There are so many different kinds of\nTM moves.\cA catalog I read said there are fifty\ndifferent kinds.

records.japanese: わざマシン　ぜんぶ　ほしいけど\nポケモン　４つしか　わざ　おぼえないもんな
records.english: I'd like to get all the different TMs,\nbut a POKéMON learns only four moves.

records.japanese: ポケモンリーグ　への　ちかみち\n４かい　‥‥　わざマシン　コーナー
records.english: A SHORTCUT TO POKéMON LEAGUE\n4F: TM CORNER

records.japanese: すてきな　ぬいぐるみが　いっぱい　なのねー\nこどものぶん　だけじゃ　なくて\rあたしのぶんも　かおうかしら　オホホホホ！
records.english: This place is full of cute DOLLS.\cI should buy some for me, instead of\njust for my children.

records.japanese: あたし　まだ　ポケモン　そだてられないから\nかわいい　ぬいぐるみ　かってもらうの
records.english: I'm not big enough to raise POKéMON,\nso I'm getting a cute DOLL instead.

records.japanese: かわいい　マットが　たくさん　うってるの！\nどれを　かおうかな‥‥\rぜーんぶ　かっちゃおうかな‥‥
records.english: They sell many cute MATS here.\cI wonder which one I should get?\nMaybe I'll buy them all...

records.japanese: かわいい　ともだち\n５かい　‥‥　ぬいぐるみ　フロアー
ほりだしものいち‥‥\nいつ　やるのか　きまって　ないのかな？\cテレビ　みてても\nぜんぜん　コマーシャル　ないんだよね
records.english: Don't they have set dates for their\nclear-out sales?\cI watch TV, but they never show any\ncommercials.

records.japanese: まちに　まった　ほりだしものいち！\nここでしか　かえないもの　ばかり！\rよーし　たくさん　かっちゃうぞお！
records.english: Yes! I've been waiting a long time for\nthis clear-out sale.\cThey have items that you can only get\nhere. I'm going to load up, that I am!

records.japanese: ああ　のどが　かわいたなあ
じどう　はんばいき　がある！\nほしい　のみもの　は‥‥
records.english: It's a VENDING MACHINE.\nWhich drink would you like?

records.japanese: ガゴン！\c[STR_VAR_1]が　でてきた！
ガゴン！\cあたりだ！　もういっぽん\n[STR_VAR_1]が　でてきた！
records.english: Clang!\cScore! An extra can of [STR_VAR_1]\ndropped down!

records.japanese: おかねが　たりない！
‥‥　‥‥　やっぱり　やめた！

げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cこのジムの　ジムリーダーは
エスパータイプの　ポケモンつかい！\cかくとうタイプや　どくタイプの
ポケモンで　いどむとものすごい　ダメージを　くらうぞ！\cしかも　ばつぐんの
コンビネーションで　せめてくる！\cだから　きみも　かつために　ポケモンとの
きずなを　きばって　みせて　やれ！
records.english:
Yo, how's it going, CHAMPION-bound
[PLAYER]?\cThe GYM LEADERS here use PSYCHIC-type
POKéMON.\cIf you go up against them with
FIGHTING- or POISON-type POKéMON,they'll inflict horrible damage!\cPlus, they'll come at you with
outstanding combination attacks.\cIf you want to win, you'll need to show
them how tight you are with yourPOKéMON. Go for it!

records.japanese: こりゃあ　たまげた！！\nきみは　すごか　トレーナーだ！
records.english: Wow, you're astounding!\nYou're one great TRAINER!

records.japanese: しょうぶは　こころの　つよさで　きまる\nこころ　よわき　ものは　かてない！
records.english: Battles hinge on the strength of your\nspirit! The weak-spirited will never win!

records.japanese: まけたか！\nオレも　きたえ　なおさねばっ！
records.english: I lost! I must temper my spirit again!

records.japanese: まよった　ほうが　まける\nオレからの　ちゅうこくだ！
records.english: The indecisive lose.\nThat's my warning to you.

records.japanese: キミの　さいのうを　みせて　もらおうか！
すばらしい　さいのうの　もちぬしだ！
よのなかに　てんさいが　いるならば\nここの　ジムリーダーが　そうだ‥‥\cだが　もしかすると　キミの　ほうが\nさいのうは　うえかも　しれない‥‥
records.english: If there are prodigies in the world,\nthen our GYM LEADERS are them!\cHowever, you may be even more talented\nthan them...

records.japanese: ふふふ‥‥\nねんりきで　モンスターボールを\rくうちゅうに　うかせて　みせよう‥‥\cうおおぉぉぉぉぉ‥‥！\n‥‥　‥‥\r‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\rちょうしの　わるい　ときも　ある‥‥
records.english: Fufufufu... Watch me levitate a POKé\nBALL telekinetically!\cWrooooooooaaaar!\n... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cSometimes, I'm out of sync...

records.japanese: ポケモン　しょうぶも\nちょうし　わりーっ！
records.english: My POKéMON battling skills are out\nof sync, too!

records.japanese: モンスターボールは　おおきすぎた\nこの　わたぼこり　なら　ぜったいに‥‥\cふううううううっ‥‥！\n‥‥　‥‥\rちがうぞ！\rはないきで　とばして　なんか　いないぞ！
records.english:
A POKé BALL was too heavy to lift
psychically. But this dust bunny...\cWhoooooooooooooooh!
... ... ... ... ... ...\cNo, I'm not cheating!
I didn't blow on it! Honestly!

records.japanese: あなたが　アタシに　まけた　としても\nおちこまない　ことね！\cあなたが　よわい　わけじゃ　なくて\nアタシが　つよすぎる　からよ！
records.english: When you lose to me, don't be too hard\non yourself.\cIt's not that you're weak - I'm just\ntoo strong!

records.japanese: あなたは　さらに　つよすぎた！
まけたから　って　クヨクヨ　しないわ\nもっと　しゅぎょう　すれば　いいんだもの！\cまえむきな　ところが　アタシの　とりえ！
records.english: I'm not going to get down on myself for\nlosing. I just need to train harder.\cPositive thinking - that's my strong\npoint!

records.japanese: みえる‥‥\nあなたの　みらいが　みえる‥‥\cわたくしに　かてたら\nあなたの　みらいを　おしえて　あげる！
records.english: I see it...\nI see your future...\cIf you can beat me, I will tell you\nyour future!

records.japanese: まいりました‥‥！
あなたと　ジムリーダーさまの　しょうぶ‥‥\nものすごく　はげしい　てんかい‥‥\cけっかは‥‥\nわたくしの　くちからは　いえない‥‥！
records.english: You will wage a terrifically intense\nbattle with our GYM LEADERS...\cThe result...\nYou won't hear it from me!

records.japanese: あなたが　これまで　あゆんできた　みちのり\nあなたが　けいけん　してきた　ことがら\cすべてを　ぶつけて　きなさい！
records.english: The roads you have traveled...\nWhat you have experienced...\cCome at me with everything you've\nlearned!

records.japanese: すばらしい　みちのり　だわ‥‥！
records.english: You've traveled a path of greatness!

records.japanese: がんばった　ものには　あかるい　みらいが\nなまけた　ものには　ぜつぼうの　あしたが\cいんがおうほう‥‥\nすべては　じぶんに　はねかえる　ものよ‥‥
records.english: A bright future awaits those who have\nworked diligently.\cFor those who lazed idly, there is\nonly despair at the end.\cWhat goes around comes around...

records.japanese:
フウ『へへへ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cラン『ふふふ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cフウ『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？
ラン『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？\cフウ『ぼくたち　ふたご！
ラン『あたしたち　ふたご！\cフウ『なにも　ことばに　しなくても
ラン『おたがいの　かんがえて　いることが\cフウ『あたまの　なかに　うかぶから
ラン『つうじあうことが　できるのヨ！\cフウ『そんな　ぼくたちの　コンビネーション
ラン『きみに　やぶることが　できる？
records.english:
TATE: Hehehe... Were you surprised?\cLIZA: Fufufu... Were you surprised?\cTATE: That there are two GYM LEADERS?
LIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\cTATE: We're twins!
LIZA: We're twins!\cTATE: We don't need to talk because...
LIZA: We can each determine what...\cTATE: The other is thinking...
LIZA: All in our minds!\cTATE: This combination of ours...
LIZA: Can you beat it?

records.japanese: フウ『ぼっ　ぼくたちの\nラン『コンビネーションが‥‥！\cフウ『やぶれた　からには　しかたない\nラン『まけを　みとめて　これを　あげるヨ！
records.english: TATE: What?! Our combination...\nLIZA: Was shattered!\cTATE: It can't be helped. You've won...\nLIZA: So, in recognition, take this.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　フウと　ランから\nマインドバッジを　もらった！
records.english: [PLAYER] received the MIND BADGE\nfrom LIZA and TATE.

records.japanese: フウ『マインドバッジには　ポケモンの\nとくこうと　とくぼうを　たかめる\rこうかが　ひめられている！\cラン『それから　ダイビング　という\nひでんわざも　つかえるように　なるヨ！\cフウ『あと　これも　もっていきなよ！
records.english: TATE: The MIND BADGE enhances the\nSP. ATK and SP. DEF of POKéMON.\cLIZA: It also lets you use the HM move\nDIVE outside of battle.\cTATE: You should also take this, too.

records.japanese:
フウ『その　わざマシン０４には
ラン『めいそうが　はいってるヨ！\cフウ『ポケモンの　とくこうと
ラン『ポケモンの　とくぼうを\cフウ『たかめてくれる　わざ　なんだ！
ラン『エスパーポケモンに　ぴったりだヨ！
records.english:
TATE: That TM04 contains...
LIZA: CALM MIND!\cTATE: It raises SP. ATK and...
LIZA: It raises SP. DEF!\cTATE: It's a move that's perfect...
LIZA: For PSYCHIC POKéMON!

records.japanese: フウ『きょうだいの　きずな　より\nきみと　ポケモンとの　きずなの　ほうが\rはるかに　つよかった　みたいだね‥‥\cラン『あなたなら　もっと　つよくなれる！\nたたかった　あたしたちには　わかるわ！
records.english: TATE: Looks like the bond between you\nand your POKéMON is far stronger than\rthe bond that we share as twins.\cLIZA: You will become even stronger!\nWe've battled you, so we know.

records.japanese: フウ『へへへ‥‥　ジムリーダーが\cラン『ふたりも　いるんで　おどろいた？\cフウ『あら？　たたかえる　ポケモンが\nラン『いっぴき　しか　いないヨ！\cフウ『それでは　たたかえないね！\nラン『しょうぶを　たのしみたいから\rもっと　ポケモン　つれてきてヨ！
records.english: TATE: Hehehe... Were you surprised?\cLIZA: That there are two GYM LEADERS?\cTATE: Oops, you have only one...\nLIZA: POKéMON that can battle.\cTATE: We can't battle that way!\cLIZA: If you want to challenge us,\nbring some more POKéMON.

records.japanese: トクサネシティ　ポケモンジム
トクサネシティ　ポケモンジム\cフウ　ラン　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
records.english: MOSSDEEP CITY POKéMON GYM\cLIZA AND TATE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

records.japanese: ムムムッ！\nきみの　[STR_VAR_1]‥‥
[STR_VAR_1]　が　すきだろう！\cいや　まちがいなく\n[STR_VAR_1]　が　すきだ！
records.english: It likes [STR_VAR_1]S,\ndoesn't it?\cNo, I'm positive of it! It definitely\nlikes [STR_VAR_1]S!

records.japanese: ポロックの　すききらいは　ないみたいだな
records.english: It doesn't appear to like or dislike\nany [POKEBLOCK]S.

records.japanese: だんなったら　みただけで\nポケモンが　すきな　ポロック　わかるのよ
records.english: My husband can tell what kind of\n[POKEBLOCK]S a POKéMON likes at a glance.

records.japanese: おれの　いもうとは　ヒワマキの\nボーイフレンドと　ぶんつう　してる\cちっとも　うらやましく　ないぞ！
records.english: My little sister exchanges MAIL with\nher boyfriend in FORTREE.\cI don't envy her one bit at all.

records.japanese: ヒワマキの　おともだちに　あえなくても\nポケモンが　おてがみを　はこんでくれるの\rはなれていても　さみしくないわ！
records.english: Even though I can't see my friend in\nFORTREE, my POKéMON carries MAIL back\rand forth for us.\cI'm not lonesome, even though we're\napart.

records.japanese: キャモメ『ぴひょー！
この　まちの　ジムリーダー\nなんといっても　あの　コンビネーションは\rさいこう！　さすが！　って　かんじよ
records.english: The GYM LEADERS in this town are a\nformidable duo.\cTheir combination attacks are, like,\nexcellent and wow!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　とくせいに　よっては\nわざの　いりょくが　かわったり\rまったく　きかなかったり　するよ！
records.english: Depending on the special abilities of\nPOKéMON, some moves might change\ror not work at all.

records.japanese: つうしん　たいせんで　かちまくって\nみんなに　あたしの　みりょくを\rアピールしたら　ファンが　ふえちゃうかな！
records.english: If I win a whole lot of link battles\nand show everyone how good I am,\rI might get a fan following!

records.japanese: げんきのかけら　って　すごい！\cこれを　あたえると\nひんしの　ポケモンも　めざめるの！\cでも　パワーポイントは\nかいふく　しないから　きをつけて！
records.english: REVIVE is fantastic!\cGive it to a fainted POKéMON, and the\nPOKéMON will arise.\cBut be careful, REVIVE doesn't restore\nthe used-up PP of moves.

records.japanese: ゴールドスプレーは\nよわい　ポケモンを　よせつけない\cかずある　スプレーの　なかで\nいちばん　ながもち　するんだ！
records.english: MAX REPEL keeps all weak POKéMON away.\cOut of all the REPEL sprays, it lasts\nthe longest.

records.japanese:
ネットボールと　ダイブボールは
ここ　トクサネでしか　つくっていないめずらしい　モンスターボール！\cネットボールは　むしタイプや
みずタイプの　ポケモンに　こうかてき！\cダイブボールは　かいていに　いる
ポケモンを　つかまえ　やすいんだ！
records.english:
The NET and DIVE BALLS are rare POKé
BALLS that are only made in MOSSDEEP.\cA NET BALL is effective against
BUG-type and WATER-type POKéMON.\cA DIVE BALL works best on POKéMON at
the bottom of the sea.

records.japanese: おーい！　トレーナーよお！\nすごいつりざおは　ほんとうに　すごいぞお\cなんたって　かいていに　いる\nポケモンも　つりあげられる　からのお！\cどお？　ほしく　なった？
records.english:
Hey there, TRAINER!
A SUPER ROD really is super!\cSay all you want, but this baby can
catch POKéMON off the seafloor!\cWhat do you think?
You want it, don't you?

records.japanese: そうだろ　そうだろ！　すごいつりざおは\nほんとうに　すごい　からのお！
records.english: You bet, you bet!\nAfter all, a SUPER ROD is really super!

records.japanese: みずの　ある　ところなら\nどこでも　つりざお　つかうと　いいぞお！
records.english: If there's any water, try dropping in\nyour ROD and see what bites!

records.japanese: あら？\nつりは　きらい　なのかね？
すごいつりざおで\nかいていの　ポケモンも　つりあげろお！
records.english: Go after the seafloor POKéMON with\nyour SUPER ROD.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]‥‥？\cそう‥‥　ここは　ボクの　いえ
なにも　ないから　はずかしいね\cそうだ
この　ひでんマシン　もっていきなよ\cダイビングが　はいって　いるけど
ボクは　もう　ポケモンに　おしえたから
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN]?\cYes, this is my place. It's a little\nembarrassing how empty it is here.\cOh, here, you should take this HM.\cIt contains DIVE.\nI've already taught my POKéMON.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『なみのりを　していると
みずの　いろが　こい　ばしょが　ある\cそこで　ダイビングを　つかうと
うみの　そこに　もぐれるから\cうかびたい　ときは
もういちど　ダイビングを　つかうんだ\cばしょに　よっては
うかべない　ばあいも　あるけど
records.english:
STEVEN: While you're using SURF, you
should notice dark patches of water.\cUse DIVE if you come to deep water
like it. You'll drop to the seafloor.\cWhen you want to come back up, use
DIVE again.\cIn some places, it won't be possible
for you to surface, though.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『この　トクサネと
ルネシティの　あいだ　にはかいていどうくつが　あるらしい\cクスノキかんちょうが　せんすいてい　で
はっけんした　という　アレだよ\cかいていどうくつ‥‥
めずらしい　いしが　みつかりそうだねちょっと　もぐって　こようかな
records.english:
STEVEN: Apparently, there's an
underwater cavern betweenMOSSDEEP and SOOTOPOLIS.\cYou know, the one that CAPT. STERN
found in his submarine.\cAn underwater cavern...\cThere might be some rare stones down
there... I should go for a DIVE...

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nモンスターボールを　しらべた！\cなかには　ポケモンの\nダンバルが　はいっている！\cモンスターボールを　もって　いきますか？
records.english: [PLAYER] checked the POKé BALL.\cIt contained the POKéMON\nBELDUM.\cTake the POKé BALL?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nダンバルを　てにいれた！
これいじょう　ポケモンを　もてない！
records.english: There is no space for another POKéMON.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　モンスターボールを\nそのままに　しておいた
records.english: [PLAYER] left the POKé BALL where\nit was.

records.japanese:
てがみが　ある！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]へ\cボクは　おもうことが　あって
しばらく　しゅぎょうを　つづけるとうぶん　いえに　かえらない\cそこで　おねがいだ\cつくえの　うえにある
モンスターボールを　うけとって　ほしい\cなかに　いるのは　ダンバルといって
ボクの　おきにいりの　ポケモンだから\cよろしく　たのむよ\cでは　また　いつか　あおう！
　　　　　　ツワブキ　ダイゴより
records.english:
It's a letter.\c... ... ... ... ... ...\cTo [PLAYER][KUN]...\cI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\cI don't plan to return home for some
time.\cI have a favor to ask of you.\cI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\cInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\cI'm counting on you.\cMay our paths cross some day.\cSTEVEN STONE

records.japanese:
てがみが　ある！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]へ\cボクは　おもうことが　あって
しばらく　しゅぎょうを　つづけるとうぶん　いえに　かえらない\cそこで　おねがいだ\cつくえの　うえにある
モンスターボールを　うけとって　ほしい\cなかに　いるのは　ダンバルといって
ボクの　おきにいりの　ポケモンだから\cよろしく　たのむよ\cよかったら　ひでんマシン
ダイビングも　もっていくと　いい\cでは　また　いつか　あおう！
　　　　　　ツワブキ　ダイゴより
records.english:
It's a letter.\c... ... ... ... ... ...\cTo [PLAYER][KUN]...\cI've decided to do a little soul-
searching and train on the road.\cI don't plan to return home for some
time.\cI have a favor to ask of you.\cI want you to take the POKé BALL on
the desk.\cInside it is a BELDUM, my favorite
POKéMON.\cI'm counting on you.\cIf you'd like, you should also take
the HM DIVE.\cMay our paths cross some day.\cSTEVEN STONE

records.japanese: ダイゴの　あつめた\nめずらしい　いしが　かざってある！
records.english: It's a collection of rare rocks and\nstones assembled by STEVEN.

records.japanese: おとうと　ったら\nひとの　ひみつきちを　さがすのが\rたのしみ　なんだって！
records.english: My little brother says he likes to go\nfind people's SECRET BASES.

records.japanese: おとうと　ったら\nともだちの　ひみつきちに　いって\rポケモンしょうぶを　するのが\rたのしみ　なんだって！
records.english: My little brother says he likes to\nvisit people's SECRET BASES and have\rPOKéMON battles.

records.japanese: ひょっとして　[STR_VAR_1]　に\nひみつきち　つくったの　きみ？
records.english: Was it you who made a SECRET BASE in\n[STR_VAR_1]?

records.japanese: きみ　どこかに　ひみつきち　つくりなよ！\nぼくが　さがしだして　みせるからさ
records.english: You should make a SECRET BASE\nsomewhere. I'll go find it!

records.japanese: エネコロロ『みゃあん？
もうすぐ　ロケットが　はっしゃ　するぞ！
ロケットが　はっしゃ　したよ！\nこれで　[STR_VAR_1]かい　うちあげ　せいこうだ！
records.english: The rocket launched safely!\nThat's successful launch no. [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese:
ロケットを　はっしゃ　するには
１パーセントの　ミスも　ゆるされない\c９９パーセント　だいじょうぶ　でも
１パーセント　ダメならすべてが　ダメになる　きびしい　ものだ\cそれでも　やりとげようと　するのは
そこに　ロマンが　つまっている　からだな
records.english:
A rocket launch demands perfection.
Not even a 1% margin of error is allowed.\cEven if it's 99% okay, the whole thing
is useless if 1% happens to be no good.\cDespite that, we never stop trying.
Why? It's a dream that never ends.

records.japanese: かいがんを　さんぽ　していて\nこれを　みつけたんだけど\rぼくは　いらないから　きみに　あげる！
records.english: I was taking a stroll down the beach\nwhen I found this.\cIt's not anything I need, so you can\nhave it.

records.japanese: むかしから　ホウエンちほうは\nいんせきの　おおい　ばしょ　として\rゆうめい　なんだよね
records.english: The HOENN region has been famous for \nits meteor showers for a long time.

records.japanese: ひとに　よっては\nポケモンは　うちゅうから　やってきた！\rって　いうよね！　ほんとう　かなー？
records.english: Some people claim that POKéMON came\nfrom space. Could it be true?

records.japanese: でっかい　てつの　かたまりが\nおおぞらを　つきぬけ\rうちゅうまで　とんで　いく‥‥\cたまげた　もん　だわい
records.english: A giant chunk of metal bursts through\nthe skies and flies into space...\cIt boggles my mind!

records.japanese: トクサネは　てんきの　よい　ひが　おおい\nかぜの　むきも　あんてい　している\cロケットを　うちあげる　には\nもってこいの　ばしょ　なんですな
records.english: MOSSDEEP has mainly sunny weather,\nand its winds are stable.\cIt's an ideal location for launching\nrockets.

records.japanese: わしも　もうすこし　わかければ\nうちゅう　ひこうしに　なりたかった‥‥\cいや　いまからでも　おそくない！\nよーし　がんばるぞー！！
records.english: If only I was a little younger, I would\nhave liked being an astronaut...\cNo... It's not too late!\nI can and will try!

records.japanese: いつか　ふつーの　ひとも\nうちゅうに　いけると　いいのにな‥‥
records.english: I wish ordinary people could go into\nspace one day...

records.japanese: わしも　わかいころは　\nポケモン　トレーナーとして\rせかいじゅうを　たび　していたのじゃ\cジジイとなった　いまでは\nわかい　トレーナーの　しょうぶを　みるのが\rゆいいつの　たのしみ　じゃ
records.english: When I was young, I traveled the world\nas a POKéMON TRAINER.\cNow that I've become an old buzzard,\nmy only amusement is watching young\rTRAINERS battle.

records.japanese: とびらには　かぎが　かかって　いるようだ！
records.english: The door appears to be locked.

records.japanese: いまは　[STR_VAR_1]　という　トレーナーが\nわしの　いえに　きておる！\c[STR_VAR_1]と　しょうぶ　してみたいのじゃな？
records.english: A TRAINER named [STR_VAR_1] is\nvisiting my home.\cWould you like to challenge\n[STR_VAR_1]?

records.japanese: しょうぶ　せんのか‥‥\nしょうぶを　みられなくて　ガッカリ‥‥
records.english: You won't battle? I'm disappointed\nthat I can't see you battle...

records.japanese: おお　そうか　そうか！\cじゃが　この　いえは\nあんまり　がんじょう　じゃないから\cせめて　３たい３の\nしょうぶに　して　くれんかのう？
records.english: Oh, good, good!\cBut my house isn't all that sturdy.\cCould I ask you to keep it down to\na 3-on-3 match?

records.japanese: じゃあ　しょうぶの　まえに\nレポートを　かいて　おいたほうが　よいぞ
records.english: Before you two battle, you should\nsave your progress.

records.japanese: よい　しょうぶを　きたい　しておるぞ！
records.english: I hope to see a good match!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
しょうぶは　ひきわけに　おわった！
records.english: The match ended up a draw.

records.japanese: ひきわけ　じゃったか！\cおたがい　いっぽも　ゆずらぬ\nすばらしい　しょうぶ　じゃったぞ！
records.english: So, it became a standoff.\cIt was a brilliant match in which\nneither side conceded a step!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
みごと　じゃったぞ！\cまるで　わしの　わかい　ころを\nみている　ようじゃわい！
records.english: That was superlative!\cWhy, it was like seeing myself in my\nyouth again!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]
ざんねん　じゃったのう\nじゃが　よい　しょうぶ　じゃったぞ！\rつぎこそは　かてると　よいのう
records.english: Ah, too bad for you!\cBut it was a good match.\nI hope you can win next time.

records.japanese:
げんき　しとぉや！！
チャンピオンを　めざす　[PLAYER]！！\cルネシティの　ジムリーダー　ミクリは
みずタイプ　ポケモンを　つかいこなす！\cそして　ミクリが　いる　ばしょ　までは
こおりの　ゆかが　ゆくてを　さえぎる‥‥\cごめんな！　きみに　おしえて
あげられるのは　ここまで　なんだ‥‥！\cあとは　じぶんで　きばってくれッ！
records.english:
Yo! How's it going, CHAMPION-
bound [PLAYER]?\cSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER WALLACE is
a master of WATER-type POKéMON.\cAnd, to get to WALLACE, an icy floor
will hamper your progress...\cListen, I'm sorry, but that's all the
advice that I have for you.\cThe rest of the way, you have to
go for it yourself!

records.japanese:
ホウエンで　いちばん　つよいと　いわれる
ミクリに　かったのかあ！！\cよし！　きみの
トレーナーカードを　みたまえ！\cすべての　バッジが　そろっているなら
いよいよ　ポケモンリーグ　ちょうせんだ！
records.english: Yow! You've beaten even WALLACE, who\nwas supposedly the best in all HOENN!\cOkay! Check out your TRAINER's CARD.\cIf you've gotten all the BADGES, you're\nset for the POKéMON LEAGUE challenge!

records.japanese: ジムリーダー　ミクリさまに　おしえてもらった\nかれいな　テクニックを　みせたげる！
records.english: I'll show you the sublime techniques\nI learned from our LEADER WALLACE!

records.japanese: ミクリさま　ごめんね‥‥
すべての　ゆかに　ヒビを　いれると\nなにかが　おこるわよ
records.english: Watch what happens if you crack all\nthe floor tiles.

records.japanese: せっかく　ここまで　これたのに\nあたしに　まけるから\rミクリさまに　あえないわね！
records.english: You came all the way here, but you won't\nget to see WALLACE.\cNot if you lose to me, you won't!

records.japanese: つよい　じゃない！！\nかわいい　みために　だまされたわ
records.english: You're strong!\nI was fooled by your cute looks!

records.japanese: あなたなら　ミクリさまと　たたかっても\nいちげきで　やられなくて　すむかもね
records.english: You might be good enough to avoid\nbeing wiped out in one hit by WALLACE.

records.japanese: ミクリさまの　たたかう　すがた‥‥\cその　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nわたくしも　ポケモンを　はじめましてよ
records.english: The sight of WALLACE conducting a\nbattle...\cThe very beauty of it compelled me to\nbecome a TRAINER.

records.japanese: たたかう　すがたの\nうつくしさで　まけましたわ‥‥
records.english: You battled with more beauty than\nI could muster...

records.japanese: あなたさまの　たたかう　すがたも\nすばらしくってよ\cああっ‥‥！\nポケモンに　であえて　よかったですわ
records.english: The grace you bring to battle is\nfabulous.\cOh... I'm so fortunate to have found\nPOKéMON.

records.japanese: おねえさんが　しょうぶの　きびしさ\nいろいろと　おしえて　あげちゃおっかな
records.english: I should teach you how harsh battles\ncan be.

records.japanese: なんだ\nつよいんだ
いいこと　おしえて　あげるね\cミクリさまに　あいたいのなら\nすべての　ゆかを　１かいずつ\rあるいて　いけば　いいの
records.english: I'll tell you something good.\cIf you want to reach WALLACE, you\nneed to walk on each floor tile once.

records.japanese: ホウエンちほうで　いちばん\nレベルの　たかい　ポケモンジム‥‥\cそれが　ここ　ルネジムよ！
records.english: The POKéMON GYM of the highest level\nin the HOENN region...\cThat's the SOOTOPOLIS GYM.

records.japanese: なんて　レベルの　たかい‥‥
records.english: What a high level you are!

records.japanese: レベルの　たかい　ジムに　いることに\nまんぞく　しないで\rほかにも　しゅぎょうに　いくほうが\rつよくなれそうだし　なにより　たのしそうね
records.english: Rather than being satisfied by being\nin a strong GYM, I imagine training in\rother places will make you stronger.\rBut above all, it looks more fun.

records.japanese: ミクリさまと　いっしょに\nポケモンを　きたえて　いるの\cかんたんに　たおせると　おもわないでね
records.english: I train my POKéMON together with\nWALLACE.\cDon't think I'm a pushover.

records.japanese: たおされちゃった‥‥
あなた　みどころ　あると　おもうの\nいっしょに　ここで　ポケモン　きたえない？
records.english: I think you have potential.\nWhy don't you stay and train with us?

records.japanese: こおりの　うえでの　ひとふでがき\cそれが　できる　トレーナーは\nエレガントに　うつくしいのよ！
records.english: A graceful glide across the ice while\ncrossing no lines...\cA TRAINER putting on that performance\nwould be elegantly beautiful!

records.japanese: ちょっとー！？
あたりまえ　だけど\nポケモンの　つよさに\rおとなも　こどもも　かんけい　ないよ
records.english: This is really obvious, but how strong\nyou are as a TRAINER has nothing to do\rwith how young or old you are.

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　いると\nじかんが　あっ　というまに　すぎるのよ！
records.english: When I'm with my POKéMON, the time\nflies by before you can say, “Oops!”

records.japanese: あっ！
まけた　しょうぶも\nあっ　というまに　わすれたい‥‥
records.english: I wish I can forget about lost causes\nbefore I can manage an “Oops!”

records.japanese:
あらためて　なのろう\cわたしは　ミクリ
この　ルネの　ジムリーダー\cなんだろう
きみの　ふんいきが　すこし　かわった\cそんな　きが　する\cめざめのほこらで　なにが　あったか
きみが　なにを　してきたかこれからの　たたかいで　わかるだろう\cさあ　みせてもらおう
きみと　ポケモンの　ちからを\cそして　ぞんぶんに　おみせしよう
わたしと　ポケモンに　よるみずの　イリュージョンを！
records.english:
Allow me to formally introduce
myself.\cI am WALLACE.
The GYM LEADER of SOOTOPOLIS.\cThere's something about you...
A difference in your demeanor.\cI think I sense that in you.\cWhat happened inside the CAVE OF
ORIGIN, and what you did, I will likelylearn through our upcoming battle.\cNow, show me. Show me the power you
wield with your POKéMON.\cAnd I, in turn, shall present you with
a performance of illusions in waterby me and my POKéMON!

records.japanese:
すばらしい\cきみが　ほんとうに　すばらしい
ポケモン　トレーナーだと　わかった\cそんな　きみと　きみの　ポケモンに
であえたことを　よろこびたい\cこの　レインバッジは
そんな　きみに　ふさわしいさあ　うけとるが　いい
records.english:
Bravo.\cI realize now your authenticity and
magnificence as a POKéMON TRAINER.\cI find much joy in having met you and
your POKéMON.\cYou have proven yourself worthy of
the RAIN BADGE. Accept it.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ミクリから\nレインバッジを　もらった！

レインバッジを　もっていると
すべての　ポケモンがきみの　いうことを　すなおに　きいてくれる\cはげしく　ながれる　たきも
ひでんわざ　たきのぼりを　つかってのぼれる　ように　してくれる\cそれから　わたしとの　しょうぶを
わすれないように　これを‥‥
records.english:
Having that BADGE assures you the
full obedience of all your POKéMON toevery command you make.\cThe BADGE also allows the use of the
HM move WATERFALL to scale wallsof cascading water.\cAnd, so that you never forget the
battle we shared, take this...

records.japanese: きみに　わたした　その　わざマシン\nなかみは　みずのはどう\cつかうと　ときおり　ちょうおんぱで\nあいてを　こんらん　させる
records.english: The TM I handed you contains\nWATER PULSE.\cIn use, it will occasionally confuse\nthe target with ultrasonic waves.

records.japanese: ホウエンで　あつめられる\nすべての　ジムバッジを　てにいれた\rトレーナーが　いくべき　ばしょ\cそれが　ポケモンリーグ\cポケモンリーグに　いくならば\nホウエンちほうの　さいはて\rサイユウという　しまに　むかうと　いい
records.english: TRAINERS who have gathered all the\nGYM BADGES of HOENN should make way\rfor the ultimate destination.\cThe POKéMON LEAGUE.\cTravel to the easternmost reaches\nof HOENN, to the island EVER GRANDE.\rThe POKéMON LEAGUE is there.

records.japanese: ホウエンで　あつめられる\nジムバッジは　あと　ひとつ\cきみが　ポケモンリーグに　いどむ　つもりなら\nヒワマキの　ポケモンジムで\rのこりの　バッジを　てにいれると　いい
records.english: There remains but one BADGE to\nobtain in HOENN.\cIf you wish to challenge the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must obtain the last\rBADGE from the GYM in FORTREE.

records.japanese: ルネシティ　ポケモンジム
ルネシティ　ポケモンジム\cミクリ　にんてい　トレーナー！\n[PLAYER]
