records.english: SOOTOPOLIS CITY POKéMON GYM\cWALLACE'S CERTIFIED TRAINERS:\n[PLAYER]

records.japanese: この　まちの　ジムリーダー　ミクリは\nホウエンちほう　でも　いちばんと\rうわさ　される　じつりょくしゃ　だよ\cしかし　ミクリよりも　つよいと　いわれる\nしてんのうの　つよさ\rどれほどの　ものだろう？
records.english:
WALLACE, this town's GYM LEADER, is a
powerful TRAINER.\cHe's rumored to be the best in the
whole HOENN region.\cBut the ELITE FOUR...\cThey're said to be even stronger than
WALLACE. How strong could they be?

records.japanese: この　まちの　みんなが　みんな\nいえに　とじこもって　でてこないんです！\cこの　てんき‥‥\nなにかの　まえぶれ　なのでしょうか？
records.english: Everyone in town has taken refuge\nand won't come out of their homes.\cThis weather..\nCould it be the prelude to something?

records.japanese: どんな　ときでも\nどんな　ことが　あっても\rあたし　ポケモンと　ともだちで　いるわ\cだって　ポケモンと　いっしょだと\nすごく　たのしいもの！
records.english: Whenever, wherever, and whatever\nhappens, I will always be friends with\rPOKéMON.\cBecause it's fun to be with POKéMON!

records.japanese: りゆうは　わからないけれど‥‥\nとっても‥‥　ふあん　なの‥‥
records.english: I don't know why...\nBut... I'm really scared...

records.japanese: ポイントアップは　すごいぞ！\cなんたって　ポケモンの\nパワーポイントを　ふやせるからな！
records.english: PP UP is great!\cIt raises the POWER POINTS, the PP,\nof a POKéMON move.

records.japanese: いったい　なにが　おこってるんだ！？
かいふくのくすり　ごぞんじ　ですか？\cポケモンの　たいりょく　ぜんかい！\nじょうたい　いじょうも　すべて　かいふく！\rまさに　ゆめのような　どうぐ　なのです
records.english: Do you know FULL RESTORE?\cFull restoration of HP!\nEradication of all status problems!\cIt's truly an item of your dreams!

records.japanese: この　てんき‥‥\nなにかが　めざめたのか‥‥？
うむう‥‥\nルネシティに　こもること　３０ねん‥‥\cわしが　あみだした　ひっさつの　わざマシン！\nおまえに　ゆずろう！
records.english: For thirty years I've remained in\nSOOTOPOLIS honing my skills.\cI developed a shattering TM.\nI bequeath it to you!

records.japanese: わざマシン３１は　かわらわり！\nせつめい　するのも　おそろしい　わざよ‥‥
records.english: TM31 contains BRICK BREAK! It's a move\nso horrible that I can't describe it.

records.japanese: カクレオン『ぷー　ぷひゃあー
おくりびやま‥‥\cちょうじょうに　ふたつのたまが\nおかれて　いるのは　ごぞんじ　ですか‥‥？
records.english: MT. PYRE...\cAt its peak are two orbs placed side\nby side. Did you know?

records.japanese: そう‥‥　ふたつのたまが\nとなりあわせに　おかれている　ようすは\rなにか　こころが　やすらぎますよ‥‥
records.english: Yes, two orbs side by side...\cThe sight of them together...\nIt is somehow soothing...

records.japanese: そうですか‥‥\nいちど　いかれては　どうでしょう‥‥
records.english: Is that so?\nPerhaps you ought to visit and see...

records.japanese: あなた　ポケモン　トレーナーね？\cルネの　ジムリーダー\nミクリさまには　ファンが　いっぱいだけど\rあなたに　ファンは　いるのかしら？
records.english: You're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\cSOOTOPOLIS's GYM LEADER WALLACE has\nmany fans.\rDo you have any?

records.japanese: へえー\nじゃあ　けっこう　つよいのね！
records.english: Oh, then you must be pretty strong.

records.japanese: あららん‥‥\nそれは　ちょっと　さみしいわね\cファンが　できるよう　がんばりなさいよ！
records.english: Oh, dear...\nThat's a little lonesome.\cTry working a little harder to get a\nfan following.

records.japanese: ねっしんな　ファンだと\nカントーや　ジョウトからも　やってくるの！\cあたしが　ミナモの\nトレーナー　ファンクラブに　いったときも\rとっても　すごかったもの！
records.english: Dedicated fans come over from even\nKANTO and JOHTO.\cIt was really wild when I went to the\nTRAINER FAN CLUB in LILYCOVE.

records.japanese: いいことを　おしえてやろう\cこの　あたりの　うみの　そこには\nこだいの　いせきが　あるそうだ！\cひょっとしたら　むかしの　おたからが\nざくざく　みつかるかも　しれないぜ！
records.english:
Listen up, and I'll tell you something
good.\cThere's supposed to be an ancient
ruin in the sea around here.\cThere could be treasures just waiting
to be discovered down there.

records.japanese: たからもの　かぁ‥‥\cあると　いいけど\nそうでなくても　ポケモンと　いっしょに\rかいていを　おさんぽ　なんて　す・て・き！
records.english: Ancient treasures...\cIt would be nice if they existed, but\neven if they didn't, it would be so\rbeautiful to take an underwater\rstroll with my POKéMON.

records.japanese: マリルリ『まるりー
この　ルネシティと　おくりびやまは\nなにかの　かんけいが　あるらしい‥‥\cむかし　いた　けんきゅうじょで\nそんなことを　ともだちと　しらべていたよ
records.english: There appears to be some connection\nbetween SOOTOPOLIS and MT. PYRE.\cMy friends and I did some research on\nit at the lab where I used to work.

records.japanese: おにいちゃん\nむかし　うみの　けんきゅうを　してたんだ
records.english: My big brother used to study the sea.

records.japanese: わー　ひさしぶりの　おきゃくさん！\cなんだか　うれしいから\nホエルコの　おおきい　ぬいぐるみ　あげる！
records.english: Hello! You're our first guest in a\ngood while.\cYou've brightened up my day, so I'll\ngive you a big WAILMER DOLL.

records.japanese: だいじに　してね！
ほしいけど　いまは　ダメ？\nじゃあ　あずかっておいて　あげるね
records.english: Oh, you want it, but not right now?\nOkay, then I'll hold it for you.

records.japanese: そうなの？\nぬいぐるみ　ほしくないの？
records.english: Are you sure?\nYou don't want this DOLL?

records.japanese: あたし　ぬいぐるみ　だいすき！
かいていに　あった　かざんが　ふんかして\nうみの　うえまで　もりあがる\cそして　ふんかこうに　あめが　たまって\nできたのが　この　ルネシティ　なんだよ
records.english:
An underwater volcano erupted and
forced itself up from the depths.\cIts crater emerged from the sea and
became filled with rainwater.\cThat's how SOOTOPOLIS CITY came into
being.

records.japanese: ルネと　そとのせかいを　つなぐ　どうくつ\cまるで　なにかを　ここから　ださないように\nつくられた　みたい　だわ‥‥\c‥‥かんがえすぎ　かしら？
records.english: The cave that links SOOTOPOLIS and\nthe outside world...\cIt seems as if the cave was made to\nkeep something from getting out.\cOr am I just imagining things?

records.japanese:
きみ　キノココって　ポケモン　しってる？
ルネでは　めったに　みられないん　だけどね\cわし　おおきな　キノココが
めちゃめちゃ　だいすき　なのよ！\cおとうとは　ドジョッチの　ほうが
おおきいって　いうんだけど\cキノココの　ほうが
おおきいに　きまってる　よね！\cん？　きみ　キノココ　もってるの？
ちょ　ちょ　ちょっと‥‥おじさんに　みせて　おくれ！
records.english:
Do you know the POKéMON SHROOMISH?
It's hardly ever seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\cAnyway, I love big SHROOMISH.
The bigger the better.\cBut my younger brother, he says that
BARBOACH is bigger.\cThat's silly. SHROOMISH has to be
bigger than that!\cHuh? Do you have a SHROOMISH with you?
P-p-please, show me!

records.japanese:
[STR_VAR_2]ｃｍ！！
おお！　こいつは　でかい！\cおとうとが　みた　でかい　ドジョッチに
まけない　おおきさ　かも！\cみせて　くれて　ありがとう
おれいに　これを　あげるよ！
records.english:
[STR_VAR_2] inches!
Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\cIt might even beat the big BARBOACH
my younger brother saw!\cThanks for showing me.
This is my thanks!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nきずぐすりを　もらった！
ありゃ？\nきみ　もちもの　いっぱいだね
[STR_VAR_2]ｃｍか‥‥\cううむ　わしは　これより　おおきい\nキノココを　みたこと　あるな‥‥
records.english: [STR_VAR_2] inches, is it?\cHmm... I've seen a bigger SHROOMISH\nthan this one.

records.japanese: おお　こいつは　なかなか‥‥　って\nこれ　キノココじゃ　ないよ！
records.english: Oh, now this is quite something...\nBut it's not a SHROOMISH!

records.japanese: おおきい　キノココ　もってないの？\nそれは　ざんねん‥‥\cこんど　おおきい　キノココ　みせてね
records.english: You don't have a big SHROOMISH?\nThat's too bad...\cIf you get a big SHROOMISH, please\ncome show me.

records.japanese: しじょう　さいだいの　キノココ！\n[STR_VAR_2]の　[STR_VAR_3]ｃｍのやつ！\cドジョッチより　おおきい　キノココ\nいつでも　ぼしゅうちゅう！
records.english: The biggest SHROOMISH in history!\n[STR_VAR_2]'s [STR_VAR_3]-inch giant!\cA SHROOMISH bigger than a BARBOACH\nalways wanted!

records.japanese:
きみ　ドジョッチって　ポケモン　しってる？
ルネでは　めったに　みられないん　だけどね\cわし　おおきな　ドジョッチが
めちゃめちゃ　だいすき　なのよ！\cアニキは　キノココの　ほうが
おおきいって　いうんだけど\cドジョッチの　ほうが
おおきいに　きまってる　よね！\cん？　きみ　ドジョッチ　もってるの？
ちょ　ちょ　ちょっと‥‥おじさんに　みせて　おくれ！
records.english:
Do you know the POKéMON BARBOACH?
It's rarely seen in SOOTOPOLIS.\cI love, I mean love, big BARBOACH!\cMy big brother says that SHROOMISH is
bigger.\cBut that's wrong! Everyone knows that
BARBOACH is a lot bigger.\cHunh? Do you have a BARBOACH?
P-p-please show me!

records.japanese:
[STR_VAR_2]ｃｍ！！
おお！　こいつは　でかい！\cあにきが　みた　でかい　キノココに
まけない　おおきさ　かも！\cみせて　くれて　ありがとう
おれいに　これを　あげるよ！
records.english:
[STR_VAR_2] inches!
Wow, that is big!\cIt might be even bigger than the huge
SHROOMISH my big brother saw.\cThanks for showing me!
This is my thanks!

records.japanese: ありゃ？\nきみ　もちもの　いっぱいだね
records.english: Whoops, looks like your BAG is full.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_2]ｃｍか‥‥\cううむ　わしは　これより　おおきい\nドジョッチを　みたこと　あるな‥‥
records.english: [STR_VAR_2] inches?\cHmm... I've seen a bigger BARBOACH\nthan this one here.

records.japanese: おお　こいつは　なかなか‥‥　って\nこれ　ドジョッチじゃ　ないよ！
records.english: Well, isn't this something!\nBut it's no BARBOACH!

records.japanese: おおきい　ドジョッチ　もってないの？\nそれは　ざんねん‥‥\cこんど　おおきい　ドジョッチ　みせてね
records.english: Don't you have a big BARBOACH?\nHow disappointing...\cIf you get a big BARBOACH, please\ncome show me!

records.japanese: しじょう　さいだいの　ドジョッチ！\n[STR_VAR_2]の　[STR_VAR_3]ｃｍのやつ！\cキノココより　おおきい　ドジョッチ\nいつでも　ぼしゅうちゅう！
records.english: The biggest BARBOACH in history!\n[STR_VAR_2]'s [STR_VAR_3]-inch colossus!\cA BARBOACH bigger than a SHROOMISH\nalways wanted!

records.japanese:
ようこそ　チャレンジャー！
おれは　してんのうの　カゲツ\cうーん　いい　かお　してるな
なかなか　たのしませて　くれそうだぞ！いいぞ！　いい　かんじだぞ！\cよーし！　おれと　おまえ　とで
ポケモン　リーグでしか　できないたたかいを　たのしむと　しようぜ！！
records.english:
Welcome, challenger!
I'm SIDNEY of the ELITE FOUR.\cI like that look you're giving me.
I guess you'll give me a good match.That's good! Looking real good!\cAll right! You and me, let's enjoy a
battle that can only be staged herein the POKéMON LEAGUE!

records.japanese: おやおや　まけちまったよ\nまっ　たのしんだから　いいんだけどよ
records.english: Well, how do you like that? I lost!\nEh, it was fun, so it doesn't matter.

records.japanese: まけた　おれから　ひとこと\cおまえなら　もっと　さきに　すすめるぜ\nさあ　つぎの　へやに　いって\rたたかいを　たのしんで　きなよ！
records.english: Well, listen to what this loser has\nto say.\cYou've got what it takes to go far.\nNow, go on to the next room and enjoy\ryour next battle!

records.japanese:
アハハ！\cアタシ　してんのうの　フヨウ\cおくりびやまで　しゅぎょう　するうちに
ゴーストタイプの　ポケモンと　きもちをかよわせる　ことが　できるように　なったの\cそう　アタシと　ポケモンの　きずな
とっても　つよいんだ！\cそんな　アタシの　ポケモンたちに
ダメージを　あたえる　ことが　できるかためして　ごらんよ！
records.english:
Ahahaha!\cI'm PHOEBE of the ELITE FOUR.
I did my training on MT. PYRE.\cWhile I trained, I gained the ability
to commune with GHOST-type POKéMON.\cYes, the bond I developed with POKéMON
is extremely tight.\cSo, come on, just try and see if you can
even inflict damage on my POKéMON!

records.japanese: あーあ\nまけちゃった

あなたと　ポケモンとの　あいだにも
たしかな　きずなが　あったのね\cそれが　わからなかった
アタシが　まけたのは　とうぜん\cウン　あなたたちの　きずなが
どこまで　つうじるか　みてみたいなつぎの　へやに　すすみなよ
records.english:
There's a definite bond between you
and your POKéMON, too.\cI didn't recognize it, so it's only
natural that I lost.\cYup, I'd like to see how far your bond
will carry you.\cGo ahead, move on to the next room.

records.japanese:
ようこそ
してんのうの　プリムと　いいます\cこおりの　わざを　きわめたくて
はるか　ホウエンまで　やって　きました\cですが　ここに　ちょうせんに　くるのは
やわな　トレーナーと　ポケモンばかり‥‥\cあなたは　どう？\cほんきを　だしても　だいじょうぶ　だと
うれしいの　ですが‥‥！！
records.english:
Welcome, my name is GLACIA of the
ELITE FOUR.\cI've traveled from afar to HOENN so
that I may hone my ice skills.\cBut all I have seen are challenges by
weak TRAINERS and their POKéMON.\cWhat about you?\cIt would please me to no end if I could
go all out against you!

records.japanese: あなたと　ポケモンの\nたましいの　あつさ！\cそれは　なによりも　あつく\nわたくしの　こおりの　わざが\rつうじる　ものでは　なかったのですね
records.english: You and your POKéMON...\nHow hot your spirits burn!\cThe all-consuming heat overwhelms.\cIt's no surprise that my icy skills\nfailed to harm you.

records.japanese: つぎに　すすみなさい\cそこで　ポケモン　リーグの\nほんとうの　おそろしさ　たしかめなさい
records.english: Advance to the next room.\cAnd there, confirm the truly fearsome\nside of the POKéMON LEAGUE.

records.japanese:
わしが　ポケモン　リーグ
してんのう　さいごの　ひとりドラゴンつかいの　ゲンジ！\cポケモンは　もともと
じゆうきままな　やせいの　いきもの\cときとして　ひとを　こまらせ
ときとして　ひとを　たすける\cそんな　ポケモンと　いっしょに　たたかうのに
なにが　ひつようかおまえ　わかって　いるのか？\cわかっていなければ
この　わしに　かつことは　できるまい！
records.english:
I am the last of the POKéMON LEAGUE
ELITE FOUR, DRAKE the DRAGON master!\cIn their natural state, POKéMON are
wild living things. They are free.\cAt times, they hinder us.
At times, they help us.\cFor us to battle with POKéMON as
partners, do you know what it takes?\cDo you know what is needed?\cIf you don't, then you will never
prevail over me!

records.japanese: みごと！　というべきだな！

さすがは　ここまで
やってきた　ポケモン　トレーナーひつような　もの　わかっている　ようだな\cそう！　トレーナーに
ひつよう　なのは　ただしい　こころ！\cポケモンは　トレーナーの
ただしい　こころに　ふれてものごとの　ぜんあくを　はんだんしただしい　こころに　ふれて　つよくなる！\cさあ　つぎに　すすめ！
チャンピオンが　まって　おるぞ！！
records.english:
You deserve every credit for coming
this far as a TRAINER of POKéMON.\cYou do seem to know what is needed.\cYes, what a TRAINER needs is a
virtuous heart.\cPOKéMON touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and learn good from wrong.\cThey touch the good hearts of
TRAINERS and grow strong.\cGo! Go onwards!
The CHAMPION is waiting!

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『ようこそ　[PLAYER][KUN]\cいつ　きみが　ここまで　くるのか
たのしみに　していたよ\cきみは‥‥　ポケモンと　たびをして
なにを　みてきた？\cたくさんの　トレーナーと　であって
なにを　かんじた？\cきみの　なかに　めばえた　なにか
その　すべてを　ボクに　ぶつけてほしい！\cさあ　はじめよう！！
records.english:
STEVEN: Welcome, [PLAYER][KUN].\cI was looking forward to seeing you
here one day.\cYou... What did you see on your
journey with POKéMON?\cWhat did you feel, meeting so many
other TRAINERS like you?\cWhat has awoken in you?
I want you to hit me with it all!\cNow, bring it!

records.japanese: チャンピオンである\nボクが　まける　とはね‥‥\cさすがだ　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cきみは　ほんとうに　すばらしい\nポケモン　トレーナー　だよ！
records.english: I, the CHAMPION, fall in defeat...\cKudos to you, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cYou are a truly noble POKéMON\nTRAINER!

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『おめでとう！\cきみの　ポケモンを　おもう　きもち\cそして　その　きもちに　こたえるため
ぜんりょくを　つくした　ポケモン\cそれらが　あわさって　ひとつと　なり
さらに　おおきな　ちからを　うみだした\cだからこそ　こうして
きみが　しょうりを　つかんだ！\cきみこそ　ホウエンちほうの
あたらしい‥‥
records.english:
STEVEN: Congratulations!\cThe feelings you have for your
POKéMON...\cAnd the POKéMON that responded to
those feelings with all their might...\cThey came together as one, and created
an even greater power.\cAnd thus, you were able to grasp
victory today!\cYou are rightfully the HOENN region's
new...

records.japanese: ハルカ『[PLAYER][KUN]！\cチャンピオンに　ちょうせん　するまえに\nアドバイス‥‥！
records.english: MAY: [PLAYER][KUN]!\cHere's some advice before you challenge\nthe CHAMPION...

records.japanese: ハルカ『あれ？　あれれ？\c[PLAYER][KUN]‥‥\nひょっとして‥‥\rもう　おわっちゃった‥‥？
records.english: MAY: Huh? What, what, what?\c[PLAYER][KUN]...\nCould it be that...\rIt's already over?

records.japanese: ユウキ『[PLAYER]！\cチャンピオンに　ちょうせん　するまえに\nオレが　アドバイス　してやろうか‥‥
records.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER]!\cHow would you like some advice before\nyou challenge the CHAMPION?...

records.japanese: ユウキ『[PLAYER]‥‥\cおまえ　ひょっとして\nチャンピオンに　かったのか？
records.english: BRENDAN: [PLAYER]...\cAre you trying to tell me...\nYou've beaten the CHAMPION?

records.japanese:
オダマキ『ほれみろ　[RIVAL]！\c[PLAYER][KUN]なら　しんぱい　いらんと
わたしが　いったとおり　だろう！\c‥‥‥　‥‥‥　‥‥‥
[PLAYER][KUN]　とうとう　やりとげたな\cきみが　トウカ　ジムの　おとうさんに
かちぬいたと　きいた　ときにもしや‥‥　とは　おもったが\cまさか　ほんとうに　チャンピオンに
なってしまうとは　な！\c‥‥おお　そうだ！\cきみの　ポケモンずかんは　どうなった？
わたしに　みせて　ごらん！
records.english:
PROF. BIRCH: See?
What did I tell you, [RIVAL]?\cDidn't I tell you that you don't need
to worry about [PLAYER][KUN]?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
[PLAYER][KUN], you've finally done it.\cWhen I heard that you defeated your
own father at the PETALBURG GYM,I thought perhaps you had a chance...\cBut to think you've actually become
the CHAMPION!\cAh, yes!\cWhat became of your POKéDEX?
Here, let me see.

records.japanese: オダマキ『とにかく　おめでとう！\cさあ　むねをはって　おくの　へやに\nいってくるが　いいよ！
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: Anyways,\ncongratulations!\cNow, go proudly into the final room!

records.japanese: ダイゴ『[PLAYER][KUN]\cいや　あたらしい　チャンピオン！\cボクに　ついてきなよ
records.english: STEVEN: [PLAYER][KUN]...\cNo, the new CHAMPION!\cCome with me.

records.japanese: ダイゴ『もうしわけないけど‥‥\cここから　さきは　チャンピオンに　なった\nトレーナー　だけが　はいれる　ばしょ！\cきみは　そこで　はかせと　いっしょに\nまっていて　くれないか
records.english: STEVEN: I'm sorry, but...\cFrom here on, only those TRAINERS who\nhave become CHAMPIONS may enter.\cYou'll have to wait outside with the\nPROFESSOR.

records.japanese:
ハルカ『‥‥がーん！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cなーんてね　いいの　いいの！
だって　そういう　きまり　だもんね！\c[PLAYER][KUN]！
ほんとうに　おめでとう！！
records.english:
MAY: Groan...\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cI'm just joking! That's okay!
That's the rule!\c[PLAYER][KUN]!
Honestly, congratulations!

records.japanese:
ユウキ『‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cしかたないか
そういう　きまり　だもんな\c[PLAYER]！　よかったな
おめでとう！！
records.english: BRENDAN: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cIt can't be helped if that's the rule.\c[PLAYER], way to go!\nCongratulations!

records.japanese: これより　さきは\nすべての　ジムバッジを　あつめた\rトレーナーだけが　すすめます！\cトレーナーよ！　きみの　ジムバッジ\nかくにん　させてください
records.english: Beyond this point, only those TRAINERS\nwho have collected all the GYM BADGES\rare permitted to enter.\cTRAINER, let us confirm that you have\nall the GYM BADGES.

records.japanese: きみは　まだ\nすべての　ジムバッジを　もっていない！\cポケモン　リーグを　めざすなら\nでなおして　きなさい
records.english: You haven't obtained all the BADGES.\cIf you're bound for the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you must return with them.

records.japanese: トレーナーよ！　おのれと\nポケモンを　しんじて　すすみたまえ！
records.english: TRAINER! Believe in yourself and your\nPOKéMON, and go forth!

records.japanese: ダイゴ『ここは‥‥\cはげしい　たたかいを　かちぬいた\nポケモンを　きろくする　ばしょ\cリーグ　チャンピオンの\nえいこうを　たたえるための　へや！
records.english: STEVEN: This room...\cThis is where we keep records of\nPOKéMON that prevailed through\rharsh battles.\cIt is here that the LEAGUE CHAMPIONS\nare honored.

records.japanese: ダイゴ『さあ！　ポケモン　リーグを\nかちぬいた　きみの　なまえと\cともに　たたかった　きみの　パートナーを\nこの　マシンに　きろく　しよう！
records.english: STEVEN: Come on, let's record your\nname as a TRAINER who triumphed over\rthe POKéMON LEAGUE, and the names of\rthe partners who battled with you.

records.japanese: ポケモンリーグは\nチャンピオンロードを　ぬけると　すぐ！\cここまで　きたら\nまえに　すすむしかないわ！
records.english: The POKéMON LEAGUE is only a short\ndistance after the VICTORY ROAD.\cIf you've come this far, what choice\ndo you have but to keep going?

records.japanese:
チャンピオンロードの
ながくて　けわしい　みちのり‥‥\cまるで　いままで　あるいてきた　みちを
おもいださせるかの　ようだな\cきみ　じぶんの　ポケモンを　
しんじて　がんばりたまえ！
records.english: The long and harrowing VICTORY ROAD...\cIt's like reliving the path one has\ntraveled in life...\cBelieve in your POKéMON and give it\nyour very best!

records.japanese: ハギ『こらこら！\nまて　まて　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Hold on, lass!\nWait up, PEEKO!

records.japanese:
おや？　きみは　たしか　ピーコちゃんを
たすけて　くれた　[PLAYER][KUN]！そのせつは　せわに　なったのう！\c‥‥なぬ？　ふねに　のりたい　とな？\cふむふむ？
ムロに　てがみを　とどけてカイナへ　にもつを　とどける‥‥なんだか　いそがしいのう　きみは\cじゃが　それくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！
わしに　まかせて　おきなさい！では　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
records.english:
Hm? You're [PLAYER][KUN]!
You saved my darling PEEKO!We owe so much to you!\cWhat's that?
You want to sail with me?\cHmhm...\cYou have a LETTER bound for DEWFORD
and a package for SLATEPORT, then?\cQuite the busy life you must lead!\cBut, certainly, what you're asking is
no problem at all.\cYou've come to the right man!
We'll set sail for DEWFORD.

records.japanese: ハギ『ムロタウン　か\cよっしゃ！　いくぞ　ピーコちゃん！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: DEWFORD, here we come!\cAnchors aweigh!\nPEEKO, we're setting sail, my darling!

records.japanese: ハギ『そうかね\nたのまれごとは　いいのかね？\cまあ　ふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nYour deliveries can wait?\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

records.japanese: ハギ『きみの　いいたいことは　わかっとる！\cムロに　てがみを　とどけて\nカイナへ　にもつを　とどけるんだろう\cそれくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！\nわしに　まかせて　おきなさい！\rでは　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
records.english:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\cYou're to deliver a LETTER to DEWFORD
and a package to SLATEPORT.\cWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all - I'm the man for the job!\cFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

records.japanese: ハギ『きみの　いいたいことは　わかっとる！\cカイナの　クスノキさんに\nにもつを　とどけるんだろう\cそれくらい　おやすい　ごようだ！\nわしに　まかせて　おきなさい！\rでは　まず　ムロに　むかうとするか！
records.english:
MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!
I know exactly what you want to say!\cYou're to deliver a package to
CAPT. STERN in SLATEPORT.\cWhat you need me to do is no problem
at all - I'm the man for the job!\cFirst, we'll set sail for DEWFORD.

records.japanese: ハギ『やあ！　きみのため　なら\nいつでも　ふねを　だそう！\cきみが　いきたいのは　どこ　かな？
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nFor you, I'll go out to sea anytime!\cNow, my friend, where are we bound?

records.japanese: ハギ『そうか‥‥　きみは\nピーコちゃんの　いのちの　おんじんだ\cふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Is that so?\nWell, PEEKO owes her life to you.\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

records.japanese: ハギ『ほい！　トウカに　とうちゃく！\cふねに　のる　ひつようが　あるときは\nいつでも　えんりょなく　いっておくれ！
records.english: MR. BRINEY: Ahoy!\nWe've made land in PETALBURG!\cYou just go on and tell me whenever\nyou want to set sail!

records.japanese: ピーコちゃん『ピー　ピひょろー！

きみほど　ポケモンを　じょうずに
つかいこなす　トレーナーは　はじめてだ！\cだが　きみよりも
わたしの　むすこの　ほうが　つよいぞ！\cなんたって　ポケモン　リーグへ
ちょうせんに　いった　ぐらい　だからな！
records.english:
You're the first TRAINER I've seen who
deploys POKéMON so masterfully.\cBut, I should tell you - my son is
stronger than you.\cHe even took the POKéMON LEAGUE
challenge, I'll have you know.

records.japanese: この　きょうせいギプスを　つかって\nわたしたち　かぞくは\rポケモンを　きたえて　います！\cわたしたち　かぞく　ぜんいんに　かった\nあなたには　ひつようない　かもしれませんが\rぜひ　うけとって　くださいな！
records.english: We use this MACHO BRACE to more\neffectively strengthen our POKéMON\rin training.\cSince you've beaten our entire family,\nI don't know if you need it, but we\rwould like you to have our MACHO BRACE.

records.japanese: わたしたちは　ポケモンでの　しょうぶに\nじょうねつを　そそいで　います！
records.english: When it comes to POKéMON battles,\nwe tend to be pretty passionate.

records.japanese: パパより　ママが　つよくて\cママより　あたしが　つよくて\cあたしより　おばあちゃんが　つよくて\cでも　おばあちゃんより　つよかったのが\nあたしの　あにき　なの！
records.english: Mommy is stronger than Daddy.\cI'm stronger than Mommy.\cAnd Grandma's stronger than me!\cBut my big brother is even stronger\nthan Grandma.

records.japanese:
あんたが　いくら　つよくても
わしの　まごに　あったらかてなくて　なきだすこと　じゃろう‥‥\cわしら　かぞくが　しってる　トレーナーの
だれよりも　つよかった　からのう！\cまごの　やつも　いまごろは
ポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンにちょうせん　しているの　じゃろうか？\cそれとも　わしの　まご　じゃから
もう　チャンピオン　かもな‥‥　ウヒヒ！
records.english:
There's no question that you're strong.\cBut if you were to battle my grandson,
you'd end up crying in frustration.\cHe's much stronger than any TRAINER
our family knows.\cHe must be challenging the POKéMON
LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\cKnowing my grandson, he could be the
CHAMPION already!

records.japanese: まごの　やつも　いまごろは\nポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンに\rちょうせん　しているの　じゃろうか？\cそれとも　わしの　まご　じゃから\nもう　チャンピオン　かもな‥‥　ウヒヒ！
records.english: My grandson must be challenging the\nPOKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION by now.\cKnowing my grandson, he could be the\nCHAMPION already!

records.japanese: あらあら　あなたの　ポケモン\nつかれてるんじゃ　ないかえ？\cよかったら　やすんで　おいき！\nそうだ　それがいい！　そうしなさい！
records.english: Oh, dear, dear.\nAren't your POKéMON exhausted?\cIf you'd like, rest up here.\nThat's a fine idea! You should do that.

records.japanese: そうそう\nここで　ゆっくり　して　おいき！
records.english: That's right.\nTake your time and rest up!

records.japanese: あらあら\nまだ　つかれてるんじゃ　ないかえ？\cもういちど　やすんで　おいき！\nそうだ　それがいい！　そうしなさい！
records.english: Oh, dear, dear.\nAre your POKéMON still tired?\cYou should take another rest here.\nThat's a fine idea. You should do that.

records.japanese: そうかね‥‥\nほんとうに　だいじょうぶ　かえ？\rえんりょ　しなくたって　いいんだよ
records.english: Is that so?\nYou don't need to be shy about it.

records.japanese: のぼり　ロープウェイ\nまもなく　しゅっぱつ　です\rごりように　なられますか？
records.english: The CABLE CAR is ready to go up.\nWould you like to be on it?

records.japanese: では　こちらに　どうぞ！
またの　ごりようを\nよろしく　おねがい　しまーす！
records.english: Please ride with us another time.

records.japanese: くだり　ロープウェイ\nまもなく　しゅっぱつ　です\rごりように　なられますか？
records.english: The CABLE CAR is ready to go down.\nWould you like to be on it?

records.japanese: では　こちらに　どうぞ！
またの　ごりようを\nよろしく　おねがい　しまーす！
records.english: Please ride with us another time.

records.japanese:
ぼくの　にいちゃん　かせきマニア‥‥
かせき　だいすき　ナイスガイ　さ‥‥\cちなみに　あなを　ほるのも　だいすきで‥‥
この　あなも　じぶんで　ほったんだ‥‥\cこれを　あげるから‥‥
きみも　にいちゃん　みたいにあなを　ほってみなよ‥‥
records.english:
My big brother's the FOSSIL MANIAC...
He's a nice guy who loves fossils...\cHe loves digging holes, too...
He dug this hole by himself...\cYou can have this, so you can DIG
holes just like my big brother...

records.japanese: ちなみに　ポケモンが　あなをほると\nどうくつの　いりぐち　まで\rいっしゅんで　もどれるんだ‥‥
records.english: If you make a POKéMON DIG inside a\ncave, you're returned to the entrance...

records.japanese: ケースのなかに　かわった　かたちの　いしが\nいくつも　かざってある‥‥
records.english: Rocks in peculiar shapes fill the\ndisplay case

records.japanese: 『ちそうが　できるまで』\n『あめ　ふって　じめん　かたまる』\r『いしと　つちと　がんせきと』\cたくさんの　ほんが　ならんでる！
records.english: THE COMPOSITION OF STRATA...\nHOW RAIN SHAPES THE LAND...\rSTONES, SOIL, AND ROCK...\cIt's crammed with books.

records.japanese:
ぼく　かせきマニア‥‥
かせき　だいすき　ナイスガイ　さ‥‥\cきみも　カセキが　ほしいの‥‥？\cここで　みつかる　カセキは
ぜんぶ　ぼくの　ものだから　あげないよ‥‥\cどうしても　ほしければ
１１１ばんどうろの　さばくに　いきなよ‥‥\cきいた　はなしでは　すなあらしで
すなの　なかに　ねむっていた　カセキがひょうめんに　うかぶことが　あるそうだよ‥‥
records.english:
I'm the FOSSIL MANIAC...
I'm a nice guy who loves fossils...\cDo you want a fossil?\cBut the fossils around these parts all
belong to me... None for you...\cIf you can't go without a fossil, go to
the desert on ROUTE 111...\cFrom what I've heard, fossils that were
buried in the sand sometimes rise tothe surface from sandstorms...

records.japanese:
きみも　カセキを　みつけたんだね‥‥
すてき‥‥　うっとり　しちゃうよ‥‥\cきみ　その　カセキ　どうするの‥‥？\cきいた　はなしでは　デボンでは
カセキを　ポケモンに　いきかえらせるけんきゅうを　している　そうだよ‥‥\cぼくは　カセキが　すきだから
そんなこと　しないけどね‥‥
records.english:
You found a FOSSIL, didn't you?
That's so nice... It's so dreamy...\cWhat are you going to do with that
FOSSIL?\cFrom what I've heard, DEVON is doing
research on reviving POKéMON fromFOSSILS...\cI love my FOSSILS, so I would never
do anything like that...

records.japanese: カセキって‥‥\nすてき‥‥　うっとり　しちゃうよ‥‥
records.english: FOSSILS are so... Wonderful...\nIt's so dreamy...

records.japanese: マユミ『あっ！　[PLAYER][KUN]\cちらかっていて　ごめんなさい‥‥\nけんきゅうに　むちゅうに　なると\rつい　こう　なっちゃうんです‥‥\cはずかしいから　ヒミツに　してくださいね\nこれ　あげますから‥‥
records.english: LANETTE: Oh! [PLAYER][KUN]!\cI'm sorry everything is so cluttered...\nWhen I get engrossed in research,\rthings end up this way...\cThis is embarrassing... Please keep\nthis a secret in exchange for this.

records.japanese: あずかりシステムを　つくった\nあたしからの　アドバイス　です\cどの　ボックスに　どの　ポケモンを\nあずけたか　わかるように\rきちんと　せいり　したほうが　いいですよ！
records.english: May I offer advice about my POKéMON\nStorage System?\cYou should organize your BOXES so you\ncan tell which POKéMON are in them.

records.japanese:
けんきゅう　ようの　ノートだ
ボックスに　ついて　かかれている！\cボックス１つに　３０ぴきの
ポケモンを　あずけられる　ようにする\cパソコンには　ぜんぶで　４２０ひきの
ポケモンを　あずけられる　ようにする\cつづきを　よみますか？
records.english: It's LANETTE's research notes.\nThere's information about BOXES.\cDesign BOXES to hold 30 POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER should be able to store\n420 POKéMON on the PC system.\cKeep reading?

records.japanese: ポケモンを　マーキングすると　ボックスが\nせいり　しやすくなる　ようにする\cボックスの　なまえ　かべがみを\nかえられる　ようにして　あずけられた\rポケモンが　よろこぶ　ようにする\cつづきを　よみますか？
records.english: A marking system should be added to\nmake POKéMON easier to organize.\cThe name and wallpaper design of each\nBOX will be made changeable to please\rthe stored POKéMON.\cKeep reading?

records.japanese:
ポケモンが　てんそう　される　ボックスは
さいごに　みた　ボックスにする\cその　ボックスが　いっぱいの　ときは
つぎの　ボックスに　てんそう　する\cつまり　ボックスを　みることで
ポケモンを　てんそう　したい　ボックスにきりかえられる　ようにする
records.english:
When storing a POKéMON, it should be
sent to the BOX inspected last.\cIf that BOX is full, the received
POKéMON is stored in the next BOX.\cIn other words, when a BOX is examined,
it is automatically selected as the BOXto which POKéMON are sent.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ノートを　とじた

パソコンを　みると
なんと　でんしメールが　きていた！\c「‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cきみの　あずかり　システム
なかなか　べんり　やな\cいろんな　ところに
じょせい　らしい　きくばりが　あってつかってて　たのしいし\cいっしょに　かいはつ　した
なかま　として　うれしいわ！\cほな　これからも　あずかりシステムの
けんきゅう　がんばってな\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥」
records.english:
There's an e-mail from someone on
the PC.\c“... ... ... ... ... ... ...\c“Your Storage System offers more
convenience than mine.\c“It has a lot of user-friendly features
that make it fun and useful, too.\c“It makes me proud that I played
a part in its development.\c“Here's hoping that you'll continue
research in Storage Systems.\c“From BILL
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...”

records.japanese:
あの　カナシダトンネル‥‥\cはじめは　たくさんの　にんげんと
さいしんの　キカイで　ほりすすんでいた\cだが　そのまま　ほりすすむと
あたりの　ポケモンにあくえいきょうを　あたえる　らしくてね\cで　おれら　どうしようもなく
ここで　ぼんやりと　しているわけさ
records.english:
That RUSTURF TUNNEL there...\cAt first, we had a huge work crew boring
through rock with the latest machinery.But, we had to stop.\cIt turns out that we would have had
a negative effect on wild POKéMON inthe area.\cSo, we've got nothing to do but loll
around here doing nothing.

records.japanese: どうしても　シダケに　いきたい\nやつが　じぶんの　ちから　だけで\rトンネルを　ほっているよ\cにんげんの　ちからで　すこしずつ　ほれば\nポケモンを　おどろかせなくて　すむし\rまわりの　しぜんにも　わるい　えいきょうを\rあたえないで　すむって　いってな
records.english: There's a man digging his way to\nVERDANTURF all by his lonesome.\rHe's desperate to get through.\cHe says that if he digs little by little\nwithout using machines, he won't\rdisturb POKéMON, and he'll avoid harming\rthe natural environment.

records.japanese: トンネルを　つかわずに　ここから\nシダケに　いくなら　うみを　わたり\rムロから　カイナ　そして\rキンセツを　とおって　いくしか　ないな！
records.english: To get to VERDANTURF without using\nthis TUNNEL, you'd have to cross the\rsea to DEWFORD, sail on to SLATEPORT,\rthen travel through MAUVILLE.

records.japanese: なんでも　シダケ　までの\nトンネルが　つうじた　らしいぞ！\cねがい　つづければ\nいつかは　かなう　って　ことなんだな！
records.english: Did you hear? The TUNNEL to VERDANTURF\nhas gone through!\cSometimes, if you hope strongly enough,\ndreams do come true.

records.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cこの　いんせきが　あれば\nえんとつやまが‥‥
ウヒョ？\cおまえが　だれだか　しらないが\nおれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　じゃまを　するなら\rようしゃは　しないぜ！
records.english: Heh?\cI don't know who you are, but if you get\nin the way of TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], don't\rexpect any mercy!

records.japanese: まてッ！\n[EVIL_TEAM]だん！\cおまえらの　あくじは\nわれわれ　[GOOD_TEAM]だんが　ゆるさん！
records.english: Hold it right there, TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!\cWe, TEAM [GOOD_TEAM], won't allow you to\nget away with your misdeeds!

records.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！
[GOOD_TEAM]だん　まで　やってきたのかよ！\cいちいち　あいてを　してやるのも
めんどうだな‥‥\cまあ　いいや！
いんせきは　てに　いれたしさっさと　えんとつやまに　いくか！\cウヒョヒョ！
あばよ！　まぬけな　[GOOD_TEAM]だん！
records.english:
Hehehe!
Even TEAM [GOOD_TEAM] joins us!\cBut it's too much trouble to deal with
you all...\cHeh, it doesn't matter!\cWe've got the METEORITE, so off to
MT. CHIMNEY we go!\cHehehe! Be seeing you, you TEAM
[GOOD_TEAM] dingbats!

records.japanese:
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか\cわたしは　マツブサ！
マグマだんを　ひきいて　アクアだんのやぼうを　そし　しているんだ！\cなぜなら　あいつら　アクアだんは
うみを　ふやす　といって\cはかいかつどうを　つづける
きけんな　しゅうだん　だからね‥‥\cだいちを　こよなく　あいする
われわれ　マグマだんの　てき　だよ！
records.english:
And you are?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cFine, so you are [PLAYER][KUN].\cI am MAXIE. As the head of TEAM MAGMA,
I have dedicated myself to thwartingthe dangerous plans of TEAM AQUA.\cWhy? Because TEAM AQUA is a grave
threat to us all.\cThey have committed many destructive
acts in their bid to enlarge the sea.\cWe, TEAM MAGMA, love dry land above
all! TEAM AQUA is our sworn enemy!

records.japanese:
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか\cわたしは　アオギリ！
アクアだんを　ひきいて　マグマだんのやぼうを　そし　しているんだ！\cなぜなら　あいつら　マグマだんは
りくを　ふやす　といって\cはかいかつどうを　つづける
きけんな　しゅうだん　だからね‥‥\cうみを　こよなく　あいする
われわれ　アクアだんの　てき　だよ！
records.english:
Who might you be?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cAh, so you are [PLAYER][KUN].\cI am ARCHIE. As the head of TEAM AQUA,
I have dedicated myself to thwartingthe dangerous plans of TEAM MAGMA.\cWhy? Because TEAM MAGMA is a grave
threat to us all.\cThey have committed many destructive
acts in their bid to expand the land.\cWe, TEAM AQUA, love the sea above
all! TEAM MAGMA is our sworn enemy!

records.japanese: [GOOD_LEADER]さま\nにげた　[EVIL_TEAM]だんを　おいかけないと‥‥
[GOOD_LEADER]『そうだな！\cいそがねば　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　やつら\nえんとつやまで　なにを　するか　わからない！
records.english: [GOOD_LEADER]: Yes, yes, we must!\nWe've got to hurry.\cThere's no telling what TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]\nwill do at MT. CHIMNEY!

records.japanese: [GOOD_LEADER]『[PLAYER][KUN]　きみも\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんには　きを　つけたまえ！\cでは　さらばだ！
records.english: [GOOD_LEADER]: [PLAYER][KUN], you should keep\nan eye out for TEAM [EVIL_TEAM], too.\cFarewell!

records.japanese:
ぼく‥‥　ソライシ
いつもは　ハジツゲで　いんせきのけんきゅうを　している　はかせ　だけど‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]だん　という　れんちゅうが
「りゅうせいのたきに　あんない　しろ！」「いんせきを　とりだして　やるから」っていうから　ここに　つれてきたんだ‥‥\cだけど　ぼく‥‥
[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　だまされたよ‥‥\cああ‥‥　もう　あの　いんせき
ぼくの　モノには　ならないよな‥‥\cしかし　[EVIL_TEAM]だん‥‥
えんとつやまで　いんせきを　つかってなにを　するんだろう‥‥？
records.english:
I... I'm COZMO...
I'm a PROFESSOR...\cI usually study METEORITES in
FALLARBOR TOWN...\cThen some people from TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
made me guide them to METEOR FALLS...\cThey promised me that they would
excavate METEORITES for me...\cBut, I...
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] tricked me...\cOh... That METEORITE...
It will never be mine now...\cBut that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]...\cWhat are they going to do with that
METEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

records.japanese: ソライシ『[EVIL_TEAM]だん‥‥\nえんとつやまで　いんせきを　つかって\rなにを　するんだろう‥‥？
records.english: PROF. COZMO: That TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]...\cWhat are they going to do with that\nMETEORITE at MT. CHIMNEY?

records.japanese: ここは　オレたち\nドラゴンつかいの　しゅぎょうの　ばしょ！\cチャンピオンも　くる　ばしょ　といったら\nその　すごさ　わかるだろうか！？
records.english: This is where we DRAGON users do our\ntraining.\cThe CHAMPION even visits.\nNow do you see how special it is here?

records.japanese: くっ！\nこれほど　つよいとは‥‥！
records.english: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

records.japanese: まだまだ　みちは　ながく　けわしい\cオレと　オレの　ポケモンが\nいちばんに　なれるのは　いつだろう‥‥
records.english: The road ahead remains long and harsh.\cWhen will my POKéMON and I become the\nbest?

records.japanese: あれから　いちばん　めざして\nかなり　じぶんたちを　きたえた‥‥\cどれほど　つよくなったか\nきみで　たしかめさせて　もらおうッ！
records.english: Since we met, we have trained hard\nwith our sights on number one.\cHelp us see how much stronger we've\nbecome!

records.japanese: くっ！\nこれほど　つよいとは‥‥！
records.english: Urgh!\nI didn't expect you to be so strong!

records.japanese: あいかわらず　ポケモンを　きたえてるな\cきみが　その　つよさで　あるかぎり\nオレも　つよくなれるよ！
records.english: You've obviously kept up your\nPOKéMON training.\cSo long as you remain strong, I, too,\ncan become stronger!

records.japanese: ゲン『わしらは　いつも　ふうふで\nポケモンを　しておるからのう\rしょうぶにも　じしんが　あるんじゃよ
records.english: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\rWe've confidence in ourselves.

records.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nまけたよ　ばあさん
records.english: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

records.japanese: ゲン『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nそういや　いちども　ばあさんに\rポケモンしょうぶで　かってないのう
records.english: JOHN: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cCome to think of it, I've yet to beat\nmy dear wife in a battle.

records.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナー　じゃな！\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれてきなされ
records.english: JOHN: Well, well, what a young TRAINER!\cWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

records.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nわたしら　ふうふの　きずなは\rどんな　ものでも　きれませんよ
records.english: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cThe bond we share as a couple could\nnever be broken.

records.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nまけましたよ　じいさん
records.english: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

records.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nふうふげんかに　なるたび\rポケモンしょうぶを　していましたねえ
records.english: JAY: Fifty years of marriage...\cIf we ever argued, we always settled\nit with a POKéMON battle...

records.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナーさん　ですねえ\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれておいで
records.english: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\cIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

records.japanese: ゲン『わしらは　いつも　ふうふで\nポケモンを　たのしんでおる　からのう\rしょうぶにも　じしんが　あるんじゃよ
records.english: JOHN: We've always battled POKéMON\ntogether as a twosome.\rWe've confidence in ourselves.

records.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nまけたよ　ばあさん
records.english: JOHN: Oh, my.\nWe've lost, dear wife.

records.japanese: ゲン『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nそういや　まいにち　まいにち\rばあさんと　しょうぶ　していたのう
records.english: JOHN: Married for fifty years...\cOn reflection, the dear wife and I,\nwe battled day in and day out...

records.japanese: ゲン『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナー　じゃな！\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれてきなされ
records.english: JOHN: Well, well, what a young\nTRAINER!\cWill you battle with us? If so, you'll\nhave to return with more POKéMON.

records.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nおたがいを　ささえあってきた\rわたしら　ふうふは　つよいですよ
records.english: JAY: We've been married for\nfifty years.\cWe've supported each other all that\ntime. We've made ourselves strong.

records.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nまけましたよ　じいさん
records.english: JAY: Oh, dear.\nWe've lost, my dear husband.

records.japanese: ハツ『けっこんして　５０ねん‥‥\nいろんなことが　ありましたねえ\cこれからも　じいさんと　いっしょに\nたのしいことが　つづくと　いいですわねえ
records.english: JAY: Fifty years of marriage...\nMany things have happened.\cI hope that we will continue to make\nhappy memories together.

records.japanese: ハツ『おやおや\nわかい　トレーナーさん　ですねえ\cわしらと　しょうぶ　してくれるのなら\nポケモンを　もっと　つれておいで
records.english: JAY: Well, well, aren't you a young\nTRAINER?\cIf you'd care to battle with us, you'll\nhave to come back with more POKéMON.

records.japanese: くるのか？\nくるなら　こいよ！
records.english: What, are you coming?\nCome and get some, then!

records.japanese: ピーコちゃん『ピ　ピひょー！

えーい　くっそー！\cうばった　ポケモンは
なんの　やくにも　たたないし\cいいところへ　にげこめたと　おもったのに
この　トンネル　いきどまり　じゃねーか！\cやい！　おまえ！
おれと　しょうぶ　するんだな！？
records.english:
Grah, keelhaul it all!\cThat hostage POKéMON turned out to
be worthless!\cAnd to think I made a getaway...
In this tunnel to nowhere!\cHey! You!
So you want to battle me?

records.japanese: む　むぐぐー！\nおれの　あくじも　いきどまりかっ！
records.english: Urrrggh! My career in crime comes to\na dead end!

records.japanese: おかしいなあ‥‥\cリーダーの　はなしでは　なにかの　にもつを\nデボンから　ぬすんでくる　っていう\rらくな　しごと　だった　はずなのに‥‥\cちぇっ！\nこんなもん　かえして　やらあ！
records.english:
This is plain not right...\cThe BOSS told me this would be a
slick-and-easy job to pull.\cAll I had to do was steal some package
from DEVON.\cTch!
You want it back that badly, take it!

records.japanese: ピーコちゃん！　ぶじで　よかった！
records.english: PEEKO! Am I glad to see you're safe!

records.japanese:
あんたは　ピーコちゃんの
いのちの　おんじん　じゃよ！\cわしは　ハギと　いうのじゃが
きみは‥‥？\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cそうか　[PLAYER][KUN]と　いうのか！
ほんとうに　ありがとうよ！\cこれからさき　こまった　ことが　あったら
えんりょなく　わしに　いっとくれ！\cいつもは　トウカのもりの　ちかくに　ある
はまべの　こやに　いるからの！\cさあ　ピーコちゃん
わしらの　おうちに　かえろうな！\cピーコちゃん『ピひょーっ！！
records.english:
PEEKO owes her life to you!\cThey call me MR. BRINEY.
And, you are?\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cAh, so you are [PLAYER][KUN]!
I sincerely thank you!\cNow, if there's anything that troubles
you, don't hesitate to tell me!\cYou can usually find me in my cottage
by the sea near PETALBURG WOODS.\cCome, PEEKO, we should make our way
home.\cPEEKO: Pihyoh!

records.japanese:
‥‥\cどうして　これいじょう　ほれない‥‥
この　いわが　かたすぎるのか？\cこのさきの　シダケタウンという　ところに
あいする　かのじょが　いるのに‥‥\cカナズミと　シダケを　トンネルで　むすべば
まいにち　かのじょに　あいに　いける\cそれなのに‥‥
おれは　どうすれば　いいんだ‥‥
records.english:
... ...\cWhy can't they keep digging?
Is the bedrock too hard?\cMy beloved awaits me in VERDANTURF
TOWN just beyond here...\cIf RUSTBORO and VERDANTURF were
joined by this tunnel, I could visither every day...\cBut this...
What am I to do?

records.japanese: カナズミから　シダケに　いこうと　すると\nムロから　カイナと　キンセツを　とおって\rいかなきゃ　ならないんだ‥‥
records.english: To get from RUSTBORO to VERDANTURF,\nyou need to go to DEWFORD, then pass\rthrough SLATEPORT and MAUVILLE...

records.japanese: なんと！　きみが　この　いわを\nくだいて　くれたんだね\cかんしゃの　しるし　として\nこの　ひでんマシンを　うけとってくれ
records.english: Wow! You shattered that boulder\nblocking the way.\cTo show you how much I appreciate it,\nI'd like you to have this HM.

records.japanese: そいつには　かいりきが　はいっている\nちからもちの　ポケモンに　おぼえさせれば\rおおきな　いわを　うごかせるよ
records.english: That HM contains STRENGTH.\cIf a muscular POKéMON were to learn\nthat, it would be able to move even\rlarge boulders.

records.japanese: ミチルさん！\nこれから　いつでも　あえます！\cミチル『よかった‥‥　です\cさあ　わたしの　いえで\nゆっくり　やすんで　ください
records.english: WANDA!\nNow I can see you anytime!\cWANDA: That's...wonderful.\cPlease, take some rest at my home.

records.japanese:
この　いわの　むこうに‥‥
わたしの　かれが　いるの\cかれ‥‥　わたしに　あうため　だけに
トンネルを　ほってるわけ　じゃないわ\cみんなの　ために
てを　きずつけながらも　がんばってるの
records.english:
On the other side of this rock...
My boyfriend is there.\cHe... He's not just digging the tunnel
to come see me.\cHe works his hands raw and rough
for the benefit of everyone.

records.japanese: おとこが　やまに　いるから　やまおとこ！\cなのに　ポケモンが　やまに　いても\nやまポケモンと　いわないのは　なぜだ？
records.english: What do you call a wild man up in the\nmountains? A mountain man, right?\cSo why don't they call a POKéMON in the\nmountains a mountain POKéMON?

records.japanese: ポケモン‥‥\nちから　つきた‥‥
ここって　ポケモンを　まもるため\nかいはつ　こうじを　やめたんだろ？\rそれって　いい　はなし　だよな
records.english: They halted development here to\nprotect POKéMON, right?\rThere's a feel-good story!

records.japanese:
おい　おまえ
このさきは　くらいからたんけん　するのも　たいへん　だぞ！\cさっきの　おとこ‥‥
ダイゴって　いったっけか？\cあいつは　フラッシュが　つかえたから
だいじょうぶ　だろうが‥‥\cうむ！　やまおとこは　であった
あいてに　やさしく　するのが　モットー！これを　ゆずってやると　するか！
records.english:
Hey, you.
It gets awfully dark ahead.It'll be tough trying to explore.\cThat guy who came by earlier...
STEVEN, I think it was.\cHe knew how to use FLASH, so he ought
to be all right, but...\cWell, for us HIKERS, helping out those
that we meet is our motto.\cHere you go, I'll pass this on to you.

records.japanese:
ひでん　フラッシュを
ポケモンに　おぼえさせて　つかうとだな\cまっくらな　どうくつも
あかるく　てらせるんだぞ！\cまあ　つかうには　ムロ　ポケモンジムの
ジムバッジが　ひつよう　だがな
records.english:
Teach that hidden move FLASH to a
POKéMON and use it.\cIt lights up even the inky darkness
of caves.\cBut, to use it, you need the GYM BADGE
from DEWFORD's POKéMON GYM.

records.japanese:
きみの　それ‥‥
ポケナビ　じゃないか\cたしか　ポケナビを　もっている
トレーナーどうしで　しょうぶを　するときろく　されて　いくんだよね\cしつれい
ボクの　なまえは　ダイゴ\cめずらしい　いしに　きょうみが　あって
あちこち　たび　してるんだよ\cえっ？
ボクに　てがみ‥‥？
records.english:
That device you have there...
It's a POKéNAV.\cWhen TRAINERS that have POKéNAVS
battle, it keeps a record of howthings went, I think.\cOh, pardon me.
My name is STEVEN.\cI'm interested in rare stones, so
I travel here and there.\cOh?
A LETTER for me?

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『うん　ありがとう\cわざわざ　とどけて　くれたんだ
なにか　おれいを　させてもらうよ\cそうだね
この　わざマシンを　あげよう\cはがねのつばさ　といって
ボクの　おきにいりの　わざ　だから
records.english:
STEVEN: Okay, thank you.\cYou went through all this trouble to
deliver that. I need to thank you.\cLet me see...
I'll give you this TM.\cIt contains my favorite move,
STEEL WING.

records.japanese:
ダイゴ『きみの　ポケモン
なかなか　いい　かんじ　だね\cしゅぎょうを　つづければ
いつかは　ポケモンリーグのチャンピオンに　だって　なれるボクは　そう　おもうな\c‥‥じゃあ
ボクは　さきを　いそぐから
records.english: STEVEN: Your POKéMON appear quite\ncapable.\cIf you keep training, you could even\nbecome the CHAMPION of the POKéMON\rLEAGUE one day. That's what I think.\cNow, I've got to hurry along.

records.japanese: バッグが　いっぱい　なのか‥‥\nじゃあ　しかたないね
records.english: Oh, your BAG is full...\nThat's too bad, then.

records.japanese: うーん\nいないなあ‥‥
records.english: Hmmm...\nNot a one to be found...

records.japanese: ねえ　きみきみ　このあたりで\nキノココって　ポケモン　みなかった？\cおじさん　あの　ポケモン　すき　なのよね
records.english: Hello, have you seen any POKéMON\ncalled SHROOMISH around here?\cI really love that POKéMON.

records.japanese: まちぶせ　していたのに\nいつまでも　トウカのもりで　うろうろと‥‥\cまちくたびれたから　きてやったぞ！
records.english: I was going to ambush you, but you\nhad to dawdle in PETALBURG WOODS\rforever, didn't you?\cI got sick of waiting, so here I am!

records.japanese: やい！　デボンの　けんきゅういん！\cその　しょるいを　こっちに　よこしやがれ！
records.english: You! DEVON RESEARCHER!\cHand over those papers!

records.japanese: ひやー！\cきみ　ポケモントレーナー　だよね\nおじさんを　たすけてよぉ
records.english: Aiyeeeh!\cYou're a POKéMON TRAINER, aren't you?\nYou've got to help me, please!

records.japanese: ‥‥ん？　なんだ　おまえ？\nそいつを　かばおう　ってのか？\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　じゃまを　する　やつは\nこどもでも　ようしゃ　しねえ！\rしょうぶ　しやがれ！
records.english: Hunh? What do you think you're doing?\nWhat, you're going to protect him?\cNo one who crosses TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]\ngets any mercy, not even a kid!\cCome on and battle me!

records.japanese: ‥‥つ　つよい　じゃねーか！

むむむ‥‥　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの
じゃまを　するとは　なんて　やつ！もう　いっかい　しょうぶ　しろ！\c‥‥と　いいたい　ところ　だが
もう　てもちの　ポケモンは　いない\cそれに　カナズミ　シティにも　[EVIL_TEAM]だんが
ねらっている　ものが　あるからな！\cきょうは　これぐらいに　しといてやらぁ！
records.english:
Grrr... You've got some nerve
meddling with TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!Come on and battle me again!\cI wish I could say that, but I'm out of
POKéMON...\cAnd, hey, we of TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] are also
after something in RUSTBORO.\cI'll let you go today!

records.japanese:
‥‥ふぅ
あぶない　ところ　だった！\cきみの　おかげで　だいじな　しょるいを
うばわれないで　すんだよ！\c‥‥そうだ！　おれいに
スーパーボールを　あげちゃおう！
records.english:
Whew...
That was awfully close!\cThanks to you, he didn't rob me of
these important papers.\cI know, I'll give you a GREAT BALL as
my thanks!

records.japanese: ‥‥そういえば　さっき　[EVIL_TEAM]だんは\n「カナズミにも　ねらっている　ものがある」\rとか　いってたよね‥‥？
records.english: Didn't that TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] thug say\nthey were after something in\rRUSTBORO, too?

records.japanese: たいへんだ！！\nこうしちゃ　いられない！
records.english: Uh-oh! It's a crisis!\nI can't be wasting time!

records.japanese: どうぐ　いっぱいで\nスーパーボール　あげられないね
records.english: You're loaded with items.\nI can't give you this GREAT BALL.

records.japanese: ポケモン　いっぱい　つかまえた！\cそら　いけ！\nぼくの　むしポケモン　チーム！
records.english: I caught a whole bunch of POKéMON!\cGo, go, go!\nMy BUG POKéMON team!

records.japanese: こんなに　ポケモン　いるのに\nかてなかったのか‥‥
records.english: I have all these POKéMON, but I\ncouldn't win...

records.japanese: たくさん　ポケモン　つかまえたら\nモンスターボール　なくなっちゃったよ
records.english: I caught a bunch of POKéMON.\nNow I'm out of POKé BALLS.

records.japanese: むしポケモンを　がっこうに　もっていくと\nそれだけで　にんきもの　だろ！？
records.english: If you take BUG POKéMON to school,\nyou get to be instantly popular!

records.japanese: まけると　にんきものに　なれないや
records.english: I can't be popular if I lose.

records.japanese: でかい　むしポケモン　もってると\nそれだけで　そんけー　されるだろ！？
records.english: If you have a big BUG POKéMON, people\nrespect you for it.

records.japanese: ぼくの　むしポケモン　そだったぞ！\nこれで　また　にんきもの　だぜ！
records.english: My BUG POKéMON have grown.\nI'll be popular again.

records.japanese: まけると　にんきものに　なれないや
records.english: I can't be popular if I lose.

records.japanese: つよい　ポケモン　もってると\nにんきものに　なれるだろ？\rだから　がんばって　そだててるのさ！
records.english: You get to be popular if you have\nstrong POKéMON, right?\rSo, I've been training hard.

records.japanese: よお！　おまえの　ポケモン　げんき？\cてもちの　ポケモンが　よわっていて\nたたかわせたく　ないときは　なるべく\rくさむらを　よけて　あるくと　いいよ！
records.english: Yo, there!\nYour POKéMON doing okay?\cIf your POKéMON are weak and you want\nto avoid battles, you should stay out\rof tall grass.

records.japanese: みえて　いなくても\nどうぐが　おちてることが　あるから\rあしもとを　しらべて　いるんだ！
records.english: Sometimes, there are things on the\nground even if you can't see them.\cThat's why I always check where I'm\nwalking.

records.japanese: それって　カナズミの　ジムバッジ！\cあなた　トレーナーなのね\nこの　どうぐ　つかってみたら　どうかしら？
records.english: Oh, neat!\nThat's the BADGE from RUSTBORO GYM!\cYou must be a TRAINER.\nYou should try using this item.

records.japanese: きせきのタネを\nポケモンに　もたせてあげると　くさタイプの\rわざの　いりょくが　あがるのよ\cきせきのタネの　ほかにも\nポケモンに　もたせると　べんりな\rどうぐが　あるらしいわね
records.english: It's a MIRACLE SEED.\nIf a POKéMON holds that item, its\rGRASS-type moves become stronger.\cBesides MIRACLE SEED, I think there are\nother convenient items for POKéMON\rto hold.

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cしょうぶの　とき\nいちど　でも　かおをだした　ポケモンは\rけいけんちが　もらえます！\cよわい　ポケモンを　リストの　うえに　して\nしょうぶのとき　すぐに　こうたい！\rこれで　よわい　ポケモンも　そだちます！
records.english:
TRAINER TIPS\cAny POKéMON that appears even once
in a battle is awarded EXP Points.\cTo raise a weak POKéMON, put it at the
top of the team list.\cAs soon as a battle starts, switch it
out. It will earn EXP Points withoutbeing exposed to any harm.

records.japanese: おとくな　けいじばん！！\cポケモンには　ヒットポイントの　ほかに\nわざを　くりだす　ちからの　もと\rパワーポイント　というものが　あります\cわざの　パワーポイントが　なくなったときも\nポケモンセンターに　いきましょう！
records.english: TRAINER TIPS\cIn addition to Hit Points (HP), POKéMON\nhave Power Points (PP) that are used to\rmake moves during battle.\cIf a POKéMON runs out of PP, it must be\ntaken to a POKéMON CENTER.

records.japanese: えんとつやま　めいぶつ\nフエンせんべい　ひとつ　２００えん！\rかって　おいきよ
records.english: LAVA COOKIES are MT. CHIMNEY's local\nspecialty.\cTry one. It's just $200.

records.japanese: どうも　ありがとね
おやまあ　おかねが　なくちゃ\nものは　かえないよ
records.english: Oh, dear. You can't buy a thing if\nyou've not got the money.

records.japanese: あら　そうかい
なぞの　そうちに\nいんせきが　はめられている‥‥\cなにかの　エネルギーを\nためている　さいちゅうの　ようだ
records.english: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine...\cThe machine seems to be storing\nenergy in the METEORITE.

records.japanese: なぞの　そうちに\nいんせきが　はめられている‥‥\cいんせきを　とりますか？
records.english: A METEORITE is fitted on a mysterious\nmachine...\cDo you want to remove the METEORITE?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　いんせきを\nそうちから　とりはずした！
records.english: [PLAYER] removed the METEORITE from\nthe mysterious machine.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　いんせきを\nそのままに　しておいた
なぞの　そうち‥‥\nまったく　はんのう　しない‥‥
records.english: This mysterious machine...\nIt makes no response whatsoever.

records.japanese: [DOWN_ARROW]　デコボコさんどう\nとおりぬけると　フエンタウン
おんせんに　つかって\nリフレッシュ　してきたからねえ\rいまの　あたしゃあ　つよいよ！
records.english: I've been to the hot springs and\nrefreshed my tired bones.\rRight now I'm feeling strong!

records.japanese: おんや　まぁ\nたいした　もんだよ
records.english: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!

records.japanese: まけて　しもうたか\nこれじゃあ　たつじん　とは　いえないねえ
records.english: Well, well, I've lost. I can't call\nmyself an EXPERT now, can I?

records.japanese: ポケモンと　こころを　ひとつに　できれば\nすばらしいことが　できそうじゃの
records.english: If you can mesh your heart with those\nof your POKéMON, why, you should be\rable to achieve great things.

records.japanese: おんや　まぁ\nたいした　もんだよ
records.english: Oh, my goodness.\nNow, aren't you something!

records.japanese: おまえさんの　こころと\nポケモンの　こころは　ひとつ　なのかもな
records.english: Perhaps your heart has become one\nwith the hearts of your POKéMON.

records.japanese: なんだか　もえあがってきて\nたたかいたくて　たまらないのっ！
records.english: I've got the fire in me, baby.\nI can't stand it! I have to battle!

records.japanese: あつい　たたかい　だったわ
records.english: Ooh, that was a scorching-hot match!

records.japanese: えんとつやまの　あつさが\nおんなを　もえあがらせるの
records.english: The heat of MT. CHIMNEY lights my\nfire, baby!

records.japanese: せっかく　えんとつやまに　きたんだから\nここでも　ポケモンを　たたかわせたいの！
records.english: I've finally made it to MT. CHIMNEY.\nI want to make my POKéMON battle!

records.japanese: その　たたかいかた\nまさに　えんとつやま　だいふんか！
records.english: The way you battle...\nIt's like a MT. CHIMNEY eruption!

records.japanese: せっかく　えんとつやまに　きたんだから\nかんこう　だけじゃ　もったいないわ\cしょうぶも　たのしみたいし\nおみやげに　せんべい　かわなきゃ！
records.english: Like I said, I've finally made it to\nMT. CHIMNEY. It would be a shame if\rI only do a little sightseeing...\cI want to get in some battles and buy\nCOOKIES as souvenirs.

records.japanese: おんせんに　はいったら\nちょうし　バッチリ　なのよね！\rぜったい　かてるわ！
records.english: Since I bathed in the hot springs,\nI've been feeling great!\rI'm sure I'm going to win!

records.japanese: うーん　ゆざめ　しちゃう
records.english: Yowch!\nI'm getting a chill out of the water.

records.japanese: もういちど　おんせんに　はいらなきゃ！\nあなたも　いっしょに　はいる？\cなんてねっ！
records.english: I'll have to take another dip in the\nhot springs. Want to join me?\cJust joking!

records.japanese: えんとつやまの　デコボコさんどう\nまさに　わたしが　もとめていた　やま！\rこの　デコボコした　ところが　たまらん！
records.english: MT. CHIMNEY's JAGGED PASS...\cNow this is what I've always wanted\nin a mountain.\cThis jagged bumpiness...\nIt rocks my soul!

records.japanese: まけて　くやしいぞ！
たしかに　ポケモンでは　まけた‥‥\cだが　やまを　あいする　きもちなら\nわたしの　ほうが　まさっているだろ！
records.english: Yes, I did lose at POKéMON...\cBut, when it comes to the love of\nthe mountains, I have you beat!

records.japanese: ここは　きがるに　のぼって　いけないもの\nちょっと　ピクニックむき　じゃないわ
records.english: This place isn't your casual hike.\nIt's not suited for a picnic.

records.japanese: あーん　もう！\nしたが　デコボコだから‥‥
records.english: Ohhh, no!\nThe ground is too bumpy...

records.japanese: こんな　デコボコしたところ\nじてんしゃで　じょうずに　のぼっていく\rひとも　いるのよ！
records.english: Did you know?\cSome people cleverly ride their\nbicycles up this horribly bumpy pass.

records.japanese: どんな　みちも　ピクニックは　たのしい！\nポケモンも　いっしょ　だしね！
records.english: Picnics are fun wherever you go.\nJust like POKéMON!

records.japanese: まけたのは\nしたが　デコボコだからよ！
records.english: I only lost because the ground is\ntoo bumpy!

records.japanese: まけたことは　さっさと　わすれて\nこの　デコボコみちを　たのしんじゃお！
records.english: I'll forget about losing and just\nenjoy this bumpy hike.

records.japanese: この　デコボコさんどうは　あるきにくい！\nポケモンを　きたえるのに　むいてるよ！
records.english: JAGGED PASS is hard to walk on.\nIt's a good place for training.

records.japanese: あしばを　きにしてる　うちに\nおわっちゃった　かんじだ‥‥
records.english: It was all over while we were still\ntrying to find a good footing...

records.japanese: ぼくも　ダートじてんしゃ　もっていれば\nだんさを　とびこえて　いけるのにな
records.english: If I had an ACRO BIKE, I'd be able to\njump ledges.

records.japanese: デコボコに　なれちゃったから\nちかごろだと　うたいながら　のぼるのさ！
records.english: I got used to this bumpiness.\nI sing while I climb now.

records.japanese: やっぱり　デコボコだと\nたたかいにくいよ‥‥
records.english: It's still not easy to battle on this\nbumpy ground...

records.japanese: ぼくも　キンセツで　カゼノさんから\nダートじてんしゃ　もらおうかな
records.english: I should get an ACRO BIKE from RYDEL\nin MAUVILLE CITY...

records.japanese: この　おくりびやま　には\nいろんな　ものが　さまよっておる‥‥\cなにが　おきるか　わからん\nねんのため　これを　もっていきなされ
records.english: All sorts of beings wander the slopes\nof MT. PYRE...\cThere is no telling what may happen.\nTake this. It's for your own good.

records.japanese: きよめのおふだ　をな\nポケモンに　もたせて　おく\cすると　やせいの　ポケモンが\nあんまり　とびだして　こなくなるぞよ
records.english: Have a POKéMON hold that\nCLEANSE TAG.\cIt will help ward off wild POKéMON.

records.japanese: あなたも　おはか　まいりに　きたの？\nずいぶんと　ポケモン　おもい　なのね
records.english: Did you come to pay your respect\nto the spirits of departed POKéMON?\cYou must care for your POKéMON a lot.

records.japanese: ここには　ぼくが　たいせつに　していた\nジグザグマが　やすらかに　ねむってる‥‥
records.english: This is the final resting place of my\nZIGZAGOON. I cherished it...

records.japanese: テル『きもだめし　するんだ！\nぼくの　かっこいい　ところ　みれば\rかのじょ　もっと　ほれるからね！\cそうだ！　きみを　たおして\nかっこいい　ところ　みせちゃおう！
records.english: LUKE: We're here on a dare.\cHeheh, if I show her how cool I am,\nshe'll fall for me. I know it!\cI know! I'll cream you and show her\nhow cool I am!

records.japanese: テル『あっちゃー
テル『まけちゃったけど　だいじょうぶ！\nぼくが　いるからさ\rきもだめし　なんて　へっちゃら　だよ！
records.english: LUKE: Well, we lost but that's okay!\nI'm right here by your side.\rWe'll make it through this dare!

records.japanese: テル『ぼくと　しょうぶ　するなら\nもっと　ポケモン　つれてきなよ！\cそうでないと　ぼく　かのじょの　まえで\nかっこいい　ところ　みせちゃうからさ！
records.english: LUKE: If you want to take me on, bring\nsome more POKéMON.\cIf you don't, I won't be able to show\noff how cool I am to my girl!

records.japanese: マコ『かれしと　きもだめしに　きたの\nすっごく　こわいけど\rかれしが　いるから　だいじょうぶ！\cそうだ！　あなたを　たおす\nかれしの　かっこいい　ところ　みせちゃう！
records.english:
DEZ: I came here on a dare with my
boyfriend.\cIt's really scary, but I'm with my
boyfriend. It's okay.\cI know! I'll get my boyfriend to look
cool by beating you!

records.japanese: マコ『あーん　こわーい！
マコ『あたしたち　ラブラブだから\nまけても　へいき　なんだもん！
records.english: DEZ: We're lovey-dovey, so we don't\ncare if we lose!

records.japanese: マコ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nせめて　２ひきは　ポケモン　いないと\cあたしの　かれし　つよいんだから\nいっぴきじゃ　はなしに　ならないわ
records.english: DEZ: If you want to challenge us, you\nshould bring at least two POKéMON.\cMy boyfriend's strong.\nJust one POKéMON won't do at all.

records.japanese: かわいかった　エネコとの　おもいで‥‥\nおもいだすだけで　なみだが　あふれる‥‥
records.english: Memories of my darling SKITTY...\nMy eyes overflow thinking about it.

records.japanese: アイタタタ‥‥　ゆかの　そこかしこに\nあなが　あいているのに　きづかないで\rおじさん　うえから　おちてしまったよ
records.english: Ooch, ouch... There are holes in the\nground here and there.\cI didn't notice and took a tumble from\nthe floor above.

records.japanese: おまえも　ポケモン　さがしに　きたのか？\nあとから　きた　くせに　なまいきだ！
records.english: Hey! Are you searching for POKéMON?\nYou came along after me! You're rude!

records.japanese: ふええええええっ！\nゆるして　くださいーっ！
めったに　ひとが　はいらない　やま　だから\nめずらしい　ポケモンが　いると　おもってさ
records.english: People don't come here often, so\nI thought there'd be rare POKéMON.

records.japanese: れいげん　あらたかな　やまの　ちからで\nサイコパワーの　アップした　わたしに\rこどもの　おまえが　かてるかな！？
records.english: The rich atmosphere of the mountain\nhas elevated my psychic power!\cA mere child like you...\nYou dream of winning?

records.japanese: アップ　アップ‥‥
わたしの　サイコパワーは　かくじつに\nつよく　なっている　はずなのに‥‥
records.english: My psychic powers have surely\ngrown several times, but...

records.japanese: おほほほほっ！\cここは　あなたの　ような　こどもが\nくる　ばしょ　では　ないのよっ！
records.english: Ahahahaha!\cThis is no place for children, least\nof all you!

records.japanese: あっさり　まけたわっ‥‥！
まだまだ　しゅぎょうが　たりないのね‥‥\nさんちょうを　めざすわよ‥‥！\cファイト！　わたし！
records.english: This means my training is still not\nenough...\cI've got to keep working toward the\nsummit...\cGo, me!

records.japanese: おししょうさま‥‥\nいまの　わたしの　じつりょく\rみていて　ください！
おししょうさま‥‥\nすんません‥‥
もっと　つよくならないと\nここに　ねむる　おししょうさまも\rあんしん　できないよな‥‥
records.english: Until I improve, my teacher, who rests\nhere, will never find true peace...

records.japanese: こわいものが　すきで‥‥\nすきで　すきで　たまらない‥‥\cあたし　ここに　いると\nこわくて　ふるえるの‥‥
records.english: I love all things horrifying...\nIt's like a disease...\cWhen I'm here...\nI shiver with fear...

records.japanese: まけるのは　きらい‥‥
こわいもの　みたさで\nここから　はなれられないの‥‥\cねえ‥‥\nあなたも　いっしょに　いない‥‥？
records.english: I want to see dreadful things...\nI can't leave...\cStay...\nWon't you stay with me?

records.japanese: ここに　いると‥‥\nなにかの　ちからが　はいってくるの‥‥
records.english: When I'm here...\nA curious power flows into me...

records.japanese: ちからが　ぬけていく‥‥
ここに　ねむっている　ポケモンたちの\nちからが　はいって　くるのかもよ‥‥？
records.english: Perhaps the power is from the spirits\nof POKéMON in fitful sleep here...

records.japanese: あなたの　うしろ‥‥\nなにが　いるの‥‥？
なにかが　きえたわ‥‥
ここに　ねむっている　ポケモンたち‥‥\nときどき　あそんでいる　みたいなの‥‥
records.english: The POKéMON at rest here...\nSometimes, they play...

records.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーだったら　いま　だいじな　ものを
ぶんどりに　でかけていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥どこに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
records.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here! He's gone off to
snatch something important!\c... ...
Where did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

records.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーだったら　いま　せんすいていを
ぶんどりに　でかけていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥どこに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
records.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here!
He's gone off to jack a submarine!\c... ...
Where did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

records.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーは　いま　１２２ばん　すいどうの
おくりびやまに　むかっていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥なにしに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
records.english:
What? What? What do you want with 
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here! He's on his way to
MT. PYRE on ROUTE 122!\c... ...
Why did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

records.japanese:
なんだ　なんだ！
おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　なんの　ようだ！\cリーダーは　いま　カイナシティに
むかっていて　るすだぞ！\c‥‥なにしに　いったのか　だって？\cわはははっ！　そんな　だいじな　ことを
おしえられる　わけ　ないだろうが！
records.english:
What? What? What do you want with
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]?\cOur BOSS isn't here!
He's on his way to SLATEPORT CITY!\c... ...
Why did he go?\cWahaha! Do you really think I'd tell
you something that crucial?

records.japanese: ややや！\nあやしい　じんぶつを　はっけーん！
うーむ　まけちまったかー！
しょうぶには　まけたが\nおれは　やくめを　はたしたのだ‥‥
records.english: I took the loss for the TEAM, but\nI did my job...

records.japanese: アジトの　ひみつを　しりたけりゃ\nおれを　たおす　ことだな！
records.english: If you want to know the secret about\nour HIDEOUT, you have me to beat!

records.japanese: ぜんぜん　かてません‥‥！
アジトの　ひみつ？\cそれはな‥‥　いちばん　おくに\nせんすいていが　あるって　ことよ！\cだが　いまごろは　いひひひ‥‥！
records.english: Our HIDEOUT's secret?\cWell, let's just say...\nThere's a submarine at the far end!\cBut, by now...\nKekekeke...

records.japanese: ねんりょうの　ほきゅう　オッケイ！\nおやつも　ほきゅう　オッケイ！\cあとは　ジャマものを　ぶっとばす　だけ！
records.english: Fuel supply loaded A-OK!\nIn-cruise snacks loaded A-OK!\cNothing left to do but KO a pesky\nmeddler!

records.japanese: こっぴどく　やられたーっ！
ふん！　これで　いいんだ\cおまえの　ジャマをする　というのが\nおれの　にんむ　だったのさ
records.english: Humph!\nThis was supposed to happen!\cMy mission was to just hold you up!

records.japanese: はーあ　アジトで　るすばんも\nたいくつ　だから　あいて　してあげるわー
records.english: Yawn... Keeping watch over the\nHIDEOUT bores me. I'll take you on.

records.japanese: はーあ　まけたわー
あんまり　うろちょろ　してると\nほかの　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　やられるかもよー
records.english: If you scurry too much, other TEAM\n[EVIL_TEAM] members might get you.

records.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥\cもう　ここまで　きたのか！
おもって　いたより　やるな！\cだが　ここまでだ！
おれは　これまでの　したっぱども　とはひとあじ　ちがう！\cじかんかせぎ　なんか　しねえで
おまえを　コテンパンに　してやるぜ！
records.english:
Hehehe...\cGot here already, did you?
We underestimated you!\cBut this is it!\cI'm a cut above the GRUNTS you've seen
so far.\cI'm not stalling for time. I'm going
to pulverize you!

records.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥\nまけちまったか‥‥
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cおれが　おまえと\nあそんで　やっている　あいだに\rリーダーの　じゅんびが　ととのったぜ！
records.english: Hehehe!\cWhile I was toying with you, our BOSS\ngot through his preparations!

records.japanese:
ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cリーダーは　どこかの　かいていにある
どうくつへ　しゅっぱつ　したぜ！\cおいかける　つもりなら　ミナモの　さきに
ひろがる　でっかい　うみをさがしまわって　みるが　いいぜ！\cそれで　みつかれば　いいけどな‥‥
ウヒョヒョヒョ！
records.english:
Hehehe!\cOur BOSS has already gone on his way to
some cave under the sea!\cIf you're going to give chase, you'd
better search the big, wide sea beyondLILYCOVE.\cBut will you find it then?
Hehehe!

records.japanese: わっはっは　まちくたびれたぞ！\nおいらとも　しょうぶ　してもらおうか！
records.english: Wahahah, I grew weary of waiting!\nYou owe me a battle, too!

records.japanese: まちくたびれて\nまけて　やぶれて‥‥
リーダーぁ‥‥\nこんなもんで　どうでしょー！
アジト　じまんの　ワープパネル！\cいま　じぶんが　どこに　いるのか\nわかって　ないでしょ！\cそうやって　つかれはてた　あいてを\nたおすのが　さくせん　なのよ！
records.english:
Warp panels, the HIDEOUT's pride
and joy!\cYou're clueless about where you are,
aren't you?\cFluster and tire out the enemy, then
lower the boom! That's our plan!

records.japanese: なによっ！\nちっとも　つかれてない　じゃない！
records.english: What's wrong with you?\nYou're not tired at all!

records.japanese: そういえば‥‥　マスターボールを\nどこに　おいたのか　わすれちゃったわ\cあれを　まもっていないと\nリーダーに　おこられるのよ‥‥
records.english: That reminds me... I can't remember\nwhere I put the MASTER BALL.\cIf I fail to guard it, our BOSS will\nchew me out...

records.japanese:
せんすいてい　には
「かいえん　１ごう」と　かかれている\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんが　カイナから
うばって　いった　せんすいてい　だ！\c[EVIL_TEAM]だんは
ここから　うえに　あがったみたいだ
records.english:
“SUBMARINE EXPLORER 1” is painted
on the hull.\cThis is the submarine TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]
stole in SLATEPORT!\cTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] must have gone
ashore here.

records.japanese: こどもに　ようは　ねーんだ\nほら　さっさと　かえれよ！
records.english: We don't need a kid around!\nGo on home already!

records.japanese: おれが　かえりたいよー！
はやく　かんぶに　なって\nしたっぱを　しごいて　やりたい‥‥
records.english: I want to get a promotion so I can\nboss around the GRUNTS...

records.japanese: せんすいてい　ちっちゃいからよー\nからだの　あちこちが　いたい　じゃねーか！
records.english: That submarine... It's tiny inside.\nI'm sore all over!

records.japanese: まけたら\nいたい　じゃねーか！
うばった　せんすいていの　のりごこち\nありゃ　さいあく　だな！\rとにかく　せますぎ　じゃねーか！
records.english: That submarine we jacked, man, it's\nbrutal as a ride.\rIt's way too tight in there!

records.japanese:
オーッホッホ！\cせんすいていも　ないのに
よく　ここまで　おいかけて　きたわね！たいした　おこさま　だわ！\cでもね‥‥
ジャマされると　めんどう　なのよね\cてんき　けんきゅうじょ　での
かりも　かえしたいし‥‥\cちょっと　いたい　おもい　させちゃうから
かくご　しなさーい！！
records.english:
Ahahahaha!\cHow did you manage to get here without
a submarine?What an impressive child!\cBut... It won't do to have you
meddling about here.\cAnd, I do want payback for what
happened at the WEATHER INSTITUTE...\cI'm going to give you a little taste
of pain! Resign yourself to it!

records.japanese: オーッホッホ！\cいったーい！
オーッホッホ！\cあなた　そんなに　つよいんだもの\n[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　なかま　じゃなくて\rとっても　ざんねんだわ\cリーダーが　じつげん　してくれる\nすばらしい　せかいを\rいっしょに　たのしむことが　できたのに
records.english:
Ahahahaha!
You're so darn strong.\cIt's terribly disappointing that you're
not a TEAM [EVIL_TEAM] member.\cYou could have enjoyed the fabulous
world our BOSS has promised to oneof our own...

records.japanese: だれだ　おまえ？\nどこから　はいってきた？
records.english: Who are you?\nWhere did you come in from?

records.japanese: まけた‥‥！
でぐちが　わかんねーんだよ\cこわがってる　わけじゃ　ねーぞ\nかんちがい　すんなよ！
records.english: I can't find the way out!\cI'm not afraid. Don't get me wrong!

records.japanese:
ミツル『あっ！　[PLAYER]さん！\cぼくが　こんな　ところに　いるなんて
おどろいた　でしょ！\cぼくが　ここまで　これたのは
[PLAYER]さんの　おかげだよ！\cあのとき　[PLAYER]さんに　まけたから
ぼくは　つよく　なれたんだ！\c‥‥だけど！
ぼくは　もう　まけない\cぼくに　ゆうきと　げんきを　くれた
ポケモンの　ためにも　かつんだ！\cそれでは‥‥　いきますよ！
records.english:
WALLY: Hi! [PLAYER]!\cI bet you're surprised to see me here!\cI made it all the way here, and it's
all thanks to you!\c[PLAYER], losing to you that time
made me stronger!\cBut I'm not going to lose anymore!\cI'm going to win! For the POKéMON who
gave me courage and strength!\cOkay... Here I come!

records.japanese: うわぁ！\nやっぱり　[PLAYER]さんは　つよいよ！
records.english: Wow!\n[PLAYER], you are strong, after all!

records.japanese: ミツル『‥‥　こんかいは\n[PLAYER]さんに　かてなかった　けど\rいつか　きっと　おいついて　みせるからね！
records.english: WALLY: I couldn't beat you today,\n[PLAYER], but one of these days, I'll\rcatch up to you!

records.japanese: ミツル『あっ！　[PLAYER]さん！\cぼく　あれから　つよくなった　はずだよ！\nそれを　[PLAYER]さんに\rみてもらいたいんだ！\cそれでは‥‥　いきますよ！
records.english: WALLY: Hi! [PLAYER]!\cI've gotten stronger since that last\ntime! I wanted to show you, [PLAYER]!\cOkay... Here I come!

records.japanese: うわぁ！\nやっぱり　[PLAYER]さんは　つよいよ！
records.english: Wow!\n[PLAYER], you are strong, after all!

records.japanese: ミツル『‥‥　こんかいも\n[PLAYER]さんに　かてなかった　けど\rいつか　きっと　おいついて‥‥\cポケモンリーグに　ちょうせん　するんだ！
records.english: WALLY: I couldn't beat you this time,\ntoo... But one of these days, [PLAYER],\rI'm going to catch up to you...\cAnd challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE!

records.japanese: ここまでは　なんとか　これたが\nあと　すこしが　とても　とおいよ‥‥
records.english: I've made it this far a couple times,\nbut the last stretch is so long...

records.japanese: ここで　おわったか‥‥
ここまで　きたなら\nいきおいで　チャンピオンに　なれよ！\rきみなら　できるさ！
records.english: You've made it this far. Keep the\nmomentum going and become the\rCHAMPION! If anyone can, it's you!

records.japanese: せっかく　ここまで　きたんだ\nいまさら　まけるなんて　ありえないよ！
records.english: I didn't come all this way to lose now.\nThat possibility doesn't exist!

records.japanese: まさか‥‥\nまけたのか‥‥？
ここで　まけた‥‥\cということは　まだ　チャンピオンに　なる\nしかくが　なかったと　いうことか‥‥
records.english: I lost here...\cThat means I lack the qualifications\nto become the CHAMPION...

records.japanese: この　はてしなく　けわしい　みち　こそ\nまさに　チャンピオンへの　みち　なのよ！
records.english: This seemingly infinite and harsh road\nlives up to its name of VICTORY.

records.japanese: すばらしい　たたかいかた　ね‥‥
あなたには　チャンピオンに　なれる\nかのうせいが　あるみたいね
records.english: You seem to have the potential for\nbecoming the CHAMPION.

records.japanese: ポケモンリーグに　ちかづいていると　おもうと\nなんだか　ドキドキ　してきたよ‥‥
records.english: The thought that I'm getting closer to\nthe POKéMON LEAGUE...\cI'm getting stage fright...

records.japanese: なにも　できなかった‥‥
ポケモンリーグが　とおのいたよ‥‥\nなんだか　がっかり　するな‥‥
records.english: The POKéMON LEAGUE became distant\nagain... What a letdown...

records.japanese: ポケモンリーグで　かちぬくには\nポケモンへの　しんらいが　ひつよう　なの
records.english: To win your way through the POKéMON\nLEAGUE, you need the trust of your\rPOKéMON.

records.japanese: しんらい　かんけい　バッチリね！
records.english: Your relationship is based on\nsolid trust.

records.japanese: いつも　いっしょに　いることで\nポケモンと　トレーナーとの　あいだに\rしんらい　かんけいが　できるの
records.english: By being together all the time, trust\ngrows between POKéMON and TRAINERS.

records.japanese: ここは　ゴール　じゃないの\nポケモンリーグへの　つうかてん　よ！
records.english: This isn't the goal. It's only a place\non the way to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

records.japanese: その　ちょうし！
あなたなら　だいじょうぶよ　きっと！\nポケモンも　やるき　まんまん　だしね！
records.english: You'll do fine, for sure!\nYour POKéMON are all eager to go!

records.japanese: かぞく　ぜんいんで\nポケモンの　しゅぎょうを　してたんだ！\rだれにも　まけないぜ！
records.english: I trained together with my whole family,\nevery one of us!\rI'm not losing to anyone!

records.japanese: おれの　かぞく　より　つよい！？\nそんなことって　あるのか！？
records.english: Better than my family?!\nIs that possible?!

records.japanese: かぞくの　だれよりも　つよかった　おれ‥‥\nいままで　だれにも　まけなかった　おれ‥‥\cだけど　じしん　なくしちゃったよ\nいえに　かえろうかなあ
records.english: I was better than everyone in my\nfamily. I've never lost before...\cI've lost my confidence...\nMaybe I'll go home...

records.japanese: つよい　こどもが　いるって　ウワサだ！\nそれって　きみの　ことかい？
records.english: I'd heard that there was a tough\nlittle kid around. Do they mean you?

records.japanese: たしかに　つよい！
おれが　きいた　ウワサだと\nその　つよい　こども　ってのは\rトウカ　しゅっしん　らしいな！
records.english: The rumors I heard, that tough little\nkid is from PETALBURG CITY.

records.japanese: そろそろ　へばって　きたかな？
records.english: You must be getting a little tired.

records.japanese: ぜんぜん　へばってないわ！
records.english: No signs of tiring at all!

records.japanese: この　チャンピオンロードも\nポケモンリーグも　ながちょうば！\rたいりょくには　ちゅうい　してね！
records.english: VICTORY ROAD and the POKéMON LEAGUE\nare long and grueling challenges.\rBeware of fatigue!

records.japanese: ジムバッジを　たくさん　もってるからって\nゆだん　しないでよ\rうえには　うえが　いるんだから！
records.english: You shouldn't get complacent just\nbecause you have a lot of GYM BADGES.\cThere's always going to be someone\nwho's better than you!

records.japanese: あなたの　ほうが　うえね！
じぶんの　あつめた　ジムバッジを　みて\nいままでの　トレーナーを　おもいだすのよ
records.english: Gaze on your collected BADGES and\nremember the TRAINERS you've faced.

records.japanese: このあたりは　からだが　ひえきって\nしゅぎょう　するのも　ままならぬ‥‥\cだが　きあいが　あれば　だいじょうぶッ！\cおぬしも　この　きあいのハチマキで\nさむさに　たえてみせるのだッ！
records.english: The penetrating cold around these\nparts is an impediment to training.\cBut with focus, one can overcome!\cWith this FOCUS BAND, buckle down and\nwithstand the cold!

records.japanese: なにごとも　きあい　なのだーッ！！
とびらは　しまっている
ちかのカギを　つかいますか？
[PLAYER]は\nちかのカギを　つかった！\cとびらは　ひらいた！
records.english: [PLAYER] used the BASEMENT KEY.\cThe door opened!

records.japanese: はつでんそうちに　ちかづいた　だけで\nねっきが　つたわってくる！\cはやく　とめたほうが　よさそうだ
records.english: The generator is radiating heat that\ncan be felt even at a distance.\cIt looks like it should be turned off\nas soon as possible.

records.japanese: はつでんそうちは　しずかに　なった

[PLAYER]は
スイッチを　ふんだ！\c‥‥ポチッとな！\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cはつでんそうち　は
とまった　ようだ
records.english: [PLAYER] stepped on the switch.\cClick...\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe generator appears to have\nstopped...

records.japanese: ふねの　なかでも\nうきわ　もっていたら　おかしい？
records.english: What's so funny about having my inner\ntube aboard the ship?

records.japanese: うわぁ　つよーい！
うきわを　もったままだと\nモンスターボール　なげにくいよ
records.english: It's not easy throwing POKé BALLS\nwhile hanging on to an inner tube!

records.japanese: ここって　おもしろいね！\nいるだけで　ワクワク　してくるよ！
records.english: Isn't it fun here?\nI get excited just being here!

records.japanese: こういった　ふねは　めずらしいので\nけんがく　しておるのですよ\cフムフム‥‥\nほかにも　へやが　ありそうですな
records.english: Ships of this sort are rare, so I'm\ntaking a look around.\cHmhm...\nThere appear to be other cabins...

records.japanese: ふなのりは　ふねに　のるとき\nかならず　ポケモンを　もっている！\rちょいと　しょうぶ　してくれ！
records.english: When we go out to sea, we SAILORS\nalways bring our POKéMON.\rHow about a quick battle?

records.japanese: こりゃ　まいった
ふなぞこが　みずの　なかに\nしずんで　いるんだよ\cポケモンが　みずに　もぐれる　わざを\nつかえたら　さきに　すすめるんだがな‥‥
records.english: The ship's bottom has sunk into the\ndepths.\cIf a POKéMON knew how to go underwater,\nwe might make some progress...

records.japanese: わーい！\nふね　だぞー！
カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　そうこ　と　かかれている
records.english: The door is locked.\c“STORAGE” is painted on the door.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nそうこのカギを　つかった！\cさしこんだ　カギは　ぬけなくなったが\nとびらは　ひらいた！
records.english: [PLAYER] inserted and turned the\nSTORAGE KEY.\cThe inserted KEY stuck fast, but the\ndoor opened.

records.japanese: とびらは　あいている！
うぅ‥‥\cなんだか　ふねの　なかに　いるだけで\nよってきちゃった‥‥\cふねは　ちっとも　うごいてないのに‥‥
records.english: Urrrrppp...\cI'm getting queasy just being aboard\nthis ship...\cIt's not even moving, but...

records.japanese: たんけんに　ぴったりの　ばしょだから\nなんだか　わくわく　してくるよ！\rきっと　すっごい　たからものが　あるぜ！
records.english: This is a perfect place to go exploring!\nIt's exciting here!\cI bet there're amazing treasures on\nboard.

records.japanese: フミ『おたから　さがしていたら\nトレーナー　はっけん！
records.english: HAL: While searching for treasures,\nwe discovered a TRAINER!

records.japanese: フミ『ぼくたち　ふたりの　ちからでも\nかてなかったのか‥‥
records.english: HAL: We couldn't win even though\nwe worked together...

records.japanese: フミ『おたから　みつからないんだよね‥‥\nもう　だれかが　もっていったのかな？
records.english: HAL: We can't find any treasures...\nI wonder if someone got them already?

records.japanese: フミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないんだね\nそれだと　ぼくたちには　かてないよ！
records.english: HAL: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

records.japanese: アヤ『あら？　おたから　さがしていたのに\nトレーナー　はっけん　しちゃった！
records.english: LOIS: Oh? We were looking for some\ntreasure, but we only found a TRAINER.

records.japanese: アヤ『つよいんだ！
アヤ『おたから　どこかな？\nみつかったら　なに　かおうか　きめてるのよ！
records.english: LOIS: I wonder where the treasures\nare hidden?\cI already know what I'm going to buy\nwhen I find them!

records.japanese: アヤ『あら　ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけね！
records.english: LOIS: Don't you have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle another time!

records.japanese: フミ『ずっと　おたから　さがしていて\nポケモンも　つよく　なったんだよねー！\rちょっと　あいて　してみてよ
records.english: HAL: We've been searching for\ntreasures all this time.\cOur POKéMON have grown stronger, too.\nLet us show you, okay?

records.japanese: フミ『あいかわらず　つよいな！
フミ『おたからは　みつからないし\nポケモンは　まけるし　いえに　かえりたいよ\cでも　そんなこと　いうと\nかのじょ　おこりだすからな‥‥
records.english: HAL: We can't find any treasures,\nwe lose at POKéMON...\cI want to go home... But if I say that,\nshe gets all angry with me...

records.japanese: フミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないんだね\nそれだと　ぼくたちには　かてないよ！
records.english: HAL: You don't even have two POKéMON.\nYou can't expect to beat us like that.

records.japanese: アヤ『あら？　また　であったわね！\nあたしたちと　いっしょで　あきらめずに\rおたから　さがしているのね！\cしょうぶして　まけた　ほうは\nあきらめることに　しない？
records.english: LOIS: Oh, hi, we meet again!\cJust like us, you haven't given up\nsearching for treasures!\cHow about we battle, and the loser has\nto give up looking?

records.japanese: アヤ『また　まけちゃった‥‥
アヤ『もっと　ポケモン　そだてて\nおたから　みつけるまで　かえらないわよ！
records.english: LOIS: We'll raise our POKéMON more.\cWe're not going home until we find our\ntreasures!

records.japanese: アヤ『あら　ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけね！
records.english: LOIS: Don't you have two POKéMON?\nWe'll have to battle another time!

records.japanese: クスノキ　かんちょうに　たのまれてね\nこのふねの　ちょうさを　しているんだ\cついでに　たんちきを　さがしてきて　\nほしいって　いわれたんだけど\rみあたらないなあ‥‥
records.english: I'm investigating this ship on behalf\nof CAPT. STERN.\cHe also asked me to find a SCANNER,\nbut I haven't had any success...

records.japanese: あ！　たんちき　じゃないか！\c‥‥よかったら　それ\nクスノキ　かんちょうに\rわたしてきて　くれないかなあ\cもうすこし　このふね　しらべたいんだ
records.english: Oh! That's a SCANNER!\cListen, can I get you to deliver that\nto CAPT. STERN?\cI want to investigate this ship a\nlittle more.

records.japanese: この　ふねは　カクタスごうと　いってね\nちょいと　むかしの　ふね　らしいんだ
records.english: This ship is called S.S. CACTUS.\nIt seems to be from an earlier era.

records.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　１ごうしつと　かかれている
records.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 1” is painted on the door.

records.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　２ごうしつと　かかれている
records.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 2” is painted on the door.

records.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　４ごうしつと　かかれている
records.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 4” is painted on the door.

records.japanese: カギが　かかっている\cとびらには　６ごうしつと　かかれている
records.english: The door is locked.\c“RM. 6” is painted on the door.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nカギを　つかった！\cさしこんだ　カギは　ぬけなくなったが\nとびらは　ひらいた！
records.english: [PLAYER] inserted and turned the\nKEY.\cThe inserted KEY stuck fast, but the\ndoor opened.

records.japanese: ひかっているだけの\nただの　ゴミ　だった‥‥
records.english: It's bright and shiny!\nBut it's just trash...

records.japanese: かべに　ちいさな　くぼみが　ある
records.english: There's a small indent in the wall.

records.japanese: かべに　ちいさな　くぼみが　ある\cひみつのちからを　つかいますか？
records.english: There's a small indent in the wall.\cUse the SECRET POWER?

records.japanese: ちいさな　どうくつを　はっけん！
ここに　ひみつきちを　つくりますか？
records.english: Want to make your SECRET BASE here?

records.japanese: はこには　ポケモンの　えが　かいてある\cポケモンマークの　ひっこしやさん　だ！
records.english: The box is printed with a POKéMON logo.\cIt's a POKéMON brand moving and\ndelivery service.

records.japanese: かいりゅうを　ものともせず　すすむ\nれんらくせんを　どうぞ　ごらんください
records.english: This ferry is built to plow through\nfast-running currents.\cWe hope you enjoy your voyage with us.\nFeel free to explore the ship.

records.japanese: それでは　れんらくせんに　よる\nふなたびを　おたのしみ　ください
records.english: We hope you enjoy your voyage on\nour ferry.

records.japanese: おつかれさまです　ただいま\nカイナシティに　とうちゃく　しました
records.english: We have made land in SLATEPORT CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.

records.japanese: おつかれさまです　ただいま\nミナモシティに　とうちゃく　しました
records.english: We have made land in LILYCOVE CITY.\nThank you for sailing with us.

records.japanese: とうちゃくまで　まだまだ　だな\cじぶんの　へやに　もどって　やすんでいなよ\nたしか　きみの　へやは\r２ごうしつ　だったな\cあの　へやの　ベッドは\nふかふか　していて　きもちいいぞ！
records.english:
It'll be some time before we make land,
I reckon.\cYou can rest up in your cabin if you'd
like. Your cabin's No. 2.\cThe bed in there is soft and plushy.
I can attest to how comfy it is!

records.japanese: とうちゃく　したぞ！
ふなたびに　あきちゃって\nきゃくしつで　ポケモンで　しょうぶを\rしたがっている　トレーナーも　いるぞ！
records.english: Go visit other cabins.\nTRAINERS bored of the boat trip will\rbe itching to battle.

records.japanese: まっ　ふなたびを　たのしんでくれよ
まどの　むこうに\nすいへいせんが　ひろがっている！
ハギ『ようこそ！　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cわしが　この　タイドリップごうの\nめいよ　せんちょう　ハギ　じゃよ！\cいやぁ　いちどは　いんたい　したが\nこんな　すごい　ふねを　みてしまうと\rふなのりの　ちが　さわぐのう！！
records.english:
MR. BRINEY: Welcome aboard, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cThey made me honorary captain of the
S.S. TIDAL!\cYou can call me CAPTAIN BRINEY now!\cYou know, I retired once before, but
when I saw this majestic ship...\cLet me just say, it stirred my sleeping
soul as a sailor!

records.japanese: ピーコ『ピひょ　ピひょひょ‥‥！
１ごうしつ
２ごうしつ
３ごうしつ
４ごうしつ
こんなに　でっかい　ところ\nそうじ　してるのも　あきたぞ！\rちょいと　しょうぶ　しようや！
records.english: Arrrgh! I'm fed up and dog-tired of\ncleaning this huge place!\cLet's have a quick battle!

records.japanese: おとうと　まけちまったよ！
おれたち　おそうじ　ブラザーズ！\cあにきが　せんざい　ぶちまけてー\nおとうと　せっせと　みがくのさー
records.english: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\cThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!

records.japanese: こんなに　ひろいから\nふなぞこで　ポケモンしょうぶ　しても\rだいじょうぶ　だろ？
records.english: This is the bottom of the ship's hull.\nThere's plenty of room.\rIt'll be alright for a POKéMON battle.

records.japanese: あにき　まけちまったよ！
おれたち　おそうじ　ブラザーズ！\cあにきが　せんざい　ぶちまけてー\nおとうと　せっせと　みがくのさー
records.english: We're the CLEANUP BROTHERS!\cThe old one dumps the detergent,\nand the young one does the scrubbing!

records.japanese: ベッドが　ある‥‥\nやすんでいこう
records.english: It's a bed.\nLet's take a rest.

records.japanese: ミナモと　カイナを\nいったり　きたり‥‥\cコンテストの　けんがくが\nわたしの　たのしみ　なんだよ
records.english: Go back and forth between LILYCOVE\nand SLATEPORT, that's what I do.\cIt's my hobby - going from port to port\nto take in POKéMON CONTESTS.

records.japanese: たのしい　しょうぶ　だったよ
つぎの　コンテストには\nどんな　ポケモンが　でるのか\rたのしみで　たまらないよ
records.english: I get so excited imagining what kinds\nof POKéMON I'll get to see in the next\rCONTEST. The anticipation of it thrills!

records.japanese: きみの　ともだちは　つよいのかね？
つよい　ともだち　だね！
にんげん　だけが　ともだち　じゃない\nわたしに　とっては　ポケモンが\rたいせつな　ともだち　なんだよ！
records.english: Friends need not be human.\nFor me, POKéMON are treasured friends!

records.japanese: おきゃくさん\nノックは　したかね？
records.english: Child...\nDid you knock on the door?

records.japanese: まけても\nあわてず　さわがず
records.english: A loss is to be accepted without haste\nor panic.

records.japanese: どんな　ときでも　とりみださないのが\nしんしの　みだしなみ　だよ
records.english: To be never ruffled in any situation is\nthe GENTLEMAN's code of conduct.

records.japanese: ジン『ちょっと　はずかしいけど\nぼくたちの　ラブラブ　パワー　みせようかな
records.english: JED: I feel a little shy about this, but...\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

records.japanese: ジン『はぁ‥‥
ジン『ぼくたちの　ラブラブ　パワーでも\nかてないのは　はじめて　だよ！\rきみは　すごい　トレーナー　なんだね！
records.english: JED: It's the first time that our lovey-\ndovey power couldn't prevail!\rYou must be an awesome TRAINER!

records.japanese: ジン『ポケモン　いっぴき？\nそれだと　さみしくないか？
records.english: JED: You only have one POKéMON?\nIsn't that just too lonesome?

records.japanese: カホ『ちょっと　はずかしいけど\nふたりの　ラブラブ　パワー　みせてあげる！
records.english: LEA: I feel a little silly, but...\nWe'll show you our lovey-dovey power!

records.japanese: カホ『やん！
カホ『ふたりの　ラブラブ　パワーでも\nかてない　だなんて\rあなた　すごい　トレーナー　なのね！
records.english: LEA: I can't believe it!\nOur lovey-dovey power failed...\rYou must be an awesome TRAINER!

records.japanese: カホ『しょうぶ　したかったのに‥‥\nポケモン　２ひき　いないのね‥‥
records.english: LEA: I wanted to battle...\nBut you don't even have two POKéMON...

records.japanese: キミ　ちょうど　いいところに　きたね！\cボク　たいくつで　たまらないんだ\nちょっと　たのしませて　くれよ
records.english: Ah, you've come just in time.\cI'm bored, you see.\nYou may entertain me.

records.japanese: ‥‥もう　いいよ
パパに　たのんで　ボク　せんようの\nヨットを　かってもらおうかな？\rポケモンと　いっしょに　のれる　ヨット！
records.english: Perhaps I shall get Father to acquire\na yacht for me.\rA yacht for me and POKéMON!

records.japanese: あら　かわいい　トレーナーさん\nおちゃに　なさる？\rそれとも　しょうぶ　かしら？
records.english: Oh, you're such an adorable TRAINER.\nWould you like to have tea?\rOr would you rather battle?

records.japanese: かっぱつで　いらっしゃるのね
ゆうがな　きゃくせんで\nせかい　いっしゅうも　よろしいけど‥‥\cれんらくせんで　のんびり\nホウエンを　みるのも　すてき　ですわ
records.english: A world cruise on a luxury liner has its\ncharms, I must say...\cBut, I will admit there is an appealing\nside to touring HOENN by ferry.

records.japanese: わたし　あやしく　ないです！\nだから　これを　あなたに　あげます！\cべつに　だれか　から\nよこどりした　モノじゃ　ないです！\rあんしん　して　つかって　ください！
records.english: Uh... Hi! I... I'm not acting suspicious!\nUh... You can have this! For free!\cIt... Honestly, I didn't SNATCH it from\nsomeone! I'd never do such a thing!\rIt's clean! You can use it!

records.japanese: よこどり　という　わざは\nあいてが　つかおうとする　わざを\rじぶんで　つかって　しまうのです！
records.english: SNATCH steals the foe's move in\nadvance, and then uses the snatched\rmove on the foe.

records.japanese: ここは　バトルタワー！\nかちぬけ！　さいきょう　トレーナー
records.english: BATTLE TOWER\n“Win it all and be the best, TRAINERS!”

records.japanese: ここは　バトルタワー　さ！\cトレーナーは　きたえあげた　ポケモンで\nひたすら　かちぬいて　いくのさ！
records.english: This is the BATTLE TOWER.\cTRAINERS bring their best-raised\nPOKéMON for elimination-style matches.

records.japanese: れんらくせんを　ごりよう　ですね！\nチケットは　おもち　でしょうか？
