records.english: Hello, are you here for the ferry?\nMay I see your TICKET?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nチケットを　もっていない！\c‥‥もうしわけ　ありません！\cふねに　のれるのは\nチケットの　ある　かた　だけです
records.english: [PLAYER] doesn't have the TICKET...\cI'm terribly sorry.\cYou must have a TICKET to board\nthe ferry.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nふねのチケットを　みせた！\cはい！　けっこう　です！\cいきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
records.english: [PLAYER] flashed the TICKET.\cPerfect! That's all you need!\cAnd where would you like to go?

records.japanese: カイナ　ですね！
ミナモ　ですね！
また　ごりよう　ください！
records.english: Please sail with us another time!

records.japanese: れんらくせんに　のって　おまちください
records.english: Please board the ferry and wait for\ndeparture.

records.japanese: いきさきは　どちら　でしょう？
records.english: Then, where would you like to go?

records.japanese: きょうは　３５にんぬき　できるまでは\nかえりませんわ！
records.english: I'm not leaving until I've beaten 35\nTRAINERS in a row!

records.japanese: すごく　つよそうな　トレーナーが\nいっぱい　だね！\rぼくは　まだ　でられそうに　ないや‥‥
records.english: Gee, there're a lot of tough-looking\nTRAINERS here.\rI'm not good enough to enter yet...

records.japanese: バトルタワーへ　ようこそ！\cこちらでは　バトルルームへの\nごあんないを　しております
records.english: Welcome to the BATTLE TOWER!\cPlease register with me to enter\na BATTLE ROOM.

records.japanese: バトルルームに　ちょうせん　しますか？
records.english: Would you like to make a BATTLE ROOM\nchallenge?

records.japanese: それでは　またの　ごりようを\nおまちして　おります
records.english: We'll be looking forward to your\nnext challenge.

records.japanese: バトルルームに　ごあんないする　まえに\nレポートを　かきますが　よろしいですか？
records.english: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress must be saved. Is that okay?

records.japanese: レベル５０の　へやと　レベル１００の　へやが\nありますが　どちらに　ちょうせん　しますか？
records.english: There are two BATTLE ROOMS,\nLevel 50 and Level 100.\rWhich would you like to challenge?

records.japanese: それでは　さんかする　ポケモンを\nえらんで　ください
records.english: Please select the POKéMON you wish\nto enter.

records.japanese: それでは　バトルルームへ\nごあんない　します！
records.english: I'll direct you to your BATTLE ROOM now.

records.japanese:
バトルタワーは　ポケモンたいせんを
おこなうための　しせつです\cタワーないには　バトルルーム　という
たいせんの　ために　よういされた　へやがたくさん　ようい　されています\cそれぞれ　バトルルームには
７にんの　トレーナー　が　いてあなたの　チャレンジを　まっています\cみごと　その　７にんを　たおした　ときは
すてきな　しょうひんを　さしあげます！\cまた　とちゅうで　ちょうせんを
ちゅうだんしたい　ばあいはちゃんと　レポートを　かかないとつづけて　ちょうせんが　できないのできをつけて　くださいね
records.english:
The BATTLE TOWER is a facility made
especially for POKéMON battles.\cWithin the TOWER are many BATTLE ROOMS.\cIn each BATTLE ROOM, seven TRAINERS
await your challenge.\cBeat all seven, and you will be rewarded
with a fabulous prize.\cYou may also take a break from your
challenge by saving your progress.\cMake sure you save properly or you
won't be able to resume your challenge.

records.japanese:
おきゃくさま！\cさんかできる　ポケモンが　３ひき　いません！\cさんかする　ためには　レベルが　５０いかで
すべて　ちがうしゅるいの　ポケモンを３ひき　よういして　ください\cまた　もたせる　どうぐも
すべて　ちがう　どうぐに　してください！\cなお　タマゴ[STR_VAR_1]さんか　させることは　できません！\cじゅんびが　できましたら
また　おこし　ください
records.english: Excuse me!\cYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\cYou must have three different POKéMON\nof Level 50 or less to enter.\cThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\cEGGS[STR_VAR_1] ineligible.\cPlease come see me when you are ready.

records.japanese:
おきゃくさま！\cさんかできる　ポケモンが　３ひき　いません！\cさんかする　ためには
すべて　ちがうしゅるいの　ポケモンを３ひき　よういして　ください\cまた　もたせる　どうぐも
すべて　ちがう　どうぐに　してください！\cなお　タマゴ[STR_VAR_1]さんか　させることは　できません！\cじゅんびが　できましたら
また　おこし　ください
records.english: Excuse me!\cYou don't have three eligible POKéMON.\cYou must have three different POKéMON\nto enter.\cThey also must be holding different\nkinds of items.\cEGGS[STR_VAR_1] ineligible.\cPlease come see me when you are ready.

records.japanese: おきゃくさま！\cぜんかい　ちゃんと　レポートを　かいて\nしゅうりょう　しませんでしたね？\cもうしわけ　ありませんが　そのばあい\nちょうせんは　むこうと　なります
records.english: Excuse me!\cYou didn't save before you quit your\nchallenge last time.\cBecause of that, your challenge so far\nhas been disqualified. Sorry!

records.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\nみごと　７にんぬき　されましたね！\c
７にんぬきを　たっせい　されましたので\nこの　しょうひんを　さしあげます！\c
records.english: For beating seven TRAINERS in a row,\nyou have earned this fabulous prize!\c

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\n[STR_VAR_1]を　もらった！
‥あら　どうぐが　いっぱいですね\cどうぐを　せいりしてから\nまたおこしください
records.english: Oh, your BAG appears to be full.\cPlease make room in your BAG, then come\nsee me.

records.japanese: おつかれさまでした！\c
せいせきを　レポートに　かきますので\nおまちください
records.english: Your record will be saved.\nPlease wait.

records.japanese: おまちしておりました！\c
バトルルームに　ごあんないする　まえに\nレポートを　かきますので　おまちください
records.english: Before entering a BATTLE ROOM, your\nprogress will be saved. Please wait.

records.japanese: いよいよ　つぎは　５０にんめの\nトレーナー　ですね！\cこれからは　７にんを　かちぬく　たびに\nあなたの　ポケモンに　きねんリボンが\rおくられますので　がんばって　くださいね！
records.english: You're finally about to face the\n50th TRAINER.\cFrom here on, every time you beat seven\nTRAINERS in a row, your POKéMON will\rreceive a commemorative RIBBON.\cGood luck!

records.japanese: つよい　トレーナー　７にんを\nかちぬいた　きねんの　リボンを　どうぞ！\c[PLAYER]は　リボンを　もらった！
records.english: Here are some RIBBONS for beating\nseven tough TRAINERS in a row.\c[PLAYER] received some RIBBONS!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　ポケモンに\nリボンを　つけて　あげた！
records.english: [PLAYER] put the RIBBONS on the\nchallenger POKéMON.

records.japanese: ねえねえ！\cバトルタワーで　これから　しょうぶだ！\n‥‥て　いうときの\rきみの　きもちを　おしえてよ！
records.english: Hello, hello!\nYou're going to battle here, right?\cCan you tell me what's going through\nyour mind as you prepare for battle?

records.japanese: おっ　おしえて　くれるの！\nじゃあ　さっそく‥‥
records.english: Oh, wow, you'll tell me?\nGreat! Then, what's your answer?

records.japanese: とくに　なにも　おもわないって　こと？\nきみって　クールなんだね
records.english: Oh, so you don't think much about it?\nYou're one cool customer.

records.japanese: あれ？　やっぱり　やめたの？\nきみって　きまぐれ　なんだね
records.english: Hunh? You changed your mind?\nI guess you're fickle.

records.japanese: へえ　そんな　きぶんに　なるんだ！\nなかなか　こせいてき　だね‥‥\cどうも　ありがと！
records.english: Okay, so that's how you feel?\nThat's quite original.\cThanks!

records.japanese: かちぬいた　トレーナーの　にんずうは\nきろく　されて　いるのよ！\cきろくは　うけつけの　よこでも\nトレーナーカードの　うらでも　みられるわよ！
records.english:
The number of matches you win in a row
is recorded.\cThe record is posted beside the
registration counter.\cIt's also on the back of your
TRAINER'S CARD.

records.japanese: いちど　バトルタワーに　はいれば\nとちゅうで　まけちゃうか\r７にん　かちぬくまでは\rでられなく　なっちゃうんだ！\cかくごして　チャレンジ　しないとね！
records.english: Once you've entered the BATTLE TOWER,\nyou can't leave until you either lose\ror you beat seven TRAINERS in a row.\cYou'd best be certain that you're up\nto the challenge.

records.japanese:
はっはっはっ　いやあ　すばらしい
いやあ　すばらしい！\cあなた　わかってますか？
５０にんぬきを　しちゃったんですよ！\cじつに　すばらしい！\cバトルタワー　オーナーの　わたしから
ぜひ　きねんひんを　おくらせて　ください！
records.english:
Hahahaha! Pure magnificence!
Pure magnificence indeed!\cDo you realize what you've achieved?
You've beaten 50 TRAINERS in a row!\cYes, purely magnificent!\cAs the OWNER of the BATTLE TOWER,
let me give you a memento!

records.japanese:
うわっはっはっはっ　いやあ　すばらしい
いやあ　すばらしい！　じつに　すばらしい！\cあなた　わかってますか？
１００にんぬきを　しちゃったんですよ！ほんとうに　すばらしい！\cバトルタワー　オーナーの　わたしから
ぜひ　きねんひんを　おくらせて　ください！
records.english:
Wahahaha! Pure magnificence!
Absolutely pure magnificence indeed!\cDo you realize what you've achieved?
You've beaten 100 TRAINERS in a row!\cYes, absolutely magnificent!\cAs the OWNER of the BATTLE TOWER,
let me give you a memento!

records.japanese: これ　かざっておくと　めだちますよ！
records.english: I suggest you keep it displayed.\nIt will surely attract attention.

records.japanese: あっ　パソコンが　いっぱいですか‥‥\cしかし　せっかくですから！\nあとでも　よいので　とりに　きてください！
records.english: Oh?\nYour PC has no room for this...\cBut it would be a shame to waste this...\nPlease come back for this!

records.japanese: あんなに　すばらしい　たたかいを\nみせて　いただいて　まんぞくです！\rバトルタワーを　つくった　かいが　あった！
records.english: I'm overwhelmed with satisfaction after\nseeing your magnificent performance.\cIt makes the building of the BATTLE\nTOWER all worthwhile!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　たいりょくを\nかいふくして　さしあげます
records.english: We will restore your POKéMON to\nfull health.

records.japanese: つぎは　[STR_VAR_1]にんめの　あいてです\nじゅんびは　いいですか？
records.english: You will be facing opponent no. [STR_VAR_1].\nAre you ready?

records.japanese: レポートを　かいて　しゅうりょう　しますか？
records.english: Would you like to save and\nquit the game?

records.japanese: バトルルームの　ちょうせんを\nちゅうし　しますか？
records.english: Would you like to cancel your BATTLE\nROOM challenge?

records.japanese: あらあら　つよそうな　トレーナーさんね\nわたくしの　ポケモンを　みてくださるかしら？
records.english: Oh? You look like a good TRAINER.\nWill you look at my POKéMON?

records.japanese: わたくしじゃ　かないませんわ
records.english: I'm not good enough for you.

records.japanese: とっても　たのしい　しょうぶ　でしたわ\nぜひ　また　たたかって　くださいね
records.english: I enjoyed our battle very much.\nPlease battle with me some other time.

records.japanese: えいっ！\nがんばれ！　あたしたちの　ポケモン！！
かてなかったあ‥‥
２ひきの　ポケモンが　いっしょに\nたたかうのって　びっくり　しなかった？
records.english: Did it surprise you that two POKéMON\nbattled at the same time?

records.japanese: ポケモンが　１ひき　だと\nあたしたちとは　たたかえないです\rだって　あたしたち　つよいもん！
records.english: You can't battle with us if you have\nonly one POKéMON.\rWhy? Because we're strong!

records.japanese: よしっ！　ひさしぶりの　しょうぶ！\nぜんりょくで　たたかうぞ！
records.english: Hey, hey! This is my first battle in\na while. I'll give it my all!

records.japanese: ぜんりょくで　たたかったのに‥‥
records.english: But I gave it my all...

records.japanese: おまえさん　つよすぎるぞ！\nさては　すごうでの　トレーナーだろう！？
records.english: You're far too strong!\nYou must be a great TRAINER!

records.japanese: わたくしの　ポケモン\nとても　かわいくて　とても　つよいの\rぜひ　おてあわせ　してくださいませ
records.english: My POKéMON are extremely cute and\nextremely strong.\rPlease allow me to show you.

records.japanese: まいりましたわ\nだって　あなた　つよいんですもの
records.english: I must concede defeat.\nAfter all, you are strong.

records.japanese: こんど　おてあわせ　するまでに\nもっと　ポケモンを　そだてて　おきますわ\cそのときは　てかげん　しなくってよ！
records.english: The next time we meet, I will have raised\nmy POKéMON much more.\cDon't expect mercy then!

records.japanese: やまおとこは　いつだって　げんき！\nわしの　ポケモンも　げんきで\rたたかいたくて　ウズウズしておるぞ！
records.english: We HIKERS are always full of energy!\nMy POKéMON are also full of energy, too.\rWe're always itching for a battle!

records.japanese: げんきが　なくなった‥‥
ワッハッハ！　たしかに　まけた！\nでも　たのしい　ポケモンしょうぶが\rできたから　だいまんぞく　だ！
records.english: Wahahah! Sure, we lost!\nBut we had a great battle, didn't we?\rWe're satisfied with that!

records.japanese: つよそうな　トレーナーですけど\nあたしたちに　かてますか？
records.english: You look like a strong TRAINER,\nbut can you beat us?

records.japanese: えーん\nまけちゃったよお！
ポケモンが　２ひき　どうじに　たたかえると\nいろいろ　できることが　ふえそうです
records.english: If two POKéMON can battle at the same\ntime, all sorts of new things can happen.

records.japanese: たたかえる　ポケモンさん\n１ひき　しか　いないですか？\cじゃあ　しょうぶは　おあずけ　ですね！
records.english: Do you only have one POKéMON that can\nbattle?\cThen we can't battle with you yet.

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶで\nぜんいんに　かてるかどうか　やってみた？
records.english: Have you tried beating all the other\nTRAINERS in battle?

records.japanese: きょうは　きてくれて\nほんとうに　ありがとう！\cはつばいを　たのしみに　まっていてね！
records.english: Thanks for coming today!\cI hope you're looking forward to this\ngame's release!

records.japanese: あれ？　もう　ぜんいんと\nポケモンしょうぶ　したの？
records.english: Huh? Did you battle with all the\nTRAINERS already?

records.japanese: きょうは　きてくれて\nほんとうに　ありがとう！\cはつばいを　たのしみに　まっていてね！
records.english: Thank you for coming today!\cI hope you're looking forward to this\ngame's release!

records.japanese: きみの　もってる　ポケモン\nおじさん　みたことが　ないよ！\rなんだか　うらやましいぞ
records.english: I've never seen the POKéMON you have.\nIt makes me envious a little.

records.japanese: ほら！　たくさんの　トレーナーと\nいろんな　ポケモンが　きみを　まってるよ！
records.english: Look at all those TRAINERS!\nThey have different POKéMON, too.\rAnd they're all waiting for you!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！！
records.english: Welcome to the World of POKéMON!

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶは\nあかるく　たのしく　はげしく！！
records.english: May all POKéMON battles be bright,\nfun, and ferocious!

records.japanese: あたし　きょうは　おるすばん\cおねーさんたちは　じゅんびが　あるって\nどこかに　いっちゃった！\cあきに　なったら\nおはなやさん　はじめるから　まっててね！
records.english: I have to stay home today.\cMy big sisters had to go out.\nThey said it was for preparations.\cIn the autumn, we're going to start\na flower shop. Please wait for it!

records.japanese:
わし　うみのいえ　の　オヤジ！
ひとよんで　うみサン！\cとにかく　あつい　ポケモンしょうぶを
みることが　だいすき　なんだよねー！\cキミもねー　あつーい　ハートで
ここに　いる　トレーナーぜんいんにかてたら　いいものを　あげるよー
records.english:
I'm the owner of the SEASHORE HOUSE.
But you can call me MR. SEA!\cWhat I love above all is to see hot
POKéMON battles.\cLet me see that your heart burns hot!\cIf you can defeat all the TRAINERS
here, I'll reward your efforts.

records.japanese: あつーい　しょうぶ　みせてくれー！\cそのためだけに　わし\nこの　うみのいえを　やってるんだねー！
records.english: Show me some hot matches!\cI run this SEASHORE HOUSE just for\nthat reason alone!

records.japanese: きみ　すごいねー！\nあつい　ポケモンしょうぶ　だったー\rわし　だいまんぞく　だよー！\cこれは　あつい　しょうぶを　みせてくれた\nきみへの　おれい　だよー\cサイコソーダ　はんダース　もっていきなよー
records.english: You're scorching hot!\nThose battles blazed!\rI'm more than just satisfied!\cAs thanks for showing me your hot\nstreak, I want you to take these.\cIt's half a dozen bottles of SODA POP!

records.japanese: と　おもったけど　バッグ　いっぱいかー\nじゃあ　あずかっておくよー
records.english: Oh, but hey, your BAG's jammed full.\nI'll hang on to these for you.

records.japanese: ポケモンも　だいすき　サイコソーダ\nいっぽん　３００えん　だよー\rかって　いきなよー！
records.english: Want to buy some SODA POP?\nPOKéMON love it!\cJust $300 a bottle!\nBuy some!

records.japanese: はいよー
おかねが　ないよー
それは　ざんねん　だねー
ポケモンも　だいすき　サイコソーダ\nいっぽん　３００えんよ　いかが！？
records.english: SODA POP! The POKéMON favorite!\nJust $300 a bottle! Want one?

records.japanese: はい　どうぞ！
あらやだ！\nおかねが　たりないわよ
records.english: Oh, dear!\nYou don't have enough money.

records.japanese: それは　ざんねん！
この　うみのいえで　いちばん\nあつい　ポケモンしょうぶが　できるのは\rこの　オレさま　だぜ！！
records.english: If you're looking for a battle on the\nhigh seas, you'll find no hotter \rTRAINER than me, matey!

records.japanese: たしかに　あつい　しょうぶ　だった\nまけて　なっとく　って　かんじ　だぜ！
records.english: That was a hot battle!\nI can accept that loss, matey!

records.japanese: オレは　カイナに　くるたびに\nここで　あつい　しょうぶと\rつめたい　サイコソーダを　たのしむんだ！
records.english: Whenever I'm in SLATEPORT, I enjoy\nhot battles and ice-cold SODA POP!

records.japanese: たいくつな　しょうぶ　なんて　ムダ！\cもえあがるような　しょうぶ　こそ\nトレーナーと　ポケモンを　きたえるのよ！
records.english: Boring battles aren't worth the effort.\cFiery hot battles are what toughen up\nTRAINERS and POKéMON!

records.japanese: あつい　じゃない！
あーあ　のどが　かわいちゃった\nサイコソーダ　のもうかな？
records.english: Whew, I'm all thirsty.\nMaybe I'll have a SODA POP.

records.japanese: ぼくの　ポケモンの　すごいところ\nみせちゃうけど　なかないでよ！
records.english: I'm going to show you how great my\nPOKéMON are, but don't cry!

records.japanese: ‥‥　まけたけど　なかないぞ
ポケモンが　ぼくを　のせて\nみずの　うえを　すすむ　わざを　つかえたら\rうきわも　いらなくなるのに
records.english: If one of my POKéMON knew the move\nfor carrying me across water on its\rback, I could get rid of this inner tube.

records.japanese: だれかの　しせんを　かんじる‥
む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　つくえの　したに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this desk? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　きの　うしろに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this tree? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　タンスの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this dresser? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　まどの　むこうに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeyond this window? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　うえきばちの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this planter? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　とだなの　なかに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nin this cupboard? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　まどの　うらに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbehind this window? You're sharp!

records.japanese: む　むむ‥！\cなぜ　わがはいが　ざぶとんの　したに\nかくれていると　わかった？　‥‥できる！
records.english: Hah? Grrr...\cHow did you know I concealed myself\nbeneath this cushion? You're sharp!

records.japanese: わがはい　こそ！\cホウエンちほう　さいだいの\nなぞの　じんぶつ\rひと　よんで‥‥\cカラクリだいおう！\nわははは！　はじめまして！
records.english: Behold!\cFor I am the greatest living mystery\nof a man in all of HOENN!\rThey call me...\cThe TRICK MASTER!\nWahahaha! Glad to meet you!

records.japanese: あんた　わがはいの　カラクリやしきに\nちょうせんしに　きたって\rわけだろう　そうだろう！\rよしっ　ちょうせんを　みとめよう！\cそこの　かけじくから　はいって\nちょうせん　するがいい！\rわがはいは　おくの　へやで　まってるぞ！
records.english:
You, you've come to challenge my
TRICK HOUSE, haven't you?\cThat's why you're here, isn't it?
Yes, it is!\cConsider your challenge accepted!\cEnter through the scroll there,
and let your challenge commence!\cI shall be waiting in the back!

records.japanese: かけじくだ！
かけじくの　うらを　のぞくと\nおおきい　あなが　あった！\cおくに　すすんで　みますか？
records.english: There is a big hole behind the scroll!\cWant to go in?

records.japanese: かけじくの　うえに　メモが　はってある\c「たびに　でます‥‥　さがさないでね\nカラクリだいおう」
records.english: There is a note affixed to the scroll...\c“I am leaving on a journey.\nDon't look for me. TRICK MASTER”

records.japanese: さて　こんどの　しかけは\nあんなことや　こんなことを‥‥\cうふふ　われながら\nむずかしいぞ‥　むふふ
records.english: For the next time, I'll use this trick,\nand that scheme, and those ruses...\cMufufufu... If I may say so, it's\nbrilliantly difficult, even for me!

records.japanese: わっ　なんだ！　あんたか！\cいま　まだ　つぎの　しかけを\nかんがえちゅう　なんだよ！\cもっと　わがはいに\nかんがえる　じかんを\rあたえて　くれたって　いいだろ！\rもうちょっと　したら　また　きてくれ！
records.english:
Hah? What?!
Oh, it's you!\cI'm in the midst of devising new tricky
challenges!\cIt's not too much to ask for a bit more
time for me to think, is it now?You wouldn't begrudge me that?Come back in a little while!

records.japanese: おお　あんた！　さては　このあいだの\nほうびを　とりに　きたんだろう　そうだろう！\rよしっ　いま　やろう！
records.english: Ah, it's you! You're here to accept the\nreward from before, isn't that right?\rYes, right I am!\cHere!\nI'll give it to you now!

records.japanese: あれ？　とりに　きたんじゃ　ないのか？
records.english: Hah?\nDid you not come to claim your reward?

records.japanese: ワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ！\nぷれぜんとヲ　ウケトッテ　クレナイト\rダイオウノ　アトヲ　オッテ　イケナイヨ！
records.english: MECHADOLL 5 I AM!\nIF REWARD IS NOT TAKEN BY YOU,\rTHEN TRICK MASTER YOU CANNOT FOLLOW.

records.japanese: ソレデハ　さらば！
エッ！　マタ　ぱそこんガ\nイッパイ　ダッテ‥‥？　アンマリダ！
records.english: YOUR PC STATUS: FULL AGAIN.\nMEAN, YOU ARE.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　まきものを　みつけた！
[PLAYER]は　まきものに　かいてある\nあいことばを　おぼえた！
records.english: [PLAYER] memorized the secret code\nwritten on the scroll.

records.japanese: あいことばが　かいてある
records.english: A secret code is written on it.

records.japanese: とびらには　カギが　かかっている！\c‥‥よくみると　とびらに　もじが　かいてある\n「ここに　あいことばを　かきつけよ」
records.english: The door is locked.\c...On closer inspection, this is written\non it: “Write the secret code here.”

records.japanese: あっ！\nあんた　ここまで　こられたのか！\rうーむ‥‥　できる！
records.english: Aak!\nYou've made it to me?\rHmmm... You're sharp!

records.japanese: てつやで　きを　うえたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの\nつぎの　つぎ　くらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to plant all those\ntrees...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five, six places!

records.japanese: てつやで　めいろを　つくったのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの\nつぎ　くらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to make the maze...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four, five places!

records.japanese: てつやで　いわを　はこび　こんだのに‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to bring in those\nboulders...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three, four places!

records.japanese: てつやで　いわを　おして　きたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to shove in those\nboulders...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two, three places!

records.japanese: てつやで　にんぎょう　つくって\nてつやで　クイズも　かんがえたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to make MECHADOLLS\nand another to think up the quiz...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness by\none, two places!

records.japanese: てつやで　とびらを　とりつけたのに‥‥\cわがはいの　つぎ\nくらいに　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night to install\nthe doors...\cYou're almost my equal in greatness!

records.japanese: てつやで　やじるしを　ならべたのに‥‥\cわがはいと　おなじ　くらい　すごい！
records.english: It took me all night setting up arrows...\cYou're my equal in greatness!

records.japanese: てつやで　ゆかを　みがいたのに‥‥\cわがはい　より　すごい！　のかも‥‥
records.english: It took me all night polishing floors...\cYou're above me in greatness!\nPossibly...

records.japanese: ど　どうしよう‥‥\nもう　カラクリの　ネタが\rつきて　しまった‥‥\rまた　ぜんこく　かくちを　まわって\rしかけを　いろいろ　かんがえて　くるか‥‥
records.english: Wh-what should I do?\nMy fountain of ideas for tricks has\rrun dry...\cPerhaps it is time I toured the country\non a quest to devise new tricks...

records.japanese: みとめたくは　ないんだが\nあんたには　まけた‥‥！\rまあ　なんども　きてくれた　あたり\rよっぽど　わがはいに\rみりょくを　かんじたの　だろうが\rそれと　わがはいの　まけは　かんけいなし！\cそうだ！\nがんばりやの　あんたと\rてんさいの　わがはいの\rゆうじょうを　きねんして‥\rこれを　うけとって　くれ！
records.english:
I hate to admit defeat, but you have
bested me!\cStill, you must have been reeled in by
my charisma for you to visit me againand again. Yes, you must have!\cBut that has nothing to do with my
losing!\cIn recognition of the friendship
between you, the driven, and the geniusthat is myself, I demand that you takethis keepsake!

records.japanese: なに　パソコンに　はいりきらない？\nそんなの　わがはいが　しるか！\c‥‥と　いいたい　ところだけど\nわがはいは　やさしいので　あとで　やろう！
records.english: What? No room in your PC?\nWhat am I to make of that?\cI wish I could say that, but I am much\ntoo kind and caring, so come back later!

records.japanese: ‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cわがはいは　これから\nあらたな　しかけを　もとめて\rたびに　でる　ことに　する‥‥\rあんたも　いつか　ここにきて\rまた　あそんで　いってくれ！\cそれでは　さらば‥！
records.english: ... ... ... ... ... ...\cI am leaving on a journey of discovery.\nA quest in search of new tricks.\cI wish that you will one day visit and\nentertain me again.\cAnd now, farewell!

records.japanese: よしっ　あんたに\nほうびを　やろう！
なにっ　もちきれない？\nそんなに　なにを　もちあるいてるんだ？\rまあ　せっかく　ここまで　こられたんだし\rほうびは　あとで　やろう！
records.english: What? Have you no room for this?\nWhat manner of items do you carry?\cBut fine, since you've reached me,\nyour reward will be with me till later.

records.japanese: なんだ　とくいそうな　かお　してからに\nわがはいに　かった　きに　なるのは\rまだ　はやいわ！\rこのあとも　また　しかけを　つくるから\rそれが　おわってから　わがはいを　わらえ！\cそれでは　じかいを　おたのしみに！
records.english:
Scrub that smug smirk from your face!
It's much too early to think you've won!\cI'll make new tricks to stump you, I will.
You may mock me only when you're done.\cCome back for the next exciting
installment!

records.japanese: おいおい\nわがはいの　ことは　むし　か！\rずいぶん　さみしい　じゃないか
records.english: Now, now! You're ignoring me now?\nNow that, I consider heartbreaking!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　すてき」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is fabulous.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: おぼえさせた　ばかりの　いあいぎりで\nきって　きって　きりまくりよ！
records.english: I'll hack and slash my way to victory\nwith the CUT we just learned!

records.japanese: ほんき　ださないでよー！
きっても　きっても　あきないわ！
records.english: I never get tired of hacking\nand slashing!

records.japanese: へんな　やしきに\nまよいこんじゃった‥‥
records.english: I wandered into this weird house\nby accident...

records.japanese: おまけに　まけちゃった‥‥
さらに　まよっちゃった‥‥\nでられない‥‥
records.english: I lost my way, I lost a battle, and I'm\neven more lost... I can't get out...

records.japanese: カラクリだいおう　って\nなにもの　なのかしら？
records.english: Just who is the TRICK MASTER?

records.japanese: きを　とられていたら\nまけちゃったわ！
records.english: I lost while I was lost in thought!

records.japanese: つよいわ！\nあなたも　なにもの　なの？
[PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　かしこい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is smart.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: どの　スイッチで\nどの　あなが　ふさがるんだ？
しょうぶ　してたら\nよけい　わかんなくなった！
records.english: After that battle, I'm even more\nconfused!

records.japanese: きみ　ぼくの　かわりに\nスイッチ　ぜんぶ　おしてきてよ！
records.english: Can I get you to push all the buttons\nfor me?

records.japanese: おっ！　カラクリやしき\n２どめの　チャレンジだね！
records.english: Oh! You're on your second TRICK HOUSE\nchallenge!

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも\nそんなに　つよいの？
カラクリだいおうが　ひとりで\nこの　しかけを　つくってるんだって！
records.english: The TRICK MASTER rigged all the tricks\nin this house all by himself.

records.japanese: いつか　わたしの　ジムを　つくりたくて\nしかけを　けんきゅうしてるの！
records.english: I want to make my own GYM one day.\nSo, I'm studying how to set traps.

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶは\nけんきゅう　ぶそく　だったわーっ！
あなた　つよいのね‥\nジムリーダーに　なれるんじゃない？
records.english: You're strong, aren't you?\nMaybe even enough to be a GYM LEADER!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　あこがれ」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is coveted.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: なんども　おなじ　ところに\nもどって　きちゃうよー！
records.english: I keep coming back to this same place!

records.japanese: ぼくが　こまってるのに\nダメおしで　かつなんて　ひどいよー！
records.english: I'm already having trouble, and then\nyou have to beat me? It's not fair!

records.japanese: とびら　だらけで\nせまくて　こわいよー！
records.english: It's full of doors here!\nIt's too small and dark in here! Help!

records.japanese: なにが　なんだか　わからなくて\nかなしく　なってきたわ‥‥
records.english: I don't know what's going on here.\nI'm starting to feel sad...

records.japanese: ひっ　ひどいわ‥‥
どうせ　あたしは　よわいし\nほうこうおんちよー！
records.english: I know I'm weak!\nAnd, I have no sense of direction!

records.japanese: いったい　なんの　ために\nこんな　やしきが　あるんだろう‥‥？
records.english: I don't get it. What would anyone want\nwith a house this bizarre?

records.japanese: いったい　なぜ\nわしは　まけて　しまったんだろう‥‥？
records.english: I don't get it.\nHow did I lose?

records.japanese: いったい　どれくらいの　しかけが\nこの　やしきに　あるんだろう‥？\cきみなら　わかるかもな
records.english: I don't get it.\nHow many traps are in this house?\cYou may be the one to solve that.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　かっこいい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is cool.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: こういうの　かんがえるのって　めんどう！\nわたしは　しょうぶだけ　したいのにー！
records.english: It's too much bother to think this out.\nI only wanted to battle!

records.japanese: まけちゃった　けど　やっぱり\nしょうぶが　いちばん　たのしい！
records.english: Even though I lost, I still like battling\nthe best!

records.japanese: トレーナーが　いそうな　ところは\nどこにでも　いきたく　なるわよね！
records.english: Wouldn't you agree? You would go\nanywhere if TRAINERS were there.

records.japanese: このくらいの　いわは\nゆび　いっぽんで　らくしょう　だぜ！
records.english: Heh! Boulders like this, I can brush\naside with one finger!

records.japanese: いわが　おせても\nパズルが　とけない‥‥
records.english: I can push boulders, but I can't solve\nthe puzzle...

records.japanese: ちからが　つよいだけじゃ　ダメだね‥‥\nアタマ　つかわないと
records.english: It's not good enough to be brawny...\nYou have to use your head. Be brainy!

records.japanese: カラクリやしきも　だんだん\nむずかしく　なってきたわね！
records.english: The TRICK HOUSE is getting trickier,\nisn't it?

records.japanese: ああっ！
さいごまで　いった\nひとって　いるのかしらね？
records.english: Has anyone made it to the end?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　てんさい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is a genius.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ！\cからくりニンギョウ　５ゴウノ　トコロマデ\nツヅケテ　くいずニ　セイカイ　スレバ\rあいことばニ　タドリツケルゾ！
records.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 1 AM I!\cIF YOU ANSWER QUIZZES CORRECTLY,\nTHEN YOU WILL GO TO MECHADOLL 5.\rTHEN YOU CAN OBTAIN THE SECRET CODE.

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　１０３ばんどうろに\nいない　ポケモンは　どれ？
records.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON is not found\non ROUTE 103. Which one is it?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　くさタイプが　はいっていない\nポケモンは　どれ？
records.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON is not of the\nGRASS type. Which one is it?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　１ゴウ　くいず！\cこのなかで　ひっかくを\nつかう　ポケモンは　どれ？
records.english: MECHADOLL 1 QUIZ.\cOne of these POKéMON uses SCRATCH.\nWhich one is it?

records.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
records.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

records.japanese: ザンネン！\nマチガイ　デーーース！
ワハハハハ！　ワハハハハ！　カタカタ！
マタノ　ちゃれんじ　オマチシテマース！
records.english: YOUR NEXT CHALLENGE WE WAIT FOR.

records.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ！\r１ゴウノ　くいずハ　ヤサシスギルヨ！
records.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 2 AM I!\cMECHADOLL 1'S QUIZ DIFFICULTY LEVEL\nIS SET TOO LOW.

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cオダマキはかせの　かばんの\nいちばん　みぎの　ポケモンは　なんだった？
records.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cIn PROF. BIRCH's bag, there were three\nPOKéMON. Which one was at the right?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cポケモン　トレーナーズ　スクールで\nこうかん　していた　ポケモンは？
records.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cWhich POKéMON was offered for a trade\nat the POKéMON TRAINER'S SCHOOL?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　２ゴウ　くいず！\cトウカのもりで　デボンの　しゃいんが\nさがしていた　ポケモンは　なんだった？
records.english: MECHADOLL 2 QUIZ.\cThe DEVON RESEARCHER was looking for\nwhat POKéMON in PETALBURG WOODS?

records.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
records.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

records.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ！\rオカネニハ　ウルサイノダ！
records.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 3 AM I!\cMATTERS OF MONEY ARE MY SOLE FOCUS.

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cモンスターボール　３つ　かうのと\nいいキズぐすり　１つ　かうのと\rどっちが　たかい？
records.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cWhich costs more?\nThree POKé BALLS or one SUPER POTION?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cあなぬけのヒモを　うって\nどくけしを　かうと　いくら　のこる？
records.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cSell one ESCAPE ROPE and buy\none ANTIDOTE. How much money remains?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　３ゴウ　くいず！\cなんでもなおし　と　スーパーボールを　かうと\nげんきのかけら　より　たかくなる？
records.english: MECHADOLL 3 QUIZ.\cDo one FULL HEAL and GREAT BALL\ncost more than one REVIVE?

records.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
records.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

records.japanese: カタカタ‥\nからくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　ヨーン！\rウツクシイ　ワタシノ　くいず　イクワヨ！
records.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 4 THAT IS ME!\cMY QUIZ IS AN OBJECT OF BEAUTY.

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cカナズミジムリーダー　ツツジの　ポケモン\nイシツブテは　オス　メス　どっち？
records.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cRUSTBORO GYM LEADER ROXANNE used a\nGEODUDE. Was it male or female?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cムロタウンの　しゅうかいじょでは\nだんせい　じょせい　どっちが　おおい？
records.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cIn DEWFORD HALL, were there more men\nor women?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　４ゴウ　くいずヨ！\cムロタウンの　ジムで　さいしょに　たたかう\nトレーナーは　だんせい？じょせい？
records.english: MECHADOLL 4 QUIZ.\cThe first TRAINER in DEWFORD GYM was\nmale or female?

records.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　ヨー！\nウフッ　オクヘ　ドウゾ！
records.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

records.japanese: カタカタ‥\nワガハイ　ハ　からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ！\rダイオウノ　サイコウ　ケッサク！
records.english: CLICKETY-CLACK...\nMECHADOLL 5 AM I!\cTHE MASTER'S BEST AND PROUDEST\nACHIEVEMENT AM I.

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cミスターカゼノが　おもてに\nかざっている　じてんしゃは　なんだい？
records.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many BIKES does RYDEL have on\ndisplay outside his cycle shop?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cフラワーショップ　サン・トウカで\nきのみを　くれるのは　なんにん？
records.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many people give you BERRIES at the\nPRETTY PETAL flower shop?

records.japanese: からくりニンギョウ　５ゴウ　くいず！\cミナモシティに　かんばんは\nいくつ　ある？
records.english: MECHADOLL 5 QUIZ.\cHow many signs are there in\nLILYCOVE CITY?

records.japanese: オメデトウ　セイカイ　デース！\nオクヘ　ドウゾ！
records.english: CONGRATULATIONS. CORRECT YOU ARE.\nGO THROUGH. PLEASE.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　いのち」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is my life.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: さいきん　へんな　やしきが　あるって\nきいたから　しらべに　きたのよ！
records.english: When I heard there was a strange\nhouse, I had to check it out.

records.japanese: つよい　トレーナーを　はっけん！
やしきを　しらべてたら　おもしろくて\nなんかいも　チャレンジ　してるのよ！
records.english: I'm sure having a good time checking\nthis place out.\cIt's a challenge I've found worth\nrepeating!

records.japanese: おいらの　とりポケモンで\nかべを　とびこえて　いっちゃうか‥‥？
records.english: Maybe I could get my BIRD POKéMON\nto fly over the wall...

records.japanese: わわっ　しまった！
てへへ‥　ズルしようと　したから\nまけちゃったの　かな‥‥
records.english: Ehehehe... I guess I lost because I\nwas trying to cheat.

records.japanese: かいてん　する　とびらで\nめが　まわってきた‥‥
records.english: I'm getting dizzy from these rotating\ndoors...

records.japanese: くーるくる　くーるくる\nおれは　もう　ダメだ‥‥
records.english: Everything's spinning around and\naround. I can't take this anymore...

records.japanese: キミは　ぜんぜん　へいき　みたいだね\nそれとも　ポーカーフェイス　なの？
records.english: You don't seem to be affected at all.\nOr do you have your poker face on?

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　だきしめたい」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER is huggable.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: いつも　カラクリだいおうは　パッと\nきえちゃうけど　どう　やってるんだろ？
records.english: The TRICK MASTER always vanishes\nlike smoke. How does he do it?

records.japanese: ひえー\nなんで　そんなに　つよいの？
records.english: Aiyeeeh! You're much too strong!\nHow do you do it?

records.japanese: ぼくも　じゆう　じざいに\nきえたり　あらわれたり　してみたいな
records.english: I wish I could appear and disappear as\nif I were smoke, too.

records.japanese: おなじところを　つづけて\nなんども　まわると　ふきつなのよ‥‥
records.english: Going around the same spot...\nIt begets ill fortune...

records.japanese: まけた‥‥！\nえんぎが　わるいわ‥‥！
わたしは　もう　１０かい　いじょう\nまわってしまった‥‥　ふきつだわ‥‥
records.english: I've circled the same spot over ten\ntimes now... It's ill fortune...

records.japanese: かった　ほうが　さきに　このしかけを\nぬけられる　よかんが　するわ！
records.english: Whoever wins will get through here\nfirst. That's the feeling I get.

records.japanese: あら！\nじゃあ　おさきに　どうぞ！
あなたは　カラクリやしきの　しかけを\nすべて　とく　って　よかんが　するわ！
records.english: You're solving all the puzzles in the\nTRICK HOUSE. That's the feeling I get.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は　あいことばを\nとびらに　かきつけた！\c「カラクリだいおう　さま　あいしてる」\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cかぎの　はずれる　おとがした！
records.english: [PLAYER] wrote down the secret code\non the door.\c“TRICK MASTER I love.”\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThe lock clicked open!

records.japanese: ここまで　こられる　トレーナーは\nそうは　いないよな！
records.english: Not many TRAINERS have made it\nthis far.

records.japanese: つまり　キミも\nすごいって　ことだよな‥
records.english: That must mean you're tough, too...

records.japanese: えっ　ポケモンリーグの　チャンピオンに\nかったって？　す　すごい‥‥！
records.english: You've beaten the POKéMON LEAGUE\nCHAMPION? That's too much!

records.japanese: わたしと　しょうぶ　できるなんて\nあなた　しあわせよ！
records.english: Consider yourself lucky to be\nbattling me!

records.japanese: そんな　わたしが\nまけるなんて‥‥！
わたしに　かつなんて　きせきよ！\nじまん　できる　ことだわ！
records.english: It's a miracle that you beat me.\nYou can brag about it.

records.japanese: あなたも　カラクリやしきに\nちょうせん　しつづけて　いるんですね！
records.english: You've been slugging through the TRICK\nHOUSE challenge, too.

records.japanese: なるほど‥‥\nすばらしい　センスですね！
records.english: I see...\nYou possess an extraordinary style.

records.japanese: あなた　みたいな　ひとが　きてくれて\nカラクリだいおうも　まんぞく　でしょうね！
records.english: Seeing someone like you should please\nthe TRICK MASTER.

records.japanese: サイクリング　ロードでは\nおもいっきり　スピードを　だせるんだ！\cだれにも　ぶつからずに　かけぬけると\nすごく　きもち　いいよ！
records.english: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\cIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!

records.japanese: サイクリング　ロードを\nあるいて　すすむのは　あぶない　です！\rじてんしゃに　のって　きてください
records.english: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\cPlease come back with a BIKE.

records.japanese: サイクリング　ロードでは\nおもいっきり　スピードを　だせるんだ！\cだれにも　ぶつからずに　かけぬけると\nすごく　きもち　いいよ！
records.english: On CYCLING ROAD, you can go all out\nand cycle as fast as you'd like.\cIt feels great to go that fast, but try\nnot to crash into anyone!

records.japanese: サイクリング　ロードを\nあるいて　すすむのは　あぶない　です！\rじてんしゃに　のって　きてください
records.english: Sorry, you can't walk on CYCLING\nROAD. It's too dangerous.\cPlease come back with a BIKE.

records.japanese:
この　あたりは
かざんばい　だらけ　ペコペコ！\cわたし　すごいよ　ペコペコ\cかざんばいを　ガラスに　してね
それで　どうぐ　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\cきみも　これで
かざんばいを　あつめなさい　ペコペコ！
records.english: This area is covered in volcanic ash,\nhuff-puff!\cI'm specially gifted, huff-puff.\cI make glass out of volcanic ash\nand make items, huff-puff.\cGo collect ashes with this, huff-puff.

records.japanese:
その　ふくろを　もって
はいの　つもった　ところを　あるくとあら　ふしぎ！\cふくろの　なかに　かざんばいが
どんどん　たまっていくよ　ペコペコ！\cかざんばいが　たまったと　おもったら
わたしの　ところに　きなさい　ペコペコ！
records.english:
Just take that SOOT SACK and walk
through piles of ash, huff-puff.\cAnd it will fill up with the volcanic ash,
huff-puff.\cOnce you think you've collected a good
amount, come see me, huff-puff.

records.japanese: かざんばい　あるのかね　ペコペコ！\nどれどれ　みせてごらん　ペコポコ！
records.english: Have you collected ashes, huff-puff?\nLet me see, huff-puff.

records.japanese: うーん‥‥\nかざんばいが　すくないよ　ペコペコ！\rガラスのどうぐ　できないよ　ペコペコ！\cあと　[STR_VAR_1]ほ　あるけば\nあおいビードロ　つくれるよ　ペコペコ！
records.english: Hmmm...\nThere's not enough ash here, huff-puff.\rI can't make glass with this, huff-puff.\cLet's see... [STR_VAR_1] is the number of steps\nyou'll need to walk for me to make you\ra BLUE FLUTE, huff-puff.

records.japanese: おほっ\nかざんばい　あつまってるよ　ペコペコ！\rガラスのどうぐ　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\cどれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
records.english: Oh!\nYou've got a lot of ashes, huff-puff!\cI'll make you a glass item, huff-puff!\nWhich one would you like, huff-puff?

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\nほんとうに　それで　いいんだね？　ペコペコ
records.english: A [STR_VAR_1], huff-puff?\nIs that the one for you, huff-puff?

records.japanese: どれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
records.english: Which one would you like, huff-puff?

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\cよしっ！　どうぐを　つくるよ　ペコペコ！\nちょっと　まってなさいよ　ペコペコ
records.english: A [STR_VAR_1] it is, then, huff-puff!\cOkay! I'll make it for you, huff-puff.\nJust wait a little while, huff-puff.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　だね　ペコペコ！\cだけど　それを　つくるには\nかざんばいが　たりないよ　ペコペコ！\cかざんばいの　つもっている　ところを\nあと　[STR_VAR_2]ほ　あるかないと　ペコペコ！\cどれが　いいかね　ペコペコ
records.english:
A [STR_VAR_1], huff-puff?\cThere's not enough ash here to make
that, though, huff-puff.\cLet's see... [STR_VAR_2] is the number of steps
you'll need to walk through volcanic ashfor me to make that item, huff-puff.\cWhich item would you rather have me
make instead, huff-puff?

records.japanese: せっかく　かざんばいを　あつめたのに\nほしい　ものは　ないのかね　ペコペコ‥‥
records.english: You've collected all that ash, but you\ndon't want anything, huff-puff?

records.japanese: おお　[STR_VAR_1]　できたよ\nもって　いきなさいよ　ペコペコ
records.english: Ah, I've finished your [STR_VAR_1].\nTake it, huff-puff.

records.japanese: あら？\nそれいじょう　もてないよ　ペコペコ\cあずかって　おくから\nこんど　きなさい　ペコペコ
records.english: Oh?\nYou've no room in your BAG, huff-puff.\cI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.

records.japanese: あら？\nパソコン　いっぱい　なのか　ペコペコ\cあずかって　おくから\nこんど　きなさい　ペコペコ
records.english: Oh?\nYou've no room in your PC, huff-puff?\cI'll hold on to it, so come back later,\nhuff-puff.

records.japanese: あら？\nはいぶくろ　もっていないのか　ペコペコ\cもちあるかないと\nかざんばい　たまらないよ　ペコペコ
records.english: Hah? You haven't got your SOOT SACK\nwith you, huff-puff.\cYou have to keep it with you to collect\nvolcanic ash, huff-puff.

records.japanese: おやかたが　はなすのに　あわせて\nビードロ　ふくと　たのしか！\cペコペコ！　ペコポコ！
records.english: It's fun to blow a glass flute while my\nboss is talking.\cHuff-huff! Puff-puff!

records.japanese: リーダーが　ここでの　けんきゅうに\nきょうみを　もったらしくて\rおれらを　よこしたんだ！　ジャマするな！
records.english: The BOSS got interested in the\nresearch they have going here, so he\rsent us out.\cYou quit meddling!

records.japanese: くそー\nこどもに　まけた‥‥
リーダーは　なんでも　しっている‥‥\cしかし　なにを　かんがえて　いるのか\nしたっぱの　おれらには　さっぱりだ
records.english: Our BOSS knows everything.\cBut I'm just a GRUNT. What would I know\nabout what he's thinking?

records.japanese: あら？\nどうして　ここに　こどもが　いるのかしら？
あらー\nまけちゃったー！？
あらら‥‥\nこどもに　まけたら　おこられちゃう‥‥\cベッドで　ねてようかしら？
records.english: Oh, no...\nI'll catch an earful for losing to a kid...\cI should just take a nap in the bed...

records.japanese: ぼくが　ベッドで　ねてる　あいだに\nみんな　２かいに　いっちゃったよ
records.english: While I was sleeping, everyone went\nupstairs!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　つよいんだね！\cぼくも　[STR_VAR_1]　みたいな\nポケモントレーナーに　なりたいや！
records.english: Wow, you're really strong!\cI wish I could be a POKéMON TRAINER\nlike you!

records.japanese: はかせは　あめが　だいすき　なのです\cですが　あめが　ふりつづくと\nこまってしまう　ひとも　いるわけです\cそこで　はかせは\nこの　あめを　なにかに　つかえないか\rけんきゅう　なさっているのです
records.english:
The PROFESSOR loves rain.
That's a fact.\cBut if it keeps raining, people will be in
trouble. That's another fact.\cAnd thus, the PROFESSOR is studying
if the rain can be put to good use.

records.japanese: やあ！\nあなたの　おかげで　たすかりましたよ！\rそれにしても‥‥\c[EVIL_TEAM]の　れんちゅうは\nなにを　するつもり　だったのでしょう？
records.english: Hello!\nWe've been saved by your actions!\cWhat I don't understand is what on\nearth the [EVIL_TEAM]S were up to.

records.japanese: ベッドが　ある‥‥\nやすんでいこう
records.english: There's a bed...\nLet's take a rest.

records.japanese: この　けんきゅうじょで　うみだされた\nポケモンは　てんきと　かんけいある　って\rきいたから　いただきに　きたのさ！
records.english: The INSTITUTE created a type of\nPOKéMON that has something to do with\rthe weather. We're here to take them!

records.japanese: こんな　こどもに　じゃま　されるのか！？
records.english: Our plan's being spoiled by a kid?

records.japanese: ここで　うみだされた　ポケモンが\nもし　てんきを　じゆうに　あやつれるなら\rぜったい　[EVIL_TEAM]だんに　ひつよう　だぜ！
records.english: If the POKéMON they made here can\ncontrol the weather freely, then we of\rTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] definitely need it!

records.japanese: おれたち　[EVIL_TEAM]だん！\nめずらしい　ものが　ある　ところなら\rどこにでも　あらわれる！
records.english: We're TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]!\nWe appear wherever anything rare is\rfound!

records.japanese: こいつは　まいった！
[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　りそうを　しらないくせに\nじゃま　するんじゃ　ないよ！
records.english: You don't have any idea what we of\nTEAM [EVIL_TEAM] are working towards!\rYou stay out of our way!

records.japanese:
オーッホッホ！\cわれわれ　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの
じゃまを　しようと　いうの！？\cもう　こわいものしらず　といおうか
ただの　おろかものと　いおうか‥‥\cかわいすぎて　にくらしく　なっちゃう！
やっつけて　あげるわね！
records.english:
Ahahahaha!\cYou're going to meddle in TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]'s
affairs?\cYou're either absolutely fearless,
simply ignorant, or both!\cYou're so cute, you're disgusting!
I'll put you down, kiddy!

records.japanese: オーッホッホ！\nつよくて　にくらしく　なっちゃうわ！

オーッホッホ！
おもわぬ　じゃまが　はいっちゃったわ！\cしかたないわね！
ここは　いちど　ひきあげちゃう！\cでもね　[EVIL_TEAM]だんの　かつどうは
まだまだ　つづくんだからおぼえて　おきなさーい！
records.english:
Ahahahaha!
We got meddled with unexpectedly!\cWe're out of options.
We'll have to pull out.\cBut this isn't the last you'll see of
TEAM [EVIL_TEAM]! We have other plans!Don't you forget it!

records.japanese: ありがとうよ\nきみの　おかげで　たすかったよ\cおれいと　いっては　なんだが\nこの　ポケモンを　もらって　おくれ
records.english: Thanks!\nThanks to you, we're safe!\cIt might be an odd way of thanking you,\nbut take this POKéMON.

records.japanese: あら？　それいじょう\nポケモンを　もてないようだよ
records.english: Hm? You don't seem to have any room\nfor this POKéMON.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\nポワルンを　もらった！
そいつは　そのときの　てんきに　よって\nすがたを　かえる　ポケモン　なんだよ\cけんきゅうじょ　には　たくさん　いるから\nえんりょせずに　もらって　おくれよ
records.english: That POKéMON changes shape according\nto the weather conditions.\cThere're plenty of them in the\nINSTITUTE - go ahead and take it.

records.japanese: わたしも　ながい　あいだ\nあめの　けんきゅうを　してるが\rてんきを　じゆうじざいに　かえるだなんて\rにんげんには　むりな　はなし　だよ
records.english: I've been researching rain for many\nyears, but it's ridiculous to think that\rhumans can freely change the weather.

records.japanese: どこかに　めざめのほこら　とよばれる\nどうくつが　あるんですって！\cポケモンの　たましいが　よみがえる　ところ\nという　うわさ　だけど\rそんなこと　ほんとうに　あるのかしら？
records.english: I heard about a cave called the CAVE\nOF ORIGIN.\cPeople rumor that the spirits of\nPOKéMON are revived there.\rCould something like that really happen?

records.japanese: キャモメ『ぴひょ？
オレは　ダイビング　トレジャーハンター！\cふかい　うみに　もぐっては\nかいていに　ねむる　おたからを　あつめる\rすげえ　やろう　なのさ！
records.english: I'm the DIVING TREASURE HUNTER!\cI'm the awesome dude who makes\ndeep-sea dives to gather treasures\rresting at the bottom.

records.japanese: おおむかしに　つくられた　という\nいろいろな　かけら　みつかったかい？
records.english: Tell me, have you seen any SHARDS of\ntools made in ancient times?

records.japanese: きみ　おたから　もってないのか‥‥\cあかいかけら　とか\nいろいろな　かけらを　みつけたら\rこうかん　してくれよな！
records.english: You haven't got any treasures\nfor me...\cIf you see any SHARDS, like the RED\nSHARD, you've got to trade it with me!

records.japanese: おおっ！　それは！\nオレが　さがしている　かけら！！\cなっ　なっ！\nきみの　もってる　おたからと\rオレの　おたから　こうかん　してくれよ！
records.english: Oh, hey! That...\nThat's a SHARD! I'm looking for those!\cOh, man, you've got to trade that\nwith me! I'll give you something good!

records.japanese: どれを　こうかん　するんだい？
records.english: What do you want to trade?

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　を　[STR_VAR_2]に\nこうかん　するんだな？
とりひき　せいりつ！\nだいじに　つかって　くれよな！
records.english: It's a done deal!\nUse that wisely!

records.japanese: まだ　こうかん　するかい？
records.english: Do you want to trade something else?

records.japanese: おっと　バッグが　いっぱい　だぜ\nどうぐを　へらして　きなよ
records.english: Whoops, your BAG's full.\nGet rid of some items, friend!

records.japanese: そいつは　がっかりだ\nきが　むいたら　また　きてくれよな！
records.english: No? That's a downer.\nWell, if you change your mind, come back.

records.japanese:
ほしいモノ　　　　　　　あげるモノ

I found a spot I liked, and I did it up
with my favorite decorations.\cI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow
stronger with it.\cThat's what I do.
Want to battle with me?

records.japanese: きみの　じつりょくを　みせてくれ！
records.english: Show me what you're made of!

records.japanese: まぁ　そんな　ときも　あるよね！
records.english: I guess there are times when you're not\ninto it.

records.japanese: きみの　じつりょくは　じゅうぶん　わかった！
records.english: I know exactly what you're made of now.

records.japanese: きみも　ぼくも　もっと　つよく　なれる！\nおたがいに　がんばろうね！
records.english: We can both become stronger.\nLet's keep at it!

records.japanese: すきな　ばしょを　さがして\nすきな　ものを　おく！\cすきな　ポケモンを　そだてて\nぼくも　いっしょに　つよくなる\cまいにち　たのしいねー
records.english: I found a spot I liked, and I did it up\nwith my favorite decorations.\cI raise my favorite POKéMON and grow\nstronger with it.\cEvery day is a great day.

records.japanese: グッズの　しゅるいや　おきかたを　みれば\nそのひとが　どんな　センスの　もちぬしか\rよーく　わかるわね！\cわたしの　センスは　どうかしら？\nうふふっ　なにも　いえないって　かんじね！\cしょうぶの　センスも　ためして　みる？
records.english: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\rdecorations they have, and how they\rdisplay them.\cWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?\cWant to see my taste in battling?

records.japanese: おもいっきり　いくわよ！
いつでも　わたしの　センスを　みせるわよ！
records.english: I'll be happy to demonstrate my style\nanytime.

records.japanese: すごい　さいのうね！\nそこしれぬ　つよさを　かんじたわ‥‥
records.english: You're supremely talented!\nYour power seems to be limitless...

records.japanese: わたしの　センス　どうだった？\nもっと　センスを　みがくわよー
records.english: What did you think of my style?\nI'll keep on polishing it!

records.japanese: グッズの　しゅるいや　おきかたを　みれば\nそのひとが　どんな　センスの　もちぬしか\rよーく　わかるわね！\cわたしの　センスは　どうかしら？\nうふふっ　なにも　いえないって　かんじね！
records.english: You can learn a lot about the taste\nand sense of people by the kinds of\rdecorations they have, and how they\rdisplay them.\cWhat do you think of my taste?\nAre you speechless?

records.japanese: えっ　なにを　してるかって？\cポケモンの　わざを　つかって\nここに　ぼくだけの　へやを\rつくろうと　おもってね！\cそうだっ　この　わざマシンを　あげるから\nきみも　つくって　みるかい？
records.english:
What's that?
What am I doing?\cI'm thinking about making my own room
here using a POKéMON move.\cI know! I'll give you this TM.
Will you use it to make your own room?

records.japanese:
ツルが　おちそうな　きにむかって
ひみつのちからを　つかってごらん！ツルが　おちてきて　きのうえに　のぼれるよ！\cそれでね　うえには　ひろいへやが　あるから
ぼくは　そこに　すきなものを　おくんだ！じぶんだけの　ひみつのへや‥そう　ひみつきちさ！きみも　つくると　いいよー\cそうそう　ひみつきちを　つくれる　ばしょは
きのうえ　だけじゃ　ないよ！\cちいさな　くぼみがある　かべなんかにも
ひみつのちからを　つかって　みるといいよ！\cぼくも　ほかの　ばしょを　さがして　みるね
それじゃ！
records.english:
Find a big tree that looks like it might
drop some vines.\cUse SECRET POWER in front of the tree.
Some vines should get free and dropdown, so you can climb the tree.\cYou'll find a lot of space for putting
your favorite things.\cIt'll be your own secret room...
A SECRET BASE!\cYou should make one, too.\cAnother thing, you don't always have
to make your SECRET BASE in a tree.\cTry using SECRET POWER on rock walls
that have small indents in them.\cI'm going to look for other places, too.
Okay, bye!

records.japanese: そう　いらないんだ‥\nほしくなったら　また　こえかけてね！
records.english: Oh, you don't want this?\nIf you change your mind, tell me, okay?

records.japanese: あれ？\nそれいじょうは　もてない　みたいだよ\cまた　こんど　とりに　きてね！
records.english: Oh, you don't have any room for this.\cI'll hold on to it, so come back for it\nanother time, okay?

records.japanese: ひみつきちの　グッズは　すべて\nパソコンに　もどります\cそれでも　よろしいですか？
records.english: All decorations and furniture in your\nSECRET BASE will be returned to your PC.\cIs that okay?

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　ひみつきちを\nとうろく　しますか？
records.english: Do you want to register\n[STR_VAR_1]'s SECRET BASE?

records.japanese: すでに　とうろくされています\nとうろくを　かいじょ　しますか？
records.english: This data is already registered.\nWould you like to delete it?

records.japanese: とうろく　できる　かずは\n１０かしょ　まで　です\cどれか　かいじょ　すれば\nとうろく　できます
records.english: Up to 10 locations can be registered.\cDelete a location if you want to\nregister another location.

records.japanese: とうろく　しました！
とうろくを　かいじょ　しました！
もようがえグッズが　ありません‥
[PLAYER]は\nパソコンの　スイッチを　いれた！
なにを　しますか？
records.english: What would you like to do?

records.japanese: とうろくした　ひみつきちは\nあいてが　ひっこしを　しないかぎり\rなくなる　ことは　ありません\cとうろく　リストから　さくじょすると\nほかの　ひみつきちに\rかわることが　あります\cとうろくは　１０かしょ　まで　できます[PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS]
records.english: The registered SECRET BASE will remain\nunless the owner moves away.\cIf it is removed from the registry,\nanother SECRET BASE may take its place.\cUp to ten locations can be registered.[PAUSE_UNTIL_PRESS]

records.japanese: バトルタワーで　[STR_VAR_1]にん　かちぬいた\nきねんの　[STR_VAR_2]の　たて
records.english: A shield of [STR_VAR_2] that marks winning\n[STR_VAR_1] times in a row at the BATTLE TOWER.

records.japanese: ほんもの　そっくりの　オモチャのテレビ\nしらない　ひとが　みたら　まちがうかも！？
records.english: A realistic toy TV. It could be easily\nmistaken for the real thing.

records.japanese: タネボー　みたいな　オモチャのテレビ\nなんだか　ころがりだしそう！？
records.english: A toy TV shaped like a SEEDOT.\nIt looks ready to roll away on its own...

records.japanese: エネコ　みたいな　オモチャのテレビ\nなんだか　あるきだしそう！？
records.english: A toy TV shaped like a SKITTY.\nIt looks ready to stroll away...

records.japanese: ひみつきちは　ひとつしか　つくれません！\c[STR_VAR_1]　にある\nひみつきちを　ひっこし　しますか？
records.english: You may only make one SECRET BASE.\cWould you like to move from the SECRET\nBASE near [STR_VAR_1]?

records.japanese: ひっこし　かんりょう！\cひみつのちからを　つかいますか？
records.english: Moving completed.\cWould you like to use the SECRET POWER?

records.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nコロシアム　に　ようこそ\cこちらでは　ともだちと\nポケモンの　たいせんが　たのしめます\cたいせんを　しますか？
records.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nCOLOSSEUM.\cYou may battle with your friends here.\cWould you like to battle?

records.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nトレードセンター　に　ようこそ\cこちらでは　ともだちと\nポケモンの　こうかんが　たのしめます\cこうかんを　しますか？
records.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nTRADE CENTER.\cYou may trade your POKéMON here\nwith a friend.\cWould you like to trade POKéMON?

records.japanese: ポケモン　つうしん　クラブ\nレコード　コーナー　へ　ようこそ\cこちらでは　トレーナーとしての　レコードを\nともだちと　まぜる　ことが　できます\cともだちと　レコードを　まぜますか？
records.english: Welcome to the POKéMON CABLE CLUB\nRECORD CORNER.\cYou may mix your records as a TRAINER\nwith the records of your friends.\cWould you like to mix records?

records.japanese:
つうしん　たいせんには　
たいせんの　モードが　３つあります\cシングルバトルは　せんとうに　ポケモンが
１ひきずつでて　ふたりで　たいせん\cダブルバトルは　せんとうに　ポケモンが
２ひきずつでて　ふたりで　たいせん\cマルチバトルは　せんとうに　ポケモンが
２ひきずつでて　４にんで　たいせんします
records.english:
There are three link battle modes.\cSINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.\cDOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS
with two or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER will send out two
POKéMON in battle at a time.\cMULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS
with one or more POKéMON each.\cEach TRAINER can have one POKéMON
in battle at a time.

records.japanese: たいせんを　しますか？
どちらの　たいせんをしますか？
records.english: Which Battle Mode would you like\nto play?

records.japanese: ダブルバトルでは　２ひき　いじょうの\nポケモンが　ひつようです
records.english: For a DOUBLE BATTLE, you must have\nat least two POKéMON.

records.japanese: こうかんでは　２ひき　いじょうの\nてもちが　ひつようです
records.english: For trading, you must have at least\ntwo POKéMON with you.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]のみをもっている　ポケモンは\nこうかんは　できません！
しょうしょう　おまち　ください\n‥‥Ｂボタンで　キャンセル
にんずうが　そろったら　Ａボタンで　すすむ\n‥‥Ｂボタンで　キャンセル
records.english: When all players are ready...\nA Button: Confirm   B Button: Cancel

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]にんで　つうしんを　はじめます\nＡボタンで　けってい　Ｂボタンで　もどる
records.english: Start link with [STR_VAR_1] players.\nA Button: Confirm   B Button: Cancel

records.japanese: つうしんかいしを　まっています\n‥‥Ｂボタンで　キャンセル
つうしんを　はじめるまえに\nレポートを　かきますが　よろしいですか？
records.english: Your progress must be saved before\nlinking. Is it okay to save?

records.japanese: それでは　へやへ　どうぞ
おともだちの　じゅんびが\nできて　いない　ようです\cじゅんびが　できましたら\nまた　おこしください
records.english: Someone is not ready to link.\cPlease come back after everyone has\nmade preparations.

records.japanese: つうしんエラー　です\nリセットして　やりなおして　ください
records.english: Sorry, we have a transmission error...\nPlease reset and try again.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Sorry, we have a transmission error.\nYou may not mix records in different\rlanguages.

records.japanese: おたがいの　せんたくが　ちがっているようです
records.english: The link partners appear to have made\ndifferent selections.

records.japanese: それでは　また　おこしください
さんかしている　にんずうが\nただしく　ありません
シングルバトルは　[STR_VAR_1]にんで\nあそぶことは　できません！
records.english: The SINGLE Battle Mode cannot be\nplayed by [STR_VAR_1] players.

records.japanese: ダブルバトルは　[STR_VAR_1]にんでは\nあそぶことは　できません！
records.english: The DOUBLE Battle Mode cannot be\nplayed by [STR_VAR_1] players.

records.japanese: さんか　にんずうが　４にん　いないと\nたいせん　することが　できません！
records.english: There must be four players to play\nthis Battle Mode.

records.japanese: もういちど　にんずうを　たしかめて\nさいしょから　やりなおして　ください
records.english: Please confirm the number of players\nand start again.

records.japanese: へやからでると　つうしんを　しゅうりょう\nしますが　よろしいですか？
records.english: The link will be terminated if you\nleave the room. Is that okay?

records.japanese: つうしんを　しゅうりょうして　へやの　そとへ\nごあんないします！　しばらく　おまちください
records.english: Terminating link... You will be\nescorted out of the room. Please wait.

records.japanese: とりこみちゅうの　ようだ‥
records.english: This TRAINER is too busy to notice...

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　トレーナーカードを\nみせてもらった！
records.english: Score! Got to look at [STR_VAR_1]'s\nTRAINER CARD!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　トレーナーカードを\nみせてもらった！　‥[STR_VAR_2]カードだ！
records.english: Score! Got to look at [STR_VAR_1]'s\nTRAINER CARD! It's a [STR_VAR_2] card!

records.japanese: しょていの　いちに　ついて\nたいせんを　はじめて　ください
records.english: Please take your seat and start\nyour battle.

records.japanese: しょていの　いちに　ついて\nこうかんを　はじめて　ください
records.english: Please take your seat and start\nyour trade.

records.japanese: しょていの　いちに　ついて\nおまち　ください
records.english: Please take your seat and wait.

records.japanese: ごりよう　ありがとう　ございました
では　マルチバトルに　だす　\nポケモンを　えらんでください
records.english: Please choose your POKéMON for the\nMULTI BATTLE.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]さんから\n[STR_VAR_2]が　おくられてきた！
トレーナーカードの\nきろくを　かきかえます！
records.english: The TRAINER CARD data will\nbe rewritten.

records.japanese: では　また　どうぞ！
records.english: I hope to see you again!

records.japanese: こんにちは！\nこちらでは　ポケモンコンテスト\r[STR_VAR_1]　ランクの\rうけつけを　おこなって　います！
records.english: Hello, there!\cWe're accepting registrations for\n[STR_VAR_1] Rank POKéMON CONTESTS.

records.japanese: あなたの　ポケモンも　コンテストに\nさんか　させて　みませんか？
records.english: Would you like to enter your POKéMON\nin our CONTESTS?

records.japanese: どの　せつめいを　ききますか？

ポケモンコンテストは　４にんの　トレーナーが
１ぴきずつ　ポケモンを　もちよって４ひきで　おこなわれます！\cコンテスト　には　１じ　しんさと
２じ　しんさが　あります！\c１じ　しんさでは　かいじょうの
おきゃくさまが　きにいった　ポケモンをとうひょう　します！\c２じ　しんさでは　ポケモンが　じゅんばんに
とくいな　わざで　アピールを　します！しんさいんに　ちゅうもくされたりおきゃくさまに　わざを　きにいられたり‥‥とにかく　たくさん　めだって　ください！\c１じしんさと　２じしんさの　けっかから
そうごうポイントを　だしていちばん　たかかった　ポケモンがゆうしょう　できます！
records.english:
A POKéMON CONTEST involves four
TRAINERS entering one POKéMON eachin competitive judging.\cA CONTEST has two stages of judging,
primary and secondary.\cPrimary judging is a popularity poll
involving the audience.\cSecondary judging features appeals
by the POKéMON using their moves.\cPlan appeals carefully to earn the
most attention of the JUDGE andexcite the audience.Do your best to stand out.\cThe primary and secondary scores are
added at the end.\cThe POKéMON garnering the highest
score is declared the winner.

records.japanese: コンテストには　５しゅるい　あります！\cかっこよさ　うつくしさ　かわいさ\nかしこさ　そして　たくましさ\rいじょうの　５しゅるい　です！\cエントリー　する　ポケモンに\nピッタリの　コンテストを\rえらんで　あげて　くださいね！
records.english: There are five kinds of CONTESTS.\cCOOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART, and\nTOUGH are the five categories.\cChoose the CONTEST that is right for\nthe POKéMON you plan to enter.

records.japanese:
ポケモンコンテスト　には
ノーマルランク　スーパーランクハイパーランク　そしてマスターランクという　４つの　ランクが　あります\cノーマルランク　には　すべての
ポケモンが　でることが　できます\cノーマルランクで　ゆうしょう　できた
ポケモンは　おなじ　しゅるいのスーパーランクの　コンテストに　でられます\cおなじように　スーパーで　ゆうしょう　すれば
ハイパーに　ハイパーで　ゆうしょう　すればマスターランクに　でられるのです\cマスターランクで　ゆうしょう　した
ポケモンは　なんどでも　マスターランクのコンテストに　でる　ことが　できます
records.english:
There are four ranks of POKéMON
CONTESTS.\cNORMAL, SUPER, HYPER and MASTER
are the four ranks.\cIn the NORMAL Rank, any POKéMON may
enter.\cAny POKéMON that won a NORMAL Rank
CONTEST may move up the SUPER Rank inthe same category.\cIn the same way, a SUPER Rank winner
can move up to the HYPER Rank, and aHYPER Rank winner can advance to theMASTER Rank in the same category.\cA POKéMON that won in the MASTER Rank
may compete in the MASTER Rank asoften as its TRAINER wants.

records.japanese: どのポケモンを　さんか　させますか？
records.english: Which POKéMON would you like to enter?

records.japanese: コンテストパスを　おもちの　かたは\nどなたでも　さんか　できます！\cコンテストパスは　シダケタウンに　ある\nノーマルランクの　コンテスト　かいじょうで\rどなたでも　もらえますよ！\cパスをもって　また　いらして　くださいね！
records.english: Anyone with a CONTEST PASS may enter.\cYou may obtain a CONTEST PASS at the\nNORMAL RANK CONTEST HALL in\rVERDANTURF TOWN free of charge.\cPlease obtain a CONTEST PASS and\ncome again.

records.japanese:
こちらは　ポケモンコンテストの
４めいさま　せんようの　うけつけです！\cコンテストパスを　おもちの　かたは
どなたでも　さんか　できます！\cコンテストパスは　シダケタウンに　ある
ノーマルランクの　コンテスト　かいじょうでどなたでも　もらえますよ！\cパスをもって　また　いらして　くださいね！
records.english:
I accept registrations only from four
linked players for a POKéMON CONTEST.\cAnyone with a CONTEST PASS may enter.\cYou may obtain a CONTEST PASS at the
NORMAL RANK CONTEST HALL inVERDANTURF TOWN free of charge.\cPlease obtain a CONTEST PASS and
come again.

records.japanese:
コンテストパスを　おもちの　かたは
どなたでも　さんか　できます！\cおもちで　ない　かたは
こちらで　はっこう　いたします！\cコンテストパスを
はっこう　しますか？
records.english: Anyone with a CONTEST PASS may enter.\cIf you don't have one, I can issue one\nfor you right now.\cWould you like me to issue you a\nCONTEST PASS?

records.japanese: それでは　こちらを　どうぞ！
あら？\c[PLAYER]さんの　パスは\nすでに　はっこう　されてますね！\cコンテストパスを　おもちに　なって\nまた　いらして　くださいね！
records.english: Oh?\cWe've already issued you a CONTEST\nPASS, [PLAYER].\cPlease come back with your CONTEST\nPASS.

records.japanese: さんか　したい　ときは\nいつでも　いらして　くださいね！
records.english: Please visit whenever you would like\nto enter a CONTEST.

records.japanese: どの　コンテストに　さんか　しますか？
records.english: Which CONTEST would you like to enter?

records.japanese: もうしわけ　ないのですが\nおきゃくさまの　ポケモンですと\rこのランクには　まだ　しゅつじょう\rできないようです‥
records.english: I'm terribly sorry, but your POKéMON\nis not qualified to compete at this\rRank yet...

records.japanese: ごめんなさい！\nタマゴは　しゅつじょう　できないんです‥‥
records.english: I'm sorry, but an EGG cannot take part\nin a POKéMON CONTEST.

records.english: Your POKéMON appears to be in no\ncondition to take part in a CONTEST...

records.japanese: あら　そちらの　リボンは‥‥\cおきゃくさまの　ポケモンは　もう\nこの　コンテストで　ゆうしょう　したことが\rあるのですね‥　それでも　いいですか？
records.english: Oh, but that RIBBON...\cYour POKéMON has won this CONTEST\nbefore, hasn't it?\cWould you like to enter it in this\nCONTEST anyway?

records.japanese: そちらの　ポケモンで　よろしいですか？
それでは　おきゃくさまの　ポケモンを\nエントリー　します！\rおきゃくさまの　エントリーナンバーは\r４ばん　に　なります！\rコンテストは　すぐに　はじまります！
records.english: Okay, your POKéMON will be entered\nin this CONTEST.\cYour POKéMON is Entry No. 4.\nThe CONTEST will begin shortly.

records.japanese: それでは　こちらへ　どうぞ！\nがんばって　くださいね！
records.english: Please come in through here.\nGood luck!

records.japanese: コンテストでの　ゆうしょう\nおめでとう　ございます！\cしょうひんは　こちらで　おあずかり\nして　ありますよ！　さあ　どうぞ！
records.english: Congratulations! Your POKéMON is the\nCONTEST winner!\cWe have your prize right here.\nPlease, right this way!

records.japanese: それでは　また　あとで\nとりに　きて　くださいね！

records.english:
You make your own profile by putting
together four words or phrases.\cHere, I'll show you an example of a
profile using four pieces of text.\cYou can switch those four pieces with
other text pieces any which way youlike to make your own profile.\cThere are a lot of text pieces that you
can use.\cThey are arranged in groups like
POKéMON, lifestyles, and hobbies soit is easier to look them up.\cSo, first, choose the group of text
pieces to display a list of choices.\cThen, pick the choice you want.\cRepeat for the remaining text choices,
and you'll have your very own profile.

records.japanese: ぶふぉー！！
いんせきに　ひめられた　ちから\cこの　そうちで　ぞうふく　すれば\nたちまちの　うちに　えんとつやまの\rかざん　かつどうは　かっぱつになる‥‥\cフフフ‥‥　かざんは　ふんかして\nやがて　ようがんが　ひえて　かたまり\rだいちが　ふえるだろう‥‥
records.english: The power contained in the METEORITE...\cBy amplifying its power with this\nmachine, MT. CHIMNEY's volcanic activity\rwill instantly intensify...\cFufufu... The volcano will erupt, spewing\nlava that will cool and harden.\rIt will expand the landmass...

records.japanese:
マツブサ『また　きみか‥‥\c‥‥　いいか　われわれ
にんげんは　だいちで　しんか　してきた！\cそう　だいちこそが　すべて！\cだから　われわれ　マグマだんは
だいちを　ふやすことであらたな　ポケモンを　しんか　させる！\cにんげんが　はってん　するための
ばしょも　ふやす！\cこれこそが　マグマだんの　りそう！
なにも　しらない　きみのような　こどもにじゃま　させる　わけには　いかない\cじゃまを　するなら　どうなるか
この　マツブサが　わからせて　あげよう！
records.english:
MAXIE: You again...\cNow listen.
We humans have grown on dry land.\cThe land is everything!
Its importance is paramount!\cThat is why we of TEAM MAGMA are
committed to expanding the landmass.\cIt will create space for new species
of POKéMON to evolve.\cIt will give us humans more space to
advance.\cThat is TEAM MAGMA's vision!\cI can't allow an ignorant child like
you to get in our way.\cI, MAXIE, will show you the
consequences of meddling!

records.japanese: なに！？\cこの　マツブサとも　あろう　ものが\nゆだん　したか！？
records.english: What?!\cI, MAXIE, was caught off guard?!

records.japanese: マツブサ『まあ　いい\nこの　えんとつやまは　ひとまず\rあきらめよう‥‥\cだが　われわれ　マグマだんの　かつどうを\nとめることなど　だれにも　できない！\cそれだけは　わすれないで　もらおう！
records.english: MAXIE: Ah, whatever.\nI will give up our plans for MT. CHIMNEY\rfor the time being...\cBut no one can ever stop us!\nTEAM MAGMA will prevail!\cDon't you ever forget that!

records.japanese: ウヒョヒョ！\cおまえ　ここまで　きたのか！\cだけど　おそかったぜ\nりゅうせいのたきで　みつけた\rいんせきは　リーダーに　わたしたからな！
records.english: Hehehe!\cSo you've come all the way here!\cBut you're too late!\nI've already delivered the METEORITE\rfrom METEOR FALLS to the BOSS!

records.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥\nまけて　しまったか\cあのとき　りゅうせいのたきで\nたたかわなくて　よかったぜ
records.english: Hehehe...\nSo I lost...\cI'm sure glad I never took you on back\nat METEOR FALLS.

records.japanese: ウヒョヒョ‥‥！\cおれに　かてても\nリーダーには　かてないぜ！\cさっさと　かえったほうが\nいたい　おもい　しなくて　すむぜ
records.english: Hehehe!\cYou might have beaten me, but you don't\nstand a chance against the BOSS!\cIf you get lost now, you won't have to\nface a sound whipping!

records.japanese: おれら　マグマだんは\nみんなの　ために　がんばってるんだ！\cだって　だいちが　ふえれば\nすむところが　ふえるから\rみんな　うれしいだろ！
records.english: We of TEAM MAGMA are working hard for\neveryone's sake.\cLike, if there's more land, there'd be\nmore places to live.\rEveryone'd be happy!

records.japanese: あれー？\nおれ　まけたのー！？
records.english: Hunh?\nWhat do you mean I lost?

records.japanese: おれらの　リーダーは\n「みんなが　よろこぶ　ことだ」って\rいってるんだ！\cなのに　なんで　みんな　ジャマするんだ？
records.english: Our BOSS says, “It will make everyone\nhappy.”\cBut why does everyone keep getting\nin our way?

records.japanese: アクアだんの　やつらめ‥‥\nいちいち　おれたちの　じゃまを　しやがって！
records.english: That annoying TEAM AQUA...\nThey always mess with our plans!

records.japanese: いんせきには　すごい　パワーが　あるのだ！
いけー！　アクアだんを　ぶっつぶせ！\nそして　だいちを　ふやすのだ！
records.english: Go! Stomp TEAM AQUA!\nAnd expand the land!

records.japanese: いいか　おれたちの　じゃまを　するな！\cおれたちは　みんなの　ために\nだいちを　ふやそうと　してるんだからな！
records.english: Stay out of our way, okay?\cWe're trying to enlarge the landmass\nfor the good of everybody!

records.japanese: よーし！\nほのおを　ぶっかけてやれー！！
もっと　もっと　だいちを　ふやすぜ！！
records.english: We're going to keep making more land!

records.japanese: ぶふぉー！！

アオギリ『おお！　[PLAYER][KUN]！
いいところに　きてくれたな！\cわたしに　かわって
マグマだんを　とめてくれ！\cあいつら　うばった　いんせきの　パワーで
この　かざんを　ふんか　させてりくを　ふやそうと　しているんだ！
records.english:
ARCHIE: Oh, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cPlease, you must stop TEAM MAGMA
for me!\cThey're trying to make this volcano
erupt by using the stolen METEORITE'spower!\cIt's all a part of their plans to
expand the world's landmass!

records.japanese: アオギリ『[PLAYER][KUN]！\cわたしに　かわって\nマグマだんを　とめてくれ！\cこいつら　したっぱ　３にんの　あいては\nさすがの　わたしでも　たいへんだ！
records.english: ARCHIE: [PLAYER][KUN]!\cPlease, you've got to stop TEAM MAGMA\nfor me!\cDealing with these three thugs is\na lot, even for me!

records.japanese:
アオギリ『[PLAYER][KUN]！　ありがとう
きみの　おかけで　マグマだんのはかいかつどうを　ふせぐことが　できた\cだが‥‥　まだ　あいつらの　やぼうは
これで　おわった　わけじゃない！\cわれわれは　ひきつづき　マグマだんを
おいかけると　しよう！\c[PLAYER][KUN]
では　また　あおう！
records.english:
ARCHIE: [PLAYER][KUN]! Thank you!\cWith your help, we thwarted TEAM
MAGMA's destructive plan!\cBut... This victory doesn't mean the
end of their evil plans.\cWe will remain vigilant and keep up
our pursuit of TEAM MAGMA.\c[PLAYER][KUN], we shall meet again!

records.japanese: くそう　マグマだんが　おおすぎる‥‥\nこのままでは　まずいぞ！
records.english: Darn... TEAM MAGMA outnumbers us!\nWe can't keep up with them!

records.japanese: だいちを　ふやしたら\nみずポケモンが　すむ　ばしょが\rへってしまう　じゃねーか！
records.english: If they expand the land, there'll be\nless habitats for WATER POKéMON!

records.japanese: マグマだんめ\nりくを　ふやそう　なんて　ばかげてるぜ！
records.english: TEAM MAGMA wants to expand the\nlandmass... How's that for insane?

records.japanese: ぷしゃー！！
アオギリ『‥‥まちたまえ！
アオギリ『ふふふ‥‥\nやはり　きみ　だったか
records.english: ARCHIE: Fufufu...\nSo it was you, after all.

records.japanese: アオギリ『どうだ　みたまえ！\cちょう　こだいポケモン　カイオーガが\nしずかに　ねむる　うつくしい　すがたを！\cわたしは　この　ひが　くるのを\nながい　あいだ　まっていた‥‥
records.english: ARCHIE: Behold!\cSee how beautiful it is, the sleeping\nform of the ancient POKéMON KYOGRE!\cI have waited so long for this day to\ncome...

records.japanese: アオギリ『それにしても　まさか　きみが\nここまで　くいついて　くるとはな！\cだが　それも　もう　おわり\nわたしの　もくてき　たっせいの　ため\rきみには　ここで　きえてもらう！
records.english: ARCHIE: It surprises me, how you've\nmanaged to chase me here.\cBut that's all over now.\cFor the realization of my dream,\nyou must disappear now!

records.japanese: この　わたしが‥‥\nまたしても　まけるとは‥‥

アオギリ『フフフ‥‥\cさすが　というべきか‥‥
きみの　その　ちからは　みとめよう！\cだが‥‥！
わたしには　これが　ある！\cこの　べにいろのたまが　あれば
カイオーガを‥‥
records.english: ARCHIE: Fufufu...\cI commend you. I must recognize that\nyou are truly gifted.\cBut!\nI have this in my possession!\cWith this RED ORB, I can make KYOGRE...

records.japanese: べにいろのたまが‥‥\nかってに　かがやき　はじめた‥‥！？
records.english: The RED ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!

records.japanese: アオギリ『‥‥！？\cわたしは　なにも　していないのに\nなぜ　べにいろのたまが‥‥？\cカイオーガは　どこへ　きえた？
records.english: ARCHIE: What?!\cI didn't do anything.\nWhy did the RED ORB...\cWhere did KYOGRE go?

records.japanese: アオギリ『そとに　いる\nだんいん　からの　れんらくか
records.english: ARCHIE: Hm? It's a message from our\nmembers outside...

records.japanese:
アオギリ『どうした‥‥？\cフム‥‥
おおあめが　ふっている‥‥\cそうだろう‥‥　それこそが
われわれ　アクアだんの　もくてきうみを　ふやすために　カイオーガをめざめさせた　りゆう　なのだからな\cなんだと！
よそう　いじょうの　あめで　このままではじぶんたちも　あぶない　だと！？\cそんな　ばかな‥‥
そんなこと　ありえない　はずだ‥‥\cとにかく　ようすを　みているんだ！
records.english:
ARCHIE: Yes, what is it?\cHm...
It's raining heavily?\cGood... That should have happened.
That is why we awakened KYOGRE,to realize TEAM AQUA's vision ofexpanding the sea.\cWhat?!\cIt's raining far harder than we
envisioned? You're in danger?\cThat can't be...
That's just not possible...\cHold your position and monitor the
situation!

records.japanese: アオギリ『おかしい‥‥\cべにいろのたまで　カイオーガが　めざめる\nそして　コントロール　できるはず‥‥\cなのに‥‥　どうして‥‥\nカイオーガは　ここから　いなくなったッ！？\cなぜなんだッ！？
records.english: ARCHIE: There's something wrong...\cThe RED ORB is supposed to awaken\nand control KYOGRE...\cBut... Why?\nWhy did KYOGRE disappear?\cWhy?!

records.japanese:
マツブサ『なんてことだ‥‥\cアオギリ‥‥　きみは　とうとう
カイオーガを　めざめさせて　しまったな！\cこのまま　えいえんに
おおあめが　ふりつづけたらせかいは　いったい　どうなる！\cすべての　だいちは
みずの　そこに　しずむぞ‥‥
records.english:
MAXIE: What have you wrought?\cARCHIE... You've finally awoken KYOGRE,
haven't you?\cWhat will happen to the world if this
downpour continues for all eternity?\cThe world's landmass will drown in
the deepening sea...

records.japanese: アオギリ『なんだと‥‥？\cべにいろのたまが　あれば\nカイオーガを　コントロール　できるはず‥‥\rそんな　ことが‥‥
records.english: ARCHIE: What are you saying?\cThe RED ORB should let me control\nKYOGRE...\rThat can't be possible...

records.japanese: マツブサ『とにかく　いまは　ここで\nいいあらそいを　している　ひまはない！\cそとに　でて　たしかめると　いい！\nめのまえに　ひろがるのが\rきみの　のぞんだ　せかいか　どうかを
records.english: MAXIE: We don't have the time to\nargue about it here!\cGet outside and see for yourself!\cSee if what you've wrought is the\nworld that you desired!

records.japanese: マツブサ『[PLAYER][KUN]も\nはやく　そとに　でるんだ！
records.english: MAXIE: [PLAYER][KUN], come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!

records.japanese: マツブサ『‥‥まちたまえ！
マツブサ『ふふふ‥‥\nやはり　きみ　だったか
records.english: MAXIE: Fufufu...\nSo it was you, after all.

records.japanese: マツブサ『どうだ　みたまえ！\cちょう　こだいポケモン　グラードンが\nしずかに　ねむる　うつくしい　すがたを！\cわたしは　この　ひが　くるのを\nながい　あいだ　まっていた‥‥

わたしには　これが　ある！\cこの　あいいろのたまが　あれば
グラードンを‥‥

I have this in my possession!\cWith this BLUE ORB, I can make
GROUDON...

records.english: The BLUE ORB suddenly began shining\nby itself!

That is why we awakened GROUDON,to realize TEAM MAGMA's vision ofexpanding the world's landmass.\cWhat?!\cIt's far hotter than we envisioned?
It's so hot that it's dangerous?\cThat can't be...

アオギリ『なんてことだ‥‥\cマツブサ‥‥　きみは　とうとう
グラードンを　めざめさせて　しまったな！\cこのまま　えいえんに
にっこうが　てりつづけたらせかいは　いったい　どうなる！\cすべての　うみは

haven't you?\cWhat will happen to the world if this

records.english: ARCHIE: [PLAYER][KUN], come on, you have\nto get out of here, too!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]の　あいいろのたまが\nとつぜん　かがやき　はじめた！
カイオーガは　ふたたび\nねむりに　ついた　ようだ‥‥
records.english: KYOGRE appears to have settled\ninto sleep again...

records.japanese: アオギリ『これを‥‥
アオギリ『‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cサヨナラだ\nもう　あうことは　ないだろう‥‥
records.english: ARCHIE: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThis is good-bye.\nThis is the last you've seen of me...

records.japanese: [PLAYER]の　べにいろのたまが\nとつぜん　かがやき　はじめた！
グラードンは　ふたたび\nねむりに　ついた　ようだ‥‥
records.english: GROUDON appears to have settled\ninto sleep again...

records.japanese: マツブサ『これを‥‥
マツブサ『‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cサヨナラだ\nもう　あうことは　ないだろう‥‥
records.english: MAXIE: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThis is good-bye.\nThis is the last you've seen of me...

records.japanese: アクアだんの　ほんとうの　おそろしさ\nおまえに　おしえてやるぜ！
records.english: I'll show you exactly how scary\nTEAM AQUA can be!

records.japanese: なるほど　ひとりで　アクアだんに\nさからおうって　わけか
records.english: So you think you can stand up alone\nto TEAM AQUA's might...

records.japanese: たしかに　おまえは　つよいな‥‥\nだけど　おれたちは　たくさん　いるんだぞ！
records.english: Yeah, so you are strong...\nBut there're a lot of us!

records.japanese: なんだ　おまえ？\nこどもが　ひとりで　なにしよう　ってんだ？
records.english: What's up with you?\nWhat does a single kid expect to do?

records.japanese: くそう　つよいな‥‥
なにも　しらないくせに\nおれたちの　じゃまを　するんじゃないぜ！
records.english: You don't know anything.\nQuit messing around with us!

records.japanese: おまえ‥‥　えんとつやまで　あったな！\nその　しかえし　させてもらうぜ！
records.english: Hey, I remember you from MT. CHIMNEY!\nIt's payback time!

records.japanese: ぐぐぐ‥‥\nまーた　こどもに　まけちまったよ
まあいいさ　じかんは　かせげた！\cリーダーの　もくてきの　もの\nうばえた　はずだぜ！
records.english: Heh, it doesn't matter!\nWe bought ourselves some time!\cThe BOSS should have snatched what\nhe was after!

records.japanese:
アオギリ『また　きみか‥‥\cきみには　これまで　なんども
じゃまを　されたがこんど　ばかりは　おそかった　ようだな！\cこの　おくりびやまに　まつられていた
べにいろのたま‥‥たしかに　この　アオギリが　いただいた！\cフフフ‥‥　これで　わたしの　もくてきも
たっせい　できる‥‥\cつぎは　カイナ　だ！
いそぐぞ！！
records.english:
ARCHIE: Not you again...\cYou've impeded our plans repeatedly,
but this time you're too late.\cThe RED ORB that rested atop
MT. PYRE...I, ARCHIE, claim it as mine!\cFufufu... Finally, I can realize my
grand design...\cCome on, crew!
It's SLATEPORT next!

records.japanese:
ああ　なんという　ことじゃ‥‥！\cべにいろのたま　が‥‥
うばわれて　しまうとは‥‥\cべにいろのたま　と　あいいろのたま　が
はなればなれに　なって　しまうなどけっして　あっては　ならないこと‥‥\c‥‥‥　‥‥‥　‥‥‥
ううむ‥‥\cよし！　おまえさんに　のこされた
あいいろのたまを　あずけよう\cさっきの　おとこを　おいかけて
たまを　とりかえして　おくれ‥‥！
records.english:
Oh, no...
This cannot happen...\cHow could they take the RED ORB?\cThe BLUE ORB and RED ORB must never
be separated. They belong together.\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...
Hmm...\cFine!
You take the remaining BLUE ORB.\cPlease take after that foul man and
get the other ORB back!

records.japanese: おまえさんに　わたした　あいいろのたまと\nうばわれた　べにいろのたま‥‥\cはなればなれ　では\nきっと　よくないことが　おこる‥‥
records.english: The BLUE ORB you have been entrusted\nwith and the stolen RED ORB...\cThey must never be apart...\nSomething terrible will happen...

records.japanese:
そうか‥‥
カイオーガが　めざめたのか‥‥\cかつて　カイオーガの　いかりを
しずめた　ふしぎな　たま　というのがその　あいいろのたま　といわれておる‥‥\cそして　その　たまが　ほりだされたのは
ルネにある　めざめのほこら‥‥\cカイオーガと　めざめのほこら　には
なにかしら　かんけいが　あるのかもな‥‥
records.english:
So...
KYOGRE has awoken...\cThe wondrous ORB that is said to have

records.japanese: お！　おじさんと　いっしょに\nポロックを　つくりたいのかい？

じゃあ　ポロックの　つくりかたは　\nもう　しってるかい？

records.japanese: あれ？\nでも　きのみを　もってない　みたいだね\cきのみが　ないと　ポロックは\nつくれないんだよ

records.japanese: おじさんの　あまりの　きのみが　あれば\nあげるん　だけど‥\cきょうは　もう　あまって　ないんだ\nまた　こんど　やろうな
records.english: If I had some BERRIES left over,\nI'd gladly give you one...\cBut, I don't have any to spare today.\nWe'll have to do this another time.

records.japanese: でも　ポロックケース　が\nいっぱいの　ようだね\cポロックを　へらしてから\nまた　おいで
records.english: But your [POKEBLOCK] CASE is full.\cYou should use some [POKEBLOCK]S before\nyou come see me again.

records.japanese: でも　ポロックケースを\nまだもって　ないようだね\cポロックケースを\nもらってから　またおいで
records.english: But you don't have a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.\cYou should get a [POKEBLOCK] CASE and then\ncome see me.

records.japanese: はやく　まぜようぜ！！
どんな　ポロックが　できるのかしら？\nドキドキ　しちゃう！

records.japanese: きのみブレンダーで　ともだちと　いっしょに\nきのみから　ポロックを　つくります\cつうしんに　はいる　まえに\nレポートを　かいても　よろしいですか？
records.english: [POKEBLOCK]S will be made with your friends \nfrom BERRIES in the BERRY BLENDER.\cIs it okay to save the game before\nlinking with your friends?

records.japanese: わしは　ポロックを\nつくるのが　だいすきで\cいつも　きのみを\nもって　きてるんだ

records.japanese: もし　よかったら\nいっしょに　きのみブレンダーで\rポロックを　つくろうや
records.english: If you'd like, we could make some\n[POKEBLOCK]S together using the\rBERRY BLENDER.

records.japanese: あれ？\nきのみを　もってないの？\cしかたないなぁ　もう\cおじさんの　あまった　きのみで\nよければ　あげるよ！

records.japanese:
あれ？
きのみを　もってないの？\cおじさんの　あまりが　あれば
あげるん　だけど‥\cきょうは　もう　あまって
ないんだ　すまんな
records.english:
Oh?
You don't have any BERRIES?\cIf I had some left over, I'd gladly
give you one...\cBut, I don't have any to spare today.
Sorry about that.

records.japanese: ポケモン　つれていれば\nキミも　りっぱな　ポケモントレーナー！\rボクの　ちょうせん　うけるよね！
records.english: If you have POKéMON with you, then\nyou're an official POKéMON TRAINER!\rYou can't say no to my challenge!

records.japanese: ああ　まけた‥‥\nもっと　そだてておけば　よかったよ

records.japanese: キミ　つよいなら　つよいって\nさいしょから　いって　くれよな！

records.japanese: わたくしの　かおりに\nまどわされませんでしたね‥‥

records.japanese: クミ『あたしは　クミ！\nこっちは　いもうとの　ルミ！\rふたりで　いっしょに　たたかうのよ！
records.english: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\rWe battle together!

records.japanese: クミ『まけっちゃったよぉ‥‥
クミ『ふたりを　あいてに　するのって\nいろんな　ことを　かんがえるよね！
records.english: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\ragainst two TRAINERS.

records.japanese: クミ『あら？\nポケモン　１ひきしか　つれてないんだね！\rそれじゃあ　あたしたちと　たたかえないわ！
records.english: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\rYou can't battle us like that.

records.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちは　ふたりで　ひとり\nいっしょに　たたかうんだよ！
records.english: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

records.japanese: ルミ『まけちゃったよぉ　おねえちゃぁん‥‥
records.english: LIV: Oh, we lost, big sister...

records.japanese: ルミ『おねえちゃんと　あたしは\nいきが　ぴったり　あってるのに‥‥\cまけちゃったよぉ‥‥
records.english: LIV: We work perfectly together, me\nand my big sister...\cBut we still lost...

records.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nポケモンを　２ひき　つれてないと　ダメよ！\rじゃないと　しょうぶに　ならないんだから！
records.english: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\rIt's not fair if you don't!

records.japanese: クミ『あたしは　クミ！\nこっちは　いもうとの　ルミ！\rふたりで　いっしょに　たたかうのよ！
records.english: AMY: I'm AMY.\nAnd this is my little sister LIV.\rWe battle together!

records.japanese: クミ『くやしい‥‥\nまた　かてなかったよぉ‥‥
records.english: AMY: Aww, boo!\nWe couldn't win again...

records.japanese: クミ『ふたりを　あいてに　するのって\nいろんな　ことを　かんがえるよね！
records.english: AMY: You have to think about all\nkinds of things when you're battling\ragainst two TRAINERS.

records.japanese: クミ『あら？\nポケモン　１ひきしか　つれてないんだね！\rそれじゃあ　あたしたちと　たたかえないわ！
records.english: AMY: Uh-oh, you have only one\nPOKéMON with you.\rYou can't battle us like that.

records.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちは　ふたりで　ひとり\nいつも　いっしょに　たたかうんだよ！
records.english: LIV: We battle together as one\nteam.

records.japanese: ルミ『また　まけちゃったよぉ\nおねえちゃぁん‥‥
records.english: LIV: Awww, we lost again...\nBig sister...

records.japanese: ルミ『おねえちゃんと　あたしは\nいきが　ぴったり　あってるのに‥‥\cどうして　また　まけちゃったの？
records.english: LIV: We work perfectly together, me\nand my big sister...\cBut why did we lose again?

records.japanese: ルミ『あたしたちと　たたかいたいなら\nポケモンを　２ひき　つれてないと　ダメよ！\rじゃないと　しょうぶに　ならないんだから！
records.english: LIV: If you want to battle us, you\nhave to have two POKéMON!\rIt's not fair if you don't!

records.japanese: つりいとが　からまって　イライラするーっ！\nええいっ　しょうぶだっ！
records.english: Gah! My fishing line's all snarled up!\nI'm getting frustrated and mean!\rThat's it! Battle me!

records.japanese: まけたっ！\nよけいに　イライラするぞーっ！
records.english: Gah! Lost it!\nI'm even more annoyed now!

records.japanese: ええい　はらだたしい‥‥！\nイライライライラ‥‥
わたしの　ポケモンちゃん\nすごく　かわいいから　みていきたまえ！
records.english: My POKéMON is delightfully adorable!\nDon't be shy - I'll show you!

records.japanese: あわわ‥‥\nわたしの　ポケモンちゃん！
かわいい　ポケモンちゃんは\nやられた　すがたも　かわいいな‥‥
records.english: My delightful POKéMON looks darling\neven when it's fainted!

records.japanese: きみ！　わたしの　ポケモンちゃん\nさらに　かわいく　なったのだ！
records.english: Hi, you! My delightfully adorable\nPOKéMON has become more darling!

records.japanese: ああ！\nわたしの　ポケモンちゃん！
いっしょに　いれば　いるほど\nポケモンが　かわいくなって　たまらん！
records.english: The more I spend time with it, the\nmore adorable my POKéMON becomes.

records.japanese: ナオ『よーし！\nあたしたちの　ポケモンと　たたかうです！
records.english: GINA: Okay, let's battle with our\nPOKéMON!

records.japanese: ナオ『まけて　すごく　くやしいです
ナオ『うわー　[STR_VAR_1]　つよいです！\nあたしたち　もっと　しゅぎょう　するです
records.english: GINA: [STR_VAR_1] is strong!\nWe have to train lots more!

records.japanese: ナオ『あら？　ポケモン　１ひき　だけですか！\nじゃあ　あたしたち　たたかわない　です！\cだって　ポケモン　１ひき　だけだと\nポケモンが　さびしそうで　かわいそう　です！
records.english: GINA: Oh? Only one POKéMON?\nThen, we don't battle with you.\cIf there's only one POKéMON, it will\nbe lonesome. That's not nice.

records.japanese: ミオ『あたしたち　ふたご　だから\nポケモンしょうぶも　いっしょに　するです！
records.english: MIA: We are twins, so we battle\nPOKéMON together.

records.japanese: ミオ『ふたりで　しょうぶ　したのに\nまけちゃったです‥‥
records.english: MIA: We battled together, but we\nboth lost...

records.japanese: ミオ『もっと　ポケモン　そだてて\n[STR_VAR_1]　みたいに　つよく　なるです！
records.english: MIA: We will train our POKéMON more\nand be strong like you.

records.japanese: ミオ『あたしたちと　たたかうですか？\cじゃあ　ポケモンを\n２ひき　つれてないと　ダメですよ！\rだって　あたしたち　つよいもん！
records.english: MIA: You want to battle with us?\cIt's a big no-no if you don't have two\nPOKéMON with you.\rWe're too strong for you!

records.japanese: みずポケモンの　エキスパートとは\nなにを　かくそう　オレのこと！\c‥‥え？\nしらないの？
records.english: Why keep it a secret?\nI'm the WATER POKéMON expert!\cHuh?\nYou don't know me?

records.japanese: けっこう　つよいと　おもってたんだけどな\nじぶんのこと‥‥　がっかり‥‥
records.english: I thought I wasn't too bad, if I may\nsay so, but I guess not... Bleah...

records.japanese: つりに　むちゅうに　なってて\nポケモン　そだてるのを　わすれてたよ‥‥
records.english: I got too into fishing.\nI forgot I had to raise my POKéMON...

records.japanese: すなはまに　あしあと　つけるのって\nたのしーよねー！
records.english: Leaving footprints in the sand is\nso fun!

records.japanese: うへーっ！\nクツに　すなが　はいって　ジャリジャリする！
records.english: Waah! I got sand in my runners!\nThey're all gritty!

records.japanese: すなはまを　ボクの　あしあとで\nいっぱいに　したいんだけど\rすぐに　きえちゃうんだよなぁ
records.english: I want to leave my footprints in the\nsand everywhere, but they disappear\rquickly...

records.japanese: しょうぶ　しようかな‥‥\nやめとこうかな‥‥\cえーい！　たたかっちゃえ！
records.english: Should I...\nOr shouldn't I?\cOkay, sure, I will battle!

records.japanese: たたかわなければ　よかったかな‥‥
どっちに　しようか　まよってる　とき\nじぶんで　きめないで　たにんに　まかせると\rどっちに　なっても　こうかいするね‥‥
