records.english: If you're faced with a decision and\nyou let someone else choose for you,\ryou will regret it, however things\rturn out.

records.japanese: あたしと　しょうぶ　してもらうわよ！
うーん‥‥\nかてると　おもったのにな
たたかうって　じぶんで　きめたから\nまけても　すっきり　してるわ！\c‥‥もちろん　まけて　くやしいけどね
records.english: I made the decision to battle, so I\ncan accept this loss in grace.\cI am still upset about losing!

records.japanese: ボクが　あいてして　あげるよ\nこの　おかねもちの　ボクがね
records.english: Oh, sure, I'll accept your challenge.\nI have a lot of money.

records.japanese: どうして　かてないんだ‥‥！？
おかねじゃ　かてない　ものが　ある‥‥\nそれが　ポケモンなんだね‥‥
records.english: There are some things money can't buy.\nThat's POKéMON...

records.japanese: きみに　まけてから　いろいろ\nポケモンのこと　べんきょう　したんだ！
records.english: After I lost to you, I learned a bunch\nof things about POKéMON.

records.japanese: また　まけた‥‥\nどうして　かてないんだ‥‥！？
records.english: I lost again?\nWhy couldn't I win?

records.japanese: おかねもちの　ボク　なのに\nなかなか　ポケモンに　かてない‥‥\cなんて　おくが　ふかいんだろう\nポケモンって‥‥
records.english: I'm fabulously wealthy, but I can't\nseem to win at POKéMON...\cIt's so deep, the world of POKéMON...

records.japanese: あなたと　であったのも　なにかの　ごえん\nおてあわせを　おねがい　できるかしら
records.english: We must have been fated to meet.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

records.japanese: まあ！
であいは　わかれの　はじまり‥‥\nまた　どこかで　おあいしましょう
records.english: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

records.japanese: また　おあい　しましたわね\nおてあわせ　おねがい　できるかしら
records.english: Hello, we meet again.\nMay I ask you for a battle?

records.japanese: あら‥‥\nわたくし　ベストを　つくしましたのに‥‥
records.english: Oh, my...\nI did the best that I could...

records.japanese: であいは　わかれの　はじまり‥‥\nまた　どこかで　おあいしましょう
records.english: “Hello” is the beginning of “good-bye.”\nI hope we meet again.

records.japanese: この　あたりに\nふしぎな　いわが　あるらしいが\rきみ　しらないかい？
records.english: There's supposed to be a mystical\nrock around here.\rDo you know anything about it?

records.japanese: いわのこと　ばかり　かんがえて\nポケモン　よわいまま　だったか‥‥
records.english: I was thinking too much about that\nrock, while my POKéMON remained weak...

records.japanese: すてきな　いわ　だったら\nなんじかん　みていても　あきないよ‥‥
records.english: I can spend hours and hours staring\nat a nice rock without growing bored.

records.japanese: よかった！　こどもが\nおぼれているのかと　しんぱい　したよ！\cだいじょうぶ　そうだから　しょうぶ　だな！
records.english: Whew! I was worried that a kid was\ndrowning when I saw you.\cYou seem to be okay, so what do you\nsay to a battle?

records.japanese: ゴボゴボ‥‥
すなはまに　むかって　かたてを　ふるのが\nおぼれたときの　サインだぜ！
records.english: If you are drowning, the signal is to\nwave one arm toward the beach.

records.japanese: あおい　うみで　およいでいると\nさいこうの　きぶん　だな！
records.english: Swimming the deep blue sea...\nIt feels the greatest!

records.japanese: まけた‥‥\nブルーな　きぶん‥‥
うみが　あおい　りゆう！？\cカイナの　はくぶつかんで　きいたけど\nそんなの　わすれちまったよ！
records.english: Why is the sea blue?\cI learned about that at the MUSEUM in\nSLATEPORT, but I forgot.

records.japanese: みずに　はいると　からだが　かるくなるわね\nなんだか　スリムに　なったみたい！
records.english: My body feels lighter in the water.\nIt's as if I've gotten slimmer!

records.japanese: ぷかぷか‥‥
みずの　なかでは　たいじゅうが\n１０ぶんの１　くらいに　なるのよ\cと　すると　いま　わたしは‥‥\nいけない！　たいじゅうが　バレちゃうわ！
records.english: Your body weight is reduced to just\none tenth in the water.\cThat would make me...\nWhoops! I'm not telling you my weight!

records.japanese: あおい　そら‥‥\nひろい　うみ‥‥\rのどか　よねー‥‥
records.english: The blue, blue sky...\nThe vast sea...\rIt's so peaceful...

records.japanese: なごんでいる　うちに\nまけちゃったわーっ！
records.english: I lost while I was lounging!

records.japanese: あたしと　いると　なごむって　いわれたいの\nうふふふふ！
records.english: I want to be told I'm relaxing to be\nwith. Giggle.

records.japanese: うみづりと　かわづり\nキミは　どっちが　すき？
records.english: Which do you prefer, fishing in the\nsea or a stream?

records.japanese: まるで　うみづりの　ように\nごうかいに　まけたぞーっ！
records.english: Like in deep-sea fishing, I lost\nspectacularly!

records.japanese: うみでも　かわでも　つりは　サイコーだ！\nキミも　そう　おもうだろ！？
records.english: Fishing is the greatest whether it's\nin the sea or a stream.\rYou agree with me, right?

records.japanese: ポケモン　つりまくったからね\nすごい　しょうぶを　してみせるぞー！
records.english: I caught a bunch of POKéMON fishing.\nI'll show you an impressive battle!

records.japanese: また　ごうかいに　まけたぞーっ！
かっても　まけても　ポケモンは　サイコーだ！\nキミも　そう　おもうだろ！？
records.english: Win or lose, POKéMON are the greatest!\nYou agree with me, right?

records.japanese: トイレに　いきたくなったとき\nみんなは　どうしてるんだろう‥‥？\cトイレに　いっている　あいだに\nもし　おおものが　かかったらと　おもうと‥‥
records.english: What do people do if they need to go\nto a washroom?\cWhat if my ROD hooks a big one while\nI'm in the washroom? I just can't go...

records.japanese: トイレを　がまん　してたから\nまけたんだよ　きっと‥‥
records.english: I lost because I'm trying to not go\nto the washroom...

records.japanese: ああっ！\nおおものが　つれそうな　よかん‥‥！
records.english: Oh, no! I've got this feeling I'll hook\na big one!

records.japanese: はっはっはっ！\nりくでは　はやく　はしれないが\rみずの　なかなら　まけないぞ！
records.english: Hahahah! I'm a lousy runner, but in\nthe water you can't catch me!

records.japanese: まいりましたーっ！
すいえいの　きょうそうなら　まけないのに‥‥
records.english: I wouldn't lose in a swim race...

records.japanese: うみは　わたしの　にわ\nこども　だからって　てかげん　しないわよ！
records.english: The sea is my backyard. I'm not going\nto take it easy because you're a kid!

records.japanese: ひょっとして\nてかげん　してないよね？
records.english: Did you take it easy on me by any\nchance?

records.japanese: なみに　ゆられて　ただようのが　だいすき\nあなたも　やってみない？
records.english: Drifting along with the waves...\nI love it! Why don't you give it a try?

records.japanese: むにゃむにゃ‥‥\cなみに　ゆられてたら　きもちよくなって\nうっかり　ねてしまった！
records.english: Yawn...\cI must have drifted off to sleep while\nI was drifting in the waves.

records.japanese: あはは　まけた‥‥\nまた　ねますか‥‥
records.english: Ahaha, I lost...\nI'll take a snooze, I think...

records.japanese: うみに　うかんで　なみに　ゆられてると\nふかふかの　ベッドで　ねてる　みたいだよ！
records.english: Floating and being rocked by the\nwaves - it's like sleeping in a plush,\rcomfy bed.

records.japanese: うみは　オレの　にわ　みたいな　もの！\nしょうぶ　しようぜ！
records.english: The sea is like my backyard.\nLet's battle!

records.japanese: ホームグラウンドで　まけた‥‥\nショック！
records.english: I lost on my home field...\nI'm in shock!

records.japanese: おおきな　ユメを　いっぱい　つめてー\nでっかい　うみを　ひとおよぎー\cさぁて　まだまだ　およぐぞー！
records.english: I swim the seas with a heart full of\ndreams...\cIt's a song!\nAnyways, I'm swimming some more.

records.japanese: でっかい　うみを　およいでいたら\nポケモンが　すっごく　つよくなったぞー！
records.english: Swimming in the big, wide sea, my\nPOKéMON has grown stronger!

records.japanese: ショック！！\cポケモンは　つよくなったが\nトレーナーの　おれが　よわいまま！？
records.english: What a shock!\cMy POKéMON has gotten stronger, but\nI stayed weak as a TRAINER!

records.japanese: たたかいの　なかで　おぼえたことが\nトレーナーとしての　つよさに　つながる！\rでっかい　うみが　そう　いっていたぞー！
records.english: What you learn in battle makes you a\nstronger TRAINER.\rThe waves taught me that.

records.japanese: ムロタウン　っていう\nちいさな　まちを　しってる？
records.english: Do you know a little town called\nDEWFORD?

records.japanese: ヤダ　もーっ！
ムロタウンの　しゅうかいじょで\nふしぎな　ことばが　はやって　いるのよ！
records.english: A weird saying is getting really\ntrendy at DEWFORD HALL.

records.japanese: わたしと　しょうぶが　したいの？\nいいわ！　あいてに　なって　あげる！
records.english: Did you want to battle me?\nSure, I'll go with you!

records.japanese: わたしじゃ　あいてに　ならなかったわ！
records.english: I wasn't good enough for you.

records.japanese: あなた　まだまだ　つよく　なりそうね\nわたしも　がんばろうっと！
records.english: I think you're going to keep getting\nbetter. I'll go for it, too!

records.japanese: ユミ『あたしたち　きょうだい　ふたりで\nしょうぶを　させてもらうわ！
records.english: LISA: We challenge you as a sister\nand brother!

records.japanese: ユミ『すごいわ\nつよさの　レベルが　ちがうのね
records.english: LISA: Awesome.\nYou're in a different class of tough.

records.japanese: ユミ『あなたは　いっしょに\nうみに　あそびに　いくような\rおともだち　いるのかしら？
records.english: LISA: Do you have any friends who\nwould go to the beach with you?

records.japanese: ユミ『アタシたちと　たたかうなら\nポケモン　もっと　つれてきなさいな
records.english: LISA: If you want to battle with us,\nbring more POKéMON.

records.japanese: シン『いつも　きょうだいで\nポケモンしょうぶ　してるんだ！\c‥‥いっつも　おれが　まけるけど\n２たい２なら　きみに　かてるよ！
records.english: RAY: We always battle POKéMON, me\nand my sister.\cI always lose, but we can beat you\n2-on-2!

records.japanese: シン『ひゃー\nつよさの　レベルが　ちがいすぎるや
records.english: RAY: Wowee, you're at a higher level\nthan us!

records.japanese: シン『おれの　ポケモン\nねえちゃんから　もらって　そだてた\rだいじな　あいぼう　なんだぜ！
records.english: RAY: My sister gave me my POKéMON.\nI raised it, and now it's my important\rpartner!

records.japanese: シン『オレらと　たたかうなら\nもっと　ポケモン　つれてきてよ！
records.english: RAY: If you want to battle us, go\nbring some more POKéMON!

records.japanese: オレの　ユメは　せかいに　ある\n７つのうみ　すべてで　およぐこと！
records.english: My dream is to swim the world's seven\nseas!

records.japanese: これじゃ\n７つのうみ　すべてで　およげない‥‥
records.english: I won't be able to swim the seven seas\nlike this...

records.japanese: うみの　ポケモンと　あそぶことも\nおよいでいる　ときの　たのしみだね！
records.english: Playing with marine POKéMON is one of\nthe pleasures of swimming!

records.japanese: なあ　キミ！\nキミも　すてられた　ふねに　いくのかい？
records.english: Ahoy, there! Are you going out to the\nABANDONED SHIP, too?

records.japanese: ああ　ぼくが　しずむ‥‥\nぶくぶく‥‥
すてられぶねの　なかに\nはいっていく　やつらが　いるんだよ！
records.english: Some people even go inside that\nABANDONED SHIP.

records.japanese: ウソつきな　カレに　いわれたのよ\nビキニが　にあってて　カワイイって‥‥
records.english: My liar of a boyfriend told me that\nI look great in a bikini...

records.japanese: いやん　まけたわーっ！
ウソでも　いいから　カワイイって　いわれたい\nふくざつな　おんなごころ‥‥
records.english: Even if it's a lie, I love being told\nI look great...\rWe girls are so complex...

records.japanese: うみって　だいすき！\nおよいでいれば　イヤなことも　わすれるわ！
records.english: I love the sea!\nI forget all my worries when I swim!

records.japanese: しょうぶに　まけると\nストレスが　たまるーっ！
records.english: When I lose a battle, I get all\nstressed out!

records.japanese: ストレスは　およいで　はっさん！\nけんこうてき　よねー！
records.english: Work off your stress by swimming!\nIt's so healthy!

records.japanese: うりゃーっ！！\nみごとに　われた　ふっきんを　みろーっ！！
records.english: Hiyah! Look at my chiseled abs!\nThis is what you call “cut”!

records.japanese: うりゃーっ！！\nまけたーっ！！
うりゃーっ！！\cふっきんと　ポケモンの　しょうぶは\nかんけい　ないぞーっ！！
records.english: Hiyah!\cMy sculpted abs have nothing to do\nwith POKéMON battles!

records.japanese: ひやけ　たいさく\nあなたは　してる？
records.english: Are you properly protected against\nthe sun?

records.japanese: あちちちちっ！
ほっぺの　あたりが　いちばん\nひやけ　しやすい　ばしょ　なのよ！
records.english: Cheeks are the most prone to burning!

records.japanese: せかいじゅうの　みなとを　おとずれたが\nカイナは　さいこーの　みなとまち　だぜ！
records.english: I've laid anchor in ports around the\nworld, but SLATEPORT's the best.

records.japanese: あんた　さいこー　だぜ‥‥
さいこーの　みなとまちには\nさいこーの　トレーナーが　いたぜ‥‥
records.english: In the best port was the best\nTRAINER...

records.japanese: ううう‥‥\nしょうぶ　するの？　オレと？
げろげろ‥‥
いつもは　もっと　つよいんだぞ！\nふなよいで　ちょうしが　わるいだけだ！\cふなのり　だけど‥‥
records.english: I'm usually stronger than this!\nI'm just seasick as a dog!\cI'm a SAILOR, but...

records.japanese: のどが　かわいたよ‥‥\nうみのいえで　サイコソーダ　のみたいな‥‥
records.english: I'm thirsty... I could go for a SODA POP\nat the SEASHORE HOUSE...

records.japanese: うーん‥‥
おなかも　へってきた‥‥\nうきわが　おっきな　ドーナッツに　みえるよ
records.english: I'm getting famished... My inner tube\nlooks like a giant doughnut...

records.japanese: おなか　へってるけど\nしょうぶ　するなら　げんき　だよ！
records.english: I'm hungry, but I've got enough pep in\nme for a battle!

records.japanese: まけた‥‥\nおなかが　へってるからだ
すなはまで　たべると\nなんでも　おいしく　おもえるよね
records.english: When you eat on a beach, everything\nseems to taste a little better.

records.japanese: ビーチパラソルって\nおおきな　おはな　みたいよねー！
records.english: Doesn't a beach umbrella look like\na giant flower?

records.japanese: ママーっ！
おそらの　うえから　すなはまを　みたら\nおはなばたけ　みたいに　みえるのよ！
records.english: If you look at the beach from the sky,\nit looks like a big flower garden!

records.japanese: もう　あなたには　まけません！\nそのために　うきわ　してるんだから！
records.english: I'm not losing to you again!\nThat's why I have my inner tube!

records.japanese: ママーっ！
うきわ　もってると　あたしと　ポケモンの\nかわいさが　ぐぐーんと　アップするの！
records.english: If I have an inner tube, me and my\nPOKéMON's cuteness goes way up!

records.japanese: うきわが　ないと　およげないけど\nポケモンなら　だれにも　まけないよ！
records.english: I can't swim without my inner tube,\nbut I won't lose at POKéMON!

records.japanese: うきわが　あるから　まけちゃったのかな？
records.english: Did I lose because I have an inner\ntube?

records.japanese: あたしの　うきわ\nオシャレだから　てばなせないの
records.english: My inner tube is a fashion item.\nI can't be seen without it.

records.japanese: そこの　トレーナーさん\nあたしと　たたかう　でちゅ！
records.english: Hi, big TRAINER.\nWill you battle with me?

records.japanese: つよいでちゅね‥‥
どうしたら　そんなに\nつよくなれる　でちゅか‥‥？
records.english: How did you get to be so strong?

records.japanese: わはは！\nおじさん　おおもの　つっちゃうぞ！
records.english: Wahahah! This dude's going to catch\nhimself a big one!

records.japanese: おじさん　まけちゃったな‥‥
たしかに　きみは　おおもの　だな！\nいや　きっと　おおものに　なるぞ！
records.english: This dude thinks you're a big one.\nNo, you're a big-one-to-be!

records.japanese: リキ『やあ　こまったなあ\cふたりっきりの　じかん\nじゃま　して　ほしくないなあ
records.english: PAUL: Well, this is a mood-breaker.\cI wish you wouldn't disturb our\nprecious time together.

records.japanese: リキ『やあ　まいったな‥‥
リキ『やあ　ぼくたちが　ここに　いること\nだれにも　いわないで　くれよ！\rふたりっきりの　せかい　なんだからさ！
records.english: PAUL: Well, don't tell anyone that\nwe're here.\rThis is just our private world of two!

records.japanese: リキ『ぼくたち　ラブラブ　だからね\nぼくたちの　ポケモンも\r２ひき　いっしょに　たたかわせるんだ！
records.english: PAUL: We're totally, deeply in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON battle\rtogether.

records.japanese: シキ『あたしたちが　ラブラブだから\nホウエンは　あっついのよお！
records.english: MEL: We're, like, totally in love.\nOur romance is heating up all of HOENN!

records.japanese: シキ『あたしの　せいで　まけたんだわ‥‥\nこんなんじゃ　リキに　きらわれちゃう！
records.english: MEL: We lost, and it's my fault!\nPAUL will hate me!

records.japanese: シキ『ねえ　リキ\nあたしのこと　おこってない？\rおこっちゃ　いやよ
records.english: MEL: Um, PAUL, are you angry with me?\nPlease don't be angry.

records.japanese: シキ『あたしたち　ラブラブ　だからね\nあたしたちの　ポケモンも\r２ひき　いっしょに　たたかわせるんだ！
records.english: MEL: We're, like, deeply and truly in love.\nThat's why we make our POKéMON\rbattle together.

records.japanese: おっと　あぶない！\nバイク　レースに　なれてない　ようだな！
records.english: Whoa! Watch it!\nI guess you're not used to BIKE racing.

records.japanese: キキーッ！\nブレーキが　こしょうした！
タイヤの　パンクや\nブレーキの　こしょうは　ケガのもと\rちゃんと　てんけん　しないとな
records.english: Flat tires and brake problems can\ncause serious injury!\rInspect your BIKE for problems!

records.japanese: ヘイ　ユー！\nワタシの　スピードに　ついてこれるかな！？
records.english: Yo, you!\nCan you keep up with my speed?

records.japanese: オー　マイ　ガッ！
スピードだけじゃ　ポケモンしょうぶ\nかてませーん！　ハンセイしまーす！
records.english: Speed alone won't let me win at POKéMON.\nI need to reconsider this...

records.japanese: じてんしゃの　スピード　でても\nあせっちゃ　いけないよ！
records.english: Don't panic if your BIKE's going fast!

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも\nあせっちゃ　いけないな‥‥
あせらず　のんびり　いこうよ\nじかんは　たっぷり　あるからね！
records.english: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

records.japanese: おっ！　スピード　だしすぎ　じゃない？\nちょっと　のんびり　しょうぶ　しようよ！
records.english: Aren't you going a little too fast?\nTake it easy and let's battle.

records.japanese: べつに　あせってないけど\nなぜだか　まけて　しまうな‥‥
records.english: I didn't panic, but I still lost...

records.japanese: あせらず　のんびり　いこうよ\nじかんは　たっぷり　あるからね！
records.english: There's no need to panic or stress.\nTake it easy. There's plenty of time.

records.japanese: トライアスロンは　ハードな　スポーツ\nすいえい　じてんしゃ　マラソンの\r３しゅもくを　こなすのよ！
records.english: The triathlon is hard in the extreme.\cYou have to complete the three events\nof swimming, cycling, and running.

records.japanese: ポケモン　しょうぶも　ハードだわ！
つかれたから　ひとやすみ\nきゅうけいは　たいせつ　なのよ
records.english: I'm exhausted, so I need a break.\nIt's important to get proper rest.

records.japanese: じてんしゃに　のりながら\nポケモンしょうぶ　ってのも　いいものよね！
records.english: Isn't it neat to hold a battle while\ncycling?

records.japanese: うわー\nどうして　そんなに　つよいの？
records.english: Wow...\nHow could you be so strong?

records.japanese: ひょっとして　きろくに\nちょうせん　していたのかしら？\cだったら　ジャマして　ゴメンねー
records.english: Were you going after a record?\cI'm sorry if I held you up!

records.japanese: じてんしゃを　こぎつづけて\nふとももが　パンパンに　なっちゃった
records.english: I've been riding without stopping.\nMy thighs are like rocks!

records.japanese: きんにくつうが　しんぱいだわ‥‥
ジムの　バッチを　もってるの？\nどうりで　つよい　はずだわ！
records.english: Oh, you have some GYM BADGES?\nNo wonder you're so strong!

records.japanese: おまえの　さくせんは　すべて　みえた！\nわたしが　まけるはず　ない！
records.english: I have foreseen your intentions!\nI cannot possibly lose!

records.japanese: じぶんの　はいぼくは　みえなかった‥‥！
records.english: I failed to prophesize my own demise!

records.japanese: おまえの　みらいが　みえる‥‥\cふうむ‥‥\nあかるい　ひかりが　みえるぞ‥‥！
records.english: I see your future...\cHmm...\nI see a shining light...

records.japanese: おほほほほっ！\nわたくしの　ミラクルを　みせてあげるわ！
records.english: Ahahahaha!\nI'll dazzle you with my wonders!

records.japanese: ミラクルに　まけたーっ！
わたくしに　かったことが　ミラクル‥‥\nそう　きせき　なのよ！\rいつでも　かてるなんて　おもわないことね！
records.english: You managed to win only because it was\na wonder! Yes, a wonder!\rDon't think you can win all the time!

records.japanese: キミの　ポケモン　みせてくれない？\nひとめで　いいから　おねがい！
records.english: Could I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

records.japanese: コンプリート　したかった‥‥！
みたことのない　ポケモンに　であうと\nボクの　コレクターだましいが　もえるなぁ！
records.english: When I see a POKéMON that I don't know,\nmy passion as a collector is ignited!

records.japanese: ねえ　キミ\nあたらしい　ポケモン　つかまえた？\cよかったら　ポケモン　みせてくれない？\nひとめで　いいから　おねがい！
records.english: Hi, have you caught any new POKéMON?\cCould I see your POKéMON?\nJust one look, please?

records.japanese: キミの　ポケモン\nうらやましいな‥‥
ああ！　とにかく　めずらしい　ポケモン\nぜんぶ　ボクの　ものに　したいよー！
records.english: Oh, I long to make all rare POKéMON\nmine!

records.japanese: ええーい！\nうしろから　はなしかけるなー！
records.english: Hey!\nDon't sneak up behind me like that!

records.japanese: まけたっ！\nくやしいっ！！
すいめんに　うかぶ　うきを　じっと　みる‥‥\nしゅうちゅうりょくが　たいせつ　なんだ
records.english: Fishing is all about concentration.\nYou have to focus on the floater.

records.japanese: おほほ！　だいじな　ポケモンを\nじまん　するためなら　どこにでも　いきますわ
records.english: Ahahaha! I would go anywhere to show\noff my delightful POKéMON.

records.japanese: あら　まあ　イヤですわ
しょうぶ　させるよりも\nコンテストで　がんばろう　かしら？
records.english: Perhaps I should groom my POKéMON for\nCONTESTS rather than battles.

records.japanese: おほほ！　だいじな　ポケモンなら\nなんどだって　じまん　しますわ！
records.english: Ahahahaha! I would be happy to show\noff my POKéMON as often as you like!

records.japanese: あら　まあ　イヤですわ
コンテストも　いいけど\nしょうぶ　するのも　すきなのよ！
records.english: CONTESTS are delightful, but I like\nto battle, too.

records.japanese: この　あたりの　くさむらで\nかっこいい　ポケモン　みつけたんだぜ！
records.english: I found some cool POKéMON in the grass\naround here!

records.japanese: かっこいい　だけじゃ　だめかぁ‥‥
records.english: Being cool isn't enough to win...

records.japanese: つかまえた　ばかりの　ポケモンじゃ\nうまく　たたかえないや！
records.english: It's hard to battle with POKéMON you\njust caught.

records.japanese: おっ！　ゴーゴーゴーグル　にあってるね！\nでも　ぼくの　ほうが　にあってるだろ？\rどっちが　にあうか　しょうぶだよ！
records.english: Oh, hey! Those GO-GOGGLES suit you.\nBut I think they look better on me.\cLet's decide who they look better on\nwith a battle!

records.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルで　まわりが\nよく　わからなかったよ
records.english: I couldn't see what was happening at my\nsides because of the GO-GOGGLES.

records.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルが　あると\nさばくの　すなあらしも　へいき　だから\rそれだけで　うれしくなるよ！
records.english: The GO-GOGGLES make it possible to\nget through sandstorms.\rThat makes me happy!

records.japanese: さばくの　なかでも　ピクニック！\cどんな　ところでも　トレーナー　いるから\nしょうぶも　できるもんね！
records.english: I'm having a picnic in the desert.\cYou can always find a TRAINER, so\nI can enjoy a battle here, too!

records.japanese: いやーん　いじわるー！
すなあらしの　なかで　たたかうなら\nポケモンの　たいりょくに　きを　つけないと\rすぐに　きぜつ　しちゃうわよ！
records.english: When you're battling in a sandstorm,\nwatch out for your POKéMON's HP.\cIt can faint if you don't keep an eye\non it!

records.japanese: ゴーゴーゴーグルを　つけてると\nなんとなく　ヒーローきぶん！\rいまの　ぼくなら　だれにだって　かてるさ！
records.english: Wearing these GO-GOGGLES makes me\nfeel like a superhero.\rRight now, nobody can beat me!

records.japanese: きぶん　だけじゃ　かてないか‥‥
records.english: I can't win on spirit alone...

records.japanese: いつかは　ほんものの　ヒーローに　なる！\nそのために　もっと　がんばって\rポケモンと　じぶんを　きたえてみせるよ
records.english: I'm going to be a real hero one day.\nI'm going to work harder to make me\rand my POKéMON stronger.

records.japanese: さばくで　カセキが　みつかるって　きいたけど\nどこに　あるのかなあ？
records.english: I heard there are fossils to be found\nin the desert. Where could they be?

records.japanese: いまいち　だわ‥‥
さばくで　カセキが　みつかると　いうことは\nむかし　ここは　うみ　だったのね！
records.english: If they can find fossils in the desert,\nit must have been a sea before.

records.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\nそんな　わたしと　たたかうのかね？
records.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\rI am to be challenged?

records.japanese: いせきを　さがしてるけど\nつよい　ポケモンは　さがしてないんだ
records.english: While I have searched for ruins, I've\nnot searched for strong POKéMON.

records.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　もう　４０ねん　さがしているか？\nあれ　どうだったかな？
records.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years?\nWhich was it now?

records.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　いせきを　さがして　４０ねん！\nそんな　わたしと　たたかうのかね？
records.english: For thirty years I have searched for\nancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years?\nAnyway, am I to be challenged?

records.japanese: いせきは　みつからない\nつよい　ポケモンも　みつからない
records.english: I've found no ruins, nor have I found\nany strong POKéMON...

records.japanese: いせきを　さがして　３０ねん！\cいや　もう　４０ねん　さがしているか？\cうーん　５０ねん　だった　きもする‥‥\nあれ　どうだったかな？
records.english:
For thirty years I have searched for
ancient ruins!\cNo, wait, was that forty years I've
searched?\cHmm... It could even be fifty...
How long have I been at this?

records.japanese: ぼくも　げんき　いっぱい！\nポケモンも　げんき　いっぱい　だよ！
records.english: I'm full of pep!\nAnd my POKéMON is peppy, too!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　げんき　なくなったよ
げんき　いっぱいに　はしりまわる\nトレーナーが　いると\rつい　そっちを　みちゃうよね！
records.english: When I see a TRAINER with a lot of pep,\nI can't help looking.

records.japanese: どこに　いくのか　しらないけど\nちょっと　しょうぶ　してみない？
records.english: I don't know where you're going, but\nwould you like to battle?

records.japanese: にくらしいほど　つよいのね！
えんとつやまに　いこうかな？　って\nおもって　いるんだけど\rこのあたりの　けしきも　いいのよね！
records.english: I'm thinking that I should go to\nMT. CHIMNEY, but the view around\rhere is very nice, too.

records.japanese: おのれを　きたえるため\nであう　にんげん　すべてに\rしょうぶを　もうしこんでるッス！
records.english: To train myself, I challenge all\nwhom I meet!

records.japanese: まいったッス‥‥！
おぬしの　ように\nつよい　トレーナーに　かてるまで\rしゅぎょう　あるのみッス！
records.english: All I can do is keep training until\nI can defeat strong TRAINERS such\ras yourself.

records.japanese: きみが　ポケモンを　どこまで\nきたえているか　みせて　もらおう！
records.english: Show me how much you've toughened\nyour POKéMON.

records.japanese: なるほど\nかなり　きたえてるね！
ポケモンも　トレーナーも\nたたかうことで　いろんなことを　まなぶ！\cだいじ　なのは\nまけても　あきらめないことさ！
records.english: POKéMON and TRAINERS learn much\nthrough battling.\cWhat's important is to never give up\neven if you lose.

records.japanese: ぼくたちは　さらなる　たかみを　めざして\nここで　ポケモンを　きたえている\rきみも　いっしょに　しゅぎょう　しよう！
records.english: We're training here to elevate our\ngame to the next level.\rStay and train with us!

records.japanese: なかなか　やるな！
そんなに　つよいなら\nポケモンリーグを　めざすと　いいよ！
records.english: Since you're that strong, you should\naim for the POKéMON LEAGUE.

records.japanese: あら　あなたの　ポケモン\nかなり　つよそうだわ！\rぜひ　おてあわせ　してくれない？
records.english: Oh, your POKéMON look like serious\nactors.\rI have to ask you for an engagement.

records.japanese: つよそう　じゃなくて\nつよいのね！
records.english: They didn't just look strong, they\nare strong!

records.japanese: あたしも　がんばって\nポケモン　そだてた　つもりだけど\rまだ　やること　いっぱい　あるわね！
records.english: I thought I was raising my POKéMON\ndiligently, but, oh no, there is still\rmuch to be done.

records.japanese: ポケモンは　つかう　わざによって\nつよくなったり　よわくなったりも　するわ！\cあなたの　ポケモン\nどんな　わざを　おぼえているの？
records.english: You can make POKéMON stronger or\nweaker depending on the moves you\rteach them.\cWhat kinds of moves do your POKéMON\nknow?

records.japanese: いい　わざを　おぼえているのね！
あたしの　ポケモン　しんか　させずに\nさきに　わざを　おぼえさせてから\rそだてた　ほうが　よかったかな？
records.english: Maybe I should have stopped my\nPOKéMON from evolving until they\rlearned better moves...

records.japanese: わっはっはっ！\nどうだ？\rオレと　しょうぶ　しないか？\rわっはっはっ！
records.english: Hahahaha!\nHow about we have a battle?\rYou and me!\rHahahaha!

records.japanese: まけた‥‥\nわっはっはっ！
いろあざやかな　キノコを　たべたら‥‥\nわ　わらいが　とまらない！\rわっはっはっ！
records.english: Hahahahaha! Something flew up my nose!\nHahahaha-hatchoo!

records.japanese: やまのぼりで　きたえた　オレの　あしこし\nちょっとや　そっとじゃ　くじけないぜ！
records.english: My legs are solid from pounding up\nand down the mountains.\cThey're not going to buckle easily,\nfriend!

records.japanese: あ‥‥\nあしが　つった‥‥
なんじゅっキロも　ある　にもつを　せおって\nやまみちを　あるき　つづけるんだ\rからだが　じょうぶに　なるぞ！
records.english: Try hiking, and I mean really\npounding, on these mountain trails\rwith a heavy pack weighing dozens of\rpounds.\cThat, my friend, will get your body\ninto serious shape.

records.japanese: やまのぼりで　きたえてるからな\nかなり　パワフルだぞ！
records.english: I've been keeping fit by hiking.\nPower, I have in spades!

records.japanese: パワーで　まけたか？
えんとつやまの　うえには\nすごい　トレーナーが　いるらしいぞ！\rこんど　しょうぶに　いくつもりだ！
records.english: I hear there are some seriously tough\nTRAINERS on top of MT. CHIMNEY.\cI intend to get up there and give them\na challenge!

records.japanese: ぼくは　つよいんだ‥‥\nまけても　ないたり　しないぞ‥‥！
records.english: I'm strong.\nI won't cry if I lose.

records.japanese: うわーーーん！
おかあさんに　あえなくて\nさみしいから　ないてるんじゃ　ないよ！\rぐすん‥‥
records.english: I'm not crying because I miss my mommy!\nSnivel...

records.japanese: ピクニックと　いえば　うた！\nさあ　いっしょに　うたいましょ！
records.english: When you're out on a picnic, why, you\nsimply have to sing!\rCome on, sing with me!

records.japanese: こんなに　つよいなんて‥‥！
うたも　ポケモンしょうぶも\nうまい　へた　なんて　かんけい　ないよ！\rたのしんだ　ほうが　かち　なのよ！
records.english: It doesn't matter if you're good or bad\nat singing or POKéMON.\cIf you have the most fun, you win!

records.japanese: この　あたりが　わりと　すずしいの\nなんでか　しってるかい？
records.english: Can you guess why it's so cool\naround here?

records.japanese: ぴゅーっ！\nまけたーっ！
かざんばいが　たいようの　ひかりを\nさえぎってるから　ひえるんだね！\rあつがりの　オレには　たすかるよ！
records.english: The volcanic ash blocks the sun, so it\ndoesn't get very warm.\cThat's good for me - I can't stand heat!

records.japanese: やまの　ふんかは\nちきゅうが　いきている　しょうこ！
records.english: The volcano's eruption is proof that\nthe earth is alive.

records.japanese: つよいな　おまえーっ！
ごほ　がへっ！\nはいが　はいに　はいった‥‥\cうけなかった‥‥\nさむい‥‥　ブルブル‥‥
records.english: Ouch! Owww! I can't see!\nI got ashes in my eyelashes!\cGet it? Ashes and eyelashes?\cOkay, that was bad, sorry...

records.japanese: あたしの　ドンメルちゃんに\nかざんばいが　かからないように\rパラソルを　さしているの
records.english: I use this parasol to ward off this\nfilthy, yucky volcanic ash from my\rdear NUMEL.

records.japanese: はあ　はあ‥‥\nつかれましたわ‥‥
とても　おつよいのね\nおねえさん　かんしん　しちゃったわ
records.english: You're very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

records.japanese: おひさしぶりね\nよろしかったら　しょうぶ　しません？
records.english: Oh, hello, hasn't it been a while?\nMay I invite you to battle?

records.japanese: おみごと　ですわ
あいかわらず　おつよいのね\nおねえさん　かんしん　しちゃったわ
records.english: You've remained very good at this.\nI must say I'm impressed!

records.japanese: はいの　なかから　ドロロンッ！！\nしょうぶで　ござる！
records.english: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

records.japanese: まいったで　ござる
もっと　かくれかたを　けんきゅう　しよう\nそれでは　しつれいするで　ござる
records.english: I must refine the art of concealment.\nI bid thee farewell.

records.japanese: はいの　なかから　ドロロロンッ！！\nしょうぶで　ござる！
records.english: From out of the ashes I leap! Hiyah!\nI challenge thee!

records.japanese: まいったで　ござる
かくれかたは　よかったが\nしょうぶが　いまいち　だった‥‥\cそれでは　しつれいするで　ござる
records.english: My flawless concealment was let down\nby my immature battle skills...\cI bid thee farewell.

records.japanese: みつけてくれて　ありがとう！\nでも　しょうぶは　べつだよ！
records.english: Thanks for finding me!\nBut we still have to battle!

records.japanese: にんぽう　かざんばい　がくれ！\c‥‥　って　もう　おわり？
records.english: I'll use my ninjutsu on you...\n“VOLCANIC ASH SWIRL CLOAK”!\c...What? It's already over?

records.japanese: かくれていて　なにが　しんぱいって\nだれも　とおらないと　さびしいんだよね
records.english: You know what's crummy about hiding?\nIt's lonely if no one comes along.

records.japanese: ナナ『ふたりで　かざんばい　あつめてるよ\nでも　ポケモンしょうぶも　するんだよ！
records.english: TORI: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

records.japanese: ナナ『まけちゃった\nつまんないから　かざんばい　あつめよ！
records.english: TORI: We lost... It's boring, so I'm going\nto get some more ashes.

records.japanese: ナナ『かざんばい　どれくらい　たまったかな？\nしろいビードロ　つくれると　いいのにね！
records.english: TORI: How much ash do we have?\nEnough for a WHITE FLUTE, I hope.

records.japanese: ナナ『あたしたち　２たい２で　たたかいたいの\nそうしないと　まけちゃうもん！
records.english: TORI: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we didn't, we would lose!

records.japanese: ネネ『ふたりで　かざんばい　あつめてるよ\nでも　ポケモンしょうぶも　するんだよ！
records.english: TIA: Both of us, we collect ashes.\nWe battle POKéMON, too.

records.japanese: ネネ『かてなかった\nつまんないから　かざんばい　あつめよ！
records.english: TIA: We couldn't win... It's boring,\nso I'm getting some more ashes.

records.japanese: ネネ『かざんばい　けっこう　たまったよ！\nもう　しろいビードロ　つくれるよ　きっと！
records.english: TIA: We have a lot of ashes!\nI think enough for a WHITE FLUTE!

records.japanese: ネネ『あたしたち　２たい２で　たたかいたいの\nそうしないと　かてないもん！
records.english: TIA: We want to battle 2-on-2.\nIf we don't, we won't win!

records.japanese: やっほーっ！\c‥‥\cこだまの　かわりに\nやっほー！　って　いってくれよ！
records.english: Yodelayhihoo!\c... ...\cYou're supposed to shout\n“yodelayhihoo” since it doesn't\recho here!

records.japanese: やっほーっ！
こどものころ　こだま　って\nむこうの　やまにいる　モノマネさんが\rやっほー！　って　いってると　おもってた
records.english: When I was a wee tyke, I believed there\nwas someone copying me and shouting\rback, “Yodelayhihoo.”

records.japanese: じゅんびを　おこたる　もの\nやまに　のぼるべからず！
records.english: If you're not prepared, you shouldn't\nbe up in the mountains!

records.japanese: やまは　こわい　ところだ‥‥
ふゆの　やまは　なだれや　ふぶきで\nそうなんする　きけんが　おおいぞ！
records.english: In the winter, mountains turn deadly\nwith blizzards and avalanches.

records.japanese: キャンプの　たのしみと　いえば\nつりに　はなびに　きもだめし！\cだけど　いちばんは\nポケモンしょうぶ　だね！
records.english: Camping's fun! You can fish, roast\nmarshmallows, and tell spooky stories!\cBut the best of all are the POKéMON\nbattles!

records.japanese: つよすぎるーっ！
ぼくね　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nキャンプ　できるだけで　しあわせ　だよ
records.english: I think it's great that I can go\ncamping with my POKéMON.

records.japanese: しょくごの　うんどう！\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しましょうよ！
records.english: I need to exercise after a meal.\nLet's have a match!

records.japanese: まけちゃったー！
おいしい　ごはんも　たべたし\nなんだか　ねむくなって　きたわ‥‥
records.english: I just had a tasty meal.\nI'm getting drowsy...

records.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\nボクの　ポケモンと　しょうぶしない？
records.english: Ufufufufufu...\nWant to battle against my POKéMON?

records.japanese: ボ　ボクの　ポケモン‥‥
からだが　おおきくて　ゴツゴツ　かたくて\nおおきな　ツノと　するどい　キバ‥‥\rうふふふふ‥‥\rそんな　ポケモンが　ほしいなぁ‥‥
records.english: A big body that's all lumpy and hard,\nenormous horns, and vicious fangs...\cUfufufufu...\nI wish I had a POKéMON like that...

records.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\nボクの　ポケモンと　しょうぶ　しようよ
ああ　ポケモン　みることが　できて\nしあわせ　だ‥‥
records.english: I feel so lucky getting to see your\nPOKéMON...

records.japanese: うふふふふふ‥‥\cポケモンの　たたかっている　すがたに\nぞくぞく　するんだ　ボク
records.english: Ufufufufufu...\cWhen I see POKéMON battling, I get all\nshivery and shaky...

records.japanese: キャンプファイヤー　するとき\nはなびを　するとき\rみずを　ようい　しておけよ！
records.english: If you're lighting a campfire, make\nsure you have water handy.

records.japanese: しょうか　かつどう\nありがとう！　ってか
ほんと　ひのようじん　だけは　おこたるな！\nひを　あまく　みるんじゃないぜ！
records.english: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\cDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

records.japanese: キャンプファイヤー　するとき\nはなびを　するとき\rみずを　ようい　するように　なったか！？
records.english: Have you learned to keep water handy\nfor campfires?

records.japanese: もえあがる　まえに\nけされた！　ってか
records.english: I got hosed down before I could flare\nup, I guess.

records.japanese: ほんと　ひのようじん　だけは　おこたるな！\nひを　あまく　みるんじゃないぜ！
records.english: You really do have to be careful with\nany sort of fire in a forest.\cDon't ever underestimate the power\nof fire.

records.japanese: つりで　しょうぶ　すると\nきみには　かちめが　ないだろう\rポケモンで　かかってきなさい！
records.english: If we were fishing, you wouldn't stand\na chance against me.\rSo, bring on your POKéMON!

records.japanese: つりの　しょうぶなら　かってた‥‥
records.english: If we were fishing, I would've won...

records.japanese: りゅうせいのたきで\nおおものでも　つると　しようかな\rあそこの　たきには　なにか　いそうだからね
records.english: I think I'll try my luck at landing\na big one at METEOR FALLS.\cThere has to be something in there.\nI just know it.

records.japanese: つりも　すき　だが\nしょうぶも　すき！\cしょうぶを　いどまれたら\nつりの　さいちゅうでも　ことわらないよ！
records.english: I like to fish. But I also like to\nbattle!\cIf anyone challenges me, I'm there,\neven if I'm fishing.

records.japanese: しょうぶは　すき　だが\nつよい　わけじゃ　ないんだ‥‥
records.english: I like to battle, but that doesn't\nmean I'm good at it...

records.japanese: こんどこそ！\cと　おもっちゃうから\nつりも　しょうぶも　やめられない
records.english: This time I'll do it!\cI always think that, so I can't walk\naway from fishing or POKéMON.

records.japanese: カヨ『そうね\nなんとなく　そんな　きぶん　だから\rあなたにも　ポケモン　おしえたげよっか
records.english: TYRA: Well, sure.\nI'm in the mood for it.\rI'll teach you a little about POKéMON.

records.japanese: カヨ『すごい　たたかいかた！
records.english: TYRA: What an amazing battle style!

records.japanese: カヨ『コウハイの　イヨに　あたしが\nポケモンを　おしえて　あげたの！
records.english: TYRA: I was teaching my junior IVY\nabout POKéMON.

records.japanese: カヨ『うふふ！\nあたしたちと　しょうぶ　するなら\rポケモン　いっぴきじゃ　ダメなのよ！
records.english: TYRA: Giggle...\nIf you want to battle with us, just one\rPOKéMON isn't enough!

records.japanese: イヨ『あなた\nだれに　ポケモン　おそわったの？
records.english: IVY: Who taught you about POKéMON?

records.japanese: イヨ『すごい　たたかいかた！
records.english: IVY: What an amazing battle style!

records.japanese: イヨ『あたしが\nポケモン　はじめた　きっかけは\rセンパイが　おしえてくれた　からなの！
records.english: IVY: I started training POKéMON\nbecause TYRA, my student mentor,\rtaught me!

records.japanese: イヨ『ポケモン　いっぴき　だけなの？\nなんだか　さみしい　かんじ　しちゃうね
records.english: IVY: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nI think it must feel lonesome.

records.japanese: ふむ‥‥\nなかなか　できそうだな‥‥\rわたしが　あいてを　してあげよう！
records.english: Hm...\nYou seem rather capable...\rLet me keep you company!

records.japanese: そうぞう　いじょうの　つよさだ‥‥！
てんさい　など　いない\nすべては　どりょく！\rわたしは　そう　しんじている‥‥
records.english: There is no such thing as a born genius.\nIt all depends on effort!\rThat is what I believe...

records.japanese: ふむ‥‥\nあいかわらずの　みのこなし\rわたしの　あいてを　してもらおう！
records.english: Hm... As always, your agility speaks\nfor itself.\rCome, keep me company!

records.japanese: あいかわらずの　つよさだ‥‥！
どりょく　あるのみ！\cまけたのは　まだまだ\nどりょくが　たりないからだ！
records.english: All it takes is effort!\cI lost because I haven't put in enough\neffort!

records.japanese: おれのッ！\cワンリキーがッ！\cたたかいを　のぞんでいるッ！
いててててっ！
おれの　ワンリキー　たちがッ！\cつよさを　のぞむかぎり\cおれたちは　どこまでも　つよくなるぜッ！
records.english: My MACHOP crew!\cSo long as they seek power, I will\ngrow strong with them!

records.japanese: オレの　とくいわざは\nずつきで　レンガを　くだく　ことだ！
records.english: My strongest skill is busting bricks\nwith my forehead!

records.japanese: うがーっ！\nあたまが　くだけたーっ！
ポケモンに　カラテを　おしえてるんだが\nオレより　つよく　なりそうで\rちょっと　たのしみ　なんだ！
records.english: I've been teaching my POKéMON karate.\cIt looks like they'll get a lot better\nthan me. I'm excited about that.

records.japanese: きみに　まけてから　がんばって\nポケモンと　おのれを　きたえなおしたぞ！\rさあ　もういちど　しょうぶ！
records.english: After you beat me, we trained hard to\nimprove our skills.\rCome on, give us a rematch!

records.japanese: うがーっ！\nまた　まけたーっ！
おれの　ポケモンは　まだまだ　つよくなる！\nがんばって　きたえるぞ！
records.english: My POKéMON will grow stronger!\nI'll redouble my training!

records.japanese: この　すなはまは　わたしの\nヒミツの　しゅぎょう　ばしょ！\rかってに　はいって　こないでよ！
records.english: This beach is my secret training spot!\nDon't come butting in!

records.japanese: しゅぎょうが　たりないわ‥‥！
すなが　クッションに　なるから\nからだを　いためないの\rさいこうの　しゅぎょう　ばしょね！
records.english: The sand acts as a cushion to reduce\nimpact and prevent injury.\rThis is the perfect place to train.

records.japanese: さあ　ポケモンしょうぶ　いくわよ！
records.english: Okay, let's get this battle on!

records.japanese: わたしは　たたかえるけど\nポケモンが‥‥
records.english: I can battle but my POKéMON...

records.japanese: まけても　ちょっと　たのしいのは\nほんとうに　ポケモンが　すき　だからかな？
records.english: Even when I lose, I still get some\nenjoyment out of it.\rIt must be that I love POKéMON.

records.japanese: ぼく　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ！\nよかったら　みせて　あげようか
records.english: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?

records.japanese: きみ‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモン　ほしいでしょ？
records.english: You...\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?

records.japanese: こんなに　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ\nそれだけで　ぼくは　まんぞく　なのさ！
records.english: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.

records.japanese: ぼく　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ！\nよかったら　みせて　あげようか
records.english: I have a rare POKéMON!\nWould you like me to show you?

records.japanese: きみ‥‥\nぼくの　ポケモン　ほしいでしょ？
records.english: You...\nYou want my POKéMON, don't you?

records.japanese: こんなに　めずらしい　ポケモン　もってるんだ\nそれだけで　ぼくは　まんぞく　なのさ！
records.english: I have this rare POKéMON.\nIt's enough to keep me satisfied.

records.japanese: トンネルが　つうじて　いないなら\nやまを　こえて　いけば　いいのだ！
records.english: If the tunnel doesn't go through, then\nI'll just go over the top.

records.japanese: ぜえ‥‥　ぜえ‥‥\nまけて　つかれて　しまった
トンネルなど　なくても　かまわん\nやまおとこは　やまが　みち　なのだ！
records.english: It's no big deal if there's no tunnel.\nTo a HIKER, mountains are roads!

records.japanese: おれの　ポケモン　つえーぞ！\nちょっと　みてみろよ！
あいたたたたっ！　キズが　できた！\nバンソーコー　はらなきゃ！
records.english: Ouch! A scrape!\nI have to put on a bandage!

records.japanese: バンソーコーは　おとこの　くんしょう！\nまた　ひとつ　ふえたぜ！
records.english: Bandages are signs of toughness!\nI've got another one!

records.japanese: ぼくの　むしポケモンは　つよいよ！\nしょうぶ　しようよ！
records.english: My BUG POKéMON are tough!\nLet's battle!

records.japanese: まけた‥‥！\nかてると　おもったのに‥‥！
records.english: I lost!\nI thought I had you!

records.japanese: むしポケモンは　しんかが　はやいから\nつよく　なるのも　はやい！
records.english: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly.\nSo they get strong quickly, too.

records.japanese: わたしの　かわいい　ポケモンの　つよさ\nじっくりと　おしえて　あげるわ！
records.english: Let me teach you how strong my\nadorable POKéMON is!

records.japanese: キミの　ほうが　いちまい　うわてね‥‥
かわいさと　つよさを　かねそなえた　ポケモン\nそれが　わたしの　りそうなの！
records.english: POKéMON that possess cuteness and\npower, that's ideal, I think.

records.japanese: トレーナーズ　スクールで\nいろいろ　べんきょう　したからね\rじっせんで　たしかめるよ！
records.english: We learn all sorts of things at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\cI want to test things out for real!

records.japanese: べんきょう　さぼってたから\nまけちゃったよ
records.english: I slacked off in school...\nThat's why I lost.

records.japanese: トレーナーズ　スクールで\nもういちど　べんきょう　しなおさなきゃ\rツツジさんに　おこられちゃうよ
records.english: I'll have to redo some courses at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

records.japanese: あれから　トレーナーズ　スクールで\nまじめに　べんきょう　したからね\rこのまえ　みたいに　まけたりしないよ！
records.english: I've been studying seriously at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rI won't lose like I did last time.

records.japanese: あれー？\nきちんと　べんきょう　したのに
トレーナーズ　スクールで\nもういちど　べんきょう　しなおさなきゃ\rツツジさんに　おこられちゃうよ
records.english: I'll have to redo some courses at the\nTRAINER'S SCHOOL.\rIf I don't, ROXANNE will be steamed.

records.japanese: スクールでも　べんきょう\nかえりみち　でも　べんきょうよ！
records.english: I study at school, and I study on the\nway home, too!

records.japanese: ショック\nまけちゃったよ
ああん！　これじゃ　ツツジさまのように\nエレガントな　トレーナーに　なれないわ！
records.english: Awww, I'll never become an elegant\nTRAINER like ROXANNE this way!

records.japanese: あれから　ものすっごく　べんきょう　したの！\nその　せいか　みてもらうからね！
records.english: I studied a whole lot since I saw you.\nYou must see my achievements!

records.japanese: ショック\nまた　まけちゃったよ
records.english: I'm in shock. I lost again?

records.japanese: ツツジさまに　かったことが　あるの？\nそれじゃ　いまの　あたしには　かてないわ
records.english: You've beaten ROXANNE?\nI can't beat you, then. Not yet.

records.japanese: オレが　そだてている　ポケモンと\nしょうぶ　してくれないか？
records.english: Listen, could I get you to battle the\nPOKéMON I'm raising?

records.japanese: みごとに　そだててるね‥‥
つよさ　だけが　ポケモンじゃないよ！\nポケモンの　こせいを　みがきあげるのも\rたのしみかたの　ひとつ　だね！
records.english: POKéMON isn't all about power.\cPolishing a unique aspect of one's\ncharacter is another way of enjoying\rPOKéMON.

records.japanese: オレが　そだてている　ポケモン\nあいかわらず　いい　かんじ　だよ！
records.english: The POKéMON I've been raising are\nlooking good, just like before.

records.japanese: いい　そだてかた　してるね‥‥\nきみには　そだてやの　さいのう　あるかも
records.english: You know how to raise them properly.\nYou might have DAY CARE skills...

records.japanese: いい　ぐあいに　そだってるね！\nコンテストに　でることを　おすすめ　するよ！
records.english: Your POKéMON are growing good!\nYou should enter them in CONTESTS.

records.japanese: ポケモンを　ちゃんと　そだててるか\nわたしが　たしかめて　あげますね
records.english: Please, allow me to evaluate if you\nhave raised your POKéMON properly.

records.japanese: ちゃんと　そだってますね
ポロックを　ポケモンに　たべさせれば\nポケモンの　こせいが　みがかれますよ
records.english: If you feed [POKEBLOCK]S to POKéMON, the\nunique aspects of their character\rwill be enhanced.

records.japanese: ポケモンを　ちゃんと　そだててるか\nまた　わたしが　たしかめて　あげますね
records.english: Allow me to reevaluate if you have\nraised your POKéMON properly.

records.japanese: みごとに　そだってますね
ポケモンの　せいかくに　よって\nすきな　ポロックが　あるみたいなの
records.english: POKéMON seem to like different kinds\nof [POKEBLOCK]S, depending on their nature.

records.japanese: トライアスロンの　まっさいちゅう　だけど\nさくっと　しょうぶ　しようじゃ　ないか！
records.english: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nwhatever, let's have a battle!

records.japanese: たいりょく　なくなった！
まいったな‥‥\cいまの　しょうぶの　あいだに\nビリに　なっちゃったかも‥‥？
records.english: I may have blown it...\cI might have dropped to last during\nthat battle...

records.japanese: トライアスロンの　まっさいちゅう　だけど\nぼくには　よゆうが　あるからね\rさくっと　しょうぶ　しようじゃ　ないか！
records.english: I'm smack in the middle of a triathlon,\nbut I'm comfortably ahead.\rLet's make this a quick battle!

records.japanese: また　たいりょく　なくなった！
records.english: I ran out of energy again!

records.japanese: およぎと　じてんしゃでは　トップだったけど\nポケモンは　いまいち　じしんが　ないよ
records.english: I was tops in swimming and cycling, but\nI'm not quite that confident with\rPOKéMON yet.

records.japanese: トライアスロンの　れんしゅう\nポケモンと　いっしょに　してるからさ\rスピードに　じしん　あるよ！
records.english: I do my triathlon training with POKéMON,\nso I'm pretty confident about my speed.

records.japanese: れんしゅうが　たりなかったかな？
records.english: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

records.japanese: れんしゅうは　つづけてこそ\nいみが　あるのよね\cよーし！　また　れんしゅうよ\nあしたから！
records.english: Training is meaningful only if you\nkeep it up regularly.\cOkay! I'll resume my training!\nTomorrow!

records.japanese: どう　れんしゅう　つづけてる？\nあたしは　もちろん　つづけてるわ\rその　しょうこ　みせちゃうから！
records.english: Are you keeping up with your training?\nI sure am!\rLet me show you the evidence!

records.japanese: れんしゅうが　たりなかったかな？
records.english: I need to get more practices in,\nI guess.

records.japanese: あしたから　また　れんしゅう　するから\nよかったら　また　しょうぶ　してね！
records.english: I'll resume training tomorrow.\nLet's battle again sometime!

records.japanese: むかしは　むしとりしょうねん！\nいまは　こんちゅうマニア！\cでも　ポケモンを　あいする　きもちは\nずっと　かわらないぜ！
records.english: Once a BUG CATCHER!\nAnd now a BUG MANIAC!\cBut my love for POKéMON remains\nunchanged!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　よわさも　かわらない‥‥
すきな　ことばかり　していたら\nいつのまにか　マニアって　よばれてるよ！\cまあ　むしポケモンに　くわしいからね\nマニアと　よばれて　とうぜん　なのさっ！
records.english: All I did was follow my heart, and now\nthey call me a BUG MANIAC...\cStill, I am an expert on BUG POKéMON,\nso it's only natural that they call me\ra BUG MANIAC.

records.japanese: ミホ『かわいい　コウハイの　まえ　だもん\nいいところ　みせちゃうんだから！
records.english: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner. I have to do good!

records.japanese: ミホ『もう！\nコウハイの　まえ　だから　かたせてよ！
records.english: ANNA: I'm with my pretty junior student\npartner! Let me win!

records.japanese: ミホ『あなたの　ポケモン\nなかなかの　コンビネーション　してる！\cそうね　あたしたちの\nつぎ　ぐらいに　すごいんじゃない？
records.english: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\cI'd say you're second only to us!

records.japanese: ミホ『あたしたちと　しょうぶ　したいなら\nポケモンを　２ひきは　もってきてね！
records.english: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring\ntwo POKéMON with you.

records.japanese: リコ『すてきな　センパイとの　タッグで\nあなたを　まかしちゃうから！
records.english: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my super\nsenior student partner and beat you!

records.japanese: リコ『やーん\nセンパイ　ごめんなさい！
records.english: MEG: Oh, no!\nI'm sorry, ANNA! I let you down...

records.japanese: リコ『あたしが　センパイの\nあしを　ひっぱっちゃったの‥‥\cそうでなきゃ　あんた　かってないわよ！
records.english: MEG: I dragged ANNA down...\nIf I didn't, she would have won!

records.japanese: リコ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわね\cあたしたち　２たい２の\nしょうぶを　たのしみたいの！
records.english: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\cWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

records.japanese: ミホ『コウハイの　まえで\nなんども　まけてられないのよね
records.english: ANNA: I can't keep losing in front of\nmy junior partner, right?

records.japanese: ミホ『ちょうしが　でなかったのよ
records.english: ANNA: I couldn't get into the groove.

records.japanese: ミホ『あなたの　ポケモン\nなかなかの　コンビネーションしてる！\cそうね　あたしたちの\nつぎ　ぐらいに　すごいんじゃない？
records.english: ANNA: Your POKéMON have some good\ncombinations.\cI'd say you're second only to us!

records.japanese: ミホ『あたしたちと　しょうぶ　したいなら\nポケモンを　２ひきは　もってきてね！
records.english: ANNA: If you want to battle us, bring\ntwo POKéMON with you.

records.japanese: リコ『センパイとの　タッグで\nこんどこそ　あなたを　まかしちゃうから！
records.english: MEG: I'm going to tag up with my\nsenior partner and win this time!

records.japanese: リコ『つよすぎるわ
リコ『センパイと　いっしょに　たたかったのに\nまけるだなんて‥‥　おちこんじゃう！
records.english: MEG: I battled together with my\nsenior partner, but we lost...\cThat's so discouraging...

records.japanese: リコ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないの？\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわね\cあたしたち　２たい２の\nしょうぶを　たのしみたいの！
records.english: MEG: Do you only have one POKéMON?\nWe can't battle with you, then.\cWe want to have a 2-on-2 battle.

records.japanese: はなの　かおりは　ふしぎな　ちから\nからだも　こころも　きれいに　なるわ
records.english: The aroma of flowers has a magical\npower. It cleanses us body and soul.

records.japanese: あらら\nまけちゃったわね
records.english: Oh, dear me.\nI seem to have lost.

records.japanese: はなも　ポケモンも\nいい　かおりの　ものが　だいすき！\rクサイにおいは‥‥　かんべんね
records.english: Flowers, POKéMON...\nI love whatever smells nice.\cStinky things...\nI'll pass.

records.japanese: いい　かおりに　さそわれて\nいらしたのかしら？
records.english: Were you drawn here by the sweet\naroma?

records.japanese: においの　こうか‥‥\nあんまり　きかなかったわね
records.english: The power of aroma...\nIt didn't seem to do much.

records.japanese: あまいかおりを　うまく　つかうと\nポケモンが　さそわれて　やってくるわね
records.english: If you use a sweet aroma properly,\nPOKéMON will be attracted by it.

records.japanese: かれいに　おおぞらを　まう\nとりポケモンが　さいこう　だぜ！
records.english: BIRD POKéMON that FLY elegantly in\nthe sky... They're the best!

records.japanese: うう‥‥　まけた‥‥
きみも　いい　ポケモンを　もってるね！\nぼくも　まけずに　そだてよっと！
records.english: You've got great POKéMON.\nI'll have to train mine better.

records.japanese: はばたけ！\nおいらの　とりポケモン！
はばたいたけど‥‥
もっと　つよくなると\nじゆうに　とべるように　なるのにな！
records.english: If they'd get stronger, they'd be able\nto fly more freely...

records.japanese: あたしゃ　つりびとだが　トレーナーでもある\nつった　ポケモン　ちゃんと　そだててるよ！
records.english: I'm a FISHERMAN, but also a TRAINER.\nI'm raising the POKéMON I caught.

records.japanese: そだてたはず　なんだが‥‥？
records.english: I thought I was doing okay in my\ntraining...

records.japanese: つりを　しながら\nポケモン　そだてても　かてなかった‥‥\rどっちも　はんぱ　だったのか！？
records.english: I couldn't win by training POKéMON\nwhile I fished...\cWas I doing things in half measures?

records.japanese: つりびとに　だいじ　なのは　どうぐ！\nトレーナーに　だいじ　なのは\rもちろん　ポケモンと　ハートだな！
records.english: For FISHERMEN, equipment is the key.\cBut for TRAINERS, the key ingredients\nare POKéMON and heart, of course!

records.japanese: ハートの　しょうぶで　まけたのか？
つり　というのも\nひとと　ポケモンとの\rしんけん　しょうぶ　だな！
records.english: Come to think of it, fishing is a battle\nbetween a FISHERMAN and a POKéMON.

records.japanese: ぼくの　メロディ\nあなたの　こころに　とどけるよ
records.english: Let my melody rock your soul!

records.japanese: ルー　ルルルー
エレキギターって\nただ　うるさい　だけじゃ　ないんだ‥‥\cこうして　こころに　しみる\nメロディも　かなでられるのさ‥‥
records.english: An electric guitar doesn't always\nhave to be noisy...\cIt can be strummed to squeeze out\nthis heart-stirring melody...

records.japanese: ぼくと　ポケモンの　メロディ\nあなたの　こころに　とどけるよ
records.english: A melody from my POKéMON and me...\nLet us deliver it to your soul.

records.japanese: ルー　ルルルー
ひいてるときの　ぼくの　きもちが\nエレキギターを　とおして\rあなたに　とどく　はずなのさ‥‥
records.english: When I play, my emotions should reach\nyou through my electric guitar...

records.japanese: ボクらは　モノマネサークル！\nキミの　うごきを　マネするよ！
records.english: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nWe MIMIC what you do!

records.japanese: うわあ　まけたーっ！
マネを　して　なにが　たのしいか‥‥\cふふふ‥‥\nキミには　わからない　だろうよ
records.english: What's so good about mimicry?\cFufufu...\nYou'll never understand...

records.japanese: ようやく　であえたね！\nぼくの　むしポケモンが　あいて　するよ！
records.english: So, we finally meet!\nMy BUG POKéMON will keep you company!

records.japanese: であわなければ　よかった‥‥
もっと　キミの　マネを　したい！\nほら　はやく　うごいてよ！
records.english: I want to MIMIC you some more.\cCan you hurry up and move?

records.japanese: きみが　まえに　すすんだら\nぼくらも　すすむ\cきみが　みぎへ　まがれば\nぼくらも　まがる‥‥
records.english: If you step forward, we step forward.\cIf you turn right, we turn, too...

records.japanese: キミが　かっても\nぼくは　まける‥‥
records.english: But if you win, I lose...

records.japanese: うーん　しょうぶの　しょうはい　だけは\nマネ　できないよなあ‥‥\rなんか　くやしい‥‥
records.english: I can't MIMIC you winning the match.\nThat's just impossible...\rIt's burning me up...

records.japanese: やっと　ボクを　つかまえられたね！\nそれとも　にげようと　していたのかな？
records.english: Yep, you've finally caught me!\nOr were you trying to avoid me?

records.japanese: すばらしい　たたかい　だったな！
records.english: Whoop, that was a great match!

records.japanese: ボクらは　モノマネサークル！\nたのしんで　もらえたかな？
records.english: We're the MIMIC CIRCLE!\nI hope you enjoyed our performance.

records.japanese: ボクが　だれなのか　わからないだろう？\c‥‥まあ　ボクも　キミのこと　しらないから\nこうして　たたかうんだけどね！
records.english: You don't know who I am, do you?\cBut, I also don't know you.\nSo, we'll battle!

records.japanese: けっこう　つよい　じゃんか！
キミが　どこかに　いくまで\nボクらは　マネを　つづけるよ！
records.english: Until you go away somewhere, we'll\nkeep on mimicking your every move.

records.japanese: モノマネ　だいすきな　ひとが\nあつまって　つくった　モノマネサークル！\cであった　そのとき\nしょうぶが　はじまる！
records.english: The MIMIC CIRCLE was formed by people\nwho like to MIMIC.\cA battle starts the instant we meet!

records.japanese: まいりましたーっ！
キミも　モノマネサークルに　はいらない？
records.english: Won't you join our MIMIC CIRCLE?

records.japanese: サバイバルに　ひつような\nちしきと　ぎじゅつを　もつ　もの！\rそれが　ポケモンレンジャーさ！
records.english: Who has the knowledge and the\ntechnique for survival?\cPOKéMON RANGERS, that's who!

records.japanese: ポケモンの　ちしきは　たらなかった‥‥
ぶんめい　から　はなれて\nにんげんの　やせいを　めざめさせる！\rそれが　オレたちの　テーマさ！
records.english: To break away from civilization and\nawaken the wild spirit within!\cThat's our vision.

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いることで\nやせいを　とりもどすのさ！
records.english: I'm going to regain my wild spirit by\nbeing together with POKéMON.

records.japanese: あいかわらず　つよいな！
とにかく　ポケモンを　しんじろ！\nじぶんを　しんじろ！\rそうすれば　みちは　ひらける！
records.english: Believe in your POKéMON.\nBelieve in yourself.\cThe road will reveal itself to you.

records.japanese: あら　あなた‥‥\nぼうけんを　している　わりには\rずいぶん　みがるな　かっこうね！
records.english: Oh? Look at you.\cFor someone on an adventure, you're\ntraveling awfully light.

records.japanese: じゅんび　ぶそくは　じこの　もと‥‥
ずいぶん　みがるな　かっこう　だけど\nひつような　どうぐは　もってるし\rきりょく　たいりょく　じゅうぶんね！
records.english: You're traveling light but you have\neverything you need.\cYou're on top of things mentally and\nphysically, too.

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょの　ぼうけんは\nうまく　いってるかしら？
まだ　なにかが\nたりなかったわね‥‥
トレーナーの　あなたが\nポケモンを　たよって　いるように\rポケモンも　あなたを　たよっているのよ！
records.english: In the same way that you, as a TRAINER,\nrely on your POKéMON, your POKéMON\rrely on you.

records.japanese: おおぞらは　おとこの　ロマン！\cじゆうに　そらを　とぶ　きもちよさは\nなにごとにも　かえがたい！
records.english: The vast sky holds untold promise!\cNothing can compare to the sheer\nexhilaration of flight!

records.japanese: まけたーっ！
そらを　とびまわる　ユメは\nとりポケモンの　おかげで　かなえられたよ！
records.english: My BIRD POKéMON made my dreams of\nflying come true!

records.japanese: ぼくの　とりポケモンの　じつりょくを\nみせて　あげるよ！
records.english: I'll show you the true potential of me\nand my BIRD POKéMON!

records.japanese: じつりょく　ぶそく　だった‥‥
ぼくは　ちいさい　ころから\nとりポケモンに　あこがれて　いたんだ！
records.english: Ever since I was a little kid, I always\nadmired BIRD POKéMON...

records.japanese: かげに　ひそみ　やみに　いきる\nそれが　オレの　さだめ‥‥！\rいざ　ポケモンしょうぶ！
records.english: To lurk in shadows, and live in\ndarkness... That is my destiny.\cI emerge to challenge you!

records.japanese: まいった‥‥！
しょうぶに　やぶれた　ものは\nいさぎよく　かげに　もどる‥‥\rそれも　さだめ‥‥
records.english: Those defeated in battle withdraw\nquietly back into the shadows.\rThat, too, is destiny...

records.japanese: ゆだん　してると\nいたい　めに　あうぜ！
records.english: If you're not on your guard, you're in\nfor some pain!

records.japanese: つよいな　きみーっ！
きしゅう　さくせんは　シッパイだった‥‥
きを　かくすなら　もりのなか！
records.english: To hide a tree, use a forest!

records.japanese: つわもので　ござるな
きを　かくすなら　もりのなか！\nポケモンを　かくすなら　ポケモンのなか！\cとくに　いみは　ないでござる
records.english: To hide a tree, use a forest!\nTo hide a POKéMON, use a POKéMON!\cThere is no deep, hidden meaning\nto that.

records.japanese: わたしに　はなしかけた‥‥\nつまり　しょうぶを　いどむ　つもりだな！\cよーし！　なみのり　しながら\nつりあげた　ポケモンで　たたかうぞ！
records.english: You spoke to me...\nSo you want to challenge me!\cSure! I'll try out the POKéMON I caught\nwhile SURFING!

records.japanese: かつための　ポイントが\nちっとも　わからん！
records.english: I don't have a clue about what it\ntakes to win.

records.japanese: なみのりを　つかう！\cポケモンの　せなかに　のって\nつりを　たのしむ！\cなんて　ゆうがな　ひととき　だろう！
records.english: Go for a SURF on my POKéMON...\cThen fish off its back...\cIt's an indescribably luxuriant moment!

records.japanese: そらを　とんでいる　ポケモンに\nダメージを　あたえる　ワザを　もってる？
records.english: Do you have any moves that can strike\na flying POKéMON?

records.japanese: キミの　ほうが\nいちまい　うわて　だった！
そらをとぶ　って　ワザは　べんりだな！\cそらを　とんでいる　あいだは\nほとんどの　ワザが　あたらないだろ？
records.english: The move FLY is convenient, don't\nyou think?\cWhile the POKéMON is flying, almost\nno moves can strike it.

records.japanese: ボクの　ポケモンは　つよいぜ！\nキミの　ポケモンは　どうかな？
records.english: My POKéMON is strong!\nHow about yours?

records.japanese: キミの　ポケモンの　ほうが\nつよかった‥‥！
どんどん　つよくなる　ポケモンは\nほんと　たよりに　なるよなー！
records.english: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

records.japanese: どんどん　つよくなる　ポケモンは\nほんと　たよりに　なるよなー！
records.english: A POKéMON that grows steadily is one\nyou can count on.

records.japanese: キミの　ポケモン\nほんとうに　つよいんだな‥‥
ポケモンが　つよくなるのと　いっしょに\nおれも　つよくならないとなー！
records.english: My POKéMON are growing stronger.\nI have to grow stronger, too.

records.japanese: きみの　ポケモン\nそうなん　しないか　みてあげよう！
records.english: I'll check your POKéMON and see if\nthey're fit for the outdoors.

records.japanese: そんなに　つよい　ポケモンと　いっしょなら\nそうなんの　おそれは　ないな！
records.english: With POKéMON that strong, you're in\nno danger of needing rescue!

records.japanese: ポケモンと　いっしょに　どこまでもいく\nトレーナーの　よろこびと　いえるだろう！
records.english: To travel wherever your heart desires\nwith POKéMON...\rThat's the joy of being a TRAINER.

records.japanese: あなたの　たいりょく　どう？\nたいりょく　ぶそくだと\rいざと　いうとき　こまるわよ！
records.english: How's your physical fitness?\nIf you're not fit, you could have a\rrough time in critical situations.

records.japanese: たいりょく　だけは　あったのに‥‥
たいりょく　づくりが　わたしの　にっか\nまいにち　ポケモンと　ランニングよ！
records.english: Fitness training is in my routine.\nI always run with my POKéMON.

records.japanese: ‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\nまた　まけた‥‥
‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\rまた　がんばろう‥‥\rだいじな　むしポケモンの　ために‥‥
records.english: ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ...\rI'll try harder...\rFor my precious BUG POKéMON...

records.japanese: ポケモンには　いろんな　とくせいが　ある\nそれを　かんがえてこそ\rいちりゅうの　トレーナーに　なれるのよ！
records.english: POKéMON have many special abilities.\nIf you want to become a first-class\rTRAINER, learn about them.

records.japanese: なかなか　かんがえてるのね
そう　ポケモンの　とくせいに　よって\nたたかいかたも　いろいろ　かわってくるわ！
records.english: The special abilities of POKéMON\nwill make battle styles change.

records.japanese: なんだね　きみは？\cもしかして　ひょっとすると\nあるかもしれない　といわれる\rこだいの　いせきを　さがしに　きたのかね！？
records.english: Who might you be?\cAre you perhaps searching for ancient\nruins that are rumored to possibly\rexist according to legend?

records.japanese: まいったね　こりゃ
あの　おおきな　いわ\nわたしは　いせき　だと　おもいたいが\rそれにしては　いりぐちが　ないね‥‥
records.english: That giant rock... I would like to\nbelieve it may indeed contain ancient\rruins. But I see no entrance.

records.japanese: あたしが　パラソルを　もってる　りゆう？\cうふふ　あたしに　かてたら\nおしえて　あげても　いいかな？
records.english: Why am I carrying this parasol?\cI'll tell you if you can win against me.

records.japanese: パラソルで　ポケモンの　こうげきは\nしのげないのね‥‥
records.english: A parasol can't ward off POKéMON\nattacks...

records.japanese: あたしの　ポケモンたちも\nあつい　ひざしは　にがてだと　おもうの\rだから　こうして　パラソルを　もってるのよ
records.english: I don't think strong sunlight is good\nfor my POKéMON.\rSo I shield them with my parasol.

records.japanese: あたしと　ポケモンと　パラソル\nどれか　ひとつ　かけていても\rうつくしさが　そこなわれるんだわ
records.english: Me, POKéMON, and my parasol...\cIf any one of them is missing, the\npicture of beauty will be ruined.

records.japanese: うつくしさが\nだいなしに　なっちゃったわ
あなたに　パラソルは　にあわないわ！\cだって　こんなの　もっていたら\nすっごく　ジャマに　なりそう　なんだもの
records.english: A parasol wouldn't suit you at all.\cWhy, something like this would only\nget in your way.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　うごきを　とりいれて\nあたらしい　にんぽうを　あみだすんだ！
records.english: I will adopt the movements of POKéMON\nand create new ninja techniques.

records.japanese: あたらしい　にんぽう\nかんせいまで　まだまだ　かかりそうだ
records.english: The creation of new ninja techniques\nis but a distant dream...

records.japanese: ニンジャの　せんせいを　さがして\nでしいり　しようかな？
records.english: Perhaps I ought to apprentice under\na ninja sensei.

records.japanese: ぼくたち　ニンジャごっこの　かくれぬの！\nどこに　いるのか　わからなかっただろ！
records.english: We ninja conceal ourselves under our\ncamouflage cloaks.\rI bet you didn't know where I was!

records.japanese: まけた！\nかくれぬので　かくれるか？
records.english: I lost!\nI should camouflage my shame!

records.japanese: ぼくたち　ニンジャごっこの　かくれぬの！\nこれって　てづくり　なんだぜ！
あたしの　とっても　プリティな\nポケモンを　かわいがってよ！
records.english: Will you play with my delightfully\npretty POKéMON?

records.japanese: かわいがるの　いみが　ちがうわ！
ミナモの　コンテストに　いくのよ\nあたしの　ポケモンなら\rマスター　ランクでも　らくしょうよ！
records.english: I'm going to a CONTEST in LILYCOVE.\cMy POKéMON should have no problem\nsweeping the MASTER CLASS.

records.japanese: せかい　かっこくを\nポケモンと　いっしょに　まわってきた\cすこしは　うでに　じしんが　ありますよ！
records.english: With my POKéMON, I have traveled the\nworld's four corners.\cYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

records.japanese: おみごと　ですな
また　ポケモンと　いっしょに\nせかいを　まわってみたい　ものです
records.english: I would like to circle the globe once\nagain with my POKéMON.

records.japanese: せかい　かっこくを\nポケモンと　いっしょに　まわってきた\cすこしは　うでに　じしんが　ありますよ！
records.english: With my POKéMON, I have traveled the\nworld's four corners.\cYou might say I have some confidence\nin my abilities.

records.japanese: おみごと　ですな！
あなたと　その　ポケモンなら\nがいこくでも　つよいと　いわれるでしょう！
records.english: Your POKéMON and you...\cYour prowess together will be\nconsidered strong, even overseas.

records.japanese: よの　なかには　ふしぎな　ちからが\nいっぱい　あるの‥‥
records.english: There are powers beyond our\nunderstanding in the world...

records.japanese: あたし　まけたのね‥‥
おくりびやま‥‥\nあそこに　ふしぎな　ちからが　あるの‥‥
records.english: MT. PYRE...\nThere is a mysterious power\rat work there...

records.japanese: マナ『ふたり　そろえば　こわいもの　なし！\nあたしたちの　つよさ　みせつけちゃうから！
records.english: KATE: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

records.japanese: マナ『コウハイの　まえで　かっこわるいわ‥‥
records.english: KATE: I blew it in front of my junior\nstudent partner...

records.japanese: マナ『あたしって　たよられちゃうと\nつい　かっこいい　ところ\rみせたく　なっちゃうのよね‥‥
records.english: KATE: When someone's relying on me,\nI get this urge to look cool in front\rof them...

records.japanese: マナ『ポケモン　１ぴき　しか　いないのね\nじゃあ　しょうぶは　できないわ！\cだって　よわいもの　いじめに　なるもの
records.english: KATE: If you've only got one POKéMON,\nwe can't battle with you.\cThat would be bullying.

records.japanese: ユイ『ふたり　そろえば　こわいもの　なし！\nあたしたちの　つよさ　みせつけちゃうから！
records.english: JOY: Together, we're fearless!\nWe'll demonstrate how tough we are!

records.japanese: ユイ『センパイ　ごめんなさーい
ユイ『えへっ！\nまた　センパイと　いっしょに　とっくんね！
records.english: JOY: Ehehe, I'll have to train with KATE,\nmy senior student partner, again.

records.japanese: ユイ『あたしたちに　しょうぶを　いどむなら\nポケモン　２ひきは　ひつよう　だからね！
records.english: JOY: You need at least two POKéMON\nif you're going to challenge us!

records.japanese: あたくしの　だいじな　ポケモン\nちょっと　みなさいよ！
records.english: Stop! Have a good look at my precious\nPOKéMON!

records.japanese: ぷんぷん！\nなによ　ほんき　だしちゃって！
records.english: Oh, how dare you!\nDon't take it so seriously!

records.japanese: サファリで　あたらしい　ポケモン\nつかまえようかな？
records.english: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

records.japanese: だいじな　ポケモン　そだったのよ！\nちょっと　みていきなさいよ！
records.english: My precious POKéMON grew!\nHave a good look!

records.japanese: ぷんぷん！\nまた　てかげん　してくれないのね！
records.english: Oh, how dare you!\nYou still won't take it easy!

records.japanese: サファリで　あたらしい　ポケモン\nつかまえようかな？
records.english: Maybe I'll go catch more POKéMON at\nthe SAFARI.

records.japanese: あなたの　じつりょくが\nどれほどの　ものか‥‥\rわたしが　たしかめて　あげる！
records.english: Want to determine how strong you are?\nI'll be the test!

records.japanese: すばらしいわ‥‥！
わたしに　かつなんて‥‥\nあなたの　じつりょくも　そうとうな　もの！
records.english: To best even me...\nYour strength is marvelous!

records.japanese: たくさん　ジムの　バッジを\nもっている　みたいだね！\cほんとうに　それだけの　ちからが　あるか\nたしかめさせて　もらうよ！
records.english: You seem to have a big collection\nof GYM BADGES.\cLet me see if you're actually worthy of\nthose BADGES!

records.japanese: たしかに　ちからは　ある！
ジムバッジに　はじない\nたたかい　だったよ！
records.english: You did your BADGES proud in that\nmatch!

records.japanese: たのしい　ことが　あるとき　って\nいい　においで　いっぱいに　なってるのね
records.english: They say that good times are filled\nwith good aromas.

records.japanese: あぁ\nかなしみの　におい　だわ‥‥
records.english: Oh...\nI smell the bitter scent of misery...

records.japanese: きのみ　めいじんの　はなばたけ\nすっごく　いいかんじの　においで　いっぱい！
records.english: The BERRY MASTER's garden is filled\nwith uplifting fragrances.

records.japanese: サイキックとは　きもちの　つよさ‥‥\cそう　ぼくは　だれにも　まけないと\nおもっているから　つよいよ！
records.english: Being a psychic is about willpower.\cI've willed myself not to lose to\nanyone. That makes me strong!

records.japanese: しょんぼり‥‥
サイキックとは　きもちの　つよさ\nきみには　まけないと　おもっていたのに‥‥
records.english: Being a psychic is about willpower.\nI thought I wouldn't lose to you...

records.japanese: ぼくは　もう　だれにも　まけないと\nおもっているから　つよいよ！！
records.english: I've convinced myself that I won't\nlose anymore. That makes me strong!

records.japanese: しょんぼり‥‥
おくりびやまで　しゅぎょうでも　しようかな\nこのままじゃ　ずっと　きみに　かてないよ
records.english: I should train at MT. PYRE...\nI'll never beat you this way...

records.japanese: ポケモンも　ちょうのうりょくも\nつかえるだけじゃ　いみ　ないわ\rきたえてこそ　ほんものに　なるのよ
records.english: Don't be too happy if your POKéMON\ndevelop psychic powers.\cYou need to refine those powers to\nmake them really useful.

records.japanese: すごい！
だれでも　ちょうのうりょくを　もっているの\nただ　つかいかたを　わすれている　だけよ
records.english: We all have psychic powers.\nWe've just forgotten how to use them.

records.japanese: どう？　あなたの　なかの\nちょうのうりょく　めばえたり　した？
records.english: Have you awoken the psychic powers\nwithin you?

records.japanese: すごいわ！
あなたの　つよさ\nそれも　ちょうのうりょく　かもね
records.english: Your power with POKéMON...\nThat could be a psychic power, too.

records.japanese: ミウ『トレーナーさんの　ポケモン\nまけても　なかないで　くださいね！
records.english: MIU: Hello, TRAINER. I hope your\nPOKéMON won't cry when they lose.

records.japanese: ミウ『まけちゃったね‥‥
ミウ『トレーナーさんの　ポケモン\nなかが　いいから　つよいんですね！
records.english: MIU: TRAINER, your POKéMON are\nstrong because you are friends.

records.japanese: ミウ『ポケモンさん　２ひきは　いないと\nたたかっても　つまらないもん！
records.english: MIU: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

records.japanese: ユキ『よーし！\nトレーナーさんの　ポケモン　やっつけます！
records.english: YUKI: Okay!\nWe're beating the TRAINER's POKéMON!

records.japanese: ユキ『まけちゃったね‥‥
ユキ『どーして　そんなに　つよいの？\nあたちたち　たたかって　まけたの　はじめて！
records.english: YUKI: Why are you so strong?\nWe've never lost before.

records.japanese: ユキ『ポケモンさん　２ひきは　いないと\nたたかっても　つまらないもん！
records.english: YUKI: It's no fun to battle if you\ndon't have two POKéMON.

records.japanese: おくりびやまは‥‥\nポケモンの　たましいが　ねむるところ‥‥\rあなたの　ポケモンも　ねむる‥‥？
records.english: MT. PYRE...\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep...\rWill your POKéMON sleep?

records.japanese: げんき　いっぱいね‥‥
おくりびやまは‥‥\nポケモンの　たましいが　ねむるところ‥‥\cきっと　たましいを　なぐさめる\nちからに　あふれてるのよ‥‥
records.english: MT. PYRE...\nWhere the spirits of POKéMON sleep...\cIt must overflow with a power that\nsoothes spirits...

records.japanese: おっと　みちに　まよったのか？\cわたしの　ポケモンに　かてたら\nみずさき　あんないにんに　なってあげようか？
records.english: Hey, are you lost at sea?\cIf you can beat my POKéMON, I can\nserve as your pilot.

records.japanese: たたかいかたを　まよってしまった‥‥
records.english: I lost my bearings in battle!

records.japanese: うみで　まよってしまう　ひとは　おおい！\cそんな　ひとは　ポケナビで\nマップを　たしかめながら　すすむと　いい！
records.english: Many people lose their bearings at sea.\cIf you're that sort, you should refer\nto the POKéNAV's MAP.

records.japanese: むっ！　じぶんで　およがずに\nポケモンに　のっている‥‥\cなんて　うらやましいんだ！
records.english: Hm! You're riding a POKéMON instead\nof swimming yourself...\cI am envious!

records.japanese: ああ！\nダメだ‥‥！
からだが　ひえてきた‥‥\nながいこと　みずの　なかに　いるからだ\cきみのように　ポケモンに　のりたいよ
records.english: I'm getting chilled...\nI've been in the water too long...\cI wish I could ride a POKéMON like you...

records.japanese: こうして　うみに　うかんでいると\nポケモンたちが　あそびに　くるのよ！
records.english: If you just float in the sea like\nthis, POKéMON come around to play.

records.japanese: あーあ\nまけちゃった‥‥
うみを　およいでいると\nおそってくる　ポケモンと\rただ　みているだけの　ポケモンが　いるの\cポケモンにも　こせいが　あるのね！
records.english: While swimming, I noticed that some\nPOKéMON attack, and some just watch.\cI guess POKéMON have personalities\nof their own.

records.japanese: こうして　うみに　うかんでいると\nトレーナーが　いどんで　くるのよね！
records.english: If you just float in the sea like this,\nTRAINERS challenge you!

records.japanese: おかしいなあ\nまた　まけちゃった‥‥
なんとなく　だけど\nカラクリやしきに　いってみようかな‥‥
records.english: This has nothing to do with anything,\nbut maybe I'll visit the TRICK HOUSE.

records.japanese: およぐのにも　あきた　ところだし‥‥\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しようよ！
records.english: I'm growing bored of swimming...\nHow about a battle?

records.japanese: こんなに　つよいなんて\nおもいも　しなかったわ！
records.english: I had no idea that you were\nthis strong!

records.japanese: ずっと　がんばって　きたことが\nあなたの　つよさなのね‥‥！
records.english: All the effort you put in must have\nmade you this strong.

records.japanese: うふふふふ\nオレは　モグリの　スイマー\rもぐりは　とくいちゅうの　とくいだぜ！
records.english: Fufufufu... I dive deep underwater\nto go deep under cover.\rPlumbing the depths is where I excel!

records.japanese: ゴボゴボゴボ‥‥\nしずんでいく‥‥
うみの　そこに　もぐれる　ポイントが\nこの　あたりには　あるらしいぜ！\rモグリの　ちが　さわぐなあ‥‥
records.english: I have it on good authority that\nthere's a DIVE spot around here.\cIt gives me the urge to go deep\nagain...

records.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cせっかくの　うみ　なのに\nいっしょに　いるのが　おとうと　なんて‥‥\cあなた　きばらしに　ポケモン　しようか！？
records.english: RITA: Sigh...\cHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\cLet's battle so I won't have to dwell\non that!

records.japanese: ナミ『コウの　せいで　まけたのよ！\nあとで　おしおき　だかんね！！
records.english: RITA: SAM! It's your fault we lost!\nYou're in for it later!

records.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cとなりに　いるのが　おとうと　じゃなくて\nすてきな　かれし　だったら　いいのに‥‥
records.english: RITA: Sigh...\cIf only it wasn't my little brother\nnext to me, but a nice boyfriend...

records.japanese: ナミ『あたしたちと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメよ
records.english: RITA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have more POKéMON.

records.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nポケモン　つよいぞ！\rまけて　ないたり　するなよ！
records.english: SAM: My big sister is tough at POKéMON!\cDon't cry when you lose!

records.japanese: コウ『うわぁ‥‥\nあとで　ねえちゃんに　おこられる‥‥
records.english: SAM: Uh-oh...\nMy big sister will chew me out...

records.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nおこると　むちゃくちゃ　こわいんだ‥‥\cだから　こいびと　いないんだぜ‥‥
records.english: SAM: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\cThat's why she doesn't have a\nboyfriend.

records.japanese: コウ『オレらと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　つれてきなよ！
records.english: SAM: Did you want to battle us?\nBring some more POKéMON, then.

records.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cせっかくの　うみ　なのに\nいっしょに　いるのが　おとうと　なんて‥‥\cあら　あなた　ひさしぶりね\nきばらしに　ポケモン　しようか！？
records.english: RITA: Sigh...\cHere I am in the sea, but who's with me?\nMy little brother!\cOh, hi, it's been a while. Let's battle\nso I won't have to dwell on things!

records.japanese: ナミ『コウったら！\nあんたの　せいで　また　まけたでしょ！\rあとで　とっくん　だかんね！！
records.english: RITA: SAM!\nIt's your fault we lost again!\cWe're having a training session later!

records.japanese: ナミ『はーあ\cあたしに　すてきな　かれしが　いたらなぁ\nすてきな　コンビネーションで\rどんな　あいてにでも　かっちゃうのに
records.english: RITA: Sigh...\cIf I had a nice boyfriend, we'd beat\nanyone with lovely combinations...

records.japanese: ナミ『あたしたちと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメよ
records.english: RITA: You're planning to battle us?\nNot unless you have more POKéMON.

records.japanese: コウ『まけたら　オレが　おこられるから\nむちゃくちゃ　ほんきで　がんばるぞ！
records.english: SAM: If we lose, I'll catch heck.\nI'm going to go totally all out!

records.japanese: コウ『うわぁ‥‥\nまた　ねえちゃんに　おこられる‥‥
records.english: SAM: Uh-oh...\nMy big sister will chew me out again.

records.japanese: コウ『オレの　ねえちゃん\nおこると　むちゃくちゃ　こわいんだ‥‥\cあとで　オレと　ポケモン\nもうとっくん　だよ‥‥
records.english: SAM: My big sister is really scary\nwhen she gets angry.\cShe's going to make me train really\nhard with POKéMON later...

records.japanese: コウ『オレらと　たたかう　つもり？\nポケモン　２ひき　つれてきなよ！
records.english: SAM: Did you want to battle us?\nBring some more POKéMON, then.

records.japanese: キミが　やってくる　おとが\nきこえて　いたから　まってたよ！
records.english: I heard you approaching, so I hung\naround for you!

records.japanese: まいりました‥‥！
くうきちゅう　よりも\nすいちゅうの　ほうが　おとの　つたわる\rスピードが　はやいんだよ！
records.english: Sound travels faster in water than\nit does through air.

records.japanese: おらーっ！！\nおれの　かわいい　ポケモンだー！！
records.english: Hey, there!\nCheck out my sweet POKéMON!

records.japanese: まいったぜ‥‥！
タッツーの　みりょくに　まいって\nおれも　およぐように　なったんだー！
records.english: I was blown away by HORSEA's charm,\nso I started swimming, too.

records.japanese: およぎ　つかれちゃった！\nわたしと　ひとしょうぶ　どう？
records.english: I'm tired of swimming.\nAre you up for a battle with me?

records.japanese: あんた　つよすぎ！
ふう　ふう‥‥\nトクサネシティは　どっち　だったっけ？
records.english: Whew...\nWhich way is it to MOSSDEEP CITY?

records.japanese: わたしの　そだてた　みずポケモンと\nたたかって　みない？
records.english: How would you like to take on the\nWATER-type POKéMON I raised?

records.japanese: まけた‥‥
あなたの　つよさは　ホンモノね！\nおどろいたわ！
records.english: Your power... You're the real deal.\nI'm amazed!

records.japanese: オレさまは　たくましい　ふなのり！\nせかいの　うみを　わたりあるく　おとこ！
records.english: Ahoy! I'm a buff, tough SAILOR!\nI've braved the world's seas!

records.japanese: ぐおおおーっ！\nかてねえ‥‥！
あさせのほらあな　は　じかんによって\nしおが　みちたり　ひいたり　するんだ！\cちなみに　みちしお　から　ひきしお　まで\nおよそ　６じかんだぞ！　しっていたか？
records.english: The tide ebbs and flows inside the\nSHOAL CAVE.\cBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Did you know?

records.japanese: おっと　ここで　あったが　１００ねんめ！\nとにかく　ポケモンしょうぶ　だっ！
records.english: It's high time I get my payback\nfrom you! Come on, we're battling!

records.japanese: かてねえ\nちっとも　かてねえよ！
records.english: I couldn't win!\nI flat out couldn't win!

records.japanese: あさせのほらあな‥‥\cしおの　みちひきに　よって\nいけたり　いけなかったり　する\rばしょが　あるんだよな\cちなみに　みちしお　から　ひきしお　まで\nおよそ　６じかんだぞ！　おぼえておけよ！
records.english: The SHOAL CAVE...\cThere are places you can and can't\nget to depending on the rise and fall\rof the tide.\cBy the way, it's about six hours from\nhigh tide to low tide. Don't forget!

records.japanese: マホ『あさせのほらあなに\nへんな　じいさんが　いるんだって！\rあなたも　あいにいく　とちゅう？
records.english: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE. Someone told me.\rAre you going to see him, too?

records.japanese: マホ『かてると　おもったのに
records.english: KIM: I thought we would win.

records.japanese: マホ『あさせのほらあなに\nへんな　じいさんが　いるんでしょ？\cさっ　ナホちゃん　あいに　いくよ！
records.english: KIM: A funny old man lives in the\nSHOAL CAVE, doesn't he?\cLet's go see him, IRIS!

records.japanese: マホ『ダメだって！\nポケモン　２ひき　いないと　ダメだって！
records.english: KIM: No, no, no! You need two POKéMON,\nor it's just no good!

records.japanese: ナホ『センパイ\nこんな　ところに　なにが　あるんですかぁ？
records.english: IRIS: KIM, can you tell me what we're\nlooking for out here?

records.japanese: ナホ『とちゅう　おしいところ　あったのに
records.english: IRIS: Oh, we came sort of close.

records.japanese: ナホ『センパイ‥‥　ほんとに\nあさせのほらあなに　はいりますぅ？\rぬれちゃいますよぉ？
records.english: IRIS: KIM, are we really going into\nthe SHOAL CAVE?\rWe'll get all wet.

records.japanese: ナホ『２たい１で　しょうぶ　なんて\nそんな　まね　あたしたちに　できないわ
records.english: IRIS: Oh, we could never, ever do\nanything like a 2-on-1 battle.

records.japanese: すいえいは　ぜんしん　うんどう！\nたいりょくが　つくぞー！
records.english: Swimming is a full-body workout!\nYou will get fit!

records.japanese: まけましたーっ！
まいにち　およいでる　おかげで\nみよ！　この　きんにくっ！！
records.english: Thanks to my daily swimming routine...\nLook! Feast your eyes on this physique!

records.japanese: この　しろく　そびえる　いわやまが\nルネシティ　なんだぜー！
records.english: This towering white mountain of rock\nis SOOTOPOLIS CITY.

records.japanese: やられたか！？
ルネシティの　いりぐちが　みつからん！\nどこに　あるんだ？
records.english: I can't find the entrance to\nSOOTOPOLIS. Where could it be?

records.japanese: おほほほっ\nわたしは　にんぎょ！
アワと　なって　きえていく‥‥\nぶくぶくぶく‥‥
records.english: My fantasy burst as if it were a bubble!\nBlub, blub, blub...

records.japanese: こっぴどく　やられちゃったわ‥‥\nアワくって　にげだしたい　きぶん‥‥
records.english: You thrashed me... I want to\ndisappear in a wave of despair...

records.japanese: ねえ　ねえ\nおねえさんと　しょうぶ　しない？
records.english: Hello, kiddo!\nWant a battle with me?

records.japanese: いやーんっ！
こうして　ポケモンと\nうみで　あそぶのが　だいすきなの！
records.english: I love frolicking with POKéMON in\nthe sea like this!

records.japanese: オレと　しょうぶ　したいって\nかおに　かいてあるぜ！
records.english: I can see it in your face. You want\nto challenge me.

records.japanese: あわわわわ‥‥
いい　しょうぶを　した　あとは\nすがすがしい　きもちに　なるなー
records.english: A well-played match leaves me feeling\nrefreshed and serene.

records.japanese: あいつには　まけたくない　って\nライバル　きみには　いるの？
records.english: Do you have a rival whom you just\nhate to lose against?

records.japanese: あぁ　すっごく　くやしい！
ライバルが　いると\nつよくなりたい　って　きもちが\rどんどん　あふれて　くるよね
records.english: If you have a rival, don't you get the\nfeeling that you have to keep getting\rbetter?

records.japanese: つりを　することで　てにいれた\nおだやかな　こころ‥‥\rそれを　みせて　あげましょう‥‥
records.english: Through fishing, I have attained a\nstate of becalmed serenity...\rPlease, allow me to demonstrate...

records.japanese: ‥‥　まけても\nこころは　おだやかです
records.english: Though I have lost, my heart remains\ncalm...

records.japanese: つれなくても　かまいません\nずっと　いとを　たらしているのです‥‥
records.english: It matters not that I catch nothing.\nThe line remains in the water...

records.japanese: おっと！？　なみのり　している\nポケモンを　つりあげて　しまったか？
records.english: Whoops! Don't tell me I snagged\na SURFING POKéMON?

records.japanese: かなわん！
きみの　ポケモン　つよそうだから\nつりあげたら　かなりの　てごたえ　だろうな！
records.english: Your POKéMON look pretty strong.\nThey'd be a handful if I hooked them!

records.japanese: よーし！\nポケモンずきと　つりずきの　たいけつだ！
records.english: Well, hey! This is a match between a\nPOKéMON fan and a fishing buff!

records.japanese: わあ！　いとが　からまった！\nまさに　あとの　まつり
records.english: No! My line's all tangled!\nThe party's over!

records.japanese: つりでは　いとが　からまることを\nマツリ　と　いうんだよ
records.english: My fishing line's doing a dance!\nThe tangle tango! Hahaha, snarl!

records.japanese: ムロの　ポケモンジムで　まなんだこと\nいま　ここで　ためす！！
records.english: What I learned at DEWFORD's POKéMON\nGYM, I will put into practice here.

records.japanese: あらなみに　もまれた！
ムロの　ジムリーダー　トウキは\nむかし　カントーで　シバという　おとこと\rいっしょに　とっくん　したらしいな
records.english: BRAWLY, DEWFORD's GYM LEADER, used\nto train with a guy named BRUNO in\rKANTO, I've heard.

records.japanese: とりポケモンは　すごく　めが　いい！\nおおぞら　たかくから　えものを　みつけるぜ！
records.english: BIRD POKéMON have excellent vision.\nThey spot prey from great heights.

records.japanese: ふぅ‥‥　まいったぜ
この　ちかくには　いっぱい\nもぐれそうな　ところが　あるな！\cそらから　みてると\nうみの　いろが　ちがうから　よくわかる！
records.english: There're lots of diving spots in the\nsea around here.\cYou can spot them easily from the sky\nbecause of their darker color.

records.japanese: サイユウシティは　まだ　とおい‥‥
records.english: EVER GRANDE CITY is still a long ways\naway...

records.japanese: ボクの　はつしょうりも　とおい‥‥
records.english: My first victory seems to be far\naway, too...

records.japanese: まけつづけている　じんせい　ですが\nけっして　あきらめませんよ‥‥！
records.english: My whole life has been about losing,\nbut I will never give up!

records.japanese: まだまだ　げんき　ですからね\nサイユウシティ　めざして　およぎますよ！
records.english: I'm still feeling good. I'll keep on\nswimming to EVER GRANDE CITY.

records.japanese: また　はつしょうり　ならず‥‥
records.english: I've yet to taste my first victory...

records.japanese: あきらめなきゃ　いつかは　かてる\nサイユウシティにも　たどりつく‥‥！
records.english: I'll eventually reach EVER GRANDE CITY\nwhere I can eventually win...

records.japanese: トライアスロンは\nすいえい　じてんしゃ　マラソン\c３つの　しゅもくを　つづけて　こなす\nかこくな　レースなの！
records.english: You have to swim, cycle, and then run\na marathon in a triathlon.\cIt's a grueling race that consists\nof three events.

records.japanese: ポケモンしょうぶも　かこく　よね‥‥
records.english: A POKéMON battle is grueling, too...

records.japanese: つぎは　じてんしゃ　だけど‥‥\nくじけそうだわ‥‥
records.english: I have to ride a BIKE next, but...\nI'm about to throw in the towel...

records.japanese: トライアスロンも　ながいけど\nポケモン　チャンピオンを　めざすのも\rながい　みちのり　なのね！
records.english: A triathlon is long. But I guess the\nroad to become the POKéMON CHAMPION\ris also a long and grueling one.

records.japanese: ほんとっ\nポケモンしょうぶ　って　きびしい‥‥
records.english: A POKéMON battle really is harsh\nand unforgiving...

records.japanese: そろそろ　チャンピオンロードに\nちょうせん　してみるのも　あり　かな？
records.english: You should give serious thought to\nchallenges on VICTORY ROAD.

records.japanese: ポケモンリーグに　ちょうせん　するため\nいままで　がんばって　きた‥‥\cここで　まけるわけには　いかないわ！
records.english: We've been working so hard to mount\na POKéMON LEAGUE challenge...\cWe can't afford to lose now!

records.japanese: ああっ！\nなんてこと
ここまで　きたんですもの\nいちど　まけたからって　あきらめない
records.english: After all I've done to get here, I won't\ngive up after one setback.

records.japanese: わたしの　ように　つよい\nポケモントレーナーは　ほかに　いない！
records.english: There is no stronger TRAINER than I!

records.japanese: なんて　ことだ‥‥！
きみの　ように　つよい\nポケモントレーナーは　ほかに　いないだろう！
records.english: There probably is no stronger TRAINER\nthan you!

records.japanese: サイユウに　いってみたいから\nたきのぼりを　おぼえた\rポケモンを　つりあげたんだよ！
records.english: I want to visit EVER GRANDE, so I\ncaught myself a POKéMON that knows\rthe move WATERFALL to crest the falls.

records.japanese: その　いきおい\nまさに　たきのぼり！
しまった！\cたきのぼりを　おぼえた　ポケモン　つっても\nルネの　ジムバッジ　もってない！
records.english: Awww, phooey!\cMy POKéMON know WATERFALL, but\nI don't have the SOOTOPOLIS GYM BADGE!

records.japanese: オレは　しょしんしゃ　トライアスリート\nはじめての　レースで　きんちょう！
records.english: This is my first triathlon.\nI'm all tense and nervous!

records.japanese: うおー！\nまけてしまったーっ！
きんちょう　していたら\nじつりょくが　だせないよな！
records.english: If I'm all tensed up, I won't be able to\ngive it my all.

records.japanese: トライアスロンの　とちゅう　だけど‥‥\nポケモンしょうぶを　しようよ！
records.english: I'm in the middle of a triathlon, but,\nsure, why don't we battle?

records.japanese: かてると　おもったのにーっ！
だいしぜんを　あいてに\nじぶんの　ちからを　ためす　ことも\rトライアスロンの　だいごみ！
records.english: Do you know what's the greatest thing\nabout triathlons?\cTesting the limits of your own\nstrength and endurance against\rMother Nature!

records.japanese: ホラホラ！\nとっとと　しょうぶ　しようぜ！
records.english: Say hey, hey!\nLet's get on with it!

records.japanese: まけた　まけたよ\nとっとと　おわろうぜ！
まけたら　なにも　ないさ\nとっとと　かえると　するか！
records.english: There's nothing for a loser.\nTime for me to beat it home.

records.japanese: のーんびり　のーんびり　やりましょうか？
records.english: What's the hurry?\nLet's take it slow and easy.

records.japanese: あらら\nもっと　のんびり　したかったなあ
records.english: Oh, my.\nI wanted to relax a little more...

records.japanese: あせって　ミスを　するのって　イヤでしょ？\nのんびり　やることに　してるのよ
records.english: Don't you hate making mistakes when\nyou're in a rush?\cThat's why I try to take things\nslowly.

records.japanese: うみの　ドまんなかで\nトレーナーに　であうとは　めずらしいな\rイッパツ　しょうぶ　するか！？
records.english: What a surprise! I didn't expect to\nsee a TRAINER out in the sea.\cI think we should battle!

records.japanese: なんて　つよい　こどもだ‥‥
きびしい　たたかいを　くぐりぬけてきた\nいい　めを　しているぜ！
records.english: Your eyes have that look of someone\nwho's experienced harsh challenges\rand won. It suits you well!

records.japanese: あおい　うみ\nブルーな　こころ\rいやされる‥‥
records.english: In the deep blue sea,\nmy shattered blue heart finds\rcomfort among waves.

records.japanese: うみ　ひろく\nポケモン　せかい\rまた　ひろし‥‥
records.english: Like the vast blue sea,\nthe world of POKéMON spans\rdepths beyond belief.

records.japanese: こどもたち\nポケモン　チャンプ\rめざしてる‥‥
records.english: The world's children dream\nof one day becoming the\rPOKéMON CHAMPION.

records.japanese: うみには　ポケモンが　たくさん　いるからね\nおよいで　わたるのも　くろう　するよ！
records.english: The sea is teeming with POKéMON.\nIt's not easy swimming, I tell you.

records.japanese: トレーナーの　そだてた　ポケモンは\nホントに　つよいなぁ‥‥
records.english: POKéMON raised by TRAINERS are\nseriously tough...

records.japanese: ひいひい‥‥　つかれた‥‥\nいきは　よいよい　かえりは　こわい‥‥\rかえりの　たいりょく　のこってるかなあ‥‥
records.english: Gasp... Gasp... I'm wiped out...\cThe going's easy. It's the leaving\nthat's the hard part.\cWill I have any energy left to make\nthe return trip?

records.japanese: うみ　うみ　うみ‥‥\nみわたす　かぎり　うみ‥‥\rうみは　もう　あきたぞーっ！
records.english: The sea... The sea... The sea...\nThe sea as far as these eyes can see!\rI'm sick and tired of the sea!

records.japanese: ひょえええええっ！
うみに　あきても\nおよぎ　つづけるしか　ないのか\cそんな　オレは\nねっからの　スイマー‥‥
