records.english: Bored I am by the sea, but swim I must.\cI'm a born swimmer!\nThat's what I am.

records.japanese: ちょっと　あんた\nわたしと　しょうぶ　しましょ！
records.english: Hi, sweetie, wait!\nWe should battle, you and I!

records.japanese: みかけに　よらず\nつよいわねーっ！
records.english: You're tough in spite of the way\nyou look!

records.japanese: あっちで　うみは　あきた　とか　いってる\nおとこが　いるでしょ？\cアレ　くちだけ　なのよ\nホントは　うみが　すきで　しょうがないの！
records.english: Did you see a guy over there who whines\nthat he's bored of the sea?\cThat's all talk.\nHe's hopelessly in love with the sea!

records.japanese: なんで　オトコって\nビキニが　すき　なのかしらね！\cみんな　わたしの　こと\nジロジロ　みるのよ！
records.english: Why do men love bathing suits so much?\cThey all ogle me!

records.japanese: じつりょくが　ちがい　すぎるわ‥‥！
みんな　ビキニを　みてるんじゃなくて\nわたしの　びぼうが　げんいん　かしら‥‥？
records.english: Maybe it's not my bathing suit that\nmakes men look. It must be my beauty!

records.japanese: アミ『きょうだい　ちからを　あわせて\nがんばっちゃおうかな！？
records.english: RELI: We'll work together as siblings\nto take you on!

records.japanese: アミ『きょうだいで　ちからを　あわせても\nかてなかったわ
records.english: RELI: We couldn't win even though we\nworked together...

records.japanese: アミ『キナギの　にんげんは\nうまれた　ときから\rうみと　ポケモンと　いっしょ　なんだ
records.english: RELI: The people of PACIFIDLOG are\ntogether with the sea and POKéMON from\rthe time they are born.

records.japanese: アミ『ポケモン　２ひき　いないの？\nポケモンしょうぶ　たのしめないわね
records.english: RELI: You don't have two POKéMON?\nWe can't enjoy a battle, then.

records.japanese: カツ『きょうだい　ちからを　あわせて\nがんばりまーす！！
records.english: IAN: I'm doing my best together with\nmy sis!

records.japanese: カツ『あねきと　がんばったのに\nかてなかったよ‥‥
records.english: IAN: I did my best with my sis, but\nwe still couldn't win...

records.japanese: カツ『キナギって　うみの　うえに\nうかんでる　まち　だろ？\cだから　うみが　つづくかぎり\nそこは　キナギ　なんだよ！
records.english: IAN: You know how PACIFIDLOG is\na floating town?\cSo, wherever there is the sea, that's\na part of PACIFIDLOG!

records.japanese: カツ『ポケモン　２ひき　いたら\nポケモンしょうぶ　してやるよ！
records.english: IAN: If you have two POKéMON, we'll\ntake you on!

records.japanese: ちいさい　ころは　よく　カゼを　ひいたけど\nすいえいを　はじめて　こんなに　じょうぶ！
records.english: I used to catch colds all the time as\na kid, but I became totally fit after\rI started swimming.

records.japanese: もっと　つよくなりたい‥‥！
ポケモン　トレーナーも\nのやまを　あるき　まわるから\rとっても　けんこうてき　だよねー！
records.english: TRAINERS travel the fields and\nmountains, so they must be fit, too.

records.japanese: ながれの　つよい　ところでは\nおよがないように　しているのよ
records.english: I try not to swim where the currents\nare too strong.

records.japanese: いやああああんっ！
ながされると　じぶんが　どこに　いるのか\nわからなく　なっちゃうの‥‥
records.english: If I get swept away, I'll lose all my\nsense of place...

records.japanese: かつか　まけるか\nやれば　わかることだろ！
records.english: Win or lose, you'll never know until\nyou try!

records.japanese: わーん\nまけて　しまった
かてると　わかる　しょうぶは　しない！\nかつか　まけるか\rその　ギリギリの　かんじが　いいんだ！
records.english: I never battle when I know I'll win.\nI like to battle at the razor's edge of\rvictory and defeat!

records.japanese: ２４じかん　ポケモンのこと　かんがえてる\nそんな　おれに　かてると　おもうか！？
records.english: I contemplate POKéMON 24 hours a day.\nHow could you possibly beat me?

records.japanese: まけた\nおまえさんには　まけたわ
くう‥‥\nおまえも　ポケモンばか　だな！\c２４じかん　ポケモンのこと　ばかり\nかんがえて　いるんだろ！
records.english: Urggh...\nYou're a POKéMON fanatic, aren't you?\cYou must contemplate POKéMON 24 hours\na day, don't you?

records.japanese: キミも　しおに　ながされて　きたの？\nこれも　なにかの　えんだね\rしょうぶ　しようよ！
records.english: Did the currents carry you here, too?\nThis must have been fated. Let's battle!

records.japanese: つよい！\nつよすぎっ！
キミみたいな　つよい　トレーナーが\nながされて　くるなんて‥‥\rオレも　ツキが　ないなぁ‥‥
records.english: It's just my luck that a tough TRAINER\nlike you would drift here...\rI must be cursed...

records.japanese: わたしは　かなしい　おんな‥‥\nながれ　ながれて　ここまで　きたの‥‥
records.english: I've led a life of woe and misery...\nI've been cast away, and this is where\rI've drifted...

records.japanese: まけたぁ‥‥
ながされる　だけの　じんせい　なんて‥‥\nもう　イヤっ！
records.english: A life adrift...\nI don't want it anymore!

records.japanese: いらっしゃーい！\nおまち　してましたわ！
いやーん！
つよい　こどもの　トレーナーなんて‥‥\nおねえさん　こまっちゃうぅ！
records.english: A strong child TRAINER...\nThat's so annoying!

records.japanese: かちたいから　って\nひとと　おなじように　そだては　しないぜ！
records.english: I want to win like everyone else, but I\nwon't raise POKéMON like everyone else.

records.japanese: くそー！\nおれの　やりかたは　まだまだ　あまい！
records.english: Darn it!\nMy way is still too slack!

records.japanese: ひとと　おなじこと　するより\nじぶんの　したいこと　したほうが\rたのしいに　きまってるだろ！
records.english: It's way more fun to do things the way\nI want than to be like everybody else.\rI mean, that's obvious!

records.japanese: とりポケモンと　いっしょに\nこんな　ところまで　きました
records.english: I came all the way out here with my\nBIRD POKéMON.

records.japanese: きみ‥‥\nなんて　かっこいいんだ！
そろそろ　ヒワマキに　かえりたいけど\nなんとなく　ここ　すきに　なっちゃったぞ！？
records.english: I'd like to go back to FORTREE, but I've\ngrown to like this place, too.

records.japanese: およぎの　とくいな　ポケモンだって\nながされる　しおの　ながれだ！
records.english: Even those POKéMON that can swim are\ncarried along by the rapid currents.

records.japanese: ひえーっ！
ポケモンたちは　この　ながれを\nたのしんでる　みたいだよ！
records.english: I think POKéMON enjoy the fast-running\ncurrents around these parts.

records.japanese: わたしの　ラブカスたちと\nたのしく　しょうぶ　しましょうよ！
records.english: My LUVDISC are looking for a fun\nmatch. Will you join us?

records.japanese: あらららららっ！
どこかの　マニアが\nラブカスの　ウロコを　あつめてるのよねー
records.english: There's a collector who's after the\nSCALES of LUVDISC.

records.japanese: よーしっ！　きゅうけい　おわり！\nポケモンしょうぶ　しようぜ！
records.english: Okeydokey! That's enough rest, gang!\nIt's time for a match!

records.japanese: また　バテた‥‥
オレの　とりポケモンたち‥‥\nながいあいだ　とぶと　すぐに　バテるんだ
records.english: My BIRD POKéMON get tired quickly after\na long flight...

records.japanese: ポケモントレーナーなら\nだまって　ポケモンしょうぶ！
records.english: You're a POKéMON TRAINER.\nNo need for words. We battle now.

records.japanese: じぶんから　しょうぶを　いどんでおいて\nまけるとは‥‥　はずかしすぎる‥‥
records.english: It was I who challenged you, and yet\nI lost. I am deeply shamed...

records.japanese: このあたりの　はげしい　しおの　ながれ！\nそれもまた　おれたちを　きたえてくれる！
records.english: The savage tide in this area serves to\nmake us stronger than ever.

records.japanese: すなおに　まけを　みとめよう
りゅうせいのたきで\nしゅぎょう　しなおすと　しよう！\cよければ　きみも　いってみたまえ\nきっと　いまより　つよくなる！
records.english: We will return for more training at\nMETEOR FALLS.\cIf you'd like, you should go, too.\nIt will definitely toughen you up!

records.japanese: スプレーのこうかが　きれた
サファリゾーンを\nこのまま　しゅうりょう　しますか？
records.english: Would you like to exit the SAFARI ZONE\nright now?

records.japanese: ピンポーン！　じかん　でーす！\nサファリゲームを　しゅうりょう　します
records.english: Ding-dong! Time's up!\nYour SAFARI Game is over.

records.japanese: サファリボールを　つかいきったので\nサファリゲームを　しゅうりょう　します
records.english: You've run out of SAFARI BALLS.\nYour SAFARI Game is over.

records.japanese: ポロックおきばに　ポロックを　おきますか？
records.english: Would you like to place a [POKEBLOCK]\non the [POKEBLOCK] FEEDER?

records.japanese: まだ　[STR_VAR_1]が　のこっています
records.english: The [STR_VAR_1] you left\nbefore is still here.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]を\nおきました！

サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\cここでは　ホウエンでは　なかなか
みることの　できない　ポケモンを\cしぜんの　すがたの　まま
めに　することが　できます\cまた　ポケモントレーナーの
ようぼうに　おこたえ　して\cポケモンを
つかまえる　ことも　できます！\cサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
records.english:
Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\cHere, you may witness many kinds of
POKéMON rarely seen in HOENN.\cAnd, you'll see them in their wild,
untamed state in natural habitats.\cWhat's more, we've thrown open the
gates to POKéMON TRAINERS.\cYou're encouraged to catch POKéMON
for keeps!\cCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

records.japanese: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\nサファリゾーンは　はじめて　ですか？
records.english: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\nIs it your first time here?

records.japanese: サファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
records.english: Come in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

records.japanese: サファリゾーンでは\n３０この　サファリボールを　つかって\rポケモンを　つかまえる　ことが　できます\cサファリボールを　つかいきるか\n５００ぽ　あるくと\cゲームは　しゅうりょう　です\cサファリゾーンを　たのしんで　いってね！
records.english: When you enter the SAFARI ZONE, you\nstart with 30 SAFARI BALLS for\rcatching POKéMON.\cThe SAFARI Game is over when you run\nout of SAFARI BALLS, or when you've\rwalked 500 steps.\cCome in and enjoy the SAFARI ZONE!

records.japanese: サファリゾーンへ　ようこそ！\c５００えんで　ポケモン　つかまえほうだい！\nサファリゲームに　さんか　しますか？
records.english: Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE!\cAll you can catch for just $500!\nWould you like to play a SAFARI Game?

records.japanese: そうですか\nこんど　ぜひ　さんか　してください！
おかねが　たりませんよ！
それでは　５００えん　いただきます
では　サファリボールを　どうぞ！
[PLAYER]は　サファリボールを\n３０こ　うけとった！
じかんに　なりましたら\nこちらから　おしらせ　しますので\cぞんぶんに　おたのしみ　ください！\nでは　いってらっしゃい！
records.english: We'll let you know when your game\nis over.\cSo, until then, enjoy yourself, please!\nOff you go on your wild excursion!

records.japanese: おきゃくさん！\nボックスが　いっぱい　ですよ！
records.english: Excuse me!\nYour PC BOX is full.

records.japanese:
あ！　おきゃくさん
ポロックケースを　おもちで　ないですね？\cサファリゾーンは　ポロックを　つかうと
より　おたのしみ　いただけますので\cぜひ　ポロックケースを
おもちに　なって　おこし　ください！
records.english: Excuse me!\nYou seem to be without a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.\cYour SAFARI Game will be much more\nfruitful if you use [POKEBLOCK]S.\cPlease come back with a [POKEBLOCK] CASE.

records.japanese: まだ　じかんが　のこっていますが\nサファリゾーンを　やめますか？
records.english: You still have time left. Would you like\nto exit the SAFARI ZONE now?

records.japanese: では　ひきつづき　おたのしみ　ください！
records.english: Please enjoy the rest of your wild\nadventure!

records.japanese: わかりました\cそれでは　のこりの　サファリボールを\nおあずかり　します\cおつかれさまでした\nまた　ごりよう　ください
records.english: Okay.\cI'll take back your remaining SAFARI\nBALLS.\cThank you for playing.\nWe hope to see you again.

records.japanese: それでは　いってらっしゃい！\rなにか　ありましたら\nわたしに　こえを　かけて　くださいね
records.english: Good luck!\cIf you need anything, don't hesitate\nto tell me, please!

records.japanese: しってた？\cあの　しかくい　はこに　ポロックを　おくと\nポケモンが　あつまって　くるんだよ！
records.english: Did you know?\cIf you put a [POKEBLOCK] in that square box,\nPOKéMON gather around.

records.japanese: この　さきに　いきたい　けど\nじてんしゃ　もって　くるの　わすれた‥‥\cおくに　めずらしい　ポケモンが\nいそうな　きが　するのに！
records.english: I want to keep going deeper, but I\nforgot to bring a BIKE.\cSomething tells me that rare POKéMON\nlive in the outlying areas.

records.japanese: ポケモンに　ポロックを　なげても\nしらんぷり　される　ときが　あるのよ\cポケモンにも　すききらいが　あるのかしら？
records.english: Sometimes, when I toss a [POKEBLOCK] at \nPOKéMON, it gets ignored.\cDo POKéMON have likes and dislikes\nabout what they eat?

records.japanese: ぜぇ‥‥　ぜぇ‥‥\nやっと　ここまで　きたけど‥‥\cつかれちゃって　ポケモン　つかまえる\nげんきも　のこって　ないよ‥‥
records.english: Gasp... Gasp...\nI...made it out here...but...\cI'm exhausted... I don't have the\nenergy to catch POKéMON...

records.japanese: ホウエンに　いない　みずポケモンを\nさがしに　きたんだけど‥‥\cみずうみは　どこにあるのか\nきみ　しってるかい？
records.english: I'm on a mission to find WATER POKéMON\nyou don't see in HOENN.\cDo you have any idea where the lake is?

records.japanese: ここで　めずらしい　ポケモンを\nたくさん　つかまえて\rともだちと　こうかん　するんだ！
records.english: I'm going to catch a lot of rare POKéMON\nhere and trade them with my friends!

records.japanese: ポロックおきばに　おいた　ポロックが\nいつのまにか　なくなっていた‥‥\cしらない　うちに\nポケモンが　たべちゃったのかな？
records.english: I put a [POKEBLOCK] on the [POKEBLOCK] FEEDER.\nBut it seems to have disappeared.\cI guess POKéMON must have eaten it\nwithout me noticing.

records.japanese: サファリゾーンの　おとくな　じょうほう！\cであった　ポケモンに\nポロックを　なげると　にげにくく　なります！
records.english: SAFARI ZONE TRAINER TIP!\cThrow [POKEBLOCK]S at wild POKéMON to make\nthem less likely to flee.

records.japanese: あるき　つかれたら　ちょっと　ひといき！\n「みんなの　きゅうけいじょ」
おれ　ポロック　もってないけど\nポケモン　たくさん　つかまえたよ\cちかづいて　ボールを　なげる　だけで\nけっこう　つかまえられる　もんだよ！
records.english: I don't have any [POKEBLOCK]S, but I caught\na good number of POKéMON.\cYou can improve your chances of making\na catch by getting closer to them\rbefore throwing a SAFARI BALL.

records.japanese: ポロックを　つかうと　いつもより\nちょっぴり　にげにくく　なるみたい\cだから　にげにくい　ポケモンに　つかっても\nあんまり　いみが　ないかもね
records.english: If you use [POKEBLOCK]S, wild POKéMON won't\nbe so quick to run away.\cIt's not much use to give [POKEBLOCK]S to\nPOKéMON that don't flee easily.

records.japanese: ポロックおきばに　ポロック　おいて\nポケモンを　つかまえると\cおなじ　ような　せいかくの　ポケモンが\nあつまる　きが　するなあ
records.english: If you put a [POKEBLOCK] on the FEEDER,\nPOKéMON are attracted to it.\cI think POKéMON with the same sort of\nnature are drawn by a certain [POKEBLOCK].

records.japanese: ここは　レート[STR_VAR_1]の　ルーレットだい　です\nルーレットで　あそびますか？
records.english: The minimum wager at this table is [STR_VAR_1]. \nDo you want to play?

records.japanese: コインが　たりません
ほんじつ　このだいでは\nレート　アップ　じっしちゅう！
ベットする　わくを　じゅうじボタンで　えらんで\nＡボタンで　けってい　します
records.english: Place your wager with the + Control Pad,\nthen press the A Button.

records.japanese: あたりー！
おおあたり！！
はずれー
おめでとう　ございます！\nコイン　[STR_VAR_1]まい　はいります！
コインが　なくなりました
つづけて　あそびますか？
だいの　うえの　たまを\nクリア　します
records.english: The ROULETTE board will be cleared.

records.japanese: コインケースを　もっていません！
records.english: You don't have a COIN CASE.

records.japanese: コインが　いっぱいです！\nけいひんと　こうかん　して　ください
records.english: Your COIN CASE is full!\nCoins can be exchanged for prizes.

records.japanese: わしは　おおきな　[STR_VAR_1]に\nとても　きょうみが　ある！\cん？　きみ　[STR_VAR_1]　もってるの？\nちょ　ちょ　ちょっと・・・\rおじさんに　みせて　おくれ！
records.english: I'm very interested in big [STR_VAR_1].\nThe bigger the better.\cHuh? Do you have a [STR_VAR_1]?\nP-p-please, show me!

records.japanese: おお！　こいつは　でかい！\nとても　すばらしい　[STR_VAR_1]だ！\cみせて　くれて　ありがとう\nおれいに　これを　もって　いきなさい
records.english: Oh, my gosh, this is a big one!\nThis is a grand [STR_VAR_1]!\cThanks for showing me.\nThis is my thanks!

records.japanese: [PLAYER]は\n[STR_VAR_2]を　もらった！
ありゃ？\nきみ　もちもの　いっぱいだね
ううむ　わしは　これより　おおきい\n[STR_VAR_1]を　みたこと　あるな・・・
records.english: Hmm... I've seen a bigger [STR_VAR_1]\nthan this one.

records.japanese: おお　こいつは　なかなか・・・って\nこれ　[STR_VAR_1]じゃ　ないよ！
records.english: Oh, now this is quite something...\nBut it's not a [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: おおきい　[STR_VAR_1]　もってないの？\rそれは　ざんねん・・・\nこんど　おおきい　[STR_VAR_1]　みせてね
records.english: You don't have a big [STR_VAR_1]?\nThat's too bad...\cIf you get a big [STR_VAR_1],\nplease come show me.

records.japanese: しじょう　さいだいの　[STR_VAR_1]！\n[STR_VAR_2]の　[STR_VAR_3]ｃｍのやつ！
オダマキ『おお　[PLAYER][KUN]！\cポケモンずかんの　ようすを\nみせて　くれるのかい？
records.english: PROF. BIRCH: Ah, [PLAYER][KUN]!\cHave you come to show me how your\nPOKéDEX is coming along?

records.japanese: うん？　みせるほど\nポケモンを　つかまえて　いないのか
records.english: Hm? Oh, you haven't caught enough\nPOKéMON to make it worthwhile.

records.japanese: ふむふむ‥‥\cみつけた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_1]\nつかまえた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_2]　か‥‥
records.english: Hmhm...\cSo, you've seen [STR_VAR_1] POKéMON,\nand you've caught [STR_VAR_2] POKéMON...

records.japanese: もっと　くさむらに　はいって\nポケモンを　さがしてみると　いいな！
records.english: You should go into grassy areas more\nand look for POKéMON more carefully.

records.japanese: ちょうしが　でてきた　みたいだね\nでも　これからが　たいへん　なんだぞ！
records.english: I guess you're getting the hang of it.\nBut, it gets harder from here.

records.japanese: きまった　ばしょでしか　みつからない\nポケモンは　しつこく　さがすしか　ないぞ！
records.english: Some POKéMON only appear in certain\nareas. You'll need to be persistent.

records.japanese: ボリュームは　まだまだ　だけど\nすこしは　ポケモンずかん　らしく　なったぞ
records.english: Well, it could use more quantity, but\nthis is looking more like a POKéDEX now.

records.japanese: なかなか　いい　かんじ　だな！\nこの　ちょうしで　がんばって　くれよ
records.english: This is coming along pretty good.\nKeep up the effort.

records.japanese: つりざおは　つかって　いるかな？\nうみにも　ポケモンは　たくさん　いるからな
records.english: Are you using any RODS?\nThere are many POKéMON in the sea.

records.japanese: ポケモンを　つかまえる　だけでなく\nしんか　させるのは　どうだい？
records.english: Instead of just catching POKéMON,\nhow about making them evolve, too?

records.japanese: すばらしい　ポケモンずかんに　なりそうだ\nそんな　よかんが　して　たまらないね！
records.english: This is going to be a fantastic POKéDEX.\nThat's the feeling I'm getting.

records.japanese: ここまで　あつめるとは‥‥\nきみの　さいのうは　たいした　ものだよ！
records.english: You've collected this many...\nYour talent is remarkable!

records.japanese: サファリゾーンには　いったかい？\nあそこでしか　つかまえられない\rポケモンも　いるって　はなし　だぞ！
records.english: Have you visited the SAFARI ZONE?\cI hear there are some POKéMON that\ncan only be caught there.

records.japanese: とうとう　１００しゅるい　こえたのか！\nポケモンずかん　として　みごとな　もんだね！
records.english: You've finally reached the 100-kind\nmark. This is an impressive POKéDEX!

records.japanese: ‥‥そういえば　いわくだきを　つかうことで\nみつかる　ポケモンも　いたっけ
records.english: There might be POKéMON that can be\nfound using ROCK SMASH.

records.japanese: ポケモンこうかん　すれば\nもっと　あつまるかも　しれないな
records.english: You should get some more POKéMON by\ntrading with others.

records.japanese: なんでも　なついていると\nしんか　する　ポケモンも　いるそうだよ！
records.english: I've heard of POKéMON that evolve when\nthey come to fully love their TRAINERS.

records.japanese: ホウエンちほう　には　こんなにも\nおおくの　ポケモンが　いたのか‥‥
records.english: I had no idea that there were so many\nPOKéMON species in the HOENN region.

records.japanese: ときどき　たいりょうはっせい　する\nポケモンが　いるらしい\rその　チャンスを　のがさないようにな！
records.english: On occasion, some POKéMON appear in\nlarge numbers like wild outbreaks.\rDon't miss opportunities like those.

records.japanese: きみの　ずかんを　みれば\nホウエンちほうの　ポケモンの\rすべてが　わかるようだ！
records.english: One can get a very good idea about the\nPOKéMON of the HOENN region by looking\rthrough your POKéDEX.

records.japanese: きみは　ポケモンはかせ　としても\nゆうしゅう　なんだな
records.english: I'd say you already qualify as a POKéMON\nPROFESSOR, and a good one, too!

records.japanese: ここまで　ずかんが　できたら\nもはや　プロフェッショナル　だぞ！
records.english: With a POKéDEX this complete, you're\na real professional at this!

records.japanese: いよいよ　かんせいに　ちかづいた！\nそんな　よかんが　してきたよ！
records.english: You're very close to completing this\nPOKéDEX. I can feel it in my bones!

records.japanese: おめでとう！！\nポケモンずかんの　かんせい　だよ！！
ふむふむ　ぜんこくてき　には‥‥\cみつけた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_1]\nつかまえた　ポケモン　[STR_VAR_2]　だね
records.english: Hmhm...\nOn a nationwide basis...\cYou've seen [STR_VAR_1] POKéMON,\nand you've caught [STR_VAR_2] POKéMON...

records.japanese:
こちらは　ポケモンくじ
ちゅうせん　コーナーです\cとうデパートに　おこし　いただいた　かたに
もれなく　ポケモンくじをひいて　いただいて　います！\cひいた　くじの　ナンバーと
おきゃくさまの　ポケモンの　ＩＤがあっていましたら　すてきな　しょうひんをプレゼント　いたします！\cポケモンくじを　ひかれますか？
records.english:
This is the POKéMON LOTTERY CORNER.\cAll shoppers visiting our DEPARTMENT
STORE get to draw a POKéMON LOTOTICKET.\cIf the LOTO TICKET's number matches
the ID number of any of your POKéMON,you will receive a fabulous gift.\cWould you like to draw a POKéMON
LOTO TICKET?

records.japanese: また　あした　いこう\nおこし　ください
それでは　また　おこし　ください
では　くじを　ひいて　ください\n‥‥‥
では　くじを　ひいて　ください\n‥[PAUSE 57]‥[PAUSE 57]‥[PAUSE 57]
くじの　ナンバーは　[STR_VAR_1]です！\cナンバーが　あなたの　ポケモンの　ＩＤと\nいっちしているか　おしらべ　いたしますので\rしょうしょう　おまちください
records.english: The LOTO TICKET number is [STR_VAR_1].\cI need to run a check on this number\nto see if it matches any of your\rPOKéMON's ID numbers. Please wait.

records.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\cあなたが　つれている\n[STR_VAR_1]ちゃんの　ＩＤが　みごとに\rくじの　ナンバーと　いっち　しました！
records.english: Congratulations!\cThe ID number of your team's\n[STR_VAR_1] matches your LOTO TICKET's\rnumber!

records.japanese: おめでとう　ございます！\cパソコンに　あずけている\n[STR_VAR_1]ちゃんの　ＩＤが　みごとに\rくじの　ナンバーと　いっち　しました！
records.english: Congratulations!\cThe ID number of your PC-boxed\n[STR_VAR_1] matches your LOTO TICKET's\rnumber!

records.japanese: ざんねんでした\nすべて　はずれの　ようです
records.english: I'm sorry.\nNone of the numbers matched.

records.japanese: ２ケタ　あって　いましたので\n３とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
records.english: Two digits matched, so you win the\nthird prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: ３ケタ　あって　いましたので\n２とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
records.english: Three digits matched, so you win the\nsecond prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: ４ケタ　あって　いましたので\n１とう　です！\r[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
records.english: Four digits matched, so you win the\nfirst prize!\rYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: なんと　５ケタ　すべて\nあって　いました！！\cとくとうです！！\n[STR_VAR_1]を　さしあげます！！
records.english: Oh, my goodness, all five digits matched!\cYou've won the jackpot prize!\nYou've won the [STR_VAR_1]!

records.japanese: ‥‥‥あら？\nどうぐが　いっぱいの　ようですね\cどうぐを　せいりしてから　もういちど\nおこし　ください
records.english: Oh?\nYou seem to have no room for this.\cPlease make room in your BAG and\nlet me know.

records.japanese: [PLAYER]さん　ですね\nおまちして　おりました！\cでは　しょうひんを\nおわたし　いたします
records.english: [PLAYER]?\nYes, I've been expecting you.\cThis is the prize we've been holding\nfor you.

records.japanese: それでは　また　おこし　ください
パパ『[PLAYER]！　よく　きたな！\n[PLAYER]あての　てがみが　とどけられたぞ
records.english: DAD: [PLAYER]! Good to see you!\nThere's a letter here for you, [PLAYER].

records.japanese: パパ『わたしも　みたことのない\nふねの　チケット　だな‥‥\rミナモに　いってみると　いいだろう
records.english: DAD: I guess this is a PASS for a ship.\nBut I've never seen this ship before.\cYou should find out what this is about\nin LILYCOVE.

records.japanese: カイナいき　れんらくせん‥‥\cあら？\nその　チケットは‥‥！
records.english: The ferry to SLATEPORT is...\cOh?\nThat PASS...

records.japanese:
ヘンテコな　チケットを
もってきたのは　おまえさんか？\cおまえが　いこうと　しているのは
みなみの　はての　ちっぽけな　しま‥‥\cそこでは　なにが　おこるのか
だれも　わからねえ‥‥ううむ　ふなのりの　ちが　さわぐぜ！\cさあ　のりな！
records.english:
Aye, mate, are you the one who brought
that mighty odd PASS?\cI'll tell you, you're trying to reach a
tiny spit of an island far in the south.\cThere's no telling what we'll encounter
once we reach there, aye.That shivers my timbers!\cAll aboard!

records.japanese: なにもねえ　ちんけな　しま　だな‥‥\nミナモへ　かえるか？
records.english: Aye, mate, there's nothing here to\nsee or do on this forgettable island.\cWhat say we sail back to LILYCOVE?

records.japanese: よし！　かえると　するか！
records.english: Aye, right, then!\nSail home we will!

records.japanese: そうかい\nまあ　すきにするが　いいさ
records.english: Aye, right, as you like, then.

records.japanese: すべての　ゆめは　もうひとつの　げんじつ\nそれを　わすれるべからず‥‥
records.english: “All dreams are but another reality.\nNever forget...”

records.japanese: きおく　かすみし　ものは\nこころに　きざみつける　ことを　のぞむ‥‥
records.english: “Those whose memories fade seek to\ncarve them in their hearts...”

パパ『やあ　[PLAYER]！\cめずらしい　きのみを　てに　いれたから\nプレゼント　するよ！
records.english: DAD: Hi, [PLAYER]!\cI just received a very rare BERRY.\nI'd like you to have it.

records.japanese: ふかふかの　つちに　はえている　きのみは\nじゆうに　とっても　よいのじゃが‥\c１つだけ　きのみを　おなじ　ばしょに　うめる\nそれが　れいぎと　いうものじゃ\cほれ　これを　わけてやろう
records.english: If you see BERRIES growing in loamy\nsoil, feel free to take them.\cBut make sure you plant a BERRY in the\nsame spot. That's common courtesy.\cHere, I'll share this with you.

records.japanese: あんた　みたところ　トレーナーじゃろ？\cトレーナーは　よく　きのみを　ポケモンに\nもたせとるわい\cふやすも　つかうも　あんた　しだいじゃ
records.english:
The way you look, you must be a
TRAINER, no?\cTRAINERS often make POKéMON hold
BERRIES.\cIt's up to you whether to grow BERRIES
or use them.

records.japanese: いつも　みずを　あげてたら\nたくさん　はなが　さいたんだ\cそしたら　きのみも　たくさん　できた！\cはい！\nこれ　あげる
records.english:
I watered my plants lots and lots!
A whole bunch of flowers bloomed!\cAnd then a whole bunch of BERRIES
appeared!\cHere you go!
You can have this!

records.japanese: がんばって　あかいポロック　つくるんだ！\n[STR_VAR_1]も　がんばってね！
records.english: I'm going to try really hard and make\nsome RED [POKEBLOCK]S!\cI hope you try hard, too!

records.japanese: きょうは　なにいろの　きのみを\nさがそっかなー
records.english: I wonder what color BERRIES I'll look\nfor today?

records.japanese: ポケモンコンテストの　ゆうしょうを　めざして\nきのみを　あつめているんだ\cよかったら　きみにも　わけて　あげるよ！
records.english: I'm gathering BERRIES so I can win a\nPOKéMON CONTEST.\cIf you'd like, I'll share one with you.

records.japanese: きみも　がんばれ！
きょうは　どの　きのみを　うめるか‥\nそして　なにいろの　ポロックを　つくるか‥\cなやむのも　また　たのしいよ
records.english: What BERRIES should I plant today?\nWhat color [POKEBLOCK]S should I make?\cFretting over stuff like that is fun\nin its own way.

records.japanese: ケースを　ふると　でてくる　ポロック‥\cそして　それを　キャッチして\nたべてくれる　ポケモン‥\cこれって　あい　だよね？
records.english: Give the case a shake, and out pops\na [POKEBLOCK]...\cAnd that [POKEBLOCK] is caught and eaten\nby a POKéMON...\cIt's an expression of love, isn't it?

records.japanese: うん　うん！\nやっぱ　わかるひとには　わかるよね\cこれ　あげる
records.english: Yes, yes.\nYou understand what I mean.\cYou should take this.

records.japanese: そっか‥‥\nでも　ちがうと　かんじることも　たいせつだね\cこれ　あげる
records.english: Oh... But it is important to make your\nown impressions, I guess...\cYou can have this.

records.japanese: その　きのみは　めずらしいもの　らしいから\nたいせつに　そだててね！
records.english: I think that BERRY is rare.\nI hope you raise it with loving care.

records.japanese: また　きのみめいじんに　もらって　こようっと
records.english: I'll get more BERRIES from the\nBERRY MASTER.

records.japanese: やっぱり\cわたしに　スーツが　にあうように\nうみには　しおかぜが　にあうな\rそして　きみには　きのみが　にあいそうだ‥‥\cなんでだろうね？
records.english: When it gets right down to it...\cThe same way suits suit me perfectly,\na crisp breeze suits the sea.\cAnd you, a BERRY suits you to a “T”...\cWhy should that be so?

records.japanese: やっぱり　それは‥‥‥‥\cきみが　トレーナーだからだ！
records.english: When it gets right down to it...\cIt's because you're a TRAINER!

records.japanese: やっぱり\cわたしに　シンプルさが　にあうように\nポケモンには　ポロックが　にあうな
records.english: When it gets right down to it...\cThe way dignified simplicity suits me,\n[POKEBLOCK]S perfectly suit POKéMON.

records.japanese: わしは　きのみめいじんと　よばれておる\cわしは　せかいじゅうを　うつくしい　はなで\nうめつくそうと　きのみを　そだてて\rそして　くばり　まくって　おるのじゃ\cきみにも　きのみを　わけて　あげよう！
records.english: You may call me the BERRY MASTER.\cI dream of filling the world with\nbeautiful flowers, so I raise BERRIES\rand hand them out to everyone.\cYou're deserving of one!

records.japanese: ほれ　えんりょ　せずに　もう　ひとつ！
カナズミの　ちかくにある　サン・トウカという\nフラワーショップも　よろしくの\cせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！
records.english: Be sure to visit the PRETTY PETAL\nflower shop near RUSTBORO.\cLet flowers fill the world!

records.japanese: きょうは　もう　おしまいじゃ\nまた　おいで\cせかいに　はなを　さかせましょう！
records.english: I'm done for today.\nCome again another day.\cLet flowers fill the world!

records.japanese: じいさんの　きのみの　そだてかたは\nそりゃあ　せかいいちじゃ\cわしも　はなが　たかいわい\cところで　あんた\nいい　ことばを　きいたことが　ないかい？
records.english: The way my husband grows BERRIES,\noh, he's the best in the world.\cHe makes me proud, that he does.\cIncidentally, child, have you heard\na good saying lately?

records.japanese: おお！　とても　よい　ことばじゃ！\nかんどう　したわい\cほれ　これを　もっていきなされ
records.english: Ah! What a remarkable saying!\nInspirational, it is!\cI want you to have this.

records.japanese: おお！　なかなか　よい　ことばじゃ\nあんたも　たいしたもんじゃ\cほれ　これを　もっていきなされ
records.english: Oh! A good saying it is.\nYou're quite remarkable.\cI want you to have this.

records.japanese: まごたち　４にんも　じいさんを　しのぐ\nおおものに　なるじゃろうて\cじんせい　たのしいことが　つきんのう！
records.english: Our four grandchildren should become\nmore accomplished than my husband.\cJoy never goes out of my life!

records.japanese: ほう‥‥
こんにちは！\cはなを　せかいに　ひろめる\nフラワーショップ　サン・トウカです！
records.english: Hello!\cThis is the PRETTY PETAL flower shop.\nSpreading flowers throughout the world!

records.japanese: [PLAYER][KUN]　きのみの　こと　しりたい？
records.english: [PLAYER][KUN], would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?

records.japanese: あなたの　なまえは‥‥\c[PLAYER][KUN]ね！\nとっても　いい　なまえだね！\r[PLAYER][KUN]　きのみのこと　しりたい？
records.english: Your name is?\c[PLAYER][KUN].\nThat's a nice name.\c[PLAYER][KUN], would you like to learn about\nBERRIES?

records.japanese:
きのみはね　くろい　ふかふかの　つちの
ところで　たまに　とれるのでね‥‥\cとったら　その１つを　また　うめるの！\cそうすると　その　きのみ　から
めがでて　みきが　できて　はながさいてまた　きのみ　が　できるの\cそうやって　はなを　ふやして
せかいじゅうを　はなに　するのがわたしの　ゆめ　なんだ！\cだから　[PLAYER][KUN]も　きのみを　うめて
せかいに　はなを　ふやしてね！
records.english:
BERRIES grow on trees that thrive
only in dark, loamy soil.\cIf you take some BERRIES, be sure to
plant one in the loamy soil again.\cA planted BERRY will soon sprout,
grow into a plant, flower beautifully,then grow BERRIES again.\cI want to see the whole wide world
filled with beautiful flowers.That's my dream.\cPlease help me, [PLAYER][KUN]. Plant BERRIES
and bring more flowers into the world.

records.japanese: おはなって　とっても　しあわせな　きぶんに\nしてくれるよね
records.english: Flowers bring so much happiness to\npeople, don't they?

records.japanese: こんにちは！\cおはなは　せわを　すれば　するほど\nたくさん　きれいに　さいて　くれるの\cあなたも　せわを　したく　なった　でしょ？\nこれ　あげるわ
records.english: Hello!\cThe more attention you give to flowers,\nthe more beautifully they bloom.\cYou'll like tending flowers. I'm sure\nof it. You can have this.

records.japanese:
きのみが　そだつ　たびに
じょうろで　みずを　あげてね！\cあとね\cきのみは　ずっと　ずっと　ほうっておくと
じめんに　おちてしまうのでもね　そこから　また　めがでて　くるの！\cすごいよね！
いきものの　ちからを　かんじるよね
records.english:
While BERRY plants are growing,
water them with the WAILMER PAIL.\cOh, another thing.\cIf you don't pick BERRIES for a while,
they'll drop off onto the ground.But they'll sprout again.\cIsn't that awesome?
It's like they have the will to live.

records.japanese: おねーちゃんたちを　みならって\nがんばって　おはなを　そだててるの\cはい！　これあげる！
records.english: I'm trying to be like my big sisters.\nI'm growing flowers, too!\cHere you go! It's for you!

records.japanese: きのみは　うめて　おおきく　したり\nポケモンに　もたせたり　できるの\cでも　さいきん　きのみを　いくつか　まぜると\nポケモンの　おかしになる　きかいが\rある　らしいんだ\cあたしも　おかし　ほしー
records.english: You can plant a BERRY and grow it big,\nor you can make a POKéMON hold it.\cBut now they have a machine that mixes\nup different BERRIES and makes candies\rfor POKéMON.\cI want some candy, too.

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]　なまえ　なんていうの？\c‥‥‥　‥‥‥　‥‥‥\nへー　いいねー\cわたしは　キリ　っていう　なまえなの\cパパと　ママが　すくすくと　そだって\nこころの　あたたかい　おんなのこに　なって\rほしいっていう　ねがいを　こめたんだって！\c[STR_VAR_1]にも　これ　あげる
records.english: Hi, what's your name?\c... ... ...  ... ... ...  ... ... ...\nOkay. That's nice!\cMy name is KIRI.\cMy mommy and daddy named me that so\nI would grow healthy and warmhearted.\rThat's what they wished.\cYou can have one of these.

records.japanese: あと　[STR_VAR_1]には　キリの　だいすきな\nこの　きのみも　あげちゃう！
records.english: KIRI will give you this BERRY, too!\nI really like it lots!

records.japanese: [STR_VAR_1]の　なまえには\nどんな　ねがいが　こめられてるの？
records.english: I wonder what kind of wish is included\nin your name.

records.japanese: はる　なつ　あき　ふゆ\nはるに　うまれると　はるが　すきで\rなつに　うまれると　なつが　すきなのかな？
records.english: Spring, summer, autumn, and winter.\cIf you're born in springtime, do you like\nthe spring, and if you're born in the\rsummer, do you like the summer?

records.japanese: じゃあ　キリは　あきに　うまれたから\nあきが　だいすき！\c[STR_VAR_1]は　いつが　すき？
records.english: Then KIRI was born in the autumn,\nso I love the autumn!\cWhich season do you like?

records.japanese: そっか‥\nかんけいないのか‥\cしりたいことって　たくさんあるなー
records.english: Oh...\nIt doesn't matter...\cThere's so much that I want to know...

records.japanese: このさきに　すすむのかね？\cもしで　よかったら\nあさせのしおと　あさせのかいがらを\rあつめてきて　くれないか\cざいりょうが　あつまったら\nわたしが　いいもの　つくるんだがね
records.english:
Are you planning on going deep in
there?\cHow about bringing me back some
SHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS?\cI can make you something good if
you bring me the ingredients.

records.japanese: あさせのしおと　あさせのかいがら\nそれぞれ　４つ　あれば\rかいがらのすずが　つくれるんだが‥‥\cかいがらのすずの　ざいりょう　なら\nまいにち　とれるよ
records.english: If you bring me four each of the\nSHOAL SALT and SHOAL SHELLS,\rI can make you a SHELL BELL...\cYou can get those ingredients\nevery day.

records.japanese: お！　あさせのしおと　あさせのかいがら！\nりょうも　じゅうぶんだ！\cこれで　かいがらのすず\nつくっても　いいかね？
records.english: Oh, hey! SHOAL SALT and SHOAL\nSHELLS! And enough of them, too!\cWould you like me to make you a\nSHELL BELL with them?

records.japanese: かいがらのすず\nさっそく　つくらせて　もらうよ\c‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\n‥‥　‥‥　‥‥　‥‥\cよし　できたっ！
records.english: All righty, then! I'll make you a\nSHELL BELL right away.\c... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\n... ... ... ... ... ... ... ...\cThere! Done!

records.japanese: ポケモンに　もたせてあげると　よろこぶよ\cなんたって　かいがらのすずの　ねいろは\nてんか　いっぴん　だからね\cかいがらのすずの　ざいりょう　なら\nまいにち　とれるから\rそろえば　また　つくらせて　もらうよ
records.english:
Have a POKéMON hold on to that.
It'll love it, that's for certain.\cWhy, the SHELL BELL's chime...
It's simply sublime!\cYou can get its ingredients every
day, so I can make you more.

records.japanese: そうかね‥‥\nかいがらのすず　つくりたかった‥‥
records.english: Oh... Is that so...\nI wanted to make a SHELL BELL...

records.japanese: あさせのしおを　とった　あと‥‥\nいまは　なにも　ない‥‥
records.english: There was some SHOAL SALT here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

records.japanese: あさせのかいがらを　みつけた　あと‥‥\nいまは　なにも　ない‥‥
records.english: There was a SHOAL SHELL here.\nBut, there's nothing here now.

records.japanese: つくっても　バッグが　いっぱいで\nもてない　ようだね‥‥\cせいりして　また　くると　いいよ
records.english: You don't have space in your BAG\nif I were to make it for you.\cYou should make room and come back\nfor a SHELL BELL.

records.japanese: ポケモンえほんが　そろってる！
records.english: There's a set of POKéMON picture books.

records.japanese: いろんな　ほんが　いっぱいだ！
records.english: It's filled with all sorts of books.

records.japanese: ポケモンざっしが　ならんでる！\c‥‥「ポケモンのとも」\n‥‥「ポケモン　てちょう」\r‥‥「かわいい　ポケモン」
たかそうな　つぼが　ある！\nのぞきこむと‥‥\cなかは　からっぽ　だ！
records.english: This vase looks expensive...\nPeered inside...\cBut, it was empty.

records.japanese: なかは　からっぽ　だ！
たくさんの　ポケモン　グッズが\nところせましと　ならべられてる！
records.english: The shelves brim with all sorts of\nPOKéMON merchandise.

records.japanese: なにかの　せっけいず‥‥？\nみても　チンプンカンプン！
records.english: A blueprint of some sort?\nIt's too complicated!

records.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！
records.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nポケモンの　せかいへ　ようこそ！

records.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nかんばん　です
records.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nかんばん　です

records.japanese: テストよう　メッセージです！\nざひょう　チェックの　イベントです
records.english: テストよう　メッセージです！\nざひょう　チェックの　イベントです

records.japanese: ここまでの　かつやくを\nポケモンレポートに　かきこみますか？
records.english: Would you like to save the game?

records.japanese: まえに　かかれた　レポートに\nうえから　かいても　いいですか？
records.english: There is already a saved file.\nIs it okay to overwrite it?

records.japanese: ポケモンレポートに　かきこんでいます\nでんげんを　きらないで　ください
[PLAYER]　は\nレポートに　しっかり　かきのこした！
セーブに　しっぱい　しました‥
べつの　ぼうけんの\nレポートが　かかれています！\cうえから　かいても　いいですか？
records.english: There is a different game file that is\nalready saved.\cIs it okay to overwrite it?

records.japanese: いやー　おまたせ　おまたせ！\cポケットモンスターの　せかいへ\nようこそ！\cわたしの　なまえは　オダマキ！\cでも　みんな　からは\n「ポケモンはかせ」と　よばれて　いるよ！\c
records.english: Hi! Sorry to keep you waiting!\cWelcome to the world of POKéMON!\cMy name is BIRCH.\cBut everyone calls me the POKéMON\nPROFESSOR.\c

records.japanese: ポケットモンスター\n‥‥すなわち　ポケモン\c
records.english: This is what we call a “POKéMON.”

records.japanese:
この　せかいには
ポケモンと　よばれる　いきもの　たちがいたるところに　すんでいる！\cわれわれ　にんげんは
ポケモンと　なかよく　あそんだりたすけあって　しごとを　したり\cときには　ちからを　あわせて
たたかったり　しながら\cいっしょに　くらして　いるんだ！\c‥‥しかし　われわれは　ポケモンの
すべてを　しっている　わけでは　ない\cポケモンの　ひみつは
まだまだ　いっぱい　ある！\cその　ひみつを　ときあかす　ため
わたしは　けんきゅうを　つづけているという　わけなんだ！\c
records.english:
This world is widely inhabited by
creatures known as POKéMON.\cWe humans live alongside POKéMON,
at times as friendly playmates, andat times as cooperative workmates.\cAnd sometimes, we band together
and battle others like us.\cBut despite our closeness, we don't
know everything about POKéMON.\cIn fact, there are many, many
secrets surrounding POKéMON.\cTo unravel POKéMON mysteries,
I've been undertaking research.That's what I do.\c

records.japanese: ところで　きみは‥‥？
おとこのこ？\nそれとも　おんなのこ？
records.english: Are you a boy?\nOr are you a girl?

records.japanese: なまえも　おしえて　くれるかい！
[PLAYER][KUN]　だね？
‥‥そうか！\cきみが　こんど　わたしの　すむ　まち\nミシロタウンに　ひっこして　くる\r[PLAYER][KUN]　だったのか！\c
records.english: Ah, okay!\cYou're [PLAYER][KUN] who's moving to my\nhometown of LITTLEROOT.\rI get it now!

records.japanese:
よーし　じゅんびは　いいかい？\cこれから　きみ　だけの　ものがたりが
はじまろうと　している！\cゆめと　ぼうけんと　であいに　みちた
ポケットモンスターの　せかいへゆうきを　もって　とびこんで　みてくれ！\cでは　また　あとで　あおう！
けんきゅうじょで　まって　いるぞ！\c
records.english:
All right, are you ready?\cYour very own adventure is about
to unfold.\cTake courage, and leap into the
world of POKéMON where dreams,adventure, and friendships await!\cWell, I'll be expecting you later.
Come see me in my POKéMON LAB.\c

records.english: This is a newly discovered POKéMON.\nIt is currently under investigation.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: No detailed information is available\nat this time.

records.japanese: ひなたで　ひるねを　する　すがたを　みかける。\nたいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびることで\nせなかの　タネが　おおきく　そだつのだ。
records.english: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in\nbright sunlight.\nThere is a seed on its back.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed\ngrows progressively larger.

records.japanese: つぼみを　ささえるため　あしこしが　つよくなる。\nひなたで　じっとする　じかんが　ながくなれば\nいよいよ　たいりんの　はなが　さくころだ。
records.english: There is a bud on this POKéMON's back.\nTo support its weight, IVYSAUR's legs\nand trunk grow thick and strong.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it starts spending more time lying\nin the sunlight, it's a sign that the\nbud will bloom into a large flower soon.

records.japanese: じゅうぶんな　えいようと　たいようの　ひかりが\nはなの　いろを　あざやかに　すると　いわれる。\nはなの　かおりは　ひとの　こころを　いやす。
records.english: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR's\nback. The flower is said to take on vivid\ncolors if it gets plenty of nutrition

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and sunlight. The flower's aroma\nsoothes the emotions of people.

records.japanese: しっぽの　ほのおは　きぶんを　ひょうげん。\nたのしい　ときには　ゆらゆら　ほのおが　ゆれて\nおこった　ときには　めらめら　さかんに　もえる。
records.english: The flame that burns at the tip of its\ntail is an indication of its emotions.\nThe flame wavers when CHARMANDER is

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes\nenraged, the flame burns fiercely.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメで　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nきょうてきと　むかいあうと　きぶんが　たかぶり\nしっぽの　ほのおが　あおじろく　もえあがる。
records.english: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its\nfoes using its sharp claws.\nIf it encounters a strong foe, it turns

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: aggressive. In this excited state, the\nflame at the tip of its tail flares with a\nbluish white color.

records.japanese: つよい　あいてを　もとめて　そらを　とびまわる。\nなんでも　とかして　しまう　こうねつの　ほのおを\nじぶんより　よわいものに　むけることは　しない。
records.english: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in\nsearch of powerful opponents.\nIt breathes fire of such great heat

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: that it melts anything. However, it\nnever turns its fiery breath on any\nopponent weaker than itself.

records.japanese: こうらの　やくめは　みを　まもる　だけではない。\nまるい　かたちと　ひょうめんの　みぞが　みずの\nていこうを　へらすので　はやく　およげるのだ。
records.english: SQUIRTLE's shell is not merely used\nfor protection.\nThe shell's rounded shape and the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: grooves on its surface help minimize\nresistance in water, enabling this\nPOKéMON to swim at high speeds.

records.japanese: ふさふさの　けで　おおわれた　おおきな　しっぽは\nながいき　するほど　ふかい　いろあいに　かわる。\nこうらの　キズは　つわものの　あかし。
records.english: Its tail is large and covered with a rich,\nthick fur. The tail becomes increasingly\ndeeper in color as WARTORTLE ages.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The scratches on its shell are evidence\nof this POKéMON's toughness as a\nbattler.

records.japanese: こうらの　ふんしゃこうの　ねらいは　せいかく。\nみずの　だんがんを　５０メートル　はなれた\nあきかんに　めいちゅうさせる　ことが　できるぞ。
records.english: BLASTOISE has water spouts that\nprotrude from its shell. The water\nspouts are very accurate.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: They can shoot bullets of water with\nenough accuracy to strike empty cans\nfrom a distance of over 160 feet.

records.japanese: からだ　よりも　おおきな　はっぱを　みるみる\nたべつくして　しまうほどの　しょくよくを　もつ。\nしょっかくから　きょうれつな　においを　だすぞ。
records.english: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite.\nIt can devour leaves bigger than its\nbody right before your eyes.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: From its antenna, this POKéMON releases\na terrifically strong odor.

records.japanese: からだの　カラは　てっぱんの　ように　かたい。\nあまり　うごかないのは　カラのなかで　やわらかい\nなかみが　しんかの　じゅんびを　しているからだ。
records.english: The shell covering this POKéMON's body\nis as hard as an iron slab.\nMETAPOD does not move very much.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It stays still because it is preparing\nits soft innards for evolution inside\nthe hard shell.

records.japanese: おいしい　はなの　ミツを　さがす　のうりょくに\nすぐれ　すみかから　１０キロはなれた　ばしょに\nさく　はなから　ミツを　あつめて　はこんでいる。
records.english: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to\nsearch for delicious honey from\nflowers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It can even search out, extract, and\ncarry honey from flowers that are\nblooming over six miles from its nest.

records.japanese: とても　するどい　きゅうかくを　もっている。\nこうぶつの　はっぱか　きらいな　はっぱか\nおおきな　あかい　はなで　かぎわける。
records.english: WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense\nof smell.\nIt is capable of distinguishing its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: favorite kinds of leaves from those it\ndislikes just by sniffing with its big\nred proboscis (nose).

records.japanese: ほとんど　うごかず　きに　つかまっているが\nなかでは　しんかの　じゅんびで　おおいそがし。\nその　しょうこに　からだが　あつくなっているぞ。
records.english: KAKUNA remains virtually immobile as it\nclings to a tree. However, on the\ninside, it is extremely busy as it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: prepares for its coming evolution.\nThis is evident from how hot the shell\nbecomes to the touch.

records.japanese: なわばりいしきが　とても　つよいので　スピアーの\nすみかには　ちかづかない　ほうが　みの　ためだ。\nおこると　しゅうだんで　おそって　くるぞ。
records.english: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.\nNo one should ever approach its nest -\nthis is for their own safety.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If angered, they will attack in a furious\nswarm.

records.japanese: ほうこう　かんかくに　とても　すぐれているので\nどんなに　はなれた　ばしょからでも　まよわずに\nじぶんの　す　まで　かえる　ことが　できる。
records.english: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense\nof direction.\nIt is capable of unerringly returning

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: home to its nest, however far it may be\nremoved from its familiar surroundings.

records.japanese: ひろい　なわばりを　とんで　みまわりを　する。\nなわばりを　あらす　あいては　ようしゃ　しない。\nするどい　ツメで　てっていてきに　こらしめるぞ。
records.english: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its\nown territory. This POKéMON flies\naround, patrolling its living space.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If its territory is violated, it shows\nno mercy in thoroughly punishing the\nfoe with its sharp claws.

records.japanese: うつくしい　こうたくの　はねを　もつ　ポケモン。\nあたまの　はねの　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nピジョットを　そだてる　トレーナーも　おおい。
records.english: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of\nbeautifully glossy feathers.\nMany TRAINERS are captivated by the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: striking beauty of the feathers on its\nhead, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT\nas their POKéMON.

records.japanese: けいかいしんが　とても　つよく　ねている　ときも\nみみを　うごかし　まわりの　おとを　きいている。\nどこにでも　すみつき　す　を　つくる。
records.english: RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.\nEven while it is asleep, it constantly\nlistens by moving its ears around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is not picky about where it lives -\nit will make its nest anywhere.

records.japanese: じょうぶな　キバは　どんどん　のびるので\nいわや　たいぼくを　かじって　けずっている。\nいえの　カベを　かじられる　ことも　あるよ。
records.english: RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.\nTo keep them ground down, it gnaws\non rocks and logs.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It may even chew on the walls of\nhouses.

records.japanese: おおきな　なきごえは　１キロ　さきまで　とどく。\nあちこちで　カンだかい　こえが　きこえる　ときは\nなかまたちに　きけんを　しらせている　あいずだ。
records.english: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can\nbe heard over half a mile away.\nIf its high, keening cry is heard

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: echoing all around, it is a sign that\nthey are warning each other of danger.

records.japanese: ながい　くびと　くちばしは　つちや　みずの\nなかに　いる　エサを　つかまえるのに　べんり。\nほそながい　くちばしで　きように　つまむぞ。
records.english: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck\nand elongated beak.\nThey are conveniently shaped for

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: catching prey in soil or water.\nIt deftly moves its long and skinny\nbeak to pluck prey.

records.japanese: ぐるぐる　からだを　まいて　やすんでいるのは\nどの　ほうこうから　てきが　おそってきても\nとっさに　あたまを　むけて　いかくできるからだ。
records.english: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while\nit rests.\nAssuming this position allows it to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: quickly respond to a threat from any\ndirection with a glare from its upraised\nhead.

records.japanese: しめつける　ちからは　とても　きょうりょく。\nドラムかんも　ぺしゃんこに　してしまうぞ。\nまきつかれたら　にげだす　ことは　ふかのうだ。
records.english: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in\norder to constrict things with its body.\nIt can even flatten steel oil drums.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once ARBOK wraps its body around its\nfoe, escaping its crunching embrace is\nimpossible.

records.japanese: はじめて　みる　ものには　でんげきを　あてる。\nくろこげの　きのみが　おちていたら　それは\nでんげきの　つよさを　まちがえた　しょうこだよ。
records.english: Whenever PIKACHU comes across\nsomething new, it blasts it with a jolt\nof electricity.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If you come across a blackened berry,\nit's evidence that this POKéMON\nmistook the intensity of its charge.

records.japanese: でんきぶくろに　でんきが　たまりすぎた　ときは\nしっぽを　じめんに　つけて　ほうでんする。\nす　の　ちかくには　じめんに　やけこげが　ある。
records.english: If the electrical sacks become\nexcessively charged, RAICHU plants its\ntail in the ground and discharges.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Scorched patches of ground will be\nfound near this POKéMON's nest.

records.japanese: すいぶんを　むだなく　きゅうしゅうする　からだの\nつくりなので　かんそうした　すなちでも　へいき。\nからだを　まるめて　てきの　こうげきを　ふせぐ。
records.english: SANDSHREW's body is configured to\nabsorb water without waste, enabling it\nto survive in an arid desert.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON curls up to protect itself\nfrom its enemies.

records.japanese: からだの　トゲは　ひふが　かたくなったもの。\n１ねんに　１かい　ふるい　トゲが　ぬけおちて\nあたらしい　トゲが　したから　はえてくる。
records.english: SANDSLASH's body is covered by tough\nspikes, which are hardened sections of\nits hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: out, to be replaced with new spikes that\ngrow out from beneath the old ones.

records.japanese: ちいさい　からだを　まもるため　きょうりょくな\nどくばりが　はったつしたと　かんがえられている。\nおこると　ツノの　さきから　もうどくを　だす。
records.english: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a\npowerful poison. They are thought to\nhave developed as protection for this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: small-bodied POKéMON.\nWhen enraged, it releases a horrible\ntoxin from its horn.

records.japanese: なかまや　かぞくと　いっしょの　ときは　おたがい\nきずつかないように　トゲが　ひっこんでいる。\nなかまから　はなれると　ふあんに　なるらしい。
records.english: When NIDORINA are with their friends or\nfamily, they keep their barbs tucked\naway to prevent hurting each other.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON appears to become\nnervous if separated from the others.

records.japanese: かたい　ウロコで　おおわれた　からだを　ぶつけて\nあいてを　はじきとばす　こうげきが　とくいだ。\nこどもを　まもる　ときが　いちばん　つよい。
records.english: NIDOQUEEN's body is encased in\nextremely hard scales. It is adept at\nsending foes flying with harsh tackles.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is at its strongest when\nit is defending its young.

records.japanese: みみを　うごかす　きんにくが　はったつしていて\nどんな　むきにも　じざいに　みみを　うごかせる。\nかすかな　ものおとも　ききもらさない　ポケモン。
records.english: The male NIDORAN has developed\nmuscles for moving its ears. Thanks to\nthem, the ears can be freely moved in

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: any direction. Even the slightest sound\ndoes not escape this POKéMON's notice.

records.japanese: ダイヤモンドよりも　かたい　ツノを　もつ。\nてきの　けはいを　かんじると　せなかの　トゲが\nいっせいに　さかだち　ぜんりょくで　たちむかう。
records.english: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than\na diamond. If it senses a hostile\npresence, all the barbs on its back

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: bristle up at once, and it challenges\nthe foe with all its might.

records.japanese: ふとい　しっぽの　ひとふりは　がんじょうな\nてっとうも　へしおる　すさまじい　はかいりょく。\nいちど　あばれだすと　てが　つけられない。
records.english: NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously\ndestructive power. With one swing, it\ncan topple a metal transmission tower.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage,\nthere is no stopping it.

records.japanese: まんげつの　よるは　げんき　いっぱいに　あそぶ。\nあけがた　つかれた　ピッピたちは　しずかな\nやまおくで　なかまたちと　よりそって　ねむる。
records.english: On every night of a full moon, groups of\nthis POKéMON come out to play.\nWhen dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: return to their quiet mountain retreats\nand go to sleep nestled up against each\nother.

records.japanese: つばさを　つかって　とぶように　スキップ。\nすいめんを　あるく　ことだって　できるのだ。\nしずかな　つきよに　みずうみを　あるく。
records.english: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if\nit were flying using its wings. Its\nbouncy step lets it even walk on water.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is known to take strolls on lakes on\nquiet, moonlit nights.

records.japanese: うまれた　ときは　しろい　１ぽんの　しっぽ。\nあいじょうを　たっぷり　うけると　しっぽは\n６ぽんに　わかれて　みごとな　まきげになる。
records.english: At the time of its birth, VULPIX has one\nwhite tail. The tail separates into six\nif this POKéMON receives plenty of love

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: from its TRAINER.\nThe six tails become magnificently\ncurled.

records.japanese: まっかな　ひとみは　あやしい　ひかりを　はなち\nあいての　こころを　じざいに　あやつる。\n１０００ねんかん　いきると　いわれている。
records.english: NINETALES casts a sinister light from\nits bright red eyes to gain total\ncontrol over its foe's mind.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is said to live for a\nthousand years.

records.japanese: こえの　はちょうを　じざいに　かえる　せいたいを\nもっているので　あいてが　いちばん　ねむくなる\nはちょうで　うたを　うたう　ことが　できる。
records.english: JIGGLYPUFF's vocal chords can freely\nadjust the wavelength of its voice.\nThis POKéMON uses this ability to sing

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: at precisely the right wavelength to\nmake its foes most drowsy.

records.japanese: おおきな　まるい　ひとみの　ひょうめんには\nなみだの　うすい　まくが　いつも　はっている。\nほこりが　ついても　すぐに　あらい　ながされる。
records.english: WIGGLYTUFF has large, saucerlike eyes.\nThe surfaces of its eyes are always\ncovered with a thin layer of tears.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If any dust gets in this POKéMON's\neyes, it is quickly washed away.

records.japanese: ひるま　くらやみで　じっと　しているのは\nたいようの　ひかりを　ながい　じかん　あびると\nぜんしんが　かるく　やけどしてしまうからだ。
records.english: ZUBAT remains quietly unmoving in a\ndark spot during the bright daylight\nhours. It does so because prolonged

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: exposure to the sun causes its body to\nbecome slightly burned.

records.japanese: いきものの　けつえきが　だいこうぶつ。\nとくに　まよなか　かつどうする　ことが　おおく\nいきちを　もとめて　よぞらを　とびまわる。
records.english: GOLBAT loves to drink the blood of\nliving things. It is particularly active\nin the pitch black of night.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON flits around in the night\nskies, seeking fresh blood.

records.japanese: ひるま　じめんの　なかに　からだを　うめて\nつちの　えいようを　ぜんしんで　すいあげている。\nこえた　つちほど　はっぱに　ツヤが　でるという。
records.english: During the daytime, ODDISH buries\nitself in soil to absorb nutrients from \nthe ground using its entire body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The more fertile the soil, the glossier\nits leaves become.

records.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　めしべの　はなつ　くさい\nにおいは　さらに　つよまるが　こころ　おだやかな\nときは　くさい　においを　ださないのだ。
records.english: GLOOM releases a foul fragrance from\nthe pistil of its flower. When faced\nwith danger, the stench worsens.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If this POKéMON is feeling calm and\nsecure, it does not release its usual\nstinky aroma.

records.japanese: どくかふんは　ひどい　アレルギーを　おこす。\nジャングルで　うつくしい　はなを　みつけても\nうかつに　ちかよらない　ほうが　いいよ。
records.english: VILEPLUME's toxic pollen triggers\natrocious allergy attacks. That's why\nit is advisable never to approach any

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: attractive flowers in a jungle, however\npretty they may be.

records.japanese: パラスから　ようぶんを　すいとって　おおきくなる\nキノコは　とうちゅうかそう　と　よばれている。\nちょうじゅの　くすりになる　きちょうな　キノコ。
records.english: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing\non its back called tochukaso. They grow\nlarge by drawing nutrients from this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: BUG/GRASS POKéMON host. They are\nhighly valued as a medicine for\nextending life.

records.japanese: パラセクトは　しゅうだんで　たいぼくの　ねもとに\nくっついて　えいようを　すいとってしまう。\nかれると　いっせいに　べつの　きに　いどうする。
records.english: PARASECT is known to infest large trees\nen masse and drain nutrients from the\nlower trunk and roots.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When an infested tree dies, they move\nonto another tree all at once.

records.japanese: みを　まもるために　ほそく　かたい　たいもうが\nぜんしんを　おおうように　なったと　いわれる。\nちいさな　えものも　みのがさない　めを　もつ。
records.english: VENONAT is said to have evolved with\na coat of thin, stiff hair that covers\nits entire body for protection.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It possesses large eyes that never fail\nto spot even miniscule prey.

records.japanese: やこうせいで　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。\nがいとうの　あかりに　さそわれ　あつまった\nちいさな　むしを　このんで　たべる。
records.english: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON\nthat only becomes active at night.\nIts favorite prey are small insects

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: that gather around streetlights,\nattracted by the light in the darkness.

records.japanese: ほとんどの　のうかは　ディグダを　そだてている。\nディグダが　あなを　ほった　とちは　ほどよく\nたがやされ　おいしい　やさいが　つくれるからだ。
records.english: DIGLETT are raised in most farms.\nThe reason is simple - wherever this\nPOKéMON burrows, the soil is left

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: perfectly tilled for planting crops.\nThis soil is made ideal for growing\ndelicious vegetables.

records.japanese: もともと　ひとつの　からだから　３つごに\nなったので　みんな　かんがえることは　おなじ。\nちからを　あわせ　どこまでも　ほりすすむ。
records.english: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that\nemerged from one body. As a result,\neach triplet thinks exactly like the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: other two triplets.\nThey work cooperatively to burrow\nendlessly.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメを　ひっこめて　ぬきあし　さしあし\nあしおとを　たてずに　あるくことが　できる。\nキラキラ　ひかる　コインが　なぜか　だいすきだ。
records.english: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into\nits paws to slinkily sneak about without\nmaking any incriminating footsteps.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: For some reason, this POKéMON loves\nshiny coins that glitter with light.

records.japanese: たくましい　６ぽんの　ヒゲは　くうきの　うごきで\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチする　やくわり。\nヒゲを　つかまれると　おとなしくなって　しまう。
records.english: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give\nit a look of toughness. The whiskers  \nsense air movements to determine what

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: is in the POKéMON's surrounding\nvicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed\nby the whiskers.

records.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからを　はっきしている　コダックから\nねむっている　ときにだけ　でるはずの　のうはが\nかんそくされて　がっかいの　わだいに　なった。
records.english: PSYDUCK uses a mysterious power.\nWhen it does so, this POKéMON \ngenerates brain waves that are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: supposedly only seen in sleepers.\nThis discovery spurred controversy\namong scholars.

records.japanese: てあしの　みずかきと　りゅうせんけいの　からだが\nすいちゅうで　おそるべき　スピードを　うみだす。\nきんメダリスト　よりも　だんぜん　はやいぞ。
records.english: The webbed flippers on its forelegs and\nhind legs and the streamlined body of\nGOLDUCK give it frightening speed.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is definitely much faster\nthan even the most athletic swimmer.

records.japanese: からだが　ふるえ　はないきが　あらくなれば\nおこりだす　まえぶれ　なのだが　あっというまに\nはげしく　おこるので　にげだす　ひまは　ない。
records.english: When MANKEY starts shaking and its\nnasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure\nsign that it is becoming angry.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because it goes into a\ntowering rage almost instantly, it is\nimpossible for anyone to flee its wrath.

records.japanese: はげしく　おこる　ことで　けっこうが　よくなり\nきんにくの　ちからを　つよくするのだ。\nただし　あたまの　かいてんは　おそくなるぞ。
records.english: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its\nblood circulation is boosted. In turn,\nits muscles are made even stronger.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, it also becomes much less\nintelligent at the same time.

records.japanese: きゅうかくに　すぐれ　いちど　かいだ　においは\nなにが　あっても　ぜったいに　わすれない。\nあいての　きもちを　においで　さっちする。
records.english: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell.\nOnce it smells anything, this POKéMON\nwon't forget the scent, no matter what.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It uses its advanced olfactory sense\nto determine the emotions of other\nliving things.

records.japanese: １００００キロの　きょりを　いっちゅうやで\nはしると　いわれている　かいそくの　ポケモン。\nたいないで　もえさかる　ほのおが　パワーとなる。
records.english: ARCANINE is known for its high speed.\nIt is said to be capable of running over\n6,200 miles in a single day and night.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The fire that blazes wildly within this\nPOKéMON's body is its source of power.

records.japanese: うずまき　もようの　ないぞうが　すけてしまうほど\nうすい　ひふだが　するどい　キバを　はねかえす\nだんりょくを　もっているのだ。
records.english: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is\npossible to see the POKéMON's spiral\ninnards right through the skin.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Despite its thinness, however, the skin\nis also very flexible. Even sharp fangs\nbounce right off it.

records.japanese: いつも　からだの　ひょうめんが　えきたいで\nぬるぬる　ぬれているため　てきに　つかまっても\nぬるりと　すりぬけ　にげる　ことが　できるぞ。
records.english: The surface of POLIWHIRL's body is\nalways wet and slick with an oily fluid.\nBecause of this greasy covering, it can

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: easily slip and slide out of the clutches\nof any enemy in battle.

records.japanese: はったつした　きょうじんな　きんにくは　どんなに\nうんどうしても　つかれる　ことは　ない。\nたいへいようも　かるく　おうだん　できるほどだ。
records.english: POLIWRATH's highly developed, brawny\nmuscles never grow fatigued, however\nmuch it exercises.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON\ncan swim back and forth across the\nPacific Ocean without effort.

records.japanese: １にち　１８じかん　ねむっている　ポケモン。\nねむったままでも　てきの　けはいを　さっちすると\nテレポートして　にげる　ことが　できるぞ。
records.english: ABRA sleeps for eighteen hours a day.\nHowever, it can sense the presence of\nfoes even while it is sleeping.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In such a situation, this POKéMON\nimmediately teleports to safety.

records.japanese: ずつうを　おこす　とくしゅな　アルファはを\nだすので　つよい　せいしんりょくの　もちぬしじゃ\nないと　ユンゲラーの　トレーナーには　なれない。
records.english: KADABRA emits a peculiar alpha wave\nif it develops a headache. Only those\npeople with a particularly strong

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: psyche can hope to become a TRAINER\nof this POKéMON.

records.japanese: のうが　どんどん　おおきくなったので　くびでは\nささえきれないほど　あたまが　おもくなった。\nちょうのうりょくで　あたまを　ささえているのだ。
records.english: ALAKAZAM's brain continually grows,\nmaking its head far too heavy to\nsupport with its neck.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON holds its head up using\nits psychokinetic power instead.

records.japanese: どんなに　うんどうを　しても　いたくならない\nとくべつな　きんにくを　もつ　ポケモン。\nおとな　１００にんを　なげとばす　パワー。
records.english: MACHOP's muscles are special - they\nnever get sore no matter how much they\nare used in exercise.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has sufficient power to\nhurl a hundred adult humans.

records.japanese: きたえあげた　きんにくは　はがねの　かたさ。\nすもうとりの　からだも　ゆび　１ぽんで　らくらく\nもちあげてしまう　かいりきの　ポケモンだ。
records.english: MACHOKE's thoroughly toned muscles\npossess the hardness of steel.\nThis POKéMON has so much strength,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it can easily hold aloft a sumo wrestler\non just one finger.

records.japanese: なんでも　なげとばす　パワーを　もつが　こまかい\nさぎょうを　すると　うでが　からまってしまう。\nかんがえる　よりも　さきに　からだが　うごく。
records.english: MACHAMP has the power to hurl anything\naside. However, trying to do any work\nrequiring care and dexterity causes

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its arms to get tangled.\nThis POKéMON tends to leap into action\nbefore it thinks.

records.japanese: ほそく　しなやかな　からだは　どんな　つよい\nこうげきでも　しなって　よける　ことが　できる。\nくちから　てつも　とかしてしまう　えきを　だす。
records.english: BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body\nlets it bend and sway to avoid any\nattack, however strong it may be.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a\ncorrosive fluid that melts even iron.

records.japanese: よるに　なると　おしりの　フックを　きの　えだに\nひっかけて　ぶらさがり　ねむりに　つく。\nねぞうが　わるいと　あさ　おっこちているよ。
records.english: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear\nend. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to\na tree branch and goes to sleep.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it moves around in its sleep, it may\nwake up to find itself on the ground.

records.japanese: あたまに　ついている　ながい　つるを　ちいさな\nいきものに　みえる　うごきで　えものを　さそい\nちかづいてきた　ところを　ぱくりと　ひとのみ。
records.english: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that\nextends from its head. This vine is\nwaved and flicked about as if it were

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: an animal to attract prey. When an\nunsuspecting prey draws near, this\nPOKéMON swallows it whole.

records.japanese: からだの　ほとんどが　みずで　できているので\nうみから　でると　からからに　ひからびてしまう。\nひからびた　ときは　うみに　もどしてあげよう。
records.english: TENTACOOL's body is largely composed\nof water. If it is removed from the\nsea, it dries up like parchment.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If this POKéMON happens to become\ndehydrated, put it back into the sea.

records.japanese: あたまの　あかい　たまが　ひかるとき　はげしい\nちょうおんぱが　あたりに　はっしゃ　される。\nそのとき　かいめんが　はげしく　なみうつという。
records.english: TENTACRUEL has large red orbs on its\nhead. The orbs glow before lashing the\nvicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's outburst creates rough\nwaves around it.

records.japanese: ながいきの　イシツブテほど　からだの　かどは\nけずれ　まるくなっていくが　きもちは　いつまでも\nごつごつ　とがって　あらあらしいのだ。
records.english: The longer a GEODUDE lives, the more\nits edges are chipped and worn away,\nmaking it more rounded in appearance.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON's heart will\nremain hard, craggy, and rough always.

records.japanese: いわを　たべて　せいちょうする　ポケモンだ。\nコケの　ついた　いわの　ほうが　すき　らしい。\n１にちに　１トンの　いわを　たべてしまうぞ。
records.english: GRAVELER grows by feeding on rocks.\nApparently, it prefers to eat rocks\nthat are covered in moss.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON eats its way through\na ton of rocks on a daily basis.

records.japanese: おおきな　じしんが　おこると　やまに　すんでいる\nゴローニャが　なんびきも　ふもとまで　ごろごろ\nころがり　おちてくる　ことが　あるよ。
records.english: GOLEM live up on mountains.\nIf there is a large earthquake, these\nPOKéMON will come rolling down off

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the mountains en masse to the\nfoothills below.

records.japanese: うまれて　すぐは　たちあがるのも　やっとだが\nころびながら　おやの　あとを　おいかけている\nうちに　じょうぶな　あしこしに　そだつのだ。
records.english: PONYTA is very weak at birth.\nIt can barely stand up.\nThis POKéMON becomes stronger by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: stumbling and falling to keep up with\nits parent.

records.japanese: いつもは　のんびり　のはらを　かけまわっているが\nひとたび　ほんきを　だすと　たてがみの　ほのおが\nもえあがり　じそく２４０キロで　はしりだす。
records.english: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually\ncantering in the fields and plains.\nHowever, when this POKéMON turns

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze\nas it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

records.japanese: しっぽを　かわに　いれて　エサを　つっているが\nそのうち　なにを　しているのか　わすれてしまい\nかわべりに　ねそべったまま　１にちを　おえる。
records.english: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by\ndipping it in water at the side of a\nriver.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON often forgets\nwhat it's doing and often spends entire\ndays just loafing at water's edge.

records.japanese: シェルダーが　かみついて　いるので　しっぽで\nエサを　つれなくなった　ヤドランは　しぶしぶ\nすいちゅうを　およいで　エサを　つかまえている。
records.english: SLOWBRO's tail has a SHELLDER firmly\nattached with a bite. As a result, the\ntail can't be used for fishing anymore.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim\nand catch prey instead.

records.japanese: でんせんに　くっついて　でんきを　たべている。\nていでんに　なったら　ブレーカーを　しらべよう。\nコイルが　びっしり　くっついて　いるかも。
records.english: MAGNEMITE attaches itself to power\nlines to feed on electricity.\nIf your house has a power outage,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: check your circuit breakers. You may\nfind a large number of this POKéMON\nclinging to the breaker box.

records.japanese: つよい　じりょくで　きかいを　こわしてしまうので\nおおきな　まちでは　サイレンを　ならして\nレアコイルの　たいりょう　はっせいを　しらせる。
records.english: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic\nforce that is fatal to mechanical\ndevices. As a result, large cities sound

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: sirens to warn citizens of large-scale\noutbreaks of this POKéMON.

records.japanese: もっている　しょくぶつの　クキにも　よいものと\nそうでない　ものが　あるらしく　カモネギどうしが\nクキを　めぐって　たたかう　ことが　ある。
records.english: FARFETCH'D is always seen with a stick\nfrom a plant of some sort. Apparently,\nthere are good sticks and bad sticks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has been known to fight\nwith others over sticks.

records.japanese: ２つの　あたまが　どうじに　ねむることは　ない。\nねている　とき　てきから　おそわれない　ように\nかわりばんこで　みはりを　しているからだ。
records.english: DODUO's two heads never sleep at the\nsame time.\nIts two heads take turns sleeping,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: so one head can always keep watch for\nenemies while the other one sleeps.

records.japanese: ３つの　あたまが　べつべつの　ほうこうを\nむいている　ときは　けいかいしている　しょうこ。\nうかつに　ちかよると　くちばしで　つつかれるぞ。
records.english: Watch out if DODRIO's three heads are\nlooking in three separate directions.\nIt's a sure sign that it is on its guard.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Don't go near this POKéMON if it's being\nwary - it may decide to peck you.

records.japanese: こおりに　おおわれた　うみで　エサを　とる。\nいきつぎを　するときは　あたまの　でっぱりで\nこおりを　わって　うみから　かおを　だす。
records.english: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea\nunderneath sheets of ice.\nWhen it needs to breathe, it punches

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: a hole through the ice with the\nsharply protruding section of its head.

records.japanese: つめたい　こおりの　うえで　ねるのが　だいすき。\nむかし　ひょうざんで　ねむる　すがたを　みた\nふなのりが　にんぎょと　まちがえた。
records.english: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly\ncold ice.\nThe sight of this POKéMON sleeping on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: a glacier was mistakenly thought to be\na mermaid by a mariner long ago.

records.japanese: ドロドロ　ブヨブヨした　からだは　どんなに\nほそい　すきまにも　はいりこむことが　できる。\nげすいかんに　もぐって　きたない　みずを　のむ。
records.english: GRIMER's sludgy and rubbery body can\nbe forced through any opening, however\nsmall it may be.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON enters sewer pipes to\ndrink filthy wastewater.

records.japanese: からだから　しみだしている　たいえきは　はなが\nまがるほど　きょうれつな　においを　はなつ。\n１てきで　プールのみずが　にごり　においだす。
records.english: From MUK's body seeps a foul fluid that\ngives off a nose-bendingly horrible\nstench.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Just one drop of this POKéMON's body\nfluid can turn a pool stagnant and\nrancid.

records.japanese: よるに　なると　おおきな　ベロで　かいていの\nすなに　あなを　ほり　そのなかで　ねむる。\nカラを　とじて　ねむるが　ベロは　だしたまま。
records.english: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad\ntongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor\nsand and then sleep in it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its\nshell, but leaves its tongue hanging\nout.

records.japanese: のみこんだ　かいすいを　うしろへ　いきおい　よく\nふんしゃする　ことで　うみの　なかを　およぐ。\nトゲを　はっしゃする　しくみも　おなじ。
records.english: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the\nsea. It does so by swallowing water,\nthen jetting it out toward the rear.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shoots spikes from its\nshell using the same system.

records.japanese: きょうふうを　うけると　ガスじょうの　からだは\nみるみる　ふきとばされ　ちいさくなって　しまう。\nかぜを　さけた　ゴースが　のきしたに　あつまる。
records.english: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous\nmatter. When exposed to a strong wind,\nthe gaseous body quickly dwindles away.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Groups of this POKéMON cluster under\nthe eaves of houses to escape the\nravages of wind.

records.japanese: やみに　うかぶ　ゴーストが　てまねきしても\nぜったいに　ちかよっては　いけないよ。\nペロリと　なめられ　いのちを　すわれてしまうぞ。
records.english: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON.\nIf one beckons you while floating in\ndarkness, you must never approach it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON will try to lick you with its\ntongue and steal your life away.

records.japanese: まよなか　がいとうの　あかりで　できた　かげが\nじぶんを　おいこして　いくのは　ゲンガーが\nかげに　なりすまして　はしって　いくからだ。
records.english: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow\nthrown by a streetlight will suddenly\nand startlingly overtake you.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is actually a GENGAR running past\nyou, pretending to be your shadow.

records.japanese: のうみそに　じしゃくが　あるので　つちの　なかを\nほり　すすんでいても　ほうこうを　まちがえない。\nとしを　とるほど　からだは　まるみを　おびる。
records.english: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts\nas a compass so that this POKéMON does\nnot lose direction while it is tunneling.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As it grows older, its body becomes\nincreasingly rounder and smoother.

records.japanese: ねむっているとき　キミの　はなが　ムズムズしたら\nまくらもとに　たった　スリープが　はなの\nあなから　ゆめを　たべようとしている　あいず。
records.english: If your nose becomes itchy while you\nare sleeping, it's a sure sign that one\nof these POKéMON is standing above

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: your pillow and trying to eat your dream\nthrough your nostrils.

records.japanese: てに　もっている　ふりこの　うごきと　かがやきが\nあいてを　ふかい　さいみんじょうたいに　おとす。\nえものを　さがしながら　ふりこを　みがいている。
records.english: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand.\nThe arcing movement and glitter of the\npendulum lull the foe into a deep state

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of hypnosis.\nWhile this POKéMON searches for prey,\nit polishes the pendulum.

records.japanese: すなはまに　あなを　ほり　そこで　くらしている。\nエサの　すくない　すなはまでは　ばしょとりをする\nクラブたちの　あらそいを　みる　ことが　できる。
records.english: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside\nholes dug into the sand.\nOn sandy beaches with little in the way

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of food, these POKéMON can be seen\nsquabbling with each other over\nterritory.

records.japanese: キングラーは　きょだいな　ハサミを　ふって\nなかまどうしで　あいずを　おくりあっているが\nハサミが　おもすぎて　すぐに　つかれてしまう。
records.english: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized\nclaw. It waves this huge claw in the\nair to communicate with others.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because the claw is so heavy,\nthe POKéMON quickly tires.

records.japanese: モンスターボールを　つくっている　かいしゃで\nはじめて　はっけんされた　ことと　すがたかたちが\nにている　ことの　かんけいは　まだ　ナゾである。
records.english: VOLTORB was first sighted at a company\nthat manufactures POKé BALLS.\nThe link between that sighting and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the fact that this POKéMON looks very\nsimilar to a POKé BALL remains a\nmystery.

records.japanese: くうきちゅうの　でんきエネルギーを　たべる。\nカミナリの　おちる　ひは　でんきを　たべすぎた\nマルマインが　あちらこちらで　だいばくはつする。
records.english: ELECTRODE eats electricity in the\natmosphere. On days when lightning\nstrikes, you can see this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: exploding all over the place from\neating too much electricity.

records.japanese: なかまおもいの　６この　たまごは　おたがいに\nひきつけあい　くるくる　かいてんしている。\nカラの　ヒビが　ふえると　しんかは　まぢかだ。
records.english: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that\nform a closely knit cluster. The six eggs\nattract each other and spin around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When cracks increasingly appear on the\neggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.

records.japanese: なんごく　うまれの　ナッシーの　あたまは　つよい\nひざしを　いっぱい　あびて　どんどん　そだち\nじめんに　おちると　タマタマに　なると　いう。
records.english: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the\ntropics. Its heads steadily grow larger\nfrom exposure to strong sunlight.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is said that when the heads fall off,\nthey group together to form EXEGGCUTE.

records.japanese: ２どと　あえない　ははおやの　おもかげを\nまんげつに　みつけて　なきごえを　あげる。\nかぶっている　ホネの　しみは　なみだの　あと。
records.english: CUBONE pines for the mother it will\nnever see again. Seeing a likeness of\nits mother in the full moon, it cries.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The stains on the skull the POKéMON\nwears are made by the tears it sheds.

records.japanese: ははおやに　あえない　かなしみを　のりこえた\nカラカラが　たくましく　しんかした　すがた。\nきたえられた　こころは　かんたんに　くじけない。
records.english: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE\nthat has overcome its sadness at the\nloss of its mother and grown tough.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's tempered and hardened\nspirit is not easily broken.

records.japanese: じざいに　のびちぢみする　あしで　きょうれつな\nキックを　はなち　あいてを　けりたおす。\nたたかいの　あと　つかれた　あしを　もみほぐす。
records.english: HITMONLEE's legs freely contract and\nstretch. Using these springlike legs, it\nbowls over foes with devastating kicks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: After battle, it rubs down its legs and\nloosens the muscles to overcome\nfatigue.

records.japanese: せかいチャンピオンを　めざしていた　ボクサーの\nたましいが　やどったと　いわれる　エビワラーは\nふくつの　せいしんで　ぜったいに　へこたれない。
records.english: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the\nspirit of a boxer who had been working\ntowards a world championship.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit\nand will never give up in the face of\nadversity.

records.japanese: はじめて　めに　する　ものは　かならず　ペロリ。\nしたざわりと　あじで　きおくしているのだ。\nでも　すっぱい　ものは　ちょっと　にがて。
records.english: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across\nsomething new, it will unfailingly give it\na lick. It does so because it memorizes

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: things by texture and by taste.\nIt is somewhat put off by sour things.

records.japanese: しげきを　あたえると　ガスの　どくそが　つよまり\nからだの　あちこちから　いきおいよく　ふきだす。\nまんまるに　ふくらんだ　あと　だいばくはつする。
records.english: If KOFFING becomes agitated, it raises\nthe toxicity of its internal gases and\njets them out from all over its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON may also overinflate its\nround body, then explode.

records.japanese: くさった　なまゴミから　でる　ガスが　だいすき。\nそうじを　しない　いえに　すみつき　かぞくが\nねしずまった　まよなか　ゴミばこを　あさる。
records.english: WEEZING loves the gases given off by\nrotted kitchen garbage. This POKéMON\nwill find a dirty, unkempt house and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: make it its home. At night, when the\npeople in the house are asleep, it will\ngo through the trash.

records.japanese: ひたすら　まっすぐ　つきすすみ　こわしまくる。\nこうてつの　かたまりに　ぶつかっても　へいきだが\n１にち　たつと　ちょっと　いたみを　かんじる。
records.english: RHYHORN runs in a straight line,\nsmashing everything in its path.\nIt is not bothered even if it rushes

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: headlong into a block of steel.\nThis POKéMON may feel some pain from\nthe collision the next day, however.

records.japanese: ツノは　ダイヤモンドの　げんせきを　くだき\nしっぽの　いちげきは　ビルを　なぎたおす。\nかたい　ひふは　たいほうでも　キズつかない。
records.english: RHYDON's horn can crush even uncut\ndiamonds. One sweeping blow of its tail\ncan topple a building.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's hide is extremely tough.\nEven direct cannon hits don't leave\na scratch.

records.japanese: えいよう　まんてんの　タマゴを　まいにち　うむ。\nしょくよくを　なくした　ひとでも　ペロリと\nたべてしまうほど　おいしい　タマゴだ。
records.english: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent\neggs on an everyday basis.\nThe eggs are so delicious, they are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: easily and eagerly devoured by even\nthose people who have lost their\nappetite.

records.japanese: てきに　つかまれると　ツルは　ぷちっと　きれる。\nぜんぜん　いたくないので　その　スキに　にげる。\nよくじつには　あたらしい　ツルが　はえそろうぞ。
records.english: TANGELA's vines snap off easily if they\nare grabbed. This happens without pain,\nallowing it to make a quick getaway.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The lost vines are replaced by newly\ngrown vines the very next day.

records.japanese: ガルーラの　こどもが　１ぴきで　あそんでいても\nぜったいに　つかまえたりしては　いけないよ。\nちかくに　いる　おやが　はげしく　おこりだすぞ。
records.english: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN\nplaying by itself, you must never\ndisturb it or attempt to catch it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The baby POKéMON's parent is sure to\nbe in the area, and it will become\nviolently enraged at you.

records.japanese: ちいさな　ムシや　いわばの　コケを　たべる。\nかいりゅうが　はやく　なると　しっぽを　いわばや\nサンゴに　まきつけ　ながされない　ように　する。
records.english: HORSEA eats small insects and moss off\nof rocks. If the ocean current turns\nfast, this POKéMON anchors itself by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: wrapping its tail around rocks or coral\nto prevent being washed away.

records.japanese: サンゴの　えだの　すきまに　もぐって　ねむる。\nシードラに　きづかず　サンゴを　とろうとして\nどくの　トゲに　さされてしまう　ことが　ある。
records.english: SEADRA sleeps after wriggling itself\nbetween the branches of coral.\nThose trying to harvest coral are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: occasionally stung by this POKéMON's\npoison barbs if they fail to notice it.

records.japanese: すいちゅうで　ゆうがに　たなびく　ひれが　とても\nうつくしい　ポケモンだが　ゆだんを　していると\nきょうれつな　ツノの　ひとつきを　くらうぞ。
records.english: GOLDEEN is a very beautiful POKéMON\nwith fins that billow elegantly in water.\nHowever, don't let your guard down

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: around this POKéMON - it could ram you\npowerfully with its horn.

records.japanese: あきに　なると　メスに　プロポーズする　ために\nかわぞこで　おどる　オスを　みることが　できる。\nからだの　いろが　もっとも　うつくしい　きせつ。
records.english: In the autumn, SEAKING males can be\nseen performing courtship dances in\nriverbeds to woo females.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: During this season, this POKéMON's body\ncoloration is at its most beautiful.

records.japanese: なつの　おわりごろ　よるに　すなはまへ　いくと\nコアと　よばれる　きかんを　あかく　ひからせた\nヒトデマンが　ほしの　ように　みえるよ。
records.english: STARYU's center section has an organ\ncalled the core that shines bright red.\nIf you go to a beach toward the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: end of summer, the glowing cores of\nthese POKéMON look like the stars\nin the sky.

records.japanese: からだの　ちゅうしんに　ある　コアと　よばれる\nぶぶんが　なないろに　かがやく　ことから\nうみのほうせき　という　べつめいを　つけられた。
records.english: STARMIE's center section - the core -\nglows brightly in seven colors.\nBecause of its luminous nature, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON has been given the nickname\n“the gem of the sea.”

records.japanese: めに　みえない　ものを　みぶりで　そこに　あると\nしんじこませる　パントマイムの　たつじん。\nしんじさせた　ものは　ほんとうに　あらわれる。
records.english: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime.\nIts gestures and motions convince\nwatchers that something unseeable

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: actually exists. Once it is believed,\nit will exist as if it were a real thing.

records.japanese: めにも　とまらぬ　スピードが　りょううでの\nカマの　きれあじを　さらに　するどく　するのだ。\nひとふり　すれば　たいぼくも　まっぷたつだ。
records.english: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing\nspeed enhances the effectiveness of\nthe twin scythes on its forearms.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's scythes are so\neffective, they can slice through thick\nlogs in one wicked stroke.

records.japanese: おどるような　こしつきで　リズミカルに　あるく。\nその　うごきは　みている　ひとも　おもわず\nこしを　ふってしまうほど　かろやかなのだ。
records.english: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and\nshaking its hips as if it were dancing.\nIts motions are so bouncingly alluring,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: people seeing it are compelled to shake\ntheir hips without giving any thought\nto what they are doing.

records.japanese: あらしが　くると　きの　うえ　など　カミナリの\nおちそうな　たかい　ばしょへ　きそって　のぼる。\nひらいしん　がわりに　する　まちも　ある。
records.english: When a storm arrives, gangs of this\nPOKéMON compete with each other to\nscale heights that are likely to be

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: stricken by lightning bolts.\nSome towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of\nlightning rods.

records.japanese: たたかいに　なると　からだから　しゃくねつの\nほのおを　ふきあげ　あいてを　いかくする。\nその　ねっぷうで　まわりの　くさきも　もやすぞ。
records.english: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely\nhot flames from all over its body to\nintimidate its opponent.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's fiery bursts create\nheat waves that ignite grass and trees\nin its surroundings.

records.japanese: じぶんの　たいじゅうの　２ばいも　ある　あいてを\nツノで　はさみ　かるがる　もちあげる　かいりき。\nさむい　ばしょでは　からだの　うごきが　にぶる。
records.english: PINSIR is astoundingly strong. It can\ngrip a foe weighing twice its weight\nin its horns and easily lift it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's movements turn sluggish\nin cold places.

records.japanese: いつも　あばれて　いないと　きが　すまない。\nたたかう　あいてが　いない　ときは　たいぼくに\nぶちあたり　なぎたおす　ことで　きを　しずめる。
records.english: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless\nit is rampaging at all times.\nIf there is no opponent for TAUROS to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: battle, it will charge at thick trees and\nknock them down to calm itself.

records.japanese: はねる　ことしか　しない　なさけない　ポケモン。\nなぜ　はねるのか　しらべた　けんきゅうしゃが\nいるほど　とにかく　はねて　はねて　はねまくる。
records.english: MAGIKARP is a pathetic excuse for a\nPOKéMON that is only capable of\nflopping and splashing.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This behavior prompted scientists to\nundertake research into it.

records.japanese: コイキングから　ギャラドスに　しんかする　とき\nのうさいぼうの　こうぞうが　くみかわる　ために\nせいかくが　きょうぼうに　なると　いわれている。
records.english: When MAGIKARP evolves into GYARADOS,\nits brain cells undergo a structural\ntransformation. It is said that this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: transformation is to blame for this\nPOKéMON's wildly violent nature.

records.japanese: ひとが　ぜつめつの　ききに　おいこんでしまった。\nゆうぐれどきになると　すくなくなった　なかまを\nさがして　かなしそうな　こえで　うたうと　いう。
records.english: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the\npoint of extinction. In the evenings,\nthis POKéMON is said to sing plaintively

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: as it seeks what few others of its kind\nstill remain.

records.japanese: からだの　さいぼうを　くみかえて　へんしんする。\nおもいだしながら　いぜん　みた　ものに　かわると\nちょっと　ちがう　かたちに　なってしまうのだ。
records.english: DITTO rearranges its cell structure to\ntransform itself into other shapes.\nHowever, if it tries to transform itself

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: into something by relying on its memory,\nthis POKéMON manages to get details\nwrong.

records.japanese: くらしている　かんきょうで　とつぜんへんい　する\nふあんていな　いでんしを　もつ　ポケモン。\nいしの　ほうしゃせんが　しんかを　ひきおこす。
records.english: EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup\nthat suddenly mutates due to the\nenvironment in which it lives.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Radiation from various STONES causes\nthis POKéMON to evolve.

records.japanese: とつぜんへんいに　より　すいちゅうで　せいかつ\nできる　ように　ヒレと　エラが　はえてきた。\nみずを　じざいに　あやつる　ちからを　もつ。
