records.english: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous\nmutation and grew fins and gills that\nallow it to live underwater.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has the ability to freely\ncontrol water.

records.japanese: さいぼうの　だす　よわい　でんきを　たいもうの\nせいでんきで　ぞうふくさせ　カミナリを　おとす。\nさかだった　たいもうは　でんきを　おびた　はり。
records.english: JOLTEON's cells generate a low level of\nelectricity. This power is amplified by\nthe static electricity of its fur,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: enabling the POKéMON to drop\nthunderbolts. The bristling fur is made\nof electrically charged needles.

records.japanese: ふさふさの　たいもうは　あがりすぎた　たいおんを\nくうきに　ほうねつして　さげる　きのうを　もつ。\nたいおんは　さいこう　９００ど　まで　あがるぞ。
records.english: FLAREON's fluffy fur has a functional\npurpose - it releases heat into the air\nso that its body does not get

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: excessively hot.\nThis POKéMON's body temperature can\nrise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

records.japanese: ぜんしんを　プログラム　データに　もどして\nでんし　くうかんに　はいる　ことが　できる。\nコピーガードされて　いるので　コピー　できない。
records.english: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself\nentirely back to program data and\nentering cyberspace.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is copy-protected so it\ncannot be duplicated by copying.

records.japanese: おおむかしに　ぜつめつしたが　にんげんの　てで\nかせきから　ふっかつさせた　ポケモンの　ひとつ。\nてきに　おそわれると　かたい　カラに　かくれる。
records.english: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long-\nsince-extinct POKéMON that have been\nregenerated from fossils by people.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws\nitself inside its hard shell.

records.japanese: しょくしゅを　あやつり　えものを　つかまえる。\nカラが　おおきく　なりすぎた　ことで　うごきが\nにぶくなり　ぜつめつしたと　かんがえられている。
records.english: OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture\nits prey. It is believed to have become\nextinct because its shell grew too large

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and heavy, causing its movements to\nbecome too slow and ponderous.

records.japanese: かせきから　ふっかつした　ポケモンだが　まれに\nいきつづけている　カブトを　はっけん　できる。\nその　すがたは　３おくねん　かわっていない。
records.english: KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been\nregenerated from a fossil. However, in\nextremely rare cases, living examples

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: have been discovered.\nThe POKéMON has not changed at all for\n300 million years.

records.japanese: すいちゅうを　およぎ　えものを　とらえていた。\nみずの　せいかつから　ちじょうで　くらせるように\nエラや　あし　などが　へんかを　はじめていた。
records.english: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for\nits prey in ancient times.\nThe POKéMON was apparently evolving

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: from being a water-dweller to living on\nland as evident from the beginnings of\nchange in its gills and legs.

records.japanese: コハクから　とりだした　いでんしを　さいせいして\nふっかつした　きょうりゅう　じだいの　ポケモン。\nそらの　おうじゃだったと　そうぞうされている。
records.english: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age\nof dinosaurs. It was regenerated from\ngenetic material extracted from amber.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is imagined to have been the king of\nthe skies in ancient times.

records.japanese: たべて　ねての　くりかえしで　１にちが　おわる。\nおおきな　おなかの　うえを　あそびばに　している\nこどもたちも　いるほど　おとなしい　ポケモンだ。
records.english: SNORLAX's typical day consists of\nnothing more than eating and sleeping.\nIt is such a docile POKéMON that there

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: are children who use its expansive belly\nas a place to play.

records.japanese: こおりを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nはばたく　ことで　くうきを　つめたく　ひやすので\nフリーザーが　とぶと　ゆきが　ふると　いわれる。
records.english: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat can control ice.\nThe flapping of its wings chills the air.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, it is said that when this\nPOKéMON flies, snow will fall.

records.japanese: でんきを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nふだんは　カミナリぐもの　なかで　くらしている。\nカミナリに　うたれると　ちからが　わいてくる。
records.english: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that\nhas the ability to control electricity.\nIt usually lives in thunderclouds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON gains power if it is\nstricken by lightning bolts.

records.japanese: ほのおを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nからだが　きずつくと　かこうの　マグマに　はいり\nぜんしんを　もやして　きずを　いやすと　いう。
records.english: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat has the ability to control fire.\nIf this POKéMON is injured, it is said to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: dip its body in the molten magma of a\nvolcano to burn and heal itself.

records.japanese: ミニリュウが　だっぴを　くりかえして　いるのは\nからだの　なかで　せいめいの　エネルギーが\nどんどん　ふくらみ　おさえきれなく　なるからだ。
records.english: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs\noff its old skin.\nIt does so because the life energy

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: within its body steadily builds to reach\nuncontrollable levels.

records.japanese: おおきな　エネルギーを　からだに　ためている。\nくびと　しっぽの　すいしょうから　エネルギーを\nときはなち　あたりの　てんきを　かえると　いう。
records.english: DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount\nof energy inside its body.\nIt is said to alter weather conditions

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: in its vicinity by discharging energy\nfrom the crystals on its neck and tail.

records.japanese: １６じかんで　ちきゅうを　１しゅうできる。\nあらしで　なんぱしかけた　ふねを　みつけると\nりくちまで　ゆうどうする　やさしい　ポケモン。
records.english: DRAGONITE is capable of circling the\nglobe in just sixteen hours.\nIt is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: lost and foundering ships in a storm to\nthe safety of land.

records.japanese: いでんしそうさに　よって　つくられた　ポケモン。\nにんげんの　かがくりょくで　からだは　つくれても\nやさしい　こころを　つくることは　できなかった。
records.english: MEWTWO is a POKéMON that was created\nby genetic manipulation.\nHowever, even though the scientific

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: power of humans created this POKéMON's\nbody, they failed to endow MEWTWO with\na compassionate heart.

records.japanese: すべての　ポケモンの　いでんしを　もつと　いう。\nじゆうじざいに　すがたを　けすことが　できるので\nひとに　ちかづいても　まったく　きづかれない。
records.english: MEW is said to possess the genetic\ncomposition of all POKéMON.\nIt is capable of making itself invisible

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: at will, so it entirely avoids notice even\nif it approaches people.

records.japanese: はっぱを　ふりまわして　あいてを　いかくするが\nはっぱから　あまい　かおりが　ただようので\nおたがいに　なごやかな　ふんいきに　なるよ。
records.english: In battle, CHIKORITA waves its leaf\naround to keep the foe at bay.\nHowever, a sweet fragrance also wafts

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: from the leaf, becalming the battling\nPOKéMON and creating a cozy, friendly\natmosphere all around.

records.japanese: くびの　まわりの　くるりと　まいた　はっぱの\nなかには　ちいさな　きのめが　１こ　なっている。\nその　かおりは　ひとを　げんきに　させるぞ。
records.english: BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up\nleaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a\nsmall shoot of a tree.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The fragrance of this shoot makes\npeople peppy.

records.japanese: はなの　かおりは　きもちを　おだやかにする。\nたたかいの　ときは　かおりを　はっさんさせて\nあいての　たたかう　きもちを　にぶらせるのだ。
records.english: The fragrance of MEGANIUM's flower\nsoothes and calms emotions.\nIn battle, this POKéMON gives off more

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of its becalming scent to blunt the\nfoe's fighting spirit.

records.japanese: せなかから　ほのおを　ふきあげて　みを　まもる。\nおこった　ときの　ほのおは　いきおいが　いいが\nつかれている　ときは　ふかんぜんねんしょうする。
records.english: CYNDAQUIL protects itself by flaring up\nthe flames on its back.\nThe flames are vigorous if the POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: is angry. However, if it is tired, the\nflames splutter fitfully with incomplete\ncombustion.

records.japanese: ほのおの　いきおいと　ねっぷうで　いかくする。\nすばやい　みのこなしで　あいての　こうげきを\nかわしながら　どうじに　ほのおで　もやす。
records.english: QUILAVA keeps its foes at bay with the\nintensity of its flames and gusts of\nsuperheated air.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON applies its outstanding\nnimbleness to dodge attacks even while\nscorching the foe with flames.

records.japanese: しゃくねつの　ほのおで　まわりに　かげろうを\nつくりだして　すがたを　かくす　ことが　できる。\nもえあがる　ばくふうは　すべてを　やきつくすぞ。
records.english: TYPHLOSION obscures itself behind a\nshimmering heat haze that it creates\nusing its intensely hot flames.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON creates blazing explosive\nblasts that burn everything to cinders.

records.japanese: ちいさな　からだでも　アゴの　ちからは　つよい。\nワニノコじしんは　あまがみ　している　つもりでも\nおおけがを　してしまう　ほどの　ちからが　ある。
records.english: Despite the smallness of its body,\nTOTODILE's jaws are very powerful.\nWhile the POKéMON may think it is just

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: playfully nipping, its bite has enough\npower to cause serious injury.

records.japanese: いちど　かみついたら　ぜったいに　はなさない。\nキバの　さきが　つりばり　みたいに　そりかえって\nいるので　いちど　ささると　ぬけなく　なるのだ。
records.english: Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on\nits foe, it will absolutely not let go.\nBecause the tips of its fangs are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: forked back like barbed fishhooks, they\nbecome impossible to remove when \nthey have sunk in.

records.japanese: おおきな　くちを　あけて　あいてを　いかくする。\nきょうじんな　うしろあしで　じめんを　けって\nものすごい　スピードで　とっしん　してくるぞ。
records.english: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by\nopening its huge mouth.\nIn battle, it will kick the ground hard

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: with its thick and powerful hind legs to\ncharge at the foe at an incredible\nspeed.

records.japanese: ねむる　ときには　こうたいで　みはりをする。\nきけんを　さっちすると　なかまを　おこすのだ。\nむれから　はぐれると　こわくて　ねむれなくなる。
records.english: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while\nanother stands guard. The sentry wakes\nthe others at the first sign of danger.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When this POKéMON becomes separated\nfrom its pack, it becomes incapable of\nsleep due to fear.

records.japanese: てきに　おそわれても　ほそい　すきまに\nするりと　もぐりこんで　にげる　ことが　できる。\nてあしは　みじかいが　とても　すばしっこい。
records.english: FURRET has a very slim build.\nWhen under attack, it can slickly squirm\nthrough narrow spaces and get away.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In spite of its short limbs, this\nPOKéMON is very nimble and fleet.

records.japanese: からだの　なかには　ちきゅうの　じてんを\nかんじとる　きかんを　もっているので　まいにち\nおなじ　じかんに　なると　なきごえを　あげる。
records.english: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that\nsenses and tracks the earth's rotation.\nUsing this special organ, this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: begins hooting at precisely the same\ntime every day.

records.japanese: わずかな　ひかりでも　みえる　すぐれた　めと\nはおとを　たてない　やわらかい　はねの　おかげで\nくらやみでは　えものを　ぜったいに　にがさない。
records.english: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in\ndarkness. This POKéMON owes its\nsuccess to its superior vision that

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: allows it to see in minimal light, and to\nits soft,  supple wings that make no\nsound in flight.

records.japanese: あしの　つけねから　だす　えきたいの　においで\nなかまと　コミュニケーションを　とっている。\nにおいの　ちがいで　きもちを　つたえるという。
records.english: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from\nwhere its legs join its body. This fluid\nis used for communicating with others.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON conveys its feelings to\nothers by altering the fluid's scent.

records.japanese: ほしが　たくさん　みえる　くうきの　きれいな\nとちには　レディアンが　たくさん　すむと　いう。\nほしあかりを　エネルギーに　しているからだ。
records.english: It is said that in lands with clean air,\nwhere the stars fill the sky, there live\nLEDIAN in countless numbers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There is a good reason for this - the\nPOKéMON uses the light of the stars\nas its energy.

records.japanese: いとで　つくった　ワナは　だい２の　しんけい。\nいとを　つたわる　わずかな　しんどう　だけで\nえものの　しゅるいが　わかると　いわれている。
records.english: The web spun by SPINARAK can be\nconsidered its second nervous system.\nIt is said that this POKéMON can

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: determine what kind of prey is touching\nits web just by the tiny vibrations it\nfeels through the web's strands.

records.japanese: あしの　せんたんには　ちいさな　カギヅメが　あり\nてんじょうや　すいちょくの　かべも　あるける。\nほそく　じょうぶな　いとで　てきを　しめあげる。
records.english: ARIADOS's feet are tipped with tiny\nhooked claws that enable it to scuttle\non ceilings and vertical walls.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON constricts the foe with\nthin and strong silk webbing.

records.japanese: うでか　あしの　どちらかだけで　はばたいている\nときは　ながい　きょりを　とんでいる　しょうこ。\nつかれると　はばたく　ハネを　かえるのだ。
records.english: If this POKéMON is flying by fluttering\nonly a pair of wings on either the\nforelegs or hind legs, it's proof that

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: CROBAT has been flying a long distance.\nIt switches the wings it uses if it is\ntired.

records.japanese: ２ほんの　しょくしゅから　プラスと　マイナスの\nでんきを　ながして　えものを　きぜつ　させる。\nでんきの　あかりは　なかまとの　サインだ。
records.english: CHINCHOU lets loose positive and\nnegative electrical charges from its\ntwo antennas to make its prey faint.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON flashes its electric\nlights to exchange signals with others.

records.japanese: しんかいのほし　と　よばれる　ポケモンだ。\nしょくしゅの　なかの　バクテリアと　たいえきを\nかがくはんのうさせる　ことで　ひかりを　つくる。
records.english: LANTURN is nicknamed “the deep-sea\nstar” for its illuminated antenna.\nThis POKéMON produces light by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: causing a chemical reaction between\nbacteria and its bodily fluids inside\nthe antenna.

records.japanese: かみなりぐもが　でている　ときや　くうきの\nかんそうした　ひは　でんきが　たまりやすい。\nパチパチ　せいでんきの　おとが　なっているよ。
records.english: PICHU charges itself with electricity\nmore easily on days with thunderclouds\nor when the air is very dry.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: You can hear the crackling of static\nelectricity coming off this POKéMON.

records.japanese: ながれぼしの　おおい　よるは　わ　に　なって\nおどる　ピィの　すがたを　みることが　できる。\nひのでまで　おどり　よつゆで　のどを　うるおす。
records.english: On nights with many shooting stars,\nCLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.\nThey dance through the night and stop

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: only at the break of day, when these\nPOKéMON quench their thirst with the\nmorning dew.

records.japanese: せいたいが　まだ　じゅうぶんに　はったつして\nいないので　うたい　つづけると　ノドが　いたむ。\nきれいな　おがわの　みずで　うがいをするよ。
records.english: IGGLYBUFF's vocal chords are not\nsufficiently developed. It would hurt\nits throat if it were to sing too much.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON gargles with freshwater\nfrom a clean stream.

records.japanese: ひとや　ポケモンが　はっしている　やさしさや\nたのしい　きもちを　エネルギーに　している。\nカラの　なかに　ためた　しあわせを　わけている。
records.english: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive\nemotions of compassion and pleasure\nexuded by people and POKéMON.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON stores up feelings of\nhappiness inside its shell, then shares\nthem with others.

records.japanese: こううんを　もたらす　ポケモンと　いわれている。\nじゅんすいな　こころの　もちぬしを　みつけると\nすがたを　あらわし　しあわせを　わけあたえる。
records.english: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that\nbrings good fortune. When the POKéMON\nspots someone who is pure of heart,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it is said to appear and share its\nhappiness with that person.

records.japanese: はねが　まだ　そだって　いないので　とべない。\nめを　あわせると　じっと　みつめるが　あいてが\nすこしでも　うごくと　とびはねて　にげていく。
records.english: NATU cannot fly because its wings are\nnot yet fully grown. If your eyes meet\nwith this POKéMON's eyes, it will stare

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: back intently at you. But if you move\neven slightly, it will hop away to safety.

records.japanese: いちにちじゅう　ネイティオが　じっとしているのは\nみらいよちで　わかった　おそろしい　できごとに\nおびえているからだと　しんじられている。
records.english: XATU stands rooted and still in one\nspot all day long. People believe that\nthis POKéMON does so out of fear of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the terrible things it has foreseen in\nthe future.

records.japanese: たいもうが　こすれて　せいでんきが　たまる。\nでんりょくが　たくさん　たまるほど　しっぽの\nさきに　ついた　でんきゅうが　あかるく　ひかる。
records.english: MAREEP's fluffy coat of wool rubs\ntogether and builds a static charge.\nThe more static electricity is charged,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the more brightly the lightbulb at the\ntip of its tail grows.

records.japanese: たいもうの　せいしつが　へんかするので　すくない\nりょうでも　たくさんの　でんきを　つくりだせる。\nでんきを　さえぎる　つるつるの　はだを　もつ。
records.english: FLAAFFY's wool quality changes so that\nit can generate a high amount of static\nelectricity with a small amount of wool.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The bare and slick parts of its hide are\nshielded against electricity.

records.japanese: デンリュウの　あかりは　うちゅうからも　みえる。\nむかしの　ひとは　デンリュウの　あかりを　つかい\nとおくの　なかまと　あいずを　おくりあっていた。
records.english: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that\nit can be seen even from space.\nPeople in the old days used the light of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON to send signals back and\nforth with others far away.

records.japanese: たいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびると\nからだの　はっぱが　くるくる　まわり　はじめる。\nキレイハナの　ダンスは　なんごくの　めいぶつだ。
records.english: When BELLOSSOM gets exposed to plenty\nof sunlight, the leaves ringing its body\nbegin to spin around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's dancing is renowned in\nthe southern lands.

records.japanese: あぶらの　つまった　しっぽは　うきわの　かわり。\nすいめんに　しっぽだけが　ういている　ときは\nもぐって　みずくさを　たべている　めじるしだ。
records.english: MARILL's oil-filled tail acts much like\na life preserver. If you see just its\ntail bobbing on the water's surface,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it's a sure indication that this POKéMON\nis diving beneath the water to feed on\naquatic plants.

records.japanese: ながい　みみは　マリルリの　だいじな　センサー。\nみみを　すませば　ながれの　はげしい　かわでも\nそこに　いる　えものの　しゅるいが　わかるぞ。
records.english: AZUMARILL's long ears are indispensable\nsensors. By focusing its hearing, this\nPOKéMON can identify what kinds of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: prey are around, even in rough and\nfast-running rivers.

records.japanese: てきに　おそわれない　ように　きの　ふりをする。\nりょうては　１ねんじゅう　みどりいろなので\nふゆは　にせものだと　すぐに　ばれてしまう。
records.english: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree\nto avoid being attacked by enemies.\nHowever, because the forelegs remain

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: green throughout the year, the POKéMON\nis easily identified as a fake during\nthe winter.

records.japanese: あたまの　まきげは　おうじゃの　あかしだ。\nながく　きれいに　まいている　ニョロトノほど\nなかまの　そんけいを　あつめると　いわれている。
records.english: The curled hair on POLITOED's head is\nproof of its status as a king. It is said\nthat the longer and more curled the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: hair, the more respect this POKéMON\nearns from its peers.

records.japanese: かぜに　のって　ふわふわ　ただよう　ポケモン。\nきょうふうの　けはいを　かんじると　なかまどうし\nはっぱを　からめ　とばされない　じゅんびをする。
records.english: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the\nwind. If it senses the approach of\nstrong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: with other HOPPIP to prepare against\nbeing blown away.

records.japanese: きおんが　１８どを　こえると　はなが　ひらく。\nおんどに　より　はなの　ひらきかたが　かわるので\nおんどけいの　かわりに　することも　ある。
records.english: SKIPLOOM's flower blossoms when the\ntemperature rises above 64 degrees F.\nHow much the flower opens depends on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the temperature. For that reason, this\nPOKéMON is sometimes used as a\nthermometer.

records.japanese: あたたかい　みなみかぜに　のって　うみを　こえ\nがいこくまで　とんでいってしまう　ポケモン。\nつめたい　くうきに　ふれると　じめんに　おりる。
records.english: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to\ncross the sea and fly to foreign lands.\nThe POKéMON descends to the ground

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: when it encounters cold air while it is\nfloating.

records.japanese: きように　うごく　しっぽの　さきを　てのひらの\nかわりに　つかっていたら　はんたいに　りょうてが\nぶきように　なってしまった　ポケモンだ。
records.english: AIPOM's tail ends in a hand-like\nappendage that can be cleverly\nmanipulated.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because the POKéMON uses its\ntail so much, its real hands have become\nrather clumsy.

records.japanese: からだに　ためた　えいようは　しんかの　ときまで\nとっておくため　ほとんど　うごこうとしない。\nなにも　たべずに　あさつゆ　だけを　のんでいる。
records.english: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it\npossibly can. It does so because it\ntries to conserve all the nutrients it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: has stored in its body for its\nevolution. It will not eat a thing, \nsubsisting only on morning dew.

records.japanese: たいようエネルギーから　えいようを　つくりだす。\nきおんの　たかい　にっちゅう　かっぱつに　うごき\nたいようが　しずむと　ぱったり　うごかなくなる。
records.english: SUNFLORA converts solar energy into\nnutrition. It moves around actively in\nthe daytime when it is warm.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It stops moving as soon as the sun goes\ndown for the night.

records.japanese: めだまを　うごかさずに　３６０ど　みわたせる。\nきゅうブレーキや　ほうこうてんかんが　とくい。\nねらった　えものを　すばやく　おいつめていく。
records.english: YANMA is capable of seeing 360 degrees\nwithout having to move its eyes.\nIt is a great flier that is adept at

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: making sudden stops and turning midair.\nThis POKéMON uses its flying ability to\nquickly chase down targeted prey.

records.japanese: ふだんは　みずの　なかで　くらしているが　エサを\nさがすときなど　たまに　ちじょうに　でてくる。\nりくでは　どくの　ねんえきで　からだを　おおう。
records.english: WOOPER usually lives in water.\nHowever, it occasionally comes out onto\nland in search of food.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: On land, it coats its body with a gooey,\ntoxic film.

records.japanese: みずの　なかで　くちを　あけて　エサが　ぐうぜん\nとびこんで　くるのを　ただただ　まっている。\nうごかないので　あまり　おなかが　すかないのだ。
records.english: QUAGSIRE hunts for food by leaving\nits mouth wide open in water and waiting\nfor its prey to blunder in unaware.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Because the POKéMON does not move,\nit does not get very hungry.

records.japanese: みとめた　トレーナーには　きわめて　ちゅうじつ。\nトレーナーを　きけんから　まもる　ために\nよちのうりょくが　はったつしたと　いわれている。
records.english: ESPEON is extremely loyal to any\nTRAINER it considers to be worthy.\nIt is said that this POKéMON developed

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its precognitive powers to protect its\nTRAINER from harm.

records.japanese: つきの　はどうを　うけて　しんかした　ポケモン。\nくらやみに　じっと　ひそみ　あいてを　うかがう。\nおそいかかる　とき　からだの　わっかが　ひかる。
records.english: UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure\nto the moon's waves.\nIt hides silently in darkness and waits

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: for its foes to make a move.\nThe rings on its body glow when it leaps\nto attack.

records.japanese: ふこうを　はこぶと　いわれ　おそれられていた。\nキラキラ　ひかる　ものに　きょうみを　しめし\nじょせいの　ゆびわを　とっていこうとする。
records.english: MURKROW was feared and loathed as the\nalleged bearer of ill fortune.\nThis POKéMON shows strong interest in

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: anything that sparkles or glitters.\nIt will even try to steal rings from\nwomen.

records.japanese: せかいの　ふしぎを　かいめい　するため　まいにち\nけんきゅう　しているが　あたまの　シェルダーが\nはずれると　ぜんぶ　わすれてしまう　らしい。
records.english: SLOWKING undertakes research every\nday in an effort to solve the mysteries\nof the world.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON apparently\nforgets everything it has learned if\nthe SHELLDER on its head comes off.

records.japanese: すすりなく　ような　なきごえで　こわがらせる。\nあいての　こわがる　こころを　あかい　たまで\nきゅうしゅうして　えいように　している　らしい。
records.english: MISDREAVUS frightens people with a\ncreepy, sobbing cry. The POKéMON\napparently uses its red spheres to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: absorb the fearful feelings of foes and\nturn them into nutrition.

records.japanese: こだいの　もじに　にた　すがたの　ポケモン。\nさきに　うまれたのは　もじか　アンノーンなのか。\nけんきゅうちゅうだが　いまだに　なぞである。
records.english: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient\nwriting. It is a mystery as to which\ncame first, the ancient writings or the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: various UNOWN. Research into this\ntopic is ongoing but nothing is known.

records.japanese: ２ひき　いじょう　あつまると　がまん　くらべを\nはじめるが　くうふくを　がまんして　しまうので\nソーナンス　トレーナーは　ちゅういが　ひつよう。
records.english: If two or more WOBBUFFET meet, they will\nturn competitive and try to outdo each\nother's endurance.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, they may try to see which one\ncan endure the longest without food.\nTRAINERS need to beware of this habit.

records.japanese: シッポの　あたまにも　ちいさな　のうが　ある。\nにおいや　おとに　はんのうして　こうげきするので\nうしろから　ちかよると　いきなり　かみつかれる。
records.english: GIRAFARIG's rear head also has a brain,\nbut it is small. The rear head attacks in\nresponse to smells and sounds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Approaching this POKéMON from behind\ncan cause the rear head to suddenly\nlash out and bite.

records.japanese: きの　えだに　ぶらさがり　えものを　まっている。\nきを　ゆらされて　しょくじの　じゃまを　されると\nじめんに　おちてから　いきなり　ばくはつするぞ。
records.english: PINECO hangs from a tree branch and\npatiently waits for prey to come along.\nIf the POKéMON is disturbed while

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: eating by someone shaking its tree, it\ndrops down to the ground and explodes\nwith no warning.

records.japanese: こうてつの　カラの　なかに　ほんたいが　いる。\nえものを　つかまえる　ときに　カラが　ひらくが\nあまりの　はやさに　なかみは　みえないのだ。
records.english: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its\nhardened steel shell. The shell is opened\nwhen the POKéMON is catching prey,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: but it does so at such a quick pace\nthat the shell's inside cannot be seen.

records.japanese: ドリルの　シッポを　つかって　うしろむきに\nじめんを　ほりすすみ　ふくざつな　かたちの\nすあなを　ちちゅう　ふかくに　つくる　ポケモン。
records.english: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail.\nIt uses this tail to burrow into the\nground backwards.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is known to make its nest\nin complex shapes deep under the\nground.

records.japanese: おとを　たてず　すべる　ように　かっくうする。\nりょううでの　おおきな　ツメと　あしの　ツメで\nえものの　かおに　しがみつき　どくばりを　さす。
records.english: GLIGAR glides through the air without\na sound as if it were sliding.\nThis POKéMON hangs on to the face of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its foe using its clawed hind legs and\nthe large pincers on its forelegs, then\ninjects the prey with its poison barb.

records.japanese: イワークよりも　ふかい　ちちゅうに　すんでいる。\nちきゅうの　ちゅうしんに　むかって　ほりすすみ\nふかさ　１キロに　たっする　ことも　ある。
records.english: STEELIX lives even further underground\nthan ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig\ntowards the earth's core.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There are records of this POKéMON\nreaching a depth of over six-tenths\nof a mile underground.

records.japanese: キバを　むきだして　こわい　かおを　すれば\nちいさな　ポケモンなら　おびえて　にげだす。\nにげられた　ブルーは　ちょっと　さみしそう。
records.english: By baring its fangs and making a scary\nface, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON\nscurrying away in terror.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON seems a little\nsad at making its foes flee.

records.japanese: したアゴが　とても　はったつした　ポケモン。\nキバが　おもたいので　くびを　かしげている。\nおどろかさなければ　むやみに　かみつかない。
records.english: GRANBULL has a particularly well-\ndeveloped lower jaw. The enormous fangs\nare heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its head back for balance.\nUnless it is startled, it will not try to\nbite indiscriminately.

records.japanese: のみこんだ　みずの　ちからを　りようして\nぜんしんの　どくばりを　いっせいに　うちだす。\nおよぐのは　ちょっと　にがてな　ポケモンだ。
records.english: QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating\nitself. This POKéMON uses the pressure\nof the water it swallowed to shoot

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: toxic quills all at once from all over\nits body. It finds swimming somewhat\nchallenging.

records.japanese: はがねの　かたさを　もつ　からだは　ちょっとや\nそっとの　こうげきでは　びくとも　しないぞ。\nハネを　はばたかせ　たいおんを　ちょうせつする。
records.english: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of\nsteel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary\nsorts of attacks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON flaps its wings to\nregulate its body temperature.

records.japanese: いわの　したで　こうらの　なかに　たくわえた\nきのみを　たべながら　みを　ひそめている。\nたいえきと　まざり　きのみは　ジュースに　なる。
records.english: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under\nrocks, keeping its body concealed\ninside its hard shell while eating

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: berries it has stored away.\nThe berries mix with its body fluids to\nbecome a juice.

records.japanese: いっちょくせんに　てきの　ふところに　もぐりこみ\nたくましい　ツノで　すくいあげ　なげとばす。\nたいぼくも　ねこそぎ　たおす　ほどの　パワーだ。
records.english: HERACROSS charges in a straight line at\nits foe, slips beneath the foe's grasp,\nand then scoops up and hurls the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: opponent with its mighty horn.\nThis POKéMON even has enough power\nto topple a massive tree.

records.japanese: てあしの　カギヅメを　つきたてて　きを　のぼる。\nおやの　いない　すきを　ねらって　きの　うえに\nある　す　から　タマゴを　ぬすんで　たべる。
records.english: SNEASEL scales trees by punching its\nhooked claws into the bark.\nThis POKéMON seeks out unguarded

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: nests and steals eggs for food while\nthe parents are away.

records.japanese: ハチミツの　しみこんだ　てのひらを　なめている。\nヒメグマの　ハチミツは　くだものと　スピアーの\nあつめた　かふんが　ブレンドされて　つくられる。
records.english: This POKéMON likes to lick its palms that\nare sweetened by being soaked in honey.\nTEDDIURSA concocts its own honey by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: blending fruits and pollen collected by\nBEEDRILL.

records.japanese: もりの　なかには　リングマが　エサあつめを　する\nたいぼくや　おがわが　あちこちに　あると　いう。\nまいにち　エサを　あつめて　もりを　あるく。
records.english: In the forests inhabited by URSARING,\nit is said that there are many streams\nand towering trees where they

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: gather food. This POKéMON walks\nthrough its forest gathering food\nevery day.

records.japanese: からだの　なかでは　しゃくねつの　ようがんが\nうずまいているが　ひえると　かたまって　しまい\nくずれて　からだが　ちいさく　なっていく。
records.english: Molten magma courses throughout\nSLUGMA's circulatory system.\nIf this POKéMON is chilled, the magma

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: cools and hardens. Its body turns\nbrittle and chunks fall off, reducing\nits size.

records.japanese: カラは　ひふが　ひえて　かたまった　もの。\nさわった　だけで　ボロボロと　くずれて　しまう。\nマグマに　はいると　もとの　おおきさに　もどる。
records.english: MAGCARGO's shell is actually its skin\nthat hardened as a result of cooling.\nIts shell is very brittle and fragile -

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: just touching it causes it to crumble\napart. This POKéMON returns to its\noriginal size by dipping itself in magma.

records.japanese: じめんに　はなを　こすりつけて　エサを　さがす。\nかれくさの　したに　はえた　キノコが　こうぶつ。\nたまに　おんせんを　ほりあてる　ことが　あるよ。
records.english: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its\nsnout against the ground. Its favorite\nfood is a mushroom that grows under

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the cover of dead grass.\nThis POKéMON occasionally roots out\nhot springs.

records.japanese: こごえる　さむさにも　たえられる　ように\nあつくて　ながい　けがわに　おおわれている。\nこおりに　うまった　エサを　キバで　ほりだす。
records.english: PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat\nof long hair that enables it to endure\nthe freezing cold.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON uses its tusks to dig up\nfood that has been buried under ice.

records.japanese: サンゴの　えだは　たいようの　ひかりを　あびると\nなないろに　キラキラ　かがやき　とても　きれい。\nおれても　ひとばんで　もとどおりに　はえてくる。
records.english: CORSOLA's branches glitter very\nbeautifully in seven colors when they\ncatch sunlight.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If any branch breaks off, this POKéMON\ngrows it back in just one night.

records.japanese: のんだ　みずを　ふっきんを　つかい　いきおいよく\nふきだして　そらを　とぶ　えものを　しとめる。\nしんかが　ちかづくと　かわを　くだっていく。
records.english: REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it\nat high velocity using its abdominal\nmuscles to shoot down flying prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When evolution draws near, this POKéMON\ntravels downstream from rivers.

records.japanese: きゅうばんの　うでで　あいてに　からみつく。\nうごけなくなった　ところを　しとめるのだ。\nかなわない　ときは　スミを　はいて　にげる。
records.english: OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using\nits tentacles. This POKéMON tries to\nimmobilize it before delivering the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: finishing blow.\nIf the foe turns out to be too strong,\nOCTILLERY spews ink to escape.

records.japanese: しっぽで　エサを　つつみ　もちはこぶ　ポケモン。\nデリバードに　エサを　わけてもらった　おかげで\nエベレストを　のぼりきれた　ぼうけんかが　いた。
records.english: DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up\nin its tail. There once was a famous\nexplorer who managed to reach the peak

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these\nPOKéMON sharing its food.

records.japanese: はれた　ひには　うみの　うえを　ゆうがに　はねる\nマンタインの　むれを　みることが　できるよ。\nテッポウオが　くっついていても　きにしない。
records.english: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can\nbe seen elegantly leaping over the\nsea's waves.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is not bothered by the\nREMORAID that hitches rides.

records.japanese: ぜんしんが　かたい　ヨロイに　おおわれている。\nじそく　３００キロの　スピードで　そらを　とび\nかたなの　きれあじを　もつ　ハネで　きりさく。
records.english: SKARMORY is entirely encased in hard,\nprotective armor. This POKéMON flies at\nclose to 190 mph.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It slashes foes with its wings that\npossess swordlike cutting edges.

records.japanese: さまざまな　なきごえを　つかいわけ　なかまと\nれんらくを　とりあい　えものを　おいこんでいく。\nチームワークの　みごとさは　ポケモンずいいち。
records.english: HOUNDOUR hunt as a coordinated pack.\nThey communicate with each other using\na variety of cries to corner their prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
あたまの　ツノが　おおきく　そりかえって　いる\nヘルガーが　グループの　リーダーてき　そんざい。\nなかま　どうしで　あらそい　リーダーが　きまる。
records.english: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its\nhorns raked sharply towards the back\nserves a leadership role.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These POKéMON choose their leader by\nfighting amongst themselves.

records.japanese: せいぶつの　すまない　しんかいに　せいそくする。\nキングドラの　あくびが　さかまく　かいりゅうを\nひきおこすと　ながい　あいだ　しんじられてきた。
records.english: KINGDRA lives at extreme ocean depths\nthat are otherwise uninhabited.\nIt has long been believed that the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: yawning of this POKéMON creates\nspiraling ocean currents.

records.japanese: かわの　ほとりに　たてあなを　ほって　くらす。\nすみかの　ちかくに　はなの　しるしを　つけて\nじぶんの　ばしょだと　なかまに　おしえているよ。
records.english: For its nest, PHANPY digs a vertical pit \nin the ground at the edge of a river.\nIt marks the area around its nest with

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its trunk to let the others know that\nthe area has been claimed.

records.japanese: からだを　まるめて　こうそくかいてん　しながら\nあいてに　とっしんする　こうげきが　とくい。\nころがり　はじめると　なかなか　とまれなくなる。
records.english: DONPHAN's favorite attack is curling\nits body into a ball, then charging at\nits foe while rolling at high speed.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once it starts rolling, this POKéMON\ncan't stop very easily.

records.japanese: にんげんが　かがくの　ちからで　つくりだした。\nじんこう　ちのうを　もたせたので　あたらしい\nしぐさや　かんじょうを　ひとりで　おぼえていく。
records.english: PORYGON2 was created by humans using\nthe power of science. The man-made\nPOKéMON has been endowed with

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: artificial intelligence that enables it\nto learn new gestures and emotions\non its own.

records.japanese: みごとな　かたちの　ツノは　びじゅつひん　として\nたかく　うれた　ために　ぜつめつ　すんぜんまで\nらんかくされた　ことのある　ポケモン。
records.english: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were\ntraded at high prices as works of art.\nAs a result, this POKéMON was hunted

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: close to extinction by those who were\nafter the priceless antlers.

records.japanese: しっぽの　さきから　にじみでる　たいえきで\nなわばりの　まわりに　じぶんの　マークを　かく。\n５０００　しゅるいの　マークが　みつかっている。
records.english: SMEARGLE marks the boundaries of its\nterritory using a body fluid that leaks\nout from the tip of its tail.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Over 5,000 different marks left by this\nPOKéMON have been found.

records.japanese: まいにち　トレーニング　しないと　ストレスが\nたまってしまうので　トレーナーは　そだてる　とき\nスケジュールかんりに　くふうが　ひつようだ。
records.english: TYROGUE becomes stressed out if it\ndoes not get to train every day.\nWhen raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: must establish and uphold various\ntraining methods.

records.japanese: こうそく　かいてんしながら　はなつ　キックは\nこうげきと　ぼうぎょを　かねた　みごとな　わざ。\nあるく　よりも　かいてんした　ほうが　はやい。
records.english: HITMONTOP spins on its head at high\nspeed, all the while delivering kicks.\nThis technique is a remarkable mix of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: both offense and defense at the same\ntime. The POKéMON travels faster\nspinning than it does walking.

records.japanese: げんき　いっぱい　うごきまわるが　よく　ころぶ。\nむっくり　おきあがると　みずうみの　すいめんに\nかおを　うつして　よごれていないか　しらべる。
records.english: SMOOCHUM actively runs about, but\nalso falls quite often.\nWhenever the chance arrives, it will

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: look for its reflection to make sure its\nface hasn't become dirty.

records.japanese: きんぞくに　さわって　からだに　ためた　でんきが\nほうでん　してしまうと　りょううでを　ぐるぐる\nまわして　ふたたび　でんきを　ためる。
records.english: ELEKID stores electricity in its body.\nIf it touches metal and accidentally\ndischarges all its built-up electricity,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON begins swinging its arms\nin circles to recharge itself.

records.japanese: きいろい　ほのおを　くちから　ふいている　ときは\nけんこうな　しょうこだが　つかれていると　くろい\nけむりが　まざる　ように　なるぞ。
records.english: MAGBY's state of health is determined\nby observing the fire it breathes.\nIf the POKéMON is spouting yellow

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: flames from its mouth, it is in good\nhealth. When it is fatigued, black smoke\nwill be mixed in with the flames.

records.japanese: まいにち　２０リットルの　ミルクを　だす。\nあまい　ミルクは　おとなも　こどもも　だいすき。\nにがてな　ひとは　ヨーグルトにして　たべている。
records.english: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk\non a daily basis. Its sweet milk is\nenjoyed by children and grown-ups alike.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: People who can't drink milk turn it into\nyogurt and eat it instead.

records.japanese: ふわふわの　たいもうで　かなしんでいる　こころを\nキャッチすると　どんなに　とおくでも　かけつけて\nえがおに　なる　しあわせタマゴを　わけてあげる。
records.english: BLISSEY senses sadness with its fluffy\ncoat of fur. If it does so, this POKéMON\nwill rush over to the sad person,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: however far they may be, to share an\negg of happiness that brings a smile\nto any face.

records.japanese: かみなりの　スピードを　やどした　ポケモン。\nその　とおぼえは　かみなりが　おちた　ときの\nように　くうきを　ふるわせ　だいちを　ゆるがす。
records.english: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning.\nThe roars of this POKéMON send shock\nwaves shuddering through the air and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: shake the ground as if lightning bolts\nhad come crashing down.

records.japanese: マグマの　じょうねつを　やどした　ポケモン。\nかざんの　ふんかから　うまれたと　かんがえられ\nすべてを　やきつくす　ほのおを　ふきあげる。
records.english: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma.\nThis POKéMON is thought to have been\nborn in the eruption of a volcano.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It sends up massive bursts of fire that\nutterly consume all that they touch.

records.japanese: わきみずの　やさしさを　やどした　ポケモン。\nすべる　ような　みのこなしで　だいちを　はしり\nにごった　みずを　きよめる　ちからを　もつ。
records.english: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of\na pure spring of water. It runs across\nthe land with gracefulness.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has the power to purify\ndirty water.

records.japanese: ちちゅう　ふかくで　うまれる　ヨーギラスは\nつちを　たべつくして　ちじょうへ　でないと\nおやの　かおを　みる　ことが　できないのだ。
records.english: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground.\nTo come up to the surface, this POKéMON\nmust eat its way through the soil above.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see\nits parent's face.

records.japanese: たいないで　つくりだした　ガスを　あっしゅくして\nいきおいよく　ふんしゃする　ことで　とんでいく。\nこうてつに　ぶつかっても　へいきな　ボディだ。
records.english: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body\nthat it compresses and forcefully\nejects to propel itself like a jet.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The body is very durable - it avoids\ndamage even if it hits solid steel.

records.japanese: じぶんの　すみかを　つくる　ために　やま　ひとつ\nくずしてしまう　ほどの　つよい　パワーを　もつ。\nたたかう　あいてを　もとめて　やまを　さまよう。
records.english: TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly\npowerful, it can bring down a whole\nmountain to make its nest.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON wanders about in\nmountains seeking new opponents to\nfight.

records.japanese: つばさを　かるく　はばたかせた　だけで　みんかを\nふきとばす　はかいりょくを　もっている　ために\nかいていで　ひとしれず　くらす　ように　なった。
records.english: LUGIA's wings pack devastating power -\na light fluttering of its wings can blow\napart regular houses.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, this POKéMON chooses to\nlive out of sight deep under the sea.

records.japanese: ひかりの　あたる　かくどに　よって　なないろに\nかがやく　ハネは　しあわせを　もたらすと　いう。\nにじの　ふもとに　すむと　いわれている。
records.english: HO-OH's feathers glow in seven colors\ndepending on the angle at which they\nare struck by light.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These feathers are said to bring\nhappiness to the bearers. This POKéMON\nis said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

records.japanese: ときを　こえ　みらいから　やってきた　ポケモン。\nセレビィが　すがたを　あらわす　かぎり　あかるい\nみらいが　まっていると　かんがえられている。
records.english: This POKéMON came from the future by\ncrossing over time.\nIt is thought that so long as CELEBI

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: appears, a bright and shining future\nawaits us.

records.japanese: あしの　うらの　ちいさな　トゲを　ひっかけて\nすいちょくの　カベを　のぼることが　できる。\nふとい　しっぽを　たたきつけて　こうげきする。
records.english: TREECKO has small hooks on the bottom\nof its feet that enable it to scale\nvertical walls.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON attacks by slamming foes\nwith its thick tail.

records.japanese: からだから　はえた　はっぱは　もりの　なかで\nてきから　すがたを　かくす　ときに　べんり。\nみつりんに　くらす　きのぼりの　めいしゅ。
records.english: The leaves growing out of GROVYLE's\nbody are convenient for camouflaging\nit from enemies in the forest.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is a master at climbing\ntrees in jungles.

records.japanese: からだに　はえた　はっぱは　するどい　きれあじ。\nすばやい　みのこなしで　きの　えだを　とびまわり\nてきの　ずじょうや　はいごから　おそいかかるぞ。
records.english: The leaves growing on SCEPTILE's body\nare very sharp edged. This POKéMON is\nvery agile - it leaps all over the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: branches of trees and jumps on its foe\nfrom above or behind.

records.japanese: トレーナーに　くっついて　ちょこちょこ　あるく。\nくちから　とばす　ほのおは　せっし　１０００ど。\nあいてを　くろコゲにする　しゃくねつの　たまだ。
records.english: TORCHIC sticks with its TRAINER,\nfollowing behind with unsteady\nsteps.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON breathes fire of over\n1,800 degrees F, including fireballs\nthat leave the foe scorched black.

records.japanese: のやまを　はしりまわって　あしこしを　きたえる。\nスピードと　パワーを　かねそなえた　あしは\n１びょうかんに　１０ぱつの　キックを　くりだす。
records.english: COMBUSKEN toughens up its legs and\nthighs by running through fields and\nmountains.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's legs possess both speed\nand power, enabling it to dole out ten\nkicks in one second.

records.japanese: たたかいに　なると　てくびから　しゃくねつの\nほのおを　ふきあげ　ゆうかんに　いどみかかる。\nあいてが　てごわいほど　はげしく　もえあがる。
records.english: In battle, BLAZIKEN blows out intense\nflames from its wrists and attacks foes\ncourageously.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The stronger the foe, the more\nintensely this POKéMON's wrists burn.

records.japanese: あたまの　ひれは　とても　びんかんな　レーダー。\nみずや　くうきの　うごきから　めを　つかわずに\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチすることが　できる。
records.english: The fin on MUDKIP's head acts as highly\nsensitive radar. Using this fin to sense\nmovements of water and air, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON can determine what is taking\nplace around it without using its eyes.

records.japanese: ちじょうでも　せいかつできる　ように　からだの\nひょうめんを　うすい　ねんまくが　つつんでいる。\nしおの　ひいた　かいがんで　どろあそびを　する。
records.english: The surface of MARSHTOMP's body is\nenveloped by a thin, sticky film that\nenables it to live on land.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON plays in mud on beaches\nwhen the ocean tide is low.

records.japanese: おもさ　１トンいじょう　ある　いわの　かたまりを\nかるがる　ひっぱる　パワーを　もつ　ポケモンだ。\nにごった　すいちゅうも　みとおす　しりょく。
records.english: SWAMPERT is very strong. It has enough\npower to easily drag a boulder weighing\nmore than a ton.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON also has powerful vision\nthat lets it see even in murky water.

records.japanese: うごく　ものを　みつけると　すぐに　かみつく。\nえものが　ヘトヘトに　なるまで　おいかけまわすが\nはんげきされると　しりごみする　ことも　あるよ。
records.english: At first sight, POOCHYENA takes a bite\nat anything that moves.\nThis POKéMON chases after prey until

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the victim becomes exhausted.\nHowever, it may turn tail if the prey\nstrikes back.

records.japanese: どうもうな　うなりごえを　あげながら　しせいを\nひくく　している　ときは　こうげきの　まえぶれ。\nするどく　とがった　キバで　がぶりと　かみつく。
records.english: MIGHTYENA gives obvious signals when\nit is preparing to attack. It starts to\ngrowl deeply and then flattens its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON will bite savagely with its\nsharply pointed fangs.

records.japanese: いつも　あっち　こっちへ　ジグザグ　あるくのは\nこうきしんが　とても　つよくて　めに　うつる\nいろんな　ものに　きょうみを　もつからだ。
records.english: ZIGZAGOON restlessly wanders\neverywhere at all times. This POKéMON\ndoes so because it is very curious.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It becomes interested in anything\nthat it happens to see.

records.japanese: まっすぐに　つっぱしり　しょうがいぶつが　ある\nときは　ちょっかくに　おれまがって　よける。\nゆるやかに　カーブした　みちが　とても　にがて。
records.english: LINOONE always runs full speed and only\nin straight lines. If facing an obstacle,\nit makes a right-angle turn to evade it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is very challenged by\ngently curving roads.

records.japanese: おしりの　トゲで　きの　かわを　はがして\nしみだした　じゅえきを　しょくりょうに　する。\nきゅうばんの　あしは　ガラスでも　すべらない。
records.english: Using the spikes on its rear end,  \nWURMPLE peels the bark off trees and\nfeeds on the sap that oozes out.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's feet are tipped with\nsuction pads that allow it to cling to\nglass without slipping.

records.japanese: おちない　ように　いとを　えだに　まきつけて\nからだを　ささえながら　しんかを　まっている。\nちいさな　あなから　そとの　ようすを　うかがう。
records.english: SILCOON tethers itself to a tree branch\nusing silk to keep from falling. There, \nthis POKéMON hangs quietly while it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: awaits evolution.\nIt peers out of the silk cocoon through\na small hole.

records.japanese: あまい　かふんが　だいこうぶつの　ポケモン。\nはなを　つけた　はちうえを　まどべに　おけば\nかふんを　あつめに　かならず　とんでくるよ。
records.english: BEAUTIFLY's favorite food is the sweet\npollen of flowers. If you want to see\nthis POKéMON, just leave a potted

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: flower by an open window. BEAUTIFLY\nis sure to come looking for pollen.

records.japanese: マユルドの　からだは　くちから　だした　ほそい\nいとが　からだを　つつみ　かたくなった　もの。\nマユの　なかで　しんかの　じゅんびを　している。
records.english: CASCOON makes its protective cocoon\nby wrapping its body entirely with a\nfine silk from its mouth. Once the silk

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: goes around its body, it hardens.\nThis POKéMON prepares for its evolution\ninside the cocoon.

records.japanese: あかりに　ひきよせられる　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nまちあかりに　さそわれた　ドクケイルの　むれが\nがいろじゅの　はっぱを　たべちらかしてしまう。
records.english: DUSTOX is instinctively drawn to light.\nSwarms of this POKéMON are attracted\nby the bright lights of cities, where

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: they wreak havoc by stripping the\nleaves off roadside trees for food.

records.japanese: いけや　みずうみの　すいめんに　ういて　くらす。\nはっぱが　かれると　よわってしまうが　きれいな\nみずを　もとめて　たまに　りくちを　いどうする。
records.english: LOTAD live in ponds and lakes, where\nthey float on the surface.\nIt grows weak if its broad leaf dies.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: On rare occasions, this POKéMON travels\non land in search of clean water.

records.japanese: ゆうぐれになると　かつどうする　やこうせい。\nつりびとを　みかけると　すいちゅうから　いとを\nひっぱり　ジャマをしては　よろこんでいる。
records.english: LOMBRE is nocturnal - it will get active\nafter dusk. It is also a mischief-maker.\nWhen this POKéMON spots anglers,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it tugs on their fishing lines from\nbeneath the surface and enjoys their\nconsternation.

records.japanese: ようきな　おんがくを　みみにすると　おどりだす。\nハイキングを　している　こどもの　がっしょうに\nさそわれて　すがたを　あらわすと　いわれている。
records.english: LUDICOLO begins dancing as soon as\nit hears cheerful, festive music.\nThis POKéMON is said to appear when it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: hears the singing of children on hiking\noutings.

records.japanese: あたまの　てっぺんを　きの　えだに　くっつけて\nぶらさがり　ながら　すいぶんを　すいとっている。\nみずを　のむほど　からだが　ツヤツヤ　ひかる。
records.english: SEEDOT attaches itself to a tree\nbranch using the top of its head.\nIt sucks moisture from the tree while

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: hanging off the branch.\nThe more water it drinks, the glossier\nthis POKéMON's body becomes.

records.japanese: うっそうと　しげった　もりに　すむ　ポケモン。\nたまに　もりを　でては　ひとを　おどろかせる。\nながい　はなを　つかまれるのは　だいきらい。
records.english: NUZLEAF live in densely overgrown\nforests. They occasionally venture out\nof the forest to startle people.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON dislikes having its long\nnose pinched.

records.japanese: じゅれい　１０００ねんを　こえた　たいぼくの\nてっぺんに　すむと　いわれる　なぞの　ポケモン。\nはっぱの　うちわで　きょうふうを　まきおこす。
records.english: SHIFTRY is a mysterious POKéMON that\nis said to live atop towering trees \ndating back over a thousand years.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It creates terrific windstorms with\nthe fans it holds.

records.japanese: どんな　つよい　あいてでも　ゆうかんに　いどむ。\nまけても　へこたれない　こんじょうの　もちぬし。\nおなかが　すくと　おおごえで　ないて　しまう。
records.english: TAILLOW courageously stands its\nground against foes, however strong\nthey may be.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This gutsy POKéMON will remain defiant\neven after a loss. On the other hand,\nit cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

records.japanese: はるか　じょうくうを　えんを　えがく　ように\nとびまわり　えものを　みつけると　きゅうこうか。\nあしの　ツメで　がっしり　つかんで　にがさない。
records.english: SWELLOW flies high above our heads,\nmaking graceful arcs in the sky.\nThis POKéMON dives at a steep angle as

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: soon as it spots its prey. The hapless\nprey is tightly grasped by SWELLOW's\nclawed feet, preventing escape.

records.japanese: エサや　だいじな　ものを　くちばしに　はさみ\nいろんな　ばしょに　かくす　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nかぜに　のって　すべる　ように　そらを　とぶ。
records.english: WINGULL has the habit of carrying prey\nand valuables in its beak and hiding\nthem in all sorts of locations.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON rides the winds and flies\nas if it were skating across the sky.

records.japanese: ちいさな　ポケモンや　タマゴを　クチバシに\nいれて　はこぶ　そらの　はこびやだ。\nうみべの　けわしい　がけに　すを　つくる。
records.english: PELIPPER is a flying transporter that\ncarries small POKéMON and eggs inside\nits massive bill.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON builds its nest on steep\ncliffs facing the sea.

records.japanese: あたまの　ツノで　ひとの　きもちを　かんじとる。\nひとまえには　めったに　すがたを　あらわさないが\nまえむきな　きもちを　キャッチすると　ちかよる。
records.english: RALTS senses the emotions of\npeople using the horns on its head.\nThis POKéMON rarely appears before

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: people. But when it does, it draws\ncloser if it senses that the person has\na positive disposition.

records.japanese: トレーナーの　あかるい　かんじょうに　ふれている\nキルリアは　うつくしく　せいちょうすると　いう。\nはったつした　のうで　サイコパワーを　あやつる。
records.english: It is said that a KIRLIA that is\nexposed to the positive emotions of\nits TRAINER grows beautiful.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON controls psychokinetic\npowers with its highly developed brain.

records.japanese: みらいを　よちする　のうりょくで　トレーナーの\nきけんを　さっちしたとき　さいだい　パワーの\nサイコエネルギーを　つかうと　いわれている。
records.english: GARDEVOIR has the ability to read the\nfuture. If it senses impending danger\nto its TRAINER, this POKéMON is said to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: unleash its psychokinetic energy at\nfull power.

records.japanese: つまさきから　あぶらが　にじみでて　いるので\nみずの　うえを　すべる　ように　あるけるのだ。\nいけや　みずうみの　びせいぶつを　たべている。
records.english: From the tips of its feet, SURSKIT\nsecretes an oil that enables it to walk\non water as if it were skating.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON feeds on microscopic\norganisms in ponds and lakes.

records.japanese: しょっかくの　めだま　もようで　てきを　いかく。\n４まいの　はねを　つかい　ヘリコプターの　ように\nくうちゅうで　ぜんごさゆう　じゆうに　すすめる。
records.english: MASQUERAIN intimidates enemies with\nthe eyelike patterns on its antennas.\nThis POKéMON flaps its four wings to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: freely fly in any direction - even\nsideways and backwards - as if it were\na helicopter.

records.japanese: ふかい　もりの　しめった　じめんに　せいそく。\nおちばの　したで　じっとしていることが　おおい。\nおちばが　つもって　できた　ふようどを　たべる。
records.english: SHROOMISH live in damp soil in the dark\ndepths of forests. They are often\nfound keeping still under fallen leaves.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON feeds on compost that\nis made up of fallen, rotted leaves.

records.japanese: かろやかな　フットワークで　てきに　ちかづき\nのびちぢみする　うでで　パンチを　くりだす。\nボクサー　かおまけの　テクニックの　もちぬし。
records.english: BRELOOM closes in on its foe with light\nand sprightly footwork, then throws\npunches with its stretchy arms.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's fighting technique puts\nboxers to shame.

records.japanese: １にち　２０じかん　いじょう　ねそべっている。\nほとんど　からだを　うごかさないので　はっぱを\n３まい　たべれば　１にちの　しょくじが　おわる。
records.english: SLAKOTH lolls around for over twenty\nhours every day. Because it moves so\nlittle, it does not need much food.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's sole daily meal consists\nof just three leaves.

records.japanese: いつも　あばれたくて　ウズウズ　している。\n１ぷんでも　すわっている　ことが　たえられない。\nうごいて　いないと　ストレスが　たまってしまう。
records.english: VIGOROTH is always itching and agitated\nto go on a wild rampage. It simply can't\ntolerate sitting still for even a minute.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's stress level rises if it\ncan't be moving constantly.

records.japanese: １にちじゅう　ねそべったまま　くらす　ポケモン。\nての　とどく　ばしょに　はえている　くさを　たべ\nくさが　なくなると　しぶしぶ　ばしょを　かえる。
records.english: SLAKING spends all day lying down and\nlolling about.\nIt eats grass growing within its reach.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it eats all the grass it can reach,\nthis POKéMON reluctantly moves to\nanother spot.

records.japanese: なんねんも　まっくらな　つちの　なかで　くらす。\nきの　ねっこから　えいようを　きゅうしゅうして\nじっと　うごかず　しんかの　ときを　まっている。
records.english: NINCADA lives underground for many\nyears in complete darkness.\nThis POKéMON absorbs nutrients from

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the roots of trees. It stays motionless\nas it waits for evolution.

records.japanese: こうそくで　うごきまわり　すがたが　みえない。\nなきごえしか　きこえて　こないので　ながいあいだ\nとうめいな　ポケモンと　かんがえられていた。
records.english: NINJASK moves around at such a high\nspeed that it cannot be seen, even\nwhile its crying can be clearly heard.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: For that reason, this POKéMON was long\nbelieved to be invisible.

records.japanese: かたい　からだは　ぴくりとも　うごかない。\nせなかから　からだの　くうどうを　のぞくと\nたましいを　すいとられると　しんじられている。
records.english: SHEDINJA's hard body doesn't move -\nnot even a twitch. In fact, its body\nappears to be merely a hollow shell.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is believed that this POKéMON will\nsteal the spirit of anyone peering into\nits hollow body from its back.

records.japanese: ふだんは　ちゅういしないと　ききとれない　くらい\nちいさな　こえだが　きけんを　さっち　すると\nずつうを　おこす　ほどの　おおごえで　なきだす。
records.english: Normally, WHISMUR's voice is very quiet -\nit is barely audible even if one is\npaying close attention.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, if this POKéMON senses danger,\nit starts crying at an earsplitting\nvolume.

records.japanese: もくぞうの　いえを　コナゴナに　ふきとばすほどの\nおおごえを　だして　あいてを　いためつける。\nまるい　みみが　スピーカーの　はたらきを　する。
records.english: LOUDRED's bellowing can completely\ndecimate a wood-frame house. It uses\nits voice to punish its foes.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's round ears serve as\nloudspeakers.

records.japanese: おおごえの　しんどうで　じしんを　おこす。\nからだの　あなから　くうきを　はげしく　すいこみ\nはじめたら　おおごえを　だす　まえぶれだ。
records.english: EXPLOUD triggers earthquakes with the\ntremors it creates by bellowing. If this\nPOKéMON violently inhales from the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: ports on its body, it's a sign that it is\npreparing to let loose a huge bellow.

records.japanese: なんかい　たおされても　あきらめず　たちあがる。\nたちあがるたび　しんかするための　エネルギーが\nからだの　なかに　どんどん　たくわえられていく。
records.english: MAKUHITA is tenacious - it will keep\ngetting up and attacking its foe\nhowever many times it is knocked down.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Every time it gets back up, this\nPOKéMON stores more energy in its body\nfor evolving.

records.japanese: いろんな　ばしょで　はりての　けいこに　はげむ。\nきょうれつな　はりて　こうげきを　くらうと\nでんしんばしらも　いちげきで　まっぷたつだ。
records.english: HARIYAMA practices its straight-arm\nslaps in any number of locations.\nOne hit of this POKéMON's powerful,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: openhanded, straight-arm punches\ncould snap a telephone pole in two.

records.japanese: なげなわの　ようりょうで　しっぽを　ふりまわし\nなげた　ときの　ちからで　とんでいく。\nさいこう　１０メートル　とんだ　きろくが　ある。
records.english: AZURILL spins its tail as if it were a\nlasso, then hurls it far. The momentum\nof the throw sends its body flying, too.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Using this unique action, one of these\nPOKéMON managed to hurl itself a record\n33 feet.

records.japanese: じしゃくの　はなは　いつも　きたを　むいている。\nノズパスどうしは　じしゃくが　はんぱつしあうため\nちかくで　かおを　あわせる　ことが　できない。
records.english: NOSEPASS's magnetic nose is always\npointed to the north. If two of these\nPOKéMON meet, they cannot turn

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: their faces to each other when they\nare close because their magnetic noses\nrepel one another.

records.japanese: うごく　ものを　みつけると　むちゅうに　なって\nおいかけまわす　しゅうせいを　もつ　ポケモン。\nじぶんの　シッポを　おいかけて　めを　まわす。
records.english: SKITTY has the habit of becoming\nfascinated by moving objects and\nchasing them around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is known to chase after\nits own tail and become dizzy.

records.japanese: マイペースで　じゆうきままな　くらしを　このむ。\nきのむくまま　エサを　たべたり　ねむったり\nしているので　１にちの　リズムが　バラバラだ。
records.english: DELCATTY prefers to live an unfettered\nexistence in which it can do as it\npleases at its own pace.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Because this POKéMON eats and sleeps\nwhenever it decides, its daily routines\nare completely random.

records.japanese: どうくつの　おくで　ひっそりと　せいかつする。\nくらやみで　ひとみが　あやしく　かがやく　とき\nひとの　たましいを　うばうと　おそれられている。
records.english: SABLEYE lead quiet lives deep inside\ncaverns. They are feared, however,\nbecause these POKéMON are thought to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: steal the spirits of people when their\neyes burn with a sinister glow in the\ndarkness.

records.japanese: はがねの　ツノが　へんけいした　おおきな　あご。\nおとなしそうな　かおに　ゆだんを　していると\nとつぜん　ふりむき　バクリと　かみつかれるぞ。
records.english: MAWILE's huge jaws are actually steel\nhorns that have been transformed.\nIts docile-looking face serves to lull

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its foe into letting down its guard.\nWhen the foe least expects it, MAWILE\nchomps it with its gaping jaws.

records.japanese: はがねの　からだを　つくるため　てっこうせきを\nやまから　ほりだして　たべているが　たまに\nはしや　レールを　たべてしまう　こまりものだ。
records.english: This POKéMON has a body of steel.\nTo make its body, ARON feeds on\niron ore that it digs from mountains.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Occasionally, it causes major trouble by\neating bridges and rails.

records.japanese: えいよう　まんてんの　わきみずを　おなかいっぱい\nのむ　ことで　はがねの　からだが　きたえられる。\nおいしい　わきみずの　ちかくに　すを　つくる。
records.english: LAIRON tempers its steel body by\ndrinking highly nutritious mineral\nspringwater until it is bloated.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON makes its nest close to\nsprings of delicious water.

records.japanese: やま　ひとつを　じぶんの　なわばりに　していて\nあらした　あいては　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nいつも　やまの　なかを　みまわり　している。
records.english: AGGRON claims an entire mountain as its\nown territory. It mercilessly beats up\nanything that violates its environment.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON vigilantly patrols its\nterritory at all times.

records.japanese: やまおくで　ヨガの　しゅぎょうを　している。\nめいそうを　していても　しゅうちゅうりょくが\nとぎれてしまうため　しゅぎょうは　おわらない。
records.english: MEDITITE undertakes rigorous mental\ntraining deep in the mountains.\nHowever, whenever it meditates, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON always loses its concentration\nand focus. As a result, its training\nnever ends.

records.japanese: めいそうする　ことで　からだの　エネルギーが\nたかまり　だい６かんが　するどくなる　という。\nのやまと　いったいになって　けはいを　けす。
records.english: It is said that through meditation,\nMEDICHAM heightens energy inside\nits body and sharpens its sixth sense.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON hides its presence by\nmerging itself with fields and\nmountains.

records.japanese: ながい　たいもうに　でんきを　ためている。\nでんりゅうで　あしの　きんにくを　しげきして\nばくはつてきな　しゅんぱつりょくを　うみだす。
records.english: ELECTRIKE stores electricity in its\nlong body hair. This POKéMON stimulates\nits leg muscles with electric charges.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These jolts of power give its legs\nexplosive acceleration performance.

records.japanese: たてがみから　いつも　ほうでんしているため\nひばなで　やまかじを　おこしてしまう　ことも。\nたたかいに　なると　かみなりぐもを　つくりだす。
records.english: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging\nelectricity from its mane. The sparks\nsometimes ignite forest fires.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When it enters a battle, this POKéMON\ncreates thunderclouds.

records.japanese: いつも　なかまを　おうえんしている　ポケモン。\nなかまが　がんばると　からだを　ショートさせて\nパチパチと　ひばなの　おとを　たてて　よろこぶ。
records.english: PLUSLE always acts as a cheerleader\nfor its partners. Whenever a teammate\nputs out a good effort in battle, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON shorts out its body to create\nthe crackling noises of sparks to show\nits joy.

records.japanese: じぶんよりも　なかまの　おうえんが　だいじ。\nからだから　はっする　でんきを　ショートさせて\nはでに　ひばなを　だしながら　おうえんするぞ。
records.english: MINUN is more concerned about cheering\non its partners than its own safety.\nIt shorts out the electricity in its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: body to create brilliant showers of\nsparks to cheer on its teammates.

records.japanese: ひが　くれると　しっぽから　ひかりを　だして\nあかるさや　てんめつで　なかまと　かいわする。\nイルミーゼの　あまい　かおりに　ひきよせられる。
records.english: With the arrival of night, VOLBEAT emits\nlight from its tail. It communicates with\nothers by adjusting the intensity and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: flashing of its light.\nThis POKéMON is attracted by the sweet\naroma of ILLUMISE.

records.japanese: あまい　かおりで　バルビートを　ひきよせる。\nたくさん　あつまった　バルビートを　ゆうどうして\nよぞらに　きかがくてきな　ずけいを　えがくぞ。
records.english: ILLUMISE attracts a swarm of VOLBEAT\nusing a sweet fragrance. Once the\nVOLBEAT have gathered, this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: leads the lit-up swarm in drawing\ngeometric designs on the canvas of\nthe night sky.

records.japanese: りょうての　はなを　ねらう　あいてには\nするどい　トゲを　とばして　こうげきする。\nはなの　かおりは　きもちを　なごませる。
records.english: ROSELIA shoots sharp thorns as\nprojectiles at any opponent that tries\nto steal the flowers on its arms.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The aroma of this POKéMON brings\nserenity to living things.

records.japanese: からだの　ほとんどが　いぶくろで　できているので\nじぶんと　おなじ　おおきさの　ものも　のみこむ。\nとくしゅな　いえきで　なんでも　しょうかするぞ。
records.english: Virtually all of GULPIN's body is its\nstomach. As a result, it can swallow\nsomething its own size.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's stomach contains a\nspecial fluid that digests anything.

records.japanese: えものを　みつけると　けあなから　もうどくの\nたいえきを　ふきだして　あびせかけるぞ。\nよわった　ところを　おおきな　くちで　ペロリ。
records.english: When SWALOT spots prey, it spurts out\na hideously toxic fluid from its pores\nand sprays the target.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once the prey has weakened, this\nPOKéMON gulps it down whole with its\ncavernous mouth.

records.japanese: はったつした　アゴと　するどく　とがった　キバは\nふなぞこを　かみちぎる　ほどの　はかいりょく。\nキバニアに　おそわれ　しずんだ　ふねは　おおい。
records.english: CARVANHA's strongly developed jaws\nand its sharply pointed fangs pack the\ndestructive power to rip out boat hulls.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Many boats have been attacked and\nsunk by this POKéMON.

records.japanese: うみのギャングと　よばれ　おそれられている。\nおれても　すぐに　はえかわる　キバを　もち\nおおがたタンカーも　１ぴきで　バラバラに　する。
records.english: Nicknamed “the bully of the sea,”\nSHARPEDO is widely feared.\nIts cruel fangs grow back immediately

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: if they snap off.\nJust one of these POKéMON can\nthoroughly tear apart a supertanker.

records.japanese: めの　うえに　ついている　はなの　あなから\nからだに　ためた　かいすいを　ふきだし\nひとを　おどろかすのが　だいすきな　ポケモンだ。
records.english: WAILMER's nostrils are located above\nits eyes. This playful POKéMON loves\nto startle people by forcefully snorting

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: out seawater it stores inside its body\nout of its nostrils.

records.japanese: みつかった　なかでは　さいだいの　ポケモン。\nおおうなばらを　ゆったりと　およぎ　おおきな\nくちで　いっきに　たいりょうの　エサを　たべる。
records.english: WAILORD is the largest of all identified\nPOKéMON up to now.\nThis giant POKéMON swims languorously

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: in the vast open sea, eating massive\namounts of food at once with its\nenormous mouth.

records.japanese: たたかれても　きが　つかない　にぶさ　だが\nくうふくは　１びょうでも　がまん　できない。\nからだの　なかでは　マグマが　にえたぎっている。
records.english: NUMEL is extremely dull witted - it\ndoesn't notice being hit. However, it\ncan't stand hunger for even a second.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's body is a seething\ncauldron of boiling magma.

records.japanese: からだの　なかに　かざんを　もつ　ポケモンだ。\nからだに　たまった　せっし　１まんどの　マグマを\nときどき　せなかの　コブから　ふきあげている。
records.english: CAMERUPT has a volcano inside its body.\nMagma of 18,000 degrees F courses\nthrough its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Occasionally, the humps on this\nPOKéMON's back erupt, spewing the\nsuperheated magma.

records.japanese: やまを　ほって　せきたんを　みつけては　せっせと\nこうらの　くうどうに　いれて　もやす　ポケモン。\nおそわれると　くろい　けむりを　だして　にげる。
records.english: TORKOAL digs through mountains in\nsearch of coal. If it finds some, it fills\nhollow spaces on its shell with the coal

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and burns it.\nIf it is attacked, this POKéMON spouts\nthick black smoke to beat a retreat.

records.japanese: シッポで　びょんびょん　とびはねる　ポケモン。\nとびはねる　しんどうで　しんぞうを　うごかして\nいるので　とびはねる　ことは　やめられないのだ。
records.english: SPOINK bounces around on its tail.\nThe shock of its bouncing makes its\nheart pump. As a result, this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: cannot afford to stop bouncing - if it\nstops, its heart will stop.

records.japanese: サイコパワーの　はどうを　くろしんじゅで　つよめ\nじゆうじざいに　あいてを　あやつる　ポケモン。\nちからを　つかうとき　はないきが　あらくなるぞ。
records.english: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its\nbody to amplify its psychic power waves\nfor gaining total control over its foe.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When this POKéMON uses its special\npower, its snorting breath grows\nlabored.

records.japanese: よのなかに　いる　パッチールは　みんな　ちがう\nところに　ブチもようが　あると　いわれている。\nおぼつかない　あゆみが　おどりのように　みえる。
records.english: All the SPINDA that exist in the\nworld are said to have utterly unique\nspot patterns.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The shaky, tottering steps of this\nPOKéMON give it the appearance of\ndancing.

records.japanese: すりばちじょうの　すあなの　そこで　じっと\nえものが　おちて　くるのを　まちつづけている。\nおおきな　アゴは　いわをも　くだく　いりょく。
records.english: TRAPINCH's nest is a sloped, bowl-like\npit dug in sand. This POKéMON patiently\nwaits for prey to tumble down the pit.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Its giant jaws have enough strength\nto crush even boulders.

records.japanese: ２まいの　ハネを　はげしく　しんどうさせて\nちょうおんぱを　だし　えものを　きぜつさせる。\nにんげんも　ずつうを　おこす　ほどの　いりょく。
records.english: To make prey faint, VIBRAVA generates\nultrasonic waves by vigorously making\nits two wings vibrate.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's ultrasonic waves are so\npowerful, they can bring on headaches\nin people.

records.japanese: さばくの　せいれいと　よばれる　ポケモン。\nハネの　はばたきで　すなを　まいあげるため\nとんでいる　ときは　いつも　すなあらしの　なか。
records.english: FLYGON is nicknamed “the elemental \nspirit of the desert.” Because its\nflapping wings whip up a cloud of sand,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON is always enveloped in a\nsandstorm while flying.

records.japanese: さばく　など　かんそうした　ちいきに　せいそく。\nつよい　はなの　かおりで　えものを　さそいこみ\nするどい　からだの　トゲを　とばして　しとめる。
records.english: CACNEA lives in arid locations such\nas deserts. It releases a strong aroma\nfrom its flower to attract prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When prey comes near, this POKéMON\nshoots sharp thorns from its body to\nbring the victim down.

records.japanese: さばくの　ひざしで　すいぶんを　うしなわない\nように　ひるまは　じっと　たちつくしている。\nきおんの　さがる　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。
records.english: During the daytime, CACTURNE remains\nunmoving so that it does not lose any\nmoisture to the harsh desert sun.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON becomes active at night\nwhen the temperature drops.

records.japanese: わたぐもの　ような　ふさふさの　つばさを　もつ。\nひとを　こわがらず　わたの　ぼうし　みたいに\nあたまに　ちょこんと　のっかる　ポケモンだ。
records.english: SWABLU has light and fluffy wings that\nare like cottony clouds. This POKéMON\nis not frightened of people.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It lands on the heads of people and\nsits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

records.japanese: わたぐもに　まぎれて　おおぞらを　まう。\nすきとおった　こえで　メロディを　さえずれば\nみみにした　ものは　うっとり　ゆめごこち。
records.english: ALTARIA dances and wheels through the\nsky among billowing, cotton-like clouds.\nBy singing melodies in its crystal-clear

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: voice, this POKéMON makes its listeners\nexperience dreamy wonderment.

records.japanese: しゅくてき　ハブネークとの　たたかいの　きおくが\nからだじゅうの　さいぼうに　きざみこまれている。\nびんしょうな　みのこなしで　こうげきを　かわす。
records.english: Memories of battling its arch-rival\nSEVIPER are etched into every cell of\nZANGOOSE's body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON adroitly dodges attacks\nwith incredible agility.

records.japanese: せんぞだいだい　ザングースと　たたかってきた。\nからだの　キズは　はげしい　たたかいの　しるし。\nするどい　きれあじの　しっぽで　こうげきするぞ。
records.english: SEVIPER shares a generations-long\nfeud with ZANGOOSE. The scars on its\nbody are evidence of vicious battles.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON attacks using its sword-\nedged tail.

records.japanese: いんせきの　おちた　ばしょから　みつかったため\nうちゅうから　やってきた　ポケモンという　せつも\nあるが　まだ　しょうめいされていない。
records.english: LUNATONE was discovered at a location\nwhere a meteorite fell. As a result, some\npeople theorize that this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: came from space. However, no one has\nbeen able to prove this theory so far.

records.japanese: うちゅうから　おちてきたと　いわれる　しんしゅ。\nくうちゅうに　うかび　おともなく　いどうする。\nたたかいに　なると　つよい　ひかりを　はなつ。
records.english: SOLROCK is a new species of POKéMON\nthat is said to have fallen from space.\nIt floats in air and moves silently.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In battle, this POKéMON releases\nintensely bright light.

records.japanese: びんかんな　ヒゲは　すぐれた　レーダーだ。\nドロの　なかから　２ほんの　ヒゲだけを　だして\nえものが　ちかよってくるのを　まちかまえている。
records.english: BARBOACH's sensitive whiskers serve\nas a superb radar system.\nThis POKéMON hides in mud, leaving only

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its two whiskers exposed while it waits\nfor prey to come along.

records.japanese: なわばり　いしきが　とても　つよい　ポケモン。\nおおきな　ぬま　ぜんぶを　なわばりに　している。\nてきが　ちかづくと　あばれて　じしんを　おこす。
records.english: WHISCASH is extremely territorial.\nJust one of these POKéMON will claim a\nlarge pond as its exclusive territory.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If a foe approaches it, it thrashes\nabout and triggers a massive\nearthquake.

records.japanese: もともと　がいこくに　すんでいた　ポケモンを\nペットとして　つれてきた　ものが　やせいかした。\nせいめいりょくが　つよいので　どんどん　ふえた。
records.english: CORPHISH were originally foreign\nPOKéMON that were imported as pets.\nThey eventually turned up in the wild.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is very hardy and has\ngreatly increased its population.

records.japanese: すぐに　たたかいを　いどむ　きしょうの　あらさ。\nシザリガーの　すむ　いけには　ほかの　いきものが\nすみつかず　さみしい　ばしょに　なってしまう。
records.english: CRAWDAUNT has an extremely violent\nnature that compels it to challenge\nother living things to battle.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Other life-forms refuse to live in\nponds inhabited by this POKéMON,\nmaking them desolate places.

records.japanese: いっぽんあしで　かいてん　しながら　いどうする。\nヤジロンと　にんげんが　いっしょに　くらす\nこだいの　へきがが　いせきから　はっけんされた。
records.english: BALTOY moves while spinning around on\nits one foot. Primitive wall paintings\ndepicting this POKéMON living among

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: people were discovered in some ancient\nruins.

records.japanese: こだいじんの　どろにんぎょうが　かいこうせんを\nあびて　せいめいを　やどしたと　いわれている。\nくうちゅうに　ういて　いどうしている。
records.english: CLAYDOL are said to be dolls of mud made\nby primitive humans and brought to life\nby exposure to a mysterious ray.

records.japanese: [NULL]
やく　１おくねんまえに　ぜつめつした　ポケモン。\nかいていの　いわに　くっつき　はなびらの　ような\nしょくしゅで　よってきた　えものを　つかまえる。
records.english: LILEEP became extinct approximately\na hundred million years ago.\nThis ancient POKéMON attaches itself

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: to a rock on the seafloor and catches\napproaching prey using tentacles \nshaped like flower petals.

records.japanese: うみの　そこで　エサを　さがして　あるきまわる。\nきの　えだの　ような　くびを　じざいに　のばして\n８まいの　しょくしゅで　えものを　つかまえる。
records.english: CRADILY roams around the ocean floor\nin search of food. This POKéMON freely\nextends its tree trunk-like neck and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: captures unwary prey using its eight\ntentacles.

records.japanese: たいこの　かせきから　よみがえった　ポケモン。\nあたたかい　うみに　せいそくし　はったつした\n２ほんの　ツメで　えものを　がっちり　つかむ。
records.english: ANORITH was regenerated from a\nprehistoric fossil. This primitive\nPOKéMON once lived in warm seas.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It grips its prey firmly between its\ntwo large claws.

records.japanese: こうらは　あらゆる　こうげきを　はねかえす。\nのび　ちぢみする　きょだいな　２ほんの　ツメは\nてっぱんを　くしざしにする　ほどの　いりょくだ。
records.english: ARMALDO's tough armor makes all attacks\nbounce off. This POKéMON's two\nenormous claws can be freely extended

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: or contracted. They have the power to\npunch right through a steel slab.

records.japanese: うまれつき　ヒレが　ボロボロで　みっともないため\nだれにも　あいてに　されない　ポケモンだ。\nうみと　かわの　どちらでも　せいかつできる。
records.english: FEEBAS's fins are ragged and\ntattered from the start of its life.\nBecause of its shoddy appearance, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON is largely ignored.\nIt is capable of living in both the sea\nand in rivers.

records.japanese: もっとも　うつくしい　ポケモンと　いわれている。\nいかりや　にくしみの　こころを　いやして\nあらそいを　しずめる　ちからを　もっている。
records.english: MILOTIC is said to be the most\nbeautiful of all the POKéMON.\nIt has the power to becalm such

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: emotions as anger and hostility to quell\nbitter feuding.

records.japanese: てんきに　よって　すがたが　かわる　ポケモン。\nちいさい　からだを　まもる　ために　だいしぜんの\nおおきな　パワーを　つかえる　ように　なった。
records.english: CASTFORM's appearance changes with\nthe weather.\nThis POKéMON gained the ability to use

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the vast power of nature to protect\nits tiny body.

records.japanese: からだの　いろを　じざいに　かえる　ことで\nまわりの　けしきに　とけこむ　ことが　できる。\nおなかの　ギザギザもよう　だけは　かえられない。
records.english: KECLEON is capable of changing its body\ncolors at will to blend in with its\nsurroundings.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There is one exception - this POKéMON\ncan't change the zigzag pattern on its\nbelly.

records.japanese: ねたみ　うらみの　かんじょうに　ひきよせられる。\nだれかを　うらむ　こころが　つよく　なると\nカゲボウズが　のきしたに　ずらりと　ならぶぞ。
records.english: SHUPPET is attracted by feelings\nof jealousy and vindictiveness.\nIf someone develops strong feelings of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: vengeance, this POKéMON will appear\nin a swarm and line up beneath the eaves\nof that person's home.

records.japanese: じぶんの　からだを　はりで　キズつける　とき\nつよい　のろいの　エネルギーが　はっせいする。\nもとは　すてられた　かわいそうな　ぬいぐるみ。
records.english: BANETTE generates energy for laying\nstrong curses by sticking pins into its\nown body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON was originally a pitiful\nplush doll that was thrown away.

records.japanese: どんなに　あつい　カベも　とおりぬける。\nねらわれたら　さいご　あさひが　のぼるまで\nずっと　おいかけられる　ことに　なるぞ。
records.english: DUSKULL can pass through any wall no\nmatter how thick it may be.\nOnce this POKéMON chooses a target,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it will doggedly pursue the intended\nvictim until the break of dawn.

records.japanese: からだの　なかみは　くうどうで　なにも　ない。\nブラックホールの　ように　なんでも　すいこみ\nすいこまれると　もどって　これないと　いわれる。
records.english: DUSCLOPS's body is completely hollow -\nthere is nothing at all inside.\nIt is said that its body is like a black

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: hole. This POKéMON will absorb anything\ninto its body, but nothing will ever come\nback out.

records.japanese: くびの　フサは　あまくて　こどもに　だいにんき。\nくだものが　だいこうぶつで　たべつづけて　いたら\nくびに　くだものが　できるように　なったらしい。
records.english: The bunches of fruit around TROPIUS's\nneck are very popular with children.\nThis POKéMON loves fruit, and eats it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: continuously. Apparently, its love for\nfruit resulted in its own outgrowth\nof fruit.

records.japanese: こえを　からだの　くうどうに　はんきょうさせる。\nおこった　ときの　なきごえは　てきを　ふきとばす\nいりょくを　もった　ちょうおんぱに　なるぞ。
records.english: CHIMECHO makes its cries echo\ninside its hollow body. When this\nPOKéMON becomes enraged, its cries

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: result in ultrasonic waves that have\nthe power to knock foes flying.

records.japanese: アブソルが　ひとまえに　あらわれると　かならず\nじしんや　つなみなどの　さいがいが　おこったので\nわざわいポケモン　という　べつめいで　よばれた。
records.english: Every time ABSOL appears before people,\nit is followed by a disaster such as an\nearthquake or a tidal wave.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, it came to be known as the\ndisaster POKéMON.

records.japanese: いつも　ニコニコ　えがおの　ソーナノ。\nおこっているときは　しっぽに　ちゅうもく。\nじめんを　パタパタ　たたいているぞ。
records.english: WYNAUT can always be seen with a big,\nhappy smile on its face. Look at its tail\nto determine if it is angry.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When angered, this POKéMON will be\nslapping the ground with its tail.

records.japanese: ゆきの　おおい　とちで　くらす　ポケモン。\nはるや　なつの　ゆきの　ふらない　きせつには\nしょうにゅうどうの　おくで　しずかに　くらす。
records.english: SNORUNT live in regions with heavy\nsnowfall. In seasons without snow, such\nas spring and summer, this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: steals away to live quietly among\nstalactites and stalagmites deep in\ncaverns.

records.japanese: いわの　からだを　こおりの　よろいで　かためた。\nくうきちゅうの　すいぶんを　こおらせて　じゆうな\nかたちに　かえる　のうりょくを　もつ　ポケモン。
records.english: GLALIE has a body made of rock, which it\nhardens with an armor of ice.\nThis POKéMON has the ability to freeze

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: moisture in the atmosphere into any\nshape it desires.

records.japanese: あるくより　ころがる　ほうが　だんぜん　はやい。\nしょくじの　じかんは　みんなが　いっせいに　てを\nたたいて　よろこぶので　けっこう　うるさいのだ。
records.english: SPHEAL is much faster rolling than \nwalking to get around. When groups of\nthis POKéMON eat, they all clap at once

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: to show their pleasure. Because of this,\ntheir mealtimes are noisy.

records.japanese: はじめて　めにした　ものは　かならず　はなで\nクルクル　まわしてみる　しゅうせいを　もつ。\nタマザラシを　まわして　あそぶ　ことが　ある。
records.english: SEALEO has the habit of always juggling\non the tip of its nose anything it sees\nfor the first time.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON occasionally entertains\nitself by balancing and rolling a SPHEAL\non its nose.

records.japanese: はったつした　２ほんの　キバは　１０トンも　ある\nひょうざんを　いちげきで　ふんさいする。\nしぼうが　ぶあつく　ひょうてんかでも　へいき。
records.english: WALREIN's two massively developed\ntusks can totally shatter blocks of\nice weighing ten tons with one blow.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's thick coat of blubber\ninsulates it from subzero temperatures.

records.japanese: がんじょうな　カラは　みを　まもる　だけではなく\nえものを　はさんで　つかまえる　ことも　できる。\nそだった　パールルの　かいがらは　キズだらけ。
records.english: CLAMPERL's sturdy shell is not only good\nfor protection - it is also used for\nclamping and catching prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: A fully grown CLAMPERL's shell will be\nscored with nicks and scratches all\nover.

records.japanese: とても　ふかい　うみの　そこに　すんでいるため\nながい　あいだ　ひとに　みつからなかった。\nくらい　しんかいでも　よく　みえる　めを　もつ。
records.english: HUNTAIL's presence went unnoticed by\npeople for a long time because it lives\nat extreme depths in the sea.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's eyes can see clearly\neven in the murky dark depths of the\nocean.

records.japanese: みなみの　しんかいに　せいそくする　ポケモン。\nしんかいの　すいあつに　きたえられた　からだは\nちょっとの　こうげきでは　キズも　つかない。
records.english: GOREBYSS lives in the southern seas\nat extreme depths. Its body is built to\nwithstand the enormous pressure of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: water at incredible depths. Because of\nthis, this POKéMON's body is unharmed\nby ordinary attacks.

records.japanese: １おくねんの　ながい　あいだ　まったく　すがたが\nかわらずに　しんかいで　くらしていた　ポケモン。\nはの　ない　くちで　びせいぶつだけを　たべる。
records.english: RELICANTH is a POKéMON species that\nexisted for a hundred million years\nwithout ever changing its form.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This ancient POKéMON feeds on\nmicroscopic organisms with its\ntoothless mouth.

records.japanese: ねったいの　あさい　うみで　くらしている。\nカップルを　みつけると　うしろに　くっついて\nおよぐ　ことから　この　なまえが　つけられた。
records.english: LUVDISC live in shallow seas in the\ntropics. This heart-shaped POKéMON\nearned its name by swimming after

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: loving couples it spotted in the\nocean's waves.

records.japanese: おおぞらを　とぶことを　ゆめみて　くりかえし\nだんがいから　とびおりている　うちに　あたまが\nきたえられ　こうてつの　ように　かたく　なった。
records.english: BAGON has a dream of one day soaring\nin the sky. In doomed efforts to fly,\nthis POKéMON hurls itself off cliffs.
