records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result of its dives, its head has \ngrown tough and as hard as tempered\nsteel.

records.japanese: かたい　カラの　ないぶは　さいぼうが　へんかして\nあたらしい　からだを　つくっている　さいちゅう。\nカラが　とても　おもいので　うごきは　にぶいぞ。
records.english: Inside SHELGON's armor-like shell, cells\nare in the midst of transformation\nto create an entirely new body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's shell is extremely heavy,\nmaking its movements sluggish.

records.japanese: つばさが　ほしいと　つよく　おもい　つづけてきた\nけっか　からだの　さいぼうが　とつぜんへんいを\nおこし　みごとな　つばさが　はえてきたと　いう。
records.english: SALAMENCE came about as a result of a\nstrong, long-held dream of growing\nwings. It is said that this powerful

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: desire triggered a sudden mutation in\nthis POKéMON's cells, causing it to\nsprout its magnificent wings.

records.japanese: からだの　なかでは　けつえきの　かわりに\nきょうりょくな　じりょくが　めぐっている。\nじりょくの　はどうで　なかまと　かいわする。
records.english: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic\nforce courses throughout BELDUM's\nbody. This POKéMON communicates with

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: others by sending controlled pulses of\nmagnetism.

records.japanese: ２ひきの　ダンバルが　がったいした　すがた。\n２つの　のうを　じりょくの　しんけいが　むすぶ\nことで　つよい　サイコエネルギーを　うみだす。
records.english: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG\nis formed. The brains of the BELDUM are\njoined by a magnetic nervous system.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: By linking its brains magnetically,\nthis POKéMON generates strong\npsychokinetic power.

records.japanese: ４つの　のうみそは　スーパーコンピュータよりも\nはやく　むずかしい　けいさんの　こたえを　だす。\n４ほんあしを　おりたたみ　くうちゅうに　うかぶ。
records.english: METAGROSS has four brains in total.\nCombined, the four brains can breeze\nthrough difficult calculations faster

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: than a supercomputer.\nThis POKéMON can float in the air by\ntucking in its four legs.

records.japanese: むかし　ひとに　ふういんされた　ポケモン。\nたたかいで　からだが　くずれると　じぶんで\nあたらしい　いわを　さがして　なおすと　いう。
records.english: REGIROCK was sealed away by people\nlong ago. If this POKéMON's body is\ndamaged in battle, it is said to seek

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: out suitable rocks on its own to repair\nitself.

records.japanese: ひょうがじだいに　つくられた　こおりの　からだは\nほのおでも　とかす　ことが　できない。\nマイナス　２００どの　れいきを　あやつる。
records.english: REGICE's body was made during an ice\nage. The deep-frozen body can't be\nmelted, even by fire.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON controls frigid air of\nminus 328 degrees F.

records.japanese: どんな　きんぞくよりも　かたい　からだを　もつ。\nからだの　なかは　くうどうに　なっているらしく\nたべている　ものも　わからない　ポケモンだ。
records.english: REGISTEEL has a body that is harder\nthan any kind of metal.\nIts body is apparently hollow.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: No one has any idea what this POKéMON\neats.

records.japanese: にんげんの　こころを　びんかんに　かんじとる。\nてきいを　キャッチすると　ぜんしんの　はねを\nさかだてて　はげしく　なきごえで　いかくする。
records.english: LATIAS is highly sensitive to the\nemotions of people. If it senses any\nhostility, this POKéMON ruffles the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: feathers all over its body and cries\nshrilly to intimidate the foe.

records.japanese: みた　ものや　かんがえた　イメージを　あいてに\nえいぞうとして　みせる　のうりょくを　もつ。\nにんげんの　ことばを　りかいすることが　できる。
records.english: LATIOS has the ability to make its foe\nsee an image of what it has seen or\nimagines in its head.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is intelligent and\nunderstands human speech.

records.japanese: そら　いちめんを　おおう　あまぐもを　つくりだし\nおおあめを　ふらせる　ちからを　もつ　ポケモン。\nかんばつに　くるしむ　ひとびとを　すくった。
records.english: KYOGRE has the power to create massive\nrain clouds that cover the entire sky\nand bring about torrential downpours.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON saved people who were\nsuffering from droughts.

records.japanese: だいちを　もりあげて　たいりくを　ひろげた\nポケモンと　しんわで　かたり　つがれている。\nカイオーガと　しとうの　すえ　ねむりに　ついた。
records.english: GROUDON has long been described in \nmythology as the POKéMON that raised\nlands and expanded continents.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON took to sleep after a\ncataclysmic battle with KYOGRE.

records.japanese: なんおくねんも　オゾンそうの　なかを　とびつづけ\nけっして　ちじょうには　おりてこない　ポケモン。\nくうきちゅうの　チリと　みずを　たべるらしい。
records.english: RAYQUAZA lived for hundreds of millions\nof years in the earth's ozone layer, \nnever descending to the ground.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON appears to feed on water\nand particles in the atmosphere.

records.japanese: めざめた　とき　あたまの　たんざくに　かかれた\nねがいを　かなえると　いう　でんせつを　もつ。\nきけんを　かんじると　ねむったまま　たたかう。
records.english: A legend states that JIRACHI will make\ntrue any wish that is written on notes\nattached to its head when it awakens.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If this POKéMON senses danger, it will\nfight without awakening.

records.japanese: レーザーを　あびた　うちゅうウィルスの　ＤＮＡが\nとつぜんへんいを　おこして　うまれた　ポケモン。\nむねの　すいしょうたいが　のうみそ　らしい。
records.english: The DNA of a space virus underwent a\nsudden mutation upon exposure to a\nlaser beam and resulted in DEOXYS.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The crystalline organ on this POKéMON's\nchest appears to be its brain.

records.japanese: あたらしく　はっけんされたポケモン\nげんざい　ちょうさちゅう
records.english: This is a newly discovered POKéMON.\nIt is currently under investigation.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: No detailed information is available\nat this time.

records.japanese: ひなたで　ひるねを　する　すがたを　みかける。\nたいようの　ひかりを　いっぱい　あびることで\nせなかの　タネが　おおきく　そだつのだ。
records.english: BULBASAUR can be seen napping in\nbright sunlight.\nThere is a seed on its back.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: By soaking up the sun's rays, the seed\ngrows progressively larger.

records.japanese: つぼみを　ささえるため　あしこしが　つよくなる。\nひなたで　じっとする　じかんが　ながくなれば\nいよいよ　たいりんの　はなが　さくころだ。
records.english: There is a bud on this POKéMON's back.\nTo support its weight, IVYSAUR's legs\nand trunk grow thick and strong.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it starts spending more time lying\nin the sunlight, it's a sign that the\nbud will bloom into a large flower soon.

records.japanese: じゅうぶんな　えいようと　たいようの　ひかりが\nはなの　いろを　あざやかに　すると　いわれる。\nはなの　かおりは　ひとの　こころを　いやす。
records.english: There is a large flower on VENUSAUR's\nback. The flower is said to take on vivid\ncolors if it gets plenty of nutrition

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and sunlight. The flower's aroma\nsoothes the emotions of people.

records.japanese: しっぽの　ほのおは　きぶんを　ひょうげん。\nたのしい　ときには　ゆらゆら　ほのおが　ゆれて\nおこった　ときには　めらめら　さかんに　もえる。
records.english: The flame that burns at the tip of its\ntail is an indication of its emotions.\nThe flame wavers when CHARMANDER is

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: enjoying itself. If the POKéMON becomes\nenraged, the flame burns fiercely.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメで　ようしゃなく　たたきのめす。\nきょうてきと　むかいあうと　きぶんが　たかぶり\nしっぽの　ほのおが　あおじろく　もえあがる。
records.english: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its\nfoes using its sharp claws.\nIf it encounters a strong foe, it turns

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: aggressive. In this excited state, the\nflame at the tip of its tail flares with a\nbluish white color.

records.japanese: つよい　あいてを　もとめて　そらを　とびまわる。\nなんでも　とかして　しまう　こうねつの　ほのおを\nじぶんより　よわいものに　むけることは　しない。
records.english: CHARIZARD flies around the sky in\nsearch of powerful opponents.\nIt breathes fire of such great heat

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: that it melts anything. However, it\nnever turns its fiery breath on any\nopponent weaker than itself.

records.japanese: こうらの　やくめは　みを　まもる　だけではない。\nまるい　かたちと　ひょうめんの　みぞが　みずの\nていこうを　へらすので　はやく　およげるのだ。
records.english: SQUIRTLE's shell is not merely used\nfor protection.\nThe shell's rounded shape and the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: grooves on its surface help minimize\nresistance in water, enabling this\nPOKéMON to swim at high speeds.

records.japanese: ふさふさの　けで　おおわれた　おおきな　しっぽは\nながいき　するほど　ふかい　いろあいに　かわる。\nこうらの　キズは　つわものの　あかし。
records.english: Its tail is large and covered with a rich,\nthick fur. The tail becomes increasingly\ndeeper in color as WARTORTLE ages.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The scratches on its shell are evidence\nof this POKéMON's toughness as a\nbattler.

records.japanese: こうらの　ふんしゃこうの　ねらいは　せいかく。\nみずの　だんがんを　５０メートル　はなれた\nあきかんに　めいちゅうさせる　ことが　できるぞ。
records.english: BLASTOISE has water spouts that\nprotrude from its shell. The water\nspouts are very accurate.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: They can shoot bullets of water with\nenough accuracy to strike empty cans\nfrom a distance of over 160 feet.

records.japanese: からだ　よりも　おおきな　はっぱを　みるみる\nたべつくして　しまうほどの　しょくよくを　もつ。\nしょっかくから　きょうれつな　においを　だすぞ。
records.english: CATERPIE has a voracious appetite.\nIt can devour leaves bigger than its\nbody right before your eyes.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: From its antenna, this POKéMON releases\na terrifically strong odor.

records.japanese: からだの　カラは　てっぱんの　ように　かたい。\nあまり　うごかないのは　カラのなかで　やわらかい\nなかみが　しんかの　じゅんびを　しているからだ。
records.english: The shell covering this POKéMON's body\nis as hard as an iron slab.\nMETAPOD does not move very much.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It stays still because it is preparing\nits soft innards for evolution inside\nthe hard shell.

records.japanese: おいしい　はなの　ミツを　さがす　のうりょくに\nすぐれ　すみかから　１０キロはなれた　ばしょに\nさく　はなから　ミツを　あつめて　はこんでいる。
records.english: BUTTERFREE has a superior ability to\nsearch for delicious honey from\nflowers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It can even search out, extract, and\ncarry honey from flowers that are\nblooming over six miles from its nest.

records.japanese: とても　するどい　きゅうかくを　もっている。\nこうぶつの　はっぱか　きらいな　はっぱか\nおおきな　あかい　はなで　かぎわける。
records.english: WEEDLE has an extremely acute sense\nof smell.\nIt is capable of distinguishing its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: favorite kinds of leaves from those it\ndislikes just by sniffing with its big\nred proboscis (nose).

records.japanese: ほとんど　うごかず　きに　つかまっているが\nなかでは　しんかの　じゅんびで　おおいそがし。\nその　しょうこに　からだが　あつくなっているぞ。
records.english: KAKUNA remains virtually immobile as it\nclings to a tree. However, on the\ninside, it is extremely busy as it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: prepares for its coming evolution.\nThis is evident from how hot the shell\nbecomes to the touch.

records.japanese: なわばりいしきが　とても　つよいので　スピアーの\nすみかには　ちかづかない　ほうが　みの　ためだ。\nおこると　しゅうだんで　おそって　くるぞ。
records.english: BEEDRILL is extremely territorial.\nNo one should ever approach its nest -\nthis is for their own safety.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If angered, they will attack in a furious\nswarm.

records.japanese: ほうこう　かんかくに　とても　すぐれているので\nどんなに　はなれた　ばしょからでも　まよわずに\nじぶんの　す　まで　かえる　ことが　できる。
records.english: PIDGEY has an extremely sharp sense\nof direction.\nIt is capable of unerringly returning

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: home to its nest, however far it may be\nremoved from its familiar surroundings.

records.japanese: ひろい　なわばりを　とんで　みまわりを　する。\nなわばりを　あらす　あいては　ようしゃ　しない。\nするどい　ツメで　てっていてきに　こらしめるぞ。
records.english: PIDGEOTTO claims a large area as its\nown territory. This POKéMON flies\naround, patrolling its living space.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If its territory is violated, it shows\nno mercy in thoroughly punishing the\nfoe with its sharp claws.

records.japanese: うつくしい　こうたくの　はねを　もつ　ポケモン。\nあたまの　はねの　うつくしさに　こころ　うばわれ\nピジョットを　そだてる　トレーナーも　おおい。
records.english: This POKéMON has a dazzling plumage of\nbeautifully glossy feathers.\nMany TRAINERS are captivated by the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: striking beauty of the feathers on its\nhead, compelling them to choose PIDGEOT\nas their POKéMON.

records.japanese: けいかいしんが　とても　つよく　ねている　ときも\nみみを　うごかし　まわりの　おとを　きいている。\nどこにでも　すみつき　す　を　つくる。
records.english: RATTATA is cautious in the extreme.\nEven while it is asleep, it constantly\nlistens by moving its ears around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is not picky about where it lives -\nit will make its nest anywhere.

records.japanese: じょうぶな　キバは　どんどん　のびるので\nいわや　たいぼくを　かじって　けずっている。\nいえの　カベを　かじられる　ことも　あるよ。
records.english: RATICATE's sturdy fangs grow steadily.\nTo keep them ground down, it gnaws\non rocks and logs.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It may even chew on the walls of\nhouses.

records.japanese: おおきな　なきごえは　１キロ　さきまで　とどく。\nあちこちで　カンだかい　こえが　きこえる　ときは\nなかまたちに　きけんを　しらせている　あいずだ。
records.english: SPEAROW has a very loud cry that can\nbe heard over half a mile away.\nIf its high, keening cry is heard

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: echoing all around, it is a sign that\nthey are warning each other of danger.

records.japanese: ながい　くびと　くちばしは　つちや　みずの\nなかに　いる　エサを　つかまえるのに　べんり。\nほそながい　くちばしで　きように　つまむぞ。
records.english: FEAROW is recognized by its long neck\nand elongated beak.\nThey are conveniently shaped for

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: catching prey in soil or water.\nIt deftly moves its long and skinny\nbeak to pluck prey.

records.japanese: ぐるぐる　からだを　まいて　やすんでいるのは\nどの　ほうこうから　てきが　おそってきても\nとっさに　あたまを　むけて　いかくできるからだ。
records.english: EKANS curls itself up in a spiral while\nit rests.\nAssuming this position allows it to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: quickly respond to a threat from any\ndirection with a glare from its upraised\nhead.

records.japanese: しめつける　ちからは　とても　きょうりょく。\nドラムかんも　ぺしゃんこに　してしまうぞ。\nまきつかれたら　にげだす　ことは　ふかのうだ。
records.english: This POKéMON is terrifically strong in\norder to constrict things with its body.\nIt can even flatten steel oil drums.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once ARBOK wraps its body around its\nfoe, escaping its crunching embrace is\nimpossible.

records.japanese: ほっぺの　でんきぶくろの　でんきは　まよなか\nねている　あいだに　ためられている　らしいよ。\nねぼけて　ほうでんしてしまう　ことが　ある。
records.english: This POKéMON has electricity-storing\npouches on its cheeks. These appear to\nbecome electrically charged during the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: night while PIKACHU sleeps.\nIt occasionally discharges electricity\nwhen it is dozy after waking up.

records.japanese: よわい　でんきを　ぜんしんから　だしているので\nくらやみでは　うっすら　ひかって　みえるよ。\nシッポを　じめんに　さして　でんきを　にがす。
records.english: This POKéMON exudes a weak electrical\ncharge from all over its body that makes\nit take on a slight glow in darkness.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: RAICHU searches for electricity by\nplanting its tail in the ground.

records.japanese: からからに　かわいた　ひふは　とても　かたく\nまるくなると　どんな　こうげきでも　はねかえす。\nよなかは　さばくの　すなに　もぐって　ねむる。
records.english: SANDSHREW has a very dry hide that is\nextremely tough. The POKéMON can roll\ninto a ball that repels any attack.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: At night, it burrows into the desert\nsand to sleep.

records.japanese: せなかを　まるめると　トゲトゲの　ボールみたい。\nトゲに　さされて　ひるんだ　あいてに　とびかかり\nするどい　ツメで　ばりばり　ひっかきまくるぞ。
records.english: SANDSLASH can roll up its body as if it\nwere a ball covered with large spikes.\nIn battle, this POKéMON will try to make

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the foe flinch by jabbing it with its\nspines. It then leaps at the stunned\nfoe to tear wildly with its sharp claws.

records.japanese: ちいさい　からだを　まもるため　きょうりょくな\nどくばりが　はったつしたと　かんがえられている。\nおこると　ツノの　さきから　もうどくを　だす。
records.english: NIDORAN has barbs that secrete a\npowerful poison. They are thought to\nhave developed as protection for this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: small-bodied POKéMON.\nWhen enraged, it releases a horrible\ntoxin from its horn.

records.japanese: なかまや　かぞくと　いっしょの　ときは　おたがい\nきずつかないように　トゲが　ひっこんでいる。\nなかまから　はなれると　ふあんに　なるらしい。
records.english: When NIDORINA are with their friends or\nfamily, they keep their barbs tucked\naway to prevent hurting each other.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON appears to become\nnervous if separated from the others.

records.japanese: かたい　ウロコで　おおわれた　からだを　ぶつけて\nあいてを　はじきとばす　こうげきが　とくいだ。\nこどもを　まもる　ときが　いちばん　つよい。
records.english: NIDOQUEEN's body is encased in\nextremely hard scales. It is adept at\nsending foes flying with harsh tackles.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is at its strongest when\nit is defending its young.

records.japanese: みみを　うごかす　きんにくが　はったつしていて\nどんな　むきにも　じざいに　みみを　うごかせる。\nかすかな　ものおとも　ききもらさない　ポケモン。
records.english: The male NIDORAN has developed\nmuscles for moving its ears. Thanks to\nthem, the ears can be freely moved in

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: any direction. Even the slightest sound\ndoes not escape this POKéMON's notice.

records.japanese: ダイヤモンドよりも　かたい　ツノを　もつ。\nてきの　けはいを　かんじると　せなかの　トゲが\nいっせいに　さかだち　ぜんりょくで　たちむかう。
records.english: NIDORINO has a horn that is harder than\na diamond. If it senses a hostile\npresence, all the barbs on its back

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: bristle up at once, and it challenges\nthe foe with all its might.

records.japanese: ふとい　しっぽの　ひとふりは　がんじょうな\nてっとうも　へしおる　すさまじい　はかいりょく。\nいちど　あばれだすと　てが　つけられない。
records.english: NIDOKING's thick tail packs enormously\ndestructive power. With one swing, it\ncan topple a metal transmission tower.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once this POKéMON goes on a rampage,\nthere is no stopping it.

records.japanese: まんげつの　よるは　げんき　いっぱいに　あそぶ。\nあけがた　つかれた　ピッピたちは　しずかな\nやまおくで　なかまたちと　よりそって　ねむる。
records.english: On every night of a full moon, groups of\nthis POKéMON come out to play.\nWhen dawn arrives, the tired CLEFAIRY

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: return to their quiet mountain retreats\nand go to sleep nestled up against each\nother.

records.japanese: つばさを　つかって　とぶように　スキップ。\nすいめんを　あるく　ことだって　できるのだ。\nしずかな　つきよに　みずうみを　あるく。
records.english: CLEFABLE moves by skipping lightly as if\nit were flying using its wings. Its\nbouncy step lets it even walk on water.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is known to take strolls on lakes on\nquiet, moonlit nights.

records.japanese: からだの　なかで　ほのおが　いつも　もえている。\nひるま　きおんが　あがると　たいおんも　たかく\nなってしまうので　くちから　ほのおを　にがす。
records.english: Inside VULPIX's body burns a flame that\nnever goes out. During the daytime,\nwhen the temperatures rise, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON releases flames from its mouth\nto prevent its body from growing too\nhot.

records.japanese: ９にんの　せいなる　ちからを　もった　せんにんが\nがったいして　うまれたという　でんせつが　ある。\nちのうが　たかく　ひとの　ことばを　りかいする。
records.english: Legend has it that NINETALES came into\nbeing when nine wizards possessing\nsacred powers merged into one.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is highly intelligent - it\ncan understand human speech.

records.japanese: うたう　ときは　いちども　いきつぎをしない。\nなかなか　ねむらない　てきを　あいてに　した\nときは　いきを　できない　プリンも　いのちがけ。
records.english: When this POKéMON sings, it never\npauses to breathe. If it is in a battle\nagainst an opponent that does not

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: easily fall asleep, JIGGLYPUFF cannot\nbreathe, endangering its life.

records.japanese: だんりょくせいに　すぐれた　からだは　おおきく\nいきを　すいこむと　どこまでも　ふくれていく。\nふくらんだ　プクリンは　ふんわり　はねるよ。
records.english: WIGGLYTUFF's body is very flexible.\nBy inhaling deeply, this POKéMON can\ninflate itself seemingly without end.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once inflated, WIGGLYTUFF bounces\nalong lightly like a balloon.

records.japanese: たいようの　ひかりを　あびると　たいちょうが\nわるくなるので　ひるまは　どうくつや　ふるびた\nいえの　のきしたに　ぶらさがって　ねている。
records.english: ZUBAT avoids sunlight because exposure\ncauses it to become unhealthy.\nDuring the daytime, it stays in caves or

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: under the eaves of old houses, sleeping\nwhile hanging upside down.

records.japanese: ４ほんの　キバで　かみつき　けつえきを　のむ。\nつきの　でてない　まっくらな　よるは　かっぱつに\nとびまわり　ひとや　ポケモンを　おそうぞ。
records.english: GOLBAT bites down on prey with its four\nfangs and drinks the victim's blood.\nIt becomes active on inky dark

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: moonless nights, flying around to\nattack people and POKéMON.

records.japanese: えいよう　たっぷりの　つちを　さがして　うまる。\nひるま　つちに　うまっている　ときには　あしが\nきの　ねっこのような　かたちを　しているらしい。
records.english: ODDISH searches for fertile, nutrient-\nrich soil, then plants itself.\nDuring the daytime, while it is planted,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON's feet are thought to\nchange shape and become similar to\nthe roots of trees.

records.japanese: どうやら　クサイハナは　くちから　たらしている\nもうれつに　くさい　ニオイが　だいすき　らしい。\nニオイを　かいで　さらに　みつを　あふれさせる。
records.english: From its mouth GLOOM drips honey that\nsmells absolutely horrible.\nApparently, it loves the horrid stench.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It sniffs the noxious fumes and then \ndrools even more of its honey.

records.japanese: せかいいち　おおきな　はなびらで　えものを\nおびきよせ　どくの　かふんを　あびせかける。\nうごけなくなった　えものを　つかまえて　たべる。
records.english: VILEPLUME has the world's largest\npetals. They are used to attract prey\nthat are then doused with toxic spores.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Once the prey are immobilized, this\nPOKéMON catches and devours them.

records.japanese: パラスから　ようぶんを　すいとって　おおきくなる\nキノコは　とうちゅうかそう　と　よばれている。\nちょうじゅの　くすりになる　きちょうな　キノコ。
records.english: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing\non its back called tochukaso. They grow\nlarge by drawing nutrients from this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: BUG/GRASS POKéMON host. They are\nhighly valued as a medicine for\nextending life.

records.japanese: パラセクトは　しゅうだんで　たいぼくの　ねもとに\nくっついて　えいようを　すいとってしまう。\nかれると　いっせいに　べつの　きに　いどうする。
records.english: PARASECT is known to infest large trees\nen masse and drain nutrients from the\nlower trunk and roots.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When an infested tree dies, they move\nonto another tree all at once.

records.japanese: みを　まもるために　ほそく　かたい　たいもうが\nぜんしんを　おおうように　なったと　いわれる。\nちいさな　えものも　みのがさない　めを　もつ。
records.english: VENONAT is said to have evolved with\na coat of thin, stiff hair that covers\nits entire body for protection.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It possesses large eyes that never fail\nto spot even miniscule prey.

records.japanese: やこうせいで　よるに　かつどうを　はじめる。\nがいとうの　あかりに　さそわれ　あつまった\nちいさな　むしを　このんで　たべる。
records.english: VENOMOTH is nocturnal - it is a POKéMON\nthat only becomes active at night.\nIts favorite prey are small insects

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: that gather around streetlights,\nattracted by the light in the darkness.

records.japanese: ほとんどの　のうかは　ディグダを　そだてている。\nディグダが　あなを　ほった　とちは　ほどよく\nたがやされ　おいしい　やさいが　つくれるからだ。
records.english: DIGLETT are raised in most farms.\nThe reason is simple - wherever this\nPOKéMON burrows, the soil is left

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: perfectly tilled for planting crops.\nThis soil is made ideal for growing\ndelicious vegetables.

records.japanese: もともと　ひとつの　からだから　３つごに\nなったので　みんな　かんがえることは　おなじ。\nちからを　あわせ　どこまでも　ほりすすむ。
records.english: DUGTRIO are actually triplets that\nemerged from one body. As a result,\neach triplet thinks exactly like the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: other two triplets.\nThey work cooperatively to burrow\nendlessly.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメを　ひっこめて　ぬきあし　さしあし\nあしおとを　たてずに　あるくことが　できる。\nキラキラ　ひかる　コインが　なぜか　だいすきだ。
records.english: MEOWTH withdraws its sharp claws into\nits paws to slinkily sneak about without\nmaking any incriminating footsteps.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: For some reason, this POKéMON loves\nshiny coins that glitter with light.

records.japanese: たくましい　６ぽんの　ヒゲは　くうきの　うごきで\nまわりの　ようすを　キャッチする　やくわり。\nヒゲを　つかまれると　おとなしくなって　しまう。
records.english: PERSIAN has six bold whiskers that give\nit a look of toughness. The whiskers  \nsense air movements to determine what

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: is in the POKéMON's surrounding\nvicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed\nby the whiskers.

records.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからを　つかった　きおくが　ないのは\nちからを　はっきした　ときは　じゅくすいしている\nときと　おなじ　じょうたいだから　らしい。
records.english: If it uses its mysterious power,\nPSYDUCK can't remember having done so.\nIt apparently can't form a memory of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: such an event because it goes into\nan altered state that is much like\ndeep sleep.

records.japanese: およぐ　スピードは　ポケモンじゅうで　いちばん。\nあらしで　おおあれの　うみでも　へっちゃら。\nなんぱせんから　ひとを　たすける　ことも　ある。
records.english: GOLDUCK is the fastest swimmer among\nall POKéMON. It swims effortlessly, even\nin a rough, stormy sea.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It sometimes rescues people from\nwrecked ships floundering in high seas.

records.japanese: からだが　ふるえ　はないきが　あらくなれば\nおこりだす　まえぶれ　なのだが　あっというまに\nはげしく　おこるので　にげだす　ひまは　ない。
records.english: When MANKEY starts shaking and its\nnasal breathing turns rough, it's a sure\nsign that it is becoming angry.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because it goes into a\ntowering rage almost instantly, it is\nimpossible for anyone to flee its wrath.

records.japanese: はげしく　おこる　ことで　けっこうが　よくなり\nきんにくの　ちからを　つよくするのだ。\nただし　あたまの　かいてんは　おそくなるぞ。
records.english: When PRIMEAPE becomes furious, its\nblood circulation is boosted. In turn,\nits muscles are made even stronger.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, it also becomes much less\nintelligent at the same time.

records.japanese: きゅうかくに　すぐれ　いちど　かいだ　においは\nなにが　あっても　ぜったいに　わすれない。\nあいての　きもちを　においで　さっちする。
records.english: GROWLITHE has a superb sense of smell.\nOnce it smells anything, this POKéMON\nwon't forget the scent, no matter what.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It uses its advanced olfactory sense\nto determine the emotions of other\nliving things.

records.japanese: １００００キロの　きょりを　いっちゅうやで\nはしると　いわれている　かいそくの　ポケモン。\nたいないで　もえさかる　ほのおが　パワーとなる。
records.english: ARCANINE is known for its high speed.\nIt is said to be capable of running over\n6,200 miles in a single day and night.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The fire that blazes wildly within this\nPOKéMON's body is its source of power.

records.japanese: うずまき　もようの　ないぞうが　すけてしまうほど\nうすい　ひふだが　するどい　キバを　はねかえす\nだんりょくを　もっているのだ。
records.english: POLIWAG has a very thin skin. It is\npossible to see the POKéMON's spiral\ninnards right through the skin.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Despite its thinness, however, the skin\nis also very flexible. Even sharp fangs\nbounce right off it.

records.japanese: いつも　からだの　ひょうめんが　えきたいで\nぬるぬる　ぬれているため　てきに　つかまっても\nぬるりと　すりぬけ　にげる　ことが　できるぞ。
records.english: The surface of POLIWHIRL's body is\nalways wet and slick with an oily fluid.\nBecause of this greasy covering, it can

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: easily slip and slide out of the clutches\nof any enemy in battle.

records.japanese: はったつした　きょうじんな　きんにくは　どんなに\nうんどうしても　つかれる　ことは　ない。\nたいへいようも　かるく　おうだん　できるほどだ。
records.english: POLIWRATH's highly developed, brawny\nmuscles never grow fatigued, however\nmuch it exercises.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is so tirelessly strong, this POKéMON\ncan swim back and forth across the\nPacific Ocean without effort.

records.japanese: まいにち　１８じかん　ねむらないと　ねぶそくで\nちょうのうりょくが　つかえなくなってしまう。\nおそわれると　ねたまま　テレポートで　にげる。
records.english: ABRA needs to sleep for eighteen hours\na day. If it doesn't, this POKéMON loses\nits ability to use telekinetic powers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it is attacked, ABRA escapes using\nTELEPORT while it is still sleeping.

records.japanese: ぎんの　スプーンは　アルファはを　たかめる。\nスプーンが　ないと　いつもの　はんぶんしか\nちょうのうりょくを　つかえなくなると　いう。
records.english: KADABRA holds a silver spoon in its\nhand. The spoon is used to amplify the\nalpha waves in its brain.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Without the spoon, the POKéMON is said\nto be limited to half the usual amount\nof its telekinetic powers.

records.japanese: むげんに　ふえる　のうさいぼうが　ちのうしすう\n５０００の　スーパーずのうを　つくりだした。\nせかいの　できごとを　すべて　きおくしている。
records.english: ALAKAZAM's brain continually grows,\ninfinitely multiplying brain cells.\nThis amazing brain gives this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: an astoundingly high IQ of 5,000.\nIt has a thorough memory of everything\nthat has occurred in the world.

records.japanese: ゴローンを　もちあげて　からだを　きたえる。\nすべての　かくとうぎを　マスターするために\nせかいじゅうを　たびする　ワンリキーも　いる。
records.english: MACHOP exercises by hefting around\na GRAVELER as if it were a barbell.\nThere are some MACHOP that travel

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the world in a quest to master all\nkinds of martial arts.

records.japanese: にんげんの　ちからしごとを　てつだいながら\nからだを　まいにち　きたえている　ポケモン。\nやすみの　ひには　のやまで　からだを　きたえる。
records.english: MACHOKE undertakes bodybuilding every\nday even as it helps people with tough,\nphysically demanding labor.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: On its days off, this POKéMON heads to\nthe fields and mountains to exercise\nand train.

records.japanese: あらゆる　かくとうぎを　マスターした　ポケモン。\n４ほんの　うでで　つかまれたら　もう　おわり。\nちへいせんの　むこうまで　なげとばされてしまう。
records.english: MACHAMP is known as the POKéMON that\nhas mastered every kind of martial arts.\nIf it grabs hold of the foe with its four

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: arms, the battle is all but over.\nThe hapless foe is thrown far over the\nhorizon.

records.japanese: ほそく　しなやかな　からだは　どんな　つよい\nこうげきでも　しなって　よける　ことが　できる。\nくちから　てつも　とかしてしまう　えきを　だす。
records.english: BELLSPROUT's thin and flexible body\nlets it bend and sway to avoid any\nattack, however strong it may be.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: From its mouth, this POKéMON spits a\ncorrosive fluid that melts even iron.

records.japanese: よるに　なると　おしりの　フックを　きの　えだに\nひっかけて　ぶらさがり　ねむりに　つく。\nねぞうが　わるいと　あさ　おっこちているよ。
records.english: WEEPINBELL has a large hook on its rear\nend. At night, the POKéMON hooks on to\na tree branch and goes to sleep.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If it moves around in its sleep, it may\nwake up to find itself on the ground.

records.japanese: あたまに　ついている　ながい　つるを　ちいさな\nいきものに　みえる　うごきで　えものを　さそい\nちかづいてきた　ところを　ぱくりと　ひとのみ。
records.english: VICTREEBEL has a long vine that\nextends from its head. This vine is\nwaved and flicked about as if it were

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: an animal to attract prey. When an\nunsuspecting prey draws near, this\nPOKéMON swallows it whole.

records.japanese: たいようこうせんを　からだの　なかの　すいぶんで\nくっせつさせて　ビームの　エネルギーに　かえる。\nすいしょうの　ような　めだまから　はっしゃする。
records.english: TENTACOOL absorbs sunlight and\nrefracts it using water inside its body\nto convert it into beam energy.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shoots beams from its\ncrystal-like eyes.

records.japanese: じゆうに　のびちぢみする　しょくしゅで　えものを\nからめとり　もうどくを　あたえて　よわらせる。\nいっぺんに　８０ぴきの　えものを　つかまえるぞ。
records.english: TENTACRUEL has tentacles that can be\nfreely elongated and shortened at will.\nIt ensnares prey with its tentacles and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: weakens the prey by dosing it with a\nharsh toxin. It can catch up to 80\nprey at the same time.

records.japanese: じめんに　はんぶん　うまり　ぐっすり　ねむる。\nとざんしゃに　ふまれても　まったく　おきないよ。\nあさ　エサを　さがして　さかを　ころがりおちる。
records.english: When GEODUDE sleeps deeply, it buries\nitself halfway into the ground.\nIt will not awaken even if hikers step

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: on it unwittingly.\nIn the morning, this POKéMON rolls\ndownhill in search of food.

records.japanese: やまの　ふもとから　さんちょうまで　のぼる\nあいだに　だいすきな　いわを　ガリガリ　たべる。\nちょうじょうに　つくと　また　ころがりおちる。
records.english: Rocks are GRAVELER's favorite food.\nThis POKéMON will climb a mountain from\nthe base to the summit, crunchingly

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: feasting on rocks all the while.\nUpon reaching the peak, it rolls back\ndown to the bottom.

records.japanese: やまの　しゃめんに　ほってある　みぞは　ころがり\nおちてきた　ゴローニャが　みんかに　ぶつからない\nように　するための　とおりみちに　なっているぞ。
records.english: GOLEM is known for rolling down from\nmountains. To prevent them from rolling\ninto the homes of people downhill,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: grooves have been dug into the sides of\nmountains to serve as guideways for\ndiverting this POKéMON's course.

records.japanese: うまれて　すぐは　たちあがるのも　やっとだが\nころびながら　おやの　あとを　おいかけている\nうちに　じょうぶな　あしこしに　そだつのだ。
records.english: PONYTA is very weak at birth.\nIt can barely stand up.\nThis POKéMON becomes stronger by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: stumbling and falling to keep up with\nits parent.

records.japanese: いつもは　のんびり　のはらを　かけまわっているが\nひとたび　ほんきを　だすと　たてがみの　ほのおが\nもえあがり　じそく２４０キロで　はしりだす。
records.english: RAPIDASH usually can be seen casually\ncantering in the fields and plains.\nHowever, when this POKéMON turns

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: serious, its fiery manes flare and blaze\nas it gallops its way up to 150 mph.

records.japanese: しっぽを　かわに　いれて　エサを　つっているが\nそのうち　なにを　しているのか　わすれてしまい\nかわべりに　ねそべったまま　１にちを　おえる。
records.english: SLOWPOKE uses its tail to catch prey by\ndipping it in water at the side of a\nriver.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON often forgets\nwhat it's doing and often spends entire\ndays just loafing at water's edge.

records.japanese: シェルダーが　かみついて　いるので　しっぽで\nエサを　つれなくなった　ヤドランは　しぶしぶ\nすいちゅうを　およいで　エサを　つかまえている。
records.english: SLOWBRO's tail has a SHELLDER firmly\nattached with a bite. As a result, the\ntail can't be used for fishing anymore.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This causes SLOWBRO to grudgingly swim\nand catch prey instead.

records.japanese: さゆうの　ユニットから　でんじはを　だす　ことで\nじゅうりょくを　さえぎり　くうちゅうに　うかぶ。\nたいないの　でんきが　なくなると　とべなくなる。
records.english: MAGNEMITE floats in the air by emitting\nelectromagnetic waves from the units\nat its sides. These waves block gravity.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON becomes incapable of\nflight if its internal electrical supply\nis depleted.

records.japanese: きょうりょくな　じりょくせんで　せいみつきかいを\nこわしてしまうため　モンスターボールに　いれて\nおかないと　ちゅういされる　まちも　あるという。
records.english: MAGNETON emits a powerful magnetic\nforce that is fatal to electronics and\nprecision instruments. Because of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this, it is said that some towns warn\npeople to keep this POKéMON inside\na POKé BALL.

records.japanese: もっている　しょくぶつの　クキにも　よいものと\nそうでない　ものが　あるらしく　カモネギどうしが\nクキを　めぐって　たたかう　ことが　ある。
records.english: FARFETCH'D is always seen with a stick\nfrom a plant of some sort. Apparently,\nthere are good sticks and bad sticks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has been known to fight\nwith others over sticks.

records.japanese: ２つの　あたまは　おなじ　のうみそを　もつ。\nまれに　べつべつの　のうを　もった　ドードーが\nうまれてくると　けんきゅうで　ほうこくされた。
records.english: DODUO's two heads contain completely\nidentical brains.\nA scientific study reported that on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: rare occasions, there will be examples\nof this POKéMON possessing different\nsets of brains.

records.japanese: ３つあるのは　あたまだけでは　ないらしい。\nしんぞうと　はいも　３つなので　いきぎれしないで\nながい　きょりを　はしる　ことが　できるのだ。
records.english: Apparently, the heads aren't the only\nparts of the body that DODRIO has\nthree of.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It has three sets of hearts and lungs\nas well, so it is capable of running long\ndistances without rest.

records.japanese: こおりに　おおわれた　うみで　エサを　とる。\nいきつぎを　するときは　あたまの　でっぱりで\nこおりを　わって　うみから　かおを　だす。
records.english: SEEL hunts for prey in the frigid sea\nunderneath sheets of ice.\nWhen it needs to breathe, it punches

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: a hole through the ice with the\nsharply protruding section of its head.

records.japanese: つめたい　こおりの　うえで　ねるのが　だいすき。\nむかし　ひょうざんで　ねむる　すがたを　みた\nふなのりが　にんぎょと　まちがえた。
records.english: DEWGONG loves to snooze on bitterly\ncold ice.\nThe sight of this POKéMON sleeping on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: a glacier was mistakenly thought to be\na mermaid by a mariner long ago.

records.japanese: おせんされた　かいていの　ヘドロから　うまれた。\nきたない　ものが　だいすきで　からだじゅうから\nバイキンだらけの　えきたいを　たれながしている。
records.english: GRIMER emerged from the sludge that\nsettled on a polluted seabed.\nThis POKéMON loves anything filthy.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It constantly leaks a horribly germ-\ninfested fluid from all over its body.

records.japanese: きたない　ものが　だいこうぶつなので　ゴミを\nみちばたに　すてる　ような　ひとが　すんでいる\nまちには　ベトベトンが　あつまってくるぞ。
records.english: This POKéMON's favorite food is\nanything that is repugnantly filthy.\nIn dirty towns where people think

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: nothing of throwing away litter on the\nstreets, MUK are certain to gather.

records.japanese: よるに　なると　おおきな　ベロで　かいていの\nすなに　あなを　ほり　そのなかで　ねむる。\nカラを　とじて　ねむるが　ベロは　だしたまま。
records.english: At night, this POKéMON uses its broad\ntongue to burrow a hole in the seafloor\nsand and then sleep in it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: While it is sleeping, SHELLDER closes its\nshell, but leaves its tongue hanging\nout.

records.japanese: のみこんだ　かいすいを　うしろへ　いきおい　よく\nふんしゃする　ことで　うみの　なかを　およぐ。\nトゲを　はっしゃする　しくみも　おなじ。
records.english: CLOYSTER is capable of swimming in the\nsea. It does so by swallowing water,\nthen jetting it out toward the rear.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shoots spikes from its\nshell using the same system.

records.japanese: きょうふうを　うけると　ガスじょうの　からだは\nみるみる　ふきとばされ　ちいさくなって　しまう。\nかぜを　さけた　ゴースが　のきしたに　あつまる。
records.english: GASTLY is largely composed of gaseous\nmatter. When exposed to a strong wind,\nthe gaseous body quickly dwindles away.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Groups of this POKéMON cluster under\nthe eaves of houses to escape the\nravages of wind.

records.japanese: やみに　うかぶ　ゴーストが　てまねきしても\nぜったいに　ちかよっては　いけないよ。\nペロリと　なめられ　いのちを　すわれてしまうぞ。
records.english: HAUNTER is a dangerous POKéMON.\nIf one beckons you while floating in\ndarkness, you must never approach it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON will try to lick you with its\ntongue and steal your life away.

records.japanese: まよなか　がいとうの　あかりで　できた　かげが\nじぶんを　おいこして　いくのは　ゲンガーが\nかげに　なりすまして　はしって　いくからだ。
records.english: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow\nthrown by a streetlight will suddenly\nand startlingly overtake you.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is actually a GENGAR running past\nyou, pretending to be your shadow.

records.japanese: のうみそに　じしゃくが　あるので　つちの　なかを\nほり　すすんでいても　ほうこうを　まちがえない。\nとしを　とるほど　からだは　まるみを　おびる。
records.english: ONIX has a magnet in its brain. It acts\nas a compass so that this POKéMON does\nnot lose direction while it is tunneling.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As it grows older, its body becomes\nincreasingly rounder and smoother.

records.japanese: ねむっているとき　キミの　はなが　ムズムズしたら\nまくらもとに　たった　スリープが　はなの\nあなから　ゆめを　たべようとしている　あいず。
records.english: If your nose becomes itchy while you\nare sleeping, it's a sure sign that one\nof these POKéMON is standing above

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: your pillow and trying to eat your dream\nthrough your nostrils.

records.japanese: てに　もっている　ふりこの　うごきと　かがやきが\nあいてを　ふかい　さいみんじょうたいに　おとす。\nえものを　さがしながら　ふりこを　みがいている。
records.english: HYPNO holds a pendulum in its hand.\nThe arcing movement and glitter of the\npendulum lull the foe into a deep state

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of hypnosis.\nWhile this POKéMON searches for prey,\nit polishes the pendulum.

records.japanese: すなはまに　あなを　ほり　そこで　くらしている。\nエサの　すくない　すなはまでは　ばしょとりをする\nクラブたちの　あらそいを　みる　ことが　できる。
records.english: KRABBY live on beaches, burrowed inside\nholes dug into the sand.\nOn sandy beaches with little in the way

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of food, these POKéMON can be seen\nsquabbling with each other over\nterritory.

records.japanese: キングラーは　きょだいな　ハサミを　ふって\nなかまどうしで　あいずを　おくりあっているが\nハサミが　おもすぎて　すぐに　つかれてしまう。
records.english: KINGLER has an enormous, oversized\nclaw. It waves this huge claw in the\nair to communicate with others.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because the claw is so heavy,\nthe POKéMON quickly tires.

records.japanese: すこしの　ショックで　すぐに　ばくはつする。\nモンスターボールに　きょうりょくな　パルスを\nあびせた　ときに　うまれたと　ウワサされている。
records.english: VOLTORB is extremely sensitive - it\nexplodes at the slightest of shocks.\nIt is rumored that it was first created

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: when a POKé BALL was exposed to a\npowerful pulse of energy.

records.japanese: でんきに　ひきよせられる　せいしつを　もつ。\nおもに　はつでんしょに　あつまってきて　つくった\nばかりの　でんきを　たべてしまう　こまりものだ。
records.english: One of ELECTRODE's characteristics is\nits attraction to electricity.\nIt is a problematical POKéMON that

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: congregates mostly at electrical\npower plants to feed on electricity\nthat has just been generated.

records.japanese: なかまおもいの　６この　たまごは　おたがいに\nひきつけあい　くるくる　かいてんしている。\nカラの　ヒビが　ふえると　しんかは　まぢかだ。
records.english: This POKéMON consists of six eggs that\nform a closely knit cluster. The six eggs\nattract each other and spin around.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When cracks increasingly appear on the\neggs, EXEGGCUTE is close to evolution.

records.japanese: なんごく　うまれの　ナッシーの　あたまは　つよい\nひざしを　いっぱい　あびて　どんどん　そだち\nじめんに　おちると　タマタマに　なると　いう。
records.english: EXEGGUTOR originally came from the\ntropics. Its heads steadily grow larger\nfrom exposure to strong sunlight.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is said that when the heads fall off,\nthey group together to form EXEGGCUTE.

records.japanese: ２どと　あえない　ははおやの　おもかげを\nまんげつに　みつけて　なきごえを　あげる。\nかぶっている　ホネの　しみは　なみだの　あと。
records.english: CUBONE pines for the mother it will\nnever see again. Seeing a likeness of\nits mother in the full moon, it cries.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The stains on the skull the POKéMON\nwears are made by the tears it sheds.

records.japanese: ははおやに　あえない　かなしみを　のりこえた\nカラカラが　たくましく　しんかした　すがた。\nきたえられた　こころは　かんたんに　くじけない。
records.english: MAROWAK is the evolved form of a CUBONE\nthat has overcome its sadness at the\nloss of its mother and grown tough.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's tempered and hardened\nspirit is not easily broken.

records.japanese: じざいに　のびちぢみする　あしで　きょうれつな\nキックを　はなち　あいてを　けりたおす。\nたたかいの　あと　つかれた　あしを　もみほぐす。
records.english: HITMONLEE's legs freely contract and\nstretch. Using these springlike legs, it\nbowls over foes with devastating kicks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: After battle, it rubs down its legs and\nloosens the muscles to overcome\nfatigue.

records.japanese: せかいチャンピオンを　めざしていた　ボクサーの\nたましいが　やどったと　いわれる　エビワラーは\nふくつの　せいしんで　ぜったいに　へこたれない。
records.english: HITMONCHAN is said to possess the\nspirit of a boxer who had been working\ntowards a world championship.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has an indomitable spirit\nand will never give up in the face of\nadversity.

records.japanese: はじめて　めに　する　ものは　かならず　ペロリ。\nしたざわりと　あじで　きおくしているのだ。\nでも　すっぱい　ものは　ちょっと　にがて。
records.english: Whenever LICKITUNG comes across\nsomething new, it will unfailingly give it\na lick. It does so because it memorizes

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: things by texture and by taste.\nIt is somewhat put off by sour things.

records.japanese: なまゴミと　からだの　どくそを　かがくはんのう\nさせる　ことで　もうどくの　ガスを　つくりだす。\nきおんが　たかいほど　ガスが　たくさん　できる。
records.english: KOFFING embodies toxic substances.\nIt mixes the toxins with raw garbage to\nset off a chemical reaction that

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: results in a terribly powerful poison\ngas. The higher the temperature, the\nmore gas is concocted by this POKéMON.

records.japanese: ふたごの　からだを　こうごに　しぼませたり\nふくらませたりして　どくガスを　まぜている。\nまぜるほど　どくそが　つよまり　くさくなる。
records.english: WEEZING alternately shrinks and\ninflates its twin bodies to mix together\ntoxic gases inside.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The more the gases are mixed, the more\npowerful the toxins become. The\nPOKéMON also becomes more putrid.

records.japanese: はしっているうちに　もくてきを　わすれるほど\nのうみそが　ちいさく　あたまが　わるいぞ。\nなにかを　こわすと　たまに　おもいだすらしい。
records.english: RHYHORN's brain is very small. It is so\ndense, while on a run it forgets why it\nstarted running in the first place.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It apparently remembers sometimes if it\ndemolishes something.

records.japanese: ドリルに　なる　ツノで　がんせきを　はかいする。\nマグマを　ふきださせてしまう　ことも　あるが\nよろいの　ような　ひふは　あつさを　かんじない。
records.english: RHYDON has a horn that serves as a\ndrill. It is used for destroying rocks\nand boulders.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON occasionally rams into\nstreams of magma, but the armor-like\nhide prevents it from feeling the heat.

records.japanese: えいよう　まんてんの　タマゴを　まいにち　うむ。\nしょくよくを　なくした　ひとでも　ペロリと\nたべてしまうほど　おいしい　タマゴだ。
records.english: CHANSEY lays nutritionally excellent\neggs on an everyday basis.\nThe eggs are so delicious, they are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: easily and eagerly devoured by even\nthose people who have lost their\nappetite.

records.japanese: てきに　つかまれると　ツルは　ぷちっと　きれる。\nぜんぜん　いたくないので　その　スキに　にげる。\nよくじつには　あたらしい　ツルが　はえそろうぞ。
records.english: TANGELA's vines snap off easily if they\nare grabbed. This happens without pain,\nallowing it to make a quick getaway.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The lost vines are replaced by newly\ngrown vines the very next day.

records.japanese: ガルーラの　こどもが　１ぴきで　あそんでいても\nぜったいに　つかまえたりしては　いけないよ。\nちかくに　いる　おやが　はげしく　おこりだすぞ。
records.english: If you come across a young KANGASKHAN\nplaying by itself, you must never\ndisturb it or attempt to catch it.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The baby POKéMON's parent is sure to\nbe in the area, and it will become\nviolently enraged at you.

records.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　はんしゃてきに　くちから\nまっくろい　スミを　はきだして　にげるぞ。\nせびれを　きように　うごかして　およぐ。
records.english: If HORSEA senses danger, it will\nreflexively spray a dense black ink\nfrom its mouth and try to escape.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON swims by cleverly flapping\nthe fins on its back.

records.japanese: からだを　かいてんさせて　うずまきを　つくる。\nぎょせんも　のみこまれる　ほどの　げきりゅうで\nえものを　よわらせてから　まるごと　のみこむ。
records.english: SEADRA generates whirlpools by spinning\nits body. The whirlpools are strong\nenough to swallow even fishing boats.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON weakens prey with these\ncurrents, then swallows it whole.

records.japanese: かわや　いけを　およぐ　ことが　だいすきなので\nすいそう　なんかに　いれていたら　ぶあつい\nガラスも　ツノの　ひとつきで　わって　にげるぞ。
records.english: GOLDEEN loves swimming wild and free\nin rivers and ponds.\nIf one of these POKéMON is placed in an

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: aquarium, it will shatter even the\nthickest glass with one ram of its horn\nand make its escape.

records.japanese: タマゴを　まもるため　オスと　メスは　こうたいで\nすの　まわりを　およぎまわり　パトロールする。\nタマゴが　かえるまで　ひとつきいじょう　つづく。
records.english: SEAKING is very protective of its eggs.\nThe male and female will take turns\npatrolling around their nest and eggs.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The guarding of eggs by these POKéMON\ngoes on for over a month.

records.japanese: ちゅうしんの　あかい　コアを　てんめつさせて\nよぞらの　ほしと　こうしん　している　らしい。\nからだは　ちぎれても　じこさいせい　するぞ。
records.english: STARYU apparently communicates with\nthe stars in the night sky by flashing\nthe red core at the center of its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If parts of its body are torn, this\nPOKéMON simply regenerates the\nmissing pieces and limbs.

records.japanese: ほしがたの　からだを　スクリューの　ように\nかいてんさせて　すいちゅうを　およぎまわる。\nちゅうおうに　ある　コアが　なないろに　ひかる。
records.english: STARMIE swims through water by\nspinning its star-shaped body as if it\nwere a propeller on a ship.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The core at the center of this\nPOKéMON's body glows in seven colors.

records.japanese: めに　みえない　ものを　みぶりで　そこに　あると\nしんじこませる　パントマイムの　たつじん。\nしんじさせた　ものは　ほんとうに　あらわれる。
records.english: MR. MIME is a master of pantomime.\nIts gestures and motions convince\nwatchers that something unseeable

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: actually exists. Once it is believed,\nit will exist as if it were a real thing.

records.japanese: めにも　とまらぬ　スピードが　りょううでの\nカマの　きれあじを　さらに　するどく　するのだ。\nひとふり　すれば　たいぼくも　まっぷたつだ。
records.english: SCYTHER is blindingly fast. Its blazing\nspeed enhances the effectiveness of\nthe twin scythes on its forearms.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's scythes are so\neffective, they can slice through thick\nlogs in one wicked stroke.

records.japanese: おどるような　こしつきで　リズミカルに　あるく。\nその　うごきは　みている　ひとも　おもわず\nこしを　ふってしまうほど　かろやかなのだ。
records.english: JYNX walks rhythmically, swaying and\nshaking its hips as if it were dancing.\nIts motions are so bouncingly alluring,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: people seeing it are compelled to shake\ntheir hips without giving any thought\nto what they are doing.

records.japanese: あらしが　くると　きの　うえ　など　カミナリの\nおちそうな　たかい　ばしょへ　きそって　のぼる。\nひらいしん　がわりに　する　まちも　ある。
records.english: When a storm arrives, gangs of this\nPOKéMON compete with each other to\nscale heights that are likely to be

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: stricken by lightning bolts.\nSome towns use ELECTABUZZ in place of\nlightning rods.

records.japanese: たたかいに　なると　からだから　しゃくねつの\nほのおを　ふきあげ　あいてを　いかくする。\nその　ねっぷうで　まわりの　くさきも　もやすぞ。
records.english: In battle, MAGMAR blows out intensely\nhot flames from all over its body to\nintimidate its opponent.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's fiery bursts create\nheat waves that ignite grass and trees\nin its surroundings.

records.japanese: たくましい　２ほんの　ツノの　ひょうめんに　ある\nトゲが　あいての　からだに　ふかく　くいこむので\nはさまれると　かんたんに　はずせないのだ。
records.english: PINSIR has a pair of massive horns \nProtruding from the surface of these\nhorns are thorns.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These thorns are driven deeply into the\nfoe's body when the pincer closes,\nmaking it tough for the foe to escape.

records.japanese: いつも　あばれて　いないと　きが　すまない。\nたたかう　あいてが　いない　ときは　たいぼくに\nぶちあたり　なぎたおす　ことで　きを　しずめる。
records.english: This POKéMON is not satisfied unless\nit is rampaging at all times.\nIf there is no opponent for TAUROS to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: battle, it will charge at thick trees and\nknock them down to calm itself.

records.japanese: はねている　だけで　まんぞくに　たたかえないため\nよわいと　おもわれているが　どんなに　よごれた\nみずでも　くらせる　しぶとい　ポケモンなのだ。
records.english: MAGIKARP is virtually useless in battle\nas it can only splash around.\nAs a result, it is considered to be weak.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, it is actually a very hardy\nPOKéMON that can survive in any body of\nwater no matter how polluted it is.

records.japanese: いちど　あばれはじめると　すべてを　もやさないと\nきょうぼうな　ちが　おさまらなく　なってしまう。\nひとつき　あばれつづけた　きろくが　のこる。
records.english: Once GYARADOS goes on a rampage, its\nferociously violent blood doesn't calm\nuntil it has burned everything down.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There are records of this POKéMON's\nrampages lasting a whole month.

records.japanese: ひとが　ぜつめつの　ききに　おいこんでしまった。\nゆうぐれどきになると　すくなくなった　なかまを\nさがして　かなしそうな　こえで　うたうと　いう。
records.english: People have driven LAPRAS almost to the\npoint of extinction. In the evenings,\nthis POKéMON is said to sing plaintively

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: as it seeks what few others of its kind\nstill remain.

records.japanese: からだの　さいぼうを　くみかえて　へんしんする。\nおもいだしながら　いぜん　みた　ものに　かわると\nちょっと　ちがう　かたちに　なってしまうのだ。
records.english: DITTO rearranges its cell structure to\ntransform itself into other shapes.\nHowever, if it tries to transform itself

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: into something by relying on its memory,\nthis POKéMON manages to get details\nwrong.

records.japanese: くらしている　かんきょうで　とつぜんへんい　する\nふあんていな　いでんしを　もつ　ポケモン。\nいしの　ほうしゃせんが　しんかを　ひきおこす。
records.english: EEVEE has an unstable genetic makeup\nthat suddenly mutates due to the\nenvironment in which it lives.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Radiation from various STONES causes\nthis POKéMON to evolve.

records.japanese: とつぜんへんいに　より　すいちゅうで　せいかつ\nできる　ように　ヒレと　エラが　はえてきた。\nみずを　じざいに　あやつる　ちからを　もつ。
records.english: VAPOREON underwent a spontaneous\nmutation and grew fins and gills that\nallow it to live underwater.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has the ability to freely\ncontrol water.

records.japanese: さいぼうの　だす　よわい　でんきを　たいもうの\nせいでんきで　ぞうふくさせ　カミナリを　おとす。\nさかだった　たいもうは　でんきを　おびた　はり。
records.english: JOLTEON's cells generate a low level of\nelectricity. This power is amplified by\nthe static electricity of its fur,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: enabling the POKéMON to drop\nthunderbolts. The bristling fur is made\nof electrically charged needles.

records.japanese: ふさふさの　たいもうは　あがりすぎた　たいおんを\nくうきに　ほうねつして　さげる　きのうを　もつ。\nたいおんは　さいこう　９００ど　まで　あがるぞ。
records.english: FLAREON's fluffy fur has a functional\npurpose - it releases heat into the air\nso that its body does not get

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: excessively hot.\nThis POKéMON's body temperature can\nrise to a maximum of 1,650 degrees F.

records.japanese: ぜんしんを　プログラム　データに　もどして\nでんし　くうかんに　はいる　ことが　できる。\nコピーガードされて　いるので　コピー　できない。
records.english: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself\nentirely back to program data and\nentering cyberspace.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is copy-protected so it\ncannot be duplicated by copying.

records.japanese: おおむかしに　ぜつめつしたが　にんげんの　てで\nかせきから　ふっかつさせた　ポケモンの　ひとつ。\nてきに　おそわれると　かたい　カラに　かくれる。
records.english: OMANYTE is one of the ancient and long-\nsince-extinct POKéMON that have been\nregenerated from fossils by people.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If attacked by an enemy, it withdraws\nitself inside its hard shell.

records.japanese: しょくしゅを　あやつり　えものを　つかまえる。\nカラが　おおきく　なりすぎた　ことで　うごきが\nにぶくなり　ぜつめつしたと　かんがえられている。
records.english: OMASTAR uses its tentacles to capture\nits prey. It is believed to have become\nextinct because its shell grew too large

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and heavy, causing its movements to\nbecome too slow and ponderous.

records.japanese: かせきから　ふっかつした　ポケモンだが　まれに\nいきつづけている　カブトを　はっけん　できる。\nその　すがたは　３おくねん　かわっていない。
records.english: KABUTO is a POKéMON that has been\nregenerated from a fossil. However, in\nextremely rare cases, living examples

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: have been discovered.\nThe POKéMON has not changed at all for\n300 million years.

records.japanese: すいちゅうを　およぎ　えものを　とらえていた。\nみずの　せいかつから　ちじょうで　くらせるように\nエラや　あし　などが　へんかを　はじめていた。
records.english: KABUTOPS swam underwater to hunt for\nits prey in ancient times.\nThe POKéMON was apparently evolving

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: from being a water-dweller to living on\nland as evident from the beginnings of\nchange in its gills and legs.

records.japanese: コハクから　とりだした　いでんしを　さいせいして\nふっかつした　きょうりゅう　じだいの　ポケモン。\nそらの　おうじゃだったと　そうぞうされている。
records.english: AERODACTYL is a POKéMON from the age\nof dinosaurs. It was regenerated from\ngenetic material extracted from amber.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is imagined to have been the king of\nthe skies in ancient times.

records.japanese: たべて　ねての　くりかえしで　１にちが　おわる。\nおおきな　おなかの　うえを　あそびばに　している\nこどもたちも　いるほど　おとなしい　ポケモンだ。
records.english: SNORLAX's typical day consists of\nnothing more than eating and sleeping.\nIt is such a docile POKéMON that there

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: are children who use its expansive belly\nas a place to play.

records.japanese: こおりを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nはばたく　ことで　くうきを　つめたく　ひやすので\nフリーザーが　とぶと　ゆきが　ふると　いわれる。
records.english: ARTICUNO is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat can control ice.\nThe flapping of its wings chills the air.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, it is said that when this\nPOKéMON flies, snow will fall.

records.japanese: でんきを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nふだんは　カミナリぐもの　なかで　くらしている。\nカミナリに　うたれると　ちからが　わいてくる。
records.english: ZAPDOS is a legendary bird POKéMON that\nhas the ability to control electricity.\nIt usually lives in thunderclouds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON gains power if it is\nstricken by lightning bolts.

records.japanese: ほのおを　あやつる　でんせつの　とりポケモン。\nからだが　きずつくと　かこうの　マグマに　はいり\nぜんしんを　もやして　きずを　いやすと　いう。
records.english: MOLTRES is a legendary bird POKéMON\nthat has the ability to control fire.\nIf this POKéMON is injured, it is said to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: dip its body in the molten magma of a\nvolcano to burn and heal itself.

records.japanese: ミニリュウが　だっぴを　くりかえして　いるのは\nからだの　なかで　せいめいの　エネルギーが\nどんどん　ふくらみ　おさえきれなく　なるからだ。
records.english: DRATINI continually molts and sloughs\noff its old skin.\nIt does so because the life energy

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: within its body steadily builds to reach\nuncontrollable levels.

records.japanese: おおきな　エネルギーを　からだに　ためている。\nくびと　しっぽの　すいしょうから　エネルギーを\nときはなち　あたりの　てんきを　かえると　いう。
records.english: DRAGONAIR stores an enormous amount\nof energy inside its body.\nIt is said to alter weather conditions

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: in its vicinity by discharging energy\nfrom the crystals on its neck and tail.

records.japanese: １６じかんで　ちきゅうを　１しゅうできる。\nあらしで　なんぱしかけた　ふねを　みつけると\nりくちまで　ゆうどうする　やさしい　ポケモン。
records.english: DRAGONITE is capable of circling the\nglobe in just sixteen hours.\nIt is a kindhearted POKéMON that leads

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: lost and foundering ships in a storm to\nthe safety of land.

records.japanese: いでんしそうさに　よって　つくられた　ポケモン。\nにんげんの　かがくりょくで　からだは　つくれても\nやさしい　こころを　つくることは　できなかった。
records.english: MEWTWO is a POKéMON that was created\nby genetic manipulation.\nHowever, even though the scientific

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: power of humans created this POKéMON's\nbody, they failed to endow MEWTWO with\na compassionate heart.

records.japanese: すべての　ポケモンの　いでんしを　もつと　いう。\nじゆうじざいに　すがたを　けすことが　できるので\nひとに　ちかづいても　まったく　きづかれない。
records.english: MEW is said to possess the genetic\ncomposition of all POKéMON.\nIt is capable of making itself invisible

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: at will, so it entirely avoids notice even\nif it approaches people.

records.japanese: はっぱを　ふりまわして　あいてを　いかくするが\nはっぱから　あまい　かおりが　ただようので\nおたがいに　なごやかな　ふんいきに　なるよ。
records.english: In battle, CHIKORITA waves its leaf\naround to keep the foe at bay.\nHowever, a sweet fragrance also wafts

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: from the leaf, becalming the battling\nPOKéMON and creating a cozy, friendly\natmosphere all around.

records.japanese: くびの　まわりの　くるりと　まいた　はっぱの\nなかには　ちいさな　きのめが　１こ　なっている。\nその　かおりは　ひとを　げんきに　させるぞ。
records.english: BAYLEEF's neck is ringed by curled-up\nleaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a\nsmall shoot of a tree.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The fragrance of this shoot makes\npeople peppy.

records.japanese: はなの　かおりは　きもちを　おだやかにする。\nたたかいの　ときは　かおりを　はっさんさせて\nあいての　たたかう　きもちを　にぶらせるのだ。
records.english: The fragrance of MEGANIUM's flower\nsoothes and calms emotions.\nIn battle, this POKéMON gives off more

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of its becalming scent to blunt the\nfoe's fighting spirit.

records.japanese: せなかから　ほのおを　ふきあげて　みを　まもる。\nおこった　ときの　ほのおは　いきおいが　いいが\nつかれている　ときは　ふかんぜんねんしょうする。
records.english: CYNDAQUIL protects itself by flaring up\nthe flames on its back.\nThe flames are vigorous if the POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: is angry. However, if it is tired, the\nflames splutter fitfully with incomplete\ncombustion.

records.japanese: ほのおの　いきおいと　ねっぷうで　いかくする。\nすばやい　みのこなしで　あいての　こうげきを\nかわしながら　どうじに　ほのおで　もやす。
records.english: QUILAVA keeps its foes at bay with the\nintensity of its flames and gusts of\nsuperheated air.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON applies its outstanding\nnimbleness to dodge attacks even while\nscorching the foe with flames.

records.japanese: しゃくねつの　ほのおで　まわりに　かげろうを\nつくりだして　すがたを　かくす　ことが　できる。\nもえあがる　ばくふうは　すべてを　やきつくすぞ。
records.english: TYPHLOSION obscures itself behind a\nshimmering heat haze that it creates\nusing its intensely hot flames.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON creates blazing explosive\nblasts that burn everything to cinders.

records.japanese: ちいさな　からだでも　アゴの　ちからは　つよい。\nワニノコじしんは　あまがみ　している　つもりでも\nおおけがを　してしまう　ほどの　ちからが　ある。
records.english: Despite the smallness of its body,\nTOTODILE's jaws are very powerful.\nWhile the POKéMON may think it is just

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: playfully nipping, its bite has enough\npower to cause serious injury.

records.japanese: いちど　かみついたら　ぜったいに　はなさない。\nキバの　さきが　つりばり　みたいに　そりかえって\nいるので　いちど　ささると　ぬけなく　なるのだ。
records.english: Once CROCONAW has clamped its jaws on\nits foe, it will absolutely not let go.\nBecause the tips of its fangs are

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: forked back like barbed fishhooks, they\nbecome impossible to remove when \nthey have sunk in.

records.japanese: おおきな　くちを　あけて　あいてを　いかくする。\nきょうじんな　うしろあしで　じめんを　けって\nものすごい　スピードで　とっしん　してくるぞ。
records.english: FERALIGATR intimidates its foes by\nopening its huge mouth.\nIn battle, it will kick the ground hard

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: with its thick and powerful hind legs to\ncharge at the foe at an incredible\nspeed.

records.japanese: ねむる　ときには　こうたいで　みはりをする。\nきけんを　さっちすると　なかまを　おこすのだ。\nむれから　はぐれると　こわくて　ねむれなくなる。
records.english: When SENTRET sleeps, it does so while\nanother stands guard. The sentry wakes\nthe others at the first sign of danger.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When this POKéMON becomes separated\nfrom its pack, it becomes incapable of\nsleep due to fear.

records.japanese: てきに　おそわれても　ほそい　すきまに\nするりと　もぐりこんで　にげる　ことが　できる。\nてあしは　みじかいが　とても　すばしっこい。
records.english: FURRET has a very slim build.\nWhen under attack, it can slickly squirm\nthrough narrow spaces and get away.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In spite of its short limbs, this\nPOKéMON is very nimble and fleet.

records.japanese: からだの　なかには　ちきゅうの　じてんを\nかんじとる　きかんを　もっているので　まいにち\nおなじ　じかんに　なると　なきごえを　あげる。
records.english: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that\nsenses and tracks the earth's rotation.\nUsing this special organ, this POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: begins hooting at precisely the same\ntime every day.

records.japanese: わずかな　ひかりでも　みえる　すぐれた　めと\nはおとを　たてない　やわらかい　はねの　おかげで\nくらやみでは　えものを　ぜったいに　にがさない。
records.english: NOCTOWL never fails at catching prey in\ndarkness. This POKéMON owes its\nsuccess to its superior vision that

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: allows it to see in minimal light, and to\nits soft,  supple wings that make no\nsound in flight.

records.japanese: あしの　つけねから　だす　えきたいの　においで\nなかまと　コミュニケーションを　とっている。\nにおいの　ちがいで　きもちを　つたえるという。
records.english: LEDYBA secretes an aromatic fluid from\nwhere its legs join its body. This fluid\nis used for communicating with others.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON conveys its feelings to\nothers by altering the fluid's scent.

records.japanese: ほしが　たくさん　みえる　くうきの　きれいな\nとちには　レディアンが　たくさん　すむと　いう。\nほしあかりを　エネルギーに　しているからだ。
records.english: It is said that in lands with clean air,\nwhere the stars fill the sky, there live\nLEDIAN in countless numbers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There is a good reason for this - the\nPOKéMON uses the light of the stars\nas its energy.

records.japanese: いとで　つくった　ワナは　だい２の　しんけい。\nいとを　つたわる　わずかな　しんどう　だけで\nえものの　しゅるいが　わかると　いわれている。
records.english: The web spun by SPINARAK can be\nconsidered its second nervous system.\nIt is said that this POKéMON can

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: determine what kind of prey is touching\nits web just by the tiny vibrations it\nfeels through the web's strands.

records.japanese: あしの　せんたんには　ちいさな　カギヅメが　あり\nてんじょうや　すいちょくの　かべも　あるける。\nほそく　じょうぶな　いとで　てきを　しめあげる。
records.english: ARIADOS's feet are tipped with tiny\nhooked claws that enable it to scuttle\non ceilings and vertical walls.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON constricts the foe with\nthin and strong silk webbing.

records.japanese: みみを　すまさないと　きこえないほど　ちいさな\nはおとで　ねらった　えものに　しのびよるぞ。\nうしろあしの　ハネで　えだに　つかまり　やすむ。
records.english: CROBAT sneaks up on its intended prey\nusing wings that barely make a sound.\nThis POKéMON rests by hanging on a

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: tree branch with its rear legs that\nserve as wings.

records.japanese: つよい　でんきを　はっせいさせる　さいぼうが\n２ほんの　しょくしゅの　なかに　つまっている。\nじぶんも　ちょっと　ピリピリ　しびれるらしい。
records.english: CHINCHOU's two antennas are filled with\ncells that generate strong electricity.\nThis POKéMON's cells create so much

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: electrical power, it even makes itself\ntingle slightly.

records.japanese: よなかに　ふねから　くらい　うみを　のぞきこむと\nしんかいを　およぐ　ランターンの　ひかりが\nほしぞらの　ように　みえる　ことが　あるよ。
records.english: LANTURN is known to emit light.\nIf you peer down into the dark sea from\na ship at night, you can sometimes see

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON's light rising from the\ndepths where it swims. It gives the sea\nan appearance of a starlit night.

records.japanese: なかまと　あそんでいるとき　おたがいの　でんきが\nショートして　ひばなを　だす　ことが　あるぞ。\nひばなに　びっくり　すると　なきだしてしまうよ。
records.english: When PICHU plays with others, it may\nshort out electricity with another\nPICHU, creating a shower of sparks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In that event, this POKéMON will begin\ncrying, startled by the flash of sparks.

records.japanese: ながれぼしの　おおい　よるは　わ　に　なって\nおどる　ピィの　すがたを　みることが　できる。\nひのでまで　おどり　よつゆで　のどを　うるおす。
records.english: On nights with many shooting stars,\nCLEFFA can be seen dancing in a ring.\nThey dance through the night and stop

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: only at the break of day, when these\nPOKéMON quench their thirst with the\nmorning dew.

records.japanese: マシュマロ　みたいな　さわりごこちの　からだから\nほんのり　あまい　においが　ただよってくるよ。\nにおいは　てきの　きもちを　おだやかにする。
records.english: IGGLYBUFF has a soft and plushy body\nthat feels very much like a marshmallow.\nFrom this body wafts a gently sweet

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: fragrance that soothes and calms the\nemotions of its foes.

records.japanese: ひとや　ポケモンが　はっしている　やさしさや\nたのしい　きもちを　エネルギーに　している。\nカラの　なかに　ためた　しあわせを　わけている。
records.english: As its energy, TOGEPI uses the positive\nemotions of compassion and pleasure\nexuded by people and POKéMON.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON stores up feelings of\nhappiness inside its shell, then shares\nthem with others.

records.japanese: こううんを　もたらす　ポケモンと　いわれている。\nじゅんすいな　こころの　もちぬしを　みつけると\nすがたを　あらわし　しあわせを　わけあたえる。
records.english: TOGETIC is said to be a POKéMON that\nbrings good fortune. When the POKéMON\nspots someone who is pure of heart,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: it is said to appear and share its\nhappiness with that person.

records.japanese: ジャンプりょくの　はったつした　ポケモン。\nおとなの　せたけ　いじょうある　たかさの　えだに\nひらりと　とびのり　きのめを　ついばむ。
records.english: NATU has a highly developed jumping\nability. The POKéMON flaps and leaps\nonto tree branches that are taller than

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: grown-up people to pick at the tree's\nnew shoots.

records.japanese: １にちじゅう　たいようを　みつめて　うごかない。\nみらいを　みとおす　ちからを　もつと　しんじられ\nせいなる　ポケモンとして　まつる　ひとも　いる。
records.english: XATU is known to stand motionless while\nstaring at the sun all day long.\nSome people revere it as a mystical

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON out of their belief that XATU\nis in possession of the power to see\ninto the future.

records.japanese: たいもうが　こすれて　せいでんきが　たまる。\nでんりょくが　たくさん　たまるほど　しっぽの\nさきに　ついた　でんきゅうが　あかるく　ひかる。
records.english: MAREEP's fluffy coat of wool rubs\ntogether and builds a static charge.\nThe more static electricity is charged,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the more brightly the lightbulb at the\ntip of its tail grows.

records.japanese: たいもうの　せいしつが　へんかするので　すくない\nりょうでも　たくさんの　でんきを　つくりだせる。\nでんきを　さえぎる　つるつるの　はだを　もつ。
records.english: FLAAFFY's wool quality changes so that\nit can generate a high amount of static\nelectricity with a small amount of wool.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The bare and slick parts of its hide are\nshielded against electricity.

records.japanese: デンリュウの　あかりは　うちゅうからも　みえる。\nむかしの　ひとは　デンリュウの　あかりを　つかい\nとおくの　なかまと　あいずを　おくりあっていた。
records.english: AMPHAROS gives off so much light that\nit can be seen even from space.\nPeople in the old days used the light of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON to send signals back and\nforth with others far away.

records.japanese: より　くさい　クサイハナから　しんかした　ほうが\nきれいな　はなを　つけた　キレイハナに　なるよ。\nよるに　なると　はなびらを　つぼめて　ねむる。
records.english: A BELLOSSOM grows flowers more\nbeautifully if it has evolved from a\nsmelly GLOOM - the stinkier the better.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: At night, this POKéMON closes its\npetals and goes to sleep.

records.japanese: ながれの　はやい　かわで　エサを　とる　ときは\nしっぽを　かわべりの　きの　みきに　まきつける。\nしっぽは　だんりょくがあって　のびる　しくみ。
records.english: When fishing for food at the edge of a\nfast-running stream, MARILL wraps its\ntail around the trunk of a tree.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's tail is flexible and\nconfigured to stretch.

records.japanese: くうきの　ふうせんを　つくる　ことが　できる。\nポケモンが　おぼれていると　くうきだまを　だして\nこきゅうが　できる　ように　してあげるのだ。
records.english: AZUMARILL can make balloons out of\nair. It makes these air balloons if it\nspots a drowning POKéMON.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The air balloons enable the POKéMON in\ntrouble to breathe.

records.japanese: てきに　おそわれない　ように　きの　ふりをする。\nりょうては　１ねんじゅう　みどりいろなので\nふゆは　にせものだと　すぐに　ばれてしまう。
records.english: SUDOWOODO camouflages itself as a tree\nto avoid being attacked by enemies.\nHowever, because the forelegs remain

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: green throughout the year, the POKéMON\nis easily identified as a fake during\nthe winter.

records.japanese: あたまの　まきげは　おうじゃの　あかしだ。\nながく　きれいに　まいている　ニョロトノほど\nなかまの　そんけいを　あつめると　いわれている。
records.english: The curled hair on POLITOED's head is\nproof of its status as a king. It is said\nthat the longer and more curled the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: hair, the more respect this POKéMON\nearns from its peers.

records.japanese: かぜに　のって　ふわふわ　ただよう　ポケモン。\nきょうふうの　けはいを　かんじると　なかまどうし\nはっぱを　からめ　とばされない　じゅんびをする。
records.english: This POKéMON drifts and floats with the\nwind. If it senses the approach of\nstrong winds, HOPPIP links its leaves

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: with other HOPPIP to prepare against\nbeing blown away.

records.japanese: きおんが　１８どを　こえると　はなが　ひらく。\nおんどに　より　はなの　ひらきかたが　かわるので\nおんどけいの　かわりに　することも　ある。
records.english: SKIPLOOM's flower blossoms when the\ntemperature rises above 64 degrees F.\nHow much the flower opens depends on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the temperature. For that reason, this\nPOKéMON is sometimes used as a\nthermometer.

records.japanese: あたたかい　みなみかぜに　のって　うみを　こえ\nがいこくまで　とんでいってしまう　ポケモン。\nつめたい　くうきに　ふれると　じめんに　おりる。
records.english: JUMPLUFF rides warm southern winds to\ncross the sea and fly to foreign lands.\nThe POKéMON descends to the ground

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: when it encounters cold air while it is\nfloating.

records.japanese: きように　うごく　しっぽの　さきを　てのひらの\nかわりに　つかっていたら　はんたいに　りょうてが\nぶきように　なってしまった　ポケモンだ。
records.english: AIPOM's tail ends in a hand-like\nappendage that can be cleverly\nmanipulated.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, because the POKéMON uses its\ntail so much, its real hands have become\nrather clumsy.

records.japanese: からだに　ためた　えいようは　しんかの　ときまで\nとっておくため　ほとんど　うごこうとしない。\nなにも　たべずに　あさつゆ　だけを　のんでいる。
records.english: SUNKERN tries to move as little as it\npossibly can. It does so because it\ntries to conserve all the nutrients it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: has stored in its body for its\nevolution. It will not eat a thing, \nsubsisting only on morning dew.

records.japanese: たいようエネルギーから　えいようを　つくりだす。\nきおんの　たかい　にっちゅう　かっぱつに　うごき\nたいようが　しずむと　ぱったり　うごかなくなる。
records.english: SUNFLORA converts solar energy into\nnutrition. It moves around actively in\nthe daytime when it is warm.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It stops moving as soon as the sun goes\ndown for the night.

records.japanese: めだまを　うごかさずに　３６０ど　みわたせる。\nきゅうブレーキや　ほうこうてんかんが　とくい。\nねらった　えものを　すばやく　おいつめていく。
records.english: YANMA is capable of seeing 360 degrees\nwithout having to move its eyes.\nIt is a great flier that is adept at

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: making sudden stops and turning midair.\nThis POKéMON uses its flying ability to\nquickly chase down targeted prey.

records.japanese: ふだんは　みずの　なかで　くらしているが　エサを\nさがすときなど　たまに　ちじょうに　でてくる。\nりくでは　どくの　ねんえきで　からだを　おおう。
records.english: WOOPER usually lives in water.\nHowever, it occasionally comes out onto\nland in search of food.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: On land, it coats its body with a gooey,\ntoxic film.

records.japanese: みずの　なかで　くちを　あけて　エサが　ぐうぜん\nとびこんで　くるのを　ただただ　まっている。\nうごかないので　あまり　おなかが　すかないのだ。
records.english: QUAGSIRE hunts for food by leaving\nits mouth wide open in water and waiting\nfor its prey to blunder in unaware.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Because the POKéMON does not move,\nit does not get very hungry.

records.japanese: みとめた　トレーナーには　きわめて　ちゅうじつ。\nトレーナーを　きけんから　まもる　ために\nよちのうりょくが　はったつしたと　いわれている。
records.english: ESPEON is extremely loyal to any\nTRAINER it considers to be worthy.\nIt is said that this POKéMON developed

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its precognitive powers to protect its\nTRAINER from harm.

records.japanese: つきの　はどうを　うけて　しんかした　ポケモン。\nくらやみに　じっと　ひそみ　あいてを　うかがう。\nおそいかかる　とき　からだの　わっかが　ひかる。
records.english: UMBREON evolved as a result of exposure\nto the moon's waves.\nIt hides silently in darkness and waits

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: for its foes to make a move.\nThe rings on its body glow when it leaps\nto attack.

records.japanese: ふこうを　はこぶと　いわれ　おそれられていた。\nキラキラ　ひかる　ものに　きょうみを　しめし\nじょせいの　ゆびわを　とっていこうとする。
records.english: MURKROW was feared and loathed as the\nalleged bearer of ill fortune.\nThis POKéMON shows strong interest in

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: anything that sparkles or glitters.\nIt will even try to steal rings from\nwomen.

records.japanese: せかいの　ふしぎを　かいめい　するため　まいにち\nけんきゅう　しているが　あたまの　シェルダーが\nはずれると　ぜんぶ　わすれてしまう　らしい。
records.english: SLOWKING undertakes research every\nday in an effort to solve the mysteries\nof the world.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON apparently\nforgets everything it has learned if\nthe SHELLDER on its head comes off.

records.japanese: すすりなく　ような　なきごえで　こわがらせる。\nあいての　こわがる　こころを　あかい　たまで\nきゅうしゅうして　えいように　している　らしい。
records.english: MISDREAVUS frightens people with a\ncreepy, sobbing cry. The POKéMON\napparently uses its red spheres to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: absorb the fearful feelings of foes and\nturn them into nutrition.

records.japanese: こだいの　もじに　にた　すがたの　ポケモン。\nさきに　うまれたのは　もじか　アンノーンなのか。\nけんきゅうちゅうだが　いまだに　なぞである。
records.english: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient\nwriting. It is a mystery as to which\ncame first, the ancient writings or the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: various UNOWN. Research into this\ntopic is ongoing but nothing is known.

records.japanese: ひたすら　がまんする　ポケモンだが　しっぽを\nこうげきされる　ことだけは　がまん　できない。\nあいてを　みちづれにする　チャンスを　うかがう。
records.english: WOBBUFFET does nothing but endure\nattacks - it won't attack on its own.\nHowever, it won't endure an attack on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its tail. When that happens, the\nPOKéMON will try to take the foe with it\nusing DESTINY BOND.

records.japanese: しっぽの　のうは　かんがえごとが　できないほど\nちいさいけど　ねむらなくても　へいき　なので\n２４じかん　あたりを　みはりつづけて　いるぞ。
records.english: GIRAFARIG's rear head contains a tiny\nbrain that is too small for thinking.\nHowever, the rear head doesn't need to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: sleep, so it can keep watch over its\nsurroundings 24 hours a day.

records.japanese: きの　えだに　ぶらさがり　えものを　まっている。\nきを　ゆらされて　しょくじの　じゃまを　されると\nじめんに　おちてから　いきなり　ばくはつするぞ。
records.english: PINECO hangs from a tree branch and\npatiently waits for prey to come along.\nIf the POKéMON is disturbed while

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: eating by someone shaking its tree, it\ndrops down to the ground and explodes\nwith no warning.

records.japanese: こうてつの　カラの　なかに　ほんたいが　いる。\nえものを　つかまえる　ときに　カラが　ひらくが\nあまりの　はやさに　なかみは　みえないのだ。
records.english: FORRETRESS conceals itself inside its\nhardened steel shell. The shell is opened\nwhen the POKéMON is catching prey,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: but it does so at such a quick pace\nthat the shell's inside cannot be seen.

records.japanese: ドリルの　シッポを　つかって　うしろむきに\nじめんを　ほりすすみ　ふくざつな　かたちの\nすあなを　ちちゅう　ふかくに　つくる　ポケモン。
records.english: DUNSPARCE has a drill for its tail.\nIt uses this tail to burrow into the\nground backwards.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is known to make its nest\nin complex shapes deep under the\nground.

records.japanese: おとを　たてず　すべる　ように　かっくうする。\nりょううでの　おおきな　ツメと　あしの　ツメで\nえものの　かおに　しがみつき　どくばりを　さす。
records.english: GLIGAR glides through the air without\na sound as if it were sliding.\nThis POKéMON hangs on to the face of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its foe using its clawed hind legs and\nthe large pincers on its forelegs, then\ninjects the prey with its poison barb.

records.japanese: イワークよりも　ふかい　ちちゅうに　すんでいる。\nちきゅうの　ちゅうしんに　むかって　ほりすすみ\nふかさ　１キロに　たっする　ことも　ある。
records.english: STEELIX lives even further underground\nthan ONIX. This POKéMON is known to dig\ntowards the earth's core.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There are records of this POKéMON\nreaching a depth of over six-tenths\nof a mile underground.

records.japanese: キバを　むきだして　こわい　かおを　すれば\nちいさな　ポケモンなら　おびえて　にげだす。\nにげられた　ブルーは　ちょっと　さみしそう。
records.english: By baring its fangs and making a scary\nface, SNUBBULL sends smaller POKéMON\nscurrying away in terror.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON seems a little\nsad at making its foes flee.

records.japanese: したアゴが　とても　はったつした　ポケモン。\nキバが　おもたいので　くびを　かしげている。\nおどろかさなければ　むやみに　かみつかない。
records.english: GRANBULL has a particularly well-\ndeveloped lower jaw. The enormous fangs\nare heavy, causing the POKéMON to tip

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its head back for balance.\nUnless it is startled, it will not try to\nbite indiscriminately.

records.japanese: のみこんだ　みずの　ちからを　りようして\nぜんしんの　どくばりを　いっせいに　うちだす。\nおよぐのは　ちょっと　にがてな　ポケモンだ。
records.english: QWILFISH sucks in water, inflating\nitself. This POKéMON uses the pressure\nof the water it swallowed to shoot

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: toxic quills all at once from all over\nits body. It finds swimming somewhat\nchallenging.

records.japanese: はがねの　かたさを　もつ　からだは　ちょっとや\nそっとの　こうげきでは　びくとも　しないぞ。\nハネを　はばたかせ　たいおんを　ちょうせつする。
records.english: SCIZOR has a body with the hardness of\nsteel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary\nsorts of attacks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON flaps its wings to\nregulate its body temperature.

records.japanese: いわの　したで　こうらの　なかに　たくわえた\nきのみを　たべながら　みを　ひそめている。\nたいえきと　まざり　きのみは　ジュースに　なる。
records.english: SHUCKLE quietly hides itself under\nrocks, keeping its body concealed\ninside its hard shell while eating

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: berries it has stored away.\nThe berries mix with its body fluids to\nbecome a juice.

records.japanese: てあしの　するどい　ツメが　じめんや　じゅもくに\nふかく　くいこむので　じまんの　ツノで　あいてを\nなげとばす　とき　おもいっきり　ふんばれるのだ。
records.english: HERACROSS has sharp claws on its feet.\nThese are planted firmly into the\nground or the bark of a tree, giving the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON a secure and solid footing\nto forcefully fling away foes with\nits proud horn.

records.japanese: てあしの　カギヅメを　つきたてて　きを　のぼる。\nおやの　いない　すきを　ねらって　きの　うえに\nある　す　から　タマゴを　ぬすんで　たべる。
records.english: SNEASEL scales trees by punching its\nhooked claws into the bark.\nThis POKéMON seeks out unguarded

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: nests and steals eggs for food while\nthe parents are away.

records.japanese: ハチミツの　しみこんだ　てのひらを　なめている。\nヒメグマの　ハチミツは　くだものと　スピアーの\nあつめた　かふんが　ブレンドされて　つくられる。
records.english: This POKéMON likes to lick its palms that\nare sweetened by being soaked in honey.\nTEDDIURSA concocts its own honey by

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: blending fruits and pollen collected by\nBEEDRILL.

records.japanese: もりの　なかには　リングマが　エサあつめを　する\nたいぼくや　おがわが　あちこちに　あると　いう。\nまいにち　エサを　あつめて　もりを　あるく。
records.english: In the forests inhabited by URSARING,\nit is said that there are many streams\nand towering trees where they

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: gather food. This POKéMON walks\nthrough its forest gathering food\nevery day.

records.japanese: からだの　なかでは　けつえきの　かわりに\nひつような　えいようと　さんそを　はこぶために\nしゃくねつの　マグマが　じゅんかんしている。
records.english: SLUGMA does not have any blood in its\nbody. Instead, intensely hot magma\ncirculates throughout this POKéMON's

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: body, carrying essential nutrients and\noxygen to its organs.

records.japanese: たいおんが　やく１まんども　あるので　あまつぶに\nうたれると　じょうきが　もうもうと　たちこめて\nあたりは　ふかい　きりに　おおわれると　いう。
