records.english: MAGCARGO's body temperature is\napproximately 18,000 degrees F.\nWater is vaporized on contact.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If this POKéMON is caught in the rain,\nthe raindrops instantly turn into\nsteam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

records.japanese: じめんに　はなを　こすりつけて　エサを　さがす。\nかれくさの　したに　はえた　キノコが　こうぶつ。\nたまに　おんせんを　ほりあてる　ことが　あるよ。
records.english: SWINUB roots for food by rubbing its\nsnout against the ground. Its favorite\nfood is a mushroom that grows under

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the cover of dead grass.\nThis POKéMON occasionally roots out\nhot springs.

records.japanese: こごえる　さむさにも　たえられる　ように\nあつくて　ながい　けがわに　おおわれている。\nこおりに　うまった　エサを　キバで　ほりだす。
records.english: PILOSWINE is covered by a thick coat\nof long hair that enables it to endure\nthe freezing cold.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON uses its tusks to dig up\nfood that has been buried under ice.

records.japanese: あたたかい　うみに　あつまった　サニーゴは\nちいさい　ポケモンたちの　かくれがに　なる。\nすいおんが　さがると　みなみへ　いどうする。
records.english: Clusters of CORSOLA congregate in warm\nseas where they serve as ideal hiding\nplaces for smaller POKéMON.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When the water temperature falls, this\nPOKéMON migrates to the southern seas.

records.japanese: のんだ　みずを　ふっきんを　つかい　いきおいよく\nふきだして　そらを　とぶ　えものを　しとめる。\nしんかが　ちかづくと　かわを　くだっていく。
records.english: REMORAID sucks in water, then expels it\nat high velocity using its abdominal\nmuscles to shoot down flying prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When evolution draws near, this POKéMON\ntravels downstream from rivers.

records.japanese: きゅうばんの　うでで　あいてに　からみつく。\nうごけなくなった　ところを　しとめるのだ。\nかなわない　ときは　スミを　はいて　にげる。
records.english: OCTILLERY grabs onto its foe using\nits tentacles. This POKéMON tries to\nimmobilize it before delivering the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: finishing blow.\nIf the foe turns out to be too strong,\nOCTILLERY spews ink to escape.

records.japanese: しっぽで　エサを　つつみ　もちはこぶ　ポケモン。\nデリバードに　エサを　わけてもらった　おかげで\nエベレストを　のぼりきれた　ぼうけんかが　いた。
records.english: DELIBIRD carries its food bundled up\nin its tail. There once was a famous\nexplorer who managed to reach the peak

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of Mt. Everest thanks to one of these\nPOKéMON sharing its food.

records.japanese: はれた　ひには　うみの　うえを　ゆうがに　はねる\nマンタインの　むれを　みることが　できるよ。\nテッポウオが　くっついていても　きにしない。
records.english: On sunny days, schools of MANTINE can\nbe seen elegantly leaping over the\nsea's waves.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is not bothered by the\nREMORAID that hitches rides.

records.japanese: たたかいを　くりかえして　ボロボロに　なった\nはがねの　ハネは　１ねんに　１かい　はえかわり\nもとどおりの　きれあじを　とりもどすのだ。
records.english: SKARMORY's steel wings become tattered\nand bashed in from repeated battles.\nOnce a year, the battered wings grow

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: back completely, restoring the cutting\nedges to their pristine state.

records.japanese: さまざまな　なきごえを　つかいわけ　なかまと\nれんらくを　とりあい　えものを　おいこんでいく。\nチームワークの　みごとさは　ポケモンずいいち。
records.english: HOUNDOUR hunt as a coordinated pack.\nThey communicate with each other using\na variety of cries to corner their prey.

records.japanese: [NULL]
あたまの　ツノが　おおきく　そりかえって　いる\nヘルガーが　グループの　リーダーてき　そんざい。\nなかま　どうしで　あらそい　リーダーが　きまる。
records.english: In a HOUNDOOM pack, the one with its\nhorns raked sharply towards the back\nserves a leadership role.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These POKéMON choose their leader by\nfighting amongst themselves.

records.japanese: いきものの　すまない　かいていで　ねむっている。\nたいふうが　やってくると　めを　さまして\nえものを　さがしに　うろつきまわると　いわれる。
records.english: KINGDRA sleeps on the seafloor where\nit is otherwise devoid of life.\nWhen a storm arrives, the POKéMON is

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: said to awaken and wander about in\nsearch of prey.

records.japanese: ながい　はなを　つかって　みずあびを　する。\nなかまが　あつまってくると　みずを　かけあう。\nずぶぬれの　からだを　みずべで　かわかすよ。
records.english: PHANPY uses its long nose to shower\nitself. When others gather around, they\nthoroughly douse each other with water.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These POKéMON can be seen drying their\nsoaking-wet bodies at the edge of\nwater.

records.japanese: かたい　からだで　ぶつかれば　いえも　こわれる。\nその　ちからを　つかって　やまみちを　ふさいだ\nどしゃくずれを　どかす　しごとを　てつだうよ。
records.english: If DONPHAN were to tackle with its hard\nbody, even a house could be destroyed.\nUsing its massive strength, the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON helps clear rock and mud slides\nthat block mountain trails.

records.japanese: にんげんが　かがくの　ちからで　つくりだした。\nじんこう　ちのうを　もたせたので　あたらしい\nしぐさや　かんじょうを　ひとりで　おぼえていく。
records.english: PORYGON2 was created by humans using\nthe power of science. The man-made\nPOKéMON has been endowed with

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: artificial intelligence that enables it\nto learn new gestures and emotions\non its own.

records.japanese: みごとな　かたちの　ツノは　びじゅつひん　として\nたかく　うれた　ために　ぜつめつ　すんぜんまで\nらんかくされた　ことのある　ポケモン。
records.english: STANTLER's magnificent antlers were\ntraded at high prices as works of art.\nAs a result, this POKéMON was hunted

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: close to extinction by those who were\nafter the priceless antlers.

records.japanese: しっぽの　さきから　にじみでる　たいえきで\nなわばりの　まわりに　じぶんの　マークを　かく。\n５０００　しゅるいの　マークが　みつかっている。
records.english: SMEARGLE marks the boundaries of its\nterritory using a body fluid that leaks\nout from the tip of its tail.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Over 5,000 different marks left by this\nPOKéMON have been found.

records.japanese: まいにち　トレーニング　しないと　ストレスが\nたまってしまうので　トレーナーは　そだてる　とき\nスケジュールかんりに　くふうが　ひつようだ。
records.english: TYROGUE becomes stressed out if it\ndoes not get to train every day.\nWhen raising this POKéMON, the TRAINER

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: must establish and uphold various\ntraining methods.

records.japanese: こうそく　かいてんしながら　はなつ　キックは\nこうげきと　ぼうぎょを　かねた　みごとな　わざ。\nあるく　よりも　かいてんした　ほうが　はやい。
records.english: HITMONTOP spins on its head at high\nspeed, all the while delivering kicks.\nThis technique is a remarkable mix of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: both offense and defense at the same\ntime. The POKéMON travels faster\nspinning than it does walking.

records.japanese: げんき　いっぱい　うごきまわるが　よく　ころぶ。\nむっくり　おきあがると　みずうみの　すいめんに\nかおを　うつして　よごれていないか　しらべる。
records.english: SMOOCHUM actively runs about, but\nalso falls quite often.\nWhenever the chance arrives, it will

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: look for its reflection to make sure its\nface hasn't become dirty.

records.japanese: きんぞくに　さわって　からだに　ためた　でんきが\nほうでん　してしまうと　りょううでを　ぐるぐる\nまわして　ふたたび　でんきを　ためる。
records.english: ELEKID stores electricity in its body.\nIf it touches metal and accidentally\ndischarges all its built-up electricity,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON begins swinging its arms\nin circles to recharge itself.

records.japanese: きいろい　ほのおを　くちから　ふいている　ときは\nけんこうな　しょうこだが　つかれていると　くろい\nけむりが　まざる　ように　なるぞ。
records.english: MAGBY's state of health is determined\nby observing the fire it breathes.\nIf the POKéMON is spouting yellow

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: flames from its mouth, it is in good\nhealth. When it is fatigued, black smoke\nwill be mixed in with the flames.

records.japanese: まいにち　２０リットルの　ミルクを　だす。\nあまい　ミルクは　おとなも　こどもも　だいすき。\nにがてな　ひとは　ヨーグルトにして　たべている。
records.english: MILTANK gives over five gallons of milk\non a daily basis. Its sweet milk is\nenjoyed by children and grown-ups alike.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: People who can't drink milk turn it into\nyogurt and eat it instead.

records.japanese: ふわふわの　たいもうで　かなしんでいる　こころを\nキャッチすると　どんなに　とおくでも　かけつけて\nえがおに　なる　しあわせタマゴを　わけてあげる。
records.english: BLISSEY senses sadness with its fluffy\ncoat of fur. If it does so, this POKéMON\nwill rush over to the sad person,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: however far they may be, to share an\negg of happiness that brings a smile\nto any face.

records.japanese: かみなりの　スピードを　やどした　ポケモン。\nその　とおぼえは　かみなりが　おちた　ときの\nように　くうきを　ふるわせ　だいちを　ゆるがす。
records.english: RAIKOU embodies the speed of lightning.\nThe roars of this POKéMON send shock\nwaves shuddering through the air and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: shake the ground as if lightning bolts\nhad come crashing down.

records.japanese: マグマの　じょうねつを　やどした　ポケモン。\nかざんの　ふんかから　うまれたと　かんがえられ\nすべてを　やきつくす　ほのおを　ふきあげる。
records.english: ENTEI embodies the passion of magma.\nThis POKéMON is thought to have been\nborn in the eruption of a volcano.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It sends up massive bursts of fire that\nutterly consume all that they touch.

records.japanese: わきみずの　やさしさを　やどした　ポケモン。\nすべる　ような　みのこなしで　だいちを　はしり\nにごった　みずを　きよめる　ちからを　もつ。
records.english: SUICUNE embodies the compassion of\na pure spring of water. It runs across\nthe land with gracefulness.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has the power to purify\ndirty water.

records.japanese: ちちゅう　ふかくで　うまれる　ヨーギラスは\nつちを　たべつくして　ちじょうへ　でないと\nおやの　かおを　みる　ことが　できないのだ。
records.english: LARVITAR is born deep under the ground.\nTo come up to the surface, this POKéMON\nmust eat its way through the soil above.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Until it does so, LARVITAR cannot see\nits parent's face.

records.japanese: たいないで　つくりだした　ガスを　あっしゅくして\nいきおいよく　ふんしゃする　ことで　とんでいく。\nこうてつに　ぶつかっても　へいきな　ボディだ。
records.english: PUPITAR creates a gas inside its body\nthat it compresses and forcefully\nejects to propel itself like a jet.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The body is very durable - it avoids\ndamage even if it hits solid steel.

records.japanese: じぶんの　すみかを　つくる　ために　やま　ひとつ\nくずしてしまう　ほどの　つよい　パワーを　もつ。\nたたかう　あいてを　もとめて　やまを　さまよう。
records.english: TYRANITAR is so overwhelmingly\npowerful, it can bring down a whole\nmountain to make its nest.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON wanders about in\nmountains seeking new opponents to\nfight.

records.japanese: つばさを　かるく　はばたかせた　だけで　みんかを\nふきとばす　はかいりょくを　もっている　ために\nかいていで　ひとしれず　くらす　ように　なった。
records.english: LUGIA's wings pack devastating power -\na light fluttering of its wings can blow\napart regular houses.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, this POKéMON chooses to\nlive out of sight deep under the sea.

records.japanese: ひかりの　あたる　かくどに　よって　なないろに\nかがやく　ハネは　しあわせを　もたらすと　いう。\nにじの　ふもとに　すむと　いわれている。
records.english: HO-OH's feathers glow in seven colors\ndepending on the angle at which they\nare struck by light.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: These feathers are said to bring\nhappiness to the bearers. This POKéMON\nis said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

records.japanese: ときを　こえ　みらいから　やってきた　ポケモン。\nセレビィが　すがたを　あらわす　かぎり　あかるい\nみらいが　まっていると　かんがえられている。
records.english: This POKéMON came from the future by\ncrossing over time.\nIt is thought that so long as CELEBI

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: appears, a bright and shining future\nawaits us.

records.japanese: ちんちゃく　れいせい　なにごとにも　どうじない。\nからだの　おおきな　ポケモンに　にらまれても\nいっぽも　ひかずに　にらみかえすぞ。
records.english: TREECKO is cool, calm, and collected -\nit never panics under any situation.\nIf a bigger foe were to glare at this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON, it would glare right back\nwithout conceding an inch of ground.

records.japanese: えだから　えだへ　みがるに　とびまわる。\nどんなに　すばやい　ポケモンも　もりの　なかで\nジュプトルを　つかまえる　ことは　ふかのうだ。
records.english: This POKéMON adeptly flies from branch\nto branch in trees.\nIn a forest, no POKéMON can ever hope

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: to catch a fleeing GROVYLE however\nfast they may be.

records.japanese: せなかの　タネには　じゅもくを　げんきにする\nえいようが　たくさん　つまっていると　いわれる。\nもりの　きを　だいじに　そだてている　ポケモン。
records.english: SCEPTILE has seeds growing on its back.\nThey are said to be bursting with\nnutrients that revitalize trees.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON raises the trees in a\nforest with loving care.

records.japanese: たいないに　ほのおを　もやす　ばしょが　あるので\nだきしめると　ぽかぽか　とっても　あたたかい。\nぜんしん　ふかふかの　うもうに　おおわれている。
records.english: TORCHIC has a place inside its body\nwhere it keeps its flame. Give it a hug -\nit will be glowing with warmth.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON is covered all over by a\nfluffy coat of down.

records.japanese: クチバシから　はきだす　しゃくねつの　ほのおと\nはかいりょく　ばつぐんの　キックで　たたかう。\nなきごえが　おおきいので　とても　やかましい。
records.english: COMBUSKEN battles with the intensely\nhot flames it spews from its beak and\nwith outstandingly destructive kicks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's cry is very loud and\ndistracting.

records.japanese: きょうじんな　あしこしを　もち　３０かい　だての\nビルも　らくらく　とびこす　ことが　できる。\nほのおの　パンチで　あいてを　くろこげに　する。
records.english: BLAZIKEN has incredibly strong legs -\nit can easily clear a 30-story building\nin one leap.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's blazing punches leave\nits foes scorched and blackened.

records.japanese: すいちゅうでは　ほっぺの　エラで　こきゅうする。\nピンチに　なると　からだより　おおきな　いわを\nこなごなに　くだく　パワーを　はっきする。
records.english: In water, MUDKIP breathes using the\ngills on its cheeks.\nIf it is faced with a tight situation in

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: battle, this POKéMON will unleash its\namazing power - it can crush rocks\nbigger than itself.

records.japanese: すいちゅうを　およぐより　どろの　なかを\nすすむ　ほうが　だんぜん　はやく　いどうできる。\nあしこしが　はったつして　２ほんあしで　あるく。
records.english: MARSHTOMP is much faster at traveling\nthrough mud than it is at swimming.\nThis POKéMON's hindquarters exhibit

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: obvious development, giving it the\nability to walk on just its hind legs.

records.japanese: ラグラージは　なみおとや　しおかぜの　わずかな\nちがいを　ヒレで　かんじ　あらしを　よかんする。\nあらしになると　いわを　つみあげ　すを　まもる。
records.english: SWAMPERT predicts storms by sensing\nsubtle differences in the sounds of\nwaves and tidal winds with its fins.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If a storm is approaching, it piles up\nboulders to protect itself.

records.japanese: なんでも　たべる　ざっしょくせいの　ポケモン。\nからだに　くらべ　おおきな　キバが　とくちょう。\nしっぽの　けを　さかだてて　てきを　いかくする。
records.english: POOCHYENA is an omnivore - it will eat\nanything. A distinguishing feature is\nhow large its fangs are compared to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its body. This POKéMON tries to\nintimidate its foes by making the hair\non its tail bristle out.

records.japanese: グループで　こうどうしていた　やせいの　ちが\nのこっているので　すぐれた　トレーナー　だけを\nリーダーと　みとめて　めいれいに　したがう。
records.english: MIGHTYENA travel and act as a pack\nin the wild. The memory of its life in the\nwild compels the POKéMON to obey only

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: those TRAINERS that it recognizes to\npossess superior skill.

records.japanese: せなかの　かたい　けを　じゅもくに　こすりつけ\nじぶんの　なわばりで　ある　しるしを　つける。\nしんだ　ふりを　して　てきの　めを　ごまかすぞ。
records.english: The hair on ZIGZAGOON's back is \nbristly. It rubs the hard back hair\nagainst trees to leave its territorial

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: markings.\nThis POKéMON may play dead to fool foes\nin battle.

records.japanese: えもの　めがけて　いっちょくせんに　つっぱしる。\nじそく　１００キロを　こえる　スピードを　だすが\nいちど　きゅうていし　しないと　まがれないのだ。
records.english: When hunting, LINOONE will make a\nbeeline straight for the prey at a full\nrun. While this POKéMON is capable of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: topping 60 mph, it has to come to a\nscreeching halt before it can turn.

records.japanese: エサにしようと　つかまえにきた　オオスバメに\nおしりの　トゲを　むけて　ていこうする。\nしみだした　どくで　あいてを　よわらせるぞ。
records.english: WURMPLE is targeted by SWELLOW as\nprey. This POKéMON will try to resist by\npointing the spikes on its rear at the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: attacking predator.\nIt will weaken the foe by leaking poison\nfrom the spikes.

records.japanese: しんかするまで　なにも　たべずに　たえていると\nかんがえられていたが　どうやら　いとに　ついた\nあまみずで　かわきを　いやしているらしい。
records.english: SILCOON was thought to endure hunger\nand not consume anything before its\nevolution. However, it is now thought

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: that this POKéMON slakes its thirst by\ndrinking rainwater that collects on its\nsilk.

records.japanese: くるりと　まいた　はりの　ような　ながい　くちは\nかふんを　あつめる　ときに　とても　べんり。\nはるかぜに　のって　かふんを　あつめて　まわる。
records.english: BEAUTIFLY has a long mouth like a coiled\nneedle, which is very convenient for\ncollecting pollen from flowers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON rides the spring winds as\nit flits around gathering pollen.

records.japanese: うごくと　つよい　からだに　しんか　できないので\nどんなに　いためつけられても　じっと　している。\nそのとき　うけた　いたみは　ずっと　わすれない。
records.english: If it is attacked, CASCOON remains\nmotionless however badly it may be\nhurt. It does so because if it were to

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: move, its body would be weak upon\nevolution. This POKéMON will also not\nforget the pain it endured.

records.japanese: はばたくと　こまかい　こなが　まいあがる。\nすいこむと　プロレスラーも　ねこむ　もうどくだ。\nしょっかくの　レーダーで　エサを　さがす。
records.english: When DUSTOX flaps its wings, a fine\ndust is scattered all over. This dust is\nactually a powerful poison that will

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: even make a pro wrestler sick.\nThis POKéMON searches for food using\nits antennae like radar.

records.japanese: もともとは　ちじょうで　せいかつしていたが\nあたまの　はっぱが　おもくなったので　みずに\nうかんで　くらすようになったと　いわれている。
records.english: LOTAD is said to have dwelled on land\nbefore. However, this POKéMON is\nthought to have returned to water

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: because the leaf on its head grew large\nand heavy. It now lives by floating\natop the water.

records.japanese: からだじゅう　ヌルヌルした　ねんえきで　おおわれ\nその　てで　さわられると　とても　きもちわるい。\nにんげんの　こどもと　よく　まちがえられる。
records.english: LOMBRE's entire body is covered by a\nslippery, slimy film. It feels horribly\nunpleasant to be touched by this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON's hands.\nLOMBRE is often mistaken for a human\nchild.

records.japanese: ようきな　リズムを　きくと　からだの　さいぼうが\nかっぱつに　かつどうを　はじめる　たいしつ。\nたたかいでも　すごい　パワーを　はっきするぞ。
records.english: Upon hearing an upbeat and cheerful\nrhythm, the cells in LUDICOLO's body\nbecome very energetic and active.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Even in battle, this POKéMON will\nexhibit an amazing amount of power.

records.japanese: えだに　ぶらさがる　すがたは　きのみ　そっくり。\nいきなり　うごいて　ポケモンを　ビックリさせる。\n１にち　１かい　はっぱで　からだを　みがくよ。
records.english: SEEDOT looks exactly like an acorn\nwhen it is dangling from a tree branch.\nIt startles other POKéMON by suddenly

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: moving.\nThis POKéMON polishes its body once a\nday using leaves.

records.japanese: あたまの　はっぱを　ぬいて　くさぶえを　つくる。\nコノハナが　かなでる　くさぶえの　ねいろは\nもりで　まよった　ひとを　ふあんにさせる。
records.english: This POKéMON pulls out the leaf on its\nhead and makes a flute with it.\nThe sound of NUZLEAF's flute strikes

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: fear and uncertainty in the hearts of\npeople lost in a forest.

records.japanese: おおきな　うちわは　ふうそく　３０メートルの\nきょうふうを　おこし　なんでも　ふきとばす。\nもりの　おくで　ひっそり　くらす　ポケモンだ。
records.english: SHIFTRY's large fans generate awesome\ngusts of wind at a speed close to 100\nfeet per second. The whipped-up wind

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: blows anything away.\nThis POKéMON chooses to live quietly\ndeep in forests.

records.japanese: すだちを　おえたばかり　なので　よるに　なると\nさみしく　なって　ないてしまう　ことも　ある。\nもりに　すむ　ケムッソを　つかまえて　たべる。
records.english: TAILLOW is young - it has only just\nleft its nest. As a result, it sometimes\nbecomes lonesome and cries at night.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON feeds on WURMPLE that\nlive in forests.

records.japanese: ツヤの　ある　はねの　ていれは　おこたらない。\nオオスバメが　２ひき　あつまると　かならず\nおたがいの　はねを　きれいに　ていれするぞ。
records.english: SWELLOW is very conscientious about\nthe upkeep of its glossy wings.\nOnce two SWELLOW are gathered, they

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: diligently take care of cleaning each\nother's wings.

records.japanese: うみから　ふく　じょうしょう　きりゅうに　のり\nほそながい　つばさを　のばして　かっくうする。\nながい　くちばしは　エサを　とるときに　べんり。
records.english: WINGULL rides updrafts rising from the\nsea by extending its long and narrow\nwings to glide.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's long beak is useful for\ncatching prey.

records.japanese: かいめん　すれすれを　とび　エサを　さがす。\nおおきな　クチバシを　うみの　なかへ　いれて\nエサを　すくいとり　ひとのみで　たべるぞ。
records.english: PELIPPER searches for food while in\nflight by skimming the wave tops.\nThis POKéMON dips its large bill in the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: sea to scoop up food, then swallows\neverything in one big gulp.

records.japanese: ひとの　かんじょうを　さっちする　ちからを　もち\nトレーナーが　あかるい　きぶんの　ときには\nいっしょに　なって　よろこぶ　ポケモンだ。
records.english: RALTS has the ability to sense the\nemotions of people.\nIf its TRAINER is in a cheerful mood,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: this POKéMON grows cheerful and joyous\nin the same way.

records.japanese: あたまの　ツノで　ぞうふくされた　サイコパワーが\nつかわれるとき　まわりの　くうかんが　ねじまがり\nげんじつには　ない　けしきが　みえると　いう。
records.english: KIRLIA uses the horns on its head\nto amplify its psychokinetic power.\nWhen the POKéMON uses its power,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the air around it becomes distorted,\ncreating mirages of nonexistent\nscenery.

records.japanese: サイコパワーで　くうかんを　ねじまげ　ちいさな\nブラックホールを　つくりだす　ちからを　もつ。\nいのちがけで　トレーナーを　まもる　ポケモン。
records.english: GARDEVOIR has the psychokinetic\npower to distort the dimensions and\ncreate a small black hole.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON will try to protect its\nTRAINER even at the risk of its own\nlife.

records.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　あたまの　さきっぽから\nみずあめのような　あまい　えきたいを　だす。\nこれが　こうぶつの　ポケモンも　いるよ。
records.english: If SURSKIT senses danger, it secretes\na thick, sugary syrup from the tip of\nits head.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: There are some POKéMON that love\neating this syrup.

records.japanese: おこった　ひょうじょうの　めだま　もようが\nかなしそうに　たれさがっている　ときは\nゆうだちの　ふりだす　ぜんちょうと　いわれる。
records.english: MASQUERAIN's antennas have eyelike\npatterns that usually give it an angry\nlook. If the “eyes” are droopy and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: appear sad, it is said to be a sign\nthat a heavy rainfall is on its way.

records.japanese: きけんを　かんじると　からだを　ふるわせて\nあたまの　てっぺんから　ほうしを　ばらまくぞ。\nくさきも　しおれてしまうほどの　もうどくだ。
records.english: If SHROOMISH senses danger, it shakes\nits body and scatters spores from the\ntop of its head.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's spores are so toxic,\nthey make trees and weeds wilt.

records.japanese: シッポの　タネは　どくの　ほうしが　かたまって\nできた　ものなので　たべたら　たいへんだ。\nひとくちで　おなかが　グルグル　なりだすぞ。
records.english: The seeds ringing BRELOOM's tail are\nmade of hardened toxic spores. It is\nhorrible to eat the seeds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Just taking a bite of this POKéMON's\nseed will cause your stomach to rumble.

records.japanese: しんぞうの　こどうは　１ぷんかんに　１かい。\nとにかく　じっと　ねそべっている　ポケモンで\nうごく　すがたを　みることは　ほとんど　ない。
records.english: SLAKOTH's heart beats just once a\nminute. Whatever happens, it is\ncontent to loaf around motionless.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is rare to see this POKéMON in\nmotion.

records.japanese: じっとしている　ことが　できない　ポケモンだ。\nねむろうとしても　からだの　ちが　たぎってしまい\nもりじゅうを　かけまわらないと　おさまらない。
records.english: VIGOROTH is simply incapable of\nremaining still. Even when it tries to\nsleep, the blood in its veins grows

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: agitated, compelling this POKéMON to\nrun wild throughout the jungle before\nit can settle down.

records.japanese: そうげんに　きざまれた　はんけい　１メートルの\nわっかは　ケッキングが　ねそべったまま　まわりの\nくさを　たべつくして　できた　ものだ。
records.english: Wherever SLAKING live, rings of over\na yard in diameter appear in grassy\nfields. They are made by the POKéMON

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: as it eats all the grass within reach\nwhile lying prone on the ground.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメで　じゅもくの　ねっこを　けずり\nすいぶんや　えいようを　きゅうしゅうする。\nたいようの　ひかりは　まぶしいので　にがて。
records.english: NINCADA lives underground. It uses its\nsharp claws to carve the roots of trees\nand absorb moisture and nutrients.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON can't withstand bright\nsunlight so avoids it.

records.japanese: じょうずに　そだてないと　いうことを　きかず\nおおごえで　なきつづけるので　トレーナーの\nうでが　ためされる　ポケモンと　いわれている。
records.english: If NINJASK is not trained properly,\nit will refuse to obey the TRAINER and\ncry loudly continuously.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Because of this quality, this POKéMON\nis said to be one that puts the\nTRAINER's abilities to the test.

records.japanese: ツチニンが　しんかしたとき　なぜか　かってに\nモンスターボールに　はいっている　ポケモンだ。\nからだは　まったく　うごかず　いきも　しない。
records.english: SHEDINJA is a peculiar POKéMON.\nIt seems to appear unsought in a POKé\nBALL after a NINCADA evolves.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This bizarre POKéMON is entirely\nimmobile - it doesn't even breathe.

records.japanese: ひとたび　おおごえで　なきだすと　じぶんの\nこえに　びっくりして　さらに　はげしく　なく。\nなきやむと　つかれて　ねむってしまう。
records.english: WHISMUR is very timid. If it starts to\ncry loudly, it becomes startled by its\nown crying and cries even harder.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When it finally stops crying, the\nPOKéMON goes to sleep, all tired out.

records.japanese: あしを　ふみならしながら　おおごえを　だす。\nおおごえを　だしたあとは　しばらくの　あいだ\nなにも　きこえなくなってしまうのが　じゃくてん。
records.english: LOUDRED shouts while stamping its feet.\nAfter it finishes shouting, this\nPOKéMON becomes incapable of hearing

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: anything for a while. This is considered\nto be a weak point.

records.japanese: からだの　あなから　ふえの　ような　おとを\nだして　なかまに　きもちを　つたえている。\nおおごえは　たたかう　ときしか　ださないのだ。
records.english: EXPLOUD communicates its feelings to\nthe others by emitting whistle-like\nsounds from the tubes on its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON only raises its voice when\nit is in battle.

records.japanese: ぜったいに　あきらめない　こんじょうを　もつ。\nたくさん　たべ　よく　ねて　うんどうする　ことで\nからだの　なかに　エネルギーが　じゅうまんする。
records.english: MAKUHITA has a tireless spirit -\nit will never give up hope. It eats a lot\nof food, gets plenty of sleep, and it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: trains very rigorously. By living that\nway, this POKéMON packs its body with\nenergy.

records.japanese: ふとった　からだは　きんにくの　かたまり。\nぐぐっと　ぜんしんに　ちからを　こめると\nきんにくは　いわと　おなじ　かたさになるぞ。
records.english: HARIYAMA's thick body may appear fat,\nbut it is actually a hunk of solid muscle.\nIf this POKéMON bears down and

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: tightens all its muscles, its body\nbecomes as hard as a rock.

records.japanese: しっぽには　せいちょうする　ために　ひつような\nえいようが　たっぷり　つまっているぞ。\nだんりょくの　ある　しっぽに　のって　あそぶ。
records.english: AZURILL's tail is large and bouncy.\nIt is packed full of the nutrients this\nPOKéMON needs to grow.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: AZURILL can be seen bouncing and\nplaying on its big, rubbery tail.

records.japanese: じしゃくの　はなを　きたに　むけたまま　まったく\nうごかないと　いわれていたが　１ねんに　１センチ\nいどう　している　ことが　かんそくされた。
records.english: NOSEPASS had been said to be completely\nunmoving, with its magnetic nose\npointed due north.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, close observation has revealed\nthat the POKéMON actually moves by a\nlittle over 3/8 of an inch every year.

records.japanese: じぶんの　シッポを　おいかけまわす　ポケモン。\nやせいは　もりの　じゅもくの　あなで　くらす。\nあいくるしい　かおで　ペットとして　だいにんき。
records.english: SKITTY is known to chase around\nplayfully after its own tail. In the wild,\nthis POKéMON lives in holes in the trees

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: of forests. It is very popular as a pet\nbecause of its adorable looks.

records.japanese: きまった　すみかを　もたずに　くらす　ポケモン。\nほかの　ポケモンが　ねどこに　ちかよって　きても\nけっして　あらそわず　ねる　ばしょを　かえる。
records.english: DELCATTY sleeps anywhere it wants\nwithout keeping a permanent nest.\nIf other POKéMON approach it as it

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: sleeps, this POKéMON will never fight -\nit will just move away somewhere else.

records.japanese: するどい　ツメで　つちを　ほり　いしを　たべる。\nいしに　ふくまれた　せいぶんは　けっしょうとなり\nからだの　ひょうめんに　うかびあがってくる。
records.english: SABLEYE digs the ground with sharpened\nclaws to find rocks that it eats.\nSubstances in the eaten rocks

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: crystallize and rise up to the POKéMON's\nbody surface.

records.japanese: あいてを　ゆだんさせ　おおきな　あごで　がぶり。\nかわいい　かおに　だまされると　きけんだよ。\nはがねの　あごは　ツノが　へんけいした　ものだ。
records.english: Don't be taken in by this POKéMON's\ncute face - it's very dangerous. MAWILE\nfools the foe into letting down its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: guard, then chomps down with its\nmassive jaws. The steel jaws are really\nhorns that have been transformed.

records.japanese: こうてつの　からだで　おもいっきり　ぶつかれば\nおおきな　ダンプカーも　いちげきで　バラバラだ。\nこわれた　ダンプカーを　むしゃむしゃ　たべるぞ。
records.english: ARON has a body of steel.\nWith one all-out charge, this POKéMON\ncan demolish even a heavy dump truck.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The destroyed dump truck then becomes\na handy meal for the POKéMON.

records.japanese: いしや　みずに　ふくまれる　てつぶんを　たべる。\nてっこうせきの　うもれた　やまに　すを　つくるが\nてつを　とりにくる　にんげんと　あらそいになる。
records.english: LAIRON feeds on iron contained in\nrocks and water. It makes its nest on\nmountains where iron ore is buried.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: As a result, the POKéMON often clashes\nwith humans mining the iron ore.

records.japanese: どしゃくずれや　やまかじで　やまが　あれると\nせっせと　つちを　はこび　きの　なえを　うえて\nじぶんの　なわばりを　きれいに　そうじする。
records.english: AGGRON is surprisingly protective\nof its environment. If its mountain\nis ravaged by a landslide or a fire, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON will haul topsoil to the area,\nplant trees, and beautifully restore its\nown territory.

records.japanese: めいそうで　せいしんエネルギーを　たかめている。\n１にちに　きのみを　１こだけしか　たべない。\nあまり　たべない　ことも　しゅぎょうの　ひとつ。
records.english: MEDITITE heightens its inner energy\nthrough meditation. It survives on\njust one berry a day.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Minimal eating is another aspect of\nthis POKéMON's training.

records.japanese: ヨガの　ちからで　だい６かんが　はったつして\nサイコパワーを　あやつれる　ように　なった。\n１かげつかん　なにも　たべずに　めいそうする。
records.english: Through the power of meditation,\nMEDICHAM developed its sixth sense.\nIt gained the ability to use

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: psychokinetic powers. This POKéMON is\nknown to meditate for a whole month\nwithout eating.

records.japanese: めにも　とまらぬ　スピードで　はしる　ポケモン。\nくうきの　まさつで　でんきを　はっせいさせて\nぜんしんの　たいもうに　たくわえている。
records.english: ELECTRIKE runs faster than the human\neye can follow. The friction from\nrunning is converted into electricity,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: which is then stored in this POKéMON's\nfur.

records.japanese: たてがみから　つよい　でんきを　はっしている。\nくうきちゅうの　でんきを　たてがみに　あつめ\nあたまの　うえに　かみなりぐもを　つくりだす。
records.english: MANECTRIC discharges strong\nelectricity from its mane. The mane is\nused for collecting electricity in the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: atmosphere. This POKéMON creates\nthunderclouds above its head.

records.japanese: なかまを　おうえんする　ときは　ぜんしんから\nでんきの　ひばなを　だして　パチパチ　ひかる。\nなかまが　まけると　おおごえで　ないてしまう。
records.english: When PLUSLE is cheering on its partner,\nit flashes with electric sparks from all\nover its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If its partner loses, this POKéMON cries\nloudly.

records.japanese: なかまの　おうえんが　だいすきな　ポケモン。\nなかまが　まけそうに　なると　からだから　でる\nひばなの　かずが　どんどん　ふえていくよ。
records.english: MINUN loves to cheer on its partner in\nbattle. It gives off sparks from its\nbody while it is doing so.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If its partner is in trouble, this\nPOKéMON gives off increasing amounts\nof sparks.

records.japanese: しっぽの　あかりを　つかって　しゅうだんで\nよぞらに　きかがくてきな　ずけいを　えがく。\nイルミーゼの　だす　あまい　かおりが　だいすき。
records.english: VOLBEAT's tail glows like a lightbulb.\nWith other VOLBEAT, it uses its tail to\ndraw geometric shapes in the night sky.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON loves the sweet aroma\ngiven off by ILLUMISE.

records.japanese: バルビートを　ゆうどうして　サインを　えがく。\nふくざつな　サインを　えがく　イルミーゼほど\nなかまから　そんけいされると　いわれているよ。
records.english: ILLUMISE leads a flight of illuminated\nVOLBEAT to draw signs in the night sky.\nThis POKéMON is said to earn greater

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: respect from its peers by composing\nmore complex designs in the sky.

records.japanese: ごく　まれに　めずらしい　いろの　はなを\nさかせている　ロゼリアが　いると　いわれる。\nあたまの　トゲは　もうどくを　もっているぞ。
records.english: On extremely rare occasions, a ROSELIA\nis said to appear with its flowers in\nunusual colors.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The thorns on this POKéMON's head\ncontain a vicious poison.

records.japanese: からだの　だいぶぶんが　いぶくろで　できていて\nしんぞうや　のうみそは　とても　ちいさい。\nなんでも　とかす　とくしゅな　いえきを　もつ。
records.english: Most of GULPIN's body is made up of its\nstomach - its heart and brain are very\nsmall in comparison.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's stomach contains\nspecial enzymes that dissolve anything.

records.japanese: はが　１ぽんも　ないので　なんでも　まるのみ。\nいっぱいに　あけた　くちは　とても　おおきく\nじどうしゃの　タイヤだって　すっぽり　はいるぞ。
records.english: SWALOT has no teeth, so what it\neats, it swallows whole, no matter what.\nIts cavernous mouth yawns widely.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: An automobile tire could easily fit\ninside this POKéMON's mouth.

records.japanese: テリトリーを　あらす　ものには　しゅうだんで\nおそいかかり　とがった　キバで　やつざきにする。\n１ぴきに　なると　とたんに　よわごしに　なるぞ。
records.english: If anything invades CARVANHA's\nterritory, it will swarm and tear at the\nintruder with its pointed fangs.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: On its own, however, this POKéMON turns\nsuddenly timid.

records.japanese: かいすいを　おしりの　あなから　ふきだして\nじそく１２０キロで　およぐことが　できる。\nながい　きょりを　およげないのが　じゃくてんだ。
records.english: SHARPEDO can swim at speeds of up to\n75 mph by jetting seawater out of its\nbackside.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's drawback is its inability\nto swim long distances.

records.japanese: からだに　かいすいを　ためると　ボールの　ように\nじめんで　とびはねることが　できるように　なる。\nたくさん　ためると　たかく　ジャンプできる。
records.english: WAILMER can store water inside its body\nto transform itself into a ball for\nbouncing around on the ground.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: By filling itself up with more water, this\nPOKéMON can elevate the height of its\nbounces.

records.japanese: えものを　おいたてる　ために　すいちゅうから\nジャンプして　おおきな　みずしぶきを　あげる。\nむれで　ジャンプする　すがたは　だいはくりょく。
records.english: When chasing prey, WAILORD herds them\nby leaping out of the water and making\na humongous splash.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is breathtaking to see this POKéMON\nleaping out of the sea with others in\nits pod.

records.japanese: １２００どの　マグマを　からだに　ためている。\nみずに　ぬれると　マグマが　ひえて　かたまり\nおもたくなるので　うごきが　にぶって　しまう。
records.english: NUMEL stores magma of almost 2,200\ndegrees F within its body. If it gets\nwet, the magma cools and hardens.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: In that event, the POKéMON's body\ngrows heavy and its movements become\nsluggish.

records.japanese: せなかの　コブは　ほねが　かたちを　かえたもの。\nにえたぎった　マグマを　ときどき　ふきあげる。\nおこった　ときに　よく　ふんかする　らしい。
records.english: The humps on CAMERUPT's back are\nformed by a transformation of its\nbones. They sometimes blast out molten

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: magma. This POKéMON apparently erupts\noften when it is enraged.

records.japanese: せきたんを　もやして　エネルギーを　つくりだす。\nひの　いきおいが　よわまると　げんきが　なくなり\nたたかう　ときは　せきたんを　たくさん　もやす。
records.english: TORKOAL generates energy by burning\ncoal. It grows weaker as the fire\ndies down.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When it is preparing for battle, this\nPOKéMON burns more coal.

records.japanese: あたまに　のせた　しんじゅが　バネブーの\nサイコパワーを　たかめる　はたらきをする。\nおおきな　しんじゅを　いつも　さがしている。
records.english: SPOINK keeps a pearl on top of its head.\nThe pearl functions to amplify this\nPOKéMON's psychokinetic powers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is therefore on a constant search\nfor a bigger pearl.

records.japanese: くろしんじゅを　りようして　ふしぎな　ちからを\nつかうとき　きみょうな　ステップで　おどりだす。\nくろしんじゅは　びじゅつひんの　かちを　もつ。
records.english: GRUMPIG uses the black pearls on its\nbody to wield its fantastic powers.\nWhen it is doing so, it dances bizarrely.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's black pearls are valuable\nas works of art.

records.japanese: おなじ　ブチもようは　ないと　いわれている。\nいつも　めを　まわしている　ような　フラフラした\nうごきには　てきを　まどわせる　こうかが　ある。
records.english: No two SPINDA are said to have\nidentical spot patterns on their hides.\nThis POKéMON moves in a curious manner

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: as if it is stumbling in dizziness.\nIts lurching movements can cause the\nopponent to become confused.

records.japanese: だっしゅつ　ふかのうな　あなを　さばくに　つくり\nえものが　くるのを　ひたすら　まちかまえている。\nみずが　なくても　１しゅうかんは　へっちゃら。
records.english: TRAPINCH is a patient hunter. It digs\nan inescapable pit in a desert and waits\nfor its prey to come tumbling down.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON can go a whole week\nwithout access to any water.

records.japanese: ビブラーバの　ハネは　まだ　せいちょうとちゅう。\nながい　きょりを　とぶ　よりも　しんどうさせて\nちょうおんぱを　だす　ほうが　とくいなのだ。
records.english: VIBRAVA's wings have not yet\ncompleted the process of growing.\nRather than flying long distances,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: they are more useful for generating\nultrasonic waves by vibrating.

records.japanese: はばたきで　おこす　すなあらしの　なかから\nうたごえの　ような　はおと　だけが　きこえるため\nフライゴンは　さばくの　せいれいと　いわれた。
records.english: FLYGON whips up a sandstorm by\nflapping its wings. The wings create a\nseries of notes that sound like singing.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Because the “singing” is the only thing\nthat can be heard in a sandstorm, this\nPOKéMON is said to be the desert spirit.

records.japanese: あめの　すくない　きびしい　かんきょう　ほど\nきれいで　かおりの　つよい　はなを　さかせる。\nトゲの　ついた　うでを　ふりまわして　たたかう。
records.english: The more arid and harsh the\nenvironment, the more pretty and\nfragrant a flower CACNEA grows.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON battles by wildly swinging\nits thorny arms.

records.japanese: まよなか　さばくを　あるく　たびびとの　うしろを\nぞろぞろと　しゅうだんで　くっついて　あるく。\nつかれて　うごけなく　なるのを　まっているのだ。
records.english: If a traveler is going through a desert\nin the thick of night, CACTURNE\nwill follow in a ragtag group.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON are biding their time,\nwaiting for the traveler to tire and\nbecome incapable of moving.

records.japanese: よごれたものを　みると　わたの　ような　つばさで\nせっせと　ふきとる　きれいずきな　ポケモンだ。\nつばさが　よごれると　かわで　みずあびを　する。
records.english: SWABLU loves to make things clean.\nIf it spots something dirty, it will wipe\nand polish it with its cottony wings.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: If its wings become dirty, this POKéMON\nfinds a stream and showers itself.

records.japanese: うつくしい　ソプラノで　うたう　ポケモン。\nわたぐもの　ような　つばさで　じょうしょう\nきりゅうを　うけて　おおぞらへ　まいあがる。
records.english: ALTARIA sings in a gorgeous soprano.\nIts wings are like cotton clouds.\nThis POKéMON catches updrafts with its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: buoyant wings and soars way up into\nthe wild blue yonder.

records.japanese: ふだんは　４ほんあしで　こうどうして　いるが\nおこると　うしろあしで　たち　ツメが　とびだす。\nハブネークとは　せんぞから　つづく　ライバルだ。
records.english: ZANGOOSE usually stays on all fours,\nbut when angered, it gets up on its\nhind legs and extends its claws.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shares a bitter rivalry\nwith SEVIPER that dates back over\ngenerations.

records.japanese: かたなの　ような　しっぽは　てきを　きりさくのと\nどうじに　しみだした　もうどくを　あびせるぞ。\nしゅくてき　ザングースと　たたかい　つづける。
records.english: SEVIPER's swordlike tail serves two\npurposes - it slashes foes and douses\nthem with secreted poison.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON will not give up its long-\nrunning blood feud with ZANGOOSE.

records.japanese: まんげつの　じき　かっぱつになる　しゅうせい。\nくうちゅうに　ういて　いどうし　あかい　ひとみは\nみたものの　からだを　すくませる　はくりょく。
records.english: LUNATONE becomes active around the\ntime of the full moon. Instead of\nwalking, it moves by floating in midair.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON's intimidating red eyes\ncause all those who see it to become\ntransfixed with fear.

records.japanese: たいよう　こうせんが　パワーの　みなもと。\nあいての　こころを　よみとると　いわれている。\nからだを　かいてんさせて　こうねつを　はなつ。
records.english: Sunlight is the source of SOLROCK's\npower. It is said to possess the ability\nto read the emotions of others.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON gives off intense heat\nwhile rotating its body.

records.japanese: からだが　ヌルヌルの　まくで　おおわれているので\nてきに　つかまれても　ヌルリと　にげだせるのだ。\nヌルヌルが　かわくと　からだが　よわってしまう。
records.english: BARBOACH's body is covered with a\nslimy film. If a foe grabs it, this\nPOKéMON just slips out of the enemy's

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: grip.\nThis POKéMON grows weak if the slimy\ncoating dries up.

records.japanese: おおあばれ　すると　ぬまの　しゅうい　５キロの\nはんいで　じしんの　ような　ゆれが　おこる。\nほんとうの　じしんを　よちする　ちからも　もつ。
records.english: If WHISCASH goes on a wild rampage,\nit sets off a quake-like tremor with a\nradius of over three miles.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has the ability to predict\nreal earthquakes.

records.japanese: するどい　ハサミで　えものを　つかまえる。\nすき　きらいが　ないので　なんでも　たべるぞ。\nきたない　みずでも　へっちゃらな　ポケモン。
records.english: CORPHISH catches prey with its sharp\nclaws. It has no likes or dislikes when it\ncomes to food - it will eat anything.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON has no trouble living in\nfilthy water.

records.japanese: だっぴした　ちょくごは　こうらが　やわらかい。\nこうらが　かたくなるまで　てきの　こうげきを\nさけるため　かわぞこの　あなに　かくれている。
records.english: CRAWDAUNT molts (sheds) its shell\nregularly. Immediately after molting,\nits shell is soft and tender.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Until the shell hardens, this POKéMON\nhides in its streambed burrow to avoid\nattack from its foes.

records.japanese: なかまを　みつけると　すぐに　あつまって　きて\nいっせいに　なきごえを　あげるので　うるさい。\nいっぽんあしで　きように　たったまま　ねむる。
records.english: As soon as it spots others of its kind,\nBALTOY congregates with them and\nthen begins crying noisily in unison.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON sleeps while cleverly\nbalancing itself on its one foot.

records.japanese: ２まんねんまえに　さかえた　こだい　ぶんめいの\nどろにんぎょうから　うまれた　ナゾの　ポケモン。\nりょうてから　ビームを　はっしゃするぞ。
records.english: CLAYDOL is an enigma that appeared\nfrom a clay statue made by an ancient\ncivilization dating back 20,000 years.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shoots beams from both\nits hands.

records.japanese: かせきから　さいせいした　こだいの　ポケモン。\nいわに　くっつき　あるく　ことが　できない。\n２つの　めで　じっと　えものを　さがしている。
records.english: LILEEP is an ancient POKéMON that was\nregenerated from a fossil. It remains\npermanently anchored to a rock.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: From its immobile perch, this POKéMON\nintently scans for prey with its two\neyes.

records.japanese: からだが　おもりがわりに　なっているので\nうみが　あれても　ながされる　ことは　ない。\nしょくしゅから　つよい　しょうかえきを　だす。
records.english: CRADILY's body serves as an anchor,\npreventing it from being washed away in\nrough seas.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON secretes a strong\ndigestive fluid from its tentacles.

records.japanese: ポケモンの　せんぞの　いっしゅと　いわれている。\nからだの　よこに　ついた　８まいの　はねを\nくねらせて　たいこの　うみを　およいでいた。
records.english: ANORITH is said to be a type of \nPOKéMON predecessor, with eight wings\nat the sides of its body.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON swam in the primordial sea\nby undulating these eight wings.

records.japanese: おおむかし　ぜつめつした　ポケモンの　いっしゅ。\nちじょうで　くらすとき　べんりな　ように\n２ほんの　あしで　あるくように　なったと　いう。
records.english: ARMALDO is a POKéMON species that\nbecame extinct in prehistoric times.\nThis POKéMON is said to have walked on

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: its hind legs, which would have been\nmore convenient for life on land.

records.japanese: からだは　ボロボロだが　どこでも　いきていける\nしぶとい　せいめいりょくを　もつ　ポケモン。\nしかし　ノロマなので　すぐに　つかまってしまう。
records.english: While FEEBAS's body is in tatters,\nit has a hardy and tenacious life force\nthat enables it to live anywhere.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: However, this POKéMON is also slow and\ndimwitted, making it an easy catch.

records.japanese: おおきな　みずうみの　そこに　すんでいる。\nからだが　あざやかな　ピンクいろに　かがやくとき\nすさんだ　こころを　いやす　はどうを　はなつ。
records.english: MILOTIC live at the bottom of large\nlakes. When this POKéMON's body glows a\nvivid pink, it releases a pulsing wave of

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: energy that brings soothing calm to\nrestless spirits.

records.japanese: しぜんの　ちからを　うけて　たいよう　あまみず\nゆきぐもに　すがたを　かえる　ポケモン。\nきしょうが　かわると　きしょうも　かわるぞ。
records.english: CASTFORM borrows the power of nature\nto transform itself into the guises of\nthe sun, rain clouds, and snow clouds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON's feelings change with the\nweather.

records.japanese: からだを　けしきと　おなじ　いろに　かえて\nえものに　きづかれない　ように　しのびよる。\nながく　のびる　ベロで　すばやく　つかまえる。
records.english: KECLEON alters its body coloration to\nblend in with its surroundings, allowing\nit to sneak up on its prey unnoticed.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Then it lashes out with its long,\nstretchy tongue to instantly ensnare\nthe unsuspecting target.

records.japanese: ひとの　こころに　ある　うらみや　ねたみ　などの\nかんじょうを　たべて　せいちょうする　ポケモン。\nうらむ　こころを　さがして　まちを　さまよう。
records.english: SHUPPET grows by feeding on dark\nemotions, such as vengefulness and \nenvy, in the hearts of people.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It roams through cities in search of\ngrudges that taint people.

records.japanese: すてられた　ぬいぐるみの　わたに　のろいの\nエネルギーが　しみこんで　ポケモンに　なった。\nくちを　あけると　エネルギーが　にげてしまう。
records.english: A cursed energy permeated the stuffing\nof a discarded and forgotten plush doll,\ngiving it new life as BANETTE.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON's energy would escape if it\nwere to ever open its mouth.

records.japanese: まよなか　やみに　まぎれて　さまよっている。\nママに　しかられるような　わるいこは　ヨマワルに\nさらわれるという　いいつたえが　のこっている。
records.english: DUSKULL wanders lost among the deep\ndarkness of midnight. There is an oft-\ntold admonishment given to misbehaving

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: children that this POKéMON will spirit\naway bad children who earn scoldings\nfrom their mothers.

records.japanese: どんな　おおきさの　ものも　すいこんで　しまう。\nあやしげな　ての　うごきと　ひとつめの　ちからで\nあいてを　さいみん　じょうたいにして　あやつる。
records.english: DUSCLOPS absorbs anything, however\nlarge the object may be. This POKéMON\nhypnotizes its foe by waving its hands

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: in a macabre manner and by bringing its\nsingle eye to bear. The hypnotized foe\nis made to do DUSCLOPS's bidding.

records.japanese: なんごくの　こどもたちは　トロピウスの　くびに\nなった　くだものの　フサを　おやつに　たべるよ。\nせなかの　はっぱを　はばたかせて　そらを　とぶ。
records.english: Children of the southern tropics eat\nas snacks the fruit that grows in\nbunches around the neck of TROPIUS.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON flies by flapping the\nleaves on its back as if they were\nwings.

records.japanese: かぜが　つよくなると　きの　えだや　のきしたに\nあたまの　きゅうばんで　ぶらさがり　なきだす。\nながい　シッポで　きのみを　つまんで　たべる。
records.english: In high winds, CHIMECHO cries as it\nhangs from a tree branch or the eaves\nof a building using a suction cup on its

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: head.\nThis POKéMON plucks berries with its\nlong tail and eats them.

records.japanese: しぜんさいがいを　キャッチする　ちからを　もつ。\nけわしい　さんがくちたいに　せいそくし\nめったに　やまの　ふもとには　おりてこない。
records.english: ABSOL has the ability to foretell the\ncoming of natural disasters.\nIt lives in a harsh, rugged mountain

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: environment. This POKéMON very rarely\nventures down from the mountains.

records.japanese: つきのよる　なかまたちと　おしくらまんじゅう。\nぎゅうぎゅう　おされて　がまんづよくなる。\nきょうれつな　カウンターを　くりだす　くんれん。
records.english: WYNAUT gather on moonlit nights to play\nby squeezing up against each other.\nBy being squeezed, this POKéMON gains

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: endurance and is trained to dole out\npowerful counterattacks.

records.japanese: ゆきや　こおりだけを　たべて　くらしている。\nユキワラシの　おとずれた　いえは　だいだい\nさかえるという　いいつたえが　のこっている。
records.english: SNORUNT survives by eating only snow\nand ice.\nOld folklore claims that a house visited

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: by this POKéMON is sure to prosper for\nmany generations to come.

records.japanese: こおりを　じざいに　あつかう　ちからを　もつ。\nえものを　いっしゅんで　こおらせて　うごけなく\nなった　ところを　おいしく　いただくのだ。
records.english: GLALIE has the ability to freely\ncontrol ice. For example, it can\ninstantly freeze its foe solid.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: After immobilizing its foe in ice, this\nPOKéMON enjoys eating it in leisurely\nfashion.

records.japanese: いつも　ころがって　いどうする　ポケモンだ。\nりゅうひょうの　きせつに　こおりの　うえを\nころがり　うみを　わたる　すがたを　みかける。
records.english: SPHEAL always travels by rolling\naround on its ball-like body. When the\nseason for ice floes arrives, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON can be seen rolling about on\nice and crossing the sea.

records.japanese: しょっちゅう　はなで　なにかを　まわしている。\nまわしながら　においや　かんしょくを　たしかめて\nすきな　ものと　きらいな　ものを　わけるのだ。
records.english: SEALEO often balances and rolls\nthings on the tip of its nose. While the\nPOKéMON is rolling something, it checks

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: the object's aroma and texture to\ndetermine whether it likes the object\nor not.

records.japanese: おおきな　キバで　ひょうざんを　くだきながら\nひょうてんかの　うみを　およぎまわる。\nぶあつい　しぼうが　こうげきを　はねかえす。
records.english: WALREIN swims all over in frigid\nseawater while crushing icebergs with\nits grand, imposing tusks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy\nattacks bounce off harmlessly.

records.japanese: かたい　かいがらに　まもられて　せいちょうする。\nほんたいが　カラに　おさまり　きらなくなると\nしんかの　しゅんかんが　ちかづいた　しょうこ。
records.english: CLAMPERL grows while being protected\nby its rock-hard shell. When its body\nbecomes too large to fit inside the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: shell, it is sure evidence that this\nPOKéMON is getting close to evolution.

records.japanese: さかなの　かたちをした　シッポで　おびきよせ\nおおきな　くちで　エサを　まるのみ　する。\nヘビのように　からだを　くねらせて　およぐ。
records.english: HUNTAIL's tail is shaped like a fish.\nIt uses the tail to attract prey, then\nswallows the prey whole with its large,

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: gaping mouth.\nThis POKéMON swims by wiggling its\nslender body like a snake.

records.japanese: およぐ　すがたは　ゆうがで　とても　きれいだが\nえものを　みつけると　ほそい　くちを　からだに\nさしこんで　たいえきを　ずるずる　すするぞ。
records.english: Although GOREBYSS is the very picture\nof elegance and beauty while swimming,\nit is also cruel. When it spots prey, this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON inserts its thin mouth into the\nprey's body and drains the prey of its\nbody fluids.

records.japanese: しんかい　ちょうさで　はっけんされた　ちんしゅ。\nごつごつした　いわの　ような　うろこで　おおわれ\nかいていの　すいあつに　たえる　からだを　もつ。
records.english: RELICANTH is a rare species that was\ndiscovered in deep-sea explorations.\nThis POKéMON's body withstands the

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: enormous water pressure of the ocean\ndepths. Its body is covered in tough\nscales that are like craggy rocks.

records.japanese: ハートがたの　からだは　あいじょうの　シンボル。\nラブカスに　であった　カップルは　えいえんの\nあいが　やくそくされると　いわれているよ。
records.english: LUVDISC's heart-shaped body is a\nsymbol of love and romance.\nIt is said that any couple meeting this

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: POKéMON is promised a loving\nrelationship that never ends.

records.japanese: おおぞらを　とぶことを　ゆめみている　ポケモン。\nとべない　くやしさを　はらす　ように　おおいわに\nいしあたまを　うちつけては　コナゴナに　くだく。
records.english: BAGON harbors a never-ending dream of\none day soaring high among the clouds.\nAs if trying to dispel its frustration

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: over its inability to fly, this POKéMON\nslams its hard head against huge rocks\nand shatters them into pebbles.

records.japanese: からだを　おおっているのは　ホネのような　もの。\nとても　かたく　てきの　こうげきを　はねかえす。\nほらあなで　みを　ひそめ　しんかを　まっている。
records.english: Covering SHELGON's body are outgrowths\nmuch like bones. The shell is very hard\nand bounces off enemy attacks.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When awaiting evolution, this POKéMON\nhides away in a cavern.

records.japanese: ゆめにまで　みた　つばさが　やっと　はえてきた。\nうれしい　きもちを　あらわすため　おおぞらを\nとびまわり　ほのおを　はいて　よろこんでいる。
records.english: By evolving into SALAMENCE, this\nPOKéMON finally realizes its long-held\ndream of growing wings.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: To express its joy, it flies and wheels\nall over the sky while spouting flames\nfrom its mouth.

records.japanese: からだから　でている　じりょくと　ちきゅうの\nじりょくを　はんぱつさせて　ちゅうに　うかぶ。\nおしりの　ツメを　がけに　くいこませて　ねむる。
records.english: BELDUM keeps itself floating by\ngenerating a magnetic force that\nrepels earth's natural magnetism.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors\nitself to a cliff using the hooks on\nits rear.

records.japanese: ２ひきの　ダンバルが　がったいしたとき　２つの\nのうが　じりょくの　しんけいで　むすばれる。\nうでを　うしろへ　まわし　こうそくで　いどう。
records.english: When two BELDUM fuse together, METANG\nis formed. The brains of the BELDUM are\njoined by a magnetic nervous system.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON turns its arms to the rear\nfor traveling at high speed.

records.japanese: ２ひきの　メタングが　がったいした　すがた。\nきょたいで　えものを　おさえつけながら\nおなかに　ある　おおきな　くちで　たべるのだ。
records.english: METAGROSS is the result of two METANG\nachieving fusion. When hunting, this\nPOKéMON pins the prey to the ground

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: under its massive body. It then eats\nthe helpless victim using the large \nmouth on its stomach.

records.japanese: からだを　つくっている　がんせきは　すべて\nちがう　とちから　ほりだされた　ものであると\nさいきんの　けんきゅうで　はんめいした。
records.english: REGIROCK's body is composed entirely of\nrocks. Recently, a study made the\nstartling discovery that the rocks

records.japanese: [NULL]
マイナス２００どの　れいきが　からだを　つつむ。\nちかづいた　だけでも　こおりついて　しまうぞ。\nマグマでも　とけない　こおりの　からだを　もつ。
records.english: REGICE cloaks itself with frigid air of\nnegative 328 degrees F.\nThings will freeze solid just by going

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: near this POKéMON.\nIts icy body is so cold, it will not melt\neven if it is immersed in magma.

records.japanese: むかし　ひとによって　ふういんされた　ポケモン。\nからだを　つくる　きんぞくは　ちきゅうじょうに\nそんざいしない　ぶっしつと　かんがえられている。
records.english: REGISTEEL was imprisoned by people\nin ancient times.\nThe metal composing its body is thought

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: to be a curious substance that is not\nof this earth.

records.japanese: ちのうが　たかく　ひとの　ことばを　りかいする。\nガラスの　ような　うもうで　からだを　つつみこみ\nひかりを　くっせつさせて　すがたを　かえる。
records.english: LATIAS is highly intelligent and capable\nof understanding human speech.\nIt is covered with a glass-like down.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: The POKéMON enfolds its body with its\ndown and refracts light to alter its\nappearance.

records.japanese: やさしい　こころの　もちぬしにしか　なつかない。\nうでを　おりたたむと　くうきていこうが　へって\nジェットき　よりも　はやく　そらを　とべるぞ。
records.english: LATIOS will only open its heart to a\nTRAINER with a compassionate spirit.\nThis POKéMON can fly faster than a jet

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: plane by folding its forelegs to minimize\nair resistance.

records.japanese: おおあめと　おおなみで　だいちを　おおい　うみを\nひろげた　ポケモンと　しんわで　かたられている。\nグラードンと　しとうの　すえ　ねむりに　ついた。
records.english: KYOGRE is named in mythology as the\nPOKéMON that expanded the sea by\ncovering the land with torrential rains

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: and towering tidal waves.\nIt took to sleep after a cataclysmic\nbattle with GROUDON.

records.japanese: あまぐもを　ふきはらい　ひかりと　ねつで　みずを\nじょうはつさせる　ちからを　もつ　ポケモン。\nこうずいに　くるしむ　ひとびとを　すくった。
records.english: GROUDON has the power to scatter rain\nclouds and make water evaporate with\nlight and heat.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It came as a savior to people who had\nbeen suffering from terrible floods.

records.japanese: なんおくねんも　いきつづけていると　いわれる。\nくもの　うえに　ひろがる　オゾンそうの　なかを\nとんでいるため　だれも　はっけん　できなかった。
records.english: RAYQUAZA is said to have lived for\nhundreds of millions of years in the\nearth's ozone layer, above the clouds.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: Its existence had been completely\nunknown because it lived so high in\nthe sky.

records.japanese: きよらかな　こえで　うたを　きかせて　あげると\n１０００ねんの　ねむりから　めを　さます。\nひとの　ねがいを　なんでも　かなえると　いう。
records.english: JIRACHI will awaken from its sleep of\na thousand years if you sing to it in a\nvoice of purity.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: It is said to make true any wish that\npeople desire.

records.japanese: うちゅうウィルスから　たんじょうした　ポケモン。\nちのうが　たかく　ちょうのうりょくを　あやつる。\nむねの　すいしょうたいから　レーザーを　だす。
records.english: DEOXYS emerged from a virus that came\nfrom space. It is highly intelligent and\nwields psychokinetic powers.

records.japanese: [NULL]
records.english: This POKéMON shoots lasers from the\ncrystalline organ on its chest.

てや　しっぽなどを　つかい\nてきを　はたいて　こうげき
records.english: Pounds the foe with\nforelegs or tail.

records.japanese: チョップで　てきを　こうげき\nきゅうしょに　あたりやすい
records.english: A chopping attack with a\nhigh critical-hit ratio.

records.japanese: てきを　おうふくビンタで\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: Repeatedly slaps the foe\n2 to 5 times.

records.japanese: てきを　れんぞくで　なぐりつけ\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: Repeatedly punches the foe\n2 to 5 times.

records.japanese: ものすごい　ちからをこめた　パンチで\nてきを　なぐって　こうげき
records.english: A strong punch thrown with\nincredible power.

records.japanese: こばんをなげて　てきを　こうげき\nせんとうごに　おかねが　てにはいる
records.english: Throws coins at the foe.\nMoney is recovered after.

records.japanese: ほのおをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　やけどさせることがある
records.english: A fiery punch that may burn\nthe foe.

records.japanese: れいきをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　こおらせることがある
records.english: An icy punch that may\nfreeze the foe.

records.japanese: でんげきをこめた　パンチで　こうげき\nてきを　まひさせることがある
records.english: An electrified punch that\nmay paralyze the foe.

records.japanese: するどいツメを　つかい\nてきを　ひっかいて　こうげき
おおきなハサミを　つかい\nてきを　はさんで　こうげき
records.english: Grips the foe with large and\npowerful pincers.

records.japanese: おおきなハサミを　つかって\nてきを　はさみ　せんとうふのうにする
records.english: A powerful pincer attack\nthat may cause fainting.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　かぜのやいばを　つくり\nつぎのターンで　てきを　こうげき
records.english: A 2-turn move that strikes\nthe foe on the 2nd turn.

records.japanese: たたかいの　おどりを　おどって\nこうげきを　グーンとあげる
records.english: A fighting dance that\nsharply raises ATTACK.

records.japanese: するどいカマや　ツメなどを　つかって\nてきを　きりつけて　こうげき
records.english: Cuts the foe with sharp\nscythes, claws, etc.

records.japanese: つばさで　つよいかぜを　おこし\nそれを　てきにぶつけて　こうげき
records.english: Strikes the foe with a gust\nof wind whipped up by wings.

records.japanese: つばさを　おおきく　ひろげて\nそのまま　てきに　たいあたりする
records.english: Strikes the foe with wings\nspread wide.

records.japanese: つよいかぜで　てきを　ふきとばす\nふきとばすと　せんとうは　おわる
records.english: Blows away the foe with\nwind and ends the battle.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　そらに　とびたって\nつぎのターンで　てきを　こうげき
records.english: Flies up on the first turn,\nthen strikes the next turn.

records.japanese: ２ー５ターンのあいだ　ながいからだや\nつるを　つかって　てきを　しめつける
records.english: Binds and squeezes the foe\nfor 2 to 5 turns.

records.japanese: ながいシッポや　ツルなどを\nてきに　たたきつけて　こうげき
records.english: Slams the foe with a long\ntail, vine, etc.

records.japanese: ムチのように　ほそながい　つるを\nてきに　たたきつけて　こうげき
records.english: Strikes the foe with\nslender, whiplike vines.

records.japanese: おおきなあしで　ふみつけて　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
records.english: Stomps the enemy with a big\nfoot. May cause flinching.

records.japanese: ２ほんの　あしをつかって　てきを\n２かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: A double-kicking attack\nthat strikes the foe twice.

records.japanese: ものすごい　ちからをこめた　キックで\nてきを　けっとばして　こうげき
records.english: An extremely powerful kick\nwith intense force.

records.japanese: ジャンプした　いきおいで　キックを\nくりだす　はずすと　ダメージをうける
records.english: A strong jumping kick. May\nmiss and hurt the kicker.

records.japanese: からだを　すばやく　１かいてんさせ\nそのいきおいで　キックを　くりだす
records.english: A fast kick delivered from\na rapid spin.

records.japanese: てきの　かおなどに　すなをかけて\nめいちゅうりつを　さげさせる
records.english: Reduces the foe's accuracy\nby hurling sand in its face.

records.japanese: あたまから　つっこんで　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
records.english: A ramming attack that may\ncause flinching.

records.japanese: とがった　つのを　つかい\nてきを　つついて　こうげき
とがった　つのなどを　つかい\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: Jabs the foe 2 to 5 times\nwith sharp horns, etc.

records.japanese: つのを　ドリルのように　かいてんさせ\nてきを　つつき　せんとうふのうにする
records.english: A one-hit KO attack that\nuses a horn like a drill.

records.japanese: からだぜんたいを　つかって\nてきに　たいあたりして　こうげき
records.english: Charges the foe with a full-\nbody tackle.

records.japanese: からだごと　たおれこんで　こうげき\nてきを　まひさせることがある
records.english: A full-body slam that may\ncause paralysis.

records.japanese: ２ー５ターンのあいだ　ながいからだや\nツルをつかって　てきを　しめつける
records.english: Wraps and squeezes the foe\n2 to 5 times with vines, etc.

records.japanese: いきおいをつけて　てきに　たいあたり\nじぶんもすこし　ダメージをうける
records.english: A reckless charge attack\nthat also hurts the user.

records.japanese: ２ー３ターンのあいだ　あばれつづける\nあばれたあとは　こんらんしてしまう
records.english: A rampage of 2 to 3 turns\nthat confuses the user.

records.japanese: いのちをかけて　てきに　たいあたり\nじぶんもすこし　ダメージをうける
records.english: A life-risking tackle that\nalso hurts the user.

records.japanese: てきに　しっぽをふって　ゆだんさせて\nぼうぎょを　さげさせる
records.english: Wags the tail to lower the\nfoe's DEFENSE.

records.japanese: どくのある　ハリや　つので　こうげき\nてきに　どくをあたえることがある
records.english: A toxic attack with barbs,\netc., that may poison.

records.japanese: りょうての　ハリを　つかって\nてきを　２かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: Stingers on the forelegs\njab the foe twice.

records.japanese: するどいハリを　てきに　はっしゃして\n２ー５かい　れんぞくで　こうげき
records.english: Sharp pins are fired to\nstrike 2 to 5 times.

records.japanese: てきを　にらんで　おびえさせて\nぼうぎょを　さげさせる
records.english: Frightens the foe with a\nleer to lower DEFENSE.

records.japanese: するどい　はで　かみついて　こうげき\nてきを　ひるませることがある
records.english: Bites with vicious fangs.\nMay cause flinching.

records.japanese: かわいくないて　てきを　ゆだんさせて\nこうげきを　さげさせる
records.english: Growls cutely to reduce the\nfoe's ATTACK.

records.japanese: ほえて　てきを　にげださせる\nてきが　にげると　せんとうは　おわる
records.english: Makes the foe flee to end\nthe battle.

records.english: Poisons the foe\nwith a toxin that\ngradually worsens.

records.japanese: あられを　ふらして\nこおりタイプ　いがいに\nダメージを　あたえる
records.english: Summons a hailstorm\nthat hurts all\ntypes except ICE.

records.japanese: からだを　きたえて\nこうげきと　ぼうぎょの\nちからを　あげる
records.english: Bulks up the body\nto boost both\nATTACK & DEFENSE.

records.japanese: タネを　２ー５かい\nれんぞくで　はっしゃして\nてきを　こうげきする
records.english: Shoots 2 to 5 seeds\nin a row to strike\nthe foe.

records.japanese: ポケモンによって　てきに\nあたえる　ダメージの\nりょうが　へんかする
５ターンの　あいだ\nほのおタイプの\nわざのいりょくが　あがる
records.english: Raises the power of\nFIRE-type moves\nfor 5 turns.

records.japanese: あいてを　おこらせて\nこうげきわざ　しか\nだせない　ように　する
records.english: Enrages the foe so\nit can only use\nattack moves.

records.japanese: れいきを　はっしゃして\nてきを　こうげきする\nこおらせる　ことがある
records.english: Fires an icy cold\nbeam that may\nfreeze the foe.

records.japanese: ゆきを　つよいかぜに\nのせて　こうげきする\nこおらせる　ことがある
records.english: A vicious snow-and-\nwind attack that\nmay freeze the foe.

records.japanese: ダメージは　おおきいが\nつかうと　つぎのターン\nうごけなく　なってしまう
ひかりのかべを　つくり\nとくこうの　ダメージを\nよわめる
records.english: Creates a wall of\nlight that lowers\nSP. ATK damage.

records.japanese: そのターンの　こうげきを\nうけないが　れんぞくして\nだすと　しっぱいしやすい
records.english: Negates all damage,\nbut may fail if used\nin succession.

records.japanese: ５ターンの　あいだ\nみずタイプの\nわざのいりょくが　あがる
records.english: Raises the power of\nWATER-type moves\nfor 5 turns.

records.japanese: あたえた　ダメージの\nはんぶんの　たいりょくを\nかいふく　できる
records.english: Recovers half the\nHP of the damage \nthis move inflicts.

records.japanese: ふしぎな　ちからに\nまもられて　とくしゅ\nじょうたいに　ならない
ポケモンが　なついて\nいないほど　あたえる\nダメージが　あがる
records.english: The less the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　ひかりを\nきゅうしゅうして　つぎの\nターンに　こうげきする
records.english: Absorbs sunlight in\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.

records.japanese: かたいシッポで　こうげき\nてきの　ぼうぎょを\nさげる　ことがある
records.english: Slams the foe with\na hard tail. It may\nlower DEFENSE.

records.japanese: でんげきを　あびせる\nあたった　てきを\nまひさせる　ことがある
records.english: A powerful electric\nattack that may\ncause paralysis.

records.japanese: かみなりを　おとす\nあたった　てきを\nまひさせる　ことがある
records.english: Strikes the foe\nwith a thunderbolt.\nIt may paralyze.

records.japanese: じめんを　つよく　ゆらす\nとんでいる　てきいがいに\nだいダメージを　あたえる
records.english: Causes a quake\nthat has no effect\non flying foes.

records.japanese: ポケモンが　なついて\nいるほど　あたえる\nダメージが　あがる
records.english: The more the user\nlikes you, the more\npowerful this move.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　じめんに\nもぐり　つぎのターンに\nてきを　こうげきする
records.english: Digs underground\nthe 1st turn, then\nstrikes next turn.

records.japanese: つよい　ねんりきを　だす\nてきの　とくぼうを\nさげる　ことがある
records.english: A powerful psychic\nattack that may\nlower SP. DEF.

records.japanese: くろいかたまりを　なげる\nてきの　とくぼうを\nさげる　ことがある
records.english: Hurls a dark lump\nat the foe. It may\nlower SP. DEF.

records.japanese: ひかりのかべ　などを\nこわして　てきに　　\nダメージを　あたえられる
records.english: Destroys barriers\nlike LIGHT SCREEN\nand causes damage.

records.japanese: ぶんしんを　つくって\nてきを　まどわせて\nかいひりつを　あげる
ひかりのかべを　つくり\nぶつり　こうげきの\nダメージを　よわめる
records.english: Creates a wall of\nlight that weakens\nphysical attacks.

records.japanese: ぜったいに　よけられない\nすばやさで　てきに\nでんげきを　あびせる
records.english: Zaps the foe with a\njolt of electricity\nthat never misses.

records.japanese: ほのおを　まきちらす\nあたった　てきを\nやけどさせる　ことがある
records.english: Looses a stream of\nfire that may burn\nthe foe.

records.japanese: ヘドロを　なげつける\nあたった　てきに　どくを\nあたえることが　ある
records.english: Hurls sludge at the\nfoe. It may poison\nthe foe.

records.japanese: すなあらしを　おこして\nまいターン　てきに\nダメージを　あたえる
records.english: Causes a sandstorm\nthat hits the foe\nover several turns.

records.japanese: だいの　もじで　すべてを\nやきつくす　こうげき\nやけどさせる　ことがある
records.english: A powerful fire\nattack that may\nburn the foe.

records.japanese: いわで　てきの　うごきを\nふうじて　こうげき\nすばやさを　さげられる
records.english: Stops the foe from\nmoving with rocks.\nMay lower SPEED.

records.japanese: すばやい　うごきで　\nぜったいに　よけられない\nこうげきを　する
records.english: An extremely fast\nattack that can't\nbe avoided.

records.japanese: てきが　おなじわざを\nれんぞくで　だせない\nようにする
records.english: Prevents the foe\nfrom using the same\nmove in a row.

records.japanese: どく　まひ　やけどのとき\nこうげきの　ちからを\nあげる　ことが　できる
たたかう　ばしょに　より\nてきに　あたえる\nついか　こうかが　かわる
records.english: Adds an effect to\nattack depending\non the location.

records.japanese: ２ターンねむり　からだの\nいじょうと　たいりょくを\nぜんかいふく　する
records.english: The user sleeps for\n2 turns to restore\nhealth and status.

records.japanese: オスなら　メスに\nメスなら　オスに\nわざが　だしにくくなる
records.english: Makes it tough to\nattack a foe of the\nopposite gender.

records.japanese: こうげきちゅうに　すきを\nみて　てきが　もっている\nどうぐを　ぬすむ
records.english: While attacking,\nit may steal the\nfoe's held item.

records.japanese: かたいつばさを　おおきく\nひろげて　そのまま\nてきに　たいあたりする
records.english: Spreads hard-edged\nwings and slams\ninto the foe.

records.japanese: わざを　だした　ターンに\nじぶんと　てきの\nとくせいを　いれかえる
records.english: Switches abilities\nwith the foe on the\nturn this is used.

records.japanese: てきが　つかおうとした\nわざを　うばって\nじぶんに　つかう
records.english: Steals the effects\nof the move the foe\nis trying to use.

records.japanese: フルパワーで　こうげき\nできるが　とくこうが\nガクッと　さがってしまう
records.english: Enables full-power\nattack, but sharply\nlowers SP. ATK.

records.japanese: カマや　ツメなどの\nするどいもので　てきを\nきりつけて　こうげきする
records.english: Attacks the foe\nwith sharp blades\nor claws.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　そらへとび\nつぎの　ターンに　てきを\nこうげきする
records.english: Flies up on the\nfirst turn, then\nattacks next turn.

records.japanese: みずに　なみを　おこし\nそれを　ものすごい\nちからで　たたきつける
records.english: Creates a huge\nwave, then crashes\nit down on the foe.

records.japanese: ぜんしんに　ものすごい\nちからを　ためこみ\nてきを　こうげきする
つよい　ひかりで　めを\nくらませて　てきの\nめいちゅうりつを　さげる
records.english: Looses a powerful\nblast of light that\nreduces accuracy.

records.japanese: いわをもくだく　ちからで\nてきの　ぼうぎょを\nさげる　ことがある
records.english: A rock-crushingly\ntough attack that\nmay lower DEFENSE.

records.japanese: たきを　さかのぼるような\nいきおいで　てきに\nとっしんする
records.english: Attacks the foe\nwith enough power\nto climb waterfalls.

records.japanese: １ターンめで　みずに　\nもぐり　つぎのターンで\nてきを　こうげきする
records.english: Dives underwater\nthe 1st turn, then\nattacks next turn.

records.japanese: すごいアピールに　なるが　このあと\nさいごまで　なにも　できなくなる
records.english: Makes a great appeal, but\nallows no more to the end.

records.japanese: つづけて　だしても　しんさいんに\nあきられずに　アピール　できる
records.english: Can be repeatedly used\nwithout boring the JUDGE.

records.japanese: ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\n１ど　くらいは　がまんできる
records.english: Can avoid being startled\nby others once.

records.japanese: ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\nがまんできる
ほかの　ポケモンに　おどかされても\nすこし　くらいなら　がまんできる
records.english: Can avoid being startled\nby others a little.

records.japanese: この　わざを　だした　あとは\nあまり　びっくり　しなくなる
records.english: After this move, the user is\nless likely to be startled.

records.japanese: じぶんの　まえに　アピールした\nポケモンを　ちょっと　おどろかす
アピールが　おわっている　ポケモン\nみんなを　ちょっと　おどろかす
records.english: Slightly startles those\nthat have made appeals.

records.japanese: じぶんの　まえに　アピールした\nポケモンを　おどろかす
records.english: Startles the POKéMON that\nappealed before the user.

records.japanese: アピールが　おわっている　ポケモン\nみんなを　おどろかす
records.english: Startles all POKéMON that\nhave done their appeals.

records.japanese: じぶんの　まえに　アピールした\nポケモンを　かなり　おどろかす
アピールが　おわっている　ポケモン\nみんなを　かなり　おどろかす
records.english: Badly startles those that\nhave made appeals.

records.japanese: じぶんの　まえに　アピールした\nポケモンを　おどろかす
records.english: Startles the POKéMON that\nappealed before the user.

records.japanese: アピールが　おわっている　ポケモン\nみんなを　おどろかす
records.english: Startles all POKéMON that\nappealed before the user.

records.japanese: しんさいんの　ほかの　ポケモンへの\nちゅうもくを　そらすことが　できる
しんさいんに　ちゅうもく　されている\nポケモンを　とくに　おどろかす
records.english: Startles the POKéMON that\nhas the JUDGE's attention.

records.japanese: みんなの　じゃまを　しまくって\nつぎの　アピールは　さんか　しない
records.english: Jams the others, and misses\none turn of appeals.

records.japanese: おなじ　タイプの　アピールを　した\nポケモンを　とくに　おどろかす
records.english: Startles POKéMON that\nmade a same-type appeal.

一个新手训练家吧？\p你知道宝可梦训练家
到达新城镇时会做什么吗？\p他们会先看看城镇里
有什么样的道馆。
看到了吗？\n这就是橙华市的道馆。
这就是道馆的标志。\n当你要找道馆时，请留意它。
我的脸倒映在水中。\p那是一张充满希望的闪亮笑容...\p或者可能是一张与恐惧抗争、\n沉默的严肃面容...\p你从自己的脸中看到了什么？
假如你有六只宝可梦，\n如果你再捕获一只的话...\p它会通过电脑连接\n自动传送到盒子中。
橙华市宝可梦道馆\n馆主: 千里\l“追求强大力量的男人！”
这里是橙华市\n“人与自然沟通的城市。”
我是努力家！\n我会努力卖给你\l你所需要的东西！
表现得非常出色！\p作为奖励，请给它\n这枚努力奖章。
你得再多加把劲儿。\p如果你做到了，我会\n给你的宝可梦一样好东西。
哦！你的[buffer1]，\n那枚努力奖章\l戴在它身上真好看！
灯塔的光芒能够照射到\n数百里开外的地方。\p不知大海里的宝可梦，\n会不会被这光吓到呢。
啊，快看这个！\p这附近采到的海草\n既新鲜又充满活力。\p哎呀，看起来简直像是\n直起身子攻击过来一样！

水源洁净的地方，
必有丰饶的物产汇聚。\p而人群汇聚之处，
很快便会形成集市。\p这就是城镇诞生
与成长的由来。
伴随着阵阵海风的气息，\n享受购物的乐趣...\p凯那市真是个\n美妙的地方啊！
玩偶或坐垫放在地板上\n会被弄脏的。\p我打算去买一些地砖，\n这样我的玩偶和坐垫\l放在外面就不会被弄脏了。
太好了！我等这一刻太久了！\n宝可梦华丽大赛！\l我要去参加！\p不过在参加之前，\n我得先捕获一些宝可梦！
呼...真是累死我了...\p我从紫堇市一路徒步过来的。\n但是，天呐，这个城市真够大呀。\p早知道这样，\n我就骑自行车来了。
楠木，\n是开设这所博物馆的人，\l恰好也是深海探险队的队长。\p大家都叫他楠木馆长。
那边是怎么回事？\n排了这么长的队...
当我还是个孩子的时候，\n我经常去博物馆。\p在参观展览后，我常常会\n遐想着海洋的神秘。
喂，别挤了！\n没看见这里在排队吗？
[Team1]的方针\n是在行动地点集合和解散。
我们的老大聪明绝顶。\p不过他现在\n要拿博物馆做什么呢？
新计划会是什么呢？\p我们老大生气时非常可怕，\n我最好别搞砸了...
如果博物馆里有我们需要的，\n我们就会把它们全部抢走！
嗯？好长的队伍啊。\p这让我想起了以前排队\n买热门游戏的日子...
我们为啥要排队买票？\n直接冲进去不就行了？
大海真是广阔啊...\p大海会不会是由宝可梦的泪水\n汇聚而成的呢？
你知道那些老旧到\n无法航行的船会怎么处理吗？\p它们会被沉入海底，\n成为宝可梦的栖息地。
每次我来这里，\n都会忍不住买一堆东西。
如果想更改你的宝可梦的昵称，\n就去找姓名鉴定师帮忙吧。
通过交换获得的宝可梦，\n你是无法更改它的昵称的。\p昵称凝聚着原来的训练家\n对那只宝可梦的情感。
最近在凯那市开设了一家\n宝可梦华丽大赛的会场。\p我打算在提升我的\n宝可梦状态后再参加。
大家必须一起努力\n让它转得更快。\p我听说，你让它转得越快，\n就能得到更好的宝可方块。
它用于制作一种\n叫做宝可方块的糖果。\p如果你给宝可梦好的宝可方块，\n它的状态会大大提升。
我本来希望是个大明星，\n这样我就能拿到签名了。\p但是被采访的人是谁？\n那不是楠木馆长吗？

当你进入狩猎地带时，\n你会获得30个狩猎球\l用于捕获宝可梦。\p当你的狩猎球用完，或者你\n走够500步，狩猎游戏就结束了。\p进来享受狩猎地带吧！
你的零花钱不够。\n非常抱歉。
我们会通知你\n游戏结束的时间。\p所以，在那之前，\n请尽情享受吧！\l开始你的野外探险吧！
打扰一下！\n你的电脑盒子已满。
打扰了！\n你似乎没有携带宝可方块盒。\p使用宝可方块盒会让\n你的狩猎之旅更加富有成果。\p请带着宝可方块盒再来吧。
你还有时间。\n现在就要离开狩猎地带吗？
请继续享受你的野外冒险！
好的。\p我会收回你剩余的狩猎球。\p感谢你的参与。\n我们期待与你再次相见。
祝你好运！\p如果有任何需要，\n请随时告诉我！
你知道吗？\p如果你在那个方盒子里\n放一个宝可方块，\l宝可梦们就会聚集过来。
我想继续深入，\n但我忘了带自行车。\p我有种预感，稀有宝可梦\n生活在偏远的地带。
有时候，当我向宝可梦投掷\n宝可方块时，它会将其无视。\p宝可梦对它们的食物\n有偏好吗？
呼...呼...\n我..总算到这里了..但是。\p我太累了...已经没有力气\n去捕获宝可梦了...
我正在寻找在丰缘地区\n找不到的水属性宝可梦。\l你知道那个湖在哪里吗？
我要在这里\n抓很多稀有的宝可梦，\l然后和我的朋友们交换！
我在宝可方块喂食器上放了\n一个宝可方块，但它似乎不见了。\p我想宝可梦一定是\n趁我没注意把它吃掉了。
狩猎地带训练家小贴士！\p对野生宝可梦投掷宝可方块，\n让它们不那么容易逃跑。
我没有宝可方块，\n但我抓到了不少宝可梦。\p你可以在扔出狩猎球之前\n靠近它们，来提高捕获成功率。
如果你使用宝可方块，\n野生宝可梦就不会那么快逃跑了。\p给那些不易逃跑的宝可梦\n喂宝可方块并无太大用处。
如果你在喂食器放个宝可方块，\n宝可梦们会被它吸引。\p我认为有着相同性格的宝可梦\n会被某种特定宝可方块所吸引。
这张桌子最低赌注为[buffer1]。\n你要玩吗？
用方向键来下注，\n下好后按A键。
你的代币盒已经满了！\n代币可以兑换奖品。
我对大的[buffer1]很感兴趣。\n越大越好。\p嗯？你有[buffer1]吗？\n请、请给我看看！
哇，天哪，这只可真大！\n这真是只巨大的[buffer1]！\p谢谢你给我看。\n这是我的谢礼！
嗯？\n你的包包已经塞得满满的了。
嗯...我见过\n比这只更大的[buffer1]。
哦，这可真有点意思...\n但它不是[buffer1]！
你没有大的[buffer1]吗？\n那真是太遗憾了...\p如果你得到了只大[buffer1]，\n请拿来给我看看。
小田卷博士：啊，[玩家][占位符]！\p你是来给我看你的\n宝可梦图鉴进展如何的吗？
嗯？哦，你捕获的宝可梦\n对于评鉴来说还不够多。
嗯...\p所以，你已经见过[buffer1]只宝可梦，\n并且捕获了[buffer2]只宝可梦...
你应该多去草丛，\n更仔细地寻找宝可梦。
我猜你已经开始上手了。\n但是，从这里开始会更难。
有些宝可梦只在特定区域出现。\n你需要坚持不懈。
嗯，虽然数量上还能更多，\n但现在看起来\l更像是宝可梦图鉴了。
进展得相当不错。\n继续努力吧。
你用过了钓竿吗？\n海里有非常多的宝可梦。
与其只是捕获宝可梦，\n不如让它们进化怎么样？
这将会是一部\n很棒的宝可梦图鉴。\l这就是我的感觉。
你已经收集了这么多...\n你的天赋真是非凡！
你去过狩猎地带了吗？\p我听说那里有一些\n只在那里能捕获到的宝可梦。
你终于达到了100种的里程碑。\n这是一本令人印象深刻的\l宝可梦图鉴！
对石头使用碎岩，\n可能会有宝可梦出现。
你应该与其他玩家连接交换\n来获得更多的宝可梦。
我听说过，宝可梦与它们的\n训练家足够亲密时会进化。
我没想到丰缘地区\n会有这么多种宝可梦。
有时，一些宝可梦\n会在野外大量出现。\l不要错过这样的机会。
查看你的宝可梦图鉴，\n可以很好地了解到\l丰缘地区的宝可梦。
我觉得你已经称得上是\n宝可梦博士了，而且还是位\l博士中的佼佼者！
将宝可梦图鉴填充这么完整，\n你在这方面真是个专家了！
你离完成宝可梦图鉴很近了。\n我能从骨子里感觉到！
恭喜！\n你完成了丰缘宝可梦图鉴！
嗯嗯...\n从全国图鉴范围内来看...\p你已经见过[buffer1]只宝可梦，\n并且已经捕获[buffer2]只宝可梦...
这里是宝可梦ID抽奖角。\p所有光临我们百货公司的顾客\n都可以抽取一张宝可梦抽奖券。\p如果抽奖券的号码与您带着的\n任何宝可梦的ID No.匹配，\l您将获得一份精美的礼物。\p您要抽取一张宝可梦抽奖券吗？
抽奖券的号码是[buffer1]。\p我需要检查这个号码是否\n与你宝可梦的IDNo。匹配。\l请稍等。
恭喜！\p你队伍的里的[buffer1]\nID No.与你的抽奖券号码匹配！
恭喜！\p你的电脑盒子里的[buffer1]\nID No.与你的抽奖券号码匹配！
很抱歉。\n没有匹配的ID No.。
两位数字匹配，\n所以你中了三等奖！\l你赢得了[buffer1]！
三位数字匹配，\n所以你中了二等奖！\l你赢得了[buffer1]！
四位数字匹配，\n所以你中了一等奖！\l你赢得了[buffer1]！
天哪，五位数字都匹配了！\n你中了头等奖！\l你赢得了[buffer1]！
哦？\n看来你的包包没有空间了。\p请腾出一些包包空间，\n然后再来找我吧。
[玩家]？\n是的，我一直在等你。\p这是我们为你准备的奖品。
爸爸：[玩家]！见到你真高兴！\n这里有封给你的信，[玩家]。
爸爸：我猜这是一张船票。\n但我以前从来没见过这艘船。\p你应该去水静市查清楚\n这是怎么回事。
开往凯那市的客船是...\p哦？\n那张船票是...

哎，伙计，你就是那个
带来那张超奇怪船票的人吗？\p我告诉你，你要去的是
南方很远的一个小岛。\p到了那里会遇到些什么，
谁也说不准，唉。\l这可让我胆战心惊！\p全体上船！
哎，伙计，\n这个不起眼的小岛上\l没什么好看的，也没啥可做的。\p要不咱们\n还是回水静市吧？
好的，那么！\n我们这就启航回家！
“万般梦境，皆为另一重现实。\n此理恒久，切莫忘却...”
“当记忆渐趋朦胧，\n唯愿将其铭刻于心底...”
爸爸：嗨，[玩家]！\p我刚收到一颗非常稀有的树果。\n我想把它送给你。
如果你看到有树果\n在肥沃的土壤里生长，\l可以随意采摘。\p但请在原地再种下一颗树果。\n这是基本的礼貌。\p来，我把这个分享给你。

看你的样子，
你一定是训练家吧？\p训练家常让宝可梦
携带树果。\p是选择种植树果还是使用它们，
这都取决于你。
我给植株浇了好多好多水！\n开了好多好多花！\l然后结了很多很多树果！\p给你！\n这个你可以收下！
我会非常努力，\n做一些红色的宝可方块！\p希望你也加油！
我在想，今天要找\n什么颜色的树果呢？
我正在收集树果，这样\n我就能取得华丽大赛优胜了。\p如果你愿意，\n我可以给你分一个。
我今天该种什么树果呢？\n该做什么颜色的宝可方块呢？\p为这些事情烦恼\n也是一种乐趣呢。

摇晃一下盒子，
就会掉出一个宝可方块...\p然后那个宝可方块
被宝可梦抓着吃掉...\p这是一种爱的表达，
不是吗？
对的，对的。\n你明白我的意思。\p你应该收下这个。
哦...不过我想，形成\n你自己的印象也很重要...\p你可以拿这个。
我认为这个树果很稀有。\n希望你能用心培育它。
我会从树果名人那里\n得到更多的树果。
说到底...\n就像西装与我相得益彰，\l清爽的海风也极衬大海。\p而你，和树果堪称绝配...\n这究竟是为什么呢？
说到底...\p那是因为你是位训练家啊！
说到底...\p正如端庄简洁于我最为合适，\n宝可方块于宝可梦也是绝配。
你可以叫我树果名人。\p我梦想着美丽的花朵\n能开遍世界，所以我种植树果\l并发给每一个人。\p也给你一个吧！
一定要去卡那兹市附近的\n圣橙华花店看看哦。\p让鲜花装点整个世界吧！
今天就到这里了。\n改天再来吧。\p让鲜花装点整个世界吧！
我丈夫种植树果的方式，\n哦，是世上最好的。\p他让我感到骄傲，真的。\p顺便问一下，孩子，\n你最近听到过什么好话吗？
啊！多么了不起的话啊！\n真是鼓舞人心！\p我想把这个送给你。
哦！这句话说得真好。\n你真是了不起。\p我想把这个送给你。
我们的四个孙子孙女\n应该比我丈夫更有成就。\p我的生活中永远充满欢乐！
你好！\p这里是圣橙华花店。\n将鲜花传遍世界吧！
[玩家][占位符]，你想要了解\n关于树果的知识吗？
你叫什么名字？\p[玩家][占位符]。\n这名字真不错。\p[玩家][占位符]，\n你想了解关于树果的知识吗？

树果只有在松软的土壤上
才能茁壮生长。\p如果你摘了一些树果，
一定要记得在松软土壤里\l再种下一颗。\p种下的树果会很快发芽长大，
开出美丽的花朵，\l然后再次结出树果。\p我希望看到整个世界
都开满美丽的花朵。\l这是我的梦想。\p请帮帮我，[玩家]。
种植树果，予世界更多花朵吧。
鲜花带给人们如此多的幸福，\n不是吗？
你好！\p你对花朵关心得越多，\n它们就会开得越美丽。\p我相信你会喜欢照料花朵的。\n你可以收下这个。

在树果正在生长时，
用吼吼鲸喷壶给它们浇水。\p哦，还有一件事。\p如果你有一段时间不采摘树果，
它们会掉到地上。\l但它们还会再次发芽。\p这不是很神奇吗？
就像它们想要活下去一样。
我在努力学习，\n以我的姐姐们为榜样。\l我也在种花！\p给你！这是送给你的！
你可以种植树果并让它长大，\n你也可以让宝可梦携带它。\p但现在有了一种机器，\n能把不同的树果混合在一起，\l制作成给宝可梦吃的糖果。\p我也想要一些糖果啊。
嗨，你叫什么名字？\p.. .. .. .. .. ..\n好的。真不错！\p我的名字叫小桐。\p我爸爸妈妈给我取这个名字，\n是希望我健康又热心肠。\l这是他们的愿望。\p你可以从这些树果里挑一个。
小桐把这个树果也给你！\n我真的很喜欢它！
我想知道你的名字里\n包含了什么样的愿望。
春、夏、秋、冬。\p如果你出生在春天，\n你会喜欢春天吗？\p如果你生于夏天，\n你会喜欢夏天吗？
然后小桐是在秋天出生的，\n所以我喜欢秋天！\p你喜欢哪个季节？
哦...\n没关系...\p我还有很多想知道的事...
你打算深入那里吗？\p能帮我带一些浅滩海盐\n和浅滩贝壳回来吗？\p如果你把这些材料带来，\n我可以为你做些好东西。
如果你给我带来\n四份浅滩海盐\l和四份浅滩贝壳，\p我就可以为你\n制作一个贝壳之铃...\p这些材料每天都能得到。
哦，嘿！\n是浅滩海盐和浅滩贝壳！\l而且数量也足够！\p你想让我用它们\n给你做一个贝壳之铃吗？
好的！\n我这就给你做一个贝壳之铃。\p......\p......\p好了！完成了！

让宝可梦拿着它吧。
它一定会喜欢的，肯定是这样。\p为什么呢？因为贝壳之铃的铃声...
是如此动人心扉！\p你每天都可以获取它的材料，
所以我能为你做更多出来。
哦...是这样啊...\n我想做一个贝壳之铃...
你的确弄到了些浅滩海盐。\n但是，现在只有这点还不够。
你的确弄到了些浅滩贝壳。\n但是，现在只有这点还不够。
如果你的包包没有空间，\n我就无法为你制作了。\p你应该腾出空间，\n然后再来找我领贝壳之铃。
摆满了各种各样的书籍。
是宝可梦杂志！\n“宝可梦之友”...\p“宝可梦绘本”...\n“可爱的宝可梦”...
这花瓶看上去很贵...\n往里面看了一眼...\p但是，它是空的。
书架上挤满了\n各种各样的宝可梦的杂志。
某种东西的蓝图？\n太复杂了！
你想要保存游戏进度吗？
已经有保存数据了。\n覆盖掉它可以吗？
正在保存中...\n请不要关闭电源！
正在保存中...\n请不要关闭电源！
正在保存中...\n请不要关闭电源！
正在保存中...\n请不要关闭电源！
此前有一份不同的游戏记录。\p覆盖这份记录可以吗？
你好！让你久等了！\p欢迎来到精灵宝可梦的世界！\p我的名字是小田卷。\p不过大家都叫我\n宝可梦博士。\p

这个世界上，
广泛生存着精灵宝可梦！\p人类与宝可梦共同生活，
有时是亲密的玩伴，\l有时是可靠的搭档。\p甚至，我们还会齐心合力，
与同伴们进行对战。\p虽然我们相处得如此亲密，
但对它们依然不算完全了解。\p实际上，宝可梦的身上
还隐藏着许多许多秘密。\p为了揭开这些未解之谜，
我一直投身于研究之中。\l这就是我身为博士的使命。\p
你是男孩子？\n还是女孩子呢？
啊，原来是这样！\p你就是即将搬到我家乡\n未白镇的[玩家][占位符]吧！\l我明白了！

好了，你准备好了吗？\p属于你自己的冒险
即将拉开序幕。\p拿出勇气，投身宝可梦的世界，
那里有梦想、冒险和友谊\l在等待着你！\p那么，我在宝可梦研究所
等着你过来哦。\p

candidates.chinese: 让一击必杀招式没有效果。
令自爆等爆炸类招式无效。
沙暴天气下提升闪避率。
有时让接触的对手麻痹。
属性变为对手招式的属性。
受火提升火属性招式威力。
不受招式的追加效果影响。
出场时降低对手的攻击。
让对手无法逃走或替换。
效果绝佳的招式才能击中。
漂起以免疫地面属性攻击。
将异常状态传染给对手。
回到队伍后治愈异常状态。
将电属性招式吸引至自身。
招式的追加效果容易出现。
发光以防止命中率降低。
出场时复制对手的特性。
让接触到自己的对手中毒。
阻止钢属性宝可梦逃走。
火、冰属性招式伤害减半。
从睡眠状态中迅速醒来。
让接触到自己的对手灼伤。
因锐利目光命中不会降低。
使出招式后下回合休息。
提高攻击但降低命中率。
有时让接触的对手着迷。
随天气变换形态与属性。
以蜕皮来治愈异常状态。
令对手吸取类招式反噬。
危机时提高草属性伤害。
危机时提高火属性伤害。
危机时提高水属性伤害。
危机时提高虫属性伤害。
防止受反作用力的伤害。
出场时令天气变得晴朗。
白色烟雾防止能力被降低。
所有天气的影响都会消失。

candidates.chinese: 这是一只新发现的宝可梦。\n目前正在调查中。
会看到它在太阳底下\n睡午觉的样子。
它的腰腿会为了支撑\n背上的花苞而变强。
据说充足的营养和阳光\n会让花儿的颜色\n变得更加鲜艳。
尾巴上的火焰代表着它的心情。\n当它开心时，\n火焰会摇曳晃动。
它会用锋利的爪子\n无情地打倒对手。
会在空中飞来飞去\n寻找强大的对手。
甲壳的作用不仅仅是\n用来保护自己。
长满蓬松毛发的\n大尾巴的颜色，会随着\n年龄的增长而越变越深。
甲壳上的喷射口\n能够精准地瞄准目标。
它的食欲很大，\n转眼间就能吃掉\n比自己身体还要大的叶子。
身体外面的壳\n有铁板那么硬。
寻找美味花蜜的能力\n非常优秀，
虽然挂在树上几乎一动不动，\n但体内却在为进化\n而忙碌地准备着。
大针蜂的领地意识非常强，\n所以为了安全起见，\n不要接近它的住处。
因为方向感非常好，\n所以无论离自己的巢穴多远，
会飞在空中巡视\n自己广阔的领地。
有着靓丽羽毛的宝可梦。
戒备心很强，\n就算睡着的时候\n也会动耳聆听周围的动静。
坚硬的牙齿越长越长，\n所以会通过啃咬岩石或大树\n来磨牙。
响亮的叫声可以\n传到1公里之外。
长长的脖子和鸟嘴\n便于捕捉土里或水中的\n猎物。
一圈圈地蜷起身体睡觉\n是因为不管敌人从\n哪个方向袭来，
勒紧时的力道非常强大。\n连铁桶都能挤扁。
会用电去电击它\n第一次看到的东西。
电力袋中的电力\n储存过多时，就会把尾巴\n贴着地面放电。
它的身体结构能不浪费地\n充分吸收水分，所以在干燥的\n沙地上生活也没问题。
身上的刺是由于皮肤\n变硬而形成的。
人们认为它是为了\n保护自己娇小的身体\n才长出了越来越强的毒针。
和伙伴或家人在一起时，\n为了避免伤及彼此\n会把刺收起来。
擅长利用\n长满硬鳞的身体将对手撞得\n弹飞起来的攻击。
牵动耳朵的肌肉十分发达，\n能随意将耳朵转动至\n任何方向。
有着比钻石还要坚硬的角。
粗尾巴的挥击有着\n能将坚固铁塔都折断的\n惊人破坏力。
在满月的夜晚\n会精力十足地玩耍。
会用翅膀像飞一样跳着走。\n就算要在水面上行走\n也没问题。
出生的时候是一根\n白色的尾巴。
能从鲜红的眼睛里\n放出奇异之光，\n自由操纵对手的心灵。
因为有着可以\n随意改变声音波长的声带，
在圆圆的大眼睛的表面，\n总是覆盖着一层\n薄薄的泪膜。
之所以白天一直待在\n阴暗的地方，是因为\n长时间受到阳光照射，
非常喜欢活物的血液。\n特别是在深夜活动的较多，
白天会把身体埋进地里，\n并用全身吸收\n土壤中的营养。
感到危险的时候，\n雌蕊放出的臭味\n会变得更加强烈，
毒花粉会引起严重的过敏。\n在丛林里就算发现了\n美丽的花朵，
从派拉斯身上吸取\n养分而长大的蘑菇\n被称为冬虫夏草。
派拉斯特会成群地贴在\n大树的根上吸取养分。
据说为了保护自己，\n变得全身长满了\n坚硬细小的体毛。
喜欢捕食被路灯灯光吸引\n而聚集在一起的小虫子。
几乎所有农户\n都在培育地鼠。
因为本来就是一体生三子，\n所以大家想的事情是一样的。
可以收起尖锐的爪子，\n蹑手蹑脚悄无声息地行走。
六根粗硬胡须的作用\n是通过感知空气流动\n来判断周围的情况。
从发挥着神奇力量的\n可达鸭身上观测到了本应只在\n睡着时才会出现的脑波，
手脚上的蹼和流线型的身体\n使它能以惊人的速度\n在水里游动。
身体颤抖，鼻息急促\n是它发怒的前兆，
暴怒会促进血液循环，\n让肌肉的力量变得更强。
嗅觉灵敏，\n只要是闻过的味道，\n不论如何都不会忘记。
据说它是一个昼夜能跑上\n10000公里距离的\n高速宝可梦。
虽然它的皮肤薄得\n能透出漩涡模样的内脏，
身体表面\n一直覆盖着一层液体，\n所以黏黏的湿湿的，
发达强韧的肌肉\n无论怎样运动\n都不会觉得疲劳。
一天有18个小时\n都在睡觉的宝可梦。
会发出能引起头痛的\n特殊阿尔法波。
因为脑袋不断变大，\n重得连脖子都无法支撑，
拥有特殊肌肉的宝可梦。\n不管怎样运动都不会疼。
锻炼过的肌肉\n硬如钢铁。
有着可以扔飞一切的力量，\n但如果是做细活，\n手臂就会缠作一团。
无论多强的攻击，\n都可以通过弯曲\n纤细柔软的身体来回避。
到了晚上就会用尾钩\n挂在树枝上睡觉。
会让长在脑袋上的藤蔓\n像小生物一样动来动去\n引诱猎物。
因为身体的绝大部分\n都是水组成的，所以离开大海后\n就会变得干巴巴的。
头上的红色珠子发光时，\n会向周围发射\n强烈的超音波。
越是长寿的小拳石，\n身上被磨掉的棱角也就越多，\n也会变得越圆。
是靠吃岩石成长的宝可梦。\n好像更喜欢吃长有苔藓的岩石。
有时候\n住在山上的隆隆岩\n在发生大地震时，
